Name: Pipeworks Ninja vs. Unicorn
Description: Ninja vs. Unicorn celebrates the epic battle between two of the biggest hop-heads of lore. Brewed with over five pounds of hops per barrel, this unfiltered double IPA is sure to please the most discerning hop lover. Whether you’re rooting for the mythical horned horse or the deadly assassin of the east, we hope you’ll enjoy Ninja vs. Unicorn. Bottle Art by Jason Burke ink & lead Designs

Name: Pipeworks Lizard King
Description: This American Pale Ale is fresh as they come and only being poured at select bars in Chicago. Brewed with Mosaic and Amarillo hops, Lizard King will be the perfect way to start (or end) your day.

Name: Pipeworks Blood Of The Unicorn
Description: In this epic battle, the Blood of the Unicorn has been shed by the sword of the deadly assassin of the east. One sip of this.aggressively hopped red ale clearly reveals what drives these, the greatest of, hop heads of lore. Is this the end of the mythical horned horse? Or will he rise like the phoenix to fight another day?

Name: Pipeworks Brief Relief
Description: What’s better than not wearing pants? Not wearing pants while enjoying a beer! So as a nod to drinking pants-less and to celebrate the insane success of Period Panties by Chicago’s Harebrained Design, we present to you Brief Relief.     Brief Relief is a Blood Orange Red Ale, filled with citrusy hops, designed to give some much-needed brief relief from whatever is currently cramping your style. Much like Period Panties, this beer gives ovary owners a well-deserved high five!

Name: Pipeworks Sangremancer Red Ale
Description: imperial red ale brewed with blood orange

Name: Pipeworks Sam Vs. Unicorn
Description: Aroma: The nose is resiny hops over sweet caramel/toffee malts, with grapefruit hop notes Appearance: It pours a hazy reddish-orange/brown with a thick, frothy beige head and good lacing Flavor: Tastes quite balanced, with the sweet malts bleeding seamlessly in the hop bitterness Palate: The body is medium-full, very smooth and easy drinking, with a clean, dry finish Overall Impression: This one poured beautifully into my boat beer glass. The frothy head rest nicely on top of the beer. A great first impression. The nose and flavor pick up right where the pour left off, with an excellent mix of sweet malt and bitter hop components. This is impressively balanced from a flavor profile perspective, and also incredibly easy drinking for a 9% beer. This is an excellent Imperial Red, right up there with some of my favorites in the "style," I would happily drink this again.

Name: Pipeworks Pineapple Bling Belgian Golden Ale
Pipeworks Soma
Description: This golden ale, brewed in collaboration with the restaurant Owen and Engine, was brewed with coconut, amchoor (dried green mangos), and jaggery (raw sugar from sugar cane and date palm tree). It's an otherworldly summer sipper. Hopped gently with grassy Hallerteau Blanc hops, this brew is a special delight.

Name: Pipeworks XO Man O War Galactic Golden Ale
Pipeworks The Mighty Thor
Description: Thor, one of our favorite four-legged friends had a big, gentle heart to match his huge, smiling, slobbering face. Jeff, Thor’s best friend and owner, says that the gentle giant would pull him in the direction of the brewery on their walks, to park it by the garage door, get some love and smell what’s cookin’. He brightened everyone’s day and is missed by all. This Imperial Porter is made in memory of the big guy. A portion of proceeds will benefit the Great Lakes Mastiff Rescue.

Name: Pipeworks Batata Obscura
Description: Inspired by the Puerto Rican dessert, nisperos de batata, this Imperial porter is crafted with the dishes core ingredients: sweet potatoes, cinnamon, clove, vanilla, and toasted coconut, and is an equatorial delight. Pipeworks is proud of our roots in Humboldt Park, grateful to neighbors like Junior of Puerto Rican Food Mart for their support. And also, we like desert.

Name: Pipeworks Easter Bunny V.S.O.P.
Description: This hoppy American style wheat wine, has a nice, full body, with a huge wheat base. We hopped this one with a surprising combination of Amarillo and Hallertau Blanc for really nice, dank aroma. We're getting tons of citrus and white grape aromas with this one.

Name: Pipeworks Cohen’s State Of Kind
Description: We're not joking around here, the jester has returned! A Foolish Wit was our original Belgian style wit beer, brewed with amchoor, (dried green mango), lemony sumac, and traditional green coriander. This is a wit that even those wielding the sharpest of tongues will enjoy. Light, bright, and full of lemony wheat flavor, this ale is ripe with mischief.

Name: Pipeworks Budapest Gambit
Description: As the season changes so does our imperial wit. Our classic Belgian style ale has been reborn, and it’s booming with lemony tart, berry-rich, hibiscus flowers as well as spicy, refreshing ginger root. Just like the spring equinox, all things are in balance with this brew.

Name: Pipeworks Elijah’s Revival
Description: A collaboration of robustious resolve. Wheat wine style ale aged with orange and spices. Ladies and gentlemen, step right up and take a pull of this desirable imbibable wonder! Now, I’m not hawking a ballyhoo for any old flukum. No, this prestidigitational flavor rambunction is brewed in inspired conjunction with Niche. Wegotcher oranger, wegotcher Mandarina Bavaria hop, wegotcher spices, wegotcher all things nices. This ale is the best on either side of the river or my name’s not Elijiah (which it is) and this is not my revival (which it is).

Name: Pipeworks A Foolish Wit
Description: We're not joking around here, the jester has returned! A Foolish Wit was our original Belgian style wit beer, brewed with amchoor, (dried green mango), lemony sumac, and traditional green coriander. This is a wit that even those wielding the sharpest of tongues will enjoy. Light, bright, and full of lemony wheat flavor, this ale is ripe with mischief.

Name: Pipeworks Zommelier
Description: Graaaaaains delicious smoked graaaaaaiiiinnnnss. The mouthwatering braaaaaaaaains behind iNG and Pipeworks have collaborated on this oak smoked wheat wine brewed with toasted black cardamon, black pepper, and lemon peel.    This collaboration with iNG is smokey, spicy with a creamy, subtle lemony finish. It's worth rising from the grave for.

Name: Pipeworks Kate’s Weirdo Wit
Description: There once was a weirdo named Kate   Who thought thai cuisine was great   She has a hunch the flavors would fit   In a refreshing wit.   Brewed with lemongrass, basil and kaffir lime,   Fermented for a time   And Goosh! A wit as weird as Kate!

Name: Pipeworks G & T
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Pipeworks Poivre Vert
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This is a beer that's very beloved here at Pdubs, and it's been a while since we've made it. When the warmer weather comes around and the temps rise in the brewhouse, there's nothing like a cold glass of this insanely refreshing brew after the day's wrapped up.

Name: Pipeworks North & Western
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: North & Western is a dry-hopped Saison style ale. Starting with a base of pilsner malt we infuse this beer with hops from around the globe, both in the boil and with a hefty dose of dry hops in the tank. The result is a complex combination of spicy yeast character with layers of floral, citrus, pone, and fruity hop notes. Drink this one fresh to get the most from the awesome bouquet of hops.

Name: Pipeworks Glaucus
Description: Glaucus is the mythological existence of a being, both man and fish, a deity amongst mere mortals. The only beer fitting of such a name marries bold, spicy Belgian yeast with bright, citric American hops in a way even the gods adore. This golden brew can calm even the harshest seas. It's been awhile since we've brewed this beer, and we couldn't be happier that it's back.

Name: Pipeworks Any Other Name Rose Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Pipeworks Nagami Equinox
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Nagami Equinox, a semi-dry Belgian golden ale brewed with honey, Mandarina Bavaria hops and 100 pounds of kumquats, pureed and added to the boil is just as refreshing as we hope'd it'd be. Brewed in collaboration with Trenchermen restaurant as part of our City Wide Collab series, we're picking up aromas of white flowers, tropical fruit, a subtle spice, and of course kumquats.

Name: Pipeworks Derketo Belgian Double IPA
Description: The little mermaid is coming at you with a nouveau take on the Imperial IPA. Blasting out of the ocean with waves of Galaxy and Amarillo hops. Derketo is as enticing as she is beautiful. But she has more tricks under her sea, with the spicy accents of Belgian wit yeast. Don’t flounder the opportunity to enjoy this massive Belgian style IPA!     "Cloudy orange with whispy white head and sticky lace. Soft yeasty nose, earthy and citrus hops, some sweetness though very clean overall. Similar flavor, lots of esters up front, some citrus and light tropical fruit character. Solid, for the style. Alcohol pretty well hidden. "

Name: Pipeworks Zombie Gnomes
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: GNOMELAND SECURITY REPORT: Gnome man, gnome woman is safe! There's been an outbreak of zombie gnomes, due to Gnomeo Sapien (if we're using proper bignomenclature) gene crossed with a mutant gene discovered during the Human Gegnome Project. Make gnome mistakes! Stay in your gnome sweet gnome. Put on a movie like E.T. Gnome Gnome, or witness Gnomi Malone's character development in Showgirls, and enjoy this smoked saison.

But the number one stunna here is the Belgian yeast, stepping with notes of pineapple, tropical fruit, and a dry tart finish. We think this beer is the shiznit. Real talk! Description: Heathens! Heed out prophesy! This imperialized milk stout brewed with cacao nibs and vanilla beans has a fiery finish form ancho chilies that will leave you en-raptured. With a fuller body, it’s perfect or judgement day or night. Don’t get left behind, armagedd-on it, and drink this apocalypse now.

Description: Begin alien transmission:"Foolish humans! You’re doomed! Doomed!Evene more doomed than we hoped! You can’t resiet the universally delicious combo of fresh mint and chocolate! Muhah! It’s time to ad-mint that there is no escape! Ok, now I’m getting charged for ’Roaming’ so I have to go. You hang up. No, what am I saying? I’m doing the fear-mongering here! I’ll hang up. Doom!" Name: Pipeworks Coconut Jones Dog Milk Stout
Description: This rich stout is brewed with cocoa nibs, lactose milk sugar and coconut

Name: Pipeworks Barrel Age Jones Dog
Description: Bottle: Dark caramel-brown & mahogany color. Basically opaque, small khaki film on top. Very, very, very boozy & very, very, very sweet on the nose. Lots of bourbon, oak, wood, vanilla, caramel crèmes, anise, brandy, toffee, butterscotch. Just smelling it is giving me a cavity. Translates to the flavor - very hot & very sweet. Borderline cloying with heavy dark fruits covered in caramel, anise, toffee, vanilla, & sticky sweet toasted malt sugars. Brown sugar lathered figs with a heavy bourbon & brandy booze aspect that burns the throat near the finish. Hot. This isn’t bad, but it needs some time to settle down. Too hot & sweet at the moment.

Name: Pipeworks Abduction Stout
Description: This was the very first Abduction - the first time the extraterrestrials got a taste of a rich, roasty, chocolatey Imperial Stout with subtle bittering hops. This specific batch is an overhaul of the original recipe. We've upped the roasty character, and brewed it bigger, and richer with a slight kiss of orange peel at the end of the boil. Be Warned: the little green men will be quick to beam this off of shelves to enjoy on their home planet.

Name: Pipeworks Close Encounter Black IPA
Description: Maybe no one believed you the last time you encountered the stellar contact between hop and roasty malt character,but succumb to a new stout trek.The imperial strikes back with a fuller body and U-F-Ohhhh so many hops. Set your phasers to stunning - because this is the most out of htis world hopped up stout on earth.

Name: Pipeworks Tropic Of Unicorn Double IPA
Description: DIPA brewed with soursop, guava and passion fruit.

Name: Pipeworks Galaxy Unicorn
Description: Our friends south of the equator really have this hop growing thing figured out and we are ecstatic they do. Without them we couldn't brig you Unicorn Galaxy. We built a platform of malted barley and wheat then atop that we constructed our ode to Galaxy hops. The hop character really shines through with aromas and flavors of tropical fruit, tangerine, citrus, passion fruit and fresh cut grass. Drink early, drink often.

Name: Pipeworks Something Hoppy This Way Comes
Description: A storm is brewing and with it comes a wicked carnival of hops. The dark carnie leader’s skin is emlazoned with many a vine, including Columbus, Cascade, and Sorachi Ace. So whether you’re a Halloway or a Nightshade, you had better run, for with this carnival, Something Hoppy This Way Comes.

Name: Pipeworks Citra IPA
Description: When ninjas take a break from their battles with the mythical unicorn, they like truly embrace their innner hop head. This particular ninja has chosen to walk the path of the Citra hop. Absolutely loaded with Citra hops, this Imperial IPA is brimming with juicy hop character from nose to palate. Enjoy a break from life’s own battles with a Citra Ninja

Name: Pipeworks Bunny & The Bird
Description: Fresh from an overseas adventure, the delightfully intrepid duo, Bunny and Bird, have teamed up to brew a splendidly hoppy English IPA with a crisp and clean English ale yeast. The brew is packed with an intriguing combination of juicy, tropical Australian Galaxy hops, and grassy, vinous German Hallertau Blanc. It's a positively tip-top combination that The Bunny and The Bird hope you will enjoy. Cheerio!

Name: Pipeworks Down Unda IPA
Description: This Imperial IPA brewed with tons of exciting Australian and New Zealand hops such as Summer, Waimea, and Wakatu, has juicy papaya and guava notes as well as a pleasant herbal aroma. Like a boomerang, we keep coming back for more of this one.

Name: Pipeworks A Real Gem Oat IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Oat IPA w/ Guava

Name: Pipeworks Passion Fruit Guppy
Description: Session Pale Ale brewed with Honey, Passion Fruit, & Citra Hops

Name: Pipeworks Cryo Citra Imperial IPA
Description: IIPA brewed with citra and cryo citra hops.

Name: Pipeworks Blood Orange Guppy IPA
Description: Session IPA brewed with honey and blood orange.

Name: Pipeworks Unicorn’s Revenge IPA
Description: This epic battle is exhausting The Unicorn. He's been at it fighting all sorts of creatures, spirits, beings from other worlds and other dimensions. If there's one thing The Unicorn hates, it's sadness. If there's another one thing The Unicorn hates, it's exhaustion. It is time The Unicorn made all others regret the day, they began this epic battle! With an intense and unexpected juicy and floral combination that can only come with generous amounts of New Zealand hops.

Name: Pipeworks Toasty Nut Abduction
Description: Sometimes you feel like a nut, sometimes you want to drink a dark, rich, delicious coconut and almond flavored beer. (Let's be honest, for us it's both...all the time.) We took our base Abduction and added cacao nibs, vanilla bean, toasted coconut and almond. The result is a deeply complex brew that will linger with you long after you're done drinking it. Delicious now but also a prime candidate for a prolonged rest in your temperature controlled catacomb of choice.

Name: Pipeworks Simcoe Ninja
Description: A new clan of Ninja is ready to do battle with your taste buds. A true warrior, the Simcoe Ninja’s only foe is the bland. With massive notes of pine and citrus, Simcoe Ninja will slash at your senses and leaves you thirsty for another bottle.

Name: Pipeworks Wolpertinger Double IPA
Description: The Wolpertinger (Crisenus bavaricus) snuck over to Pipeworks, all the way from the Belgium-Germany border, as a stowaway on a German hop shipment. While we normally frown upon invasive species, this flying, furry little guy has sunk his fangs into our hearts. To wilkommen him we’ve brewed this DIPA with a subtly spicy Belgian yeast and juicy German hops.

Name: Evil Twin Even More Jesus
Description: Few times in the history of craft beer it has happened that a highly praised beer rises beyond mortal stardom into a higher godly league. Usually the recipe to make such heavenly drops is thick fudge-like body, pitch black color, amazingly overwhelming aromas of chocolate, coffee, dark fruits and muscovado sugar, obviously only made in limited amounts and most crucial of all – it must taste rare!

Name: Evil Twin Hop Flood
Description: On a beautiful summer night in July while peaceful Danes rocked at Roskilde Festival and others sipped wine in their picturesque summer retreats, an apocalyptic tidal surge flooded the famous Ølbutikken in Copenhagen and drowned thousands of precious beer - Hop Flood is a bitter tribute to the heroic bottles that didn’t make it.

Name: Evil Twin Classique Imperiale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Perhaps you’ve heard of a Premium drop can under the name “Classique” – A cerebral nod to American industrial beers – An everyday and all-day premium brew? Well this is something entirely different – A super-exclusive, counter-culture smooth blonde imperial ale – A cerebral nod to the art of craft brewing. Please slow down and feel the pleasure of drinking small mouthfuls at a time.

Name: Evil Twin Lil B Porter
Description: Shall one compare thee to a fair beer, Not even this perfect porter before thou will do thee justice. Thou art more complex, brave and cunning. Thou have changed more than a brew will ever. Thou may be lil’, but thy mind is greater than words can speak and beer will ever taste.

Name: Evil Twin Imperial Bisscotti Break Natale
Description: Imperial Biscotti Break with sour cherries added.

Name: Evil Twin/Two Roads Two Evil Pachamama Porter
Description: Our second collaboration with Danish/Brooklyn brewery Evil Twin, Two Roads and Evil Twin have paid homage to Incan heritage by using three Peruvian staple foods in this porter: sweet potatoes, purple mais and aji panca chili peppers. Pachamama is a goddess revered by the indigenous people of the Andes; she is known as the earth mother in Inca mythology. Given that the main ingredients of the 6.5% ABV porter come from the rich Peruvian soil, the two breweries thought the name Pachamama fit this product beautifully.

Name: Evil Twin Imperial Doughnut Break
Description: Brewed for Brewvival 2013 and later bottles. Imperial Biscotti Break dry-doughnuted!!

Name: Evil Twin Imperial Wedding Cake Break Porter
Description: Imperial Porter brewed with coffee, almond and Wedding Cake

Name: Evil Twin Imperial Doughnut Maple Syrup Bourbon Barrel Aged
Description: Imperial porter aged in Maple Syrup Bourbon Barrels with doughnuts, almonds, coffee, vanilla added.

Name: Evil Twin P.H.A.T Porter
Description: Have you ever considered why some people get stuck in a certain hairstyle, dress sense or even a political view, that went out of style many years ago. They are stranded in a period of their life where they peaked as a human and desperately want to hold on to that image. Wake up, before you know it, you’re becoming an old stubborn fool. So take a good look at yourself, unless you’re sure that I’m not right.

Name: Evil Twin Double Barrel Imperial Biscotti Break
Description: Imperial Porter first aged in bourbon maple barrels, then in marsala wine barrels. NOTE: this is not the same beer as 'Imperial Biscotti Break Double Maple Barrel-Aged'

Name: Evil Twin Imperial Donut Break
Description: Did the flavors of sugar and bitter sweet almonds and coffee in Imperial Biscotti Break also make you sentimental? Now we topped it off with insane amounts of doughnuts. This all time American favorite is making it’s way back into the spotlight and we at Evil Twin Brewing are not letting a tasty trend pass us by without taking it to the next level. Drink it with great gusto - Forza Doughnuts.

Name: Evil Twin Nomader Wit
Description: Some people we know - the write about beers, and they have called those of us at Evil Twin Brewing ’nomads.’ Other people we know - they build a hotel and restaurant, and their neighborhood didn’t really have a name, so they called that ’NoMad.’ And how interesting that both nomads and those in NoMad enjoy a Brett-fermented Wit beer with notes of coriander and orange peel. So, no matter what - hit the road or hunker down... this beer was made nice, just for you.

Name: Evil Twin The Porthole
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This beer is made in collaboration with Micah Melton The Aviary and is a modest attempt to imitate The ‘Blueberry’ cocktail as it is served in The Porthole at The Aviary, Chicago. The Porthole is an equally genius and gorgeous infusion vessel designed by Martin Kastner of Crucial Detail design studio. It can be used to create striking cocktails or any other type of infusion - maybe even beer.

Name: Evil Twin Nasty Trunks Sour IPA
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Did you also like Sour Bikini - a light bodied sour pale ale? This is Nasty Trunks - a more full-bodied India Pale Ale. Expect bigger muscles, more bitterness, a beer that is desperate for attention - in other words such a nasty pair of trunks.

Name: Evil Twin Grand Cru
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Maple bourbon barrel aged stout and barleywine style ale blend

Name: Evil Twin Joey Pepper
Description: With intellectual curiosity, impeccable perfection and childlike excitement he examines, drinks and teaches the beers. His name is Joey Pepper. Maybe he is real or maybe an allegory. One thing is certain - we’ve all met him and admired his extreme commitment, laser focus and contagious behavior. Remember next time you wanna accomplish something - examine, consump and inspire like Joey Pepper. ‘Nothing great in the world has been accomplished without passion’ (G.W.F. Hegel).

Name: Evil Twin Ron And The Beast Ryan
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Ryan And The Beaster Bunny with brett.

Name: Evil Twin Ryan And The Gosling
Description: Hey girl - just listening to you talk about how the 100% brettanomyces with CMY-1, CMY-5, CMY-7, along with the mash consisting of pale 2-row, Munich II, oats, wheat and honey, together with citrus peel and juice that is added at KO, followed by fresh zest with balanced citrussy hop characteristics at whirlpool - makes me wanna drink this beer just for you.

Name: Evil Twin Fire Water
Description: Many of us have a passionate love-hate relationship with painfully spicy food and beverage - there is simply something substantial fascinating, thrilling and a little frightening about a burning sensation in your mouth. Scientists are at a loss why humans (and only humans) find such great joy in tasty pain. Perhaps it’s what makes us human - it takes a complicated brain, mixed with weird self-awareness to enjoy events that the body are programmed to treat as a threat but the mind knows better. Description: Pouring the Nomader Weisse from its can, a bright and fizzy golden body just a few shades darker than the aluminum container itself emerges, converging into a medium-sized, bristling white head that dissipates in mere moments. A cloudy, sediment-speckled murkiness lingers in the center—a characteristic feature of any Berliner Weisse. With just a slight tilt of the glass towards the face, the beer’s pungent, sour aromas of lemon and Granny Smith apple come forth, but a tinge of sweet, malty wheat curtails the dominant sour smell so as not to prematurely overwhelm the drinker.    The nose doesn’t seem to stray too far for your standard Berliner Weisse, but just after taking the first sip of the Nomader Weisse, one begins to see how Evil Twin’s Jeppe Jarnit-Bjergsø left his nomadic mark on the landscape, or in this case, the Berliner Weisse style. The tangy notes of lemon and apple, just as in the nose, playfully bite at the drinker’s teeth on contact in typical Berliner fashion. However, the Nomader soon reveals Jeppe’s modern day tinkerings with slight hints of white grape, an effect akin to transporting a German Oktoberfest in its entirety right to America: somewhat bizarre, but still delicious.

Its a blended Spontan Ale and Saison, It is 6,0% abv, It is awesome and it comes in a magnum bottle. Welcome Win Bic.   The Tasting panel Said:   Cloudy light orange with a fine foamy thick white head  Aroma – A mild spicy impression with acidic green apples, cloves and a sweetness as from dried apricots. We also find some bitterness as from lemon peel and a lactic touch. You clearly sense the saison notes as white pepper and mild various spices.  The taste blasts out the saison expressions in the beginning and we think of oxidated apples as you find in certain ciders – after that you get the lactic and sour impression that appears very refreshing and drinkable. A freshness topped with dry impressions of the barrels. You feel like another sip.  The mouth feel is not as carbonated and fizzy as in most of Mikkellers spontan beers. The palate of this lightly sparkling beer is sweet and sour with a moderate bitterness, and a discrete alcohol profile, coupled with an unusual though not unpleasant silage scent. The aroma also reveals the wooden notes from the barrels along with some burned toffee and spices like Star anise. It has a very heavy acidic profile at first, one that quickly slides into a smooth kind of sweetness. We taste green apples, carambola and very young green grapes. It has a certain lactic acidic touch and a creamy dry finish that lasts forever and bares the green impressions through. Some mild creamy blue cheese on roasted rye bread would work great due to both the lactic and acidity impressions in this beer.

Name: Mikkeller Hallo Ich Bin Berliner Weisse Passion Fruit
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Berliner-style Weisse beer brewed with Passionfruit

Name: Mikkeller Spontandryhop Simcoe
Description: Give it up for the Dry Hopped Simcoe Sour Ale - She's about to change your look on hops for good!

Name: Mikkeller Spontacassis
Description: A Casbic brewed on: water, malt, wheat, old hops, black currant and yeast. Stored on oak barrels.

Name: Mikkeller Blå Spøgelse
Description: The newest addition to the ever expanding collaboration brew list. Once again arm in arm with our FFF brothers. Blå Spøgelse, paving the way with its blueberry and oak barrel action, will knock you right off your feet.

Name: Mikkeller SpontanSeabuckthorn
Description: In the spontan series we present Spontanseabuckthorn – this time, forming an alliance with sea buckthorn that were generously added underway the brewing process, creating a truly unique and distinct, sour beer.

Name: Mikkeller Spontansourcherry
Description: Sour ale brewed with sour cherries & aged in oak barrels.

Name: Mikkeller Spontanlemon
Description: In the spontan series we present Spontanlemon – this time, forming an alliance with Lemon that were generously added underway the brewing process, creating a truly unique, distinct and very sour beer.  Aged at our barrel house in Belgium.

Name: Mikkeller Spontanwatermelon
Description: Watermelon and citrus dominate a tart, sour base with touches of funk.  You may also like...

Name: Mikkeller Hallo Ich Bin Berliner Weisse Peach
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Crisp, refreshing and tart with a mellow peachy finish.

Name: Mikkeller Hallo Ich Bin Berliner Watermelon
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Berliner-style Weisse beer brewed with Watermelon

Name: Mikkeller Fruit Face Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: a Berliner style Weisse beer brewed with raspberries and coffee

Name: Mikkeller Brand New Normal
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Mikkeller Ich Bin Berliner Weisse Blueberry
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Berliner-style Weisse beer brewed with Blueberry

Name: Mikkeller NYC Sour Pitch Suds
Description: Punch-style Sour IPA with cherry, pomegranate, key lime, pineapple, tangerine, passion fruit, lemon zest, OH MY!

Name: Mikkeller Show Me Cuvee
Description: Clear light dark brown - red amber color with a average, frothy, good lacing, mostly lasting, off-white head. Aroma is moderate to heavy malty, caramel, wood - tobacco, bread - cake, marzipan, moderate yeasty, leather - brett notes. Flavour is moderate to heavy sweet with a long duration, sweet malt, cuvee, sour apples. Body is medium, texture is oily to watery, carbonation is soft.

Name: Mikkeller Spontangreenapple
Description: Sour ale brewed with green apples and aged in oak barrels.

Name: Mikkeller Spontankriek
Description: Ale brewed with cherries and aged in wine barrels

Name: Mikkeller Its Alive! White Wine Barrel Aged
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: It’s Alive!!! Indeed it is. This Belgian Ale has been aged in White Wine barrels to give it that touch of alcohol, while the Brettanomyces give the tartness. Complex but well balanced beer.

Name: Mikkeller Spontanwildstrawberry
Description: Ale brewed with strawberries and aged in wine barrels.

Name: Mikkeller Stillwater Our Side Two Gypsy Ale
Description: Dark sour ale aged in oak barrels. A collaboration between The Bruery and Cigar City Brewing, this Imperial Oud Bruin is layered with aromas of cranberries, tropical fruits, leather, and aged balsamic, balanced by wood tannins and roasted malt.

Name: Mikkeller Uncle Mai Bpen Rai
Description: Sour Ale brewed with Pineapple and Kafir Lime Leaves

Name: Mikkeller Pom Pom Pash
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Pom Pom Pash is a Berliner-style Weisse beer brewed with copious amounts of pomegranate and passionfruit, which lend themselves towards a bright fruit-forward tartness.

Name: Mikkeller It’s My Vacation Too
Description: Gose-style Sour Brewed with Lemon

Name: Mikkeller Beer Geek Breakfast
Description: An oatmeal stout with 25.0% oat-based ingredients and a nice touch of gourmet coffee. A beer that goes extremely well with breakfast! Also good for the afternoon and the evening…  Good hints of coffee and smoke as well as dark chocolate and roasted malts. A Mikkeller classic!    – Oatmeal stout with coffee  – Brewed at Lervig  – 330 ml  – Abv: 7,5%

Name: Mikkeller San Diego Beer Geek Breakfast
Description: Oatmeal Stout with Dark horse coffee. Roast forward, a complex malt profile. Brewed at Mikkeller San Diego.

Name: Mikkeller Beer Geek Brunch
Description:
From the beer geek breakfast series – the beer that really put Mikkeller on the map – This imperial Oatmeal stout is brewed with one of the world’s most expensive coffees, made from droppings of weasel-like civet cats. The fussy Southeast Asian animal are picky and will eat nothing but the best and ripest coffee berries. Enzymes in their digestive system aid the process of breaking down the beans which brews a strong, fist-in-the-air flavored coffee.
Who would’ve thought drinking beer that started its journey travelling through the insides of a weasel, would taste this good?

Name: Mikkeller Traeblod Imperial Stout
Description: A massive Imperial Stout, blasted with an incredible amount of high-quality Vermont Maple Syrup and kissed with a moderate amount of dark roast coffee. A full serving of breakfast in a glass - decadent tree sap, roasted malt, and eggy french toast crust. Full-bodied and balanced, a unabashed symphony between sweet syrup and dark roasted coffee.

Name: Mikkeller Beer Geek Dessert
Description: From the beer geek breakfast series – the beer that really put Mikkeller on the map – we added cocoa and vanilla to the french press coffee trick, creating a whole new dimension to the beer that are loved by freaks and geeks worldwide. It’s dark, dangerous, sweet and incredibly tasty as you would expect, but most of all; it’s ready to conquer your breakfast table routines.

Name: Mikkeller 3x Flat White Oatmeal Stout
Description: Oatmeal stout brewed with coffee & lactose

Name: Mikkeller Proper Pint
Description: We meticulously replicated Dublin water to create a smooth Dry Irish-style Stout with subtly sweet aromas and a distinctly mellow roast

Name: Mikkeller Beer Geek Vanilla Maple Shake
Description:
Imagine a huge imperial stout clocking in at 13% brewed with coffee and vanilla. Then add a shitload of maple syrup. Yes! This is a real treat...

Thick, viscous, sweet vanilla and intense maple.

Name: Mikkeller Beer Geek Brunch Weasel
Description: This imperial Oatmeal stout is brewed with one of the world’s most expensive coffees, made from droppings of weasel-like civet cats. The fussy Southeast Asian animals only eat the best and ripest coffee berries. Enzymes in their digestive system help to break down the bean. Workers collect the bean-containing droppings for Civet or Weasel.

Name: Mikkeller Freddie Murkury IPA
Description: NE Style IIPA with Simcoe, Mosaic, and four octaves.

Name: Mikkeller Subway Mosaic
Description: Subway Mosaic IPA is brewed with barley, wheat, oats and hopped exclusively with Mosaic It displays a light body and bright finish, while sporting notes of mango, blueberry and citrus.

Name: Mikkeller Magic Skyway IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: IPA with Simcoe and Mosaic hops. Beautifully juicy with grapefruit notes and a slightly bitter finish.

Name: Mikkeller Ripple Effect IPA
Description: A classic foundation of citrus peel and pine aromas are backed by tropical layers and a firm dankness. Soft malt character leads way to balanced bitterness and clean dryness in finish.

Name: Mikkeller Mosaic Black IPA
Description: Don't let the color in this black IPA fool you. IPA first, dark beer second, this Danish ale is crafted with sparing amounts of dark malt, lending it lots of color but just a hint of roast, allowing mosaic hop-derived flavors of grapefruit, passionfruit, guava, pineapple, and herbs shine.

Name: Mikkeller Invasion Farmhouse IPA
Description: High up in Alaska, where the bears rule, where the winters are long and dark, and where a man is a man that digs for gold. High up north, where you only go if you are in search of happiness and easy money. Or if you are on the run from the long arm of the law.  Up there lies a brewery. In our opinion, one of the most exciting American breweries we have become familiar with for a very long time. Of course I’m talking about Anchorage Brewing Company.

Name: Mikkeller Don Graper IPA
Description: NE Style IPA brewed with Mikkel's Riesling grape juice

Name: Mikkeller Haller Atcha Boy!
Description: Hallartau Blanc was calling so we shouted back. “Haller Atcha Boy!”— A beautifully refreshing 6% IPA with Hallertau Blanc and Simcoe hops.

Name: Mikkeller Spells Double IPA
Description: An intensely hoppy pale ale with minimal malt character, designed to showcase its strong hop flavors.

Name: Mikkeller I Beat YoU
Description: Heavily hopped with Herkules, Centennial, Warrior, Amarillo, Simcoe and Columbus.

Name: Mikkeller Bumping This Thread
Description: Re: Imperial IPA with Citra and Galaxy. Bump. Following up here, any updates? Super fruity nose with big mouthfeel coming from malted wheat and flaked oats.

Name: Mikkeller Careless Island Affair
Description: Collaboration with Seven Island Brewery (Greece). Imperial IPA with Lactose DDH w/Citra, Mosaic and Wai'iti hops

Name: Mikkeller Mosaic Imperial IPA
Description: Poured with a white head this clear amber coloured beer has a nice aroma of pineapple, citrus fruits and crispy hops. The Mosaic hop adds a high bitterness while giving a nice fruity taste. Neatly carbonated and at 8.9 abv serves you well when you want that full, hoppy and fruity taste. Easy to drink and enjoy!

Name: Mikkeller Sort Kaffe
Description: Black India Pale Ale w/ Coffee.

Name: Mikkeller Simcoe Imperial IPA
Description: Mikkeller X-series. The first in a series of single hop IIPA’s. Brewed with US hop variety Simcoe, a Mikkeller favourite.

Name: Mikkeller Hallertau Galaxica IPA
Description: Super juicy IPA and dry hopped with Halletau Blanc and Galaxy hops.

Name: Mikkeller Big Sky Lullaby Double IPA
Description: Big nose of honey dew, lemongrass, green tea, and pine. Body is lighter, allowing hop flavors to showcase their citrus and chamomile characteristics.  Enough bite from the hops to blend with the 8% alcohol to allow a balanced taste

Name: Mikkeller 20 IPA
Description: Brewed & bottle by Mikkeller at De Proef Brouwerij, Lochristi-Hijfte, Belgium. Ingredienser: vand, malt (pilsner, munich, cara-crystal), havreflager, humle og gær

Name: Mikkeller San Diego Hop Geek Breakfast
Description: Black IPA with Coffee

Name: Mikkeller 10
Description: The culmination of the First Single Hop Series has arrived. Yes, that’s right, all of our old friends make a reappearance in this one – good to see you again, Nelson Sauvin; how ya been, Nugget? All equal amount of all 10 hops in one delicious IPA.

Name: Mikkeller 19
Description: A blend of those single hop IPAs:  Simcoe 17,14%, Citra 15,72%, Amarillo 14,29%, Sorachi Ace 10,71%, Bravo 6,79%, Columbus 6,79%, Cluster 4,64%, Warrior 4,64%, Cascade 3,57%, Centennial 3,57%, Palisade 2,86%, Challenger 1,43%, Galena 1,43%, Magnum 1,43%, Mt Hood 1,43%, Tettnanger 1,43%, Nugget 0,71%, Super Galena 0,71%, Williamette 0,71%.

Name: Mikkeller Hoppy Lovin’ Christmas
Description: India Pale Ale brewed with Ginger and Pine Needles

Name: Mikkeller Waves IPA
Description: Zesty citrus dominates the aroma of this IPA, leading into a honeyed malt body with a satisfying citrusy bitterness.

Name: Mikkeller It Was Professor Plum
Description: Session IPA brewed with Plum, Blueberry, and Hibiscus

Name: Mikkeller Cryo Room
Description: IPA with mosaic, simcoe, and citra cryo hops.

Name: Mikkeller Outta The Bike Lane
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Mikkeller Citra Eyes
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Papaya, melon, citrus, grapefruit & pomelo. Soft, creamy mouthfeel by way of oats and wheat.

Name: Mikkeller Raspberry Trippelbock
Description: This is a Trippelbock from the Mikkeller folks, with a hearty helping of raspberries at its core. A perfect pudding beer.

Name: Mikkeller Chill Pilsner
Description: Clean pilsner origin that gets a nice fruity blast of citrus from the Yuzu

Name: Mikkeller Say Hey Sally
Description: Bursting with floral hops and a soft cracker-like malt structure, layers of sunflower and pineapple develop a delicate hop profile. With hints of earth and slate, a snappy finish awakens the palate with medium hop bitterness and a dry backbone.

Name: Mikkeller RauchPils
Description: Smoked Pilsner – Brewed at D’Proef

Name: Mikkeller American Dream
Description: A premium lager packed with American hops. The kind of beer you drink straight outta the can on a hot summer day.

Name: Mikkeller Butcher Bier
Description: German-style Lager

Name: Mikkeller Ris A La M’ale
Description: Based on traditional danis dessert ris a lamande, made using rice, lactose, cherries and almond extract

Name: Lamplighter Rabbit Rabbit Double IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A dangerously drinkable New England-style double IPA brewed with Citra, Amarillo, and Idaho 7. This beer is a veritable juice bomb, boasting huge hop flavors of mango, melon, and ripe fruit. Kick back and hop to it! Tasting notes: Tropical, Hop Candy, Ripe Mango

Name: Lamplighter Birds Of A Feather IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A New England-style IPA brewed with Mosaic, Citra, Columbus. Birds has become a staple of our roster because of its fruit-forward hop flavors of dank citrus and passionfruit, coupled with a smooth finish. The beer takes its name from the Phish cult-classic of the same name. Tasting Notes: Spruce, Lemongrass, Blueberry

Name: Lamplighter Major Tom IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Ground Control? This is Major Tom, our New England-style IPA brewed 100% with Galaxy. This Bowie-inspired beer boasts bold flavors of passionfruit and mango, alongside a creamy mouthfeel and smooth finish. Just don’t forget your protein pills and helmet. Tasting Notes: Peach, Passionfruit, Mango

Name: Lamplighter Werewolves Of Cambridge Porter
Description: Our house porter brewed with a variety of black, crystal, and English malts. With a smooth, roasty body and a ton of toffee and chocolate goodness, this beer is bound to get you howling. Werewolves is particularly drinkable for its style, keeping things more tame than an all-out boozy or syrupy porter. Named after Warren Zevon’s classic ballad, “Werewolves Of London.” Awooooo! Tasting Notes: Robust Coffee, Treacle, Dark Fruit

Name: Lamplighter Bunnies IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A New England-style IPA brewed with Azacca and Nelson Sauvin hops. This beer is the lower alcohol, offspring version of our Rabbit Rabbit double IPA. Bunnies is built on a similar malt bill as Rabbit Rabbit, and uses the same strain of yeast, but features a different mix of hops to lend flavors of melon, citrus, and pineapple. Kick back, relax, and hop to it! Tasting Notes: Mango, Pineapple, Peach

Name: Lamplighter Gold Rush
Description: A Golden Ale dry-hopped with citrusy hops and krausened with our house lager yeast. The result is a unique blend of ale and lager - fruity and floral up front, yet crisp and drinkable on the finish with a bountiful and balanced hop character.

Name: Lamplighter All Gold Everything Dry Hopped Golden Ale
Description: A Golden Ale double dry-hopped with Motueka and Nelson Sauvin. A special release for the Winter Olympics! Tasting notes of white peach, tropical fruit and crisp bitter.

Name: Lamplighter Speedwagon Kolsch
Description: A deliciously drinkable Kolsch, Speedwagon goes down easy and is perfect for warm weather. The style is fermented with ale yeast, but then finished in cold temperatures like a lager. The resulting beer exhibits some of the best characteristics of both categories - light and quaffable, with a touch of muted fruitiness and a crisp, clean finish.

Name: Lamplighter Ophelia Baltic Porter
Description: This beer is that is robust, roasty, and rich with minimal hop bitterness. Lager yeast provides a clean fermentation profile, accentuating notes of dark fruit, toffee, and nutty caramel derived from a complex malt bill.

Name: Lamplighter Lit Double Wit
Description: Double Belgian-style Witbier brewed with lavender, coriander, orange peel, and peppercorn. This witbier plays homage to a traditional style, but with our twist of adding a bit of lavender in. The addition of wheat in the grain bill give this beer a silky smooth mouthfeel, complemented by tangy flavors of spice and Belgian phenols. Lighters up! Tasting Notes: Spice, Lavender, Pepper

Name: Lamplighter Group Theory Wheat Ale
Description: A light and smooth wheat ale brewed with honey and chamomile. This beer is brewed with grains from Valley Malt and chamomile flowers sourced by MEM Tea. The final piece of the equation — raw honey from Sleeping Bear Farms — gives this beer a lovely, dry finish.

Name: Lamplighter Barb Dry Hopped Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A dry-hopped saison brewed with our friends at Solemn Oath Brewery in Naperville, Illinois. This beer is hopped exclusively with Ella for resilient flavors of grapefruit, guava, spice, and star anise. Each sip is full of floral, dry, and effervescent character, but low enough in alcohol to keep things chill. Named in reverence of the dearly departed Barbara Holland of Stranger Things. Can artwork by Chloe Feldman Emison of Longfellows Coffee and Jourdan Gullett of Solemn Oath.

Name: Lamplighter Ele Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Our true-to-style saison. This beer highlights the spicy phenolic and fruity esters produced by Belgian yeasts. Expect fruity esters, hints of clove, and a spicy and peppery finish. Dry, drinkable, and always down for another round. All of our saisons take their names from the Netflix series “Stranger Things”. This one is named after our favorite Eggo-loving psychic. Tasting Notes: Bright, Spicy, Fruity

Name: Lamplighter Brewing Blitzen Holiday Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Blitzen is a Belgian-style Dark Strong Ale brewed with fresh-ground nutmeg and cinnamon sticks. Sporting bold flavors of chocolate-covered cherry, black find, and brown sugar, this holiday brew is dangerously drinkable and delightfully full-bodied – sure to bring color to the coldest of cheeks. Malt character takes center stage here, well-balanced by warming alcohol and yeast-derived spice. Cozy up, take a long sip, and let this ruby-hued delight keep you toasty throughout the holiday season.

Name: Lamplighter The Upsidedown Dark Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A smooth and spicy dark saison. Think of this beer as a cross between a brown ale and a true-to-style saison. Here, dark malts and a punch of toffee lead to an effervescent and zesty finish from the Belgian yeast. Despite the style, this beer stays mild enough to entrance more discerning drinkers. Cross over responsibly. Tasting Notes: Malty, Toffee, Spicy

Name: Lamplighter Chief Hopper Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Hoppy Saison with Azacca and Hallertau Blanc. Notes of spice, honeysuckle, and citrus.

Name: Lamplighter Milou Belgian-style Dubbel
Description: A balanced and malt-forward Belgian-style Dubbel. Rich flavors of molasses, caramel, and plum complement this beer’s sweet and somewhat strong malt profile. The addition of Belgian yeast helps the beer finish out with notes of cherry, fig, cinnamon, and clove. It’s a traditional yet approachable beer, brewed as an homage to a classic Belgian style. The beer is named after the dog in Tin Tin, a Belgian comic. Tasting Notes: Molasses, Stone Fruit, Toffee

Name: Lamplighter Atari’s Lantern
Description: This Belgian-Style Quadrupel is a beer bigger, bolder, and boozier than its sister styles Dubbel and Tripel. Ruby brown in color with a richly vinous palate, this ale is ripe with flavors of stone fruit, sherry, and spice, after four months of aging in Port wine barrels. An exceptionally creamy mouthfeel masks a subtle, but distinct, alcohol warmth – each sip is sweet but not cloying, potent but not heady – a brew fit to be savored in the coldest winter months. Drink fresh or cellar.

Name: Lamplighter From Copenhagen With Love
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: From Copenhagen with Love is a "socially distant collaboration" brewed virtually with our friends at Spybrew (Copenhagen, Denmark). Balancing floral overtones from Ethiopian Gatame honey with a light caramel sweetness, this malt-forward farmhouse ale drinks smooth and finishes exceptionally dry. Keep cold, spy hard, and enjoy fresh!

Name: Lamplighter Calico
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Calico is a Barrel Aged Farmhouse Ale, brewed with Belgian Pilsner malt and a blend of wheat and rye. Initially a classic saison, the base beer developed rich complexity, subtle oak character, and a faint acidity after six months of aging in French Oak. Smooth and delicate, leading with spicy yeast character and notes of white grape and pear, this medium-bodied brew finishes dry with nearly imperceptible bitterness. Drink fresh or cellar.

Name: Lamplighter In Bruges Tripel
Description: A clean and effervescent Belgian-style Tripel. Slightly hazy in appearance, with pleasant waves of cracked pepper and light caramel. A bright and somewhat sweet finish rounds out each sip. It’s the sort of beer you’d find among the towering buildings and cobbled streets of Belgium, and that’s just the way we like it. Tasting Notes: White Pepper, Mandarin Orange, Butterscotch

Name: Lamplighter Brewing Outside Bruges
Description: Outside Bruges is a radical take on a Belgian-Style Tripel, aged for a year in Brettanomyces-inoculated barrels of American, Hungarian, and French origin. Overtones of pineapple and ripe peach replace traditional pepper and clove aromas, riding atop a refined funk and warming alcohol presence. On the finish, a tannic backbone offers hints of oaky vanilla, resulting in a delightfully dry and complex pint.

Name: Lamplighter Electric Bloom Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Typically, experimental hop varieties take at least 8-10 years of evaluation by breeders, growers, and brewers alike before commercialization is considered, and these are certainly no exception – recently released by Hopsteiner, these new hops are fresh to market and bursting with potential. Resinous and fruity, this beer sings with notes of spruce, mango, and tangerine, and drinks smooth wIth semi-dry finish and velvety mouthfeel.

Name: Lamplighter Pressure Drop Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A New England-style pale ale brewed with Citra and Hull Melon. This beer is apricot- and melon-forward, with a balanced malt profile to boot. Those light and hoppy flavors converge for one drinkable, out-of-this-world crusher. Named after a spaceship in The Culture series. Tasting Notes: Kiwi, Melon, Pine

Name: Lamplighter Looking Glass ESB Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: An English-style extra special bitter (ESB) ale. Hearty English malts take center stage to give this beer balanced notes of dark bread, toasted hazelnut, and a robust earthiness. The beer is then lightly hopped with Target and Challenger hops to accentuate those flavors. Despite the name, ESB’s aren’t all that bitter. We kept things true-to-style here, so expect a balanced, drinkable, and malt-forward beer all around. Named after a series of backwards events in Alice In Wonderland. Tasting Notes: Brown Bread, Toasted Hazelnut, Earthy

Name: Lamplighter Watt English Golden Bitter
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: A nutty yeast character is balanced by toasty maltiness and earthy hoppiness, resulting in a beer with crisp flavor, mild bitterness, and soft body. Named after the watt, a unit of power used to quantify the rate of energy transfer (and often associated with lightbulbs and lamps! And we love lamp).

Name: Lamplighter Gender Trouble
Description: Gender Trouble is a refreshing, summery Pale Ale brewed with wheat and oats, and dry hopped with New Zealand-grown Nelson Sauvin. Uniquely fruity with aromas of white grape and passion fruit, this drinkable beer is well-balanced, finishing with a snappy, invigorating bitterness. Named after Judith Butler’s foundational queer-theory text, Gender Trouble is brewed in honor of our queer friends and family for Pride Month.

Name: Lamplighter Leopard King Pale Ale
Description: A 100% Brett-fermented pale ale hopped with Centennial and Idaho 7, formerly released as Mad Hatter. This beer is the third in our series of 100% Brett-fermented beers, accompanying Easy Tiger and Lion Eyes. Here, a funky and mild yeast presence melds with flavors of grapefruit pith, tropical fruit, and a hint of clove. This beer is a touch more drinkable than its animal companions, but still carries enough funk and hay flavor to keep the palate guessing. Welcome to the jungle...Tasting Notes: Hay, Grapefruit, Clove

Name: Lamplighter Cuppa English Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: A British Ale with hot bloom Ethiopian cold brew produced by Longfellows.

Name: Lamplighter 1968 Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: 1968 is a Pale Ale brewed in collaboration and in celebration of Just-A-Start, a local organization dedicated to building housing security and economic stability throughout Cambridge. This beer is an easy-drinking American pale ale with balanced hop bitterness, piney aroma, and a pleasant malty finish.

Name: Lamplighter Sound & Vision Sour
Description: Our rotating fruited sour series. Each batch of this beer highlights a different fruit addition, bolstered by a clean and tart kettle-soured base beer. V1 (February 2017): Satsuma Mandarin Orange, V2 (May 2017): Raspberry, V3 (July 2017): Passionfruit, V4 (August 2017): Tart Cherry, V5 (October 2017): Raspberry, V5 (November 2017): Cranberry. Tasting Notes: Vary

Name: Lamplighter Blame It On My Juice
Description: Blame it on My Juice is a Gose series with rotating fruit additions.

Name: Lamplighter Danger Zone Dry Hopped Sour
Description: A dry-hopped kettle sour ale brewed with Lemondrop hops. This beer keeps things tart and lively from the addition of Lactobacillus, and features prominent aromas of lime, lychee, and grapefruit. Those smells set the stage for refreshing notes of Meyer lemon, ripe melon, and just a hint of pine resin. Grab a glass and enter the Danga’ Zone!

Name: Lamplighter Riley Barrel-Aged Sour
Description: Riley is a mixed-culture sour brewed with wheat, flaked oats, and a variety of Belgian caramel malts. Aged for 18 months in Hungarian oak barrels, this ruby-colored beer developed rich notes of sour cherry, grape must, and vanilla layered beneath a mouth-puckering lactic tang. Despite its undeniable tartness, Riley is medium-bodied and smooth, lingering lightly on the palate and allowing flavors to bloom. Drink fresh or cellar.

Name: Lamplighter Raspberry Fields Wild Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: We wanted to make sure our first anniversary beer was a special one, so we cranked up some Beatles tunes and got to work brewing. The result was a barrel-fermented wild farmhouse ale aged on whole raspberries. Raspberry Fields spent five months slumbering in French oak barrels with a wild Saccharomyces yeast strain, which gave the beer balanced flavors of lemon, hay, and a touch of tartness. The beer’s rest on raspberries gave it a prominent fruity profile, while its time in oak barrels smoothed out the finish with a touch of vanilla. This is a special beer, for a special first year of our business, and we couldn’t be happier to share it with you. Tasting Notes: Dry, Raspberry, Lemon

Name: Lamplighter Moondance Milk Stout
Description: A milk stout brewed with lactose and roasted malts. This beer is smooth and balanced, showcasing a creamy mouthfeel and robust flavors of espresso and dark chocolate. Pairs well with chilly nights, ice cream, and slow dancing in the moonlight. Tasting Notes: Rich Coffee, Cacao, Caramel

Name: Lamplighter Brunch Breakfast Stout
Description: Brunch is a hearty Stout brewed with an abundance of oats, malted and flaked, for added richness and body. Two types of coffee are featured in this brew; a Colombian light roast contributes bright acidity reminiscent of honey and spice while a Mexican dark roast enhances the deep chocolate flavors characteristic of roasted malts. Creamy, comforting, and caffeinated, this beer covers all the bases of a balanced breakfast - there’s no better way to start the day.

Name: Lamplighter Brewing Coquito
Description: Coquito is our take on a traditional Puerto Rican holiday nog made with coconut cream, spices and rum. A base stout was brewed with oats, lactose, cinnamon stick, and shaved nutmeg before fermenting on toasted coconut and aging in rum barrels. The result is a festive and full-bodied stout with balanced flavors of rum, winter spice, coconut, and milk chocolate. Drink fresh or cellar.

Name: Lamplighter After Midnight Imperial Stout
Description: An imperial stout brewed with bourbon Madagascar vanilla beans and over 200 pounds of Vermont maple syrup. If you’re looking for a festive fall beer to welcome in the colder months, look no further: Decadent and rich flavors of vanilla, espresso, and chocolate cake envelop the tongue at first sip. As this beer warms, more complex flavors of black coffee, roasted marshmallow, and molasses will start to surface. Pairs well with chilly fall nights, bonfires, and worn flannel. Tasting Notes: Chocolate Cake, Espresso, Creamy Vanilla

Name: Lamplighter Black Pearl Oyster Stout
Description:
Black Pearl is an oyster stout brewed with our friends at Medusa Brewing Co. (Hudson, MA) and Island Creek Oysters (Duxbury, MA).

Hints of brine brighten decadent notes of espresso and cacao, resulting in a velvety rich body chock full of bittersweet flavor.

Name: Lamplighter Life On Mars IPA
Description: An IPA brewed with Amarillo and Galaxy hops.

Name: Lamplighter Sneaker Wave IPA
Description: A New England-style IPA brewed with Arctic thyme. We teamed up with Borg Brugghus of Reykjavik, Iceland, to throw a Nordic twist on this hazy staple. Waves of herbs and sweet thyme follow flavors of tropical fruit, mango, and citrus zest. The addition of Styrian Wolf and Grungiest hops keep that swell going with pockets of elderflower, anise, and even more mango.

Name: Lamplighter Space Monster IPA
Description: A West Coast Style IPA hopped with 100% Michigan grown Chinook. Pale orange in color and slightly hazy, this beer balances caramel malts with prominent bitterness and juicy hop-forward flavor. The aroma is dominated by notes of sweet pineapple candy and peach rings, followed by a palette bursting with rich flavors of sweet cedar, citrus rind, and mango juice.

Name: Lamplighter Get Lucky IPA
Description: A refreshing and drinkable ale  brewed with a trio of fruit-forward hops, Get Lucky offers up the flavors of a robust, American-style IPA at sessionable strength. This pale gold beer features bright aromas of lemongrass and pineapple, a soft and pillowy mouthfeel, and a delightfully pithy bitterness. Get Lucky isn’t too hoppy, isn’t too malty, and isn't too boozy - it's just right. Named after Daft Punk’s 2013 disco hit.

Name: Lamplighter To The Moon IPA
Description: A New England Style IPA brewed in collaboration with our friends and neighbors from Aeronaut Brewing Co (Somerville, MA). A profile of all-American hops (Eureka, Denali, El Dorado, and Idaho 7) provide firm bitterness and tropical-forward flavor, all balanced by a smooth and soft mouthfeel.

Name: Lamplighter Side Salad IPA
Description: This effervescent American-style IPA was brewed with fresh lemon verbena, hand-picked in Carlisle, MA. Intensely aromatic with distinctly herbal undertones, Side Salad is quaffable and smooth, like any glass of fresh-squeezed citrus. Eureka and Lemondrop hops contribute subtle notes of stone fruit and a zesty bitterness balances malty sweetness while preserving the juicy quality of every pint. Why eat a meal when you can just order a side salad?

Name: Lamplighter Dank And Stormy
Description: Dry hopped with Cryo Ekuanot powder, this hazy ale delivers a complex array of aromas and flavors ranging from fruity and tropical to herbal and dank.

Name: Lamplighter Jamberry
Description: Jamberry is a rotating fruited IPA series.This juicy and full-bodied beer drinks like a fruit smoothie with a lingering pithy finish. Keep cold and drink fresh!

Name: Lamplighter Stardust IPA
Description: An IPA brewed with Summit, Simcoe, and Amarillo. Honeydew hits the palate first, followed by a bit of bitterness and a blast of hop flavor. Think pink-colored Starburst. Named in honor of the Bowie fan in all of us, with a slight nod to a special heroine from Star Wars. Tasting Notes: Citrus, Pine, zest

Name: Lamplighter Professor Lupulin
Description: Professor Lupulin is a juicy New England-style IPA and our first brew featuring Cryo Citra. Extracted from whole leaf Citra hops, this lupulin powder is chock-full of resins and citrus-forward aromatic oils, providing maximum flavor while drastically reducing brewing waste. The resulting ale leads with a bouquet of ripe melon and citrus zest, complemented by a sweetly malty body and a Sirius-ly snappy finish. Best enjoyed under a full moon…

Name: Lamplighter You Won’t
Description: You Won’t is an American IPA brewed with small-batch Maine-grown malt and hopped with Mosaic and Simcoe, two multi-purpose hops balancing tropical fruit aromas with a distinctly herbal bouquet. A medium body promotes a firm backend bitterness, leaving the palate refreshed and thoroughly quenched. Named after a favorite local alternative band.

Name: Lamplighter Lawyers, Guns, and Honey IPA
Description: An IPA brewed with Amarillo, El Dorado, and 240 pounds of raw honey. While the addition of that much honey may scream sweet, this beer is quite balanced. Citrusy and floral hop notes lead to a slightly dry finish, with a touch of lingering sweetness. In other words, this beer is all of your hop and honeycomb-dipped dreams in liquid form. Named after our unofficial brewhouse anthem, “Lawyers, Guns, and Money” by Warren Zevon. Tasting Notes: Citrus, Floral, Honey

Name: Lamplighter Lucid Nonsense Oat IPA
Description: An oat IPA brewed with El Dorado and Centennial. Lucid leans more West Coast than East, sporting pine and citrus flavors that linger on the palate thanks to the addition of body-boosting oats. This beer takes its name from a spaceship in The Culture series. Tasting Notes: Orange, Resin, Citrus Zest

Name: Lamplighter Brewing Cloud City IPA
Description: Cloud City is a New England-style IPA hopped 100% with Strata®, an Oregon-grown variety sourced through Crosby Hop Farm. On the nose, intense aromas of melon and guava accompany notes of bright citrus, producing an alluring tropical bouquet that gives way to a thick and pillowy body. Well balanced, the fruit-forward flavors of this ale are tempered by a light and lingering bitterness.

Name: Lamplighter Easy Tiger Brett-fermented IPA
Description: A 100% Brett-fermented IPA hopped with Amarillo and El Dorado. Easy Tiger possesses a more hop-forward profile than our other Brett-based offerings: complex, fruity, tropical flavors of grilled pineapple and black pepper quickly combine with earthy, dank flavors from the wild yeast. The beer takes it name from a craft beer bar in Austin, Texas, where the vision for Lamplighter’s funky and tasty beers was first realized. Welcome to the jungle…Tasting Notes: Mango, Pineapple, Savory

Name: Lamplighter Dad Bod
Description: Dad Bod is a full bodied IPA brewed in honor of Father’s Day and dry hopped with Eureka and Simcoe. Combining characteristics from several IPA traditions, this ale is hazy like a New England-style IPA, piney like a West Coast IPA, and sports a snappy bitterness in the classic American IPA tradition. Bright citrus flavors lead to earthy and herbal undertones, resulting in a unique bouquet of pomelo, mint, and resiny pine. Brewed in honor of dads everywhere (and their bods).

Name: Lamplighter So Pitted
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: So Pitted is a New England-Style IPA brewed with our friends at Vitamin Sea Brewing (Weymouth, MA). Inspired by the tropical Painkiller cocktail, this hazy IPA fermented on 840 lbs of pineapple, along with an aromatic blend of vanilla, nutmeg, and cinnamon. Intense fruit-forward flavors are balanced by Sabro and Loral hops, which lend notes of citrus pith and a zesty finish. Keep cold, hang loose, and enjoy fresh.

Name: Lamplighter So Much For Subtlety Double IPA
Description: Our rotating double IPA series. Each batch of this hoppy beer highlights a different hop addition, presenting everchanging hop flavors atop the same base beer. Another beer named after a spaceship in The Culture series.

Name: Lamplighter Neon Nights Double IPA
Description: A glowing double IPA brewed and dry-hopped with Galaxy and Ella. These two Australian hop varieties converge for bright flavors of juicy pineapple, ripe peach, and just a touch of grapefruit and melon. Pleasant floral aromas and a soft spiciness dance around that flavor profile, capping off one illuminating drinking experience.

Name: Lamplighter Yaks On The Phone IPA
Lamplighter Chapter One IPA
Description: Chapter One is our first foray into the world of fruited IPAs. Juicy, hoppy, and exceptionally hazy, this ale balances the best of the New England-style IPA tradition with a unique twist. Its creamy body quenches and drenches the palate with tropical flavor; Galaxy hops enrich aromas of musky passionfruit while Chinook’s pithy bite complements the sweetness of fresh pineapple. Like the beginning of any great adventure, Chapter One bridges the exotic with the familiar.

Name: Lamplighter Not McKinley DDH IPA
Description: A double dry-hopped IPA brewed 100% with Denali hops. Hazy, hoppy, and dripping with flavors of peach, mango, and pineapple. As the cool kids say these days, this thing is one helluva juice bomb. Named after the national debate surrounding a great, high, and wondrous mountain.

Name: Lamplighter The Big Drop Brut IPA
Description: The Big Drop is a “brut” IPA brewed in celebration. Bone-dry and highly aromatic, with notes of white grape, peach, and gardenia, this popular new style boasts zero residual sugar thanks to the work of an amylase enzyme added during fermentation. This process allows hop aroma and flavor to take center stage, resulting in a pint that’s effervescent, refreshing, and refined.

Name: Lamplighter Lady Marmalade
Description: Lady Marmalade is slightly tart with musky overtones and hints of vanilla and almond, the apricots’ unique flavor is accentuated by tangerine-forward hop aromas and complemented by a piney bitter finish. Best enjoyed in the comfort of a boudoir. Voulez-vous boire trop avec moi?

Name: Lamplighter Loose Seal 2
Description: Loose Seal 2 is a balanced, New England-Style Double IPA brewed with Australian Ella hops. Hazy, rich, and true-to-style, this beer’s creamy body carries aromas of passionfruit and grapefruit zest to the palate for a thoroughly tropical (and dangerously drinkable) pint. Inspired by a wealthy family who lost everything. Keep cold and drink fresh!

Name: Lamplighter Flight Of The Kiwi
Description: Flight of the Kiwi is our latest IPA series, featuring rotating New Zealand-grown hops. Batch 1 features “The Bruce” – an aromatic hop blend comprised of Nelson Sauvin, Motueka, Pacifica, and Pacific Jade varietals. Aromas of gooseberry, orange blossom, and ripe tropical fruit make for a juicy, full-bodied, and quaffable pint. Keep cold and drink fresh!

A New England-Style IPA brewed and double dry-hopped with juicy American hops. Birds has become a staple of our roster because of its fruit-forward flavors of dank citrus and passionfruit, coupled with a smooth finish and creamy mouthfeel.

Name: Lamplighter Loose Seal
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Loose Seal is a New England-Style IPA dry hopped with Azacca, Hallertau Blanc, and Chinook. Boasting prominent fruit notes and an underlying spice, this tasty ale is drinkable, smooth, and balanced. Keep cold and enjoy fresh for an afternoon delight!

Name: Lamplighter Altitude Sickness IPA
Description: Altitude Sickness is an IPA brewed in collaboration with our friends from Turtle Mountain Brewing Co. out of Rio Rancho, NM. Simcoe, Mosaic, and Chinook add pine and citrus-forward flavors, complemented by smooth mouthfeel and firm finishing bitterness.

Name: Lamplighter Baby Shark
Description: Fruity, drinkable, and revitalizing, Baby Shark is a berry-forward Session IPA dry hopped with French Barbe Rouge and German Hull Melon hops.

Name: Lamplighter Rabbit Rabbit Double IPA 1/6 Barrel
Description: A dangerously drinkable New England-style double IPA brewed with Citra, Amarillo, and Idaho 7.

Name: Lamplighter Luminati Rotating IPA
Description: An IPA featuring Citra: an American hop bursting with notes of grapefruit, lychee, gooseberry, and melon. This beer is the first addition to a rotating IPA series, with each batch highlighting a different hop addition

Name: Lamplighter Watchman Session Wheat IPA
Description: A session wheat IPA brewed with Hallertau Blanc hops. Soft yet punchy flavors of white grape, peach, and pear help ease the palate into a wheaty, full-bodied finish. This beer’s low alcohol content classifies it as a session beer, which simply means you can put a few back in one sitting without feeling like you got run over by a train the next day. At one time, a Watchman was in charge of lighting lamps around town and keeping guard over the town until morning. We felt the name and occupation suited this beer and its drinkability. Tasting Notes: Peach, Gooseberry, White Grape

Name: Lamplighter Unlucky Wizard
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Unlucky Wizard is a hazy New England-Style IPA brewed with our friends at Backlash Beer Co. (Boston, MA). Silky smooth and impressively full-bodied, this juicy ale is dry-hopped with a blend of Kiwi and Australian hops, known for their succulent aromas of tropical fruit and citrus. Our take on a “liquid luck” elixir, this beer may cause dangerous overconfidence if consumed in excess.

Name: Lamplighter Superstition
Description: Superstition is a New England-Style Double IPA brewed with Ella, Lemondrop, and Styrian Dragon hops. Hazy, juicy, and floral, this beer balances hop-derived aromas of sweet lemon, honeysuckle, and star anise with a snappy bitter backbone. Keep cold and drink fresh!

Name: Lamplighter Honalee IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Honalee is a New England-style IPA brewed with Slovenian-grown Styrian Dragon and Styrian Wolf hops, best known for their intensely fruit-forward and floral aromas.

Name: Lamplighter Chapter Two
Description: The second iteration in our fruited IPA series, Chapter Two features juicy pink guava alongside Azacca and Amarillo hops, known for their citrus-forward and fruity aromas and flavors. Medium-bodied and smooth, Chapter Two’s rich tropical flavor combines notes of pear, quince, and strawberry, punctuated by a pithy backbone, silky mouthfeel, and soft bitter finish.

Name: Lamplighter Paper Planes
Description: Paper Planes is a dry hopped Kellerbier brewed with our friends at Flying Machine Brewing Co. (Wilmington, NC). Combining traditions from lager and ale brewing, this beer balances sweet grain character with delicate hop aromas of citrus pith and red currant. Keep cold and enjoy fresh!

Name: Lamplighter The Union Maibock
Description: German-style Maibock brewed with Pilsner, Vienna and Munich malts

Name: Lamplighter Barley Smalls Vienna Lager
Description: A full-bodied Vienna-style lager. The hefty addition of Vienna malts in this beer lend flavors of caramel and toast, while the beer’s slumber under colder temperatures smooths out its bite. This is an easy drinking lager, perfect for sipping in the company of family and friends. Brewed and named in honor or our resident pup. Tasting Notes: Biscuit, Caramel, Toast

Name: Lamplighter Oktoberfest
Description: Oktoberfest is our take on a Bavarian Marzen, the lager traditionally served at Oktoberfest celebrations. Before refrigeration, brewing ceased with the coming of spring, typically in March (“Marz” in German). To prepare for fall, brewers developed a rich and toasty brew whose higher abv prevented infection during the hot summer months. Our interpretation is similarly full-bodied, boasting complex malt character with a hint of sweetness and a snappy bitter finish. Best served in a stein. Prost!

Name: Lamplighter/Night Shift Nocturne Dunkel
Description: A German-style Dunkel lager made in collaboration with Night Shift Brewing. This beer exudes dark amber hues, lighting the way for aromas of toasted malt and freshly ground caraway. Deep sips reveal rich flavors of roasted chestnuts, toasted pumpernickel, and hints of caramel. This lager finishes with a soft mouthfeel, light bitterness, and medium-dry finish.

Name: Lamplighter Apollo Sunshine Pilsner
Description: A light-bodied German-style Pilsner. Clear and golden, with a delicate floral nose and crisp malt bite. A blend of Noble hops bolster flavors of straw and biscuit, backed by a herbaceous finish. Drinks dry and slightly bitter. Named to honor the alt-rock jams of Apollo Sunshine, a Boston-based group that disbanded in 2010. Tasting Notes: Floral, Grassy, Biscuit

Name: Lamplighter Jagged Little Pils
Description: Jagged Little Pils is a Czech-Style Pilsner fermented in oak foeders. Brilliantly golden and strickingly clean, this easy-drinking lager achieves a delicate balance of complex malt character, spicy noble hop aroma, and subtle undertones of oaky vanilla.

Name: Lamplighter Stupid Seagulls Pale Lager
Description: A Pale Lager dry-hopped with Hallertau Blanc, this beer has bright aromas of honeydew and fresh grass followed by crisp flavors of lemonheads, hay, and white grape skin.

Name: Lamplighter Giants Under the Sun Helles Lager
Description: Easy-drinking and refreshing, this golden lager presents a soft floral character complemented by biscuit maltiness, slight spice from the noble hops, and a round, smooth finish. With notes of fresh cut flower, wheat cracker, and herbs, it is best enjoyed in the bright sunshine!

Name: Lamplighter Brewing Smokey The Beer
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Smokey the Beer is a Rauchbier brewed in collaboration with our friends from Brato Brewhouse + Kitchen (Boston, MA). On the nose, a familiar campfire scent is enriched by light aromas of grilled pear and grape must, emphasizing sweet wood character without any trace of char. Pale amber in color and especially smooth, this lager’s lightly smoky flavor is derived from Beechwood and Cherrywood smoked malts.

Name: Jack’s Abby House Lager
Description: What the Helles is a Landbier? Ours is sweet and golden with a full malty body, inspired by the country lagers of Bavaria. This Pale Bier is our House specialty. From Jack’s House to Your House!

Name: Jack’s Abby Copper Legend
Tasting Notes: Biscuit, Bready, Crisp, Dry, Grainy, Malty, Tobacco, Vanilla
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Nuts, Pork, Root Vegetables
Description: Ancient timelines talk of dark days, plagued by hardships and Kingdom demands. When hope was all but lost, a legend emerged. A plumber. With copper pipes and an uncanny wit, he battled fierce foes and saw to the brewery’s opening. Our Octoberfest is malty, smooth and exceedingly drinkable. It is perfect to celebrate and honor today’s legends. We use locally grown wheat from MA, Munich malt and noble hops.

Name: Jack’s Abby Post Shift Pilsner
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Biscuit, Bright, Crisp, Dry, Grainy, Light, Minerality
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Stinky, Nuts, Pasta, Pork, Shellfish
Description: There will be no working during drinking hours! Brewed with Bavarian malt and hops, this everyday Pilsner is bright, crisp and refreshing. We think it’s the perfect way to end the work day. Clock out, post-up and enjoy!

Name: Jack’s Abby Blood Orange Wheat Radler
Tasting Notes: Bready, Citrus, Floral, Fresh, Fruity, Light, Nectarine, Sweet
Food Pairing: Fish - Meaty  Oily, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: Blood Orange Wheat debuted in our Beer Hall and it quickly became a fan favorite. This German-style radler is fruit forward, juicy and bloody refreshing. Lean back and enjoy!

Name: Jack’s Abby Shipping Out Of Boston
Description: Shipping out of Boston is our take on a German-Style Export Lager. Export Lagers were originally brewed stronger than other pale lagers to endure lengthy travel times. This kellerbier is brewed with a blend of German specialty malts for a deeply golden lager with an intense sweet biscuit flavor. Like the rest of the beers in our Keller Series, Shipping Out of Boston is left unfiltered.

Name: Jack’s Abby Hoponius Union
Categories: India Pale Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Tasting Notes: Bitter, Citrus, Crisp, Grapefruit, Hoppy, Pine
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily
Description: Cut through the haze with Hoponius Union, a crisp and clear India Pale Lager hopped with Citra and Centennial. Our flagship hoppy lager is like a traditional IPA but with a twist – it’s fermented cold and aged for extended periods. A blend of harmonious American hops creates a huge tropical fruit and citrusy hop aroma. A dry finish accentuates the pleasant bitterness and hop profile.

Name: Jack’s Abby Smoke & Dagger Dark Lager
Description: Cloaked in Mystery, this Black Lager is brewed with traditional old world ingredients and cutting edge lagering techniques. The perfect balance between old and new.

Name: Jack’s Abby Framinghammer Baltic Porter
Tasting Notes: Bold, Fig, Leather, Malty, Oak, Smooth, Velvety
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: This unusual lager style has many similarities to Imperial Stouts. A lengthy conditioning period creates a silky smooth chocolaty mouth feel enhanced by the use of oats and brown sugar. Noticeable sweetness gets balanced by roasted malt and hop bitterness. At 10% alcohol by volume, this beer is sure to keep you warm on a cold winter night.

Name: Jack’s Abby Coffee Framinghammer
Tasting Notes: Bold, Caramel, Chocolate, Coffee, Fig, Intense, Oak, Toasty, Velvety
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel
Description: Baltic porter aged in bourbon barrels with coffee beans. The lengthy conditioning period in the barrels creates a silky smooth chocolatey mouth feel enhanced by the use of oats and brown sugar. Noticeable sweetness gets balanced by roasted malt and hop bitterness. Additional flavors include bourbon, vanilla, and oak.

Name: Jack’s Abby Super Mole
Description: Big, bold, black, and aged in bourbon barrels with cocoa nibs, chili peppers, and whole cinnamon sticks. The lengthy conditioning period in the barrels creates a silky smooth chocolatey mouth feel enhanced by the use of oats and brown sugar during the brew process. Noticeable sweetness gets balanced by roasted malt and hop bitterness. Additional flavors include bourbon, oak, and spice.

The lengthy conditioning period in the barrels creates a silky smooth chocolatey mouth feel enhanced by the use of oats and brown sugar. Noticeable sweetness gets balanced by roasted malt and hop bitterness. Additional flavors include bourbon, vanilla, and oak.

Noticeable sweetness gets balanced by roasted malt and hop bitterness.

Name: Jack’s Abby S’mores
Food Pairing: Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel
