Name: Breckenridge Brewery Nitro Irish Stout
Description: The Nitro Irish Stout is a classic old-world style with the mesmerizing magic of nitro and a colorful Colorado spirit. Brewed with roasted Irish barley for a rich malty flavor, the memorable, sensory nature of Nitro Irish Stout nods to the welcoming adventure that our home state’s all about.

Name: Breckenridge Brewery Hop Peak IPA
Description: Simcoe and Citra dry hops form a pinnacle of lush citrus and pine aromas in this modern interpretation of the classic India Pale Ale. Our hopback infuses flavor from whole cone hops to build a complex body, further emboldened by the addition of an oil-rich, concentrated hop flower resin called lupulin powder. This potent powder kicks up a fresh hoppy dominance, which is supported by a backbone of unique specialty malts. Golden amber in color and refreshing in taste, Hop Peak IPA is a congratulatory drink for reaching any of life’s summits.

Name: Breckenridge Brewery 472 Double IPA
Description: This intensely aromatic Imperial IPA earns its title with an abundance of Chinook, Centennial and Simcoe whole-cone hops infused in our hopback for a powerful citrusy, tropical profile. At 9% ABV, this bright hop complexity is beautifully supported by an equally strong, malty backbone. Defined by both boldness and balance, each of our carefully-chosen ingredients shines through for an all-around brilliant labor of love.

Name: Breckenridge Mile High Copper Lager
Description: Stand Denver proud with this brilliantly bright full-flavored copper lager. Mile Hih City has Full Pint and Munich malts to create a lightly toasted sweetness balanced with a refreshingly clean finish. A dose of Mt. Hood hops adds a mild, spicy and fruity aroma that compliments this exceptionally smooth beer. Brewed to celebrate the Denver Nuggets, this copper lager is the perfect court-side companion.

Name: Breckenridge Brewery Oktoberfest
Description: Oktoberfest is an elegant Marzen Lager that’s true to style and exceptionally smooth. Bready, toasty aromas and flavors mingle with a light malty sweetness. Its soft mouthfeel is met with a touch of hops to offer a clean, dry finish.

Name: Breckenridge Brewery Breck Lager
Description: Breck Lager is a delightfully crisp standard American Lager. Clean and bright with the color of sunflowers, it greets you with a soft, malty, sweet aroma that's grounded by  hints of grains and earth. The light maltiness comes through in flavor as well, which gives Breck Lager its satisfying body. Subtle hop character leaves a pleasant, dry finish that invites the next sip.

Name: Breckenridge Brewery Velvet Variety Pack
Description:
A nitro twist on classic cocktails

A completely new to world malt-based product that
is designed to mimic an egg-white cocktail with a
thick velvety white head from nitrogen. 

Variants: 
Raspberry & Juniper
Elderflower & Botaincal
Tart Lime & Bitters

Name: Oskar Blues Dale’s Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Brewed with hefty amounts of European malts and four kinds of American hops, Dale's Pale Ale delivers a blast of hop aromas redolent of citrus and spice, which are then complemented by toasty and sweet malts. This brew has a silky mouthfeel with an accompanying lingering bitterness. ABV 6.50

Name: Wild Basin Boozy Sparkling Water Mixed Pack
Description: Wild Basin takes a contemporary approach with flavors including Cucumber Peach, Melon Basil, and Lemon Agave Hibiscus – while Classic Lime offers a familiar, refreshing option.

Name: Oskar Blues Mama’s Little Yella Pils
Description: Yaya raised a rebel who grew up to have dirt on his face, sweat on his brow, and beer in his blood. That’s why Mama’s Little Yella Pils is an uncompromising, hand crafted version of the great Pilsner beers of Bavaria and Bohemia.  Unlike mass market pilsners diluted with corn and rice, Mama’s is built on pilsner and honey malt then hopped with Saaz and Aramis hops. While it’s rich with flavor, its 33 IBUs and 4.7% ABV make it a luxurious but low-dose (by Oskar Blues standards) refresher. It’s damn good, crushable beer.

Name: Oskar Blues Can-O-Bliss Tropical IPA
Description: A maverick blend of Mosaic, Azacca, Galaxy, El Dorado and Idaho 7 hops mingle in this fruit-forward IPA, evoking flavors and aromas of apricot, lime, tangerine and papaya. Part of the Can-O-Bliss IPA Series, which highlights unconventional hop combinations.

Name: Oskar Blues Death By Coconut
Food Pairing: Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Cheese - Hard Aged
Description: When you crack open a Death By Coconut, intense pure liquid cacao flavors swirl with popping coconut aromas, all supported by a semi-sweet porter made from loads of our dark chocolate and extra dark caramel malt. This limited release specialty comes around once a year to satisfy that sweet tooth, so get ’em while you can before they disappear. At 6.5% ABV and 25 IBUs, this choconut goodness will have you yellin’ “Pass. Dash. Hit.” all winter long.

Name: Oskar Blues G’Knight Red IPA
Description: Our "Velvet M-80" is a hefty, dry hopped double-red ale with a nose full of aroma, a sticky mouthfeel, a malty middle and unctuous hop flavors. G'Knight sports a surprisingly sensuous finish for a beer of its size (8.7% ABV, 60 IBUs). It's brewed in tribute to a fellow Colorado craft beer pioneer and Vietnam vet who died fighting a 2002 wild fire outside of our Lyons hometown.

Name: Oskar Blues Ten Fidy Imperial Stout
Description: This titanic, immensely viscous stout is loaded with inimitable flavors of chocolate-covered caramel and coffee and hide a hefty 65 IBUs underneath the smooth blanket of malt. It is made with enormous amounts of two-row malt, chocolate malt, roasted barley, flaked oats and hops.

Name: Oskar Blues Can-O-Bliss DIPA
Description: Double down on bliss with our Can-O-Bliss IPA Series taken to a higher level of uncommon, unfiltered and unrestrained. This DIPA chock full of Citra hops delivers a one-two punch of hop aroma and blissful flavors of passionfruit and citrus, balanced with a substantial malt backbone.

Name: Oskar Blues Pinner Throwback IPA
Description: How do you cram as much hop & malt flavor and aroma as possible into a beer but make it crushable too? That’s the challenge we answered with PINNER Throwback IPA. At 4.9% ABV and 35 IBUs, this drinkable IPA uses several varieties of hops to target the ever-evolving flavor. With tropical fruits, citrus juices, pineapple and spice berry up front in the aroma and flavor, the biscuit & toasted bread at the back balance out all the hops and make a great finish to go on to your next can of PINNER. It’s the perfect beer for a little sip, sip, give.

Name: Oskar Blues Can-O-Bliss Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Strata, Cashmere, Enigma, Hallertau Blanc and Eureka hops come together in this complex, hazy creation and conjure notes of peach, white wine, honeysuckle and tangerine zest. Part of the Can-O-Bliss IPA Series, which highlights unconventional hop combinations.

Name: Oskar Blues Hotbox Coffee Porter
Description: This porter (6.4% ABV, 30 IBUs) is based on malt flavors of roasted nuts, crème brulee, cocoa, and caramel, extracted from English and German roasted and caramel malts. Hotbox Roasters then crashes the party and infuses potent, cold-extracted coffee from Burundi and Ethiopian beans and deals out flavors and aromas of dark plums, chocolate, and hints of blueberry.

Name: Oskar Blues Priscilla Wit
Description: This AmeriCAN take on the Belgian Classic Wit, featuring orange peel and coriander spice emanated from the basement blues music legacy Dave McIntyre (Oskar Blusologist) built at the original Oskar Blues Grill & Brew in Lyons, CO. On draft for over a decade, Priscilla's zesty citrus and light fresh baked bread aromas mix with spicy, fruity fermentation. Light bodied with a subtle savory spice accent and a dry, lightly tart finish you can nearly feel the flicker of the neon and sounds of the King. White Wit Wheat.

Name: Oskar Blues Brewery & Cigar City Brewing Bamburana
Description: Oskar Blues Brewery and Cigar City Brewing are stoked to announce the release of their innovative new collaboration beer, Bamburana. The imperial stout, brewed with figs and dates, is double barrel-aged – in both whiskey and brandy barrels – and aged once more in tanks with Amburana wood spirals. Bamburana is the first nationally distributed collaboration between the two breweries – a big, sticky, complex 12.2% ABV beer.

Name: Oskar Blues One-Y IPA
Description: A hazy IPA delivering citrusy flavors of orange peel, tangerine and lemon zest balanced with bread-like malt and presented as a 100 calorie wonder. Big, fruit-forward herbal vibes will make you forget it's low cal.

Name: Oskar Blues Can-O-Bless Resinous IPA
Description: When we say "Resinous," we're talking about potent hop flavor and aroma resulting from generous dry-hopping. A new-school blend of Bravo, Meridien, Saphir and Talus hops evoke old-school piney qualities with a tropical spin.

Name: Oskar Blues Deviant Dale’s India Pale Ale
Food Pairing: Duck  Game Bird, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm
Description: Deviant Dale’s IPA (8 percent ABV, 85 IBUs) was born at the crossroads, in a juke joint, as if Dale’s Pale Ale sold its soul to balance Deviant’s foreboding aromas of citrus, grapefruit rind and piney resins, its copper ball-of-fire color and inscrutable flavor-intense finish. Deviant is the Devil incarnate with untold amounts of malt and hedonistic Columbus dry-hopping. Oskar Blues delivers this boundary-buster in the brewery’s first 16-ounce tallboy can.

Name: Oskar Blues Steep Coast Strata Double IPA
Description: At the first sip, Steep Coast Strata DIPA blasts off into a dank citrus stratosphere, through a far-out peach and stone fruit sky, then drifts via a passionfruit parachute back down to earth on sweet breezes. Strata, a sought-after varietal from Oregon State University's lauded hop breeding program, is characterized by pronounced green cannabis notes.

Name: Oskar Blues Hotbox Coffee IPA
Description: An odd couple can make for some of the most incredibly unique tastiness. Take Hotbox Coffee IPA (7.2% ABV, 70 IBUs) for example - a piney, citrus, mango, Simcoe-hopped IPA and an infusion of cold brew extract made with Hotbox Roasters' Ethiopian beans poppin' with creamy blueberry and cacao notes.

Name: Oskar Blues Slow Chill Vienna Lager
Description: This lager is an homage to malt and the traditional beer style originating in Vienna. The Vienna malt base gives the beer a biscuity and slightly nutty tone, while a dollop of Briess Victory malt lends a lightly toasty aroma that invites you to slow down and chill with every step.

Name: Oskar Blues Rose For Daze
Description: Tart, bright prickly pear meets floral hibiscus in this refreshing, spritzy rosé beer inspired by America’s favorite pink wine. A subtle hop profile of Aramis and Centennial hops provide light berry and floral notes, matched with honey-toned malts.

Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Mighty Squirrel Cosmic Distortion Double IPA
Description: Double dry-hopped with 6 lbs. per barrel of Galaxy & Mosaic hops, this is our hoppiest IPA ever. It’s a juicy, hazy, dank double IPA with notes of passion fruit, mango, pineapple, starfruit, papaya, and tangerine.

Name: Mighty Squirrel Dear Mino NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
If beer across the state of Massachusetts tastes better and fresher, and if there are more craft options on shelves and menus today, it’s probably because of Mino! As Head of Sales for our distributor (Atlantic Beverage), Mino is a mover, shaker, master negotiator, our biggest believer, and dear friend!

And in our eyes, this has earned him the kind of opportunity every man dreams of...having a beer named after him! Introducing 'Dear Mino' – the first impression is very lively and fierce, followed by sweetness, just like the man himself! With fresh zingy lemon-lime around the edges, hints of tropical fruit and citrus dominate this beer. As Mino would say, "Listen up! This one's gonna be BIG!"

Name: Mighty Squirrel Dear Bubba
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: One Hop (Idaho 7) New England IPA

Name: Mighty Squirrel Dear Jesse
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Mighty Squirrel Original
Description: Complex with bready, caramel, and citrus notes, plus a hint of honey.

Name: Mighty Squirrel Dear Mack
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
Smooth, slick, the best of the best, and we haven’t even started talking about the beer! Mackenzie, or affectionately known to the squirrel family as “Mack,” joined our sales team in 2017 and has been lighting up our lives ever since. Sharp as a tack, quick with a joke or a warm smile, she is one of the universe’s own rare breed. Mack’s passion for beer is only matched by her love for Montana, where her love for craft beer began.

It’s only fitting that our next New England IPA in our ‘Dear Series’ (our line of single-hop IPAs), brimming with tropical notes of ripe mango, pineapple, and orchard fruit, be named after her. This one is too awesome to be known by anything else but Dear Mack!

Name: Sloop Brewing Juice Bomb IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The low bitterness and late hopping showcase the citrusy, juicy notes of American hops. A blast of tropical aroma is followed by a resiny and balanced flavor. Juice bomb features all the aspects and nuances of full hop flavor — not just bitterness.

Name: Sloop Brewing Super Soft IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Super Soft is an IPA with no boil hops for a finish that lands on the palate with the delicacy of a ton of feathers. The aroma is full of ripe, pungent tropical fruit and citrus. The flavor has notes of red grapefruit, papaya with hints of black tea.

Name: Sloop (NO) Pumpkin IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Sloop Fantastic Voyage IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: FANTASTIC VOYAGE // NEIPA brewed with Malted Wheat and Flaked Oats. Dry-hopped with Citra Cryo, Cashmere, and German Amarillo. Notes of orange syrup, rainbow sherbet, and cotton candy

Name: Sloop Brewing Confliction
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: 2016 World Beer Cup Gold Medal winner for best American Sour! The conflict of flavors in this dry-hopped sour ale combine to create a truly unique beer. Our house lactic culture creates a tart, sour base, contrasted with an intense Citra and Galaxy dry hopping. The aroma showcases citrusy, fruity elements and the finish tastes of freshly squeezed grapefruit juice.

Name: Sloop Brewing Coco Baked
Description: Brewed with milk sugar and malted oats for silky smooth, deep bodied stouts.

Name: Sloop Liquid Sorcery
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A juicy smooth IPA. Aromas of melon, cantaloupe rind and mango. Flavors of honeydew melon, strawberry, notes of of pineapple and candy. Nectar squeezed from paradise.

Name: Sloop Brewing (No) Tan Line IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: India Pale Ale w/ flaked wheat, flaked oats, & citra cryo & cashmere hops

Name: Sloop Brewing Aluminum Army
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: ALUMINUM ARMY is a hazy IPA dedicated to everyone’s favorite packaging — the CAN! They’re lining up in single file on the packaging lines, ready for duty. Brewed with malted oats and flaked oats, Aluminum Army is one of our most fruit forward beers, with aroma and flavors of passion fruit and Fruity Pebbles. Salute the Aluminum Army!

Name: Sloop Brewing Green Islands
Description: Green Islands is an unfiltered IPA brewed with oats. The oats give the beer a slightly silky smooth body, and the hops give the beer dank, citrusy, tropical nots. The finish is a refreshing tropical flavor of tangerine pith. A classic IPA with a new school twist.

Name: Sloop Brewing Techno Viking
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed with milk sugar, flaked wheat, and malted wheat for aromas of green melon and mango, flavor notes of orange sherbet and grapefruit, a smooth, creamy mouthfeel, and a big, bold, hoppy finish. Keep your tastebuds on alert for the Techno Viking invasion! THE FUTURE IS NOW.

Name: Sloop Brewing Nelson Bomb
Description: Brewed exclusively with Nelson Sauvin hops, this one off riff on Juice Bomb showcases the nuances of Nelson Sauvin hops — dank, earthy, juicy, white wine-like notes with a tropical blast of gooseberry and kiwi aroma, a fluffy white head, and a resiny balanced flavor. A hazy, golden, unfiltered IPA, Nelson Bomb features a full hop flavor, not just bitterness — providing an upfront but easy drinking beer.

Name: Sloop Brewing Cyber Punk
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed w/ milk sugar, hallertau blanc, & mosaic to hack into your taste buds w/ notes of dark, ripe stone fruit on the nose, flavors of neon melon rind & electric marmalade, & a creamy, full-bodied mouthfeel.

Name: Sloop Brewing Make It Nice
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed with flaked oats, flaked wheat, milk sugar, and a double dose of dry hop goodness! Pacific Northwest and new school German hops make this beer super fruit-forward with notes of pineapple, melon, and white wine. Whenever we do anything here at Sloop, we always make sure and say to Make It Nice — and we tried extra hard with this one!

Name: Sloop Brewing DDH Pixie Dust
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: An enhanced version of our ever-popular Pixie Dust. This clean, light, crusher of an IPA got an extra generous sprinkling of Pacific Northwest green glitter for an extra bright, pungent brew to magically turn your day around. At 6% ABV, DDH Pixie Dust was designed to be on the crushable side of the IPA style — with some extra love!

Name: Sloop Brewing Double Plus Good Citra Cashmere Chinook
Sloop Lupulin Mutant IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Lupulin Mutant is a hazy golden IPA brewed with a blend of hops from Australia and the Pacific Northwest: Galaxy and Citra. The aroma hits you with dank tangerines and lemons. The flavor finishes bright, juicy, and SUPER crushable. So good it's uncanny

Name: Sloop Brewing Simcoe Bomb
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed exclusively with Simcoe hops, SIMCOE BOMB is a hazy, golden IPA showcasing the nuanced and piney notes of Simcoe, with a blast of a tropical sherbet aroma.

Name: Sloop Brewing Juice Bomb Northeastern Special Edition IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Sloop Brewing Pixie Dust
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A light, bright, magical IPA to turn your day around. At 6% ABV it was designed to be on the crushable side of the IPA style, perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

Name: Sloop Brewing Mosaic Bomb
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A hazy, golden, unfiltered IPA with an XXL dose of TWO dry-hop additions. This DDH Mosaic Bomb tastes like dank tangerines and clementines. A blast of flavor and smooth hop bite will rock your palate out of this world.

Name: Sloop Atomic Spritzer Bomb: Red
Description: BRAND NEW COLLAB with Sixpoint! Brewed w/ malbec grape must & hallertau blanc & mosaic hops, this DOUBLE IPA has fruity, grassy aromas on the nose & flavors of cantaloupe, papaya, & wine-like notes. Not just a bomb . . . this one’s atomic!

Name: Sloop Brewing Not In My Dojo
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
Fear does not exist in this dojo. Pain does not exist in this dojo. Defeat does not exist in this dojo.

Our latest IPA is boldly brewed w/ malted oats & flaked oats, hopped w/ motueka, mosaic, & hallertau blanc for maximum IPA pleasure, & has big flavors of lime zest, candied ginger, & lychee for the win.

Strike first. Strike hard. NO MERCY.

Name: Sloop Freakout
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed w/ malted wheat & flaked wheat, intensely hopped w/ citra, motueka, & rakau, Freakout has big flavors of candied orange peel, tropical fruit punch, & cotton candy.

Name: Sloop Cashmere Bomb
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Sloop Brewing Turbo Speed
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: We mashed the mash button HARD on this one, w/ generous amounts of flaked oats & flaked wheat for a smooth, full-bodied mouth feel, then finished w/ the perfect combo move of Sabro, Cashmere, & old school Chinook for notes of coconut & candy peach rings & BIG hop flavor.

Name: Sloop Brewing Next Level
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed with hops from the Pacific Northwest and down under for a big, bold beer with notes of underripe cantaloupe and candied orange peel.

Name: Sloop Brewery Hoppy Pils
Description: Our version of a Bohemian / Czech style pilsner, Hoppy Pils leans less on bitter hop flavor and more on bright, floral hop characteristics. The lightly kilned German malt provides a rounded, delicate backbone to perfectly showcase these hop nuances. With a bouquet of noble hop aromatics and a crisp finish, Hoppy Pils is the perfect beer to satisfy a thirst of any size.

Name: Odell 90 Shilling Ale
Description: We introduced 90 Shilling, our flagship beer, at our opening party in 1989. For a while, we’d been wondering what would happen if we lightened up the traditional Scottish ale? The result is an irresistibly smooth and delicious medium-bodied amber ale. The name 90 Shilling comes from the Scottish method of taxing beer. Only the highest quality beers were taxed 90 Shillings. A shilling was a British coin used from 1549 to 1982. We think you’ll find this original ale brilliantly refreshing, and worth every shilling.

Name: Odell IPA
Description: We took the traditional IPA, originally shipped from England to India in the 1700?s, and made it bolder and more flavorful – American Style. We’ve added new varieties of highly aromatic American hops to create a distinctive bitterness profile and an incredible hop character.

Name: Odell Sippin’ Pretty
Description: More of a mantra than a beer, Sippin’ Pretty is our Fruited Sour Ale. Loaded with our unique blend of açai, guava, and elderberry, and balanced with a delicate addition of Himalayan pink sea salt, this beer pops with a bright ruby color and a refreshing tart finish. So sit back, relax, and sip on something pretty.

Name: Odell Myrcenary Double IPA
Description: Named for Myrcene, a component of essential oils in the hop flower, Myrcenary Double IPA is our tribute to those who revere the illustrious hop, and their unyielding exploit to craft hop forward beers. Brewed with a blend of hops containing the highest levels of Myrcene, this double IPA prevails with a tropical fruit-like flavor, a pungent floral aroma, and a clean getaway.

Name: Odell Mountain Standard IPA
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Fresh, Fruity, Hoppy, Intense, Peach
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Chicken, Salads  Greens
Description:
This is Mountain Standard, a tribute to our backyard and the Rocky
Mountain lifestyle. Hand-selected, modern American hop varieties build
layers of complex hop flavors with juicy, tropical notes and bold, vibrant
aromas. Join us as we help define the Mountain-Style IPA.

Name: Odell Drumroll Hazy Pale Ale
Description:
A drumroll fills you with anticipation—much like the notes in this
Hazy Pale Ale. Each year we select the rock-star hops of the harvest to
craft this bold, juicy, tropically hop-forward brew, drumming up a
citrus-inspired rhythm for what's to come.

Name: Odell Easy Street Wheat
Description: Light and refreshing, Easy Street Wheat is an unfiltered American-style wheat beer. Leaving in the yeast gives the beer a nice, smooth finish and a slightly citrusy flavor. Easy Street Wheat gets its name by brewers “taking it easy” and not filtering the beer. However, for ultimate enjoyment, we encourage you to work just a little harder in pouring it: pour 2/3 of the beer into a glass, swirl what’s left to stir up the yeast, then pour the rest and enjoy.

Name: Odell Isolation Ale
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Caramel, Dried Fruit, Earthy, Malty, Roasted
Description: Available each winter from the first of November until it runs out, Isolation ale is amber in color, malty and strong. We consider it a traditional winter warmer, without the addition of fruits or spices.  "An excellent example of a traditional winter ale made with English hops. Not too sweet, no extra spices; added just a smooth, hoppy flavor."    A funny thing happens here around summer’s end – our eyes start searching the skies for those first fall flakes. As we welcome autumn’s first snow, we celebrate the return of Isolation Ale. A sweet caramel malty ale that is balanced by a subtle crisp hop finish. Whether you ski, shred, or shoe, Isolation Ale will inspire you to make first tracks.  Available October through December

Name: Odell Lugene Chocolate Milk Stout
Description: If you’ve ever been to our brewery, you’ve likely seen the old, beat-up truck that hauls away our spent grain. That truck belongs to Lugene who’s been feeding his dairy cows the hearty malt for over a decade. Named in his honor, Lugene Chocolate Milk Stout is brewed with milk sugar and milk chocolate. The rich and creamy brew reminds us of a cold glass of chocolate milk and our hometown “Aggie” roots.

Name: Odell 180 Shilling
Description: In 1989 we opened our doors with our flagship, 90 Shilling. We’re celebrating our 30th Anniversary with a double version of the recipe that started it all. 180 Shilling has a hearty roasted malt base balanced by subtle earthy hops and aged on oak to create notes of toffee, plum, vanilla and dried cherry. Thanks for 30 years of beers, and here’s to many more.

Name: Odell’s Extra Special Red
Description: Extra Special Red is our Imperial Red Ale, a crimson-hued brew full of juicy hop flavors and aromas of pine and stone fruit. After 6 months of aging in rye whiskey casks, it was roused from its oak cradle to the bottle in your hands. The barrels impart notes of sweet vanilla and soft tannins, while the hops settle into the background in favor of the strong malt foundation. Slainte!

Name: Odell Fernet Aged Porter
Description: Over the past year, we’ve collected empty Fernet Barrels from our friends at Leopold Bros. Distillery. Their distinct Fernet includes lavender, honeysuckle, ginger root, bitter aloe, dandelion root, rose petals, chamomile, and pepper. Inspired by the herb & spice flavors of this dark minty liqueur, we promptly filled the barrels with a rich porter. The roasty chocolate malt character is infused with hints of mint and licorice from the herb-soaked oak, creating a decadent flavor and aroma.

Name: Odell Witkist White Grapefruit Ale
Description: Witkist Grapefruit White Ale is a modern take on a Belgian-style White Ale with bright aromas of citrus from pureed grapefruit, and a delicate spice from dried orange peel and coriander. Complex yet delicate with a clean, refreshing finish, Witkist brings an unexpected twist on tradition.

Name: Odell 5 Barrel Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: The distinctive hop character of our 5 Barrel Pale Ale is due to the extraction of essential oils from select hops. We treat 5 Barrel Pale Ale to an infusion of fresh whole hop flowers in the Hop Back and the Fermentor, as well as four hop additions during the kettle boil. We like how this gives the beer a fresh, lively flavor and aroma.

Name: Odell Loose Leaf
Description: You know those epic days that start with an idea, turn into a dare and end with a great story to tell? This is the beer for those days. Crisp and refreshing like any respectable session ale, but a bit more hop-forward and flavorful than some. Perfect for going with the flow.

Name: Odell Brewing Friek
Tasting Notes: Cherry, Fruity, Funky, Red Fruit, Sour
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Fish - White, Shellfish
Description: This unique blend of framboise (raspberry sour ale) and traditional lambic kriek (cherry sour ale) is aged in oak barrels in our cellar. Fresh raspberries are then added to the wild fermented brew just prior to the final blending, creating a subtle sweetness to balance the tart cherry flavors.

Name: Odell Dark Theory Black Cherry Sour
Description: Experience the gravity of Dark Theory. Black cherries swirl in an abyss of wild fermented imperial porter. Belgian yeast strains illuminate a galaxy of plum an cranberry flavors atop layers of tart cherry and sweet bread. Roasted malts add notes of coffee, chocolate, and tobacco for a beer that is full-bodied, complex, and out-of-this-world smooth.

Name: Odell The Meddler
Categories: ALE, Brown Ale, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Odell Flemish Giant Flanders Red Sour Ale
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Odell Barreled Treasure Imperial Stout
Description: A reward of hidden bliss awaits the intrepid explorer whose liquid journey brings them to Barreled Treasure. An imperial stout aged in both bourbon and rum barrels and awakened with a hefty dose of coffee, Barreled Treasure has a luscious, complex profile packed with aromas and flavors of rich espresso, blackstrap molasses and baker’s chocolate. Your riches await!

Name: Odell Jolly Russian Imperial Stout
Description: Bridging the Baltic and Caribbean Seas, Jolly Russian is a rich Russian Imperial Stout stowed away in Rum Barrels for aging. Dark as night and thick as the raging sea, this brew boasts notes of coffee and cocoa with waves of oak, spiced molasses, dried fruit and vanilla from the planks. It’s dangerously delicious!

Name: Odell Pulp Theory Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The mind of a brewer is a complex space, blending the worlds of art and science. Pulp Theory is our mad journey into both with a hyper-hopped hazy IPA crafted to accentuate bold hop flavors of ripe orange, pineapple juice, and fruit punch. Join us at the collision of imagination and possibility. Available July-September 2020

Name: Odell Elephunk Wild Imperial IPA
Description: Striking a perfect balance between sweet and tart, Elephunk Imperial Wild IPA showcases layers of flavors that dance on the palate in funky liquid harmony. Pungent tropical fruit aromas burst forward while oak-aged traits of vanilla, brown sugar, and cedar create a slightly sweet contrast to the tart flavor. Notes of ripe pineapple and peach pie unite in this wild-inspired barrel aged imperial IPA

Name: Odell Tree Shaker Imperial Mango IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Dessert - Fruit, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel
Description: Tree Shaker is an Imperial Mango IPA showcasing a tropical hop bill that accentuates the natural mango sweetness, and features pronounced hop flavors and aromas of mango, coconut, melon and orange.Available April - August 2020

Name: Odell Hammer Chain Fresh Grind
Description: Hammer Chain was born to reinvent our approach to Double IPAs. Named after the spinning blades of our custom-built machine that pulverizes each whole-flower hop, Hammer Chain is brewed with meticulously sourced, vibrant American hop varieties and packed with notes of drippy tropical fruit, radiant peach, and sweet stonefruit.

Name: Odell’s Woodcut No. 9 Imperial IPA
Description: To celebrate our 30th anniversary we’re bringing back our renowned Woodcut Series. For each release, freshly made barrels provide a blank canvas of oak flavor. Woodcut #9 is an Imperial IPA aged in medium-toast American oak barrels which imparts notes of vanilla, almond and dried fruit, while massive dry-hopping adds vibrant tropical fruit aromas, combining to create a beautifully complex ale. Cheers to 30 years!

Name: Odell Peach Stand Rambler Blonde Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Stinky, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Salads  Greens
Description:
There’s nothing quite like the summer harvest of Palisade peaches. Peach Stand Rambler is our tribute to the hands that carefully tend those orchards. A crisp and refreshing Blonde Ale brewed to accentuate fresh Palisade peaches, this beer is refreshing and bright like a calm Colorado sunset.
Available April - August 2020

Name: Odell Seasonal
Description: Rotating seasonal series - product availability may differ from the image shown, and varies based on brewery production and retailer inventory. Please see odellbrewing.com for current availability

Name: New Belgium Fat Tire Amber Ale
Food Pairing: Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Nuts, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables
Description: Fat Tire is the easy-drinking Amber Ale born in Colorado from New Belgium Brewing Company, a certified B-Corp.

Name: New Belgium Voodoo Ranger Imperial IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Mushrooms, Root Vegetables
Description: New Belgium Voodoo Ranger Imperial IPA is a rare blend of choice hops that creates an explosion of fresh-cut pine and citrus flavors for a complex, rich and delicious flavor.

Name: New Belgium Voodoo Ranger IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Lamb, Mushrooms, Nuts, Root Vegetables
Description: Bursting with tropical aromas and juicy fruit flavors from Mosaic and Amarillo hops, this golden IPA is perfectly bitter with a refreshing, sublime finish.

Name: New Belgium Voodoo Ranger Juicy Haze IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Mushrooms, Root Vegetables
Description: Packed with bright tropical aromas and brilliant citrusy flavors, this unfiltered IPA wraps up with a pleasantly smooth finish.

Name: New Belgium Rotating Seasonal, Accumulation White IPA
Description:
The latest in New Belgium's Seasonal Rotational Series.  

This winter, IBUs start accumulating like snow in Colorado with our new Accumulation White IPA. Brewing a white IPA was not only a way to salute the white beauty falling from the sky, but a direct revolt to the longstanding tradition of brewing dark beers for winter and winter seasonal beers. At least that’s what our rebellious brewers like to claim as they shovel in plenty of mosaic and Amarillo hop varietals and a bit of wheat for a smooth mouthfeel. Stack up a few cases of Accumulation White IPA to keep your long nights glowing blizzard white.

Name: New Belgium Voodoo Ranger Rotating IPA Series
Description: Limited release Voodoo Ranger IPA. Get it while you can. Note: Beer varies with seasons.Exploding with tropical citrus flavors and aromas

Name: New Belgium Mountain Time Premium Lager
Food Pairing: Fruit - Citrus, Mushrooms, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens
Description: Cold & refreshing as snowmelt in the spring, Mountain Time Premium Lager is brewed with only the finest ingredients by the proud employee-owners of New Belgium Brewing. This refreshing lager will take you to another time & place. Live life on Mountain Time.

Name: New Belgium Fat Tire Belgian Style White
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Salads  Greens
Description: Taking inspiration from our decades of experience brewing Belgian beers, Fat Tire Belgian White is made with Seville oranges and Indian coriander.  It’s a fresh, perfectly sweet, natural tasting Belgian White.

Name: New Belgium Voodoo Ranger American Haze
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fruit - Dried, Mushrooms, Nuts, Salads  Greens
Description: With notes of passion fruit and freedom, American Haze is a supremely drinkable, juicy, and unfiltered IPA brewed with all-American hops.

Name: New Belgium Trippel Belgian Style Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cured Meats, Mushrooms, Salads  Greens
Description: Our Trippel has always been a big, beautiful Belgian-style ale. This golden beer opens with a bold blast of spicy Noble hops, courtesy of Saaz and Hallertau Mittlefruh, and gives way to the fruity aromas offered by our traditional Belgian yeast. Brewed with Pilsner and Munich malts, Trippel is classically smooth and complex, and sings with a high-note of sweet citrus before a pleasantly dry finish delivers a warm, strong boozy bite. Give Trippel a sip to get you smiling.

Name: New Belgium Honey Orange Tripel
Food Pairing: Cheese - Stinky, Cured Meats, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: For this recipe, our brewers drew inspiration from Belgian Golden Strong Ale, a style we love. We sought out the very best ingredients, sourcing wild honey from the African Bronze Honey Company, a member of the Fair Trade Federation and a certified B-Corp. The Seville orange peel is freshly ground. In the end, we created a big, sweet and citrusy Belgian-style Tripel with thoughtfully sourced ingredients.

Name: New Belgium Glütiny Pale Ale
Description:
There’s an uprising in the craft beer world, a mutiny on gluten, and the movement’s invaded our brewhouse, demanding we finally brew an uncompromised gluten-reduced pale ale fit for the most adventurous hopheads. Our response? This is Glütiny! 

For this new year-round release, we armed the beer with a hefty dose of exotic Equinox hops, lending breezy guava, papaya and stone fruits to a wash of sweet, slightly herbal malt flavors. We then employed a special enzyme during the brewing process, which breaks down the gluten. 

Like any delicious pale ale, expect swift bitterness in the swallow and an assertively dry finish, just how we like it. Ready to join the uprising? Taste the Glütiny.  

The fine print: This product is fermented from grains containing gluten and crafted to remove gluten. The gluten content of this product cannot be verified, and this product may contain gluten.

Name: New Belgium La Folie
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Tasting Notes: Funky, Intense, Oak, Red Fruit, Sour, Tart
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Fruit - Dried, Lamb
Description:
La Folie, French for "the folly," is a beer steeped in New Belgium brewing tradition. This wood-aged, sour brown spends one to three years in big oak barrels known as foeders. And when the beer finally hits the glass, La Folie is sharp and sour, full of green apple, cherry, and plum-skin notes. Pouring a deep mahogany, the mouthfeel will get you puckering while the smooth finish will get you smiling. 

Not a beer for the timid, La Folie is a sour delight that will turn your tongue on its head. Find out why it's considered one of the best sour beers around.

Name: New Belgium Old Aggie Superior Lager
Food Pairing: Cured Meats, Nuts, Pasta, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description:
What better beer for a fall football game than a sessionable, crisp lager? For this special collaboration with Colorado State University, we brewed an incredibly easy-drinking lager that clocks in at 4.7% ABV.

Brewed with the finest malts and brightest hops, this beer floats subtly sweet honeycomb notes across the tongue, while a citrusy snap of Cascade and Chinook hops punctuates each delightful sip.

Available along the Colorado Front Range.

Name: New Belgium Mural Watermelon Lime
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Pork, Salads  Greens
Description: In Mexico, the agua fresca is everywhere.  Meaning "fresh waters" agua frescas are usually found in street food stalls and feature a blend of seasonal fruits.  Brewed in partnership with Mexico's premier craft brewery, Cerveceris Primus.  Infused with real fruit and weighing in at 4% ABV with just 110 calories & just 0.1 gram of sugar, Mural is bubbly, light, refreshing & delicious.

Name: New Belgium Accumulation White IPA
Description: Accumulation White IPA was inspired by the white beauty that falls each winter from our Colorado sky. Flurries of Mosaic and Amarillo hops bring soft fruit and citrus flavor, followed by a layer of bitter. Piled high in IBUs, Accumulation will make your winter brighter.

Name: New Belgium Citradelic Tangerine IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Salads  Greens
Description: Tune in and hop out with New Belgium Citradelic. Set adrift on a kaleidoscopic wave of hoppiness brought to you by a mystical marriage of Citra hops and tangerine peel, which elevates each sip onto a plane of pure tropical, fruity pleasure. Citradelic’s namesake hop and fruit combine to jam with visions of additional hops like citrusy Mandarina Bavaria, tropical Azzaca, and fruity Galaxy for a colorful explosion that’s grounded by just a touch of malty sweetness. Bored by the status quo? Expand your palate with a pour of Citradelic.

Name: New Belgium The Hemperor HPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Hard Aged, Mushrooms, Nuts, Root Vegetables
Description:
Get ready: an exciting new offering that’ll change the way you think about hoppy beers is coming your way. The brewers at New Belgium have created a new style of IPA: The Hemperor HPA. 

With the popularity of hoppy beers, our brewers are always on the lookout for different hop varieties and the complexities and flavors new strains can bring. That’s where hemp comes into the picture. Without getting too nerdy, we found a unique way to recreate hemp terpene flavors in a beer, which complement the inclusion of hop flavors and hemp hearts (seeds) in a brand new, delicious way—not to mention this beer is extremely dank! The flavors and aromas are so unique that it’s a style unto itself, hence HPA.

Name: New Belgium Tart Lychee Tropical Sour
Description: Lychee fruit is so insanely sweet and flavorful you almost can’t stand it alone. Sour to the rescue! Tart Lychee is brewed with exotic lychee fruit and cinnamon, and then blended with sour Felix from our wood cellar for a citrusy, tropical sip that attacks with an invigorating tart bite.  Explore the tropics, but brace for the wild.

Name: New Belgium Le Terroir
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Duck  Game Bird, Mushrooms, Root Vegetables
Description: Le Terroir is a french term meaning ‘of the earth’ and is frequently used to reference the natural, environmental conditions that affect beer. So it is with our Wood Cellar and the foeders in which Le Terroir is created. These oak barrels combine nature and craftsmanship to age our sour beer in varying temperatures, humidity and vibrations. Coupled with dry-hopping using fruit-forward and experimental hops, Le Terroir is a beer that rewards differently every time you experience it.

Name: New Belgium Transatlantique Kriek
Tasting Notes: Cherry, Dark Fruit, Fruity, Sour, Stone Fruit, Tart
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Stinky, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Nuts, Turkey
Description:
Winner of a gold medal at the 2018 Great American Beer Festival, Transatlantique Kriek begins its life in oaken vessels of Gert Christiaens’ Oud Beersel, a 130-year-old lambic brewery in the Zenne valley of Belgium – home of authentic Lambic beer. After time spent aging in wood, Oud Beersel’s lambic is blended with tart Polish cherries and shipped across the Atlantic to New Belgium. 

In concert with Oud Beersel’s cherry lambic, or Kriek, we blend an equal portion of golden sour ale matured for 1 – 3 years in our oak vessels called foeders. 50% Sour Golden Ale blended with 50% Traditional Cherry Lambic Ale leads to an intense cherry nose, a sour flash across the palate and a refreshing, mouthwatering finish.

Name: New Belgium Sour IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Stinky, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Duck  Game Bird, Mushrooms, Root Vegetables
Description: An IPA that runs against the wind.  Juicy and tropical notes are lifted to new heights by the addition of our iconic wood-aged sour for a flight of refreshing acidity.

Name: New Belgium Up Next Series
Description:
Here, then gone.  Always unique.  Always easy to drink.  Blurring the lines between beverages & pushing the limits of beer innovation.  One series, endless innovation.

Description: Wachusett Brewery and Boston’s Rock Station, WAAF have teamed up to bring you Revered Red. Name: Wachusett Blackshack Porter
Description: Chocolate, coffee and oatmeal flake undertones and a malty backbone give this porter it's flavor. It's dark complexion and bitter hops give it it's character. The original brewing facility gave it it's name.

Name: Wachusett Strawberry
Description: The complex, spicy flavors of the traditional Belgian yeast are offset by the delicious strawberry flavor. It is brewed with 160 lbs of strawberry puree per batch.

Name: Wachusett Summer
Description: An American wheat ale with a hint of lemon is made for summer weather. Refreshing, light, and ready for the beach.

Name: Wachusett Blood Orange
Description: The newest addition to our family for the fall season is a wheat ale infused with the sweet & juicy flavors of fresh blood orange.

Name: Wachusett Larry
Description: LARRY was originally brewed this summer for the Publick House’s Hop Head Throwdown. David -- owner of the Publick House -- It was such a success in growlers here and at the Publick House, that we brewed another batch to go to speciality accounts. We’ll be putting it in 22’s in March 85 IBUs 5-hops (Simcoe, Magnum, Amarillo, Cascade, Chinook)

Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Wally Juice combines a crisp, acidic hop character balanced out with the sweetness of an all-natural blood orange infusion, creating a unique, reddish hued interpretation of the style. Wally Juice is a hazier, juicier sequel to our original New England IPA, Wally.

Name: Wachusett Glory American IPA
Description: This crushable modern style IPA is loaded with hops that provide an aroma of mango, pineapple & pear. With a soft silky body and ABV of 5.5% this is an easy drinking IPA that everyone can enjoy.

Name: Wachusett Mass Soul IPA
Description: Channel your inner Mass Soul with this luscious and delicious IPA.  A ripe blend of passion fruit, pineapple and other tropical fruit notes compliments the soft mouthfeel and unique vibrancy of this medium bodied brew.

Name: Wachusett IPA Mix Pack

Name: Wachusett IPA
Description: The appearance was a nice looking hazy yellow to orange color with a one finger white foamy head that dissipates at a nice pace and ends up leaving some nice slightly foamy lacing. The smell was completely floral but did allow a decent citrus back up. Don’t count on any sweet malts trying to show up, damn, this stuff is powerful. The taste was florally and citrusy sweet. On the palate, this one sat about a light to medium and showed a decent sessionability about it. The carbonation had the right amount of sharpness for an AIPA.

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Commonwealth Amaranthine Belgian Strong Dark Ale

Name: Commonwealth Tinta Rosa
Description: Tinta Rosa is our Sangria inspired, 5.4% Gose, made with pomegranate, plum, raspberry and oranges. This is the 4th iteration of our international street vendor drink series.

Name: Commonwealth Marvolo Nitro Imperial Chocolate Stout
Description: An imperial stout where cold brewed coffee, toasted dark coconut and Dutch cocoa melt and merge seamlessly to sire this superbly smooth roast, infused with flavors so bold and dark that even He-Who-Must-Not-Be-Named would stop in for a quick drink mid-mayhem.

Name: Commonwealth Chinchilla Chocolate Hazelnut Imperial Milk Stout
Description: Nitro Chocolate Hazelnut Imperial Milk Stout

Name: Commonwealth Papi Chulo
Description: NE Style IPA w/ Citra, Mosaic & Idaho 7

Description: The 8% big brother version of Papi Chulo, super juicy with low bitterness!

Description: This IPA delivers a sweet Pineapple, Mango nose with tropical flavors courtesy of a carefully selected house Brettanomyces yeast strain. Blond, full bodied, deceptively drinkable

Name: Commonwealth Incandesce IPA
Description: Passion Fruit, Melon, & Grapefruit Notes

Description: Nelson & Vic Secret Double IPA

Description: Double IPA with Hallertau Blanc, Citra and Mosaic.

Name: Commonwealth Valkyrie IPA
Description: The Legend of The VALKYRIE embodied in this huge hopped Sabro, Strata and El Dorado Double IPA

Name: Commonwealth Aureole Pilsner
Description: Pale Belgian malt unites with noble hops from Czech and Styria creating a clean, golden lager with a hint of malt sweetness followed by a refined and balanced finishing bitterness.

Name: Kalik Light Platinum
Description: A step up from Kalik light.

Name: Bearded Iris Homestyle
Description: A soft, juicy IPA brewed with oats, and hopped singularly and intensely with Mosaic.

Name: Bearded Iris Tunnel Vision IPA
Description: Focus, focus. This 6.8% IPA showcases a blurred-edge mouthfeel, multilayered juiciness of mosaic and citra, and a chewy, lemon starburst zing courtesy of el dorado oil.

Name: Bearded Iris DDH Ever Clever
Description: It’s the cleverest of the ever-ests. Your favorite banter-slinging, foxy DIPA now bursts with a wicked double dry hop that’ll keep your taste buds as nimble as your wits.

Name: Bearded Iris Telepathy Pale Ale
Description: Because we’ve been sensing you might need another highly crushable, tiny beer to spruce up your fridge vibes. This 4.5% pale delivers a sensory tingle of citra and amarillo straight to your brain.

Name: Bearded Iris Sundaze Breakfast Sour
Description: At the SUNDAZE cafe on Planet BIBCO, they’re known for an interstellar breakfast sour so satisfying and mouthwateringly overflowing with flavor it bends time and space. This house specialty blends peanut butter + flaked coconut + ripe raspberries & blackberries + orange peel + almond + cinnamon + vanilla bean and lactose into a thick and creamy glowing flare that’s good in any dimension you find yourself.

Name: Bearded Iris Static
Description: Don’t let the name fool you. STATIC sizzles and pops above the background noise. Peanut butter + coconut + apricot + cinnamon + vanilla bean and lactose blend in this breakfast sour that’s an energetic clash somewhere between pb & j and crunchy coconut french toast.

Name: Bearded Iris V. Latte Imperial Stout
Description: Need a little pick-me-up? How about another imperial oatmeal stout? This one delicately folds together cocoa nibs, vanilla bean, lactose & Blue Heron, a fruity, bright espresso blend courtesy of our friends at Crema Coffee Roasters here in Nashville.

Name: Bearded Iris Little Treat
Description: Our first session pastry stout is a tasty LITTLE TREAT. Sweet sprinkles of toasted coconut + raw coconut + swirls of coconut milk & lactose, wrapped inside a smooth, easy-drinking body make for an irresistibly flavorful refreshment perfect for the summer heat.

Name: Bearded Iris Chief Of Chiefs Double IPA
Description: First, they came for the Mosaic. Then, the Simcoe. And finally, the Citra. But the path to greatness must be paved with empty cans and crushed dreams, says the new DIPA in town, because now this Chief has it all.

Name: Bearded Iris Offbeat Double IPA
Description: For when you’re craving classic, but with an unexpected skip of disarming softness. A casual 7.5% DIPA feat. that golden simcoe + citra duo, OFFBEAT hits the right notes when it needs to.

Name: Bearded Iris Denali Vision IPA
Description: You might spy a distinct zip of melon, but this variant promises to fill your vision with Denali’s resinous ripe pineapple and a subtle hint of pine.

Name: Bearded Iris Scatterbrain IPA
Description: This hazy Simcoe IPA is bursting with aromas of passionfruit and pine.

Name: Bearded Iris Boomerang
Description: Toss one back and head in for another. This DIPA flows through a trajectory of enigma + el dorado + mosaic cryo + simcoe cryo that ripples with soft tangerine, pear, and grapefruit pith on looping repeat.

Name: Bearded Iris Lucid IPA
Description: Ever feel like you’re caught in a dream? Our latest Imperial IPA blends the waking-state wonder of el dorado + citra + simcoe into a phantasmagoric pint. Fall into a world of whimsical, rarely seen apripassion fruit, ripe pineappleoupe, and melting tropicitrus, with a fuzzy 9.5% lying just beneath the surface.

Name: Bearded Iris Tempo Double IPA
Description: The syncopation of el dorado, citra, and centennial lend this DIPA a pleasant, bright complexity & well-timed juicy citrus and pear notes.

Name: Bearded Iris Hex DIPA
Description: When the powers of styrian wolf + vic secret + simcoe combine, this spellbinding DIPA materializes. HEX invokes shimmering notes of summer strawberry and ripe kiwi to bewitch and beguile your taste buds.

Name: Bearded Iris Kinetic IPA
Description: Like poetry in motion. Our latest IPA fuses Mosaic, Simcoe, Amarillo, Citra & Nelson into energetic, vibrant hop movement that just won’t quit.

Name: Bearded Iris Shakedown IPA
Description: Up or down, no matter which way you shake it our latest IPA mixes Michigan chinook (from Hop Head Farms) + citra + columbus into a refreshing oscillation of grapefruit zest, ripe pomelo, and nuanced pine & spice.

Name: Bearded Iris Double Scatterbrain DDH
Description: This is your brain on Double Scatterbrain, DDH with citra. Double the piney passion fruit goodness you know and love + now double the dry hopped citra magic you crave for a pint that’s sure to make your brains feel like Waffle House hashbrowns.

Name: Bearded Iris Queen Bee DIPA
Description: Sun-kissed threads of orange blossom honey, African Queen hops, and soft heaps of golden naked oats flow together into this powerful and regal DIPA. QUEEN BEE is an elegant and bold expression of nectarine and currant, sweet florals, and commanding citrus, all in delicate balance.

Name: Bearded Iris Parallelogram Double IPA
Description: School’s out but we’re kicking it Euclidean over here with our newest release, brewed with pals at Cloudburst Brewing.  PARALLELOGRAM maps proportionately potent lines of citra + 630 + cashmere into angular spreads of sweet lemon-orange, summer melon, and cherry candy.

Name: Bearded Iris Again & Again
Description: Again & Again, our hybrid east/west coast style pale, showcases citra, centennial, simcoe, warrior & columbus hops, dry-hopped at our DIPA rate to leave the echo of each sip lingering on your palate. At an easygoing 5.5%, it’s worth repeating.

Name: Bearded Iris Escape Artist Double IPA
Description: Our newest release isn’t easy to pin down. Strata + cashmere + citra hops tie to subtle strands of expressive English yeast for a DIPA that’s smooth and just a bit of a sweet talker. Silky fresh-sliced mango mouthfeel and undaunted notes of lemon squares, clementine rind, and refreshing citrus sorbet leave a lasting impression.

Name: Bearded Iris Mirror Mirror DIPA
Description: Open the portal to a flipside wonderland of galaxy + enigma + vic secret, where flickers of citrus pith thread into geometric slices of peach and looping frames of melon and white grape.

Name: Bearded Iris Pep Talk
Description: Our latest pilsner blends perle + hallertau blanc + nelson into an uplifting conversation of bright key lime, sparkling white grape cider, and overripe passion fruit, at an encouraging 4.2% to boot. We can all use a PEP TALK now and then, can’t we?

Name: Harpoon IPA
Description: As enjoyable today as it was in ‘93, IPA is a regional favorite and a craft beer classic. Styled after an English IPA but brewed with distinctly American hops, it’s citrusy, refreshing, and perfectly balanced– as perfect on a Cape Cod beach as it is in a VT ski lodge or Boston dive bar. This is New England's Original IPA.

Name: Harpoon Seasonal Series
Description: Rotating seasonal series - product availability may differ from the image shown, and varies based on brewery production and retailer inventory. Please contact customer support with any questions.

Name: Harpoon Rec League Pale Ale
Description: An all-star lineup of ingredients that include a healthy dose of hops, sea salt, buckwheat, and chia work together to create this quenching pale ale. Low in alcohol, light in calories, and just a little hazy, Rec League was crafted to be your #1 cool-down companion.

Name: Harpoon Dragon Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: This new wave Berliner Weisse is a tropically tart alternative to your typical light beer. Dragon fruit and hibiscus brighten a lively wheat base with maca root and sea salt to keep your tempo going. Delightfully different yet easy-drinking – DragonWeisse is the perfect choice for when the day’s been long but the night’s still young.

Name: Harpoon Winter Warmer
Description: When you bring a glass of this dark copper ale to your lips to take your first sip you will notice the aroma of cinnamon. There is no aromatic hop added that might overpower the distinct spice scent. The medium body of this beer is formed from caramel and pale malts. These create enough body to support the spices without making the beer excessively rich. Bittering hops are added to counter the sweetness of the malt and spice. The finish of the beer is a blend of cinnamon and nutmeg. The combination of these two spices results in a balanced, pumpkin-pie flavor.

Description: No Whalez Here was brewed on June 12, 2017 with Hill Country well water, White Horn pilsner malt from Blacklands, malted wheat, raw wheat, flaked wheat, Carafoam malt, rolled oats, hops, fresh-crushed Texas coriander, Texas tangerines, and Texas lavender. Name: Jester King Snorkel
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Jester King Beachtimez Sportzketball
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Beachtimez Sportzketball was brewed on March 24, 2016 with Hill Country well water, malted barley, malted wheat, raw wheat, and hops. It was fermented in stainless steel with our mixed culture of brewers yeast, and native yeast and bacteria harvested from the land and air around our brewery. It was then refermented in stainless steel with loquats grown here in central Texas.

Name: Jester King Part And Parcel
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Jester King Part & Parcel — the first beer in modern history brewed with 100% Texas grown and malted grain.   Made from just well water, Texas barley, hops, yeast, and bacteria, is a great example of our philosophy on farmhouse ales. In this case, the land told us what beer to make, not the other way around. We didn’t set out to create a specific flavor/aroma profile. Rather, we took what was available to us from our surroundings, which then determined how the beer tasted and smelled. We didn’t “master” the beer by bending nature to our will. We took what nature gave us and presented it as straightforwardly as we could.  Part & Parcel was brewed on October 3rd, 2016 with Hill Country well water, 100% Endeavor malt from Blacklands, Perle hops, and our mixed culture of brewers yeast and native yeast and bacteria. We think it’s the first single malt and single hop (or “SMASH” beer) we’ve made. It’s 5.5% alcohol by volume, 29 IBU, 3.7 pH, and has a finishing gravity of 1.007. It was packaged on November 21st, 2016 and is unfiltered, unpasteurized, and 100% naturally conditioned.

Taking a further cue from the slow and steady winter fermentation of the style, we allowed Reposé to rest in brandy barrels for almost a year. Unfiltered, unpasteurized, and 100% bottle-conditioned.

Name: Jester King Das Uberkind

Name: Jester King Estival Dichotomous

Name: Jester King Thrash Metal
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: A golden colored, high gravity (O.G. 1.074) ale, brewed with pilsner, wheat and caramunich malts, along with a good dose of American hops and fermented with Jester King’s farmhouse yeast, finishing at 9.3% alcohol by volume. It is a hop forward beer with dank, resinous hop flavor and aroma, balanced by lightly kilned malt flavors, farmhouse yeast esters and a bit of warming alcohol.

Name: Jester King Sin Frontera
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: All three breweries involved in the collaboration ferment their beer with unique blends of yeast and bacteria. In the case of Jester King, all of our beer is fermented with a mixed culture of microorganisms consisting of brewers yeast and native yeast and bacteria harvested from the air and wildflowers around our brewery in the Texas Hill Country. We brewed our version of Cerveza Sin Frontera at our brewery in October 2013 with the help of Chad Yakobson of Crooked Stave and Raphaël Mettler of Trois Dames. The wort, brewed with Hill Country well water, barley, wheat, oats, and hops, was initially fermented in stainless steel for three months, then refermented in Spanish sherry barrels for twelve months, and finally refermented in bottles, kegs, and casks for three more months.

Name: Jester King Salt Lick Censored
Description: Pecan Wood Smoked Saison Crafted in the once commonplace, Old World tradition of bière de coupage, young, dry hopped ale is blended with old, barrel-aged sour beer fermented with native yeast. A portion of the malt was smoked over pecan wood at The Salt Lick BBQ in Driftwood, Texas. Unfiltered, unpasteurized and naturally conditioned.

Name: Jester King Örter i Mörker
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Örter i Mörker was brewed with well water, malted barley, hops, woodear mushrooms, dried dill, dried caraway seeds, and fresh pine needles. It was fermented with our mixed culture and aged in 225L oak barrels formerly containing akvavit, a Scandinavian spirit flavored with caraway or dill.

Name: Jester King Gotlandsdricka

Description: Gotlandsdricka, meaning “Drink of the Good Land”, is believed to have been the beer of the Vikings. Our rendition of this ancient style is inspired by the traditional farmhouse ales once brewed on the island of Gotland, off the coast of Sweden. Unfiltered, unpasteurized, and naturally-conditioned.
