Name: Spiteful Brewing Peanut Butter Porter
Description: On two wooden peg-legs Pirate Pigeon click-clocks through the gutters of the loop. In his racksack: a jar of peanut butter and a treasure map, ’X’ marks the spot. If only he knew how to read. He takes his perch upon the Tribune Tower, beside the gargoyles. He flutters off, headed north this time, toward the brewery. Take cover, he’s armed with peanut butter bombs. He might be after more than just out tanks!

Name: Spiteful Brewing Ba God Damn Pigeon
Description: Don’t fight it, SPITE IT! Our God Damn Pigeon Porter was brewed with our friends from across the pind in mind. We use traditional Englush Amber malt, but being the unruly Americans we are, we put our own happy twist on things. One of our favorite hops, Simcoe was added late in the boil. This delightful Porter will take your mind off the everyday nuisances of living in a big city, especially those f-ing pigeons!

Name: Spiteful Brewing Time Stealers Porter
Description: Trying to stay on schedule and on task? Too bad. That unavoidable person is coming your way, ready to steal an hour of your time by talking about his kid’s birthday party. This ale was made with amber and chocolate malts to add a biscuit and slightly roasted flavor. Molasses was added during the boil which gives off the perfect amount of sweetness. Now that your time has been stolen, you might as well go ahead and grab a beer.

Name: Spiteful Brewing Gold Coast Problems
Description: Don't fight it, Spite It!  Valet taking too long to retrieve your Benz?  Hostess lost your reservation?  Bouncer says your name isn't on the list?  We have a prescription for all of these Gold Coast Problems.  Our Wit is spiced with coriander and citrus zest.  Fruity and refreshing, this beer surely won't be an inconvenience to your taste buds.  But like my old man said, "whatever floats your yacht."

Name: Spiteful Brewing Hot Dog Meets Bush
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: The Hot Dog Meets the Bush is a collaboration between  Spiteful and Denali Brewing Company out of Talkeetna, Alaska.  We worked together to create a beer with ingredients unique to each  brewery's home. For us, here in Chicago, mustard seeds  seemed an obvious choice given the city's obsession  with the Chicago hot dog. To complement that,  Denali brought Alaskan Blueberries with them.  Together our ingredients blend for a refreshing Saison.

Name: Spiteful Alley Time Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Simcoe-hopped American pale ale. Crushable!

Name: Twang Gose with Guava
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Guava, Sour, Tart, Tropical Fruit
Description: Tart wheat beer with guava. Tropical and refreshing!

Name: Spiteful Malevolance Ris
Description: "Pours nearly opaque with a fading head, some oily legs and no lace. The nose is a tad medicinal and boozy along with fig, prune, chocolate, tobacco, tar, Mexican sugar, molasses, herbal hops and espresso. The taste is mostly sweet malts, some dark fruit twang, earthy tobacco like note with an okay amount of bitterness and charred ashy notes. The mouth feel is oily and sticky but not really heavy, warming and boozy. Young and aggressive that needs to age out but also seems to need a bit more bitterness to counterbalance the sugars. It is worthy a try for any stoutie.

Name: Spiteful I Hate My Boss
Description: Pours mostly clear and black with a small, creamy, lightly-tanned head. The bouquet is a mouth-watering mélange of brownie brittle, espresso and vanilla. Full-bodied and creamy with busy carbonation. The flavor presents jet black mocha – espresso roast coffee and 93% cacao dark chocolate – joined by an acrid, carbonic note of black patent malt.

Name: Spiteful Brewing Worst Driver Award
Description: Don't fight it, Spite It!  The first beer in our idiot award series is this delightful honey stout.  It's made to take your mind off the road rage created by that driver  who was either putting their makeup on, texting, or both.  They go 5 mph the second the snow hits the ground,  many times this is done with a dog on their lap.  So when you get home after honking the horn,  relax with this stout, brewed with local honey  giving it the right amount of flavor.  Everyone hates that guy, so don't be that guy.

Name: Spiteful Brewing Ba Malevolence
Description: Malevolence stout aged in FEW bourbon Barrels.

Name: Spiteful Brewing Ba G.F.Y. Stout
Description: $78.00 USD    G.F.Y. Stout (Case)    Alc. 8% By Vol.    Style: American Stout    Contains Qty 12: 22oz Bo

Name: Spiteful Brewing Working For The Weekend
Description: Dank double IPA w/ Citra & Mosaic hops

Name: Spiteful Messenger IPA
Description: To all the bike messengers out there who dedicate their lives to not giving in  to the man. This Imperial IPA was brewed for you with Citra hops to help  take your minds of grimy Lower Wacker, aimless pedestrians,  a**hole security guards and of course, answering the infamous question:  "what's the weather like?"   There may be slow days, but you gotta admit, it's better  than wasting your life away at a desk!

Name: Spiteful IPA
Description: Citra-hopped American IPA

Name: Spiteful Lunch Beer Luke
Description: Don't fight it, Spite It!    You don't want to work with Luke when he doesn't get a lunch beer.    He's not himself, and his unquenchable thirst propels him into a blind rage.    Raised on Wu-Tang in the frigid streets of NW Minnesota,    his blood is the coldest shit out there.    One time we ran out of lunch beers. Luke snapped his skateboard.    He ate a lit cigarette. He even punched Norm.    No bueno.    So, put a few in the cooler.    It's time for a lunch beer.

Name: Spiteful Brewing Chatty Cathy
Description: Listen to this! Martha had an affair with Bob! Bob is getting a divorce! John is getting fired! Kyle got out of jail! Quit gossiping and drink this India Pale Ale brewed with Victory Malt, a touch of wheat, and generously hopped with El Dorado for a tropical burst of flavor and aroma.

Name: Spiteful Brewing Selfies Are For…
Description: Don't fight it, Spite It!  We see you on the Internet, pixelated and hungry for attention.  You just posted a selfie, and can't wait for the validation.  "Beautiful."  "HOTT."  "SEXY."  But not this time.  This selfie is going to cost you a punch in the nuts and a loss of self-worth.  We discovered that our honey IPA is a natural duck face repellent.  Citric and dry, with a delightful addition of honey.  Redeem yourself, wiener.  Following our four easy steps in the only known cure for the selfie pandemic.

Name: Instigator Session IPA
Tasting Notes: Bitter, Grapefruit, Hoppy, Light, Nectarine, Smooth
Description: Light-bodied IPA, packed with grapefruit flavor.

Name: Spiteful/Breakroom Working Hard Or
Description: Black body, a couple fingers of tan foam that leave behind sheets of lacing all around the glass, and lasting surface coverage.    Aroma is roasty but mellow, fairly faint. Charred pine needles.

Name: Spiteful Brewing Norm Is A S.O.B
Description: cloudy copper body, trace white head   decent lacing

Name: Spiteful Brewing Prove It Gruit
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Spiteful Brewing was founded in January 2010 by Brad Shaffer and Jason Klein.  While the brewery is new, we have known each other since we were kids.  It was a friendship that started instantly following a spiteful incident during a hockey game on the pond.  Initially home brewing in the kitchen on a stove, we’ve slowly upgraded our system as we gained experience and understanding of the brewing process.  We now have a Brewery from Portland Kettle Works with a 2.5 BBL Brewhouse and 5 BBL Fermenters.

Name: Pontoon New Wave Blonde Ale
Description: It’s just a blonde ale, right? FALSE. Our New Wave Blonde ale was brewed with an English yeast to provide some fruity esters that give this simplistic style a well-rounded character, while remaining crisp and light. Light notes of semi-sweet fruits and bready malts dance on your tongue while finishing clean, crisp and refreshing! Ride the New Wave and drink a beer that tastes like a beer should!

Name: Pontoon Quad Stack
Description:
Belgian quad, layered with real
Vermont maple syrup to create a rich base,
adorned with notes of light brown sugar, ripe
figs, and robust molasses. Big in body and
sweet to the finish, this quad hits on all the
areas that you would want and then some
with the subtle layer of real maple syrup.

Name: Pontoon The Mighty Banana
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description:
The time has come to test thy courage…This
big, malt-forward golden strong ale beams
bright in color like the sacred triforce artifact
and is full of banana and clove esters from
the Belgian yeast. The timeless style of a
golden strong ale is blended with a new
age feel with the addition of rum-soaked
bananas, cinnamon, Madagascar vanilla,
and banana puree to give a banana foster
flavor! We’ve been waiting for you, Hero of
Beer.

Name: Pontoon I’m On A Float
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description:
We made a refreshing sour that makes you
want to get on a float and make a music
video about it! We took pineapple and
pear and mixed it with a healthy amount of
lavender to create a beautiful melody of tart,
fruity and floral. With harmonious notes of
sweet pineapples and pears mixed with the
soothing lavender, this beer makes you want
to sing I’m on a float, whoa!

Name: Pontoon Nightmare Fuel
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: The most disturbing part of this beer is the absurd amount of fruit in it! This Berliner Weisse is made with raspberries, tart cherry and black currant to give this tart fruit bomb that eerie dark red color. With a haunting and delicious taste, the only nightmares you’ll be having are when you run out of it!

Name: Pontoon Crushing Waves Berliner
Description: This German style tart ale has 700lbs of fresh pineapple and tart cherry puree. Kettle soured with lactobacillus, this tart beer embodies the perfect dessert inspired sour. The pineapple and tart cherries are added during the secondary fermentation to create a juicy, yet tart, sour beer that is bursting with flavor.

Name: Pontoon Rainbow Smiggles
Description: Cereal, candy and beer... all part of a yummy balanced breakfast! Rainbow Smiggles is our newest Berliner style Weisse with Skittles, Trix Cereal, Strawberries and Pineapples... yes, you heard that right! The Skittles and Trix are brought to light with the addition of strawberries to give it a fresh fruity taste as well as pineapples to brighten it with some acidity. They’re always after me Rainbow Smiggles!

Name: Pontoon Glazed Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Glazed is a Berliner Weisse style sour ale with huge notes of tangerine, mango, peach, and Tongan vanilla.

Name: Pontoon Brewing Flotation Device: Snozz
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description:
German style tart ale has 2.5 tons of
fresh raspberries, blackberries and black
currant puree, vanilla and milk sugar to
transform it into Pontoon’s most popular
Serious Series beer, Snozzberries

Name: Pontoon Black Is Beautiful Imperial Stout
Description: This version of Black Is Beautiful, in collaboration with The Atlanta Podcast and Atlanta Beer Gang, is tiramisu inspired with subtle notes of cocoa, coffee and vanilla to showcase the recipe by Weathered Souls Brewing Co. 20% of the proceeds go to SONG Atlanta.

Name: Pontoon Down With The Thickness
Description:
Stout with hazelnut, chocolate,
vanilla and lactose for a thick milk stout.

Name: Pontoon Gingerbread Murder Scene
Description:
Every year, millions of innocent gingerbread
men and women are devoured by ruthless
humans. These are their stories. * Dun
Dun *. This big imperial stout features
gingerbread cookies, gingerbread Bones
coffee, ginger, allspice, cinnamon, clove, and
nutmeg to create a holiday treat that pays
tribute to all the fallen gingerbread people
we lose every year.

Name: Pontoon Decadent Mousse Vol. 2
Description:
Round two on our interpretation of a dessert
classic. Decadent Mousse Volume 2 is a
medium-high bodied imperial milk stout with
Honduran cocoa nibs and orange peel, to
create a perfect embodiment of a chocolate
covered orange. Silky and mousse like in
mouthfeel but sweet and enough to want to
go back for seconds of this decadent treat!

Name: Pontoon The Floor Is Lava
Description:
This Milkshake IPA is erupting with 2lbs of
real strawberries, guava, and kiwi, then we
added vanilla and lactose to create a fruity,
creamy IPA. This is packed full of flavor,
making it dangerously good for those who
dare to drink.

Name: Pontoon Combustible Pineapple
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
Combustible Pineapple is a double dry
hopped, hazy, Milkshake New England IPA
brewed with 1.5lbs per gallon of pineapple.
Drink cold for a burst of citrus and pineapple
with a backing of vanilla and lactose to
create a creamy, yet citrus and pineapple
forward, IPA.

Name: Pontoon Peach City
Description:
A fruited IPA with our house English yeast
and fresh peaches to add to the stone fruit
and citrus notes from the Citra, El Dorado
and Azzaca hops. This bright and refreshing
take on a peach IPA will still carry the
balance of a New England IPA but add the
fruitiness and slight tart nature of a fresh
Georgia peach! Thick and fluffy mouthfeel
with big notes of stone fruit, succulent
peaches, candied citrus and some refined
bitterness. Take a bite into this fresh fruited
hop bomb!

Name: Pontoon Volume Integral
Description:
After we brewed Volume Displacement with
our friends at Ology Brewing, we decided
to do a version with different hops up here
in Atlanta! This hazy double IPA brewed
with oats and white wheat creates a fluffy
mouthfeel and uses El Dorado, Azacca,
Mosaic and Belma hops to create notes of
tropical fruit, under ripe berries, candied
melon, and some stone fruit.

Name: Pontoon Wake Zone IPA
Description: Make some waves with this refreshing, unfiltered IPA! This year round offering will showcase a rotating variety of hops ranging from the radical and experimental to the tried and true favorites; each hand picked by our brewers to rock your docks off! We used light and sweet Maris Otter base malts to let the hop flavors take the helm in this crisp, unfiltered IPA.

Name: Pontoon Garage Karate
Description: Testing out some your sweet moves in the garage dojo really works up a sweat. Enjoy a session IPA while working on that roundhouse kick. This easy drinking beer is full of Citra,Tettnang, and Loral Hops. KIAI!

Name: Pontoon Evergreen Terrace
Description: This West Coast Double IPA is all that you want in a west coast IPA: punchy, hoppy, piney, citrusy and powerful! We took the Standy By recipe and boosted it to give the Vienna and caramel malt more of a presence that would otherwise be masked by the absurd amount of hops in this beer. With bittering, whirlpool and dry hop additions of Citra, Simcoe and Chinook, you get bold notes of pithy tangerine, noble pine and dank resin. Warning, this beer packs a punch!

Name: Pontoon All Together IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Pontoon Brewing is joining forces with Other Half Brewing Company and over 500 other breweries for the worldwide collaboration, All Together. Together we are brewing this India Pale Ale to support hospitality professionals all over the world. 100% of the proceeds from Pontoon Brewing’s All Together will go directly to Bottleshare who supports industry workers and their families when they experience adversity outside of the workplace. All Together features notes of fresh pineapple, explosive citrus fruits, delicate mango and some ripe berry notes along for the ride!

Name: Pontoon Das Labyrinth
Description: The arrival of our Marzen marks a fine time of the year where dark, malty lagers are king and the schnitzel rains from the sky! This malty treat is brimming with Munich, Vienna and caramel malt, giving notes of biscuit, toffee and toasty caramel with a firm but clean bitterness from the hop addition. Pouring a beautiful amber tone and exhibiting velvety mouthfeel, this traditional German Marzen brings you back to beautiful landscapes of the German countryside!

Name: Pontoon OK Zoomer Pilsner
Description: We took our gold medal winning dry hopped pilsner and increased the amount of malt to give it more ABV and a fuller body! The result is a malty and doughy backbone with a bright and refreshing dry hop addition with Enigma and Barbe Rouge, which impart notes of red currant, strawberry, and a nice floral balance. Finishing crisp, this beer delievers on all sides to keep you happy while we continue to figure out how the heck to unmute or turn on our cameras!

Name: Pontoon The Great Punkin’ Spice
Description:
Good grief! The Great Punkin’ Spice is finally
here! This imperial brown ale is chocked full
of real pumpkin, sweet potato, cinnamon,
vanilla, pumpkin spice and pumpkin spice
coffee! Sweet, creamy and as basic as they
get!

Name: Pontoon Dock Party Pilsner
Description: The first beer we ever put out but with a slightly new recipe and our in-house lager yeast to transform this from the California Common it used to be and into the true German Pilsner it deserved to be! Supplanted by a heavy German Pilsner base and a small amount of white wheat, victory malt and carapils malt, this full-flavored pilsner is accompanied by a soft and chewy body from the natural carbonation process, pillowy head and lacing with notes of biscuit and slightly sweet honey, a firm but refreshing bitterness and floral and zesty aromas from the German noble hops. Crisp but not lacking flavor!

Name: Sweetwater 420 G13 Strain IPA
Description: This aromatic super-hybrid sticky IPA is first and foremost a phenomenally delicious and drinkable beer, with the added bonus of an olfactory experience that mimics that of the legendary G13 cannabis strain. The IPA base brew has a great body, good head and nice amount of haze at a pleasurable 6% ABV. To work with the malt bill, the brewers added some of their dankest hops, Columbus and Simcoe, plus two dry hop additions. To achieve the aroma, our brewers found the perfect botanically-sourced, strain specific terpenes and married them with propriety natural hemp flavor, both perfectly complementing the hops in the IPA.

Name: SweetWater IPA
Description: This mammoth IPA is defined by generous quantities of premium hops and balanced with a premium selection of English malt. Traditionally unfiltered IPA’s lead to the slight haze appearance. An extensive dry-hopping process contributes to its very intense floral hop aroma. The IPA is unfiltered and as always, unpasteurized to leave all the natural flavors intact. If you’re at the brewery you’ll be able to guess what style of beer every brewer has in his hand. THE BEER YOU'VE BEEN TRAINING FOR!

Name: Sweetwater 420 Strain Mango Kush IPA
Description: A second sticky hit from 420 Strain, an American Wheat packed with herbal, juicy mango notes and a distinctive dank nose. Strain specific terpenes and natural hemp-type flavors complement the hop and malt bill, delivering a euphoric ale with that fresh olfactory bonus rip.

Name: SweetWater 420 Extra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: SweetWater 420 Extra Pale Ale is a tasty West Coast Style Pale Ale with a good hop feel to it and a crisp finish. First brewed on April 20th, 1997 this beer has developed quite the following in the Southeast. Drink em if you got em

Name: SweetWater Hash Session IPA
Description: We kept the malt bill light to allow the hops to shine through. We dosed this sucker with a boatload of Amarillo Hop Hash. Pungent with floral, tropical citrus fruit flavors, and the hop hash gives it that one of a kind chewy, gooey, resiny mouthfeel. As the chaser, we are giving it a hefty dry hop to enhance the potent aromas. Ahtanum gives it orange and grapefruit tones, Crystal for a little kick of spiciness, and El Dorado bringing some pear and watermelon characteristics.

Name: Sweetwater Pulled Porter
Description: On the farm way too long, Ol’ McDanko began showing some worrisome tendencies. Following a solid session in the hot box smoking malt, he was overcome by a methane cloud emitted from the herd. Ya heard? Reaching for the hops, he goofed and grabbed porky by the e-i-e-i-oh and plopped her in the brew kettle slow and low – that is the tempo. Knock knock – who’s there? It’s McDanko’s inbred neighbor, Gert Reynolds, swinging by delivering his deliverance with some fat back here and some fat back there. Stepping out past some Foxy brothers picking a banjo on the porch to sample his wares, McDanko, doubled over the chopping block and squealed like a pig – wieii wieii – proclaiming this to be the most bodacious bacon beer brewed this side of the Chattoog-a!

Name: Sweetwater Seasonal
Description: Varies by season!

Name: Sweetwater The Pit & The Pendulum
Description: The perfect balance of three distinct divergences. Allowed to initially flower with Belgian ale yeast, The Pit & The Pendulum was then incarcerated with Brett and freshly puréed peaches to intensify the trifecta of its persona.

Name: Sweetwater Curtisimo
Description: Oud Brun aged with cherries in bourbon barrels and sangiovese puncheons.

Name: Sweetwater Through The Brambles
Description: A southern funk sour ale rich with notes of blackberry, oak, and filled with wild yeast and bacteria. Light bodied and rose in color this tart ale is dosed with Georgia grown blackberries and aged in an American Oak Foeder for 12 months.

Name: Sweetwater Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout
Description: A supremely rich full-bodied imperial stout laced with subtle notes of chocolate and bourbon from aging over six months in bourbon barrels. Multiple influences upon this robust stout will allow your palate to explore the depths and layers of this very limited release.

Name: Sweetwater Dank Tank Johnny Hash Double IPA
Description: We broke the cell wide open that’s been holding this hop hash locked up since the last time a Hooter girl passed the bar. We are walking the line with this Double IPA! Not just another boy named Sue, this renegade would get us thrown into Folsom prison with the amount of Citra "hop hash" we scraped from the inside of the Yakima pelletizers and fisted into this beer. This super concentrated hash is pure hop lupulin (ya know-the hop kief-the good stuff!) and will play a resinous riff with the pilsner, 2 row and wheat malt used to back up the man in black! With Amarillo on the drums setting the bitterness beat, Citra hash takes the mic in the whirlpool, packing a sticky aromatic punch with potent lyrics creating a heavy hop forward set worthy of a July Carter finger dip. For the encore we invited Mt. Hood and Simcoe on stage for a dry hop jam session, bringing down the house in a ring of fire!

Name: SweetWater Goin’ Coastal IPA
Description: Slip into some sunshine and step off the grid by Goin’ Coastal with this pineapple laced IPA. The bright aromas of the five citrus hop additions are accentuated by the tropical fruit of the pineapple. And just like those three day weekends, its finish is quick. Golden copper in color with a full malt bill to bring the balance to our year round offering.

At 5.5% ABV, you can lean back assured it will refresh from sun up to sun down.

Name: SweetWater Take Two Pils
Description: Sweetwater Take Two Pils is a German Pilsener style beer brewed by SweetWater Brewing Company in Atlanta, GA.

Name: SweetWater Blue
Description: Sweetwater Blue is a unique lighter style ale enhanced with a hint of fresh blueberry. When you drink this beer take a good whiff first and you'll smell the blueberry influence, but on the taste it's extremely subtle and the finish is extra clean. Ain't no fruit beer, but it is our breakfast beer, usually folks that are looking to quench their thirst or for those that are new to the "good beer" lifestyle this is their choice. This brew and the ESB were the original two to go through the tanks at SweetWater in February 1997.

Name: SweetWater 20 Imperial India Pale Ale featuring Hash on Brett
Description: Casting our line in the water 20 years ago in the great city of Atlanta has lead us down some tremendous paths and some twisted alleys. Wouldn’t be who we are today without all the joys and bumps along the way. This year’s anniversary ale is a step forward for us, while staying true to who we’ve always been (a little rough around the edges). We are going big this year with this giant IPA, but then playing with some new toys we’ve grown to love at the brewery – the unique quality that the Hash delivers to our beer as well as the dose of brettanomyces the brings the funk to that soul.  The 20th anniversary IPA is an extremely hop forward with a residual sweetness and golden in color covered with a wonderful haze. The Brettanomyces used is our house blend, which you’ll see more and more as our Woodlands Project grows. As fermentation finishes, the Brett will start to produce its associated acids and phenols and to lend a slightly tart finish. The aroma will be fruity, herbal, tropical, citrus, and the Brettanomyces will give it a nice touch of funk and earthy phenolics to bring a unique definition to this wondrous creation.  Here’s to 20 years of heady beers – looking forward to a boatload more!!!

Name: Springdale Not Stirred Dark And Stormy
Description: A stormy blend of barred-aged beer aged on freshly shaved ginger chases the clouds away.

Name: Springdale Not Stirred Mint Julep
Description: A golden beer aged in ex-bourbon barrels on fresh mint to elegantly refreshing effect.

Name: Springdale Noonanbach Flanders Red Ale
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Springdale Kriek Mythology Barrel Aged Sour
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: A legendary fruit from the breadbasket of civilization, the cherry has long been a companion of brewers. Kriek Mythology honors the sour cherry beers of the Flanders region of Belgium. We use whole cherries and puree, and age in barrels for up to a year.

Name: Springdale Desert Solitaire
Description: Sour ale brewed with wheat, rye and spelt aged in oak barrels.

Name: Springdale Elder Mother
Description: Respect the Elder Mother and her bounty will provide. To our offering of golden and red barrel-aged beer, we add elderberries and long pepper for a mysterious, deeply fruity and complex beer.

Name: Springdale No Fuzz
Description: Golden sour aged on white nectarines. Bright and juicy.

Name: Springdale Citrus Got Real
Description: Mild funk, pepper, green apple, and damp cellar on the nose. Initial wave of fermentation character on the palate follows suit with spicy pepper and honeyed sweetness, quickly overtaken by bright, vibrant citrus character than cleanses the palate.

Name: Springdale Citrus Got Real 1/6 Barrel
Description: Mild funk, pepper, green apple, and damp cellar on the nose. Initial wave of fermentation character on the palate follows suit with spicy pepper and honeyed sweetness, quickly overtaken by bright, vibrant citrus character than cleanses the palate.

Name: Springdale Malted Milk Ball Donut Shop Series
Description: Donuts. Beer. Enough Said.Not Enough Said? Well if you must know we’ve toiled for months with our friends at Union Square drinking beers and eating donuts to land on this truly incredible, decadent collaboration beer to be paired with their collab donut. Grab a pack of beer and a quick half dozen.  You’re Welcome.

Name: Springdale Maple Barrel-Aged Brigadeiro Stout
Description: Brigadeiro aged 27% in barrels containing Maple syrup, 73% Bourbon Barrel. 8.5%ABV

Name: Springdale IPA
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Citrus, Crisp, Dry, Earthy, Floral, Fruity, Grassy, Guava, Peach, Pine, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily
Description: Our flagship IPA is brewed for those In Pursuit of Adventure. Truly bi-coastal, it draws inspiration from the best of the East- and West- coast styles, culminating in the perfect balance of dank bitterness and tropical hop character.

Name: Springdale Rhythm Recipe
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Floral, Fruity, Guava, Peach, Pine, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Fish - White, Shellfish
Description: Boy this track really has a lot of flavor! Rhythm Recipe is the first in our new series of music-driven Hazy IPAs. This hip-hop inspired recipe features Motueka, Citra, and Waimea hops for flavorful notes of orange citrus, melon, and strawberry.

Name: Springdale The Boogie IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
In a lot of ways, great beer is like great music. Complex layers of sound and flavor seem to fall together effortlessly when done right. There’s a high hat here, a hop blend there, and a sample you never would have thought of before but “Holy $#!T, that’s awesome!” With every listen and every sip, you discover something you never noticed before. And whether it’s a good song or a good beer, you can’t wait to share it with friends.

The Boogie is inspired by Outasight’s high energy track featured on our Springdale 2020 Playlist. We wanted to turn that energy into art. Influenced by Boogie Nights and sound waves, we spilled 70’s influence over every bit of this label. Hyper saturated colors tease the bright flavors inside as Bravo, Mosaic, and Citra hops groove together in this hazy, golden India Pale Ale.

We got the beer. We got the tunes. You got the moves. 

Let's boogie

Name: Springdale A Beer Called Quest Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
The sixth track in our fresh and ephemeral IPA series has dropped! A Beer Called Quest is a 6.8% ABV hazy IPA featuring a hip-hoppy mix of Nelson
and Motueka hops. This IPA is inspired by the tunes of A tribe Called Quest, one of the many great artists featured on our Springdale 2020 playlist. Now streaming at springdale.beer/spotify!

Name: Springdale Spaceman Day Dream
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Springdale/Against The Grain Any IPA
Description: Against The Grain teamed up with Springdale Beer, the experimental wing of Jack’s Abby, to create the antithesis of the hazy IPA trend – an IPA that pours nearly as clear as water. No murky glasses of beer that resemble orange juice found here. Why not, right? After all, Crystal Pepsi is a real thing. This clear IPA features "any" hops, "any" grain and all the love and hugs. 6.5% It is also, of course, a cheeky and irreverent commentary on our subculture's social media driven obsession with beer appearance. Do androids dream of electric haze, or will clearer heads prevail?

Name: Springdale On The Contrary
Description: Make too much noise, question authority, drink ale, wander in the woods, swim upstream. Or, you know, do your own thing. NEIPA dry-hopped with El Dorado, Waimea, Galaxy, and Mosaic.

Name: Springdale Chat Room IPA
Description: Collab IPA with Counterweight Brewing using South African Hops.

Name: Springdale But I Digress IPA
Description: NEIPA Hopped with Amarillo, Simcoe and Citra. 6%ABV

Name: Springdale Where Am I Double IPA
Description: DIPA dry-hopped with Citra, Idaho 7, Denali and El Dorado

Name: Destihl Wild Sour Series: Here Gose Nothin’
Description: We threw caution to the wind with our interpretation of a Leipzig-style Gose, featuring complex aromas and acidic flavors contributed by indigenous wild yeast and lactic fermentation. Lemon, lime and other citrus-like qualities are balanced by the spicy character of coriander and a mineral-mouthfeel from French sea salt, resulting in a refreshing beer that was worth the risk.

Name: Destihl Wild Sour Series: Flanders Red
Description: Flanders red is a sour ale offering an initial impression of tart cherry candy, dissipating into a complex palate of bright acidity with a backbone of caramel and biscuit malt and minimal hop character. The dry, wine-like finish accentuates the complex malt profile and bright fruit notes showcased in this brilliant, red-colored interpretation of a Belgian-style Flanders.

Name: Destihl Wild Sour Lynnbrook Raspberry
Description: Lynnbrook, named after our founder's family farm, is a wild Berliner-style Weisse with raspberries added. The result is a refreshing, fuchsia-colored beer with an aroma of raspberry-lemon giving way to hints of brie with subtle lemon and yogurt-like flavors supported by tart, fresh raspberries and underlying lactic sourness.

Name: Destihl Weissenheimer
Description: Need a break from all the smart alecks in your life? You’ll get the last laugh as you kick back and relax with this seriously enjoyable & refreshing South German-style Hefeweizen. This wheat ale has a hazy, straw-colored hue with classic banana-like & clove-like aromas and flavors with very low hop bitterness and a full mouthfeel without being full of itself. No joke.

We then dry-hopped this crimson-colored beer for a touch of citrus aroma and flavoring, adding another layer of complexity and a perfect finish.

Name: Destihl Wild Sour Series: Key Lime Pie Gose (Seasonal)
Description: We've added key lime, vanilla and lactose to our Leipzig-stye Gose to create a liquid version of the popular dessert. The result is a tart, creamy, refreshing treat for your tastebuds. Now you can have your pie and drink it too!

Name: Destihl Wild Sour Series: Synchopathic
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Synchopathic is the cool harmonization of a refreshingly tart and acidic sour ale with citrusy, fruity, & floral dry-hops normally in concert with pale ales, with totally rad aromas and flavors reminiscent of grapefruit, orange, lemon, tangerine, pineapple and hints of pine, giving way to a biscuity-crackery malt back beat, low bitterness and a dry finish to bring everything in synch.

Name: Destihl Wild Sour Series: Pina Colada Gose (Seasonal)
Description: If you like Piña Coladas, then you're going to love this fun, refreshing take on our Leipzig-style Gose, which is brewed with pineapple and coconut for a tropical twist on this classic sour ale. The combination provides an added layer of sweet, fruity complexity to our Gose that is already known for its tart, citrusy qualities while still balanced by French sea salt and hints of spice from added coriander.

Name: Destihl Wild Sour Series: Blueberry Gose (Seasonal)
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Our Leipzig-style Gose and blueberries are a combination destined to be together, so we've done that for you with this edition of our Gose. The blueberries add another layer of fruity complexity to this sour ale already known for its tart, citrusy qualities while still balanced by the spicy character of coriander and a mineral mouthfeel from French sea salt.

Name: Destihl Dosvidanya Bourbon Barrel (2020)
Description: The hidden soul of this oak bourbon barrel-aged beer that we said Dosvidanya ('goodbye') to several months before revealing, is its rich flavors like dark chocolate, toffee, black cherries and coffee along with robust & roasty maltiness that finishes dry.

Name: Destihl Amra Mango IPA

Description: Our Deadhead IPA Series melds the strong vibe of music we love with the beer we love to drink, elevating both into a higher state of consciousness. Name: Destihl Normal Pils
Description: Named after our hometown, this light-bodied lager celebrates the simplicity of rural Central Illinois, where the soil is rich, air is clean and crops are abundant. Brilliantly pale in color, this beer exhibits a pronounced spicy, floral nose with a soft bready character. Flavors of sweet malt with earthy, floral hops come to the front before finishing crisp and dry, for a beer that is anything but normal.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Fuego del Otono
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Autumn Fire - Ale brewed with chestnut and spices. To catch a bit of soft radiance in each special bottle, we wait for fall colors to begin their bright and fleeting glow before brewing this wonderful ale under their autumn fire. Gentle amber malts lead smooth caramel notes, gently lapping against a shore of distant forgotten spice. A beer to contemplate and enjoy!

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Artisan Ales Oro de Calabaza Golden Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: Brewed in the Franco-Belgian tradition of strong golden ales. Spicy and peppery with a gentle hop bouquet and beguiling influence of wild yeast.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Bam Biere
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Saison X
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Rich yellow gold color, highly effervescence. Sugary, spicy aroma, tart and refreshing with a hint of citrus and candied ginger in the finish.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Clementina
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Brewed with clementine, yuzu peel, lime peel, pink Himalayan salt, and coriander.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Biere De Mars
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: A sustaining beer that is brewed to comfort in the gusty ides of March and welcome in a wealth of warmer weather.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Bamarillo Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Amarillo-hopped saison brewed with pineapple.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Z Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Ron’s third brew in his “Letters” Series. This brew has a wonderful deep rich color with a sharp aroma of citrus and sugar. There are flavors of mouth coating chocolate, mixed citrus, sweet orange, and kumquat lending a delicious sweet, tart, sour contrasting note. Finishing long and lingering rich baking chocolate… A drink suitable for an Aztec deity, no?

Name: Jolly Pumpkin La Parcela
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Ok, so the joke was that Jolly Pumpkin doesn’t brew a pumpkin beer. Well, now we do. Packed with real pumpkins, hints of spice, and a gentle kiss of cocoa to liven the soul. An everyday easy way to fill your squashy quotient. Guess now folks will have to find something else to joke about…Ok, so the joke was that Jolly Pumpkin doesn’t brew a pumpkin beer. Well, now we do. Name: Jolly Pumpkin De Viento
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A dark and smoky sour Saison full of rich aromatic coffee and the spicy heat of a secret Algerian spice blend. Proceeds go to the Dexter Relief Fund.

Name: Bam Biere Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This delicious farmhouse ale is named for our Jack Russell, who struck by a car, bounced back in fine tenacious Jack Russell fashion, and is brewed for those of us who knocked down, have picked up, dusted off and carried on undaunted. Golden, naturally cloudy, bottle conditioned and dry hopped for a perfectly refreshing balance of spicy malts, hops and yeast. Please enjoy our beers in good health, And look both ways when crossing the street!

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Pincha Discos
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Saison brewed with anhui wild lime and rose lemongrass tea. A collaboration with Stillwater.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Io Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Baudelaire Io Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Luciernaga
Description: A Belgian style Pale Ale Saison blend. Coriander and Grains of Paradise round out the spicy palate, melting o so softly into a silken finish of hoppiness and bliss! Make any season a celebration!

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Weizen Bam
Description: Jolly Pumpkin’s Weizen Bam Biere is ruddy golden, with yeast driven esters of banana, spicy clove, and nutmeg all wrapped up with a generous dose of rapscillion delight.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin La Roja Artisian Amber Ale
Description: La Roja, an artisan amber ale brewed in the Flanders tradition. Deep amber with earthy caramel, spice and sour fruit notes developed through natural barrel aging. Unfiltered, unpasteurized and blended from barrels ranging in age between two and ten months. Truly an ale of distinction.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Rojzilla
Description: A sour brew that is aged for a year and a half in a 100-bbl oak foudre before being blended with a few "normal" size barrels of varying ages. The result creates a complex combination of flavors and sophistication.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin La Roja
Description: La Roja, an artisan amber ale brewed in the Flanders tradition. Deep amber with earthy caramel, spice and sour fruit notes developed through natural barrel aging. Unfiltered, unpasteurized and blended from barrels ranging in age between two and ten months. Truly an ale of distinction.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Sobre
Description: Sobrehumano Palena 'ole is a sour red ale brewed with liliko'i and cherries co-brewed with Maui Brewing. Maui used standard fermentation while the Jolly Pumpkin version is a barrel-aged sour. Maui released its version in cans.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Sobrehumano Palena Ole
Description: Sour, barrel-aged version of the beer by the same name. Brewed in collaboration with Maui brewing.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Apocolocynposis
Description: Our second collaboration with Los Angeles’ Monkish Brewing Company. Apocolocynposis was aged in oak for a total of seven months. Blackberry Puree and Limes were added in the last two months of aging, giving this ale flavors of blackberry, blueberry, and vanilla, that slowly fade with a tart lime touch.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Madrugada Obscura
Description: A Belgian inspired stout that is as dark as a moonless midnight, brimming of roasted malts and bitter hops. It will keep you good company in all places, be thay light or dark.

Name: Jolly Pumpkin Seasonal
Description: Varies based on season!

Name: El Segundo Broken Skull IPA
Description: A bad-ass 6.7% IPA designed by Steve Austin and ESBC for the working man and woman. It features Citra, Chinook and Cascade hops to deliver big flavor with an easy finish. Now stop reading and start enjoying this awesome beer!

Name: El Segundo Station No.1 Red Ale
Description: Layers of malt provide notes of bread, toast, biscut, and light caramel. Deep mahogany tones. No. 1 hoppy... I know... shocker from us. But this mellow malt forward beer is a fabulous anytime brew and approachable for all those shy of hops and bitterness.

Name: El Segundo Citra Pale Ale
Description: A straightforward American Pale Ale. American two-row barley, a touch of Vienna malt. Then, an irresponsible amount of dry hopping with Citra for a unique aromatic experience. Pour vivaciously into your favorite tapered glass to fully enjoy.

Name: El Segundo Hammerland Double IPA
Description: Mosaic and Simcoe American IIPA

Name: El Segundo Grand HIll IPA
Description: Named after the hill you have to slog back up from El Porto.. since it is precisely what you’ll be looking for after a day in the surf and sun, and a 1/4 mile climb straight back up to town! Nothing but base malt, Big Bitterness, 7.2% ABV, and a heavy dose of Amarillo and Centenniel hops make this India Pale Ale a nod to what has made the California IPA what it is today. Bright presence of lemon zest in the aroma leads well into a base of pine and citrus in the palette.

Name: El Segundo White Dog IPA
Description: Named for Rob’s dog, the White alludes to our use of 50% wheat instead of barley in this beer. Aside from that though, this beer has very little in common with what most people consider a “wheat” beer. The wheat in the malt bill gives the beer a lighter texture and mouthfeel, and helps to accentuate the bright citrus characters of the fruity West Coast and New Zealand hops we use. The result is an IPA that Hop Heads will love, but that is immediately approachable for most people.

Name: El Segundo Two 5 Left Double IPA
Description: A brazenly hop-forward beast of a beer, with a huge passionfruit nose. A subtle caramel character provides a malt backbone to shoulder the massive amount of dry-hopping that gives this beer its unique aroma and hop flavor. Two 5 Left is the runway that sends planes screaming right over El Segundo. We always knew we would name a beer after this local landmark and when it came to naming our first Double IPA, it fit the bill perfectly.

Name: El Segundo Hop Tanker Double IPA
Description: Two-row malt, meet Nelson Sauvin and Citra. Fast friends indeed. As sleek as a 9% DIPA can be with the sharp hop tone of lemon peels filled in by orange marmalade and just utter dankness. And you thought those tankers off-shore were just unloading crude...  2 pounds of dry hops per barrel. That’s right.

Name: El Segundo Power Plant Triple IPA
Description: This behemoth of a "Triple" India Pale Ale gets a heavy dose of hops both in the kettle and on the dry hop resulting in a nose that is straight up fruit cocktail. Monstrous, yet deceptive in the same breath. Don’t let this one sneak up on you lest ye be #Powerplanted.

Name: El Segundo Chinook
Description: Super simple - single hop in one massive late boil kettle addition. Base beer stays constant. We will release three at a time - taste them all.

Name: El Segundo The Pine Tar Incident Black IPA
Description: Whiffs of pine and spruce lead you in to the glass, where you find bitter cocoa and candied oranges. A touch of roast permeates throughout, but the hop expression wins over in the end. Dry and lively but with a creamy feel. Enough hops to be under protest, but we rule it a home run.

Name: El Segundo Bursted Huell Melon
Description: Super simple - single hop in one massive late boil kettle addition. Base beer stays constant. We will release three at a time - taste them all.

Name: El Segundo Blue House IPA
Description: Full bodied and noticeably more amber in color than most California IPA. Our flagship IPA is bursting with fruity hop character, balanced well by a rich, silky body. The Simcoe hop makes itʼs distinct presence known with pine and passionfruit notes with Cascade filling in. Itʼs hop aroma is complex and hearty, and is mirrored in the palette. This IPA has a pronounced malt profile with a touch of caramel showing, yet the beer finishes dry. The bigger body gives more of a base for the hop character to grow from, and more to balance.

Description: Super simple - single hop in one massive late boil kettle addition. Base beer stays constant. We will release three at a time - taste them all.

Name: El Segundo La Gold
Description: After we both brought home some bling from the Great American Beer Fest last year we decided we should make some beer with our Bros from Highland Park Brewery. We added some West Coast steez to a traditional Kellerbier and the results are pure L.A. Gold!

Name: El Segundo Casa Azul Lager
Description: We built our name brewing clear West Coast IPAs with an exorbitant amount of hops…so the last thing you’d expect from us is a GABF Gold medal winning malt-forward amber lager. Yet here we are. If malt is your game, this lager is your Huckleberry.

Name: Mystic The Hum Porter
Description: Low-frequency porter.

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Introducing Wave Break our extra hopped Table Beer. Dry hopped with Santiam and Perle, creating a crisp, refreshing take on Table Beer. Brewed for those summer months to come.

Name: Mystic Day Of Doom
Description: Day of Doom is a 12% Belgian Quad with rich malts as well as notes of dark fruits and dark sugars. This Quad is most definitely a big beer with big complex personality to match.  Masterson’s Rye is the highest rated Rye whiskey via whiskey bible at 96.5 points. It was also given high praise in whiskey advocate last year at a 90 point rating. When given the opportunity to hand select a single barrel version of this Rye last year we jumped all over it. Masterson’s has become one of our house favorites for sure.  The marriage of Day of Doom in our Masterson’s Rye Whiskey barrel will be sure to not only excite the palate but to also compliment it with hints of vanilla and spice from the oak and rye to match the dark fruits and rich malts. Don’t miss your chance to get one of these 156 bottles.

Name: Mystic Electric Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Brut Saison

Name: Mystic Table Beer
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Mystic table beer traces its roots back to a time when water was never an option at the dining table. Beer, as often as 1.5% ABV, was the only drink served to slake the thirst. At 4.3% ABV, Mystic table beer is a slightly more potent table beer. But it retains its namesakes’ eminent drink-ability. Its flavor and texture are derived our house Renaud yeast strain and traditional bottle conditioning. Enjoy with lunch or while swaying in a hammock.

Name: Mystic Saison Renaud
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A saison for the summer. Made with pilsner malt and Saaz hops…it’s similar to a pilsner with more spice and light fruit.

Name: Mystic Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Mystic Saison is our take on the old Belgian farmhouse ale. Saisons were traditionally brewed for refreshment during the summer months. Light in color, effervescent with a billowy, well-retained head — it is very dry and strongly aromatic with light pepper and pear overtones. Heavier in alcohol at 7% abv, it finishes clean and bright, with a very light bitterness.    Saison is far more a tradition than a style. Made with wine yeast by French speaking people in the ‘grain belt’ of Europe, saison was brewed in winter to slake thirsts of farm workers in summer.    We found that in many ways saison goes far beyond white wines that were in the minds of the old Wallonians. It can be as dry and crisp but far more variable. In Belgium, every farm house had its own saison, influenced by their very own farm and the grains available to them. For Mystic Saison we worked towards the essence of saison.    The Name. Mystic Saison was our first beer and named to reflect the straightforward approach to a “whole field” saison.

Name: Mystic Hazy Jane
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Jane is a wheat saison finished with a blend of citrusy American and Japanese hops, then dry-hopped with the aromatic, noble Tettnang hop.

Name: Mystic Chardonnay Barrel Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Our Barrel Program beers are entirely fermented and aged in wood barrels. For millenia wood was an essential part of the brewing process - long before the advent of stainless steel. This beer was fermented in barrels formerly used for chardonnay wines. As such, it expresses an essence of its former contents along with the classic vanilla of French oak.

Name: Mystic Luminous Ruins
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Dry-hopped sour farmhouse Ale

Name: Mystic An Dreoilin
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: In the times before modern industry, the cold, shorter days of the approaching winter directly affected the character of a breweries beer. For our third batch of beer we let the cooler temperatures influence the brewing process. The result was a remarkable variation on Mystic Saison. The hops are brighter, the drinkability fantastic, and balance of flavors intriguing. Because of this venture into old ways of brewing (and the distinct differences they create), we called this beer "An Dreoilin" after an ancient druid festival of the winter solstice.

Name: Mystic Mary of the Gael
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Mary of the Gael Saison-Style Farmhouse Ale. Spring Saison. St. Brigid’s Day (AKA Mary of the Gael) is celebrated in Ireland at the time of the Imbolic, a once pagan celebration of "Summer in the belly of winter." This release in our series of seasonal saisons is a refreshingly hoppy take on saison for springtime. Mary of the Gael has a simple base of pilsener malt, a touch of honey malt and is dry-hopped with a copious amount of floral hops.

Name: Mystic DDH Saturation
Description: DDH Saturation is a version of our hoppy pale ale that's been dry hopped a second time just before canning. We take both pellets and lupulin powder of Mosaic hops and freshly layer on top Amarillo, Mosaic and Citra. The result is an extra-aromatic yet crushable juicy pale ale full of citrus and tropical fruit.

Name: Mystic/Shacksbury Smashed Apple Pale Ale
Description: Inside this can is the collision of two similar-minded makers of disparate concoctions. The brewer and the cider maker and Vermont and Massachusetts. Aromatic, dry, flowering with apple goodness and beery hoppiness. New England artisanship. Learn more about Shacksbury Cider here.

Name: Mystic Ventus
Description: A wild ale fermented with a mixed culture of wild yeast and bacteria in chardonnay barrels for 30 months, then finished in the bottle for an additional year.

Name: Mystic Descendant
Description: Mystic Descendant is a beer descended from the cultural history of the Boston harbor area.  A dry Irish stout meets an English porter and is then fermented with our saison yeast with a touch of the ubiquitous ingredient from the area’s past: molasses.  The result is a unique beer; it has more dark fruit than a porter and less roast than a traditional stout, while having a different ester profile than a Belgian stout.  We thus dubbed our recipe a Suffolk Dark Ale, as an homage to our immigrant ancestors.    If Mystic Saison is our local answer to white wine, Descendant is our red. The subtle molasses works with the saison yeast and dark malts to create a rich cherrywood flavor and aromatic finish.  It can stand up to red meats or relax by the fire as the days get cooler and the leaves turn to welcome New England’s finest season.    The Name. As a combination of Irish Stout, Molasses and the Renaud yeast culture, the name for this beer a direct description: it’s an imagined descendant.

Name: Mystic Flight Of The Earls
Description: The "Irish-style" stout is typically a low-gravity stout with bitterness ranging between 30-45 IBUs. Roastiness is present, but restrained, and there should not be hops in either the flavour or aroma. A little bit of acidity can be present. Often, this type of stout is serving via nitrogen, with all the effects that has on a beer - low carbonation, extra-thick head, lifeless palate and muted flavour and aroma.

Name: Mystic Spectral Evidence New England Imperial Stout
Description: This New England version of an imperial stout is brewed with Massachusetts malted wheat and native Massachusetts yeast.

Name: Mystic Iwpa
Description: India Wharf Pale Ale is fermented with our house English yeast strain and presents a beautiful blend of earthy and fruity american hops complimented by a distinctive British malt profile.

Name: Mystic Double Voltage IPA
Description: Lightning struck twice here at Mystic Brewery. The result? Double Voltage. This Double IPA (8.3% abv) version of our beloved Voltage is surging with Citra lupulin powder, Santiam, Ella, and Perle hops.

Name: Mystic Voltage IPA
Description: Voltage is the simple answer to the everyday question, "What beer should I have?" Strong aromas of orange and guava translate in flavor. Drink it from the can, pour into a glass, or trade it with a friend. Just be sure to save one for yourself.

Name: Mystic Danger! Danger! Double IPA
Description: This 8.8% troublemaker is brewed with Huell Melon and Nugget, and dry hopped with four lupulin powders: Mosaic, Equinox, Simcoe, and Citra. It tastes of apricot, tangelo, and DANGER.

Name: Mystic DDH Amperage
Description: This is a twist on our hazy, soft IPA series that incorporates a Belgian slant into big hops. This one is bigger and deeper into the apricot, peach, and papaya zone. It’s double dry hopped with Ella, Santiam, and Citra hops.

Name: Mystic Hyperdry Brut Double IPA
Description: Hopped with Perle, Santiam, and Citra, this dynamic Brut DIPA bursts with tropical fruit aromas, flavors of guava, papaya, and subtle white grape, and ends with a crisp, dry finish.

Name: Great Divide Yeti Imperial Stout
Food Pairing: Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: YETI IMPERIAL STOUT is an onslaught of the senses. It starts with big, roasty malt flavor that gives way to rich caramel and toffee notes. YETI gets its bold hop character from an enormous quantity of American hops. It weighs in at a hefty 75 IBUs.

Name: Great Divide Colette
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: COLETTE is our homage to the saisons that Belgian farm workers have enjoyed for centuries. Brewed with barley, wheat and rice and fermented at high temperatures with a special blend of four different yeast strains, COLETTE is fruity and slightly tart, with a dry finish that makes it that rarest of treats — a beer as refreshing as it is complex.

Name: Great Divide Titan IPA
Description: TITAN IPA is a big, aggressively hopped India Pale Ale brewed for hop disciples. It starts out with piney hop aromas and citrus hop flavors, and finishes with a nice rich, malty sweetness that is balanced with crisp hop bitterness.

Name: Great Divide Strawberry Rhubarb Sour Ale
Description: STRAWBERRY RHUBARB SOUR ALE is a gift for the senses. Strawberry is the yin to rhubarb’s yang—the sweet to the tart. This beautiful partnership creates a beer that glows ruby in the glass, bursts with strawberry aroma, and bites with every sip. Bright and effervescent, this sour is a fun and refreshing, lip-puckering treat perfect for every occasion, any time of the year.

Name: Great Divide Coffee Porter
Description: No shortcuts were taken to create this perfect pairing of coffee and beer. Whiskey barrels that once held Yeti Imperial Stout were filled with green coffee beans sourced from Mexico and provided by our favorite local purveyor, Pablo’s Coffee. Once the beans were infused with characteristics of both barrel and Yeti, they were roasted and integrated into the coffee porter you hold in your hand. Cheers!

Name: Great Divide Orabelle
Description: ORABELLE is brewed with barley, wheat, oats, and rye.  This Belgian-Style Tripel is a golden beauty.  Its two yeast strains, orange peel and dash of coriander impart surprising complexity and richness to this delicate ale. Don’t let Orabelle’s demure nature fool you; this is one flavorful pour.  Watch out, she’s a charmer – one sip and you’ll be in love.

Description: HOSS is based on the Märzen lagers of Germany. Rich, layered malt notes, with hints of cherry and dark fruits, dominate, while the unique addition of rye imparts a slightly earthy, spicy character. Hoss finishes crisp and dry, and its brilliant red-orange color is a toast to the sunsets that make the perfect backdrop for this beer.

Name: Great Divide Seasonal

Description:
WHITEWATER HARD SELTZER is our refreshing and lively take on a craft
spiked seltzer. Brewed with all-natural ingredients, gluten-free with low
carbs and zero sugar, WHITEWATER showcases real, yet subtle, fruit
flavor. Available in Mango + Ginger, Wild Berry, Pomegranate + Lime, and

Name: Great Divide Hibernation Ale
Description: HIBERNATION ALE has been our celebrated winter tradition since 1995. This robust, dry-hopped ale has a malty richness balanced with a complex hop profile and hearty, warming character.

Name: Great Divide Roadie Grapefruit Radler
Description: Named both for the road biking cyclist (Roadie) and the German word for cycling (Radler), the Roadie Grapefruit Radler was inspired by Great Divide’s roots in the cycling community. As an avid cyclist, owner and founder Brian Dunn instilled his passion for cycling throughout the brewery from the very beginning. Great Divide has been a part of the Colorado cycling community throughout the years through the creation of the Great Divide Bike Team, annual participation from employees in the Bike MS race, and donating profits from our Tap Room Giving Program to organizations like Bike Denver and the Bicycle Racing Association of CO. Brian Dunn has also participated in the BoulDurango for the last few years where he and some of the most tenured Colorado craft brewery owners and employees ride the grueling 426 miles from Avery Brewing Co. in Boulder, CO to Ska Brewing Co. in Durango, CO over the course of 6 days. Together they ride over mountain passes and cruise across Colorado plains, all the while sharing their experiences, perspectives, and insights on the brewing industry and stopping for cold brews along the way. As a way to honor Great Divide’s roots in the cycling community and the comradery of events like the BoulDurango, the Roadie Radler was born. With artwork that was designed to create an image of the Colorado cycling community, this beer is a nod to cyclists everywhere. So, whether you are riding over grueling mountain passes or just out for a quick pedal, the Roadie Radler is the perfect brew for any summertime cruise.

Description: Chinook and Mosaic hops hold your tongue accountable for your worldly sins in our fiendishly vengeful session pale ale. The moment between each sip may be temporary, but feels like its own brief purgatory. 5.9% ABV. 22oz bottles.

18th Street Hunter Double Milk Stout
Description: Here is a father’s toast to his son. Brewed with cocoa nibs and lactose, Hunter boasts a creamy texture and rich chocolate flavor. Vanilla, roast, and caramel sweetness are met with a bright hop bitterness. Complex enough to pair with dinner or dessert. Suave enough to skip the meal altogether. A chip off the old block, alright.

Name: 18th St Here Comes The Reaper IPA
Description: Brewed with Mosaic and Chinook hops giving it tons of citrus character and a spicy edge.

Name: 18th Street Rubicon IPA
Description: Brewed with Centennial and Amarillo hops, this West Coast Style IPA comes in at 7.2% and is deliciously bitter and dank!

Name: 18th Street Sinister Double IPA
Description: Chicagoans like hoppy beers, so we oblige by brewing a mean double IPA. Then we ask artist Joy Potts to design a label of equal intensity.   Generously hopped with Falconer's Flight, Zuthos, and Cascade, Sinister is brimming with juicy tropical flavors of mango and pineapple.  Don't expect back rubs and mix-tapes from this beer--Sinister won't even remember your name. What did you expect?

Name: 18th Street Disciples Revenge Double IPA
Description: Under the innocent guise of a floral, citrus aroma, lies in wait the power of the true Imperial Indian Pale Ale.

Name: 18th St ED PA
Description: Prepare for a close encounter of the beer kind. This extra-dimensional English IPA takes inspiration from our terrestrial neighbors across the pond. With a pleasant earthiness and a hop characteristic that is out of this world, we suggest you let Ed PA invade your taste buds.

Name: 18th Street 1857 IPA

Description:
Meet the premium flavored malt beverage that started it all. With its crisp taste and bubbly finish, Smirnoff Ice Original features natural lemon lime flavor. Lightly carbonated, Smirnoff Ice has a delicious citrus bite, along with a refreshing effervescence. Enjoy chilled and drink responsibly. 

Smirnoff Ice Original has a 4.5% ABV. While Smirnoff Ice is made by the Smirnoff brand you know and love, the beverage isn’t made with vodka. Smirnoff Ice is made like traditional beers with malt. One of the most popular malt beverages in the nation, Smirnoff Ice has been a staple of get-togethers and parties since 1999.

If you want to give your beverage a twist, try turning it into a shandy by mixing equal parts Smirnoff Ice with a Blonde lager. Add a squeeze of lemon, and if you're really feeling fancy, top it off with some lemon zest. You've got yourself the ideal drink for chilling by the pool or sipping on game day.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Green Apple
Description: Smirnoff Ice Green Apple is perfect for parties or just casual evenings with friends. With its crisp taste and bubbly finish, Smirnoff Ice Green Apple features natural apple flavor. Lightly carbonated, this drink is not too sweet, not too tart and is packed with crisp apple flavors. Enjoy chilled and drink responsibly. Smirnoff Ice Green Apple has a 4.5% ABV. One of the most popular malt beverages in the nation, Smirnoff Ice has been a staple of get-togethers and parties since 1999

Name: Smirnoff Ice Screwdriver
Description: Keep things fun with the classic taste of Smirnoff Ice Signature Screwdriver. With its crisp taste and bubbly finish, Smirnoff Ice Signature Screwdriver features natural orange flavor. Lightly carbonated, this drink has the classic flavor of a screwdriver with a tart and tangy citrus kick. Enjoy chilled and drink responsibly. Smirnoff Ice Signature Screwdriver has a 5.8% ABV. One of the most popular malt beverages in the nation, Smirnoff Ice has been a staple of get-togethers and parties since 1999.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Watermelon Mimosa
Description: Smirnoff Ice juicy watermelon flavor with prosecco notes.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Raspberry
Description: Juicy red raspberry flavor complemented by a dry, crisp finish.  Lightly carbonated, this drink packs a tangy kick with a refreshing finish. Enjoy chilled and drink responsibly. Smirnoff Ice Raspberry Burst has a 4.5% ABV

Name: Smirnoff Ice Peach Bellini
Description: Smirnoff Ice Peach Bellini brings the fun, flavor and convenience of malt beverages to the world of champagne, with our Sparkling Seasonal malt beverage offering Smirnoff Ice Peach Bellini. A sophisticated blend of Peach with a hint of Raspberry, try one today!

Name: Smirnoff Ice Grape
Description: Here's a taste that's ripe for the pickin', so grab a bunch. Even though these grapes are wild - you shouldn't be - so drink responsibly.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Triple Black
Description: Smirnoff Ice® Triple Black is an edgy twist on the familiar crisp taste of Smirnoff Ice. This sweet, carbonated beverage has a clean, crisp, refreshing lime taste that won't weigh you down.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Pineapple
Description: Add some 'fiesta' to your next get-together with SMIRNOFF ICE Pineapple, a flavored malt beverage with the crisp, clean taste you'd expect from Smirnoff Ice with a twist of Latin fruit flavoring.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Smash Peach + Mango
Description: A bold fusion of peach and mango flavors that brings you a smash hit for wherever you go. 8% Alcohol Conveniently in a Can.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Smash Pineapple Coconut
Description: Smirnoff Ice Pineapple + Coconut Smash features a tropical fusion of luscious pineapple and sweet coconut flavors. Lightly carbonated with a refreshing flavor. 8% Alcohol conveniently in a can

Name: Smirnoff Ice Smash Strawberry Lemon
Description: A BOLD FUSION OF STRAWBERRY AND LEMON FLAVORS THAT BRINGS YOU A SMASH HIT FOR WHEREVER YOU GO. 8% Alcohol Conveniently in a Can.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Strawberry
Description: Keep things lively and fun with Smirnoff Ice Strawberry. With its crisp taste and bubbly finish, Smirnoff Ice Strawberry features natural strawberry flavor. Lightly carbonated, this drink has a sweet and indulgent strawberry flavor with a crisp finish. Enjoy chilled and drink responsibly. Smirnoff Ice Strawberry has a 4.5% ABV. One of the most popular malt beverages in the nation, Smirnoff Ice has been a staple of get-togethers and parties since 1999.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Blueberry Lemonade
Description: A line of malt beverages inspired by classic freshly made mixed drinks. Blueberry notes add an exciting twist to an old classic. Chill and enjoy straight from the bottle or in a glass over ice.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Mango
Description: Add some fiesta to your next party with this fresh and tangy flavor.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Margarita
Description: Smirnoff Ice Margarita is citrusy, tart and sweet with complex, earthy/salty tequila notes. Enjoy the refreshing taste of a Margarita without the fuss!

Name: Smirnoff Sourced Pineapple Coconut
Description: Made with real fruit juice. Premium malt beverage with real pineapple juice from concentrate, natural pineapple, coconut, and other natural flavors, and certified colors.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Cranberry & Lime
Description: A line of malt beverages inspired by classic freshly made mixed drinks. A burst of cranberry flavor with a hint of lime. Chill and enjoy straight from the bottle or in a glass over ice.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Berry Blast
Description: This limited edition Berry Blast is loaded with vibrant flavours of citrus, blue raspberry and cherry. Assertive flavours persist on the palate with fruit sweetness that is both refreshing and delicious.

Name: Smirnoff Sourced Strawberry Kiwi
Description: Made with real fruit juice, Smirnoff Sourced Strawberry Kiwi has a bright, fresh strawberry aroma with a juicy strawberry-kiwi flavor and a sweet, strawberry finish.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Spiked Original
Description: SMIRNOFF > SMIRNOFF ICE > SPIKED FLAVORS > SMIRNOFF ICE™ SPIKED ORIGINAL SMIRNOFF ICE™ SPIKED ORIGINAL Refreshing tasting flavors perfectly carbonated with 8% alcohol, all in a can for an evening on the go. It’s a fresh new drink inspired by the classic Smirnoff Ice, and it's just right for a twilight toast to the night ahead.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Black Cherry
Description: Smirnoff Ice Black Cherry, a flavored malt beverage with a rich cherry flavor that has a tangy bite and sweet finish. Enjoy chilled!

Name: Smirnoff Ice Tropical Fruit
Description: Smirnoff Ice Tropical Fruit is packed with an invigorating blend of zesty, fruit flavors that dance across the palette with every delicious sip. With its tangy, fresh blend of irresistible fruit flavors, SMIRNOFF ICE Tropical Fruit is sure to transport your mind to an island paradise.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Pink Grapefruit
Description: A premium ready to drink palate refresher. It's a blend of the best selling Smirnoff vodka, soda and grapefruit flavours. Serve chilled or over ice in a big frosty glass. Easy to serve and enjoy.

Name: Smirnoff Ice Lime
Description: Smirnoff Ice Cherry Lime masterfully blends the sweet taste of fresh cherries with a lively touch of ripe Lime. This novel combination of fruit flavors is sure to refresh and delight.

Name: Blue Point Toasted Lager
Description:
Toasted Lager was originally named for the “toasted” characteristics of our original direct-fire brick kettle. Our World Beer Cup gold medal winning flagship brew is brewed with a blend of six specialty malts for a flavor as rich and unique as the town it’s from. 

Toasted Lager’s balanced flavor of malt and hops makes for easy drinking and our special proprietary lager yeast produces an exceptional, long-lasting smooth finish.

Name: Blue Point Pumpkin Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Seasonal Ale
Description: Our golden orange-colored Pumpkin Ale is brewed with pumpkin and spices to produce a delicious taste of fall. This mild ale has little bitterness and a malty backbone. The spicy characteristics take the lead in this roasty beer and its tremendous depth of character will keep you warm during the fall season.

Name: Blue Point Pumpkin Ale
Description: Our golden orange-colored Pumpkin Ale is brewed with pumpkin and spices to produce a delicious taste of fall. This mild ale has little bitterness and a malty backbone. The spicy characteristics take the lead in this roasty beer and its tremendous depth of character will keep you warm during the fall season.

Name: Blue Point Hoptical Illusion
Description: We use a collection of unique hops, hand-selected by our brewers, and add them five different ways.

Name: Blue Point Pinstripe Pils
Description: Brewed with generous amounts of pilsner malt and Moteuka hops, this bright golden pilsner has a crisp maltiness balanced with a thin of lime in the aroma from the hops. A perfect pilsner to pair with a sunny summer day, friends in the bleachers, or a tray of ball park nachos!

Name: Blue Point Winter Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Seasonal Ale
Description: Our Winter Ale is a hearty, robust amber ale. We use pale, Vienna, crystal and chocolate malts to create a balanced character of malt and hops with just the right amount of spice to warm you up during the colder months.

Name: Blue Point Summer Ale
Description: The delicious, refreshing taste of Summer Ale comes from a substantial portion of wheat malt added to a traditional barley malt mix which gives this delicious brew a unique tartness not found in many light ales these days. No surprise – this light, thirst-quenching brew is best enjoyed on hot summer days.

Name: Blue Point The IPA
Description:
Hoppy. Balanced. The End.

In a city as unique as NY, Blue Point is introducing a unique IPA to match: Using brewing techniques from New England-style IPAs, and our own New York sensibilities, we’ve created a 6.0% ABV, 40 IBU IPA that we’ve wanted to have for ourselves. This beer is a rarity—featuring the best attributes from Denali, Citra, and El Dorado hops contribute melon, citrus, and candy characteristics to a balanced and clean body. All of these features make it balanced and easy to drink—just like the rest of our portfolio.

Name: Blue Point Winter Ale
Description: Our Winter Ale is a hearty, robust amber ale. We use pale, Vienna, crystal and chocolate malts to create a balanced character of malt and hops with just the right amount of spice to warm you up during the colder months.

Name: Blue Point Blueberry Ale
Description: Blueberry Ale is a crisp golden ale with just a hint of blueberry flavor and a mild hops finish.

Name: Blue Point Imperial Sunshine
Description:
Our Imperial Sunshine is a bright, refreshing brew with a "bit of punch" - not for the faint hearted. Brewed with orange peel, this strong blonde ale packs a nose reminiscent of orange Tic Tacs, hard candy and our favorite non-alcoholic drink, Tang.

But don't get it twisted... the drinkability on this one will have you waking up wondering how you lost your shoe. Enjoy the trip!

Name: Blue Point Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Blue Point Brewing's Pale Ale has a light golden color but explodes with a rich full-flavor. This refreshing ale is top fermentated and hopped at three different stages of the brewing process. English pale malt lends complexity to this brew. Small amounts of Wheat and Carapils round out the malt bill. Brewed to satisfy the hop lover, this pale ale has an immediate floral-citrus flavor that pervades the overall character of this hoppy, quenching microbrew.

Name: Blue Point Beach Plum Gose
Description: Beach Plum Gose is our Blue Point twist on a traditional German sour ale. We brew this kettle sour with beach plums indigenous to the shores of Long Island for a unique tartness and add North Atlantic seaweed and locally cultivated sea salt for a savory finish. This Gose stays true to its style’s German roots and its brewers’ Long Island roots - so it’s a little salty yet approachable, just like us.

Name: Blue Point Oatmeal Stout
Description: Our Woodbridge Cabernet Merlot combines some of the best attributes of both varietals, resulting in a delicious, smooth, full-bodied blend. Merlot's lush, plummy aromas and silky black cherry flavors complement the Cabernet's structure, with hints of vanilla oak and mocha adding just a bit of spice.    Our Cabernet Merlot pairs well with a number of dishes, including a hearty beef stew or roasted garlic chicken.

Name: Blue Point Hazy Bastard IPA
Description: Double dry hopped New England style IPA

Name: Blue Point Oktoberfest
Description: Originally brewed a couple hundred years ago to celebrate the betrothal of the Crown Prince of Bavaria, we’re helping keep the tradition alive by brewing Oktoberfest every fall for our most royal/loyal followers.

Name: Blue Point Delayed Pilsner
Description: Great news – your train is DELAYED. And whether it’s 2 minutes or 2 hours, it’s scientifically proven that delays are the bane of any New Yorker’s existence. But fear not, you guys: we brewed the ultimate Pilsner to get you through this abomination. Brewed with a blend of floral, spicy hops for subtle apple and lemonlime aroma, DELAYED Pilsner is balanced by slight honey notes from a creamy malt body. The result is a crisp, drinkable Pilsner that will make your crowded, frustrating, too-much-body-heat-filled delay just a bit more bearable.
