Name: Fremont Seasonal
Description: Seasonal brews from Fremont, current season will vary depending on availability.

Name: Fremont Cowiche Canyon Fresh Hop Ale
Description: Cowiche Canyon Fresh Hop Ale is made from select organic hops grown in the famous Cowiche Canyon of the Yakima Valley. Fresh Hop ales are brewed with hops harvested and placed in our kettle within 24 hours. We use only fresh hops throughout this beer for a unique, once-a-year beer. We brew Cowiche Canyon ale in partnership with legendary hop-growing wizards from the Yakima Valley in a joint effort to launch a large-scale organic hop industry in Washington State…Because Organic Hops Matter. A portion of all sales goes toward the Cowiche Canyon Conservancy.

Name: Fremont Universale Pale Ale
Description: Fremont is the self-proclaimed “Center of the Universe” and Universale, our flagship beer, honors the namesake of our unique location. Universale Pale Ale offers a distinctive Northwest twist on the classic pale ale, using a select blend of pale roasted malt and Old World malts balanced with classic Northwest hops to achieve a heavenly beer of rich malt flavor and hop spice. This is beer. Enjoy.

Name: Fremont Summer Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Fremont 11th Anniversary Stout
Description: AN EXCLUSIVE BLEND OF BARREL-AGED IMPERIAL STOUTS   Stout aged in 8-10 years old Heaven Hill bourbon barrels   Stout aged in 8-10 years old Heaven Hill bourbon barrels with tart Montmorency and Dark Tart cherries from Royal Ridge Fruits in Royal WA   Stout aged in ex-bourbon vanilla extract barrels

Name: Fremont Head Full Of Fresh Hop Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Head Full of Fresh Hops starts with select fresh hops harvested in Yakima and loaded into the brew kettle within 24 hours of harvest.  Fresh hop beers signal the harvest season in the Pacific Northwest and are the height of our brewing year.

Name: Fremont Rusty Nail Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout
Description:
The Rusty Nail begins life as The First Nail, an oatmeal stout of epic proportions with brewer’s licorice, smoked barley, and pale malt and is then aged on cinnamon bark. She becomes The Rusty Nail after spending 15 months in 12-year old bourbon barrels. The Rusty Nail pounds your palate, challenges your perception of all that you’ve known of beer, and leaves you wanting … another sip. 

Aroma: Cinnamon, dark sugar (molasses), bourbon, spices (cinnamon, clove)
Flavor: Vanilla, oak, chocolate, coffee, dried dark fruits

Name: Fremont B Bomb Barrel Aged Stout Imperial Stout
Description: This year’s release of B-Bomb is aged in 12-year-old American Oak bourbon barrels and is a blend of 9, 12, and 24-month old barrel strength Winter Ale. B-Bomb achieves distinct bourbon, oak, cacao, leather, and dark coffee notes from its extended barrel aging and barrel blending. Each barrel contributes a different note, and combining each barrel to create a coherent tone is a distinct art and true pleasure. Please do enjoy this unique barrel-aged ale today but know that B-Bomb will age gracefully for at least another 5 years. Don’t Be Afraid To Be Abominable.

Name: Fremont Disco Wolf DIPA
Description: Disco Wolf is brewed for the party animal that won’t let the party stop. This fruit forward double IPA is brewed to be dangerously approachable with a moderately bitter bite.

Name: Fremont Sister IPA
Description: Family always comes first. Just when you thought that your poor tongue couldn't stand any more humulus lupulus, The Sister comes home to prove you wrong. Using the same unbreakable malt backbone of The Brother to balance out a truckload of Calypso and Bravo hops, The Sister weighs in at approximately a billion IBUs.

Name: Real Ale Firemans #4
Description: With an ever-drinkable balance of smooth malt and zesty hops, Firemans #4 is a refreshing blonde that's perfect on a hot day or paired with spicy food. It’s no wonder why so many Texans love it. This blonde ale is named after the Texas bikemaker Firemans Cruzer and was also the fourth year-round beer created by Real Ale Brewing. Silver Medal Winner – 2012 Great American Beer Festival – Golden or Blonde Ale

Name: Real Ale Devil’s Backbone
Food Pairing: Fish - Meaty  Oily, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm
Description: Named for a winding stretch of Hill Country highway, Devil’s Backbone is a Belgian-style tripel. Featuring a beautiful pale-golden color, this ale’s spicy hops and Belgian yeast work together to create a distinctive flavor and aroma. Don’t let the light color fool you, this one has a dark side too. Traditional Belgian brewing techniques add strength without increasing heaviness. Find one near you, or better yet, take a road trip out to Blanco. We promise the views (and the brews) will be well worth the drive. ABV: 8.1% – IBU: 35 – OG: 18°

Name: Real Ale Axis IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed for tap walls overrun with the white noise of West Coast IPA's, here’s an offering so exotic, you’d think it was from another world. Like its namesake before it, the axis deer of Southern Asia, so too has this species (beverage?) of hop-forward animal magnetism come to invade the landscape of IPA’s that have long held sway over the taps of Texas’s finest watering holes. Tropical fruit, citrus, and a pale golden body, help keep this breed light on its feet. And with few natural predators there is little anyone can do to stop the spread. IPA may not have been born in Texas, but it will soon seem as native as the sky that stretches between its borders.

Name: Real Ale Hans Pils
Description: You might say, a great beer is man’s other best friend. So when we made this German-style pilsner, it just made sense to name it after the brewery’s dog, Hans — our owner’s German Shorthair Pointer. Inspired by the pilsner beers of Northern Germany, Hans is crisp, brightly hoppy and full of flavor. At 50 IBUs and featuring Tettnang hops, it’s even hoppier than many pale ales. The German malt helps create a nice pale golden color and provides the perfect companion to the hops. ABV: 5.3% – IBU: 50 – OG: 12.5°  Silver Medal Winner – 2012 Great American Beer Festival – German-Style Pilsener

Name: Real Ale Red King Imperial Red
Description: When the siren calls you go, and when the people speak the brewers answer. After much fanfare our Imperial Red has been crowned the Red King, the first of its kind to move from humble Brewers’ Cut beginnings to Real Ale’s year round royalty. This unflinching ale is deep crimson in appearance, demanding fealty to both its English malt heritage and a surfeit of American hops. Pay tribute to your king, and run with the wolf! ABV: 8.6% – IBU: 75 – OG: 20°

Name: Real Ale Brewers Cut Imperial Red
Description: Feel the warm embrace of malt and hops. Enjoy a bold Red Ale with firm caramel malt character and hefty doses of Centennial hops.

Name: Real Ale Coffee Porter
Description: Shade Grown Coffee Porter is a American Porter style beer brewed by Real Ale Brewing Company in Blanco, TX.

Name: Real Ale Mix
Description: Sure to delight every birthday celebrant, this case is packed with ales from up and down the land. Two bottles of each ensures there's enough to share with family and friends at the party.    The perfect birthday present!    All our mixed cases can be customised however you like in your shopping basket, so you can have a little more of this or a little less of that.

Name: Real Ale Rio Blanco Pale Ale
Description: Born in England. Raised in Texas. Meet our interpretation of a traditional English-style pale ale. This copper-hued ale is our homage to the nearby Blanco river. Inspired by its cool, clear waters, Rio Blanco has an enticing aroma and crisp finish. And its great balance of spicy hop flavor and hop bitterness make it perfect for a day spent relaxing out on the river. It’s the best of England and Texas all in one bottle. So, enjoy a pint/mug at your nearest pub/watering hole with your best mate/amigo today.  (Contains wheat)

Name: Real Ale Four Squared
Description: Originally brewed to celebrate the brewery’s 16th anniversary, and wildly popular as a seasonal release, Four Squared lives on in our year round lineup to quench the thirst of both the hop beginners and the most ardent hop heads. Lighter bodied and not too bitter, the balance of Four Squared leans heavily towards its dry hop component, a combination of Crystal, Amarillo and Mosaic hops that brings a brightness to the hop flavor and won't weigh you down. Save the resin and dank for your IPA, this beer is all about the tropical, juicy citrus that grabs you from the first sip. Dry and refreshing, bright and fruity, Four Squared keeps you coming back for more.

Name: Real Ale Commissar Russian Imperial Stout
Description: This noble brew evolved from its common cousins, porter and stout, by necessity to endure the long voyage to the Russian royal court. Colossal additions of American hops are used to balance the robust malt character and infuse this ale with their distinctly citrus-like qualities. The Commissar can be consumed now or laid down for further enjoyment. Take some home to share with friends and family at your court. ABV: 9.8% – IBU: 75 – OG: 22°

Name: Real Ale Lost Gold IPA
Description: Texas has more buried treasure than any other state. (Seriously, Google it.) That fact was the inspiration for Lost Gold. English Crystal malts give this IPA a rich golden-orange hue and a subtle, yet firm, malt background. Bright and citrusy with grapefruit notes, Lost Gold features an abundance of American hops that always mark the spot. Don’t worry, however, you won’t have to hunt for this treasured favorite. It’s available year round all over Texas. ABV: 6.6% – IBU: 62 – OG: 15.5°

Name: Real Ale Full Moon Rye IPA
Real Ale Oktoberfest
Description: Fall and German beer go together like Texas and tacos. So we brewed Oktoberfest, our first lager, using traditional Bavarian brewing methods and the highest quality German malt, hops, and yeast. Munich and Vienna malts are the real heroes of this brew, resulting in a smooth, copper-colored, medium-bodied beer that’s perfect for Fall. This year, celebrate Oktoberfest with Real Ale and fill a stein with this traditional Bavarian lager. We won’t even make you wear lederhosen.

Name: Real Ale Firemans Light
Description:
“Do y’all have anything lighter than Firemans #4?”  It’s a question we’ve been getting for years. We weren’t opposed to brewing a light craft beer, but our team knew that it would be a monumental challenge to brew a real light beer the Real Ale way.

It has taken years to get it right. And now that we know we’ve got it right, we’re ready to answer that question with a resounding YES. Introducing Firemans Light. We think we’ve perfected the lighter side of craft, with a 110 calorie, easy-drinking, crisp, light bodied lager that delivers a clean, malt-driven finish. If you’re a craft beer drinker looking for a lighter option, you’ll want to check this out.  If you’re a light beer drinker looking for quality, freshness, and flavor from an independent Texas brewery, come on in!  Either way, it’s about time light beer got real. Firemans Light. Real. Light. Beer.

Name: Real Ale Mix
Description: Sure to delight every birthday celebrant, this case is packed with ales from up and down the land. Two bottles of each ensures there's enough to share with family and friends at the party.    The perfect birthday present!    All our mixed cases can be customised however you like in your shopping basket, so you can have a little more of this or a little less of that.

Name: Real Ale Seasonal
Description: Varies each season!

Name: Horse & Dragon Sad Panda Coffee Stout
Description: The rich, black-as-night color with the creamy, tan head tells you that the beer in your glass is a stout through and through. However, as soon as you raise the glass to your nose, you will know that Sad Panda is something special. Aromas of vanilla and chocolate are prominent yet balanced with the malt sweetness and caramel aromas expected in stouts. Your first sip introduces the complex combination of flavors you might expect in your favorite coffee – the balanced sweetness of vanilla and dark chocolate flavors blend with a smooth coffee bitterness at the finish. This drinkable stout hits all the right notes. Better have one more....

Name: Horse & Dragon Fire Captain Irish Red Ale
Description: A malt forward ale with a strong biscuity sweet flavor balanced with a smooth noble hop bitterness. In honor of the Firefighters who serve in our region and everywhere one dollar of each pint sold in our tap room will be contributed to the Firefighters Community Compassion Fund. The FCCF provides each engine and truck in the region with a "petty cash" box which can then be used for immediate needs encountered when on a call. Thank you firefighters! Cheers.

Name: Horse & Dragon Respite 2020 Peach Basil Golden Ale
Description: Though perhaps not the first things one might think to combine, peach and basil come together beautifully in this golden ale to create a delicious medium-bodied brew. Sweetness from both malts and peaches is balanced by a light fruity hop bite and the sharp earthiness of basil additions. We hope you can kick back for a brief respite from 2020 or whatever ails you with this refreshing golden ale. Cheers!

Name: Horse & Dragon Almost Summer Blonde Ale
Description: Sit back into Colorado’s sunny days with our American version of an English-style Summer Ale. Bridging the gap between the warm, rich ales of winter and the light and refreshing brews of summer, Almost-Summer Ale is a delicious balance of biscuity-malt flavor and light citrus hop finish, with a slightly bigger body and smoother mouth feel than a traditional summer ale. Note the sunny golden hue, take a moment to enjoy the balanced aromas of both hops and malts. Perfect for enjoying the Colorado days where chilly mornings turn into summerlike afternoons.

Name: Horse & Dragon Winter Lights Spiced Imperial Porter
Description: From the first whiff, malty-sweet and spiced aromas rise from this porter, lent by additions of cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger. As you sip, that sweetness is joined by lightly smoky dark fruit and toffee notes, and balanced with plenty of hop character. Robust malt roast finishes out this hefty, flavorful brew with balanced bitterness that will warm you up throughout the winter months!

Name: Horse & Dragon Snow Camp Robust Porter
Description: Aromas of roasted malt and caramel waft from this traditional porter. As you sip, flavors run the gamut from hints of unsweetened dark chocolate and toffee to toasted malt highlights. As this beer warms slightly, complexity increases, culminating with malt roast notes that linger on your tongue as the beer finishes clean and dry, inviting you to go back for another.

Name: Horse & Dragon Zest of Both Worlds Pale Ale with Grapefruit (Collab w/Loveland Aleworks)
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Zest of Both Worlds is a beer that, like many things, is all about balance. Sharp, citrusy aromas are joined by slight malt undertones and the sweet/bitter combo of grapefruit. That tangy bite carries through to the finish of this crisp, refreshing pale ale. We had an awesome time collaborating with our friends at Loveland Aleworks to create this delicious, zesty brew, and we hope you too can (virtually) gather with friends to raise a glass!

Name: Horse & Dragon Colorado Breeze Juicy Pale Ale
Description: Full, bright citrus and tangerine aromas are joined by a hint of spiciness on the nose of this juicy pale ale. Its silky smooth texture complements more of those citrusy flavors, joined by notes of starfruit, melon and a slight malt-sweet base, melding together in a delightful flavor combination. Finishing crisp and refreshing with a little lingering hop bitterness, this brew is perfectly reminiscent of any Colorado breeze!

Name: Horse & Dragon People Power Blood Orange Kettle Sour
Description: This rosy golden-hued kettle sour begins with subtle tart notes, and hints of star fruit and pineapple, which are joined by slight citrus pithiness from blood orange additions to create a light, drinkable brew. As a part of the People Power Beer initiative, Horse & Dragon will be donating 10% of the purchase price for each beer sold to the American Civil Liberties Union. Learn more at peoplepower.beer.

Name: Horse & Dragon Citrus Fiesta Kettle Sour
Description: Malty cereal scents tinged with a telltale hint of citrusy hop rise from this light golden kettle sour. Your first sips will be refreshing and tangy, dancing brightly across your tongue. The 2020 Citrus Fiesta’s additions of lime and blackberry are apparent throughout, and play into the tart nature of the sour itself. As your mouth warms up after you drink, you’ll experience a lingering fruit punch medley. To summer in a glass!

Name: Horse & Dragon Maracuyá Passionfruit IPA
Description: Sweet and tart aromas of maracuyá (passionfruit) pair beautifully with carefully selected hops to produce a warm citrus and tropical fruit nose. First sips will bring a burst of hop bitterness trailed by a bright malt backbone. The finish is clean and balanced. The fantastic sweet-tart flavor of passionfruit complements each facet of this rich, copper-colored IPA.

Name: Horse & Dragon Rye Whiskey Barrel Aged Imperial IPA
Description: As a result of the five months it spent aging in rye whiskey barrels, our barrel-aged Blue Giant Imperial IPA boasts a much sweeter and more mellowed hop profile than it’s original iteration. However, the blending of a few additional hops post-aging has lent a brightness to this beer. The result is a delicious balance of sweet malt flavors, barrel-aged oakiness, hints of dark stone fruit, and light hop brightness to round out this full-bodied brew.

Name: Horse And Dragon Picnic Rock Pale Ale
Description: In the scenic Poudre Canyon alongside the wild Cache la Poudre River, Picnic Rock is a favored stop for fishing, kayaking, climbing, and friends. Picnic Rock Pale Ale aligns itself with recreation in Colorado and our desire for great craft beer. Fresh hop aromas likened to lemon, pineapple, and honeydew melon stand out in the front of this golden colored ale holding a white laced head. The aroma taking center stage is then carried into the noticeable hop bitterness. Malt body is medium-light and complements the bitterness allowing for a smooth finish with a lingering light floral hop flavor. Let's go for a picnic! ABV: 6.6%

Name: Horse & Dragon This is the Haze Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This refreshing and drinkable hazy IPA starts with big hop aromas right off the bat. As you taste, those hop flavors continue through to the beer’s soft, full body, joined by subtle sweetness to balance the slight hop bitterness. Our head brewer, Tanner, is playing with different hops in search of the ideal hazy IPA, so be on the lookout for all the tweaks and quirks of each new episode of This is the Haze!

Name: Horse & Dragon Hop Voyage Imperial IPA
Description: Containing the most hops we’ve ever used in a single batch of beer (over 6.5 pounds per barrel!), Hop Voyage lives up to its name. A delicious hop bouquet kicks off this beer with bright aromas of pineapple, tangerine and grapefruit. As you sip, look for more notes of  bittering, resinous hops, married with sweetness from the many malts that give this beer its high alcohol content. All of these conclude in a crisp, clean finish for this well-balanced and hoptastic brew.

Name: Horse & Dragon The Dark Horse Dark Lager
Description: Don’t let the color fool you, this dark lager is full of surprises. An all German malt bill lends a depth of malt complexity to its body, with a touch of oak smoked wheat bringing each flavor together. A unique mashing technique was used to impart all of the dark color with only a hint of dark malt flavors, leaving this beer incredibly smooth and drinkable. All of this balanced with German Saaz hops, and you can bet the house on this Dark Horse!

Name: Horse & Dragon Silver Lion
Description: This light and eminently refreshing lager is a pale straw color. A honey-sweet malt backdrop highlights floral scents from the traditional Saaz hops. Virtually no bitterness is wrought from the hops during brewing, but they leave a slightly spicy flavor and a hint of lemon zest. Both the yeast and the hops produce what our team termed a “European finish,” but happily minus the skunkiness we often associate with imported European lagers that don’t weather transport well – Silver Lion is fresh & delicious. The logo pays homage to Bohemia (with its double-tailed silver lion crest), where this style of beer was first brewed.

Name: Horse & Dragon Trail Snack American Lager
Description: At first sniff, fruit forward hop aroma wafts off of this refreshing golden lager. Those delicate citrusy notes continue through to the first sip, joined by light malt sweetness and increased mouthfeel lent by flaked corn, present in the malt bill, and Mexican lager yeast, used for fermentation. A slight resiny hop bitterness lingers to round out this crisp, drinkable beer. Perfect for enjoying cold on the trail or raising a glass at home! (Provided you’re at least six feet apart, that is!)

Name: Horse And Dragon Disfrute Pineapple Ginger Lager
Description: When Josh told us he and Ellen were playing around with fermenting tepache at home and might want to incorporate some of the ingredients in for a Horse & Dragon lager, we were intrigued. A little discussion and research revealed that this traditional Mexican fermented fruit beverage is now made with pineapple, ginger, cinnamon, and chiles. Thinking that that many strong flavors might overwhelm the great lager base he had planned, Josh decided to limit the recipe additions to pineapple and ginger. We can’t think of a more refreshing summer drink. Ginger on the nose combines with floral and tropical hop notes. Sipping the beer you could just enjoy a light and eminently refreshing summer beer, or you could try to analyze the different stages of grain – no ginger – no pineapple – no hops -- on your tongue. Like a beautiful tropical umbrella drink, only better, because: beer! ABV: 5.1%

Name: Sun King Osiris Pale Ale
Description: Osiris is an assertively hopped west coast style Pale Ale. Every aspect of Osiris is designed to showcase the hops without overpowering your taste buds.

Name: Sun King Pachanga
Description: Pachanga is a Mexican-Style Lager with a crisp malt flavor and thirst-quenching character, perfect for hot days in the summer sun.

Name: Sun King Amber Has Two Moms
Description: Amber Has Two Moms is an American Amber Ale with a beautiful red hue and a rich caramel malt flavor.

Name: Sun King Cowbell Porter
Description: Cowbell is a rich, creamy porter with hints of chocolate.

Name: Sun King Ring Of Dingle
Description: Ring of Dingle is a rich and roasty Irish-Style Dry Stout with a clean, dry finish. The beer is named after a scenic road network in Ireland that starts and ends in the city of Dingle.    Ring of Dingle was the winner of the Silver Medal in the Classic Irish-Dry Stout Category at the 2012 World Beer Cup, and the winner of the Gold Medal in the Irish-Style Dry Stout category at the 2011 Great American Beer Festival.

Name: Sun King Grapefruit Jungle IPA
Description: GFJ American IPA crafted with a unique blend of hops to provide the tropical aroma and flavors of grapefruit, passionfruit, tangerine, and apricot. No grapefruits were harmed in the creation of this beer.

Name: Sun King Fistful Of Hops: Orange
Description: Fistful of Hops is our quarterly series of four IPAs, each with the same malt base. We balance that base against a seasonal “fistful of hops” - each time a different variety. Our Summer 2016 release features Citra, Mandarina, and Cascade, for balanced citrus and tropical fruit flavor.

Name: Sun King GFJ IPA
Description: In tribute to 1955's Blackboard Jungle, which brought Rock & Roll to the masses, the Brewers at Sun King bring our passion for brewing to a glass near you. GFJ's unique blend of hops provide a jungle of aroma and flavors - passionfruit, tangerine, apricot, grapefruit, and orange zest - with just the right amount of malt balance to create an IPA as revolutionary as Rock & Roll itself.

Name: Sun King/Revolution Double 00 Session
Description: This collaborative effort between Indy’s Sun King and Chicago’s Revolution is a juicy success. Citra and Mosaic are employed here, delivering a deliciously tropical flavors and aromas. The finish is light and snappy with hints of tangerine, lemon and papaya.

Name: Sun King 30 Minute Coma
Description: 30 Minute Coma is a CANlaboration devised with our friends from Solemn Oath Brewery for the second annual Sun King CANvitational. This Belgian-style Session IPA combines citrusy American and German hops with spicy Belgian yeast in an international showcase of flavor.

Name: Sun King Eighteenth Sun Imperial Wheat IPA
Sun King Oktoberfest
Description: Crafted with choice German malts and Noble hops, Sun King Oktoberfest has a clean malty start with a slightly earthy hop character and a crisp, dry finish.

Name: Sun King Seasonal
Description: Wee Muckle was the winner of the Gold Medal in the Scotch Ale category at the 2011 Great American Beer Festival.

Name: Sun King Java Mac
Description: Java Mac is the coffee infused version of our Wee Mac Scottish-Style Ale. Locally roasted coffee from Bee Roasters harmonizes with the base beer's hazelnut character and toffee undertones to create a vibrant symphony of rich coffee flavor. Java Mac was the winner of the Gold Medal in the Coffee Beer category at the 2011 Great American Beer Festival.

Name: Lord Hobo Boomsauce Double IPA
Description: There is nothing subtle about our Flagship beer. Boomsauce is a big bold IPA with a complex hop profile. With five different hops, it hits you with strong tropical fruit flavors before mellowing out to finish with a hint of earthiness. Each subsequent taste opens up the dynamic layers of complexity woven throughout this beer. Imagine fresh-pressed fruit without the sweetness, perfect for that Saturday afternoon pick-me-up or a late-night congregation of friends. Boomsauce is your way to celebrate no matter the occasion.

Name: Lord Hobo Life Session IPA
Description:
This hop forward, easy-drinking IPA tickles your tongue in all the right ways. The Citra hops bring out a fresh zesty lemon without the puckering aftereffect, while the flaked oats in the malt bill
provide a silky mouthfeel. Grab Life by the hands and don’t let go.

Name: Lord Hobo Angelica Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Angelica is a one of a kind showcase of the magnificent Mosaic hop - notes of fresh cut citrus fruits dance along the palate and are complemented by a subtle sweetness. This beer pours a beautiful hazy golden yellow and drinks so smooth you'll barely believe you're drinking a beer! Soft and pillowy wheat malt adds to the drinkability and full body of Angelica.

Name: Lord Hobo 617 Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Dry, Pine, Silky, Smooth, Sweet
Description: 617 embodies the iconic winning spirit of Boston and all of the things that make New England great. The hops and grains beautifully blend together providing a perfect balance between sweet and bitter, leaving you ready for another one. Together they form a bright berry flavor profile with a hint of honey on the finish. 617 is a homerun however you decide to drink it. #THATS617

Name: Lord Hobo Glorious New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Hoppy, Dry, Tropical Fruit, Stone Fruit
Description:
Glorious is the beautiful culmination of all things New England IPA. Bursting with fruity aromas of mango, peach, passion fruit, and papaya with matching juicy flavors, the Galaxy dry hopping works in harmony with the malt bill to create an elegant hazy appearance and smooth drinking
experience. This is New England’s IPA.

Name: Lord Hobo Freebird Golden Ale
Description: The word crushable doesn’t even begin to describe what Freebird has to offer – showcasing a distinct malt profile and a clean, crisp finish, our Golden Ale can quench even the greatest thirst. The subtle aromatic notes of fresh bread and earthy pine set the stage for the slightly sweet, biscuity malt flavors that are the backbone of this refreshing beer. Before you know it, you’ll be ready to crack open another one.

Name: Lord Hobo Godmother Imperial Stout
Tasting Notes: Bitter, Chocolate, Coffee, Malty, Rich, Roasted, Smooth, Sweet
Description: We originally brewed Godmother as a small batch experiment to balance our portfolio of NE Hazy IPAs with something dark and bold. As is tradition here at Lord Hobo, when we commit to something, we go big, really big – the result was a giant and assertive 12% Imperial stout that maintains a deceptive drinkability and smoothness. Everyone at the brewery and our customers loved this beer so much that we felt it had to make a return with a wider release as part of our Good Lord series, a rotating release of high-end specialty beers that we prize for their creativity and craftsmanship. Godmother is a cherished companion to long dark nights indoors and will help stave off the encroaching cold of winter. A slow sipper, this Imperial Stout opens up the more time you spend with it. Warming and welcoming, like any Godmother should be, this beer will always be there for you.

Name: Lord Hobo Doomsauce Black Double IPA
Tasting Notes: Bitter, Citrus, Creamy, Malty, Roasted, Smooth, Sweet
Description: A welcomed darkness has fallen upon our flagship Double IPA. Pouring black as midnight with a hefty tan head, yet conjuring the aromas of fresh citrus layered with the soft tropical fruit and candied orange flavors you know and love in Boomsauce there appears to be something sinister at work. By summoning the smoothest black malts available to mortal men we’ve created a delicate roasted malt backbone with a slightly sweet and remarkably clean finish. From the depths of darkness the Doomsauce emerges.

Name: Lord Hobo Orange Angelica Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Berry, Citrus, Creamy, Fruity, Stone Fruit
Description: While most beers emulate citrus flavors with a careful blend of hops we set out to up the ante and push those flavors over the top by taking our Angelica Hazy IPA and adding a healthy dose of orange to the fermenter. Forget an orange slice on the glass, our seasonal Hazy Orange IPA is bursting with juicy orange flavor and tropical citrus aroma that perfectly compliment the mixed berry and stone fruit qualities of the Mosaic hops. Combine that with the creamy body, and the delicate mouthfeel and you have a hop forward yet crushingly balanced IPA.

Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Fruity, Hoppy, Pineapple, Stone Fruit
Description: The Lord Hobo Vagabond Series is a year-long curated list of specialty beers inspired and produced by our brewing team, highlighting their creativity and unique personalities. Not to leave out other members of the Lord Hobo family, this NEIPA was inspired by our very own Graphic Designer, Chuck, and his band Diablogato; who play a style of music that’s not quite punk and definitely not rockabilly. It’s revved up greasy garage stomp that has a swampy swing and a voodoo twang. And what better way to conjure up the sinister 3 eyed gato than with a raucous hazy juice bomb packed with Galaxy and Centennial hops. Bursting with notes of juicy pineapple, not only from the Galaxy hops but also amped up by the unique and out there Kveik yeast, which adds some extra depth to the flavor. Get ready to rock your taste buds with this 8% bombshell.

Name: Lord Hobo Consolation Prize Double IPA
Description: A full-bodied Double IPA that glows a magnificent hazy orange. Heavily dry-hopped with Jarrylo, Azacca & Mosaic resulting in big notes of pineapple, mango, honeydew with a notable Pilsner malt backbone. Dangerously drinkable and surprisingly mellow.

Name: Lord Hobo Museum Triple IPA
Tasting Notes: Bitter, Grapefruit, Malty, Pine, Sweet, Tropical
Description: Our Vagabond Series is a year-long monthly rotating series of specialty beers inspired and produced by our brewing team, highlighting their creativity and unique personalities. When you have a work of art deemed a masterpiece, it should be on display in a Museum. We created this Triple IPA to test the limits of combining a high ABV IPA while also maintaining the New England style flavor profile. Museum is an 11% Triple Dry Hopped IPA. Citra, Galaxy, and Mosaic hops combine to showcase tropical aromas of orange, apricot, and peach. Medium in body with a moderate, piney bitterness, Museum boasts a delicate balance between resinous and a touch of rounded malt sweetness. Enjoy the exhibition while you can, before it heads back into our vault.

Name: Lord Hobo Hop Evolution Double IPA
Tasting Notes: Bright, Citrus, Hoppy, Malty, Peach, Smooth, Sweet
Description: Our Good Lord Series is a bi-monthly release of some of our most cherished beers and a few that are new to a market-wide release. These beers are always big and bold; boundary-pushing examples of our uncompromising need to make world-class beer. When we partnered with Connecticut's Wood-N-Tap Bar & Grill to create a juice bomb worthy of both the Lord Hobo and Wood-N-Tap name, we ended up doing things a little differently. To get ourselves inspired and spark a little friendly in-house competition, we ran a contest among the brew team—who could design and brew the best, juiciest IPA? While each beer was exceptional, there was one stand-out entry that employed a combination of Citra, Simcoe, and Mosaic hops. We took our time refining the recipe until we found the perfect balance of those hops. The name, Hop Evolution, is an homage to the beer's development and a testament to our ever-evolving innovation process.

Name: Long Trail VT IPA
Description:
Our brewers developed this recipe for more than a year; playing around with yeast strains and hop combinations in search of a smooth, juicy offering that pleases palates. With VT IPA they found the perfect balance of tropical fruit and citrus flavors through a heavy dry-hopping of Citra and Amarillo hops, which give distinct tangerine, mango, pineapple and grapefruit character. 

The juicy hop profile is complemented by the grist, which features a heavy hand of flaked oats and aromatic Munich malt to deliver a smooth mouthfeel and hazy appearance. What sets this beer apart --aside from the soft bitterness-- is the introduction of a new yeast strain that provides the beer with more neutral notes and juicy esters that enhance the hops.

Enjoy it fresh, enjoy it often.

Name: Long Trail Summer
Description: An unfiltered golden ale made to chill out summer's hottest days. Remarkably light on the palate, with a soft Pilsner malt character and a distinct citrus hop aroma deriving from dry-hopped additions of Citra hops. Each sip finishes with a refreshing bitterness that invites another. At 4.3% ABV, this golden beauty is a truly quaffable drinking experience.

Name: Long Trail Ramble
Description: A great thirst quencher that takes the use of malts and hops off the beaten path. Brewed in traditional Kölschbier style  this beer has a clean  refreshing flavor profile  with strong citrusy and mild peppery notes deriving from the use of lemon rind and ground peppercorns in the brewing process.

Name: Long Trail Blackbeary Wheat
Description: This brew combines 2-Row Pilsen malt, a hint of Crystal malt, and of course, plenty of malted wheat. A hint of blackberry at the finish makes this beer a real thirst quencher! For the health conscious, Blackbeary Wheat has less than 6 grams of carbs and under 125 calories per bottle!

Name: Long Trail Mostly Cloudy
Description: Whether you prefer partly sunny or mostly cloudy, this brew will happily keep your glass half full.

Name: Long Trail Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Our take on the traditional Belgian farmhouse ale, Saison features a fruity bouquet of Belgian yeast character that’s complemented by a spicy hop aroma. A soft malt character is nicely balanced with a light bitterness that reveals a dry, effervescent finish.

Name: Long Trail Smash Project Pale Ale
Long Trail Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: In 25 short years, we've weaved our way into the Vermont landscape and become as much a Green Mountain tradition as the Long Trail itself. A lot has changed since the first batch of Long Trail Ale rolled off the line at the original Mountain Brewers brewery – including our name – but one thing remains constant; Long Trail's presence at ski hills, cookouts and get-togethers all over the East Coast.

Name: Long Trail Stand Out Pale Ale
Description: Brave the elements, reach the peak, and savor life’s stand out moments. Brewed in the spirit of adventure this beer showcases the complex fruity and herbal notes of Equinox hops.

Name: Long Trail Barrel Aged Unearthed Stout
Long Trail IPA
Description: In 25 short years, we've weaved our way into the Vermont landscape and become as much a Green Mountain tradition as the Long Trail itself. A lot has changed since the first batch of Long Trail Ale rolled off the line at the original Mountain Brewers brewery – including our name – but one thing remains constant; Long Trail's presence at ski hills, cookouts and get-togethers all over the East Coast.

Name: Long Trail Limbo
Tasting Notes: Hoppy, Melon - Honeydew, Tropical Fruit, Citrus
Description: A big, mouth-watering IPA, brimming with all the flavors and aromas of the new breed of hops coming out of Australia and the Pacific Northwest.

Name: Long Trail Little Anomaly IPA
Description:
Little Anomaly is our addition to the low-calorie IPA genre. Legend has it that we noticed one thing while sipping and sampling the growing field of low-cal IPAs: big hop flavor is an anomaly.

Fast-forward to development and our crew nailed down the elusive attributes of the IPAs we enjoy so much. Hazy, juicy and full of big, bold flavors from Mandarina Bavaria, Simcoe, Columbus and Centennial hops. All wrapped up in 110 calories of crushable content.

Name: Long Trail “Sick Day” IPA
Description: The snow dance worked! Emails can wait. Invoke the powder clause and have a “sick day.”A hoppy brown ale that's built for winter's deepest days, "Sick Day" is knee-deep in piney, spicy hop flavors and nicely balanced by a warming, toasty malt presence that'll warm your soul after a day in the snow.

Name: Long Trail Citrus Limbo IPA
Description: Forbidden fruit is within reach in this grapefruit and tangerine infused take on our mouthwatering Limbo IPA. Dry-hopped with Galaxy and Mosaic hops for an added citrus punch.

Name: Long Trail Vermont Double IPA
Description: Vermont Double IPA is full of fruity, juicy and dank hop flavors with a light, soft mouthfeel and slight alcohol presence. The recipe features green mountains of Amarillo, Citra and Simcoe hops.

Name: The Lost Abbey Judgment Day
Description: In Belgian brewing there are fantastic wild ales brewed with naturally occurring yeast. These beers develop over time and are ready on their own terms. Duck Duck Gooze is our homage to these effervescent and wonderfully complex sparkling beers.A blend of young and old barrel aged beers, this has been one of our most sought after beers year after year since it’s original release in 2009.Alas, it is released in very small quantities only once every three years, so it’s extremely difficult to come by beyond the day we release it. It does, however, turn up on our Tasting Room’s Vintage List from time to time, so don’t despair.

Name: The Lost Abbey Lost & Found
Description: A life worth living is full of discovery and we are reminded everywhere there is opportunity. All it takes is desire to seek out and find these things, these moments and everything in between. We brewed Lost and Found Abbey Ale to pay homage to the great monastic breweries of Belgium. Like us, we hope you’ll take the time to discover a beer that breathes aromas of figs, raisins and candied fruits. Please join us by raising your glass as we offer a toast to patience, perseverance, and all the things we have lost along the way and were somehow lucky enough to find once again.

Name: Lost Abbey Track #8
Description: At a Glance The Beer: A fresh track, Track 8 is a spicy monster — A base of Judgment Day aged in freshly emptied bourbon barrels then spiked with liberal additions of cinnamon stick and dried chili pepper. ABV: 13.7% Released: August 18, 2012 Liner Notes We’ve never released a Bourbon Barrel version of our Judgment Day. So we thought it might be interesting to take the base beer for Cuvee de Tomme age in first fill Bourbon Barrels and let mother nature take over. Of course, because this is a Rock and Roll inspired Box Set beer, we couldn’t just leave well enough alone. Upon sampling the base beer, it became apparent that the raisins used to brew the base beer were going to drive the flavor bus of this beer. The conversations turned to Oatmeal Raisin cookies and the essence of a freshly baked treat. So we added some cinnamon sticks to the barrels and threw in some dried chiles as well. At 13.70 ABV this beer has amazing depth of flavor and presents a unique drinking experience for consumers who may be seeking enlightenment on Judgment Day.

Name: The Lost Abbey Saints Devotion
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A Brett-finished version of our Devotion Ale. Saint’s Devotion is bottle conditioned with brettanomyces to deepen the layers of flavor on our most hop-forward beer from Lost Abbey lineup.

Name: The Lost Abbey Red Barn Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This Farmhouse Ale traces its roots to the small rustic breweries of Southern Belgium. The word Saison comes to us from the French language and it means Season. Lightly spiced with Organic Ginger, Orange Peels, Black Pepper and Grains of Paradise, this brew promises to quench your thirst on the hottest Southern California days or wherever your travels may take you.

Name: The Lost Abbey Red Poppy Ale
Description: Perhaps no country embraces the use of fruit in beers more so than Belgium. Numerous traditional as well as regional specialty ales are infused with every sort of fruit imaginable. In this way, the flavor of the fruit becomes especially prominent. Red Poppy Ale is a veritable celebration of Sour Cherries in an explosion of aromas and tastes. Brewed from a brown ale base and aged in our oak barrels for over 6 months, this beer is not for the faint of heart. The Golden Poppy is the state flower of California and the Red Poppy is found in Flanders Fields where our inspiration for this beer comes from.

Name: The Lost Abbey Red Poppy
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: The Lost Abbey Red Poppy Ale  Red Poppy Ale is a veritable celebration of Sour Cherries in an explosion of aromas and tastes. Brewed from a brown ale base and aged in our oak barrels for over 6 months, this beer is not for the faint of heart.    The Golden Poppy is the state flower of California and the Red Poppy is found in Flanders Fields where our inspiration for this beer comes from. This beer is 5.5% ABV and is available in 375 ml bottles and on draft at inspired locations.    TASTING NOTES:  AROMA: Red Poppy starts with a complex nose of tart cherries, vanilla and cinnamon like finish. There is also an underlying basis of yeast esters and wild yeast components that result in an extraordinary complex nose.     TASTE: Red Poppy starts its life out as our Dawn Patrol Dark. Post primary fermentation, we blend this with some of our Amigo Lager at transfer to barrel. During the fermentation in the barrel from the micro organisms, we gain acidity which results in a beer with hints of Vanilla, Tannins and Sourness from the Cherries and the secondary fermentation and extensive aging.  STYLE REFERENCE:  Flanders Red Ale  PAIR WITH:  Duck with reductions sauces and fruit components

Description:
Our clean, crisp, true-to-style Kölsch is brewed using traditional German methods, German Pilsner malt and German noble hops. It’s as authentic as it is refreshing.Reach for a bottle of light, easy-drinking Rasenmäher whenever the sun shines…
or you want it to.

Name: Down The Road Spring Heel Jack Porter
Down The Road Reynard’s Witbier
Description: Reynard’s WitBier is a new seasonal brew from Down The Road - just in time for Summer 2017. This new spin on a traditional Belgian Wit features a blast of refreshing citrus. Cloudy and vibrant, Reynard’s WitBier erupts with bitter orange zest, calming chamomile, delicate Indian coriander and subtle Noble hops.

Name: Down The Road Fee Des Fleurs Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Down The Road Pukwudgie Pale Ale
Description: Like the mythical Wampanoag woodland creature, our Pukwudgie Pale Ale is bantamweight and highly  spirited with an impish attitude built right in.    Premium Chinook and Mosaic hops along with select American malt deliver a complex bouquet of tropical fruit, citrus, caramel, and pine without ever dragging you down. Again and again.

Name: Down The Road Citra Pukwudgie
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This version of Pukwudgie adds Citra hopsto our classic blendof Mosaic and Cascade to amplify the bright, citrusy qualities of this hoppy, sessionable brew.

Name: Down The Road Full Spectrum Hoppy Pale Ale
Description: Full Spectrum is a juiced, hoppy pale ale, meant to keep you going all night at 4.5% ABV. We started with a tried and true combo of Mosaic, Chinook and Cascade hops and then finished with a heavy handed splash of pure Pineapple juice. The result is an insanely drinkable pale that strikes a perfect balance of bitter and sweet, booze and tastiness.

Name: Down The Road Colibri Gose
Description: All proceeds of this beer is donated to Hurricane Relief in Puerto Rico. Brewed with guava, mango and native sea salt

Name: Down The Road Deep Dweller
Description: It is this unlikely monster to which we dedicate our Deepdweller Cranberry Chocolate Stout - a reminder of the old world horrors that once dominated our collective unconscious. This beer is deep and black as the sunken graves of the Knucker with roasted malt and robust chocolate contrasted against a quick zip of tart cranberry, alluring as a chest of rubies. Although we have prepared Deepdweller to be enjoyed fresh, we also set aside a fraction of the batch to age in Buffalo Trace bourbon barrels, where it will slumber for several months awaiting the perfect opportunity to strike. Drink, but remember - if you seek to hunt monsters, you must take caution lest you become one yourself.

Name: Down The Road Folktour
Description:
“Folktour” is a celebration of the friendship between Down The Road and City Brew Tours, as well as our mutual love of storytelling and beer.

This decadent ale blends dark malts and sweet chocolate into a hot cocoa porter with a hint of vanilla to warm your bones through the cold winter months.

Name: Down The Road Sunna Double IPA
Description: Sunna, Goddess of the Sun, drives her blazing chariot across the heavens, eternally in retreat from Sköll, the lupine devourer of gods. Every morning, Sunna illuminates the world with her brilliance, and every night, her path obscures her from sight. At the end of time, Sköll will succeed in his hunt, but for now, the sun yet rises.   This Double IPA boasts epic juiciness from Citra, Simcoe, Amarillo and Galaxy - all legends from the pantheon of hops. Sunna Double IPA is a perfect harmony of orange, apricot and grapefruit notes, radiant as a smile from the Sun Goddess herself.

Name: Down The Road Undine Double IPA
Description: Our Double IPA is brewed using Amarillo, Citra and Mosaic hops, Pale 2 Row Malt and Chico Yeast to create a heady brew with juicy notes of tropical fruit and citrus.

Name: Down The Road Dreamtime New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Dreamtime is a hazy, New England-style IPA featuring Vic Secret and Ella hops from Australia. An eruption of passionfruit and pineapple blend beautifully into light pine, delicate floral and subtle herbal notes. Crack a Dreamtime NEIPA, and breathe deep the stardust of your ancestors.

Name: Down the Road Seventh Star IPA
Description: Our Seventh Star IPA is a ripe, fruity brew that features elusive Idaho Experimental #7 hop. This new contender boasts bright notes of melon, grape and strawberry, which we offsest against a light swirl of Azaca hops, allowing for just a splash of tropical fruit. Like the Seventh Sister of the Pleiades, this divine IPa sttraddle the gulf between heaven and earth to deliver a truly cosmic experience.

Name: Down The Road Queequeg’s Revenge IPA
Description: An exotic take on a New England IPA, this beer sails on a great swell of New Zealand hops as waves of lime, orange and floral spice crest and crash over the palate.

Name: Down The Road Wolfgeist
Description: Wolfgeist Dunkel Lager is a richly malted beer with deep notes of chocolate that drinks clean and finishes dry. Unlike a porter or stout, this dark beer has virtually no yeasty esters and the body is surprisingly uplifting and effervescent. An homage to the Feldgeist of German folklore, Wolfgeist is rooted in centuries of harvest festivals and traditional brewing methods. When the cold winds rise and heavy November rains lash against your windows, this is the beer to pour as you set spark to tinder and warm yourself by the hearth.

Name: Down The Road White Hart Helles Lager
Description: White Hart is our take on a traditional German Helles. Literally translating to “Light,” Helles is a straw-colored lager with clean maltiness, subtle hops and a refreshingly dry finish.  However, unlike traditional Helles, White Hart is brewed with Huell Melon hops to contribute a soft, fruity complexity that evokes honeydew melons and fresh strawberries! Cheers!

Name: Reuben’s Brews Crikey IPA
Description: The hope profile in this brew is led by notes of citrus, tangerine and tropical fruit with a little pine in the background. The malt backbone provides balance in every sip.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Hazealicious IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazealicious IPA is juicy, with a soft bitterness, providing a perfect balance for a hazy IPA. Tropical aromas, particularly kiwi and passionfruit, come from a bold blend of Citra, Strata, and Mosaic hops. The show-stopping hops are balanced and gently restrained by a pillowy malt body.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Robust Porter
Description:
Our Robust Porter is brewed with eight malts to make a roasty brew with
coffee and chocolate in the nose, balanced by complex caramel flavor
and a medium full, malty mouthfeel.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Razzmatazz Raspberry Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Berliner weiss-style beer fermented with raspberries. Crisp, refreshing, tart and balanced

Name: Reuben’s Brews Tart Cherry Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description:
A Berliner weiss-style beer fermented with tart cherries.
Crisp, refreshing, tart and balanced.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Seasonal IPA
Description: Every year we create a new IPA using unique hops, malts or processes we recently discovered. This is our chance to innovate with the “Bits & Bobs” that we are so excited about! It is an expression of the new and innovative IPA profiles we love.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Mind The Gap IPA
Description: Mind the Gap!® is a bright and crisp India Pale Ale brewed for PNW adventures. Highly drinkable, with big grapefruit and citrus hop flavors, and a refreshing finish.

Name: Reubens Brews Crikey Fresh Hop IPA
Description: Fresh Hop version of our Crikey IPA featuring fresh Simcoe hops from the Yakima Valley

Name: Reubens Bits And Bobs IPA
Description: EVERY SPRING WE CREATE A NEW BEER USING A VARIETY OF HOPS AT OUR DISPOSAL, THOSE "BITS & BOBS" WE HAVE AVAILABLE. EVERY YEAR A NEW HOP PROFILE FOR THE SEASON!

Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Reuben’s Hop Tropic IPA
Description: A light refreshing IPA with a medium-light mouthfeel and a nose of passionfruit, grapefruit, guava and tangerine.  The house IPA for Zeeks Pizza, Zeeks was one of our first ever customers when we opened back in 2012!  After years of support, and many months of R&D, Hop Tropic became reality.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Northsun Vienna Lager
Description: Classic Vienna Lager flavors of toasted, crusty bread with a light caramel sweetness. Crisp and easy drinking with a lovely aroma.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Pilsner
Description: OUR CZECH-STYLE PILSNER. A CLEAN, CRISP, AND BRIGHT LAGER WITH BREADY MALT NOTES AND SPICY TRADITIONAL HOPS.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Betonbier Pilsner
Description: Spicy and floral hops are supported by a bready, dry, crisp body, with slight minerality.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Southsun Mexican-style Lager
Description:
This thirst-quenching, light lager is balanced, drinkable, and very
refreshing. Vienna and Pilsner malts provide the light, smooth body,
and delicate Saaz hops pack just the right crisp flavor.

Name: Reuben’s Brews Autumn Harvest Imperial Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Soft, rich malt provides a showcase for pumpkin, supported by a subtle nuttiness. Spice notes compliment the rich, pumpkin mouthfeel. Perfect for the cold, crisp fall days.

Name: Idle Hands Galaxy Four Seam New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Take all that you know and love about our flagship NEIPA but swap the big Citra addition for a big Galaxy addition! Flavors of ripe oranges, pineapple, and melon on a pillowy and rounded body of malt.

Name: Idle Hands Blanche de Grace
Description: A Wit made in the traditional sense with unmalted wheat and spiced with citrus peel and coriander. Fermented with the Idle Hands house yeast in such a way as to add additional fruit complexity without the usual spiciness. This beer is unfiltered and cloudy as a hazy summer afternoon. The light tartness in the finish makes it the perfect beer to quench your thirst after a hard days work. ABOUT BLANCHE DE GRÂCE: Literally translated to “the white of Grace”, this beer has been a favorite of Grace’s from the time it was first homebrewed several years ago. Over the years, the spicing in the recipe has undergone constant refinement to the point where the spices now serve to compliment the soft, wheaty character of the malt instead of dominate it. As with many of our beers, we prefer to subtly tease you with the spices instead of bashing you over the head with them. We think you’ll find that these flavors add an interesting note that is both quick and refreshing – just as wit should be.

Name: Idle Hands d’Aison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Unsweetened Chocolate and light coffee notes combine w/ the familiar saison yeast spiciness. Dark malt flavors round out the pallet and finish with a light but dry roast character.

Name: Idle Hands Four Horsemen
Description: The 2014 Four Horsemen release contains plenty of dark fruit character which creates the foundation for flavors of citrus, gingerbread, and allspice to play on top.

Name: Idle Hands Croupier Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Idle Hands P-Funk
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Mixed fermentation farmhouse ale w/ peaches

Name: Idle Hands Transmutation I
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Delicate white grape, pineapple and floral aromas with flavors of white grape, crackers and star anise. First release of Funk Town 2018.

Name: Idle Hands Patriarch
Description: Brewed in the tradition of the original abbey table beers of Belgium; simple in its design but complex in its flavor. You'll find notes of stone fruit and a light spicy finish highlighting the unique character of our house yeast. The beer finishes with a grainy malt backbone and crisp edge.

Name: Idle Hands Kill Your Idles
Description:
Kill Your Idles is our rotating series of fruited sour beers. We construct each variation with a specific fruit character in mind and balance the acidity of the beer and fruit with lactose to create a beer that showcases both the flavor and aroma of the fruit without overpowering the beer itself.

Image is subject to change based on availability and current release.

Name: Idle Hands Crantastic
Description: A kettle soured ale loaded with flavors of cranberries and blood oranges.

Name: Idle Hands Check Raise American Stout
Idle Hands Double Crossroader
Description: Our original amplified American Stout turned up even higher with the addition of real maple syrup and aged on American toasted oak. A decadent ale with aromas of toasted coconut, maple, and fudge and flavors of burnt sugar, espresso and vanilla.

Name: Idle Hands Four Seam 1/6 Barrel
Description: Four Seam, our first year round IPA, conjures up thoughts of a tropical paradise with bursts of citrus, mango and guava that sit on top of a refrained malt backbone. Bitterness remains subdued to allow the true character of the hops to shine through while the cloudy appearance elevates the experience — a true New England IPA.

Name: Idle Hands Broktoberfest
Description: Our interpretation of the festival lagers served during Oktoberfest in Munich. These beers have become drier over the years with less caramel character, but our version retains the malt complexity for which the style is known. So whether you’re in Munich or not, you can still toast like a Bavarian, “Oans, zwoa, drei, g’suffa!”

Name: Idle Hands Brunhilda
Description: We’re thrilled to announce the release of Brunhilda, a Munich Dunkel and our first German lager! Brunhilda is filled with rich malty character (think bread crust and toast) with highlights of unsweetened chocolate AND a touch of cola nut.

Name: Idle Hands Edgeworth American Pilsner
Description: Edgeworth is a 4.8% ABV American hoppy pilsner designed to be an everyday, easy drinking, after work beer. Made with 100% American malt and hops, Edgeworth has a floral aroma with hints of citrus peel. Flavors of cracker, light lemon, and grapefruit lead to a clean, crisp finish.

Name: Idle Hands Klara
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: This beer screams traditional German and made me think “this is beer”. Klara is super smooth and buttery on the palette. It brings a grainy, bready flavor mixed with earthy hops.

Name: UFO White
Description: Light, crisp, refreshing UFO White follows in the tradition of spiced wheat beers that have been brewed in Belgium for well over 300 years. Brewed with orange peel and coriander, UFO White is the perfect choice for a summer’s barbecue, a night out with friends or any time you're thirsting for something a little different. Like all UFO beers, we leave UFO White UnFiltered.

Name: UFO Seasonal

Name: UFO Light Force
Description: The Light Force has arrived! Light in body but a force of flavor, this 94-calorie* white ale packs a refreshing punch of orange peel and coriander into a delightfully drinkable package.

Name: UFO Big Squeeze Grapefruit Shandy
Description: It's back! In 2014, we released our first UFO summer seasonal. In 2016, we retired it. And the people spoke. Loudly. And started a Facebook campaign to bring it back. Well, we are. But this time, it's full time.

Name: UFO Pumpkin
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Imagine a pumpkin vine wound its way in a field of barley, and a brewer harvested it all to make a beer. Add Northwestern hops and a blend of spices, and you've got UFO Pumpkin. The malt combination provides a smooth body and slightly sweet flavor, which balances perfectly with the earthy notes derived from the pure pumpkin. And like all of our UFO beers, UFO Pumpkin is unfiltered so all the wonderful flavors are right there in your glass. Cheers!

Name: UFO Winter Blonde
Description: Have you ever tasted a light wheat beer that tastes like vanilla coffee? We hadn’t either until our brewers made this delicious little treat. Made with vanilla cold brew from a local partner, you won’t believe how light and refreshing this beer is for your next holiday jingle!

Name: UFO Maine Blueberry
Description: Our signature blueberry beer. Refreshing with the right touch of sweetness, this easy-drinking and flavorful hefeweizen will make you think you picked this beer right off a blueberry bush.

Name: UFO Georgia Peach
Description:
Refreshing with the right touch of sweetness, this easy-drinking and flavorful hefeweizen was first brewed for our friends in Georgia. We’re happy to bring this fresh-from-the-tree flavor to all!

Raspberry has a distinctive, hazy rose color. The scent of fresh raspberries hits the nose immediately, along with a subtle bready aroma from the wheat and yeast. There is a faint sweetness on the palate, which finishes cleanly in a semi-dry, tart finish.

Description: Invited to brew in the US I wanted to use local ingredients. Agamemnon is an Imperial Stout brewed with maple syrup. Boiled 7 hours.

Name: Omnipollo Yellow Belly Imperial Stout
Description: This beer is a collaborative effort together with our good friends – and world class brewers – at Buxton Brewery (UK).  Yellow Belly — a person who is without courage, fortitude, or nerve; a coward.  To us, one of the most cowardly deeds is to act anonymously, hiding behind a group. A signifying trait of institutionalised racism.  This beer is brewed to celebrate all things new, open minded and progressive. A peanut butter biscuit stout with no biscuits, butter or nuts. Taste, enjoy, and don’t be prejudiced. Brewed with aromas.

Name: Omnipollo Symzonia Imperial Stout
Description: It was cold so we decided to go with an Imperial Stout conditioned on Ethiopian coffe, Madagascan vanilla beans, Brazilian cocoa nibs & carefully weighed cinnamon sticks.

Name: Omnipollo Mackaper
Description: We love the subtle sensation of comfort that a good usage of grains render. This pale ale is built from equal parts malt, wheat and oats. Hopped profoundly with Mosaic and Galaxy hops, it aims to bring you a fruity yet layered experience.

Name: Omnipollo Aurora IPA
Description: The wort of this beer looks radio active. Pale, wheaty and green tinted from a pos boil hop burst. After a short and efficient fermentation we dry-hop it as many times as it takes and carbonate it softly. We love brewing beer, thinking about beer, dreaming about beer, talking about beer, breathing beer, changing beer, exchanging beer etc. Chill it perfectly and crush it deductively

Name: Omnipollo Devin The Dude’s Brew
Description:
Inspirations for our beers come from everywhere. Sometimes it’s like the universe is telling us there needs to be a beer. It sounds pretentious and, in a way, it is… But with the release of this Omnipollo® German style pilsner we are in the center of a vortex of incidences telling us that all we want to drink is a truly well-crafted pilsner.

My own pilsner journey started long ago, and pilsner is still my favorite style of beer, but it totally seems like the right time to celebrate this style. The signs are there. Like when your favorite rapper doesn’t enjoy the IPA you had planned to brew in his honor, saying “none of that fruity stuff”. Or the fact that for the last couple of years, all brewers at festivals will not be found drinking the latest hype brew, but instead gathering at the tap of whoever brought a classic pilsner.

A pils is sort of like your favorite t-shirt, you wear it often, but it is never a loud statement. So we raise our (pilsner) glass to you, and hope you will enjoy Devins German style pilsner and the rest of our pilsner journey. Be curious, be classic.

Name: Westbrook White Thai
Description: Classic Belgian Witbier style. Instead of the traditional coriander and orange peel spicing regimen, we add fresh lemongrass, ginger root, and a dash of Sorachi Ace hops. The result is a wonderfully refreshing ale with notes of lemon candy, citrus fruit, and a slight spiciness from the ginger.

Name: Westbrook / Stillwater Big Tasty’s Back Door
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: For our remix of Stillwater’s Cellar Door, we wanted to expand on the cleansing aspect of the white sage used in the original beer, so we added a number of herbs and spices known for their therapeutic properties. Brett Brux is added at bottling for a funky complexity that will develop over time.

Name: Westbrook Gose
Description: This is our interpretation of Gose (pronounced “Gose-uh”), a traditional German-style sour wheat beer brewed with coriander and salt. Once nearly extinct, this very refreshing style is making a comeback.

Name: Westbrook Brewers Tan
Description: A tropical creme-pie style gose brewed with pineapple, coconut, pistachios, cinnamon, vanilla, and milk sugar. Collaboration with LIC Beer Project.

Name: Westbrook Tiki Time Sour
Description: Get your freaky tiki on with this tropical spiced pineapple, passionfruit, and guava smoothie sour. IT IS TIME TO TIKI.

Name: Westbrook Mexican Cake Imperial Stout
Description: Happy birthday to us! To celebrate our first year as a brewery we brewed a serious imperial stout and aged it on cocoa nibs, vanilla beans, cinnamon sticks, and fresh habanero peppers. This was the first offering in our annual Anniversary series. It was so delicious we decided to bring it back each May!

Name: Westbrook Gates Of S’Mordor
Description: This s’mores-inspired imperial stout is brewed with marshmallows, cocoa nibs, cinnamon, and graham crackers.

Name: Westbrook 9th Anniversary Peanut Butter & Chocolate Stout
Description: For our 9th anniversary beer we drew inspiration from that classic confection – the peanut butter cup. Rich chocolate and nutty, roasty peanut butter make this beer a rich and rewarding amusement. Released December 2019.

Name: Westbrook Velvet Tuxedo
Description: Blend of the base recipes for 3 Sons Summation and Westbrook Mexican Cake. Aged 22 months in Napa cabernet barrels and finished on cocoa nibs and dried tart cherries.

Name: Westbrook IPA
Description: A base of pale, Munich, and Carapils malts is just enough to contain the massive hop flavor and aroma packed into this highly drinkable IPA. A blend of four American hop varieties is added four times in the kettle and twice in the fermenter for a complex and layered hop experience. Best served at 45-50?F in a tulip or English style pint glass.

Name: Westbrook Citrus Redacted IPA
Description: This beer combines three of our favorite things: juicy fresh-squeezed hops, zesty and bright citrus fruits, and a name that doesn’t make any sense unless you know the story behind it. Enjoy!

Name: Westbrook Orange Creamsicle Shake IPA
Description: Hazy milkshake IPA with orange, lactose and vanilla.

Name: Westbrook Table Beer

Dry-hopping adds a hop accent to the nose, while cold fermentation with a a classic Czech lager yeast emphasizes the fresh grainy flavor of the malt and spiciness of the kettle hops. This beer provides plenty of flavor and nuance to be enjoyed on its own, but is also simple enough to get out of the way when food and/or conversation is the focus. We could drink it everyday!

Name: Threes People Power Plisner
Description: Threes brewery-led grassroots efforts invited fellow brewers around the country to all launch their own version of a beer called People Power and donate 10% of sales of that beer to the American Civil Liberties Union. After reaching out to a wide swath of breweries around the country, 75+ breweries representing over 25 states signed on, including many high profile names in craft beer.

Name: Half Acre Daisy Cutter Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Half Acre Daisy Cutter Pale Ale  Daisy Cutter Pale Ale - A west coast Pale Ale chock-full of dank, aromatic hops. This one's a screamer, hoard it. 5.2% ABV.

Name: Half Acre Tome Hazy Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A new addition to our year round lineup and a friendly business partner at 5.5% abv. We've been developing versions of this beer for a while. You can find an intersection somewhere between “On The Lawn ~ Smoking Gull ~ Tasty Waves ~ Smoking Daisy.” Its final compounds POP with Citra, Mosaic, Idaho 7 and Centennial, but it’s still tangled up in the horns of original pale ale – a sweet and creamy core. This bond, all held high by yeast’s haze darling, London 3. Another arch in the Half Acre ROYGBIV system.

Description: Imperial IPA, a doubling of our house IPA, Space. A chasm of pits and peaks, swollen with caramel and sap. The water is chummed, here come the sharks.

Name: Half Acre Logue DIPA
Description: A focus on two of our favorite hops in 2019: Cashmere and Sabro. Severe island vibe peach sap and melting pineapple starburst.

Name: Half Acre Galactic Double Daisy Cutter
Description: Double Pale Ale. Brewed just once a year, this beer takes everything we love about Double Daisy Cutter and skins it with the tropical impact of Galaxy hops. Typically available in May. 8% ABV

Name: Half Acre Wand Double IPA
Description: Brewed to hum, targeting resin and blazing forest fruits, we used our house 2-row, Vienna, malted oats and malted wheat alongside Simcoe, Amarillo and Mosaic hops for expressive mango, citrus and peach qualities with a stabilizing dankness.

Name: Half Acre Beer Hates Astronauts
Description: India Pale Ale. A callaboratory brew with graphic novel genius Ryan Browne - stripped down to nothing but Citra hops and Vienna malt, this brew is likely to move you crooked. Typically available early summer. 7.5% ABV

Name: Half Acre Burl
Description: A seasonal stepping stone from Crocus DIPA and spring’s ability to push decay into a new life, Burl brings Fall and everyone’s interest in gathering warmth. A combination of two transformative yeast strains and an art piece double dry hop featuring Simcoe, Mosaic Cryo, Citra, and 2019 Nelson places Burl into the softcore ~ big and pungent with Half Acre's bitterness and drinkability.

Name: Half Acre Classic Future
Description: Whirlpool additions of Amarillo Cryo and Mosaic were followed up by a double dry hop of Citra, Mosaic Cryo, Amarillo Cryo and an experimental strain that puts out an aromatic profile like the exhaust fan at your local, earth-friend smoothie joint. Some classic bitterness keeps this beer tethered to history, but it pumps out and into pulp-scape.

Name: Half Acre Pony Pilsner
Description: Half Acre Pony Pilsner  Pony Pilsner is a firm take on the classic German style aimed to quench the masses.  German hops and malts are braided together to release the crisp awakening your summer self needs.  5.8% ABV

Name: Half Acre Fader Lager
Description:
Fader Lager recently joined our year-round line-up.

Fader has a lot of champions inside our brewery. Background beers, brewers love background beers. Clean, fresh, uncomplicated beers of integrity that tether you to a place without clawing for attention. Fader is Premium Lager Beer. No need to discuss it.

Name: Half Acre Beer Company Lager
Description: Half Acre Lager was the first beer released by Half Acre Beer Co. The Lager will hold a special spot in the history or Half Acre Beer Co, but we moved on. You never know, though.

Name: Foolproof Irish Rhode
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: An imperial Irish red ale aged in Jameson® Irish Whiskey casks, Irish Rhode is bursting with complex malt and whiskey notes, backed by a beautiful dark crimson hue and a full body. This barrel-aged beer is one of a kind and celebrates the friendship and camaraderie of these two Irish and Rhode Island Drinking Buddies.

Name: Foolproof Barstool Golden Ale
Description: You’re bellied up to the bar with your buddies at the local watering hole... Not too malty, not too hoppy, Barstool is designed for a night out with your friends. Our flagship beer is handcrafted with the freshest ingredients, including two-row barley and specialty malts. A blend of English and Czech hops top off this delicious golden ale, which can be enjoyed for hours on end.

Name: Foolproof Raincloud Robust Porter
Description: Raincloud is the perfect “stay at home” brew. Dark, smooth, mysterious—this rich and flavorful porter is brewed with chocolate and crystal malts and a subtle blend of European hops. Raincloud is the ideal accompaniment for a lazy day of movie watching or reading.

Name: Foolproof Peanut Butter Raincloud
Description: Sometimes the rain can drive you nuts, so you might as well have some in your beer. With that, we are proud to introduce Peanut Butter Raincloud, a unique and flavorful adaptation of our popular Raincloud robust porter. Raise a glass to the miracle that is peanut butter porter.

Name: Foolproof La Ferme Urbaine
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This eight-percent farmhouse ale tastes like it was just air-dropped from Belgium, but it's actually from a two-year old brewery in Pawtucket. The brewers at Foolproof use a complex grain bill with barley, wheat, rye, oats, and spelt. And while we can't tell you what exactly the spelt flavor is, it works. A bright spice from the yeast and rich malt flavor are set off by biting herbal hops in this fantastic saison.

Name: Foolproof Tatou Rosé Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Foolproof Vango – Pineapple Sour
Description: What is Vango? It’s your undiscovered adventure. A future memory, journey, or story yet to be told. Brewed with light malts and dry-hopped with Mosaic hops, this kettle sour ale is suitable for any occasion. The beer delivers a thirst–quenching tanginess that is refreshing yet complex.

Name: Foolproof Revery
Description: We put together an insane malt bill for Revery – two row, Maris Otter, Crystal 40, Carafa, roasted barley, chocolate malt, and flaked oats combine to make Revery incredibly smooth and rich while boasting a high alcohol content. A delicate blend of Northern Brewer, Tettnanger, and Hallertau hops round out this masterpiece.

Name: Foolproof Shuckolate
Description: Foolproof SHUCKOLATE (6% ABV)    Style: Chocolate-Oyster Stout  Experience: Best enjoyed with somebody special...  Shuckolate is our first collaborative beer. We’ve partnered with local food artisans, Walrus & Carpenter Oysters and Garrison Chocolates. This limited-release stout incorporates two natural aphrodisiacs that lend a creamy silk mouthfeel, slight brininess, and chocolate flavors and aromatics.

Name: Foolproof King Of The Yahd IPA
Description: King of the Yahd is the royal big brother of our beloved Backyahd IPA. The King’s got a big malt backbone – piles of pilsner, maris otter, rye, and spelt – topped off with a mighty crown of hops. King blends a selection of rare American and New Zealand hops in 11 individual additions.

Name: Foolproof The Depths Double IPA
Description: A sibling of The Grotto IPA, this double India pale ale showcases the aggressive aromatics and bold flavors yielded from fresh lupulin powder, added in healthy doses throughout the brewing process. This 8% ABV treasure is backed by a healthy grain bill featuring a selection of soft, light malts.

Name: Foolproof Grotto IPA
Description: We all have a Grotto – a hidden wonderland where we retreat in selfish self-discovery to reflect and bask in life’s simpler pleasures. Here’s a beer for that private indulgent experience. The Grotto IPA boasts juicy flavors and aromas straight out of a tropical paradise – fruity American hops complement a smooth, light body.

Name: Foolproof Backyahd IPA
Description: Guaranteed to deliver an unspoken zen with a spatula in your other hand...  The ultimate suburban brew, Backyahd is an aggressively hopped American IPA with a tantalizing hop aroma. The beer’s bitterness pairs perfectly with spicy foods coming straight off the grill. Enjoy it with friends, family, or whomever you choose. After all, it’s your Backyahd.

Name: Foolproof Queen of the Yahd Raspberry IPA
Description: IPA aged on raspberries and dry hopped with Cascade hops

Name: Foolproof Augtoberfest
Description: This festbier is a celebration of Foolproof’s annual Augtoberfest festival, which we host at our brewery in Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Augtoberfest is brewed with caramel and Munich malt as well as American hops and is fermented cool to produce a clean, refreshing flavor. Prost!

Name: Foolproof Ocean State Lager
Description: This bold, crisp lager is brewed in homage to the great state of Rhode Island. With an extended cold fermentation, we’ve taken careful consideration to preserve the beer’s delicate nature. Ocean State Lager has a soft and subtle malt profile balanced with a refreshing hop flavor.

Name: Shock Top Belgian White
Description: This spiced Belgian-style wheat ale is the pinnacle of refreshment brewed with real orange, lemon and lime peels for a smooth, citrusy finish. The beer that’s always down to chill — and be chilled.

Name: Shock Top Lemon Shandy
Description: Sun’s out, lemons out. Always smooth, always refreshing — this crisp lemon recipe was designed for summer. Just like the season, you won’t want it to end. Available May-September.

Name: Shock Top Honeycrisp Apple Wheat
Description: Shock Top Honeycrisp Apple Wheat is a unique  hand crafted brewed hybrid of Belgian wheat beer and sweet cider  with natural Honeycrisp flavor added to produce an innovative new brew that is crisp  refreshing and flavorful. This unfiltered brew is the perfect beer to welcome the warming Spring days.

Name: Shock Top Hefeweizen
Description: We’ve shaken up traditional tastes by brewing a spiced Belgian-style wheat ale with real orange, lemon and lime peels,and then added a little coriander spice to the mix. This uniquely-crafted and award-winning ale is unfiltered to create a brew that is naturally cloudy with a light golden color and a smooth, refreshing finish.

Name: Shock Top Raspberry Wheat
Description: Belgian Style wheat ale brewed with spices with natural raspberry flavor added

Name: Shock Top Honey Bourbon Cask Wheat
Description: Shock Top’s newest edition is Honey Bourbon Cask Wheat. This Belgian-Style unfiltered wheat ale is brewed with honey, caramel malt, and aged on bourbon cask staves for the perfect balance of flavor and refreshment all year round
