Name: Upslope Craft Lager
Description: Our Craft Lager is a premium American lager brewed entirely of malted barley.  Snowmelt-infused and river-ready, this Colorado-style session beer stands side-by-side with our family of premium ales to bring you a clean, easy, light-bodied lager for the ages.

Name: Upslope IPA
Description: Our India Pale Ale will appeal to the beer enthusiast who desires a bold, deep and bitter ale. With a coppery color indicative of a traditional IPA, Upslope India Pale Ale has a complex malty character and is more well-balanced than most IPAs, but still offers that bitterness that IPA lovers seek.  Complex malty character meets the bitter side.

Name: Upslope Citra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Prominently featuring Citra hops, our Citra Pale Ale delivers pungent grapefruit and tropical fruit aromas on the nose with a semi-dry finish. Juicy notes imparted by the hops pair with the light caramel malt character to balance this drinkable, “go-to” American Pale Ale.

Name: Upslope Pumpkin Ale
Description: Seasonal offering from Upslope.

Name: Upslope Rocky Mountain Kolsch
Description: Layered in flavors inspired by the backcountry, our Rocky Mountain Kölsch merges the easy-drinking character of traditional Kölsch yeast with our innovative spin. Colorado honey, sage and Mosaic and Lemondrop hops create a bright, lemon citrus character with a touch of hops.

Name: Upslope Belgian Style Blonde with Guava
Description: This sessionable Belgian Style Blonde Ale is brewed with guava puree, premium pilsner malt, white wheat and East Kent Golding hops. At a modest 4% abv, it’s bright, crisp and light bodied-an effortless sipper with a tropical touch.

Name: Upslope Pale Ale
Description: This clear, crisp, dry Pale Ale is our signature beer–the one that started it all!  It’s refreshing characteristics, and signature dry finish, blend smooth malt flavors with a unique spicy hop bitterness.  Sure to be the “go-to” beer on any camping trip, fishing excursion or music festival.

Upslope Foreign Style Stout
Description: Pours a dark, coffee black with reasonable head. Aromas of chocolate fudge with a bit of coffee. Semi-sweet toasted taste with a very subtle hop tang. Coffee notes gradually dissipate thru the finish.

Name: Urban Chestnut Schnickelfritz Weissbier Ale
Description: The unmistakable characteristics of this Bavarian Weissbier are achieved with a yeast that is decidedly fruity and phenolic.  You may note clove, nutmeg or even vanilla and banana-like aromas and flavors.

Name: Urban Chestnut Zwickel
Description: Our flagship lager, pronounced ‘tzv-ick-el’, is an unfiltered, unpasteurized German classic that finishes as a smooth-drinking, vitamin rich (from the yeast), naturally cloudy bier.

Name: Urban Chestnut Harwood Myth English Brown Porter
Description: This English-style, brown porter has a nicely rounded, roasted malt flavor. You may detect some cocoa and /or caramel surrounding the bitterness on the sides of your tongue.

Name: Urban Chestnut Wing Nut
Description: We affectionately refer to the first beer in our Revolution series of modern, American craft beer, as our unusual little bird. It’s a little on the flighty side @ 5.4% ABV, and it’s a little on the wacky side because we brew it with finely milled chestnuts (genus castanea …for you nut freaks), Willamette hops, and we ferment it with a Bavarian Weissbier yeast strain. All of these nuances contribute to its ‘nutty’ personality.

Name: Urban Chestnut Erlkonig Double Pale Wheat Bock Ale
Description: Pale Wheat Doppelbock - This Maifest special is sweet, soothing, and a deceptive delight. So much so that it may deceive thy sight. Should you start to see visions of Elf King fame, heed the warnings from where this beer gets its name. Spelled out clearly in the Goethe poem...Hold on tight to a loved one and head for home.

Name: Urban Chestnut Schnickelfritz 1/2 Barrel

Name: Urban Chestnut Apotheosis Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This French-style Saison was first brewed in collaboration with the fine folks at The Royale to celebrate the Feast Day of Louis IX. Named after the statue of St. Louis that sits atop Art Hill, this farmhouse ale is a tribute to our beloved city.

Name: Urban Chestnut Moon Monkey
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Urban Chestnut Ku’damm
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Urban Chestnut Fantasyland West Coast IPA
Description: Fantasyland – Noun; a place or circumstance existing only in the imagination or as an ideal; dream world. Origin – Midwest “Coast” of the United States. Need we say more?!

Name: Urban Chestnut STLIPA Double IPA
Description: We pronounce it “sta-leep-ah”; you pronounce it how you like. STLIPA, which is the acronym for St. Louis India Pale Ale, is actually a DIPA (Double or Imperial IPA, double the stats of a traditional IPA). We hope it’s a “sleepe” that you’ll include in your set of favorite DIPA’s from one of the best beer cities in the world St. Louis. Hops- Sterling, Cascade, Mt. Hood, Willamette, Chinook.

Name: Urban Chestnut Hopfen Bavarian IPA
Description: A beer we are describing as a ‘Bavarian IPA’. Brewed and dry-hopped with a variety of Hallertau ‘hopfen’… instead of the usual and more citric hop varieties of most American IPA’s… gives this beer a decidedly German twist.

Name: Urban Chestnut Stammtisch
Description: Stammtisch is an informal group meeting held on a regular basis – more directly translating to ‘table for regulars’. Our Stammtisch was brewed to celebrate this idea of community and socializing.  It’s a traditional German pilsner featuring a blend of Hallertau and Strisselspalt hops, and we think it’s the perfect accompaniment to any friendly gathering.  Help us make it a ‘regular’ around here!

Name: Urban Chestnut Oachkatzlshwoaf Octoberfest Lager
Description: This “export” style lager, brewed for our annual Oktoberfest celebration, is malty yet well balanced like the bier traditionally served at Oktoberfest in Munich. However, our Festbier has a tale/tail of its own–Oachkatzlschwoaf (pronounced “oh-khut-zel-schvoaf”) translated is “tail of a squirrel”…just a little Bavarian humor.

Name: Urban Chestnut Erlkonig Double Pale Wheat Bock Ale
Description: Pale Wheat Doppelbock - This Maifest special is sweet, soothing, and a deceptive delight. So much so that it may deceive thy sight. Should you start to see visions of Elf King fame, heed the warnings from where this beer gets its name. Spelled out clearly in the Goethe poem...Hold on tight to a loved one and head for home.

Name: Urban Chestnut Count Orlok Pumpkin Ale
Description: Nosferatu (Bird of Death) a.k.a. Count Orlok was THE German Count Dracula. He was a blood-sucking vampire, but being German he must’ve enjoyed beer too, right? We believe it is so and thus have created a Black Pumpkin Wheat Ale in his honor...a ’beer noir’ if you will.

Name: Urban Chestnut Wolpertinger Anniversary Ale
Description:
Wolpertinger 2015 – HO! We have a sighting of the Bavarian Beast, and his 2015 description becomes even more mysterious. He’s rumored to be a bit cagier than in year’s past; he’s been fermented once with a Weissbier yeast and then a second time with a Belgian Trappist strain. All while being ‘trapped’ in French red wine and Spanish sherry barrels. And to top it off, he’s said to be brewed with a bit of sweet honey!

The legend continues… Prost!

Name: Hopewell Do Tell Dunkelweizen
Description: Do Tell is a Dunkelweizen that draws its inspiration from those made in the historic brewing region of Bavaria. Dark malts and weizen yeast combine for notes of banana bread, caramel and spice, while a large dose of wheat offers a creamy, fluffy body to back it all up.

Name: Hopewell Ride or Die
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Ride or Die is a Pale Ale you can depend on—a bona fide fridge staple. Bright neon flavors of grapefruit and pine give way to a pleasantly soft malt base and a quick slice of balancing bitterness. Reliably tasty without a fuss.

Name: Hopewell Table Salt Gose
Description: A Gose-style Sour Ale brewed with French grey sea salt, lemongrass, lime leaf and cardamom. Vibrant and punchy with huge lemon-lime aroma, followed by a gentle tartness and a touch of salinity on the finish. Incredibly refreshing and easy-going.

Name: Hopewell Ya Filthy Animal
Description: Inspired by our favorite mulled holiday drinks, Ya Filthy Animal is a Sour Red Ale brewed with spices, black currants and plums. Festive and fruity with a tart, warming finish. Keep the change.

Name: Hopewell Arrow of Time
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Arrow of Time is a series of oak-aged wild ales blended from the best barrels our stock has to offer. Every blend is different, but each represents the best expression of our barrels at that moment in time.

Name: Hopewell Deluxe Vanilla Chocolate Stout
Description: Vanilla Deluxe is an Imperial Stout brewed with barrel-aged chocolate malt, cacao nibs and vanilla. This decadent dessert beer is packed with notes of rich fudge, dark chocolate and creamy vanilla, making for an ideal post-dinner sipper to send off the night.

Name: Hopewell Deluxe Chocolate Stout
Description: Deluxe is an Imperial Stout brewed with barrel-aged chocolate malt and cacao nibs. This lush, decadent beer is packed with notes of rich fudge, dark chocolate and fresh espresso, making for an ideal post-dinner sipper to send off the night.

Name: Hopewell Going Places
Description: Going Places is an IPA for those on the up-and-up. A vibrant combo of new-wave hops offers fresh citrus, tropical fruit and sticky pine with a prickly finish, putting this hoppy bev on the path ahead. Let's get it.

Name: Hopewell Lightbeam
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Lightbeam is a Hazy IPA that radiates the full spectrum of modern hop eccentricities. An initial burst swells with the essence of ripe mango, papaya and apricot, while reverberant threads of green grass and prickly pine tether its final form. Here's to a bright spot.

Name: Layup
Description: Layup is a Double Dry-hopped Double IPA brewed with Citra and El Dorado hops. This silky smooth, super hopped-up number is laced with notes of candied citrus, pineapple, lime peel and pine. An easy score.

Name: Hopewell Vis-à-Vis
Description: Vis-à-Vis is a Double Dry-hopped IPA brewed with Strata and Meridian hops, presenting a citrus orchard’s wide array of vibrant aromas and flavors. Added notes of dank pine, tropical fruit and berry help flesh out its final form, making for a modern IPA with the comforts of a classic.

Name: Hopewell Tiny Waves
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Tiny Waves is a Hazy IPA brewed with Rakau, Wai-iti and Nelson Sauvin hops. This trio of New Zealand varietals combines for a vibrant sensory experience of fresh peach, passionfruit, lime peel and white grape skin, finishing soft and easy with a mellow bitterness and clean malt character.

Name: Hopewell Foeder Bock
Description: This Doppelbock was conditioned in a large oak vessel known as a foeder. Rich, full-bodied and malty, balanced by a touch of drying oak character and a clean lager finish.

Name: Hopewell Stay Frosty
Description: Stay Frosty is a Winter Lager that stands up to the frigid temps that come with the season. Full-bodied and malty with a pronounced nuttiness and slight caramel sweetness, plus a hint of noble hop spiciness to keep it easy on the palate. Cozy up.

Name: Hopewell Codified Dunkel
Description: Codified is a Dunkel Lager that is distinctly malt-forward, yet clean and easy-drinking. Expect notes of caramel, chocolate and freshly baked bread, but a dry finish for continued enjoyment.

Name: Hopewell First Pils
Description: The first beer ever brewed by Hopewell and, fittingly, the one we reach for most often. A Pilsner-style Lager with a bready malt profile and a snappy noble hop finish. Tastes great anytime — but best with friends.

Name: Hopewell Dear Diary
Description: Dear Diary is a Double Dry-hopped Lager featuring Nelson Sauvin and Centennial hops. A clean lager base meets an alluring profile of papaya, kiwi and white grape, made complete with a dry, weightless finish. Worth an entry.

Name: Hopewell Erde German Style Pils
Description: Erde is a German-style Pilsner that takes cues from various interpretations seen across the country. A crisp malt character meets a delicate-yet-assertive noble hop presence, striking a quaffable balance that is the hallmark of the style.

Name: Oxbow Farmhouse Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: FPA is a farmhouse ale brewed exclusively with American-grown hops.

Name: Oxbow Surfcasting Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description:
Farmhouse ale with sea salt and lime. 

Surfcasting is a gently salted grisette brewed with American hops, wheat, and limes.

Name: Oxbow Barrel Aged Farmhouse Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A farmhouse ale fermented in stainless steel and aged in oak barrels with Brettanomyces.

Name: Oxbow Brewing Dance Language
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Dance language is a saison de miel brewed with single-source Maine honey.

Name: Oxbow Momoko
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Momoko is a blend of freshly pressed peaches and mature barrel-aged farmhouse ales

Name: Oxbow Saison Rosé
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Saison Rose is a mixed-fermentation farmhouse ale fermented with Pinot Noir grapes and aged on estate-grown cherries, strawberries, and raspberries.

Name: Oxbow Catalyst
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Catalyst is a barrel-aged Bière de Miel featuring Maine honey. A copious amount of raw wildflower honey is added in the kettle and additionally utilized for bottle-conditioning.

Name: Oxbow Low Bush
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Low Bush is a barrel-aged farmhouse ale brewed with Maine-grown wild lowbush blueberries.

Name: Oxbow Brewing Cherry Jackpot
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Cherry Jackpot is a mixed-fermentation farmhouse ale fermented and aged in American oak barrels with Montmorency cherry juice. Produced in collaboration with Will Sears of Oxbow, Keith Shore of Mikkeller, Mike Van Hall of Stillwater Artisanal, and Karl Grandin of Omnipollo.

Name: Oxbow Kahn
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Adjunct saison brewed with Maine-grown fresh corn, flaked corn, and polenta.

Name: Oxbow Harvest Wet Hopped Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Oxbow Paloma Daydream Farmhouse Ale With Grapefruit
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Oxbow Arboreal Sour Ale
Description: An American Sour Ale, fermented in bourbon barrels with Brettanomyces and Lactobacillus. Aged for six months in oak.

Name: Oxbow Brewing Abrico
Description: Stainless-aged farmhouse ale with apricots.

Name: Oxbow Max Tun
Description: A Belgian-style imperial stout aged in rye whiskey barrels. Produced in collaboration with Brad Clark formerly of Jackie O’s Brewery of Athens, Ohio.

Name: Oxbow Infinite Darkness
Description: Infinite Darkness is a Belgian-style imperial stout brewed with European malts and fermented with a blend of Trappist and farmhouse yeast.

Name: Oxbow Seaworthy
Categories: India Pale Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: Seaworthy is a pale lager dry-hopped with Centennial and Amarillo hops.

Name: Widowmaker Blender Ender Sour
Description: Blender Ender is smooth and juicy and is our most fruit forward sour to date. Huge additions of strawberry, blackberry, blueberry and raspberry plus a touch of vanilla and lactose make this beer a perfectly sweet and sour delight.

Name: Widowmaker Virtual Zoology Fruited Sour
Description: Virtual Zoology, a Fruited Sour Ale featuring blueberry, raspberry, granola, vanilla, and touch of lactose, is ripe for the picking starting this Friday! We could not be more excited to develop and brew this beer with our Florida friends at Tripping Animals Brewing.

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Bastards In A Basket Sour
Description:
Ladies and gentlemen, ladies and gentlemen, thank you so much for visiting with us this evening. Now I've traveled across half our state to be here and to see about this sour. Now I daresay some of you might have heard some of the more extravagant rumors about what my plans are, so I just thought you'd like to hear it from me. This is the face -- it's no great mystery.

I'm a Peanut Butter and Jelly man, ladies and gentlemen.

Name: Widowmaker Reace & Desist With Marshmallow
Description: We took one of our favorites and turned it up to 11! Out beloved peanut butter stout has to get a new name, but we figured why not give it a king size goodbye?! Reace and Desist comes in at 10.2% abv and is smooth, creamy, and packed with peanut butter and marshmallow flavor. (Don't worry! Our normal peanut butter stout will be back soon with a new name!)

Name: Widowmaker Braintree Split Stout
Description: Braintree split- A collaboration with Foleys Ice Cream. We linked up with our favorite hometown ice cream shoppe to create something pretty sweet! We started with a huge grist bill consisting of all our favorite dark malts, a good helping of oats and an addition of homeade waffle cones from Foleyâs. We conditioned this massive beer on over 800 lbs of strawberry and banana puree, a huge dose of cocoa nibs, over 100 lbs of marshmallow fluff and madagascar vanilla beans. Pairs well with rainbow sprinkles and a cherry on top.

Name: Widowmaker Brewing There’s No Wrong Way with Marshmallow
Description: Peanut Butter Stout with Marshmallow. We decided to have some fun with our award winning TNWW PB stout. There's marshmallow in it. A lot of marshmallow. Period.

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Blue Comet
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Blue Comet is packed with Simcoe and Comet hops providing a ripe, tropical fruit nose that is backed up in the taste. Complimented by a soft, biscuity, malt character. Pours a hazy yellow with medium,white head.

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Drowning In The Drip
Description: Drowning in Drip features our house IPA yeast, a combination of Citra, Mosaic and Azacca hops, and a healthy dose of tangerines which all have this beer exploding with fresh citrus goodness.

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Triple Ecstasy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: With a new brew house on the horizon and our time with our original brew house coming to an end we decided to push it to the limit one last time. We figured there is no beer we have brewed more than Ecstasy of Gold in our 2+ year since we opened, lets go big with it! We maxed out in every way we could imagine and in turn what we have is a massively textured full bodied Triple IPA that is jam packed with flavor and true to Ecstasy of Gold we find it to be refined and balanced!

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Ecstasy Of Gold
Description: Cloudy, light-copper coloring and a pungent fruit aroma when poured. A balanced fruit taste with a sweet, malty backbone.

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Quarry Juice DIPA
Description: Generously dry-hopped with Citra and Apollo, Quarry juice is big, bold and busting with hoppy fruit flavors. Subtle nuanced sweetness and a soft mouthfeel round out this easy drinking DIPA.

Name: Widowmaker 50 Year Storm
Description: Vaya con Dios! 50-Year Storm pours a hazy gold with a thick white head. A well-balanced beer with floral notes upfront and a grapefruit finish. Australian hops and 100% pure adrenaline.

Name: Widowmaker Nothin’ But A Dog Thang DIPA
Description: If you’ve been to our tap room you know we love dogs, if you have ever by the brewery when we are closed you know we love our dogs! We brought in Chase, Harley, Lucie, Otis, & Wallace, our best four legged friends, to brew up what we consider our cutest collaboration beer to date! Hopped with Galaxy, Rakau, & Strata and loaded with oats, this beer will have you wagging your tail and begging for more!

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Sstainless
Description: Sstainless 003 is the third release in our rotating IPA series!  With this series we truly hope to push the limits of our brewhouse and our own processes.  With this batch we wanted to experiment with quantities. The brew day consisted of our largest grist to date, as well as our largest kettle charge and whirpool additions.  In fermentation we adjusted pitch and dry hop rates and timelines, varying from our standard dry-hopping process.The different varieties were added to this hopped out IPA: Citra, Michigan Chinook, Mosaic.

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Honeymaker
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Honeymaker is an Imperial NEIPA packed with Citra, Comet, Azacca, and Idaho 7 hops providing a citrusy tropical fruit nose that is complimented by a round softness and delicate sweetness in the finish.  Honeymaker was brewed in collaboration with the women of Widowmaker while utilizing locally sourced honey harvested by our very own Marissa Dyckman (Widowmaker Bartender & member of Plymouth Country Beekeepers Association).

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Dry Wall Puree IPA
Description: Dry Wall Puree’ is loaded with Simcoe & Chinook hops. Big tropical notes on the nose and a juicy blast on the palate with a soft creamy mouthfeel. A lot of flavor packed into a crushable 6.2% IPA!

Name: Widowmaker Brewing Widowlager Pilsner
Description: A traditionally brewed German-style Pilsner. An effervescent lager that is light and crisp. Pouring a light, golden, straw color with tasting notes of toasted bread and cracker.

Name: Palm Bay Raspberry Starfruit Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives

Name: Palm Bay Strawberry Pineapple
Description: Pale pink, strawberry and pineapple aromas; gentle fizz, strawberry and pinapple flavours, balanced acidity

Name: Palm Bay Mango Pineapple Vodka Soda
Palm Bay Spirit Grapefruit
Description: This refreshing liqueur has blended flavours of freshly squeezed ruby grapefruit and crisp lemon citrus. Add a splash of soda and garnish with a slice of pink grapefruit for a easy summer sipper.

Name: Palm Bay Mango Lemon Iced Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives

Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives

Name: Palm Bay Strawberry Kiwi Iced Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives

Name: Palm Bay Raspberry Passion Fruit Vodka Soda
Big Rock Alberta Genuine Draft
Description: Appearance: Clear, pale golden yellow. Aroma: Light malts, mild hops. Mouthfeel: Light body, medium carbonation. Food Pairing: Chicken burgers, pork chops, trout fillets and bratwurst.

Name: River Valley Golden Lager
Description: Pale golden hue with a sweet malt flavour and hint of bitter hop aroma.

Name: River Valley Red Ale
Description: Amber hue with a light caramel malty flavour and mild bitterness aroma.

Name: River Valley Light Lager
Description: Yellow hue with a faint malt flavour and light hop aroma.

Name: Big Rock Rhine Stone Cowboy Kolsch
Description: A lederhosen wearing, bedazzled pardner strolling along the Rhine... oh and there's that rooster too. A vision born from our Brewmaster's creation in this fine Kölsch style pale ale. All natural, batch brewed with pale and Vienna malts, aged at lager temperatures... our refreshing ales is light in body and appearance, with aromas of clean malt and fruit, and a touch of noble hops. This cowboy joins the ranks of our great session beers.

Name: Big Rock Grasshopper Wheat Ale
Description: A light touch of hops gives the brew a crisp finish, balancing its soft sweetness and texture with fruity or citrusy notes.

Name: Big Rock Dunkelweizen
Description: If you think the name’s a mouthful, wait till you taste the complex flavours of its five distinct malts and two different German hops

Name: Big Rock Fowl Mouth
Description:
Brewmaster Paul Gautreau came up with his plan to brew an ESB after visiting a popular and very rowdy beer festival in Falmouth, UK. Paul, an English trained Brewmaster, loved the bitters he tried there. He wanted to put his British training to the test to brew his own. To keep it true to the style of great ESB’s, Paul imported barley from England, and East Kent Goldings, and Fuggles hops. 
The term “pale ale” and “bitter” are synonymous in England. Our Brewmaster’s ESB is a beautiful amber colour, and quite balanced in the perceived hop bitterness/malt sweetness ratio. Originally released in 2014, Big Rock fans loved this one so much, that Paul’s excited to have it joining the ranks of our great Signature Series beers.

Name: Big Rock McNally’s Extra Ale
Description: The New World Guide to Beer listed this as one of the best Irish style ales on the planet. We’re happy to agree. And we’ll also tell you that while watching the mist roll across an Irish lake is an excellent way to enjoy McNally’s Extra, it’s also perfectly at home, right here in Canada.

Name: Big Rock Warthog English Style Mild Ale
Description: We have the English to thank. Having invented hot, dusty African safaris, they had no choice but to invent refreshingly mild ales to extinguish the resulting fiery thirsts. Warthog, named after one of the beasts they journeyed to see, is such an ale, reinvented with the Big Rock difference.

Name: Big Rock Citradelic IPA
Description: Imperial Pacific NW IPA, beautiful citrus fruit nose and flavour. Medium bodied with a pleasant lingering aftertaste. Amber hue with a tight white head.

Name: Big Rock IPA
Description: A classic, sessionable IPA, dry hopped to lend a distinctive citrusy Cascade hop flavour and aroma.

Name: Big Rock Honey Brown Lager
Description: We use real honey from friendly local bees to help sweeten our Honey Brown lager, while the Brown comes from something just as natural and local, our world-renowned Alberta prairie malt.

Name: Big Rock Saaz Republic Pilz
Description: You’re on a quaint cobbled street in Prague. Tiny motorcycles scoot by as you sit under an umbrella on a terrace in the midday sun. This is the beer you quaff as you figure out how you got to eastern Europe and how any drink can be quite this refreshing.

Name: Big Rock Jack Rabbit Light Lager
Description:
A pure light lager, flavourful and satisfying, without any excess.

A light lager for your active lifestyle.  No additives, no preservatives.  100 calories per 355 ml can. 90 calories per 330ml bottle.

Name: Big Rock Winter Spice Ale
Description: It can be tough to enjoy our long Canadian winters. The short days and cold temperatures sap the will. We crafted Winter Spice as the winter warmer that we’d want to drink to give us much-needed comfort during our longest season. Aromas of cloves and caramel evoke the sensation of home baking and the rich, malty flavour is enhanced with cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger.

Name: Rising Tide Ishmael
Description: Ishmael is our richly-flavored American copper ale. This American interpretation of the altbiers of Düsseldorf is brewed with continental Munich malt, American-grown hops, and a clean-fermenting ale yeast to produce a slightly sweet and malty beer balanced by a firm bitterness.

Name: Rising Tide Spinnaker
Description: Spinnaker  [spin-ah-ker] (n)—a large billowing sail set forward of the mainsail and used for running down wind    Spinnaker is the perfect companion to a lazy summer day. With a nod to the traditional hazy wheat beers of Germany, our hefeweizen balances sweet yeast esters and spicy phenolics with a refreshing bready body. Prost!    For a traditional hefeweizen experience, gently swirl the bottle to rouse the yeast.

Name: Rising Tide Gose
Description: Light, dry, crisp, and refreshing, Gose is our interpretation of the old German style. Our version is brewed with lactobacillus, coriander, and local seawater for a tart and mineral character.

Name: Rising Tide Maine Island Trail Ale
Description: With a bright malt body and bold notes of citrus and pine from the hop blend including citra and simcoe, this hoppy American ale is the perfect accompaniment to summer in Maine

Name: Rising Tide Daymark
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Chart a new course with Daymark as your guide. We start with a classic, clean and crisp American pale ale brewed with spicy Columbus and Centennial hops. Then we accent the grain bill with rye grown on small local family farms right here in Maine and malted to our specifications at Valley Malts, an artisanal malt house. Finally we dry hop the finished beer for a bright floral aroma.

Name: Rising Tide Maine Island 1/6 Barrel
Description: With a bright malt body and bold notes of citrus and pine, Maine Island Trail Ale is the perfect companion for summer in Maine.

Name: Rising Tide Nikita Bourbon Barrel Aged Russian Imperial Stout
Description: Barrel aged Nikita began its life as a fairly traditional Rye Russian Imperial Stout. Nikita was then aged in bourbon barrels. The result is a smooth and delicious barrel aged beer with notes of oak, vanilla, baker’s chocolate, and bourbon.

Name: Rising Tide Ursa Minor
Description: Style | ABV   American Stout |  6.70% ABV     Availability: Winter    Notes & Commercial Description:   Beer added by: dciBA on 12-18-2010    Dark as squid ink and moody as the sea, Ursa Minor is our take on a winter wheat beer. Starting with a German wheat-beer yeast and a base of malted wheat, we added a blend of dark crystal and roasted malts to create a wheat stout. Redolent of dark fruit, weizen yeast esters, and roasted barley, Ursa Minor is perfect for an icy winter’s eve.

Name: Rising Tide Zephyr
Description: Heady like the sweet breath of Zephyrus, our India pale ale is redolent of citrus, apples, and pears, balanced by a touch of caramel. We use malted barley grown by local farmers and add a special blend of Cascade, Centennial, and Calypso hops to create this juicy, hoppy ale.

Name: Rising Tide Atlantis Black Ale
Description: Whether you are celebrating lost cities under the sea or shooting for low Earth orbit, take Atlantis along for the ride. We use a special blend of dark malts and add Galaxy, Cascade, and Calypso hops to create this smooth and hoppy black ale with just a whisper of cherry-wood smoke. We think Poseidon would approve.

Name: Rising Tide Great Diamond Island
Description:
Great Diamond Island — an island in Casco Bay. It is a part of the city of Portland, Maine. Used as a military base in the late 19th century through WWII. 

Great Diamond Island is a juicy IPA that features big pineapple, coconut, cantaloupe, and citrus notes with a full mouthfeel and low bitterness.

Name: Rising Tide Calcutta Cutter Imperial IPA
Description: Imperial IPA. Double IPA. XIPA. IIPA. Whatever you want to call it, Calcutta Cutter is our homage to hops. Lots of hops. Early hops. Late hops. Very late hops. Dry hops. Then we condition the bottles in a bed of hops. Well, maybe not that last bit, but you get the idea. With just enough malt body and alcohol to balance the beer out, we let the lupulin shine.

Name: Rising Tide Chebeague Island
Description: Pleasantly sweet and smooth with a big melon, stone fruit, and tropical fruit character.

Name: Rising Tide Oktoberfest
Description: Complex and malty while still being dry and crisp, our Märzen-style lager is a celebration of the crisp weather of autumn. Prost!

Name: Rising Tide Back Cove Pilsner
Description: The Back Cove tidal basin lies at the heart of our city and provides the most iconic view of the Portland skyline. As a tribute to the civic leaders who preserved a park encircling Back Cove 100 years again, we offer this crisp, easy drinking pilsner.   Back Cove is a North German-style pilsner fermented with kellerbier yeast.  Harmoniously balanced, with hints of orchard fruit, clean malt and earthy bitterness.

Name: Rising Tide Maine Island Trail Ale
Description: With a bright malt body and bold notes of citrus and pine from the hop blend including citra and simcoe, this hoppy American ale is the perfect accompaniment to summer in Maine

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Flower Child IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Hard Aged
Description: Extensively hopped and dryhopped with a big roster of hops – Simcoe, Centennial, Cascade, Ahtanum, Chinook, and Amarillo – it’s big, bright, and floral, with just enough malt to balance. This American-style I.P.A. stands head and shoulders above its hoppy brethren, blending pale and honey malts to balance the palate without interfering in your herbal reverie, and creating a new American classic.

Name: CBC Red God
Description: Red God features 5 different hop varieties showcasing, in particular, Columbus, Amarillo, and Centennial. These varieties combine for a strong herbal, spicy, citrusy character, which dominates the palate. Hopping rate is, aggressive at nearly five pounds per barrel, yet balance prevails! American pale and Belgian caramel malts provide a malty, deep red pedestal upon which this hop fest rides until its long, lingering, hop-bittered finish. Beware this vengeful God!

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Morning Dew
Description: Morning Dew is a refreshing take on Belgian Golden ale. It is brewed with a complex blend of malted and unmalted grain, including Rye Wheat, Buckwheat and flaked Barley. It has a medium body, smooth and round with a long lingering white head.    Morning Dew is lightly bittered with German Hallertauer hops and infused with a touch of elderflower, then extensively dry hopped with Nelson Sauvin. This provides a beautiful balance of floral and fruit aromatics, followed by hints of spicy grain. The flavor is more fruit with cereal grain and spicy Belgian yeast character, with a juicy bright finish.

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Working Class Hero
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: CBC Tripel Threat
Description: The tripels are generally the strongest specialty ales made by the Belgian and Dutch Trappist monastic breweries. Pale in color with a very distinct palate, they are painstakingly created as beers to be consumed on holidays and religious festivals.

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Sgt. Pepper
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Brewed with Pilsner, CaraVienne, and Rye malts, plus Magnum and Spalter hops.  But the driving force behind this beer is the contribution from whole Black, Green, White, and Pink peppercorns. Added to the brewkettle, these four fab peppercorns harmonize with spicy hops while the malted rye and our Belgian yeast hold down the backbeat.

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Bright Size Life
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Casual Gods
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Wild Golden Ale.

Name: CBC You Enjoy My Stout
Description: The brilliance of its composition becomes clear at first taste, where a deep bass of very rich, sweet chocolaty flavor gives over to high notes of elevated alcohol and then decrescendos to a slight bitterness from highly-roasted malts. If you’re better at this than I am, you may detect some hop flavor-we used British Northdown. Continuing its articulate arpeggio across your palate, YEM trills notes of vanillin, hints of bourbon and oak, and an enchanting tannic note of red wine, with a smooth, creamy licorice flavor that coats without cloying. A final improvised splash of cherry-ish fruit grabs for your attention before a ridiculously long, lingering, espresso-roasted finish.

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Spring Training IPA
Description: You want an IPA, you’ve got one, but with a twist. “Spring Training” breezes in like a breath of fresh air, ready to awaken your senses from a long, cold winter. Made from primarily Canadian pale malts, the recipe also incorporates Belgian carapils, aromatic and wheat malts to contribute to the beer’s complex body and straw-golden color. Ahtanum and Palisades hops were chosen for their essence of wildflowers and freshly-cut grass and to present a contrast to the piney, earthy and resiny characteristics of most IPAs. But don’t worry that these “pretty” hops won’t deliver a strong punch-in addition to extensive kettle hopping the beer is dry-hopped with 10 lbs of Ahtanums to blast your senses away.

Name: Cambridge Brewing The Fog that Surrounds
Description: New England Double I.P.A.

Name: CBC Big Man IPA
Description: Our Winter seasonal beer is here! Originally brewed in September of 1992 at the request of three bartenders/managers (who have since gone on to great fame and glory) Big Man I.P.A. has been a favorite seasonal brew at Cambridge Brewing Company ever since. Legend has it that the grist weight of Big Man I.P.A. was their combined total weight – 770 pounds of malt for 10 barrels of beer!

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Remain In Light
Description: American light lagers and Pilsners are easy to drink and refreshing. They are not, however, easy for a craft brewer to make – but we are always up for a challenge. Pilsner malt and flaked rice provide sweet cereal grain notes while German and Czech hops add spiciness and a balanced bitterness to the finish. Cold fermented and aged with a German lager yeast, the palate is clean with a snappy finish.

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Great Pumpkin Ale
Description: New England’s first and CBC’s most sought after seasonal beer, The Great Pumpkin Ale, is back in bottles and on draft! We are very proud to be brewing with locally-grown sugar pumpkins from our friends at The Farm School in Athol, and Wilson Farms in Lexington.  We’re also using organic barley that was grown in MA and then small-batch malted by our friends at Valley Malt in Hadley, MA.

Name: Cbc Spring IPA
Description: You want an IPA, you’ve got one, but with a twist. “Spring Training” breezes in like a breath of fresh air, ready to awaken your senses from a long, cold winter. Made from primarily Canadian pale malts, the recipe also incorporates Belgian carapils, aromatic and wheat malts to contribute to the beer’s complex body and straw-golden color. Ahtanum and Palisades hops were chosen for their essence of wildflowers and freshly-cut grass and to present a contrast to the piney, earthy and resiny characteristics of most IPAs. But don’t worry that these “pretty” hops won’t deliver a strong punch-in addition to extensive kettle hopping the beer is dry-hopped with 10 lbs of Ahtanums to blast your senses away.

Name: Cambridge Brewing Company Audacity of Hops (CBC)
Description: Liberally hopped to an audacious degree, our Belgian Double IPA reaches across the aisle to bridge the seemingly contradictory brewing philosophies of the old world and new. Our beer uses generous portions of Pilsner and Vienna malts to give it its hazy golden color and rocky white head. Two independent dry hop additions of Simcoe, Chinook, Amarillo, Hallertauer, and Spalt put aside their differences to form a delicious coalition. Floral grassiness dominates the nose with fruity hints of bright citrus well represented. Its subtle spicy flavor comes from a Belgian yeast as well as generous doses of German hops in the kettle. These aggressive flavors are complemented by a determined bitterness and a full but dry finish.

Name: Cambridge Brewing Big Man IPA
Description: Formerly known as Winter Ale. Our Winter seasonal beer is here! Originally brewed in September of 1992 at the request of three bartenders/managers (who have since gone on to great fame and glory) Big Man Ale has been a favorite seasonal brew at Cambridge Brewing Company ever since. Legend has it that the grist weight of Big Man Ale was their combined total weight – 770 pounds of malt! Deep copper-colored and unfiltered (as are all of CBC’s beers), it boasts a full body complemented by strong, robust flavors. Its rich notes of malt and caramel are offset by very aggressive hopping—it is kettle-hopped with Columbus, Cascade and Centennial hops and further dry-hopped with even more Cascades and Amarillo. These hop varieties lend a fruity, citrusy character to this big malty beer, vaguely in the style of a strong stock ale or I.P.A. We just call it the Big Man.

Name: Kona Big Wave Golden Ale
Description: Big Wave Golden Ale is just the ticket. Big Wave is a lighter bodied golden ale with a tropical hop aroma and flavor – a smooth, easy drinking refreshing ale. The use of caramel malt contributes to the golden hue of this beer and our special blend of hops provides bright quenching finish. Our brewers wanted to make a beer that went down easy after a day out on the water. Pairs well with seafood, poultry, salads and light pasta dishes.

Name: Kona Longboard Island Lager
Description: Longboard Island Lager is a smooth refreshing lager fermented and aged for weeks at cold temperatures to yield its exceptionally smooth flavor. A delicate, slightly spicy hop aroma complements the malty body of this beer. Exceptionally smooth. Pairs well with lighter fare, but has enough body to stand up to heartier foods too.

Name: Kona Spiked Island Seltzer Variety
Description: Need a Hawaiian vacation? Every fizzy sip of our crisp hard seltzers is packed with tropical tastes that will transport your senses - no luggage needed! Sparkling bubbles, enticing aromas, and juicy flavors bring the islands right to you. What’s even more refreshing? Kona Spiked Island Seltzers have zero sugar and are naturally gluten free. One Life, Right?

Name: Kona Hanalei Island IPA
Tasting Notes: Hoppy, Tropical Fruit, Melon - Honeydew, Bright
Description: Hanalei Island IPA is named after the historic town of Hanalei and world-famous Hanalei Bay, a magnificent crescent shaped bay tucked against lush green mountains streaked with waterfalls. Hanalei Island IPA is the perfect beer to enjoy after a day of stand up paddling, surfing and kayaking to accompany casual summer fare such as seafood, tacos, pizza or pasta dishes.

Name: Kona Gold Cliff IPA
Description: Gold Cliff IPA features real pineapple, along with bright, tropical fruit aromas of Mosaic and Citra hops and a hint of smooth caramel malt.

Name: Kona Kanaha Blonde Ale
Description: Our brewer’s were inspired by the trade winds to create this smooth, refreshing blonde ale with the adventures of summer in mind. After a day riding the winds over shimmering waters, Kanaha Blonde ale is a bright, sessionable beer that will ease you ashore without weighing you down. Real mango fruit adds a juicy, tropical flavor that is easy like the islands. This crisp Kona brew will take you up, up and away. *Per 12 fl. oz. – Average Analysis: Calories, 99. Carbohydrates, 4g. Protein, 1g. Fat, 0g.

Name: Kona Castaway IPA
Description: Take a sip of this copper-colored India Pale Ale and you’ll taste bold, citrusy hops with a touch of tropical mango and passion fruit, balanced by the rich caramel malts. Castaway IPA has a clean, crisp finish that’s as refreshing as the wind in your face when you set sail for adventure. Set sail for adventure! Pairs well with sweet and savory dishes, such as Hawaiian-inspired spicy bacon wrapped pineapple and spam.

Name: Kona Wailua Wheat
Description: On Maui, follow the old Hana Highway and you will find such a place – Wailua Falls. This plunging cascade of clear water is the inspiration for Wailua Wheat. This golden, sun colored ale has a bright, citrus flavor that comes from the tropical passion fruit we brew into each batch. Pairs well with lighter fare like grilled fish and shrimp, roasted chicken, salads and Asian foods.

Name: Kona Wailua Wheat 1/6 Barrel
Description: On Maui, follow the old Hana Highway and you will find such a place – Wailua Falls. This plunging cascade of clear water is the inspiration for Wailua Wheat. This golden, sun colored ale has a bright, citrus flavor that comes from the tropical passion fruit we brew into each batch.

Name: Kona Fire Rock Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Its signature copper color results from the unique blend of specialty roasted malts. The pronounced citrus-floral hop aroma comes from the liberal amount of hops added to each brew. Fire Rock Pale Ale is crisp, refreshing “Hawaiian-style” pale ale. Pairs well with a broad variety of foods. The perfect complement to any dish.

Name: Yuengling Traditional Lager
Description: Yuengling Lager is an iconic American lager famous for its rich amber color and medium-bodied flavor. Roasted caramel malt adds subtle sweetness, while a combination of cluster and cascade hops round out this well-balanced beer. Drink this classic lager chilled, either in a beer mug or straight from the bottle.

Name: Yuengling Light Lager
Description: True to its American heritage, Yuengling Light Lager is an exceptional brew that appeals to consumers who don't want to sacrifice character for a low-calorie light beer. It has been masterfully developed to maintain the full flavor profile akin to our flagship Lager brand. Skillfully pairing a caramel malt flavor and mild hop character creates a beautifully rich-colored beer with deep amber highlights that finishes smooth and clean. With only 99 calories, Yuengling Light Lager is a uniquely refreshing beer that brings new dimension to the meaning light beer.

Name: Yuengling Flight
Description: Raise the bar with the next generation of light beer. FLIGHT by Yuengling is easy drinking, clean, crisp, and refreshing. FLIGHT is only 95 calories, 2.6g carbs, 4.2 ABV (alcohol by volume).

Name: Yuengling Black & Tan
Description: Yuengling Black and Tan models a traditional English Half & Half. Introduced in 1986, Yuengling produced one of the first hand-crafted draft blends to lead this style of American brewing. Black and Tan combines 60% of our popular Dark Brewed Porter and 40% of our Premium Beer to create a brew that is rich and dark in color with hints of caramel and coffee from the dark roasted malts.

Name: Yuengling Golden Pilsner
Description: Yuengling Golden Pilsner is a modern pilsner crafted with the perfect balance of hop and malt character for crisp, smooth refreshment. Golden Pilsner is Yuengling’s interpretation of an outstanding, modern pilsner born from six generations of brewing expertise, with all of the qualities consumers have come to expect from Yuengling, in a beer that is sessionable and full of flavor.

Name: Yuengling Lord Chesterfield Ale
Description: One of Yuengling's heritage beers, Yuengling Lord Chesterfield Ale has as much rich heritage as it does flavor and appeal. Crafted in a unique two-stage European brewing style for enhanced bitterness, it utilizes both conventional kettle hopping and dry hopping after fermentation resulting in a dry sharp finish. Its distinct robust flavor is derived from a delicate combination of sweet maltiness and lingering herbal bitterness.

Name: Yuengling Porter
Description: Yuengling Dark Brewed Porter is an original specialty beer that has been brewed expressly for tavern owners and family trade since 1829. We are proud to be one of the largest Porter producers in the US. Our Porter calls for a generous portion of caramel and dark roasted malts which deliver a rich, full-bodied flavor and creamy taste with slight tones of chocolate evident in every sip.

Name: Yuengling Seasonal
Description: Yuengling® is proud to offer our Oktoberfest as an homage to our German Heritage. Copper in color, this medium bodied beer is the perfect blend of roasted malts with just the right amount of hops to capture a true representation of the style.

Name: Yuengling Premium Light Beer
Description: Yuengling Light maintains a well-balanced character of malt and hops for a crisp, satisfying finish with only 98 calories per serving. Drawing from traditional brewing techniques, our Light Beer is brewed longer to reduce the sugar content and produce fewer calories. Its pale golden color is complemented by a light bodied flavor.

Name: Yuengling Premium Beer
Description: A regional favorite, Yuengling Premium is very popular among local beer drinkers for its thirst quenching taste. It is a pilsner-style brew, gold in color with a pale malt character that finishes crisp and clean. Premium flawlessly blends both 2-row and 6-row barley malt for a well-balanced flavor that is always refreshing. Traces of the slight hop aroma are evident in every delicious sip of Yuengling Premium Beer.

Name: Kent Falls Trapped In Habitual Hoppy Blonde Ale
Description: Bright and beautiful, each batch of Trapped in Habitual Nostalgia features a different pairing of classic and new wave hop profiles  delivered through a plush body for a perfectly smooth ride along the wave of tradition directly into the future

Name: Kent Falls Equinox
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Brewed on each equinox to celebrate the change of season with its namesake hop which imparts both fresh green pepper and tropical fruit character into the beer. This is one of our favorite seasonal farmhouse ales to brew for the way it expresses itself when fresh and develops a complex character as it ages.

Name: Kent Falls Field Beer
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bitter, Dry, Fruity, Grassy, Honey, Hoppy, Tart
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Chicken, Dessert - Fruit, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Shellfish, Tomatoes
Description:
Field Beer is the first beer we produced as a brewery. Meant as a philosophical flagship it is a beer that has gone through several iterations. We brew this beer to highlight profiles of individual barley farms and the maltsters who allow us to make beer with their harvest.

The beers that came to define the farmhouse “style” were often brewed for those very farmhands who worked the soil that spawned the beer, but today, modern agriculture and brewing make up a far more elaborate web. With Field Beer, our farmhouse ale fermented with a mix of indigenous microbes cultured from our farm, we pay homage to saison’s intrinsic connection to the fields. Working with nearby farmers and maltster, we work to preserve our beer’s vital connection to local agriculture by highlighting where our malt came from for each batch. Each iteration of Field Beer will offer familiar fermentation flavors – dry, delicate, and complex – while highlighting the nuance created by varietal and geographical differences, as well as an individual producers’ manner of cultivation.

Name: Kent Falls Sweatpants Pale Ale
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Citrus, Crisp, Grapefruit, Hoppy, Pine
Description: The first pale ale we released. A clean ale fermentation of Waymaker, one of our Brett IPAs. We encourage you to taste the difference.

Name: Kent Falls Waymaker Brett IPA
Description: It’s true. Every brewery needs an IPA. We’re bringing the farmhouse culture to ours, fermenting it with a blend of 100% brettanomyces. Brewed with plenty of hops, it delivers the big juicy hop flavors to delicately balance the clean, and tropical fruit forward flavors of the wild yeast. Our goal was to produce an easy drinking IPA packed with enough hop flavors and aroma to create a new refreshing taste in any season. Initially, this will be a draft only offering to ensure it is consumed fresh and in the best condition possible. If we ever can it, we strongly encourage you to make it your hiking partner.

Name: Kent Falls ¯_(ツ)_/¯ Shruggie IPA
Description: Shruggie is alive!  At 6% abv.  and amply hopped with Amarillo, Azacca, and Galaxy our newest IPA, “¯_(ツ)_/¯” a.k.a. Shruggie is a lot more fun to drink than it is to try and type out (I’m about to set a shortcut on my laptop for it).  So when you go out to celebrate CT Beer this week, and the bartender asks you what you’d like…. There’s only one thing to do.

Name: Kent Falls Super Sparkle
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This sweet little hoppy beer is flush with Simcoe and Mosaic providing refreshing fruit, citrus and pine character to keep hydrated in the field and ready to #sparkleon.

Name: Kent Falls Playback With A Twist
Description: Playback With A Twist is an IPA which integrates time, technique and process along with carefully selected hops to unlock massive latent aromatic potential in otherwise unassuming varieties. Bold cantaloupe and honeydew notes to compliment orange and pine.

Name: Kent Falls Zep Of The Jukebox
Description: Go with the classics. Zep on the Jukebox is brewed with a focus on Falconer’s Flight hops, accented by other classic northwest hops known for their gripping grapefruit, lemon, and softer tropical notes.

Name: Superscript IPA
Tasting Notes: Berry, Citrus, Hoppy, Nectarine, Pine, Red Fruit, Tropical
Description: IPA brewed with 100% local grains and our hops from our favorite farms.

Name: Buddy Sprinkles Saves The Day
Food Pairing: Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Pork, Root Vegetables, Tomatoes
Description: Citra, Mosaic, Vic Secret IPA named in honor of our farm's heroic feline.

Name: Kent Falls Substrate Dark Lager
Description: Dark lager brewed with 100% locally grown, malted and roasted grains.

Name: Kent Falls Yeesh Czech Pilsner
Food Pairing: Cheese - Hard Aged, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - White, Mushrooms, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: Yeesh! As we continue to explore brewing lager biers, we strive to develop the perfect pils. This beer is the maturation of a more traditional Czech profile reflecting a deeper body and Czech hops.

Name: Kent Falls Danny Boy Pilsner
Description: Danny Boy is a hop accented unfiltered German inspired pilsner. Select German hops, proper malt character and bitterness, and a head that keeps the beer drinking pretty.

Name: Kent Falls Pastori Pilsner
Description: Keller pilsner brewed with Endeavour barley from Valley Malt and hopped with Southern Hemisphere noble hops.  After introducing noble hops into certain pale ales and IPAs, we sought to develop a pale lager which will combine a traditional low alpha/noble hop bitterness and profile while boosting the fruit forward character of more contemporary hops. We found our answer in Australia and New Zealand; Helga, Summer, and Pacifica provide plenty of stone fruit flavors and aromatics atop this clean and snappy lager.

Name: Kent Falls Shoots
Description: This beer comes from the soul of our brewery. Each batch will have a rotation of adjunct grains  (raw, malted, whatever we are able to get our hands on) alongside locally grown and malted barley from our friends at Valley Malt which contributes a beautiful clover and honey note behind the floral, fruity and lightly resinous hop character. Both of the hops in this beer, Michigan Copper and Bitter Gold are varieties we have planted on our farm and are chosen for the distinct flavor profiles they offer us as brewers which we believe leads to economic viability for farmers. This will never be an “estate” beer but rather a vision and celebration of a beer whose ideals are cultivated, ingredients grown, and flavors produced by a community.

Name: The Hollow
Description: Our farm's favorite pilsner. Brewed with locally grown and malted endeavor barley it is the perfect beer for time out on the pasture.

Name: Backlash Groundswell 1/2 Barrel

Name: Backlash Allston IPA
Description: Allston is the first in our Stomping Grounds Series. This beer is brewed with Citra hops and Mosaic powder and commemorates where the first batch of homebrew was made. Juicy with a touch of bitterness, let us know what you think!

Name: Backlash Salute Double Ipa
Description: still brimming with Citra and Simcoe hops. Swirl the can for extra haze!

Name: Backlash Indomitable IPA
Description: This beer is a huge Double IPA where old school meets new school. Resin and dankness blends with sweet fruits with hints orange and peach.

Name: Backlash Conquest White IPA
Description: The first of the four is here, and his name is Conquest. No, not that type of Conquest where you wake up struggling to remember the name of the person next to you. We’re talking about the dude wearing a crown, holding a bow, on a big ol’ white horse. Yeah, THAT Conquest. The fact is that the fact is actually nigh.

Name: Backlash Follow Through DIPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Our latest exploration of the New England Double IPA is FOLLOW THROUGH - a soft DIPA featuring heaps of Citra hops, which give this beer an intense cantaloupe / melon character.

Name: Banded Samoan Drop Porter
Description: Our favorite coconut-caramel cookie in a beer! Shortbread cookies with caramel & dark chocolate are added directly to the mash then the brew is finished with a “dry-hop” of toasted coconut. A powerhouse brew with a sweet, delicious embrace.

Name: Banded Ghost Widow
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Inspired by ghost stories that take place in the historic Peppered Mill and a singularly haunting window at the top of the stair tower of Building 15, which we can see from our brew deck. Ghost Window is a French-style Saison brewed with flaked-rye and wheat, then classically fermented in a re-purposed dairy tank, before being dry-hopped with a healthy dose of Mandarina Bavaria, and finally conditioned with Brettanomyces. This ale is ready to be enjoyed now or, like the tales from the mill, will become more complex over time.

Name: Banded Brewing Greenwarden
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Inspired by a lore: an ale of mythic proportions. Heroically brewed with Maine-foraged spruce tips replacing flavor and aroma hops. A super refreshing, complex ale with a Maine malt base. Notes of mild evergreen, mint + sweet herb balance out candied fruit flavors- we’ve heard everything from pineapple lifesavers to grape nerds!

Name: Banded Brewing Co. Charms & Hexes Sour
Description: A spirited sour ale with rotating fruits. A balance of sweet and tart that will delight, enchant, and refresh the senses.

Name: Banded Charms And Hexes
Description: A spirited sour ale with rotating fruits. A balance of sweet and tart that will delight, enchant, and refresh the senses.

Name: Banded Norweald Stout
Description: Inspired by our playground, the north woods of Maine. It covers the spread of dark malt flavors perfectly: dark chocolate, smoke, burnt toffee, cream, and caramel.

Name: Banded The Jolly Woodsman
Description: A stout enhanced with wood-roasted Kenyan espresso from (Portland, ME's) Speckled Ax. Huge, bright coffee nose. Tasting notes (barista style)- Orange, cacao husk, cranberry, juicy, bitter chocolate. Fuels the hungriest of fires, or the most ardent woodsman.

Name: Banded Mountain
Description: The aptly named Mountain is a Russian Imperial Stout. Dark and forboding, notes of burnt caramel, oak, charcoal, and cream, mingle well with a deep, intense maltiness. A huge stout, yet it remains balanced and one sip begs another chance to explore the complexities.

Name: Banded At Ease Imperial Stout
Description: Imperial Stout w/Cinnamon & Vanilla

Name: Banded Veridian IPA
Description: A balanced American IPA. Smooth, light maltiness, with a touch of honey and granola. Hops are vibrant and bracing, yet light on the palate. Lemon peel, tropical fruit, and spruce dominate the bouquet.

Name: Banded Zealot IPA
Description: Full-bodied, big, balanced and quaffable: meet Zealot. Brewed with a healthy dose of wheat, a ton of Simcoe, Amarillo, and Summit hops for a sticky, resinous, punchy yet harmonious hop profile."

Name: Banded Daikaiju
Description: A monolithic Double IPA that is dangerously balanced with an understated malt presence that won’t weigh you down.

Name: Banded Session Ender
Description: DRINKER, BEWARE! You’ve stumbled into hazardous territory. Cast aside the session and let this monstrosity sink its fangs in.  A colossal Triple IPA brewed with rotating hop varietals in each batch. Hits hard, leaves fast. This beast will consume you.

Name: Banded Wheat & Potato Session IPA
Description: Session IPA made with Maine wheat and potatoes.

Name: Banded Pepperell Pilsner
Description: Light and extremely drinkable, Pepperell Pils is the perfect session beer. The hops are sharp, noble, and spicy matched with a fresh, bready malt. Brewed as a tribute to our home in the enduring fortress that is Biddeford’s Pepperell Mill. Das Bier Der Mühle am Fluss: “The Beer from the River Mill.”

Name: Banded Wicked Bueno
Description: Brewed for a time of year when we don’t know what the weather will bring. A lighthearted Mexican-style Lager brewed to transport us to the wicked good days of summer. Light on the palate with a hint of citrus-floral hops. A delicate lager that radiates the sunshine.

Name: Shiner Bock
Description: Brewed with rich, roasted barley malt and German specialty hops this lightly hopped American-style dark lager always goes down smooth.  Originally a seasonal beer, fans have demanded it year-round since 1973.  Growing to the top-selling craft beer in Texas it is truly the beer of Texas.

Name: Shiner Light Blonde
Description: Using only the highest-quality two-row barley and choice aroma hops, Shiner Light Blonde is a refreshing, easy-drinking and flavorful light beer that has only 99 calories and 3.4g carbs.  It's Light Done Right!

Name: Shiner Seasonal Holiday Cheer
Description: Happy Holidays from the 'Little Brewery' in Shiner, TX! Shiner Cheer is an old-world Dunkelweizen brewed with Texas peaches and roasted pecans. The malty flavors of this dark wheat ale are enhanced through the use of malted barley and wheat.  And Krausening ensures a smoothness that makes the subtle peach and pecan flavors all the more satisfying.

Name: Shiner Ruby Redbird
Description: Shiner Ruby Redbird is brewed with genuine Texas Ruby Red Grapefruit, the signature sweet citrus of the Rio Grande Valley, and ginger. This lager beer features grapefruit tartness and finishes with a ’lil kick of ginger. With Texas Ruby Red Grapefruit and Ginger, Shiner Ruby Redbird is a crisp and refreshing summer beer.

Name: Shiner Straight Shooter Hard Seltzer
Description: Shiner Straight Shooter Hard Seltzer is crafted with all-natural ingredients and 111 years of brewing experience to make each flavor big, bold, and straight-up delicious.  Variety Pack comes with Cherry, Mango, Lemonade, and Grapefruit and Lime

Name: Shiner Holiday Cheer
Description: This holiday dunkelweizen practically unwraps itself with hints of Texas peaches and pecans.  Caramelized malts give it a uniquely rich, malt body that's perfect for the holidays.

Name: Shiner Weisse N’Easy Wheat
Description: Brewed with a hint of Texas dewberries, it’s a wheat beer that is unfiltered and full-flavored, but only 50 calories.

Name: Shiner Weisse ‘N’ Easy
Description: All the flavor of a wheat beer without any of the heaviness.  With only 95 calories and 2.9g carbs, it's year-round refreshment.  Perfect for kickin' back and takin' it Weisse and Easy.

Name: Shiner Wicked Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Wicked in all the right ways, this juicy IPA is dry hopped, unfiltered and bursting with tropical Citra hops for a bright, juicy kick of fresh citrus flavors.

Name: Shiner Brewer’s Pride Wine Barrel Blonde Ale
Description: Brewed in small batches and finished in cabernet and merlot barrels from Becker vineyards in Fredericksburg, TX, this brewer's pride carries notes of ripe berries, stone fruit and oak. It's bright, refreshing and vintage Shiner.

Name: Shiner Bohemian Black Lager
Description: A Bohemian Black Lager is a rare and delicious style of beer, referred to in Germany as Schwarzbier. Shiner Bohemian Black Lager remains true to this old-world style by using imported Czech Saaz and Styrains Hops and select roasted malts to make it our darkest beer. First brewed to commemorate our 97th anniversary, this Bohemian Black Lager remains true to the old-world heritage of the German and Czech immigrants that settled Shiner. Prosit!

Name: Shiner Oktoberfest
Description: Here in Shiner, TX (pop. 2,070), we’re suckers for tradition. Which is why this classic Oktoberfest brew is made with the highest quality two-row barley, Munich and caramel malts, along with German grown Hallertau Tradition and Hersbrucker hops. It’s our way of honoring our ancestors and the beer they loved to celebrate with. So raise your stein to tradition and enjoy this utterly classic brew.

Name: Shiner Prickly Pear Summer Seasonal
Description: This small batch brew is the third in our Limited Edition Brewer’s Pride Craft Brew Series. A combination of Citra and US Golding hops gives this refreshing lager its citrus flavor and floral aroma. The brew’s signature tartness comes from the fruit of the prickly pear, a cactus native to our brewery’s landscape that’s hearty, rugged and unmistakably unique - qualities we surely appreciate. Prosit!

Name: Belching Beaver Deftones Phantom Bride IPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Named after the ethereal song by the one and only Deftones, Phantom Bride IPA is a blend of Amarillo, Citra, Simcoe, and Mosaic hops delicately balanced for the perfectly drinkable mix of citrus and hoppy goodness. A truly original Deftones/Belching Beaver Collaboration envisioned by Chino Moreno and skillfully crafted by Thomas Peters. Sit back, put on your headphones and drink away.

Name: Belching Beaver Peanut Butter Milk Stout
Belching Beaver Hop Highway Ipa 78
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Belching Beaver Peach Be With You
Description: Peach Be With You is an easy-drinking pale ale brewed for our fall release. The goal was to complement the big stone fruit of Galaxy hops with the bright flavors of pureed peaches. Thomas first unleashed this beer at our Tavern, it had such a great response we had to share beyond the Den. This has to be an expensive beer because everything he makes costs us a small fortune! Every day around here is Christmas for Thomas. We keep getting deliveries of all these really expensive ingredients and high tech brewing gadgets. We finally had to cut up his Amex card, can you feel me, it’s a problem! Drink, enjoy, Dam Good Time To You My Friend!

Name: Belching Beaver Peanut Butter Milk Stout Nitro
Description: America’s Favorite Peanut Butter Milk Stout, on Nitro to-go! Don’t let the dark color fool you, this beer is delightfully easy to drink with aromas of roasted peanuts, dark chocolate and coffee.

Name: Belching Beaver ¡Viva La Beaver!
Description: Peanut Butter flavored Mexican Chocolate Milk Stout.

Name: Belching Beaver Milk Stout Nitro
Description: It all started with Milk Stout, our first craft beer at Belching Beaver Brewery. We’re excited to now bring it to you in a Nitro package version to be enjoyed anytime, anywhere. Dark in color but not in flavor, it’s an easy drinking style with notes of chocolate and roasted coffee. The beautiful cascade effect sets the tone for this creamy, silky, smooth beer. It is also the foundation of our Peanut Butter Milk Stout.

Name: Belching Beaver Milk Stout
Description: Our milk stout is light to the taste yet frothy and silky. It starts with a slight coffee roasted beginning and tapers down to a residual sweetness to finish you off. Enjoy our Nitro or Co2; come in and make the comparison, it may surprise you. Specialty malts include: Barley, Dark Malts, Rolled Oats.

Name: Belching Beaver Peanut Butter Latte Nitro Golden Stout
Description: People love our Peanut Butter Milk Stout, and this time we put a fun twist on our classic. Thomas brewed up a milk stout that is golden in color, a real sensory trip, and loaded it with coffee and chocolate. Then we kicked it up a notch by peanut butterizing (is that a word?) the beer for a real treat. Tom said, “A Peanut Butter Latte, that sounds great!” Perfect to sip on chilled nights and early mornings.

Name: Belching Beaver Viva La Beaver Barrel Aged 500 Ml
Belching Beaver Peanut Butter Latte
Description: Belching Beaver Peanut Milk Stout

Name: Belching Beaver Melty Hops DIPA
Description: We are proud to collaborate with our good friends from who happen to be some of the best hoppy beer brewers in the world. This beer is loaded with Citra, Simcoe, Cashmere, and Azacca to create a bouquet of tropical fruit, pine, mandarin orange, and tangerine.

Name: Belching Beaver Dammed!
Description: Our Dammed Double IPA has more hops than logs in a dam! Yet, you would never know it. This beer carries all of the spicy and earthy complexity that hops offers without the harsh bitterness. With a clean finish, this beer is proof that God loves you, and He wants you to be happy.

Name: Belching Beaver Here Comes Mango IPA
Description: Mango-infused IPA.

Name: Belching Beaver Deftones Lager
Description: Mexican Style Lager with Lime: Dia De Los Deftones is the namesake of the bands annual music festival, and we had to collaborate on a beer that reflected the amazing and diverse music featured. Combining the refreshing crushability of a lager and the exciting flavor of lime, this combo is perfect for hanging out on a warm, fall day listening to some of the best music by one of the most seminal bands of our time.

Name: Belching Beaver Passionfruit & Guava Hard Seltzer
Description: Here at the Beav, we love making beer, but some of our guys are packing on the pounds. So Thomas came up with the idea of making a low carb, hard seltzer. Troy brewed up a batch using real fruit – no artificial flavors or extracts. Now we have a low carb, no sugar added, easy drinking style to balance out our carb intake. It’s either this or the gym, so hard seltzer it is! Let the Dam Good Times continue!

Name: pFriem IPA
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Fresh, Guava, Pine, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cured Meats, Root Vegetables
Description: When the first Pale Ales were sailed around the Cape to arrive in India in the early 18th century, outcries of “Zounds! Jolly good! and Huzzah!” were heard across the East Indian subcontinent. Similar exclamations are to be expected when sniffing the piney aroma and tasting the big hops, huge citrus and candy-like malt of pFriem’s own IPA. Drink up, Guv’nor.

Name: Pfriem Frambozen
Description: Take a sniff of our raspberry Lambic-inspired ale, pFriem Frambozen, and huge perfumy aromas of fresh fruit will tease your nose. Take one sip and your taste buds will be embraced by the flavors of lavender and fresh jam before the tart, prickly finish will make you long for another.

Name: Pfriem Belgian Strong Blonde
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Bright blonde topped with pillowy white foam. Aromas of light clove, pear, and apricot. Flavors of sweet and spice melding, with a touch of tangerine. Finishes with an assertive bitterness, prickly carbonation, while leaving the mouth dry and clean.

Name: Pfriem Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: 10 IBU’s  Key Descriptions: Guava, Papaya, Tangy  Malt- Gambrinus Canadian Pilsner, Spelt, Raw Wheat  Hops- German Tettnang, Citra, Huell Melon  Yeast- Farmhouse Ale  Bacteria: Mixed Lactobacilli

Name: pFriem Mosaic Single Hop Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Pfriem Bright Pale Ale
Description: Building on an already great tradition of American Pale Ales, pFriem Bright Pale Ale is bursting with fruity, tropical brightness. Notes of white grapes, pineapple, pine and tropical aromas of honeydew melon and passion fruit will lead you to a crisp, fruity, and clean finish. One sip will brighten anyone’s day!

Name: Pfriem Golden Coffee Ale
Description: Fruity Kenyan coffee and aromatic hops to create the perfect harmony in pFriem's Golden Coffee Ale - a rich, citrus and nutty flavored, quaffable treat for both coffee and beer lovers alike!

Name: Pfriem Peche
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Chicken, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Duck  Game Bird
Description: When we add juicy, heirloom peaches to our year-old Lambic, magic happens— they unite, gushing with bright acidity, nutty undertones and a tangy finish. It does take eight more months of aging, but it’s well worth the wait.

Name: Pfriem Flanders Blonde
Description: Bright and golden topped with fluffy white foam. Light tannis bring forth lemon zest with a touch of French Oak. Round tart flavors with fresh green apple. Finishes spritzy, bright, and beautiful.

Name: pFriem Flanders Red
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: pFriem Flanders Red is a tribute to the Burgundies of Belgium, the red ales that once captivated the country. Each glass is rich with notes of cherry, hints of passionfruit and a Pinot-like flavor that comes from the eighteen months it spent in an oak barrel. Take one sip, savor the tart finish and you’ll understand how one beer could charm a country.

Name: Pfriem Bosbesssen Blueberry Sour
Description: We combine fresh blueberries with our barrel-aged Lambic-style ale to make pFriem Bosbessen. Its aromas of ripe fruit, white pepper and tobacco lead to a bright, jammy flavor that finishes as tart and tangy as the berries themselves.

Name: pFriem Citrus Zest IPA
Description: By adding grapefruit and tangelo zest to fruit and citrus forward hops we’ve maximized the fruit flavors in pFriem Citrus Zest IPA. Its notes of melon, papaya, and ripe fruit, and the zesty, refreshing finish will have you puckering up with joy in no time.

Name: pFriem Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Juicy IPAs may have started in New England, but we like to put our own west coast spin on things. pFriem’s Juicy IPA features big, fruity aromas of peach and starfruit, and jammy notes of orange sherbet, papaya and white grape. We think you’ll agree that we’ve put all this juice to good use.

Name: Pfriem Pilsner
Food Pairing: Chicken, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Shellfish
Description: Shines brilliantly gold with fluffy white foam. Aromas of fresh grass, spring flowers, with a touch of lemon zest quaffs from the glass. The mouth fills with zesty spiciness, a touch of honey, and finishes crisp, snappy, and refreshing.

Name: pFriem Export Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cured Meats
Description: pFriem Export Lager is a testament to balance in brewing art. Aromas of lightly toasted bread, wildflowers, and a hint of white grape converge in this cross between a Helles and a Pilsner. Each sip balances pleasant malt sweetness with floral hops and a restrained bitterness. You may want to balance your last sip with another pint.

Name: Fifth Hammer Streets & Avenues
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This saison was brewed with Pilsner & wheat malt and fermented in our American Oak foeder. A touch of wood and notes of apple, pear, lemon and white pepper dance with a creamy body and a dry finish for a most elegant ale.

Name: Fifth Hammer Brewing Midnight Sauce

Description: This is one refreshing sour - bushels of pineapple on the front with blood orange following. Juicy and bright.

Name: Fifth Hammer Strudel Goblin Sour
Description: Strudel Goblin is back! This version is packed with raspberry, peach and milk sugar. This fruit-forward sour is mildly tart and pours a brilliant bright pink. A raspberry-peach creamsicle in a glass.
