Name: Unibroue Trois Pistoles
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Strong Belgian type ale similar to a Port wine ! Is as dark as can be, mellow in taste with an aroma of ripe fruits. It can be compared to an old porto and is brewed from well roasted malt.

Name: Unibroue A Tout Le Monde
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: À TOUT LE MONDE ale is a flavorful Belgian style dry hopped golden saison with hoppy and spicy notes. Topped by an unctuous head, this beer will give fans a clean, fresh taste and a crisp dry finish inviting to take another sip

Name: Unibroue Don De Dieu
Description: Poured from bottle to snifter. One finger crisp head, fades rather quickly into thin film. A ring of head around glass edge, but little lacing. Darker straw color, and quite cloudy. Bananas and cloves on nose, with some tropical fruit and brown sugar characteristics. Hints of strawberry and clementine. Tastes very fruity, mostly bright red fruits and green grapes. Has a slightly bitter aftertaste, works well in the balance. Some spiciness. Higher carbonation and thicker, slightly syrupy body, though leaves a sparkling sensation that lingers. Does not seem like it is 9%. Delicious, complex and balanced. Though on expensive side (~$4/12 oz bottle), will certainly be buying more for special occasions.

Name: Unibroue Grande Reserve 17
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Unibroue La Resolution
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Unibroue Ephemere
Description: BRONZE MEDAL 2010 WORLD BEER CUP Hazy yellow color. Sweet green apple aromas with a nice touch of baking spices. A zesty entry leads to a frothy, fruity tart medium bodied palate.

Name: Unibroue Ephemere Apple
Description: Éphémère is the third in a series of lively original-recipe beers that come and go before you know it. From season to season and year to year you’ll find a different Éphémère beer.

Name: Samuel Smith Organic Chocolate Stout
Description: Brewed with well water (the original well, sunk in 1758, is still in use with the hard water is drawn from 85 feet underground), the gently roasted organic chocolate malt and real organic cocoa used in this ale impart a delicious, smooth and creamy character, with inviting deep flavours and a delightful finish - this is the perfect marriage of satisfying stout and luxurious chocolate that will lead to smiles and refills. Samuel Smith's brews in traditional coppers, uses stone 'Yorkshire Squares' for fermentation, and ships every bottle from the brewery with great pride.

Name: Samuel Smith Oatmeal Stout
Food Pairing: Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Cheese - Hard Aged
Description: Originally a drink for lactating mothers, oatmeal stout was described as nutritional on early labels. Oats are in the same family as barley, and a small addition yields great flavor. Popular in the late 1800’s, the last oatmeal stout was brewed before the First World War until Samuel Smith reintroduced this style in 1980.     Almost opaque, with an unusually silky texture and complex, medium-dry velvet palate. Bittersweet finish.

Name: Samuel Smith Organic Lager
Description: Lightly kilned organic lager malt grown in the UK is the main ingredient, with a substantial addition of organic UK Vienna malt. Samuel Smith's has begun to source organic hops in England; some of the organic hops used in the recipe come from New Zealand. Certified Organic by the USDA-accredited UK Soil Association. In 2012, Pure Brewed Organic Lager replaced Pure Brewed Lager and Organic Lager; UPC codes are the same as Organic Lager.    Taste    Bright straw-gold color; medium body. Pure barley malt flavor and herbal hops in perfect balance. Clean and crisp, with brilliant conditioning.    Serving Suggestion    As an aperitif, or with Quiche Lorraine, Crab Louis, poached salmon, or grilled halibut. Serve in traditional Samuel Smith tulip glass.    Product Sizes and Quantities    18.7 ounce (550 ml) "Victorian Pint" bottles / 12 per case  12 ounce (355 ml) bottles / 6 - 4 packs per case  Stats    ABV: 5.0% - OG: 1.045 - IBU: 25   Ingredients: Water, organic barley malt, organic hops, yeast.

Name: Sam Smith Organic Strawberry
Description: Samuel Smith's Organic Fruit Beers are brewed and fermented at Melbourn Bros. Brewery in Stamford; then blended, conditioned and packaged at Samuel Smith's Old Brewery in Tadcaster; they are Certified Organic by the USDA-accredited UK Soil Association.    While there are older breweries in England, it would be safe to say that few breweries are so little changed as this gem at Stamford, which has stood in the center of the beautifully preserved market community since 1825. From the antique grist mill to the ancient copper vessels, Melbourn Bros. remains today, a working brewery which blends the traditions of the ancient craft with that of the early industrial revolution. Closed in the 1970s, restoration with respect for the historical brewing equipment was begun by Samuel Smith's in the 1990s.

Name: Samuel Smith Taddy Porter
Description: Brewed with well water (the original well at the Old Brewery, sunk in 1758, is still in use, with the hard well water being drawn from 85 feet underground), malted barley, roasted malt, yeast and hops. Fermented in ‘stone Yorkshire squares’.

Name: Samuel Smith Imperial Stout
Description: Available filtered and pasteurised in clear glass bottles.  Rich, flavorful, deep chocolate color, scented and roasted barley nose. Complexity of malt, hops, alcohol and yeast.

Name: Samuel Smith Organic Pale Ale
Description: A classic malt-accented, copper-colored pale ale in which subtle fruity esters from the Samuel Smith yeast strain interact with caramel flavors - from organic crystal malt - and fresh hops.

Name: Sam Smith India Pale Ale
Description: Brewed with well water (the original well at the Old Brewery, sunk in 1758, is still in use, with the hard well water being drawn from 85 feet underground); best malted barley and a generous amount of choicest aroma hops; fermented in ‘stone Yorkshire squares’ to create an exceptionally full-flavoured complex ale with an abundance of maltiness and fruity hop character.

Name: Samuel Smith India Ale
Description: Taste    A restrained maltiness and an emphasis on the aroma and flavor of hops from England’s finest farms: floral, herbal hops show in the aroma and finish, but bitterness is balanced, refined and elegant.    Serving Suggestion    Green chili and lime pickle, mulligatawny soup, pork with vinegar and garlic, chicken with a roasted coconut sauce, fish on a bed of potatoes, onions and tomato masala, prawns curry and duck risotto. Serve in nonik pint glasses.

Name: Samuel Smith Pure Brewed Organic Lager
Samuel Smith Organic Apricot
Description: Samuel Smith's Organic Fruit Beers are brewed and fermented at Melbourn Bros. Brewery in Stamford; then blended, conditioned and packaged at Samuel Smith's Old Brewery in Tadcaster; they are Certified Organic by the USDA-accredited UK Soil Association.

Name: Samuel Smith Organic Strawberry Fruit Ale
Description: Strawberries offer a soft and subtle flavour, making the character of this fruit beer extremely sophisticated and refined. The smooth malt and aromatic strawberry flavours merge together in an elegant fashion, with fresh, ripe strawberries shining through.

Name: Parallel 49 Lost Soul Chocolate Pumpkin
Description: All treat, no trick: this rich, robust Chocolate Pumpkin Porter is so good, even the living dead will indulge.

Name: Parallel 49 Jerkface 9000 Wheat Ale
Description: Hey you! Yeah... I'm talking to you, buddy. How about you grab a bottle of this Mosaic hopped American wheat beer and cram it down your pie hole. Did I hurt your feelings? Too friggin' bad. When it's this good, you ain't gotta be nice about it.  An easy drinking American wheat ale dry hopped with Mosaic Hops. Juicy citrus, tropical, and floral hop notes sit atop a light grainy malt base giving the beer a very flavourful hop punch with a light refreshing body.

Name: Cabana Hammock Hefeweizen Recy
Description: Pilsner, Munich and Wheat malts are used in combination with a traditional German yeast to create this refreshing Hefeweizen. This unfiltered yeast provides banana and clove flavors with a rich and lasting finish.

Name: Parallel 49 Wild Ride
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: This Belgian-style golden strong is finished with Brettanomyces - exploding with funky and fruity flavours. A good mix between classic style Belgian beer and a new age funk.

Name: Parallel 49 Trifecta
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Annnnd they're off! Hold on to your hats folks, we added a trifecta of hops to this Hefe. Place your bets on Winning Brew, this thoroughbred is going to win, place and show with its triple crown combo of hoppy, spicy and fruity aromas.  This beer upholds the banana and clove character of a traditional German Hefeweizen while adding a unique twist. Trifecta is dry-hopped with Huell Melon, Meridian and Saphir hops which add notes of strawberry, kiwi, lime and Jasmin Tea and give it a fruit smoothie-like impression.

Name: Parallel 49 Ugly Sweater Milk Stout
Description: A North American take on a classic English style of beer. This beer is brewed as a smooth tasting stout and sweetened using milk sugar (lactose). The sweetness plays an integral part in balancing the roasted malts that give the beer it’s dark colour.

Name: Parallel 49 Filthy Dirty IPA
Description: With Pale, Crystal and Carapils malts, and Chinook, Centennial, Simcoe, Amarillo, Citra and Ahtanum hops.

Name: Parallel 49 Snap, Crackle, Hop Imperial Rice IPA
Description: Pour this medium-bodied Imperial IPA for a bit of snap and crackle - and plenty of hop. Brewed with Motueka hops from New Zealand, it starts dry and finishes crisp.

Name: Parallel 49 Black Hops Cascadian Dark Lager
Description:
Parallel 49 recommends the use of hop grenades for self-defence purposes only.

This Cascadian Dark Lager balances malty richness and flavours of burnt toffee and caramel with the spicy, citrusy character of Cascadian hops.

Name: Parallel 49 Craft Pilsner
Description: Our Craft Pilsner is inspired by the traditional Czech Pilsner style and is brewed with Saaz and Saphir hops with a blend of Moravian and Canadian Pilsner malt. This beer is crisp and refreshing with a rich and complex bready maltiness complimented by the slightly spicy and floral hop character. Craft Pilsner pours pale gold and has a creamy, long-lasting head. It’s extremely sessionable and a fantastic ode to the classic style.

Name: Parallel 49 Craft Lager
Description: Standing tall over Clark Drive you'll find the iconic East Van cross. Here you'll find a light, clean lager with a hint of malt and subtle hop flavour standing tall over the others; an iconic East Van beer.  Clean, crisp and refreshing. A pale lager brewed with all malted barley and local Sterling hops grown at Sartori Cedar Ranch in Chilliwack, BC. Fermented cool using a traditional German lager yeast.

Name: Parallel 49 Tricycle Radler
Description: Our European-style Radler is the drink of champions. Tart grapefruit juice and crisp lager combine for a refreshing summer hybrid - it’s like rocket fuel for leisure times.

Name: Parallel 49 Schadenfreude Pumpkin
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Tall Grass Zombie Monkey
Description: Zombie Monkie is a dark, rich porter, carefully brewed for the post-apocalyptic world to come. Crafted with lots of roasty dark chocolate and specialty malts, then inoculated with enough hops to add a floral/citrus character in the finish. It’s hardy, complex, and interesting, because you might be drinking it for a long time

Name: Tallgrass Brewing Co. Wooden Rooster
Description: This beer is a Belgian Tripel that lives up to its name. Smooth and carefully crafted like a fine velvet painting, but with an 8.5% ABV this bird has some spurs! The beer pours a golden straw color with brilliant clarity. Topped with a lofty pure white head the beer has a wonderful floral nose, with subtle fruit notes. The taste is clean and crisp, with subtle fruit notes and a touch of candy like sweetness. The beer has a Champagne-like effervescent that provides a crisp offset to its sweet finish. While a pint glass is always nice, Velvet Rooster would also be at home in a tulip glass or Champagne flute.

Name: Tallgrass Songbird
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: It’s no secret that we love hops at Tallgrass. But it’s not always about beers with huge hop flavor; sometimes we use hops in a more subtle fashion.We also use the dry-hopping process in a more delicate beer like Songbird Saison to create a refreshing Belgian-style ale where apricot and lemon flavors mingle with fresh-cracked pepper and citrus notes. Landing at 4.8% with a light, dry finish, Songbird is gentle on the palate, soars with flavor and is totally crushable.Take flight with this easy drinking beer that is loaded with complex flavor. Click on the image below to find Songbird in markets near you.

Name: Tallgrass Brewing Co. 8-Bit Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Just like those classic video games we all grew up with, 8-Bit Pale Ale seems spectacularly simple at first, yet remarkably fun and complex when you get into it. Our Hop-Rocket* infuses the character of Australian grown Galaxy Hops into and American Pale Ale, giving a unique tropical almost melon aroma in a classic American Style.

Name: Tallgrass 16-Bit Double Pale Ale
Description: 16-Bit Double Pale Ale is the next generation of pale ale from Tallgrass, a one-pint finishing move that delivers a sweeping sequence of crisp aromas, light body, bright hoppiness and striking citrus flavors. In the realm of pale ales, we wanted to have a bigger beer (more ABV, more IBUs) that also was smoother, more refined and more drinkable.

Name: Tallgrass Raspberry Jam Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Raspberry Jam was initially developed at our brewpub, the Tallgrass Tap House. It became an instant hit and we decided it should “go on tour” as part of the Tallgrass lineup. Its crisp, natural tartness is balanced by the addition of raspberries, creating a sour wheat ale that’s light-bodied and refreshing.

Name: Bourbon Barrel Aged Buffalo Sweat Oatmeal Cream Stout
Description: Bourbon Barrel Buffalo Sweat is the second barrel-aged release from Tallgrass Brewing Co. We took our award-winning oatmeal cream stout and aged it in bourbon barrels to create a rich, complex, medium-bodied beer with a chocolate-espresso flavor and aroma, and warm bourbon undertones.

Name: Tallgrass Big Ricc Russian Imperial Stout
Description: Several years in the making and hitting shelves for the first time in October 2015, Big RICC is large and in charge. A big, bold Russian Imperial Stout, Big RICC rolls in at 10.5% ABV and packs a punch. Every batch is brewed with 200 pounds of coffee from Radina’s Coffeehouse & Roastery right here in our hometown of Manhattan, Kansas!

Name: Tallgrass Brewing Co. Buffalo Sweat Stout
Description: If you only try one dark beer in your life, try a Buffalo Sweat. It will change your entire perception of how a stout should taste. Our secret is milk sugar. The creamy sweetness of the milk sugar is not lost in the brewing process and beautifully complements the copious quantities of the dark-roasted barley to create a medium-bodied beer that is rich, complex, and delicious with a definitive espresso-chocolate aroma and flavor.

Name: Tallgrass The Grizz Imperial IPA
Description: What does it mean to “Be a Grizz?” Being a Grizz means going big in everything you do. It’s a mindset, an unofficial company motto we’ve followed for years. It’s what caused us to double the amount of roasted barley and lactose used while developing Buffalo Sweat, which took it from an average test beer to our #1 brand! It’s also what inspired us to go all-in with 16 oz. cans for our year-round beers and seasonal brands when we switched from bottles in 2010, a decision that helped the brewery achieve tremendous growth.

Name: Tallgrass Ethos
Description: Ethos is no ordinary IPA. Crafted from a palette of six hop varieties and then double dry-hopped with three different types of hops, this beer has an aroma that is big, bright and beautiful and a taste that explodes with juicy hop flavors, with notes of pine, resin, grapefruit and caramel.

Name: 3 Stars Peppercorn Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Slightly sweet fruity nose, hints of grass and coriander, smooth underlying bitterness, clean dry finish, smooth lingering citrus notes.

Name: 3 Stars Desolation
Description: Immediately you are struck by a huge black coffee component in the nose, and this accompanies you through the first sip, across your palate, and through the finish. Big roasty malt notes continue with a complex rye character on the finish.

Name: 3 Stars Pandemic Porter
Description: grain bill: 2 Row, Wheat, Chocolate Malt, Crystal, Rolled Oats & Black Patent Malt hops: Tettnanger and Willamette, cold steeped espresso added during secondary fermentation flavor profile: Huge roasted malt and coffee nose, lots of chocolate and roasted malt flavors up front, finishes smooth with strong coffee flavors and slight hints of alcohol. Lingering chocolate and coffee flavors, with smooth malt sweetness. food pairing: This beer can be paired with many different foods; best with big flavors like game, salmon, roasts and BBQ. Also works very well paired with desserts like crème brulee, gelato, and chocolate cake.

Name: 3 Stars Citra & Lemon Peel Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Bright & refreshing with subtle citrus notes and a touch of tartness from the lemon peel and hops.

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: 3 Stars Diamonds Are Forever
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Tasting Notes: Grapefruit, Hoppy, Nectarine, Peach, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description: Diamonds Are Forever is highly sessionable, with a soft and pillowy mouthfeel laying down a pleasant base to let the hops shine. Double dry hopped with Amarillo, Mosaic, and Citra notes of fresh tangerine, peaches, and grapefruit dominate this easy drinking hazy pale ale.

Name: 3 Stars Can’t You See the Sunshine
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: This refreshing slightly tart ale is perfect for warm DC nights. Brewed with Pilsen, White Wheat, and Carapils malts, this kettle sour gets an addition of lime to create a crisp, effervescent, tart but not overpoweringly sour crusher. Medium bodied, spritzy, the first sip leaves you refreshed and looking forward to the next sip.

Name: 3 Stars Sabertooth Unicorn Sour
Description: Barrel fermented sour w/ honey

Name: 3 Stars Funky Boss Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Barrel aged American Wild Ale. Done in collaboration with RAR.

Name: 3 Stars Bout That Life
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Tasting Notes: Acidic, Bright, Earthy, Fruity, Funky, Sour
Description: Bout That Life is a bright, champagne-like wild ale produced exclusively with twelve strains of brettanomyces and lovingly aged for two years in stainless steel. Full bodied and fruity, this complex farmhouse ale exhibits notes of barnyard, sweet hay, honey and lemon drop candies.

Name: 3 Stars Brewing Ghost IPA
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Chicken, Fruit - Citrus, Salads  Greens
Description: Bright, light, citrusy and crisp with a lingering hop bitterness. Featuring CTZ, Amarillo, Citra & Simcoe hops

Name: Haze to the Dome – Double IPA
Description: Double IPA DDH with Vic Secret, Azacca and CTZ hops - In addition to the nice crisp Pilsen base malt, we’ve now added hundreds of pounds of oats and wheat to soften the mouth feel and add to the haziness as the hops bond with the London III yeast to create juicy flavors like pineapple, passionfruit, citrus and ripe mango.

Name: Barrier Money IPA
Description: You got Money on your mind. Now you hold Money in your hand. 500 mill to be exact. Smells stanky. Piece of advise? Don't save your Money. Party like a rockstar. Get air like you just don't care. Because when you go through all your Money, we'll make more. Cha-Ching!

Name: Barrier Green Room Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Barrier Tanto IPA
Description: American style IPA brewed with ID007, Motueka, Citra and Chinook

Name: Barrier Nothing Is Too Much
Description: Brewed in collaboration with Tap and Barrel for their 7th Anniversary. Triple India Pale Ale is Double Dry Hopped with Mosaic, Citra and Brewed with Tangerine, Mango, and Peach Purée

Name: Barrier No Rules Just Reservations
Description: India Pale ale brewed with our friends Aslin Beer Company

Name: Barrier It’s A Sweater
Description: This India Pale Ale is dry hopped with Citra and Centennial.

Name: Barrier/Hackney Kronk 2X IPA
Description: Brewed in collaboration with Hackney. Imperial version of Kapow!

Name: Barrier Jump In The Line
Description: Collaboration with Magnify Brewing Company. Double dry-hopped with Citra, Simcoe, Calypso and Citra lupulin powder.

Name: Barrier Lomax Summer IPA
Description: A Summer India Pale Ale dry-hopped with Simcoe, Centennial & Mosaic.

Name: Heavy Seas Loose Cannon
Description: Our flagship beer, Loose Cannon wins people over at first smell. The carefully cultivated interplay of Simcoe, Palisade, and Centennial creates a most fragrant IPA—its nose bursts with notes of grapefruit, herbs, and pine. Bitterness is somewhat subdued by the floral quality that pervades the taste. The color is burnished gold, and the mouthfeel is creamy. A strong malt backbone balances out the triple-hopped beer. Its nickname, Hop3, comes from the brewing process: our brewers hop Loose Cannon in the boil, the hopback, and the fermenter. It won a second place CAMRA award at the 2010 Great British Beer Festival.

Name: Heavy Seas Tropicannon
Description: Our brand new citrus IPA is exploding with bright citrus aroma and flavor. Creating an exciting new variation on our flagship Loose Cannon, TropiCannon clocks in at the same 7.25%ABV as its cousin, but packs a full blast of blood orange, grapefruit, mango and lemon flavor. We've downplayed some of Loose Cannon's piney-ness and amped up the citrus by swapping Centennial and Palisade hops for Amarillo and even more Simcoe. We've introduced dried grapefruit, orange and lemon peel in the brewing process and added mango, blood orange and more grapefruit post-fermentation.

Name: Heavy Seas Double Cannon Double IPA
Description: Hop aromas blast out of this flavor explosion. Massively dry-hopped, with a balanced malt sweetness, this irresistible force showcases the power of bringing in the extra artillery. Hop cubed - then squared (hop to the sixth)! We've kept the same malt recipe proportions as Loose Cannon, pumped up to 22 Plato (from 16.5) and then doubled the hops. We employed the late addition, whirlpool, hopback, and dry-hopping process that makes Loose Cannon such a flavorful IPA. We've captured the beautiful balance of Loose Cannon but we've doubled the firepower.

Name: Heavy Seas Greater Pumpkin
Description: In the most worthy of pumpkin patches and during the silence of the midnight hour, the Greater Pumpkin raises up and pours a rich deep and burnished orange color. Heady aromas of bourbon, cinnamon, ginger, allspice and clove linger seductively over the thick white head of this tremendous brew. Its love at first sip as the full malt body, dominated by British crystal malt, brown sugar and pumpkin, slowly washes over your tongue. Bourbon barrel aging rounds out the flavors with notes of oak, vanilla, and bourbon. Pairs well with crisp autumn weather, crunchy fallen leaves, and the knowledge that your kids will be asleep soon so you can raid their Halloween candy bags.

Name: Heavy Seas Blackbeards Breakfast Porter
Description: Blackbeard's Breakfast is a robust porter with a new world twist. Aged in bourbon barrels and brewed with Chesapeake Bay Roasting Company's Dark Sumatra coffee, this porter is flavorful and complex. Featuring unique English malts, this brew will have strong notes of caramel and a slight nut character. Paired with bourbon notes and the sumptuous Sumatran Coffee, Blackbeard's breakfast will please coffee and beer connoisseurs alike.

Name: Heavy Seas Red Flag
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Fruit - Dried, Lamb, Mushrooms
Description: Brewed in the classic Flemish Red style, Red Flag is brewed in small batches on our 15 Barrel Brewhouse. Each batch is then aged in stainless as well as bourbon and red wine barrels. After barrel aging each barrel is hand selected and blended to create the most complex and seductive sour ale possible. Red Flag is our first sour offering in the Uncharted Waters series. Deep ruby in color, this barrel aged sour ale delights with sweet malt tones, deep complex fruit undertones, and a deliciously tart finish. Send up the Red Flag, a storms a’brewin’ and it’s gonna rock the boat!

Name: Heavy Seas AmeriCannon Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The newest addition to the Cannon Crew, AmeriCannon is a bold pale ale that's been double dry-hopped with Centennial hops and Simcoe lupulin hop powder. With an ABV that won't turn you into a Loose Cannon, it's a true celebration of American independence. The first Heavy Seas beer to utilize lupulin hop powder, AmeriCannon is an intensely flavorful Pale Ale. AmeriCannon is also the first Heavy Seas beer to carry the Brewers Association Independent Craft seal, AmeriCannon embodies everything that Heavy Seas stands for: We are Fearless. Bold. Independent.

Name: Heavy Seas Peg Leg
Description: This full-bodied imperial stout pours an opaque mahogany color with a tan head. Its smell is dominated by notes of roasted coffee beans, with a slight hint of chocolate, but Simcoe and Fuggles hops add complexity to the aroma. The roasted barley is detectable in the taste, and this complements the bitterness from the Target hops - balancing out the sweetness from the load of malts used in brewing Peg Leg. A creamy mouthfeel makes this a smooth, utterly drinkable beer.

Name: Heavy Seas Siren Noire
Description: Our Siren Noire isn’t your father’s chocolate stout. We’ve used almost 3 pounds of Belgian coco nibs per barrel. We’ve aged it for five weeks in bourbon barrels with vanilla beans added. A mix of dark malts gives Siren Noire a well-rounded body that is decidedly chocolatey—but without being extraordinarily sweet. Brewers Gold hops contribute an earthy spiciness, with notes of black current.

Name: Heavy Seas Dat Booty Doe Märzen
Description: Dat Booty Doe is an Oktoberfest-style lager that we brewed in collaboration with Reagan and Bethany from MIX 106.5! This malty, biscuity and balanced Oktoberfest will be sure to get you in the fall mood. A portion of all 4 packs sold will go to the Maryland Food Bank! Cheers to feeding friends & good beer!

Name: Heavy Seas Pounder Pils
Description: Made with German malts and a plethora of European hops, Pounder Pils is an American interpretation of a classic European Style. Exhibiting a crisp malt backbone and an herbaceous hop profile, this Pilsner is quaffable and refreshing. This year-round offering is smooth and elegant showcasing a bright yet zesty botanical aroma.

Name: Heavy Seas Smooth Sail Ale
Description: Smooth Sail gets its name from its deliciously drinkable taste. We use lemon and orange peel to give it a pleasant, citrusy finish and wheat malt for its round mouthfeel. Light, bright, and too smooth for school.

Name: Heavy Seas Seasonal
Description:
We offer 4 seasonal selections in 12oz cans:

Starting in January:
HYDRA'S HAZE - Hazy IPA - One of our haziest beers yet, Hydra’s Haze is one monster of a beer. Brewed with a ridiculous amount of Citra® and Galaxy® hops, this beer isn’t shy about its juiciness. From its dank aroma to its powerful citrus finish, Hydra’s Haze packs an intense hop experience. Catch it while you can- this limited beer will only be lurking for a short period of time. 6.0% ABV

Starting in April:
SMOOTH SAIL - Wheat Ale - Smooth Sail gets its name from its deliciously drinkable taste. We use lemon and orange peel to give it a pleasant, citrusy finish and wheat malt for its round mouthfeel. Light, bright, and too smooth for school. 4.5%ABV

Starting in June:
SUNBURST - Fruited Sour Ale - Bursting with raspberry puree and lemon juice,  Sunburst is as tart as it is fruity. Its subtle raspberry sweetness and refreshing lemon pop makes this beer a real thirst-quencher. 
We recommend pairing this beer with a whole lot of sunshine and a beach chair. 4.5% ABV

Starting in September:
NIGHT SWELL - Dark IPA - Night Swell’s arctic winds and northern tides make their way south, a darkness descends upon the Atlantic, and even the most hardened hop heads feel the pull of the darkness. Night Swell's nor'easter blast of hoppy aromas combines with a warming dark roast and rich malt sweetness for a full-flavored, full-bodied IPA that stretches the boundaries of the style. Surrender to the darkness and ride the swell. 7.5% ABV

Name: Urban Village Dietz Nuts
Description: This was done in partnership with Dietz & Watson to create a beer that emulated their Honey Maple Smoked Dietz Nuts. We used wildflower honey, dark maple syrup, applewood smoked malts and a variety of roasted malts to achieve the flavor profile we are looking for. This beer will have aromas similar to bacon or ham coming from the smoked malts paired with the honey and syrup. Those flavors will come through in more nuanced way on the palate and compliment the coffee and dark chocolate flavors of the porter.

Name: Urban Village Merry Xmas
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: the perfect beer for the holidays. delicious blend of fruits & spices including orange, juniper berry, ginger, cinnamon, coriander & eldeflower

Name: Urban Village Tyson
Description: Loaded with roasted chocolate malts and finished with a touch of cinnamon and vanilla bean

Name: Urban Village Super Villain
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Weihenstephaner Oktoberfest Bier
Description: It’s that time of year again – Oktoberfest is here – and what better way to celebrate than with a beer straight from Bavaria, made in the oldest brewery in the world? The Weihenstephaner Oktoberfestbier (also known simply as Festbier in certain markets) pours a brilliant, clear, golden color capped by a nice crop of white foam that retains fairly well before leaving behind some lace as it drops to a persistent collar. Unlike some other Oktoberfest-style beers, which are often very focused on doughy/bready malts, this brew offers a much more balanced approach, and actually leans a bit more towards the hoppy end of the spectrum. The malt presence is there on the nose, offering a bit of a bready, crackery quality, but we found the European noble hops really shine through, presenting a grassy, herbal, and lightly earthy quality bolstered with some notes of lemon pith. Expect a well-balanced beer on the palate, with a fairly substantial core of pils malt offering a touch of honey-like sweetness, while the hops balance with a lemony zing and a spicy herbal character that does a good job of drying out this festbier in the finish. Like all of the Weihenstephaner beers, this one is supremely drinkable; try pairing with grilled spicy sausages, pierogies, pizza, or spicy chicken dishes. Prost!

We hope you like the brew that inspired our drive.

Name: Bronx Brewery City Island Sour IPA
Description:
A slightly sour, crisp and refreshing Northeast IPA with a juicy punch. 

City Island debuted as an Up & Comer in the spring of 2019, as the latest in our series of limited-edition beers paired with rising-star artists — featuring can art by the great Mason Eve. It was supposed to be around just for the summertime. But after our fans kept asking if it’d be available when the temps dropped, we didn’t have much of a choice.

On Aug. 1, 2019, City Island became the first-ever sour beer to join our year-round rotation. That’s why on every can, you’ll see ‘Born in the spring. Raised in the summer. Perfect for every season’ — including the times of the year when you need to carry your sunshine with you.

With Bronx Summer, we hope to make it that much easier. We brew it with citrusy hops and lemon peel making it a refreshing remedy for keeping cool when the city starts to sweat.

Name: Finch’s Beer Co. Golden Wing Blonde
Description: Finch's Blonde Ale is an easy drinking and approachable American craft beer. It has a moderately sweet malty aroma and is deep gold in color. We like to think of this particular one as more of a 'Dirty Blonde.' When you first pour it, a soft lacey foam clings to the glass as malty aromas fill your nose and linger to the final sip. Upon finish, this blonde turns heads with a smooth finish and a touch of bitterness in the aftertaste. Enjoy this medium-bodied craft beer anytime of year.

Name: Finch’s Beer Co. Wet Hot American Wheat
Description: Wet Hot American Wheat is named for its particularly 'wet' mash, 'hot' initial fermentation temperature and being in the style category of American Wheat Ale. It is brewed and dry hopped with Centennial and Columbus hops and utilizes two different kinds of wheat: malt-white wheat and Torrified wheat. This beer has an initial sweetness that is balanced by hop additions late in the boil.

Name: Finch’s Pale Ale
Description: Finch's Pale Ale is an American style Pale Ale featuring Crystal and Munich malts to give it a nice sweet, biscuit malt flavor with a hop punch from Cascade and Simcoe for a citrus, dank aroma. At 5.2% ABV and 40 IBUs this beer is easy to drink on a hot day and packed with flavor to make you want to drink another.

Name: Finch’s Beer Co. Secret Stache Stout
Description: Secret Stache Stout won a gold medal in the stout category at the 2013 United States Open Beer Championship, and then won a silver medal in 2014 in the same category. Heaps of chocolate malt give this beer color as well as chocolate and coffee notes. Vanilla beans and lactose lend to its complexity and full flavor. Torrified wheat is also used for additional body and head retention.

Name: Finch’s Sobek & Set IPA
Description: Sobek & Set is named after the Egyptian gods representing a boar and a crocodile. The beer is dark with mahogany and burgundy highlights. This is achieved by using generous amounts of Briess Midnight Wheat for a dark color and smooth finish without the astringent, roasted qualities. Caramel malt is also present. This beer is balanced with earthy and citrus hops.

Name: Finch’s Hardcore Chimera
Description: Hardcore Chimera is an American style imperial IPA brewed with Citra, Simcoe, Columbus, Cascade and Mosaic hops. The beer won a silver medal at the 2014 International Beer Festival in Rhode Island. Ringing in with over 80 IBUs Hardcore's intense aroma and flavor of passionfruit and citrus is balanced out against a hearty grain bill that lends to Hardcore's deceptively drinkable 9% ABV.

Name: Finch Skull Hammer IPA
Description: Skull Hammer follows up on the popularity of our award winning Hardcore Chimera. This Imperial IPA is a flavorful gateway into the depths of your skull. Nailing the East Coast Style IPA that is more sweet than bitter, this head banger hammers down with the citrussy blend of everyone's favorite hops including Citra, Mosaic, & Simcoe. Whether you are a neurosurgeon, Viking, carpenter, or beer enthusiast, this is the Hammer to reach for.

Name: Finch’s Chimera IPA

Description: Threadless® is the gold medal winner in the IPA category at the 2013 World Expo of Beer, the largest international beer sampling event in Michigan. Our Threadless®/Finch collaboration IPA is a balanced experience of both perceived hoppiness and true bitterness. It pours a darker amber color and finishes with a citrus flavor, and when combined, will require this to be the last IPA you ever drink!

Name: 4 Noses Brewing Company ‘Bout Damn Time IPA
Description: A big American IPA with the hop-head in mind. Loaded with Pacific Northwest hops from the kettle to the fermenter, this IPA packs a massive aroma of bright tropical fruit and refreshing citrus notes. The simplicity of the malt bill allows for a plethora of hop flavors to come through on the pallet, making for an absolutely crushable IPA.

Name: 4 Noses Brewing Company Raspberry Blonde
Description: Raspberry Blonde empowers the senses with a harmonious blend of tart raspberries on top of refreshingly light blonde ale base. Perfect for conquering mountains or your next Netflix series.

Name: 4 Noses Pump Action Imperial Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: •Winning Gold at both Great American Beer Festival & World Beer in 2016• Football season has arrived, pie is in the oven, and the aspens have turned. Time to lock and load your pallet full of cinnamon sticks, nutmeg, allspice, brown sugar and cloves in in this pumpkin behemoth. Packed with over 10 pounds of pumpkin per barrel and a hefty helping of pumpkin pie spices, there is no shortage of fall flavors in this spiced ale.

Name: 4 Noses Brewing Mountain Wave Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description:
Utilizing a refined Mosaic product, we gain access to taste all of the intricate hop flavors interwoven into this simple yet sturdy grain bill. The Mosaic aroma is massive, which allows the lucky drinker to sample with your nose before it even hits your palate. It can almost trick you into thinking that you have something hoppy in your cup, yet carries a very easy drinkability to it. Most of the hops were added after flame out as to not add too much bitterness but add nice touches of papaya and tangerine flavors.

With low bitterness, low alcohol and lower price, this a day drinker and night drinker alike. Mountain Wave showcases the delicacy of the Mosaic hops wonderfully without throwing flavor away. Balanced and Easy, and perfect for your next adventure.

Name: 4 Noses Brewing Company Perfect Drift Pilsner
Description: In honor of our friend Mitch, an avid fly fisherman, Perfect Drift is a smooth and easy drinking twist on a German Style Pilsner. The German malts and lager yeast lend a bready, crisp and mildly sweet flavor of a traditional Pilsner. But, we cast off on our own with a heavy hand of American Cascade hops, generating a citrusy aroma and hop flavor to brighten up this thirst crushing lager. *Available in cans

Name: 4 Noses Brewing Fruit on the Bottom
4 Noses Brewing Under the Palms
Description: Under the Palms is a gose style ale with passion fruit and guava that comes in at a sessionable 4.2%.

Name: 4 Noses Brewing Casey You’re On Mute Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: 4 Noses Cherry Pie Velvet
Description: Milkshake IPA beautifully balanced with cherries and graham crackers. On top of that, we used Monroe hops that push the cherry flavor boundaries even more. With both sweet and tart cherries, the cherry flavor dominates and is rounded out by the subtle vanilla and graham cracker that melds nicely with the rich malts

Name: 4 Noses Mosaic Whimsy
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: 4 Noses Galaxy Whimsy
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: New England IPA brewed with galaxy hops which offer this beer citrusy flavors that get your tastebuds tingling. It also has a fluffy mouthfeel to top it all off. If you want a beer that is smooth with a refreshing kick, this is the beer for you!

Name: Surly Furious IPA
Description: The beer that built Surly. Aggressively hopped and citrusy, with a chewy, caramel malt backbone.

Name: Surly Todd the Axe Man
Description: Double dry-hopping with Citra and Mosaic hops creates this world-renowned IPA’s intense tropical fruit and citrus aromas. Brewed with Golden Promise malt, Axe Man finishes rich and dry.

Name: Surly Xtra Citra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Fish - White, Pork, Shellfish
Description: Bursting with Citra hop flavor and tropical, citrusy notes, this sessionable pale ale showcases Surly’s bright side.

Name: Surly Hell Lager
Description: Hell is German for light. A pale-gold lager with bready malt aromas and flavors, floral hop aroma, and a balanced finish.  Finally, a Surly beer my German mother will drink. She says this one tastes like a bier from back home. Not unlike a Zwickel Bier from Germany, Hell is not filtered and fermented with lager yeast. American hops takes a back seat to the Pils malt sweetness and fresh bread aroma. The color is well… hell (Deutsch for light). It’s fiendishly drinkable, and you don’t have to sell your soul to get another.

Name: Surly First Avenue +1 Golden Ale
Description: An old Minneapolis bus station. An abrasives factory in the ‘burbs. From these humble beginnings sprang the last great rock club in the country and one of America’s leading craft breweries. A collaboration just makes sense.  First Avenue and Surly Brewing are proud to present +1, an easy-drinking, classic-style golden ale ideal for the Mainroom, the Entry, the Turf, or anywhere the music hits you.

Name: Surly Pentagram
Description: 100% Brettanomyces dark beer, fermented in stainless and aged in used red wine barrels. “Brett” is a unique yeast strain that produces flavors that would be offensive if they weren’t intentional. Flavors of sour cherry, tobacco, oak, and classic “Brett” barnyard funk, balanced by Dark Munich malt chewiness. Enjoy immediately or age at cellar temperature for a couple years.

Name: Surly Darkness
Description: This massive Russian Imperial Stout brings waves of flavors; chocolate, cherries, raisins, coffee, and toffee, finishing with a non-traditional dose of aroma hops.

Name: Surly Abrasive Ale
Description: Hazy gold in color, this Oatmeal Double IPA has aggressive aromas of candied grapefruit/tangerine and tropical fruit. Malted oats greatly enhance the body and the high level of bitterness is balanced by this sweetness. Citra hops are used for aroma & flavor additions and for dry-hopping, while Warrior hops are used primarily for bitterness.

Name: Surly Brewing One Man Mosh Pit IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: An absurd dose of Amarillo, Citra, and Mosaic dry-hopping hoists this IPA above the fray. Juicy and hazy, it’s the perfect soundtrack to the music in your head. Running in a circle and shoving yourself optional.

Name: Surly Damien Child of Darkness Ale
Description: From the blackest depths of the brewhouse comes Damien, Child of Darkness. Spawned from the usually discarded remnants of Darkness, Damien is a dry-hopped black ale. Flavors of roasted malt and dark brown sugar suffocated by aromas of tangerine and pine.

Name: Surly Overrated
Description: It's been said; "Its easier to brew an extremely hoppy beer than an extremely balanced beer." And you know us, we are always looking for the easy way out, so we jumped on the West Coast IPA Bandwagon and brewed this dry and hoppy ale. "Surly's a little bit of a one-trick pony, they just brew gimmick beers," and maybe we are OVERRATED, but at the end of the day it's just a beer. If yo like it, great, so do we. If you only liked us when we were small, then leave this one on the shelf. Let one of the fanyboys grab it.

Name: Surly Smoke Lager
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Ebony-hued, Smoke wafts out of the bottle and into your senses, borne on the wings of European traditions, wrapped in American innovation. Lager-brewed, like any true Baltic Porter, with smoked malts from Bamberg, Germany, the home of Rauchbiers, then mellowed by oak-aging. Black malt flavors mesh with notes of raisins, plums, figs and licorice with the subtle smoke on the side, for a complex and luxurious, yet silky smooth drinking experience. It's a sipper at Alc. 8.2% by VOL., but everyone knows you can't have Smoke without fire!

Name: 4 Hands City Wide
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: City Wide American Pale Ale, is our opportunity to make our mark on the St. Louis community by donating a percentage of proceeds to local non-profit organizations. The scope of our mission has always included more than just brewing beer. We strive to be a positive force in the St. Louis community. For every 16 ounce 4 pack sold we will donate $.50 to our partner organizations. The 2016 organizations are each quarterly recipients of the money raised during that time period. Our goal is to empower our consumers, while giving back. 2016 Recipients will be Cherokee Street/Love Park, Grace Hill, Great Rivers Greenway & International Institute.

Name: 4 Hands Chocolate Milk Stout
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Hard Aged, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel
Description: Our Chocolate Milk Stout pours black as the night sky with aromas of dark chocolate, chocolate malt, and more chocolate. With a firm tan head and a rich velvety mouthfeel our Chocolate Milk Stout is a perfect complement to the change of seasons. Pairs wonderfully with beef and of course chocolate.

Name: 4 Hands Divided Sky Rye IPA
Description:
This beer brings together tow of our favorite ingredients; hops and rye - serious hops up front provide a pungent, floral, and citrus character. We use centennial, Columbus, and Cascades in this hop lovers dream. The rye provides a slightly spicy flavor and a full mouth-feel. Divided Sky pours
straw in color with notes of tangerine, grapefruit, and pine.

Name: 4 Hands Single Speed Blonde Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Fruit - Citrus
Description: Our American blonde ale is a soft and delicate ale brewed with pilsner malt and jasmine flower. The addition of jasmine adds a floral and slightly fruity layer. Single speed pours a crisp golden hue with floral undertones. What's your speed? Ours is a Single Speed.

Name: 4 Hands Passion Fruit Prussia
Description:
Passion Fruit Prussia is our non-traditional look at
the classic Berliner Weisse style. Brewed with a generous
amount of passion fruit, this beer pours golden in color
with a nice tart finish. A perfect compliment to the summer
heat.

Name: 4 Hands Brewing Co First Impressions Wheat Ale
Description: First Impressions is a Raspberry vanilla wit with lactose sugar on nitro.

Name: 4 Hands Absence Of Light Peanut Butter Stout
Description: Absence of Light is a milk stout brewed with peanut butter. Chocolate malt dominates the grain bill, backed up by a combination of caramel malts and roasted barley. This provides a very rich, complex flavor with notes of chocolate, coffee, peanut butter and a slightly sweet finish. | ABV 7.1%

Name: 4 Hands Scale Of Complexity Citra IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Southern Hemisphere is light in color, with a ton of haze. This beer is heavily-hopped with Galaxy and Motueka hops, producing strong notes of passionfruit, lime and pineapple, with a tropical, juicy finish. Look for rotating varieties of Scale year-round.

Name: 4 Hands City Pilsner 4 Hands
Description:
City Wide Pils is a classic American Pilsner. This traditional
lager is brewed with American-grown malt and hops. Cold
fermentation with a bottom-fermenting yeast strain results
in a smooth, easy-drinking beer with a clean, crisp finish.

Name: 4 Hands Seasonal
Description: Varies by season!

Name: Molson Canadian
Description: Canada is known around the world for our vast wilderness, thousands of freshwater lakes, and golden Prairie barley fields as far as the eye can see. Our land is packed full of nature at its best. And it’s from this land that we make our signature beer, Molson Canadian. Brewed with Canadian water, prairie barley and no preservatives, the result is a beer as clean, crisp and fresh as the country it comes from.

Name: Molson Golden
Description: Molson Golden is a unique blend of ale and lager that delivers the spicy, fruity flavors of ale, combined with the clean, crisp, refreshing qualities of a lager.

Name: Molson XXX
Description: Molson XXX is a unique, super premium beer that combines 7.3% ABV with the characteristic cold, crisp and clean finish that people have come to expect from Molson brewmasters.

Name: Molson Black Ice
Description: An ‘ice brewed’ beer which has a clean, fresh, snappy taste and a mellow aftertaste from the ice filtering process.

Name: Molson Export
Description: Molson Export is the refreshing, satisfying ale that signals confidence, pride and determination for those that believe that everything tastes more satisfying when you give it your all.

Name: John HR Molson and Bros 1908 Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Molson Ice
Description: Molson Ice is an award-winning brew, slowly fermented with Molson's prize lager yeast and is then ice-filtered just before being bottled.

Name: Molson Canadian Cold Shots
Description: Same great Molson Canadian taste, but with 6% alcohol in a 250ml slim can.

Name: Molson Canadian Victory
Description: CANADIAN truly exemplifies the pride of Canada's young adults and is a reflection of the pride we take as Canadians in brewing world class beer. Starting with crystal clear water, malted barley and the finest hops, CANADIAN is slowly fermented to produce a smooth, refreshing beer with a genuine taste. Clean and clear, crisp and cold CANADIAN is a classic lager.

Name: Molson Special Dry
Description: To beer drinkers who value the genuine friendships they make and keep, Molson Dry is the only lager that provides easy refreshment with no aftertaste so that it sets the scene for naturally simple enjoyment because Molson Dry has a crisp, dry finish with an added 0.5% advantage

Name: Molson Canadian NHL Original Six Variety Pack
Description: Molson Canadian is made from the best this land has to offer: Canadian water, prairie barley, and no preservatives. The result is a beer as clean crisp and fresh as the country it comes from. Molson Canadian. Made from Canada.

Name: Kamenitza 1881
Description: Produced in Bulgaria under the supervision of Belgian Brewmasters.

Name: Carling Black Label Supreme
Description: Black Label is a Canadian brand of lager distributed by Carling and well-known throughout the former British Empire. In several countries, it is also known as Carling Black Label, and in Sweden, it is known as Carling Premier. However, in the United Kingdom it is now known as just Carling in response to public demand for a snappier call at the bar (according to the company).

Name: Molson Carling Black Label Extra Old Stock
Description: A full bodied, robust, hoppy malt liquor with a fruity estery aroma and taste, derived from liberal use of select prairie grown barley, North American hops and a cool unhurried fermentation process. In Newfoundland, still available under the old O Keefe Extra Old Stock name.

Name: Latitude 33 Blonde Cartel Golden Ale
Description: Like the perfect crew, Blonde Cartel has a perfectly balanced cast of characters. It’s a flavorful blonde ale with the right amount of bitterness. At first you’ll experience a floral hop character then a slightly biscuit-like malt flavor. Taste for yourself how this blonde is pulling off unparalleled refreshment.

Name: Latitude 33 Vanilla Porter
Description: A delicious vanilla porter inspired by the melting pot that is America. Loosely based on an English porter but spiced up with whole vanilla beans from Mexico and Madagascar, it’s a deep, rich brown with a mocha head and plenty of luscious vanilla notes in the nose. The flavors are sweet chocolates, spices and smooth cream with just a hint of hoppy bitterness and enough kick to know this is no ordinary porter.

Name: Latitude 33 Lost Cities Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: We stumbled upon this hazy wonder while navigating through the fog of San Diego’s craze for haze. When the clouds clear, Lost Cities Hazy IPA exposes peaks of flavor erupting with juicy citrus—leaving a desire to experience more unparalleled haze. It may be concealed, but this adventurous brew is waiting to be discovered.

Name: Latitude 33 Meridian Myst
Description: Tropical notes. Crushable. Notes of fruity citrus.

Name: Latitude 33 Mangoveza
Description: One for the spicy locals, Mangoveza appeals to all the senses. Fruity, tropical bitterness upfront followed by a short burst of habanero heat provides a complex yet well-balanced IPA. For a culinary adventure, enjoy with your favorite ‘South of the Border’ inspired meal

Name: Latitude 33 Ocean Grown
Description: With many hop varieties grown near the ocean we decided to honor our neighbor with our premiere Double India Pale Ale. Hopped with Motucka, Nelson, Citra and Mosiac, we believe to have found the perfect balance of dank and citrusy hoppiness.

Name: Latitude 33 Camel Corps Ipa
Description: Camel Corps is our interpretation of a classic West Coast / San Diego IPA… but with a bit of a Kiwi twist. A golden straw color with a moderately persistent white head and woody citrus notes in the aroma, American Two-Row and English Pale and Crystal malts offer a dry, but sweet flavor. This is balanced by citrus notes from Cascade hops, and accentuated with pineapple, grapefruit and spices derived from New Zealand Matueka hops. Dry Hopped with Columbus.

Name: Latitude 33 Honey Hips Blonde
Description: She may be sweet as honey, but this daring brew packs a punch. Honey Hips conjures aromas of clover honey and refreshing citrus with a touch of sweetness, making her seductively drinkable. This lady has a fierce passion for unparalleled craft and is bold enough to make your head turn.

Name: Lawson’s Sip of Sunshine IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This lupulin-laden India Pale Ale is packed with juicy tropical fruit character, bright floral aromas and delectable layers of hop flavor. Pour mindfully, inhale deeply and enjoy a tropical vacation in a glass. Always store cold, enjoy fresh and stay cool!

Name: Lawson’s Super Session #4
Description: Our session IPA is so tasty and quaffable that it will leave you craving more! Super Session #4 features full malt flavor and assertive hop character with copious additions of Centennial hops late in the kettle and dry hopping.

Name: Lawson’s Finest Liquids Hopzilla Double IPA
Description: This monster of an India Pale Ale will make you pucker up! Loaded with high-alpha US grown  Summit, Amarillo, Centennial and Cascadian hops. A brawny, dry hopped ale is wicked strong and will terrorize your taste buds, but has enough malt backbone to balance the intense bitterness.

Name: Lawson’s Finest Liquids Above the Clouds
Description: Our crisp, clear golden ale features notes of straw and fresh grain along with a subtle citrusy hop aroma. An approachable and light bodied brew.

Name: Lawson’s Fayston Maple
Description: This seasonal specialty is brewed with organic pale malt and almost two gallons of VT maple syrup per barrel. This cellar aged brew is a huge, rich, and strong stout with a maple twist and is deceivingly drinkable. Designed to keep you warm on sub-zero nights and for sipping with a fine meal or dessert.

Name: Lawson’s Finest Liquids Chinooker’d IPA
Description: Chinooker’d is our traditional American IPA recipe which is chock-full of Chinook hops bursting with pine and citrus aromas. Firm bitterness and a balanced malt profile gives way to waves of flavor.

Name: Lawson’s Finest Super Session IPA #6
Description: Same amazing recipe with different single hop! Galaxy features a passion fruity character along with aromas and flavors of clean citrus, peach, pineapple and tropical fruit. In short, its characteristics are all fruit with no floral, pine, or spice.

Name: Lawson’s Finest Super Session IPA #8
Description: Super Session #8 is designed to be a light and refreshing beer with low alcohol, yet the full hop character of a Session IPA. Each beer in our Super Session series is brewed with with the same malt base and specialty malts but features a different single-hop variety. Super Session #8 is brewed with copious amounts of Mosaic hops. Go ahead, you can have more than one… Cheers!

Name: Lawson’s Super Session #7
Description: Super Session #7 is designed to be a light and refreshing beer with low alcohol, yet the full hop character of a Session IPA. Each beer in our Super Session series is brewed with with the same malt base and specialty malts but features a different single-hop variety. Super Session #7 is brewed with copious amounts of Idaho 7 hops. Go ahead, you can have more than one… Cheers!

Name: Lawson’s Double Sunshine IPA

Name: Lawson’s Sugarhouse IPA

Name: Lawson’s Scrag Mountain Pils
Description: Scrag Mountain Pils was inspired by the traditional Czech Pilsner style. Our house lager is a tribute to the source of Waitsfield’s town water and the aquifer deep beneath Scrag Mountain.

Name: Lawson’s Finest Liquids Maple Nipple
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description:
A big and rich maple ale loaded with Vermont’s finest maple syrup from start to finish. Available for only a limited time.

Our hearty Vermont Maple ale is a unique and tasty brew that is smooth and strong so watch out!

Name: Coconut Hiwa Porter
Description: Brewed with a carfeully crafted malt bill comprised of seven different varieites of malted barley, this robust dark ale has a silky mouthfeel with notes of roasted malt, dark cacao and coffee. The addition of 400 pounds of in-house hand-toast- ed coconut lend a delightful and distinct tropical aroma that carries into the flavor. Cascade hops are used to temper the sweetness and lend a spicy yet subdued complexity.

Name: Pineapple Mana Wheat
Description: Maui Gold Pineapple gives sweet aroma to this smooth-bodied American Wheat beer. Light in both color and body, this beer is an ideal sessionable offering, pouring with a thick, creamy head.

Name: Big Swell IPA
Description: Tropical citrus notes burst from this dry-hopped IPA that is brewed with a variety of Northwestern hops and balanced with Munich and Crystal malts. The flavor begins smooth and malty, and is followed by big citrus, tropical fruit and piney hop notes. Hop profile: Simcoe, Mosaic, Citra, Chinook, Centennial.

Description: European Pilsner malt offers sweetness balanced by a spicy hop profile from the Floral Saaz hops. Bright golden in color and pours with a creamy white head.

Name: Bikini Blonde Lager
Description: Our flagship Munich-style Helles is brewed with Pilsner, Light Munich & a touch of Crystal malts for a differentiating color and sweetness. Complemented by the hop aroma and low bitterness provided by the floral & slightly spicy Sterling and Saaz hops. The result is a clean, crisp & refreshing lager perfect any time.

Name: POG Hard Seltzer
Description: Spiked sparkling water with a hint of natural Passion Fruit, Orange and Guava

Name: Citrus Hard Seltzer
Description: Spiked sparkling water with hint of Key Lime and Lemon

Name: Dragon Fruit Hard Seltzer

Name: Devils Backbone Vienna Lager
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Caramel, Crisp, Malty, Smooth, Toasty
Food Pairing: Beef, Chicken, Cured Meats, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Pork
Description:
This is our Ol’ Faithful. No, it’s not a geothermal phenomenon. It’s the beer everybody, including professional beer judges, just seems to dig. Maybe they like how it’s smooth, medium-bodied, and semi-sweet, while not too heavy or bitter. Maybe it’s the amber color, or the blend of four imported malts balanced by two Germanic hops, or the fact that it takes five weeks to get right. Or maybe it’s all the above.

Gold Medal World Beer Cup 2012. Gold Medal GABF 2012, 2015 & 2016.

Name: Devils Backbone Danzig Baltic Porter
Description: Danzig, which we named after a Baltic Sea town, isn’t for the faint of heart… or mouth. It’s a well-balanced, full-bodied blend of a strong English porter and a Germanic black lager, making it smooth with a sneaky high ABV. The intense mix of malts and hops provides flavors of chocolate, coffee, and caramelized sugar. No wonder it won Bronze at the World Beer Cup 2018. It’s full-on! Hence the lightning bolt on the pack.

Name: Devils Backbone Loved By The Sun
Description: Some of the best summer evenings are spent under the glow of the setting sun with a cold one in hand. We’ll one-up that with a can that changes color with the sun, and a beer that’s low-calorie, and bursting with juicy peach & mango flavors. So, head outside, slow down, and enjoy the delicious show as the cans change color in direct sunlight.

Name: Devils Backbone Eight Point IPA
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Citrus, Crisp, Fresh, Hoppy, Light, Pine, Smooth
Food Pairing: Beef, Chicken, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Lamb, Nuts, Pork, Turkey
Description: The thing about bucks is, they’re big, strong, and they make their presence felt. That notion sorta inspired us to brew Eight Point IPA, the first beer we ever brewed at Devils Backbone. It’s got a nice hoppy presence but is approachable. It’s gold, medium-bodied, and made with four malts, plus brash American hop varieties like Simcoe, Centennial, Comet, Amarillo, and Citrus. We don’t have any proof that a buck would like it, but we’re pretty sure they’d respect it.

Name: Devils Backbone 16 Point IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird, Fruit - Sweet, Lamb, Pasta, Pork
Description: Calling all hop lovers out there! This Imperial IPA is for you. It’s called Sixteen Point because, well it’s pretty obvious we doubled the hops of our Eight Point IPA, right? Anywho. When you combine five imported malts with loud American hops like Cascade, Bravo, Citra, Columbus, Centennial, and Simcoe you get this honey-colored, full-bodied juggernaut of a beer. Hoppy, resin, and herbal.

Name: Devils Backbone München on Hops
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bready, Citrus, Crisp, Fresh, Fruity, Hoppy
Food Pairing: Beef, Dessert - Fruit, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Pork, Root Vegetables
Description: We’ve been brewing world class beers inspired by German traditions for over a decade, so when Spaten, the granddaddy of all Oktoberfest breweries, called on us to collaborate we thought, “Let’s brew the hoppiest new-school German party beer this side of München” (a.k.a. Munich, for our stateside friends). So that’s what we did. München On Hops abides by the Bavarian purity law requiring all-German ingredients, but we gave it some American flair with extra hops straight from the source. Grab a handful of steins and celebrate this Oktoberfest by dancing on benches with your hop-loving frueden.

Name: Devils Backbone Juicy Little Giant
Description: Picture this: you’ve just set up your basecamp at the foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains. After a day of hiking into your favorite forest retreat, you’ve finished your campfire feast and are ready to kick back and enjoy Mother Nature’s show as the sun sets over those Blue Ridge beauties. Juicy Little Giant was brewed to be enjoyed during that special moment of pause. Juicy and citrus notes are paired with a smooth malty backbone for a crisp, low bitterness finish. Not a worry in the world. Well, other than who’s going get up and grab the next round from the cooler.

Name: Devils Backbone Juicy Magic Eye-PA
Description: We may be showing our age, but remember those Magic Eye prints from the 90’s? Yeah, the ones you would stare at and then get jealous of the friends that suddenly saw some trippy 3D image appear? Those were the days. And we’re bringing them back with this 90’s inspired package that’s as cool on the outside as the trendy juice bomb of an IPA on the inside. So, just for old time’s sake, take it Slow by Nature and zone out for a bit. Even if you don’t see the 3D scene, at least you spent 5 minutes doing nothing for the first time in a while.

Name: Devils Backbone Hayesy Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: If you’ve ever stopped by to visit us in the Virginia heartland, you may have met our fearless leader Hayes (he was that guy wearing his famous madras blazer and a fedora while drinking a DB beer and letting out a boisterous belly laugh). Well, he’s a brand new dad these days and to celebrate we had to brew him a beer! This hazy IPA is low on bitterness with tropical aromas and notes of pineapple, guava, and papaya. Just like Hayes, we left this one unfiltered. Cheers to all the dads out there who we can always count on to be the life of the party!

Name: Devils Backbone Schwartz Bier
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Chicken, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Duck  Game Bird, Fruit - Dried, Lamb, Mushrooms, Nuts, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables, Turkey
Description:
We like this beer for lots of reasons. It’s a traditional old world beer style and it’s a lager, so it takes time to make but it also has roasted & toasted malt flavors. And while it’s light to medium in body, it’s black with a quick, crisp finish. Add in six imported malts and two European hop varieties, you’ll taste why this true to style DB favorite is an award winner!

Gold Medal 2014 GABF. Gold World Beer Cup 2016

Name: Devils Backbone Gold Leaf Lager
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - White, Lamb, Nuts, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Tomatoes, Turkey
Description:
While Gold Leaf is on the lighter side, it takes five weeks to perfect this traditional German-style lager. An homage to the days when beers were made 100% from malted barley, Gold Leaf is brewed with four European malts tempered with a touch of three imported hops. Plus, it’s got subtle bready notes. And since it’s not super hoppy or dark, this beer doesn’t hide any flavor inconsistencies. That just keeps us honest.

 GABF Gold Medal 2009 & 2010, Silver 2013.

Name: Devils Backbone O’Fest
Description: Inspired by modern German Oktoberfest bier, O’Fest will make you want to hoist a stein at your local bier hall and say “Prost!” We hear that means “cheers” in German. It’s medium-bodied, golden in color, and tastes smooth, malty & bready thanks to the contemporary blend of malts and hops. You’ll love it whether it’s October or Oktober.

Name: Devils Backbone Bright Pineapple
Description: What’s a sparkling ale? Well, it’s an ale, first of all. But the “sparkling” describes the dry, effervescent, and bubbly mouthfeel. It’s also packed with delicious, all-natural pineapple flavor, low in carbs, and only 85 calories soaking wet. So you can enjoy it without undoing your workout. Or…even if you didn’t get a workout in and you’re just spending your afternoon counting the hot air balloons that float over the Blue Ridge Mountains, this bubbly brew won’t weigh you down!=

Name: Devils Backbone Wine Barrel Aged Glitter Bomb
Description: Every now and then you just want to walk into a party and make everyone else a little jealous. Well folks, here’s your glittery, delicious ticket! Glitter Bomb is a tart little treat for beer and wine lovers alike. We kettle sour this light ale, add wine-like Hallertau Blanc hops during the boil & maturation, and the beer is fermented with Muscat grape juice. For that big, bright finish we age in locally sourced white wine barrels. Just remember, you may need to explain yourself a bit before you ask your friends if they want a Glitter Bomb. Fair warning!

Name: Community Beer Citra Slice IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
This beer is a result of our trips to the Yakima Valley in the Pacific Northwest. This is the most prominent hop-growing region of the U.S., and we are fortunate to work with experienced hop growers to hand-select the most flavorful, aromatic hops around!

We've taken premium Citra hops and expertly blended them with fresh lemon & orange peel. This results in an explosively delicious citrus-forward India Pale Ale bursting with tropical flavors & aromas.

Welcome to our little slice of hop paradise!

Name: Community Whitbier
Description: The mostly-extinct farmhouse breweries of Belgium were notorious for using whatever ingredients were available to them. One of treasures made by these breweries and nearly lost to history was spiced witbier (white beer). Witbier defied an untimely fate, being revived by a man named Pierre Celis who worked in one of the last breweries in Belgium to commercially produce a version of this unique, spiced beer. Celis eventually sold his own witbier brewery and moved to Austin, Texas to open another white beer brewery (Celis White) and the rest is history. ​ In honor of the late and great Pierre Celis, we are proud to offer Community Wit as a warm weather libation, produced locally for our fellow Texans once again. We brew it traditionally using unmalted wheat as our base and lightly spice the kettle with freshly ground sweet and bitter orange peel and coriander seed. The hops are minimal, keeping the focus on the wheat, spices and the unique character contributed by authentic Belgian yeast strains, one of which originated from the same strain that Pierre brought across the Atlantic to America.

Name: Community Brewing Company Razzy Raspberry Witbier
Description: Razzy begins as our World Cup Gold Medal-Winning Witbier, a year-round offering.  After primary fermentaion, we add natural raspberry puree to create a secondary fermentation.     The fresh raspeberry character melds perfectly with this gently-spiced Belgian-style wheat beer!

Name: Community Beer Public Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description:
Public Ale’s name is an ode to a sessionable style that not only has been commonly found in English public houses for centuries, but can be enjoyed today by everyone within our Community.

In reverence to the best ESB’s of England, we brew it with nearly all English ingredients: 100% English malts, a blend of English, German and American hops, our house ale English yeast strain and of course our own crystal clear, filtered water.

The subtle complexities of this beer begin with a base of 100% Maris Otter English pale malt – prized for its superior, rich, bready taste – which adds a malt complexity that is difficult to achieve with modern, higher yielding malt varieties. English crystal malt increases the malt complexity, brings amber color and some residual sweetness, all of which mingles well with the fully expressed fruity esters developed by our house ale yeast during fermentation. While the hops are noticeable, they are part of an integrated whole, leaving the beer well balanced and drinkable.

Name: Community Beer Hop Skinny IPA Low Cal
Description: All the hoppy flavors & aromas you'd expect from a full bodied IPA, but clocking in at 98 calories and 4.5g of carbs! Drink Lo-Cal!

Name: Community Brewing Company Sundial Session IPA
Description: Sundial, a sessionable IPA at only 4.5% ABV, is Community Beer Co.’s newest seasonal release.  When you want hops and a refreshing, crisp beer that’s drinkable all day long, Sundial is the answer.  We keep the grist simple to showcase our delicious hops, and use copious amounts of Centennial, Simcoe and Amarillo hops to give a delightful hoppy aroma and flavor.  Hop bitterness is present, but dialed back with just enough to balance the malt and contribute to the refreshing nature of our new favorite summer beer!

Name: Community Texas Lager
Description: A light bodied, crisp & refreshing lager, brewed for all Texans to enjoy!

Name: Community Brewing Company Razzy Raspberry Witbier
Description: Razzy begins as our World Cup Gold Medal-Winning Witbier, a year-round offering.  After primary fermentaion, we add natural raspberry puree to create a secondary fermentation.     The fresh raspeberry character melds perfectly with this gently-spiced Belgian-style wheat beer!

Name: Excel 2nd Anniversary Imperial Porter
Description: Baltic Style Porter celebrating our 2nd Anniversary brewed with chocolate and coconut, aged in rye whiskey barrels.

Name: Excel Flash Bang Wheat Ale
Description: Hoppy and refreshing, this unfiltered American wheat beer is brewed and dry hopped with copious amounts of Amarillo hops, giving it distinct grapefruit and tropical notes.

Name: Excel 3rd Anniversary Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Excel Southside Stout
Description: Roasted barley and dark caramel malts combine with citrusy American hops creating this Dark American Stout from Breese’s Southside.

Name: Excel Eastside IPA
Description: Intensely hoppy without the palate destroying bitterness. Notes of tropical fruit, lemon zest, and pine combine in this West Coast Style IPA brewed on the Eastside.

Name: Excel Piasa Pilsner
Description: Named after the mysterious winged beast that haunts the bluffs along the Illinois side of the Mississippi, this pre-prohibition style pilsner celebrates the early American take on classic German pilsners.

Name: Excel Lefty’s Lager
Description: Munich Style Helles Lager. A classic, easy drinking German beer named after Excel’s founding father, Edward “Lefty” Meier. After catching a bankrobber, he used the reward money on a used bottling machine and the rest is history.

Name: Excel Oktoberfest
Description: Malty and smooth, our traditional German style Märzen lager is brewed to celebrate the fall months.

Name: Excel Piasa Pilsner
Description: Named after the mysterious winged beast that haunts the bluffs along the Illinois side of the Mississippi, this pre-prohibition style pilsner celebrates the early American take on classic German pilsners.

Name: Excel El Pistolero Lager
Description: Amber in color, this traditional Vienna Style Lager is fermented and lagered with a yeast strain sourced from a very famous brewery in Mexico City.

Name: Excel Sugarfire Smoked Lager
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Created in conjunction with our good friends at Sugarfire Smokehouse, this German style lager is brewed with malt smoked by the pitmasters themselves. The result is a light, pleasing smoke character that pairs perfectly with great BBQ.

Name: Excel 2nd Anniversary Imperial Porter
Description: Baltic Style Porter celebrating our 2nd Anniversary brewed with chocolate and coconut, aged in rye whiskey barrels.

Name: Excel Bruja Imperial Pumpkin Ale
Description: An Imperial Pumpkin Ale brewed with cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, and allspice, and then aged in Añejo Tequila barrels.

Name: Excel Bose Roggen Rye Schwarzbier
Description: Our “Evil Rye” Schwarzbier (black lager) is brewed with 50% rye malt and chocolate rye. Dark, crisp and smooth with a spicy rye finish.

Name: Cisco Brewers Whale’s Tale Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Turkey
Description: An amber English-style ale that has a nice balance between hops and malt. It's the most popular of our beers and the most versatile in terms of pairing with food or people.

Name: Cisco Brewers Grey Lady Wheat Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cured Meats, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Shellfish, Turkey
Description: The name "Grey Lady" comes from the nickname for the often-foggy island for which it is brewed. This hazy, Belgian-style Wit emits a complex, earthy nose with sophisticated notes. The sift, malty mid-palate has wicked good zesty hints but gives way to a delectably dry finish.

Name: Cisco Brewers Gripah Grapefruit IPA
Food Pairing: Beef, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Fruit - Sweet
Description: "Gripah" or Cisco's Grapefruit IPA gets its tropical fruit flavors from the zest of the ruby red grapefruit along with additions of Citra, Amarillo, Galaxy and El dorado hops. Our brewers have gotten a grip on the perfect balance between sweet and tart resulting in a real grapefruit explosion which launches your taste buds to the top floor.

Name: Cisco Brewers Wandering Haze Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Peach, Smooth, Stone Fruit, Tropical Fruit
Description: This refreshing, juicy and delicious IPA will brighten your taste buds with notes of citrus and peach, and is a Cisco Brewers’ take on a New England-style, hazy IPA. And Cisco should know a thing or two about New England beer – they’ve been putting out tasty brews on Nantucket since 1995. Wandering Haze is mid-bodied, and carries a tropical fruit taste and smooth finish, at 6.8% ABV.

Name: Cisco Brewers Shark Tracker Light Lager
Description: This golden, crisp, light-bodied lager was developed in partnership with the men and women of OCEARCH - a leading non-profit organization focusing on the research, tagging and monitoring of White Sharks in the Atlantic Ocean. Cisco Brewers donates a portion of proceeds from every sale to OCEARCH.

Name: Cisco Brewers Getaway IPA
Description: A Coastal Getaway in a beer - this IPA is a big and bold West Coast IPA packing a ton of hop flavor at 6.5%. It's a sessionable IPA, inspired by the days spent on a drive-on beach, away from it all. Taste the getaway in every sip.

Name: Cisco Brewers Sankaty Light Lager
Description: This 126 calorie lager with wonderful balance and strong hop finish is unlike most light beers. Reminiscent of an IPA but smooth and easy to drink. It is named after the famous lighthouse that has stood on a bluff on the south eastern side of Nantucket Island since 1849. Perched precariously 88 feet above the raging Atlantic Ocean, Sankaty Head Light is in danger of falling prey to beach erosion. The lighthouse is the most powerful in New England.
