Name: Bale Breaker Topcutter IPA
Description: Our flagship IPA is a well-balanced yet aggressive West Coast IPA that showcases Yakima Valley hops at their finest. Late additions of Simcoe®, Citra®, Ahtanum™, and Mosaic™ give this beer its complex citrus, fruity, and floral aroma and flavor. Named for a unique piece of farm equipment that removes hop vines from the trellis during the annual hop harvest, Topcutter IPA delivers loads of hoppiness all year long.

Name: Bale Breaker Field 41 Pale Ale
Description: Don’t be fooled by the powerful hop aroma of Field 41 Pale Ale. Heavily dry-hopped with Simcoe® and Ahtanum™, this perfectly sessionable Pale Ale drinks easy with a smooth bitterness and is named for the hop field that is home to Bale Breaker Brewing Company. Light and refreshing, it’s the perfect beer for a day on the river or afternoon on the slopes. - See more at: http://www.balebreaker.com/beer/detail.html?varietyid=2#sthash.xtxKpFPg.dpuf

Name: Bale Breaker Dormancy Stout
Description:
Who says Bale Breaker only does hoppy?  Conditioned on locally-roasted coffee beans by Yakima's Lincoln Avenue Coffee Co, this rich, dark brew reminds us that good things still happen while hop fields lay dormant in the off-season.

Malt is dominant with flavors and aromas of roasted malt, coffee, and chocolate. Secondary flavor and aromas may include dried fruits, toffee, molasses, raisin, vanilla, and smoke. Balanced sweetness and medium-full body with moderate bitterness.

Name: Bale Breaker Bottomcutter IIPA
Description: Double dry-hopped with homegrown Yakima hops, Bottomcutter IIPA may be light in color but is packed with citrus and pine hop character.  This Imperial IPA is brewed to finish dry, perfect for the combination of Citra®, Simcoe®, and Ekuanot™ hops.  As the bottomcutter is a tractor that leads the topcutter through the fields during harvest, this beer will lead to a new appreciation for our valley’s hops.

Name: Bale Breaker Fresh Off The Farm IPA
Description: The Official Beer of Seattle Beer Week 2017, Fresh off the Farm IPA was brewed in the center of hop field #41, just minutes from downtown Yakima, by Bale Breaker Brewing Company. Founded by fourth-generation hop growers, this truly farm-to-glass brewery crafted a brand-new IPA to celebrate the 9th Annual Seattle Beer Week. A big hop aroma on a clean Pilsner malt base perfectly showcases a few of the newest and most exciting hop varieties off their family’s hop farm. Whirlpool additions of Simcoe® and Mosaic® add depth to the nose generated from a post-fermentation charge of Ekuanot™, Loral™, and the still-experimental HBC 630. From the fields of the Yakima Valley to the streets of Seattle, Fresh off the Farm IPA delivers farm fresh flavor no matter where it's poured.

Name: Bale Breaker Hazy L IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
Introducing Hazy L IPA, our sixth year-round beer available in six-packs and on draught! This innovative take on the hazy IPA style features Citra®, Sabro™ and Mosaic® hops grown by BT Loftus Ranches.  With an approachable bitterness and a crisp body, this hazy IPA was thoughtfully crafted for everyday drinking.

After refining our hazy game for a year with over 30 recipes in our Imagination Station, we finally settled on this hazy IPA recipe as the newest addition to our year-round lineup. It’s a nod to the ripe East Coast hazies with our own fun West Coast spin – which is why we decided to name it Hazy L, another nod to some of the greats that came before us: our great-grandparents’ B.T. and Leota Mae Loftus’ cattle brand ‘Lazy L.’

Name: Bale Breaker Leota Mae IPA
Description: Introducing our fourth year-round beer available in six-packs and on draught! Leota Mae joins the Bale Breaker lineup with a fresh take on a heavily hopped West Coast IPA. With late additions of Ekuanot™ and Mosaic®, this beer veers into dank, tropical territory, highlighting the aromatic power of these two Yakima-bred varietals.   Our great-grandparents planted hops in the Yakima Valley in 1932. The matriarch of our family, Leota Mae, worked sunrise to sunset cultivating the land we still farm today. This beer pays tribute to our family’s legacy and the woman who started it all. Cheers, Leota Mae, here's your IPA.

Name: Bale Breaker Hop Country Session IPA
Description:
Hitch a ride to hop country with this aromatic, sun-packed IPA, the first of our three-part rotator series. With a hop bite like a rattlesnake, this bucking bronco of flavor showcases Simcoe, Mosaic, and Ekuanot.

All the smells of the Yakima Valley plus some sunny, tropical notes: mandarin orange, Douglas fir, cantaloupe, pineapple, and freshly kilned hops.

Name: Bale Breaker Citra Slicker IPA
Description:
Each hop harvest, the big city brewers from Cloudburst Brewing make the trek from downtown Seattle over the Cascades to team up with the farm brewers from Bale Breaker to brew Citra® Slicker Wet Hop IPA, a fresh hop beer that was first brewed in 2014 with then-owner of Elysian Brewing, Dick Cantwell. 

While it takes the Cloudburst team over two hours to get to Bale Breaker, the hundreds of pounds of wet Citra® hops picked fresh from the fields travel just four minutes from farm to kettle. Heavily dry-hopped, while light in color and body, this beer is all about these fresh, farm-grown hops!

Name: Proclamation Tendril IPA
Description: Our hybrid mix between the west coast pine/grapefruit/citrus/floral hop profile and softer, less bitter, medium haze IPA. 7.5% abv, dry, super drinkable.

Name: Proclamation Ale Derivative: Citra
Description: Notes of mixed citrus, pineapple, dank, earthy, stanky.

Name: Proclamation Ale Derivative: Mosaic
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description:
This beer is a unique snowflake; a Unicorn on a farm of Shetland ponies; a complete original that we at Proclamation Ale Company came up with entirely by ourselves, by our own creative volition, without any outside inspiration whatever! Wow! Check this out: we got this awesome idea to take barley, make a sugary tea with it, ferment it with yeast and then throw a ton of sexy, nouveau hops in it!! (Note: we named the hops Galaxy when we invented them)
NOTHING LIKE THIS HAS EVER BEEN DONE BEFORE!!! 
Enjoy this beer because you will never drink another one like this again!!
EVER!!!

Name: Proclamation Ale Derivative: Galaxy
Description: Hopped with Amarillo and Citra and dry-hopped with those two plus Galaxy.

Name: Proclamation Ale Derivative: Citralaxy
Description: Our first double-single-hopped variation in the Derivative series. Contains both Citra and Galaxy hops. Notes of orange, papaya, mango, grass, and dank

Name: Proclamation Broze
Description: More chocolatey, less roasty. Contains lactose. Variation includes coffee from Barrington Coffee Roasting Company.

Name: Proclamation Stalk
Description: With Citra, Mosaic, Galaxy, and CTZ hops.

Name: Proclamation (In)Signficance
Description: Crushed to the saturation point with almost 8lbs per bbl of El Dorado, Citra, Galaxy, and Vic Secret. Notes of naval orange, tangelo, fruity hard candy, and pithy grapefruit.

Name: Five Boroughs Brewing Tiny Juicy IPA
Description: A hazy session IPA brewed with copious amounts of ﬂaked oats. Hopped with Mosaic, Simcoe and Cascade for a fruity and piney ﬂavor that is cleaned up with a punch of bitterness. Tons of hop character in a small package–super drinkable and great for the season.

Name: Five Boroughs Gridlock Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazy IPA offering a tropical traffic jam of flavor. Flaked oats balance heavy Amarillo and Citra hop additions — bumper-to-bumper deliciousness.

Name: Five Boroughs Hoppy Lager
Description: At a higher ABV, our Hoppy Lager is a departure from the more traditional lagers we brew. We use a light grain bill and our clean-fermenting house lager yeast to create the perfect base to showcase large additions of Motueka and Centennial hops. This gives the beer an aroma of tropical fruit, lime zest, grapefruit, and light pine.

Name: Five Boroughs Pumpkin Ale
Description: From harvest to Halloween to the Thanksgiving table, Pumpkin Ale is the ideal accompaniment to autumn. A medley of base and specialty malts coupled with a touch of mixed spices result in fresh baked aromas perfect for those crisp fall days. A slight, earthy hop charge balances out this seasonal brew.

Name: Five Borough Insufficient Fare Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description:
Insufficient Fare debuted in 2017, a delectable, pillowy double dry hopped Northeast IPA packed with tropical fruit flavors. Its can — which caused quite a social media stir — is adorned with no one’s favorite, not-so-subtle reminder of suboptimal subway funds.

ABV: 5.5%

Malts: Pilsner, Wheat, Flaked Oats, Carafoam

Hops: Citra, Simcoe, Mosaic, Columbus

Appearance: Hazy gold with a thick white head

Aroma: Tropical fruit and citrus peel with a touch of pine and sweet malt

Taste: Papaya and citrus with a pithy bitterness

Mouthfeel: Fluffy and soft

Food Pairings: Sharp cheese, salads with bitter greens, really anything with acid or bitterness

Name: Five Boroughs Gose
Description: An incredibly drinkable low-ABV beer, our Gose is the perfect balance of acidic sourness and saltiness. Fermented cool with our house ale yeast, this beer finishes super clean with little to no bitterness.

Name: Five Boroughs United By Beer Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: United By Beer is our 2nd annual Pride collaboration with The Center, a leading advocate for NYC’s LGBTQ community. A double dry hopped Hazy IPA, United By Beer is powered by a Galaxy dry hop that, along with additions of Amarillo and Citra, generates notes of citrus, passionfruit, peach, and tropical fruit. Flaked oats are the malt bill’s focal point and add a smooth, full-bodied dimension to this tasty beer. The Center will receive 100% of proceeds.

Name: Five Boroughs Tic Tac Toe DIPA
Description: This double dry hopped Double IPA is our 3rd Anniversary release, a liquid celebration of the journey our team has taken over the last 1,095 days. Full-bodied and super juicy, Tic-Tac-Toe is packed to the gills with citrusy, tropical fruit goodness and hints of pine. Don’t miss the three game-ready tic-tac-toe boards on the can!

Name: Five Boroughs City Light
Description: An unfiltered light lager made with Saaz hops, premium German malts, and New York City water. A serious beer that's also seriously sessionable

Name: Five Boroughs Sunset Shandy
Description: Sunset Shandy Lemonade is a tantalizingly light shandy that zings with refreshing, lemony flavor. This easy drinker pairs particularly well with New York City’s sweltering summertime heat.

Name: Kills Boro Lapse Of Judgement Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A light, airy orange and grapefruit cocktail. Maris Otter and Pilsner malts add a lightly toasted, sweet bread character. Dry hopped with Ella and Amarillo adds a complimentary citrus and mild resinous finish.

Name: Kills Boro Gimme, Gimme Passionfruit Guava
Description: Sour Ale with Passionfruit, Guava, Vanilla Beans and Lactose. Tart, with a big body and a smooth finish. Fruit forward.

Name: Kills Boro Gimme Gimme Kiwi Strawberry
Description: Sour Ale with Strawberry, Kiwi, Vanilla Beans, and Lactose.

Name: Kills Boro Couch Locked
Description: Pastry Stout conditioned on toasted almonds, bananas, toasted coconut, coffee beans, cacao nibs, and vanilla beans.

Name: Kills Boro Island Vibes IPA
Description: Pilsner Malt, Flaked Wheat, and Flaked Oats. Hopped with Centennial, Azacca, and Idaho 7, then copiously dry hopped with Azacca, Idaho 7, Citra and Cashmere. Bursting with citrus and tropical fruit flavors can make any island feel tropical.

Name: Kills Boro Birthday Check
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Double dry hopped New England IPA featuring Nelson Sauvin, Simcoe, and Cryo Simcoe hops

Name: Kills Boro Soft Spoken Sour IPA
Description: Sour IPA conditioned on mango and marshmallows.

Name: Kills Boro Brewing With Wild Abandon
Description: Double Dry Hopped NE DIPA with Medusa, Citra, and El Dorado hops.

Name: Kills Boro Brewing Wavy Tropics
Description: The addition of Guava and Orange Peel compliment the tropical hop character in this beer. Smooth, juicy, and complex.

Name: Kills Boro DOPE!
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: DDH IPA with Centennial, El Dorado, and Mosaic.

Name: North Peak Original Hoppy Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: With less alcohol than an IPA, the hops are still prominently showcased in this hoppy pale ale. A light sweet malt taste compliments the beautiful citrus floral notes from the hops. An everyday tribute to the original pale ale.

Name: North Peak Dubious Black Chocolate Stout
Description: North Peak Dubious is a Dark Chocolate Stout that has the perfect combination of chocolate, roast and black malts resulting in a smooth rich beer. Judicious use of hops bring out a complex, yet subtle bittering finished off with a big Goldings nose. This swirl of aroma, flavor and body is underscored by the rich chocolate that is added at the end of the boil. This medium bodied beer is brewed in Traverse City, MI, on Old Mission Peninsula incorporating locally grown hops.

Name: North Peak Thunder Oat IPA
Description: This style is full of haziness along with dry/late hop additions to create a juicy mouthfeel with citrus, piney notes unlike any other IPA. Enjoy!

Name: North Peak Wanderer Session IPA
Description: North Peak Wanderer is a Session IPA. This exciting new style is balanced with malt and hop characters and has a clean finish. The combination of full hop flavor and lower alcohol gives Wanderer a a wonderful drinkability! Wanderer has a light, clean and refreshing body, and is hopped with Perle, Willamette, Centennial and Citra hops that gives Wanderer a Citrus and Pine finish. Wanderer is rounded out with a generous amount of dry-hopping with Citra hops to fill the nose. It is brewed in Traverse City, MI, on Old Mission Peninsula incorporating locally grown hops.

Name: North Peak Stormy Oat IPA
Description: Stormy is full of haziness from the oat malt along with late/dry hop additions to create a juiciness mouth feel with citrus, piney notes unlike any other IPA.

Name: North Peak Dweller
Description: An imperial white ipa. Hopped with Amarillo, centennial, chinook, mosaic, and simcoe. Made with grapefruit peel, coriander, and peppercorn.

Name: North Peak Double Diabolical Double IPA
North Peak Mighty Melon Ale
Description: This sessionable melon ale boasts aromas of watermelon, berry and guava. This exceptionally drinkable beer is the perfect balance of malts, melons and gently-hopped Vanguard, Crystal and Michigan Chinook hops.

Name: North Peak Mellow Cherry Hibiscus
Description: Mellow is more than just a beer, it is Northern Michigan brewed a bottle. It embraces the lifestyle of slowing down and focusing on the beauty of this magical place. Brewed with Michigan cherries and hibiscus, this higher gravity ale has the sweet iconic flavors of the North. Mellow is fruit and sweet with a hint of tartness. Each sip of this big and balanced beer with transport you to the wonders of Northern Michigan.

Name: Blue Owl Brewing Spirit Animal
Description: Sour Pale Ale

Name: Blue Owl Van Dayum!
Description: Sour Red Ale

Name: Blue Owl Brewing Little Boss
Description: Sour Session Wheat

Name: Blue Owl Cool & The Gang
Description: A collaboration with Lazarus Brewing, this sour summer beer is the perfect balance of tart, lemon, and tea. Great for a day on the mini-golf course or after you’ve finished the weekend yard work.

Name: Blue Owl Brewing Professor Black
Description: Sour Cherry Stout

Name: Blue Owl Professor Black Sour Cherry Stout
Blue Owl Tiki Hop Totem
Description: This fruited milkshake sour IPA combines two sets of flavors into one exotic tropical flavored drink! On one side, you get bright acidity, pineapple, and Citra hops to form the "piña" flavor. On the other side, smooth milk sugar, coconut, vanilla, and Sabro hops form the "colada" flavor. Together, the flavors balance to form our take on the classic tropical tiki piña colada!

Name: Blue Owl Brewing ¡Limetastico!
Description: Sour Mexican Lager w/ Salt & Lime

Name: Blue Owl Brewing Dapper Devil
Description: Sour Raspberry Belgian-style Ale

Name: Blue Owl Brewing SMaSH SMash
Description: Sour New Zealand IPA

Name: Russell Barrel Aged Sour
Description: We took our time with this one! This ale was soured using Roeselare blend while resting in Avery Creek Merlot barrels for almost twelve months. The unique notes of the fermentation used blend well with the warmth of the oak. We are proud to offer our next beer in our barrel aged series!

Name: Russell Happy Little Brut IPA
Description: A champagne like IPA named after the driest of sparkling wines, fermented with Saccharomyces Trois and fully attenuated with the help of specialized enzymes. Generously dry hopped with a mix of Vic Secret and Idaho 7  with notes of pineapple, passionfruit and papaya lending themselves to a crisp dry finish.

Name: Russell Punch Bowl North West IPA
Description: Subtle NW honey malt characters are combined with Citra, Mosaic, and Amarillo hops to create tropical, fruity flavours such as stone fruit, berries and melon. India Pale Ale was a beer created to make the trip from England to India, Punch was a fruit drink introduced to England from India. So as tribute to full flavoured beer and to party drinks that can be spiked, may we present the Punch Bowl!

Name: Russell IP’eh
Description:
Russell IP’eh! quirky name, serious taste. Well balanced English-style India Pale Ale with great drinkability. Generously hopped with Pacific North West Cascade and Williamette hops. Finished with a dry hopping of Cascade flowers. Well-pronounced caramel and toffee notes anchor the bitterness and deliver a smooth, balanced taste.

PART OF THE RUSSELL BREWMASTER SERIES – a succession of small batch beers crafted for an unconventional beer drinker.

Name: Russell Miami Rice
Description: A hazy southeast IPA brewed with rice, oats and barley, with late kettle additions of Mosaic and Citra. Fermented using a blend of London Ale III and Saccharomyces Trois producing a slightly tart finish with delicate hints of pineapple, mango and citrus. Best enjoyed while listening to cheesy 80’s TV theme songs in your beige and pastel blazer.

Name: Russell East Coast IPA
Description: Ever had a beer that tastes like juice? Well, our entry into the “Haze Craze” is just that. With large additions of wheat and oats in the mash, our brewers achieved the classic haze and mouthfeel that this style is known for. The real stars of the show are the hops, with Simcoe, Citra, and Galaxy front row and center. Fermented using “juice,” an appropriately named east coast yeast strain, this beer delivers the delicious juicy vibes you’re looking for. Thank you for your thirst and support.

Name: Russell Papaya Milkshake IPA
Description: A Milkshake East Coast IPA loaded with fresh tropical papaya and sweetened with lactose then dry hopped with ridiculous amounts of both Denali and Ekuanot. Sweet and fruity with big aromas of papaya, pineapple and melon perfectly blending into those tropical summer vibes.

Name: Russell Black Lager
Description:
Oh man, this is the ocean of beers. Big, Dark and Endless. Once called Schwarzbier, we Canadians prefer Black Lager. Midnight Wheat with Pilsen and Dark Munich Malts make it genuine. Our fearless brewer dove into the abyss and arose from the depths with this great beer.

PART OF THE RUSSELL BREWMASTER SERIES – a succession of small-batch beers crafted for an unconventional beer drinker.

Name: Russell Craft Lager
Description: You’re thirsty, done work and just want a great f*#%ing Lager. Look no further. Made with 4 simple ingredients, this beer is unpasteurized, preservative-free and small batch brewed to keep it fresh. Local since’95, we’ve really figured out how to brew a great f*#%ing Lager.

Name: Russel White Rabbit Lemon Raz Radler
Description: A Super sensational, surprisingly spritzing, seductive summer RADLER. The Lemon Raspberry White Rabbit Radler is a delicious summer blend of lemons, raspberries and our citra hoped white rabbit hefeweizen. This blend results in a fruity nose, pronounced mostly by the raspberries and citra hops, but on the palate you get a great hefe taste and light lemon finish. It immediately demands a second, third and fourth sip to figure out what just happened in your mouth.

Name: Foley Brothers Pieces Of Eight Imperial IPA
Description: This delicious double IPA is brewed and dry hopped twice with an amazing blend of eight hop varieties to create a one of a kind experience. Drink this beer fresh. Unfiltered, decant into glass.

Name: Foley Brothers Fair Maiden
Description: Foley Brothers Brewing is happy to present to you Fair Maiden Double IPA. We have a very limited supply to ensure you get the freshest, tastiest beer possible. Brewed with seven hop varieties, Fair Maiden Double IPA has a delicious flavor profile found no other brew.

Name: Foley Brothers Big Bang
Description: Unfiltered single I.P.A brewed with Citra and Galaxy then dry hopped with Citra, Mosaic, Amarillo and Simcoe. Aromas are a melody of Grapefruit, passion fruit, papaya, lychee and melon.

Name: Budweiser
Description: Budweiser beer is a medium-bodied, American-style lager beer. Brewed with high quality barley malt, a blend of premium hop varieties, fresh rice and filtered water, this American beer is crisp and full of flavor. Budweiser beer has 5% ABV and contains 145 calories and zero grams of fat per serving. Every occasion calls for a Budweiser; enjoy a cold beer while watching the game or grab a pack when your barbecues or social gatherings need refreshing drinks. This lager beer is the perfect companion to pizza, burgers and fried chicken, but don't let the pairings stop there. The cans and package make this beer easy to transport wherever Budweiser is needed.

Name: Bud ICE
Description: The ice brewing process results in a full-bodied taste and a smooth finish. Bud Ice is brewed with a combination of malt and select unmalted grains and U.S.-grown hops.

Name: Budweiser Chelada with Clamato
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Rich & refreshing Chelada drink. Budweiser Chelada with Clamato is a savory new spin on a classic. With the crisp smooth taste of an American Lager, the Rich spicy flavor of Clamato and a hint of lime, Chelada is perfect for almost any occasion. It pairs well with Latino dishes like ceviche, enchiladas and tamales. Also try the Picante flavor for an extra kick! Pairs well with Seafood, Shrimp Fajitas, or Guacamole. Brewed in the U.S.A. 5% alcohol by volume. 186 calories per serving. 1 serving size = 12 fl. oz.

Name: Budweiser Chelada Picante with Clamato
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Rich, spicy & refreshing Chelada drink. Pairs well with Seafood, Shrimp Fajitas, or Guacamole.

Name: Budweiser Select 55 Premium Light
Description: Budweiser Select 55 is a premium light American-style lager with only 55 calories and the crisp, clean finish of Budweiser Select. The lighest beer in the world.

Name: Budweiser Select
Description: The Budweiser flavor you love, with only 99 calories.

Name: Budweiser Black Crown
Description: The ingredients of Black Crown are at its heart.  Black Crown is a golden amber lager brewed with toasted caramel malt, a variety of American hops, and finished over beechwood to ensure that this is a beer as distinctive as the people who drink it.  Brewed using Budweiser’s 1876 yeast strain and signature aging process. Black Crown is the sophisticated and distinctive smooth lager from Budweiser. Pairs well with pork tenderloin, gouda, or swiss cheese.

Name: Not Your Father’s Root Beer
Description: Kovac passed down his family’s beer making tradition by working tirelessly with his son to craft the first version of “Not Your Father’s Root Beer.” At 5.9% ABV, the silky, smooth and satisfying finish is unmatched in flavor. It appeals to craft beer aficionados as well as those who don’t typically drink beer but crave something unique.

Name: Not Your Father’s Ginger Ale
Description: Some people used to make their own ginger ale out of real ginger root. Like…in their kitchens. Small Town Brewery founder Tim Kovac remembered his family’s recipe so warmly that he set out to brew up Not Your Father’s Ginger Ale, a fond favorite that delivers the classic American flavor with a grown-up twist.

Name: Not Your Father’s Mountain Ale
Description:
Elevate your taste buds with balanced and bright flavors achived through true craftsmanship. We know you’ll enjoy it, we do. Beer with citrus flavor.

Let this refreshing citrus brew take you to new heights.

Name: Not Your Father’s Vanilla Creme Ale
Description: Chances are you’re probably familiar with the island of Madagascar thanks to some talking cartoon animals or a super strict geography teacher. What you might not know is that Madagascar produces the best vanilla in the world. And we use a healthy dose of it (literally tons) to make Not Your Father’s Vanilla Cream Ale, a classic American favorite that comes through with a vanilla flavor that’s anything but ordinary.

Name: Not Your Mom’s Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
Description: Sometimes rhubarb gets a bad rap. It’s a vegetable that masquerades as a fruit and almost always gets paired up with its much more celebrated friend, strawberry. Well, rhubarb finally gets half the stage with Not Your Mom’s Strawberry Rhubarb, a flavored craft brew that reminds of you the fresh pies Mom used to take out of a box she got at the local bakery.

Name: Not Your Mom’s Iced Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: There are some days that are just made for iced tea. And then there are days when you need a little something harder. We’ve answered your prayers with Not Your Mom’s Iced Tea, a thirst- and stress-quenching twist on the classic drink people everywhere turn to for good ol’ fashioned refreshment.

Name: JuneShine Midnight Painkiller
Description: JuneShine Midnight Painkiller is bold and flavorful featuring activated charcoal and a unique ½ upside down can design. Our dark twist on the classic painkiller tiki cocktail with charcoal, pineapple, coconut, orange, and nutmeg.

Name: JuneShine Blood Orange Mint
Description:
From sunset sessions to late-night antics, this dangerously drinkable flavor has become a crowd favorite for any occasion. We combined farm-fresh blood oranges from Temecula, CA and a hint of organic mint to create a tangy, yet soothing sip of sunshine.
 
Blood oranges contain up to 40% more vitamin C than navel oranges and also boast a richer, less acidic flavor. 


The natural red pigment found in blood oranges is due to higher levels of anthocyanin, known for its powerful antioxidant properties.

A simple dash of mint activates the tastebuds and aids in digestion.

Name: JuneShine Hard Kombucha Acai Berry
Description: Brewed with organic Acai and Blueberries for a subtle earthiness. Inspired by our love for the antioxidant-rich South American superfood.

Name: JuneShine Honey Ginger Lemon Hard Kombucha
Description: This concoction of organic ginger juice, organic honey, and organic lemon was created to satisfy both tastebuds and tummies.

Name: JuneShine Hard Kombucha Rosé
Description: Everything we love about hard kombucha, dressed up with a touch of rosé. Because sometimes simple is smarter—we only added organic red wine grape juice to our already delicious jun kombucha base. Because summer with JuneShine is anything but basic.

Name: Juneshine Hard Kombucha Hibiscus Lime
Description: Revel in this refreshing remix of our signature hard kombucha. Its stripped-down flavor formula means you can do more sippin’ without trippin’. It’s light — made right! Hibiscus, lime, apple, honey, green tea, cane sugar, jun kombucha.

Name: Juneshine Strawberry Fields
Description: Whoever said summer can’t last forever clearly hadn’t picked up this can. You’ve stumbled across the season’s best kept secret: Strawberry Fields. Brewed with local, organic Cyclops Farms signature strawberries, this farm-to-booch blend is simply divine–thanks to sunshine!

Name: Juneshine Cran Apple Cinnamon Hard Kombucha
Description:
Everything nice with a touch of spice, this trippy trio pairs perfectly with vintage sweaters and dreamy fireplaces. 

And the groovy art on the can and merch? That’s the handiwork of JuneShine athlete / artist @ChrisBenchetler. He’s one of the most recognizable names in the world of skiing, but his ability to draw creative lines doesn’t stop on snowy mountain tops. Most recently, Chris has extended his talents as a producer, director, visionary for a genre-expanding collab with the Grateful Dead in the film, “Fire on the Mountain”.

With Mother Nature in mind, 4% of sales goes directly to Protect Our Winters—a nonprofit dedicated to championing solutions to climate change.

Name: JuneShine Cucumber Mojito
Description: JuneShine Cucumber Mojito draws inspiration from a mojito cocktail, with an added twist of refreshing cucumber to add a little bit of greens and balance the acidity of the lime.

Name: Boochcraft Grapefruit Hibiscus Organic Hard Kombucha
Description:
An effervescent citrus and floral riot that’s loud, vibrant, and oh so sensational.

Ingredients: Raw kombucha*, Grapefruits*, Hibiscus*, Heather*, Dried Ginger*, Yeast*
*certified organic

Name: Boochcraft Orange Pomegranate Organic Hard Kombucha
Description:
An enlightened botanical beauty that’s juicy and tart with a radiant glow.

Ingredients: Raw Kombucha*, Oranges*, Pomegranates*, Beets*, Red Wine Vinegar*, Rosemary*, Yeast*
*certified organic

Name: Boochcraft Ginger Lime Organic Hard Kombucha
Description:
Crisp and snappy, this elevated root punch dazzles the senses with a zesty kick.

Ingredients: Raw kombucha*, Ginger*, Lime*, Rosehips*, Yeast* 
*certified organic

Name: Boochcraft Lemon Maple Thyme Organic Hard Kombucha
Description:
Next-level lemonade with a drizzle of maple sweetness and country thyme twang.

Ingredients: Raw kombucha*, Lemons*, Maple Syrup*, Thyme*, Yeast*
*certified organic

Name: Boochcraft Watermelon, Mint, Chili
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Filtered water, black tea, cold pressed watermelon juice, mint, chili peppers, and cane sugar

Name: Boochcraft Apple Jasmine Organic Hard Kombucha
Description:
A liquid slice of tart apple pie with a sweet scoop of jasmine and a dash of lime.

Ingredients: Raw Kombucha*, Apples*, Limes*, Jasmine Green Tea*, Yeast*
*certified organic

Name: Boochcraft Heirloom Kiwi Organic Hard Kombucha
Description: In celebration of California’s organic farms, we bring you Heirloom Kiwi, a dreamy symphony of tart, sweet, and creamy. The tropical tang of the fuzzy green berries pairs perfectly with Coachella Valley dates and Madagascar vanilla beans. It’s cool, we didn’t know kiwi was a berry either.

Name: Boochcraft Tumeric Tangerine Organic Hard Kombucha
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description:
Turmeric's rich, aromatic spice is a perfectly warming companion to juicy Satsuma tangerines  and the punchy zing of fresh ginger. 

Ingredients: Raw Kombucha*, Turmeric*, Tangerines*, Ginger*, Yeast*
*certified organic

Name: Boochcraft Bring The Part Variety Pack Hard Kombucha
Pikes Peak Gold Rush Belgian Ale
Description: In 1859, they were shouting Pikes Peak or Bust! During one of America’s greatest gold rushes, thousands of prospectors used the mountain as a beacon, guiding them across the Great Plains to their fortunes.   Our Gold Rush is a full-flavored Belgian-inspired ale with notes of honey, clove and baking spice. Dig in and enjoy it, you’ve hit the mother lode.

Name: Pikes Peak Devils Head Red Ale
Pikes Peak Blue Mesa Tropic Blonde
Pikes Peak The Ascent Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The annual marathon up Pikes Peak is one of the country’s most difficult. It demands a runner’s full measure of determination and many are unable to finish.  We’ve made this classic pale ale much more easy-going. It balances just enough citrus and bitterness against light body of smooth, golden malt. With a finish as clean as the air at 14,000 feet, it’s a refreshing reward for a tough climb. Relax on this Ascent, you’ve earned it.

Name: Pikes Peak Tava Raza
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A twist on our wild american red. A dry hopped kettle sour made with raspberry puree.

Name: Pikes Peak Brewing Oatmeal Stout
Description: It’s a creamy brew with a characteristic roast and nutty malt flavors finish with some lingering spice.

Name: Pikes Peak Brewing 38 Faces Pineapple Milkshake IPA
Description: Each edition of this IPA has a common malt backbone. This edition, No. 2 is a Pineapple Milkshake IPA. It's a hazy, New England-style IPA made with pineapple and lactose for a creamy mouthfeel.

Name: Brewster’s Hammerhead Red
Description: A traditional red ale, Hammerhead combines three types of hops to create a sophisticated brew with teeth. Once you get a taste of this red you’ll be ravenous for more.

Name: Brewster’s Hawaiian Coconut Porter
Description: Like a trip to the Islands! We take a classic British porter and infuse it with fresh coconut.

Name: Brewster’s Farmers Tan Belgian White
Description: Farmer’s Tan is our authentic Belgian style white ale made with flaked wheat, a Belgian yeast strain, fresh coriander and orange peel. The Brewmaster’s choice as our must-try beer, it’s the ideal summertime refresher, easy-drinking with a big citrus kick.

Name: Brewster’s Rig Pig Pale Ale
Description: This North American style pale ale is quite hoppy and delicious. Its 'rig' sized aroma comes from the lethal pairing of Cascade and Centennial hops that are paired with American Victory malt to offer a caramel counterpoint.

Name: Brewster’s Imperial Stout
Description: Aged in Kentucky bourbon barrels. Drink fresh or cellar.

Name: Brewster’s Curly Horse IPA
Description: This big, bold, hoppy beast is our Brewmaster’s pride. It’s an unholy union between an English and North American IPA, and the hoppiest of our regular cast of beers. Its unbridled stampede of hops includes the Simcoe, Cascade, Centennial and Warrior varieties.

Name: Brewster’s Honest Paul IPA
Description: Cascade, Citra and Mosaic hops

Name: Brewster’s Jimmy’s Easy IPA
Description: Fragrant hops and fruity notes characterize this vibrant sessionable IPA.

Name: Brewster’s Brewfoot Blueberry Ale
Description: If you prefer your wheat ales in a slightly blue shade, Brewfoot Blueberry blends ten types of blueberries from across North America to add a fruity finish to our refreshing wheat beer. Of course you’ll always find fresh blueberries bobbing around in every pour from Brewsters taps.

Name: Austin Beerworks Peacemaker Anytime Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: Peacemaker is our easiest beer drink but one of the hardest to make.  It's so light and clean there is nothing to hide behind.  It's a crisp, balanced beer that you can drink anytime.  Hey, look at that:  It's Anytime!GABF Silver Medal Winner

Name: Austin Beerworks Pearl-Snap
Description: You always remember your first kiss. But no matter how very many times you try to recreate it with your awkward advances it never matches up. That’s why you should plant your pucker on a Pearl Snap. This crisp refreshing pils will never let you down. Whether if it’s your first date or two year anniversary, every bright clean sip tastes like the very first time.

Name: Austin Beerworks Fire Eagle IPA
Tasting Notes: Bold, Citrus, Floral, Hoppy, Pine, Strong
Description: You can't get more USA than Fire Eagle.  Proudly hopped and gallantly balanced, this IPA is one to judge all others against.  What noise does a Fire Eagle make?  "Screeeeeeee!"GABF Silver Medal Winner

Name: Austin Beerworks Amber Vision Amber Ale
Description: A balanced blend of traditional English malts and contemporary American hops gives an exciting update to a classic style.  It's an Amber through our lens.

Name: Austin Beerworks Flavor Country Hoppy Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bold, Citrus, Peach, Pine, Tropical
Description: Overflowing with notes of peach skins and tropical fruit, this easy-drinking ale is your passport to a magical land of tastiness.  Welcome to Flavor Country.

Name: Austin Beerworks Sputnik Stout
Description: Oats. Cuvee Coffee. Alcohol. And we have liftoff! Like the sight of a comet, the appearance of Sputnik has the locals thanking the brewing gods. As Will says, “we get all science on this shit.” He has developed a proprietary way to introduce the coffee into the beer. We’ve seen it happen and we know a stopwatch and monocle are involved. What happens is it opens up the aromatics without adding any harshness. You get an intense coffee aroma and bold flavor that perfectly compliments the silky oats and high alcohol. It will take your taste buds to orbit.

Name: Austin Beerworks Bloodwork Orange IPA
Description: Sicilian blood oranges added on top of a classic American IPA make for a citrus symphony of the senses.

Name: Austin Beerworks Montecore Oktoberfest
Description: A flamboyant display showmanship, Montecore magically balances malty sweetness, floral German hops, and a clean lager finish. This is a super traditional fest beer that features all German malts, hops and yeasts. The only thing American is the water. This is what an Oktoberfest should be. It's a must have during the Fall festival season. Don't miss it before it disappears in a puff of smoke.

Name: Austin Beerworks La Verdad Mexican-style Lager
Description: Like an accordion solo, this light lager is a celebration of the Hill Country's German and Mexican cultures.  Take a sip of Tejano in a can.

Name: Manor Hill Mild Manor’d Amber Ale
Description: This was created to bring the world of English Mild Ales together with American Ambers. We use 9 different types of malt together to provide you with a unique experience while still maintaining a nice balance of flavors. The result is a copper colored brew with a big white head. Aromas of caramel malt complexity and light berries come through on the nose. The flavor profile is incredibly smooth, with more caramel, along with a touch of biscuit followed by a clean finish.

Name: Manor Hill Grisette
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: The Grisette is an old working class Belgian Farmhouse style that is typically brewed with wheat. This take on the classic style is a very light and sessionable farmhouse ale with subtle hop flavor. A fluffy white head crowns this straw colored brew. Aromas of tropical fruit and lemongrass come through on the nose. Mosaic and Hallertau Blanc hops combine to provide lots of juicy citrus fruit followed by a very dry finish.

Name: Manor Hill Fruit Blends: Blackberry & Peach
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Our Fruit Blend Series is born out of our constantly evolving wild fermentation program. Each variant is aged in oak barrels and blended with the finest selection of fruit. This version was conditioned on Blackberries and Peaches to provide a sweet stone fruit flavor and a huge berry burst to balance the tartness

Name: Manor Hill Hayes Creek Sour
Description: This incredibly aromatic and refreshing warm-weather seasonal is brewed with Tangerine peel! It will pour an orange body crowned by a pillowy white head. A slightly tart first sip is complemented nicely by sweet citrus fruit flavors and a mild bready backbone in the finish. It is best enjoyed directly out of a can among friends and sunshine!

Name: Manor Hill Cashmere Splendor IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: In celebration of FIVE YEARS, we’re expanding into splendiferous new territory. This riff on our popular Double IPA features the Cashmere hop, pouring a hazy gold with a big white head. Delicate aromas of lime, lemon peel, and melon come through on the nose. The first sip is smooth, bringing intense hop bitterness and bright citrus that are complimented by that slightly sweet signature finish.

Name: Manor Hill Festbier
Description: For this traditional take on a classic style, we harnessed our German roots. This Vienna lager pours amber in color with a fluffy white head. It offers rich and bready maltiness and a hint of toast... all balanced by restrained and deliberate noble hop additions. This clean, crisp and very tasty lager is ideal for enjoying on an equally beautiful late summer or fall day. Prost!

Name: Pizza Port Kook Double IPA
Description: Double IPA brewed with CTZ, Amarillo, El Dorado, Melon and Chinook hops.

Name: Pizza Port California Honey Blonde Ale
Description: California Honey is pale straw in color. Fruit ester with aromas and flavors of honey with a crisp, clean finish.

Name: Pizza Port Today’s Forecast IPA
Description: Today's Forecast is a light and dry IPA showcasing the depth of Mosaic hops. Aromas of fresh squeezed citrus fruits and pine fill the glass, while flavors of mango and other tropical fruits parade around your tastebuds. The use of Mosaic from the beginning of boil to the dry hop highlights the unique ability of this dual purpose hop.

Name: Pizza Port In The Pit IPA
Description: This West Coast style IPA delivers barrels of ripe mango and passion fruit that crash with notes of citrus and fresh herbs. One ride in the pit will leave you stoked and frothing for more.

Name: Full Sail Amber Ale
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Chicken, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird, Nuts, Pork, Turkey
Description: This ridiculously tasty Amber Ale is a Northwest classic and our flagship brew. Don’t just take our word for it - Full Sail Amber has brought home 28 gold medals. Not that we’re counting or anything. Malty sweet, medium-bodied with a reddish amber hue and a spicy floral hop finish, this is one great-tasting beer. We’re as proud of it today as we were back in ’89.

Name: Full Sail Blood Orange Hefeweizen
Description: A refreshing unfiltered wheat beer with a twist of citrus. Blood Orange Hefeweizen has a medium malt body with subtle orange flavor, and a crisp wheat finish. It pours hazy in the glass with a golden hue, and has a white lacy head, with a pleasant hint of orange aroma.

Name: Full Sail Citrus Maxima
Description: Here at Full Sail, when life gives us citrus, we make Citrus Maxima Pale Ale. Maximum citrus levels of grapefruit, pomelo, citrus peel and – of course – hops, make Citrus Maxima a balanced and refreshing pale ale. The greatness of tart and juicy fresh-squeezed citrus cannot be contained, but it can be canned. One sip and Citrus Maxima will be your main squeeze. Tart and juicy tropical flavors of grapefruit and pomelo complement the citrusy hop character of this balanced and refreshing Pale Ale.  In case you were wondering, Citrus maxima comes from the scientific name of the pomelo, one of the three primary ancestors of citrus fruits. Playing on this, as well as the unique grapefruit-like character of pomelo, Citrus Maxima is an easy-drinking pale ale that’s well stocked with Simcoe and Citra hops, while fresh pomelo and grapefruit peels lend citrus and grapefruit notes.   The greatness of tart and juicy, fresh-squeezed citrus cannot be contained but it can be canned. Full Sail Citrus Maxima Citrus Pale Ale is available year-round in 12 oz. can 6-packs and in the Full Sail Grab ‘n’ Go-Go variety 12-pack.

Name: Full Sail Imperial Stout
Description: Our Bourbon Aged Imperial Stout is a highly anticipated release from our Brewmaster's cellar. This beer was brewed in December of 2013 and was carefully aged for a year in Kentucky Bourbon casks from Jim Beam and Four Roses. This extended aging presents hints of vanilla and allows the Stout to pick up the flavors of the wood, bourbon and oak. The aging accentuates the robust character of the Imperial Stout and brings out the depth of flavor from the bourbon creating an overall elegantly sophisticated beer.     This year’s Bourbon Barrel Aged Stout is inky black with aroma of dried cherry, shaved chocolate, and whiskey. It has a full malty palate with flavors of dark chocolate, vanilla, cherry, dried figs and a subtle hint of molasses. It finishes deliciously warm on the palate.

Name: Full Sail Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout
Description: Highly anticipated by beer lovers every year, this release from the Brewery has received numerous accolades over the years, including gold and silver medals, five star ratings, and a bounty of happy customers. The beer is racked in small batches and is available in only very limited quantities. It cellars well, so if you store a few bottles in a dark, cool place and be patient, you will be rewarded for your effort and restraint. This special beer is available early February in 22oz. bottles and draft. ABV 10.5% IBU 40 (Formerly known as Black Gold)

Name: Full Sail Hood River Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Super juicy and drinkable, everything you want in this style. 2-Row Pale malt along with generous additions of oats and wheat create the golden backbone of this beer. Our hazy yeast strain then goes to work with massive additions of Azacca, Mosaic, and Amarillo hops to create the ripe, juicy flavors that hazy lovers are looking for.

Name: Full Sail West Coast Style IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Pale malt, oats, and wheat combine to create a golden base allowing Cryo Citra, Mosaic, Simcoe, and Ekuanot hops to shine. Beautiful aromas of tropical fruit, citrus, and melon are well complemented by clean malt notes. This refreshing beer is high on hop aromatics yet well balanced.

Name: Full Sail Bohemian Pilsner
Description: Our super-soft Mt. Hood water is perfectly suited for brewing this classic style. This well balanced and ultra-drinkable Bohemian Pils has a light malt profile while showcasing Saaz and Saphir hops. Beautiful noble aromas upfront, including white pepper and floral notes, give way to hints of biscuity grain.

Name: Full Sail Pilsner
Description: While our Cascade Pils is inspired by classic European pilsners, this beer is really a celebration of the fresh, local Cascade hops grown by family farmers right here in our beloved Pacific Northwest.  It has intense aromas of citrus and pine, supported by a medium body and dry malty palate. As you savor that unmistakable aroma and long, clean hop finish, tip your hat (and your glass) to the generations of hop farmers who help us live the locavore dream every day.     We originally brewed Cascade Pilsner as a special release to celebrate our 26th Anniversary and our Northwest hop growers. It quickly became our fastest growing Full Sail draft beer and our bestselling 22oz. bottle. With that warm consumer response we decided it deserved its own year round six-pack.

Name: Grimm Brothers Little Red Cap
Description: Coming in at 6.3% ABV and IBUs Little Red Cap is an easy drinking hop forward beer worthy of its heritage. We use a bit of Cascade hop to give it an “American Twist” while maintaining its German heritage.  This beer won a Gold Medal at the 2011 GABF and a Bronze at the 2012 GABF.

Name: Grimm Brothers Snowdrop
Description: Snow Drop is our recreation of this beer that had been lost to history.  It comes in at a 7.1% ABV and 20 IBUs.  Snow Drop features a light crisp palate with just a hint of honey and molasses and a beautiful bouquet of noble German hops.   In 2015 this beer won a Bronze in the Historical category at GABF

Name: Grimm Brothers Master Thief
Description: Master Thief weighs in at 5.2% ABV and 20 IBUs.  It is a full bodied malty beer that features aromas and flavors of Chocolate, Caramel, a slight roast and a delicate hop finish.

Name: Grimm Brothers Any Thing For Love
Grimm Candlepower Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Strong Farmhouse Ale with Sage and Pink Peppercorns

Name: Grimm Brothers Fearless Youth
Description: Coming in at 5.8% ABV and 22 IBUs Fearless Youth is true to its style.  Featuring a complex bready malt with just a hint of Hallertauer hops.  Fearless youth features a clean easy refreshing finish. This beer won a Bronze at the 2013 GABF and a Silver at the 2015 GABF.

Name: Grimm Brothers Midnight Strikes
Description:
Just like the story of Aschenputtel (Cinderella), Midnight Strikes is an unexpected favorite, even if you’ve never had a Schwarzbier. Schwarzbier originated from southern Thuringen and northern Franconia in
Germany and is a variant of the Munich Dunkel style. Sometimes referred to as a “black pilsner” this beer is rarely that dark and doesn’t have strong roasted or porter-like flavors. Midnight Strikes keeps with German tradition and is balanced throughout combining subtle, smooth roast malt flavors with hints of caramel. Don’t let looks deceive, this flavorful beer is easy to drink and may just win your heart.

Name: Grimm Brothers 3 Golden Hairs
Description: Coming in at 4.6% ABV and a solid 40 IBUs, 3 Golden Hairs is a wonderfully refreshing Pilsner.  3 Golden Hairs features the soft grainy flavor and aroma of Pilsner malt with the substantial and notable hop profile of the Saaz (Pronounced Z-Ah-ts) hop.

Name: Grimm Brothers Maiden’s Kiss
Description: Maiden's Kiss is our spring seasonal Radler. A German traditional beer by adding beer with lemonade. Perfect on a crisp spring day and in a word, crushable.

Name: Newport Storm Rhode Rage IPA
Description: This Double IPA’s unfiltered light body allows for maximum hop flavors. Features a blend of Mosaic and Citra hops. Notes of crackery malt combined with oats allow for drinkability and a rounder-mouth feel. Aroma features sweet notes of apricot and tangerine with subtle notes of stone fruits.

Name: Newport Storm Hurricane Amber Ale
Description: This first beer from Newport Storm continues to be one of its most popular. The goal was to create a flavorful ale where delicate malt and hop flavor were in perfect balance. To meet this goal, the brewing crew uses North American crystal malt for color and sweetness, and Munich Malt for body and mouthfeel. The perfect amount of spicy Tettenang hops are added for flavor and aroma which compliment the bittering properties of the Magnum hops to round out this session brew.

Name: Newport Storm The Sting Sour Ale
Description: The Sting is a brett beer that we aged in our Thomas Tew Rum barrels for a year. Brettanomyees yeast added elements of stone fruit and cherry to the brew. The result is a barrel-forward sour ale that can be enjoyed any time of year.

Name: Newport Storm InfeRIority Complex
Description: Sour ale aged in rum barrels

Name: Newport Storm InFringement Russian Imperial Stout
Newport Storm Red Dawn
Description: This Russian Imperial Stout sticks to traditional style guidelines utilizing English Chocolate Malt and German Chocolate Wheat to bring forth a rich chestnut color and deep tan head. Never ones to stick completely to tradition though, brewers decided to get extreme with Red Dawn and highlight the roast characteristics of this brew that are often masked by the chocolate sweetness. The use of Canada Pale Malt, Castle Special B Malt and English Black Malt gives this brew a complex flavor of raisin, plum and roasted nuts. Magnum hops were used for bitterness to balance out the chocolate malts, while flaked barley and oats were layered in to create a velvety mouthfeel and smooth finish.

Name: Newport Storm India Point Ale IPA
Description: After 13 years of brewing excellence, we deemed it time to produce a year round IPA style.  Because a well made, well balanced IPA is a work of art, we took our time with this one and added our own local spin onto it.    First we needed a substantial malt backbone to not only create the 6.5% abv, but to compliment later lupulin additions.  Heavy doses of Munich Malt and Cara malt help to add body, mouthfeel and a touch of sweetness.  Canadian wheat malt also lends to the great foam and head retention.  5 different hops are added at 7 different times in this brew, and the majority of the massive, complicated, but delightful hop profile is derived from Columbus and Cascade hops from the kettle boil (bittering, flavor, and aroma additions).  The real icing on this masterpiece, however, comes from literally searching the near and far: Brewmaster Derek Luke married Annie Sherman, a Kiwi citizen in late 2011, visiting New Zealand for their honeymoon.  Upon return, Derek came back raving of the legendary Motueka hop.  Craving to satiate the “near and far desire”, this hop is added in conjunction with Chinook hops grown right here in RI from Ocean State Hop farms during the lengthy dry hopping process.  The result: A fantastic IPA 100% produced locally with local hops, yet worldly in its own right!

Name: Newport Storm Pacific IPA
Description: Brewed with a blend of Columbus, Centennial, Citra & Simcoe hops, this beer is what Brewmaster Derek Luke claims will be his next “go-to-beer”. It has the classic West Coast pine but is well-balanced.

Name: Newport Storm Oktoberfest
Description: This is our most technical brew to make and one of our only lagers. The colder and longer fermentation requires precision and patience. True to the Maarzen style, copious amounts of German Vienna, Carapils, and Munich Malts lend a sweetness people ask for all year! German Tradition and Czech Saaz hops are added post boil to really authenticate this fantastic crowd favorite!

Name: Bad Martha Vineyard Summer Ale
Description: Wild Vineyard grape leaves, premium Pilsner malt and Saaz hops give our Vineyard Summer Ale a bright golden glow, a clean pilsner malt flavor and subtle Bartlett pear aromatics. Its refreshing, light body makes it the perfect ale for a lazy day on the sand. And maybe a night, too.

Name: Bad Martha Martha’s Vineyard Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Bad Martha's flagship ale teases the senses with a devilishly dark honey hue, a smooth caramel flavor and a seductive floral aroma. Brewed with premium English malt, the finest English and American hops, and leaves of the grape that gave the island its name, Martha’s Vineyard Ale lures you in with approachable flavor and light to medium body you’ll want to get your hands on.

Name: Bad Martha Growler
Description: Bad Martha's flagship ale teases the senses with a devilishly dark honey hue, a smooth caramel flavor and a seductive floral aroma. Brewed with premium English malt, the finest English and American hops, and leaves of the grape that gave the island its name, Martha’s Vineyard Ale lures you in with approachable flavor and light to medium body you’ll want to get your hands on.
