Name: Eel River Amber Ale
Description: As Eel River Brewing Company's first certified organic beer, the Amber Ale is medium-bodied with a hoppy bouquet and a distinctive rich taste. A caramel-like sweetness is balanced with a liberal dose of certified organic hops for a pure taste with pure ingredients.

Name: Eel River Organic Amber
Description: Eel River Brewing Company, brewers of California’s first Certified Organic Ale, proudly brings you our Organic Amber Ale. Unique in flavor and purity, this medium bodied beer has a hoppy bouquet and a distinctive rich taste with a caramel-like sweetness that is balanced with a liberal dose of certified organic Pacific Gems and Hallertau hops, imported from New Zealand. Pure taste, pure ingredients, pure good.

Name: Eel River Brewing Organic Blonde Ale
Description: A light, crisp certified organic Blonde Ale created with delicate malt characteristics, this brew is balanced by a very subtle touch of citrusy spice from Pacific Northwest organic hops.

Name: Eel River Emerald Triangle Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Every detail of this crisp, light and refreshing Pale Ale has been deliberate and well considered. Loaded with Magnum, Simcoe, and Citra hops, it features a tropical fruit character with hints of melon and citrus. A refreshing and hoppy beer.

Name: Eel River Raven’s Eye Imperial Stout
Eel River Earth Thirst Double IPA
Eel River Hazy By Nature IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A Hazy, fruity, New England style IPA juicing you up like a Panasonic on your shoulder. Featuring the fruitiness of Galaxy and Mosaic hops to balance the London Ale III yeast and Organic Grains.

Name: Brew Bus You’re My Boy, Blue
Description: You’re my boy, Blue is our blueberry wheat ale. Brewed with Pacific Jade hops and all natural blueberries this ale is sure to refresh every taste bud it touches.

Name: Brew Bus You’re My Boy, Blue
Description: You’re my boy, Blue is our blueberry wheat ale. Brewed with Pacific Jade hops and all natural blueberries this ale is sure to refresh every taste bud it touches.

Name: Brew Bus Rollin’ Dirty Irish Red
Description: Hop on for the ultimate craft beer experience on the Tampa Bay Brew Bus! From brewery tours and tastings to sporting events and bachelor parties, the Brew Bus offers a once-in-a-lifetime experience for everyone. Our tour guides are experienced and knowledgeable, and our staff is friendly and accommodating. Hop on today! Brewed exclusively for the Tampa Bay Brew Bus Tours.

Name: Brew Bus Hazelnut Spread Porter
Description: Spread on the love with this decadent Imperial Milk Porter. Like a famous brand of sweetened hazelnut paste our lawyers advised us not to mention by name, this beer is just as great for dessert as it is for breakfast.

Name: Brew Bus Are Wheat There Yet?
Brew Bus Wrong Way Citra Pale Ale
Description: An Irish style red ale, deep amber in color with a forward caramel flavor and hints of chocolate. English hops lend an herbal bitterness for balance.

Name: Brew Bus Last Stop IPA
Description: This 7.2% ABV, crushable IPA, is the perfect blend of the refreshing notes of tropical fruit and citrus, along with the clean finish of fresh pine. Hopped with Magnum, Centennial, and Columbus hop additions give this IPA a strong citrusy, floral base with little hints of spice. And dry hopped with Amarillo, Simcoe, and Citra hops, the Last Stop IPA is sure to be a crowd pleaser.

Name: Brew Bus Rising Hope IPA
Description: Two of the Tampa Bay area’s top craft breweries have joined forces with the National Pediatric Cancer Foundation for a unique fundraising opportunity. Brew Bus Brewing and Cigar City Brewing, among the longest serving craft breweries in the region, have collaborated to create a special beer for a special cause. Rising Hope IPA is a hoppy ale with notes of gooseberry and grapefruit that is available in cans and on tap throughout the area. All sales proceeds from this special offering will be sent to the National Pediatric Cancer Foundation to help fund clinical trials and fast-track less toxic and more targeted pediatric cancer treatments.

Name: Thirsty Dog Twisted Kilt
Description: This Scottish Ale gets it's unique flavor and aroma through a special time consuming, extra long and vigorous boil. The wonderful caramelized flavors produced blend perfectly with the balanced flavors of roasted barley and complementing hops. Raise a glass of this very drinkable beer to ANY occasion!

Name: Thirsty Dog Dog Days Ale
Description: A crisp ale packed with flavors and aroma. Masterfully brewed with Azacca, Centennial, Citra & Mozaic hops.

Name: Thirsty Dog Siberian Night Bourbon Barrel Aged
Description: We took our award winning Siberian Night Russian Imperial Stout and aged it for 11 months in fresh bourbon barrels. The result blew us away. The dark chocolate malt yields a milk chocolate flavor that blends perfectly with the vanilla flavor from the barrel. The bourbon aroma adds the finishing touch

Name: Thirsty Dog Blood Hound Orange IPA
Description: Infused with blood oranges and hopped with Azacca & Centennial hops for a refreshing, fruit flavored sensation.

Name: Thirsty Dog Xahoo Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Xahoo (zah-hoo) is a hazy, juicy New England Style India Pale Ale. This IPA is made with Citra, Mosaic & Equinox hops.

Name: Thirsty Dog Labrador Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: A Traditional German Lager brewed with all German grain and yeast. Very drinkable.

Name: Thirsty Dog Heaven Or Helles Lager
Description: This Munich Style Helles (light) Lager is a perfect balance of malt and hops.  Selected ingredients from Germany give authenticity to this very easy drinking favorite.

Name: Thirsty Dog 12 Dogs of Christmas
Description: This beer's name sums up the idea of bringing the best together to celebrate. It is filled with seasonal flavors from gererous amounts of toasted and carmel malts, mixed with equally generous amounts of honey, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg. We feel it is the perfect libation, filled with flavors of the season.

Name: Thirsty Dog Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Flat 12 Moustache Ride
Description: A rich American amber with hints of roasted malt and very moderate hop bitterness, aged in a bourbon barrel with real vanilla beans.Aroma is dominated by vanilla and bourbon, hints of caramel, grain, and chocolate. Flavor is smooth and rich – cream soda, with a slight alcohol kick.

Name: Hello My Name Is Amber Ale
Description: Hoppier than its English cousins this American amber ale will have you saying “Jolly good show” when the maltiness rolls across the palate and locks fingers with the spicy hop finish. Hopped to the top end of the style, Flat12’s amber ale maintains its composed American character throughout. ABV: 5.8% IBU: 42.7

Name: Flat 12 Walkabout
Description: A single-hop pale ale featuring Galaxy hops from Australia, Walkabout delivers a big passionfruit aroma and flavor, with a nice hoppy finish.

Name: Flat 12 Full 90 Pale Ale
Description: Brewed in tribute to Indy’s first professional soccer team and all of their awesome, supporting fans, this American Pale Ale with orange peel is the perfect game-day beer.

Name: Flat 12 Half Cycle IPA
Description: The Half Cycle is so named due to its marriage of single and double IPA characteristics. In baseball parlance, a single and double is half of “the cycle”, and this IPA is a heavy hitter. It’s a single IPA, hopped like a double, with an over-the-top hop character that’s a bit spicy, citrusy, piney, you make the call. Light in color, but not on flavor, Half Cycle is dry hopped with a pound of high alpha American hops in every barrel.

Name: Flat 12 Half Cycle
Description: The Half Cycle is so named due to its marriage of single and double IPA characteristics. In baseball parlance, a single and double is half of “the cycle”, and this IPA is a heavy hitter. It’s a single IPA, hopped like a double, with an over-the-top hop character that’s a bit spicy, citrusy, piney, you make the call. Light in color, but not on flavor, this big boy is dry hopped with a pound of high alpha American hops in every barrel. ABV: 6% IBU: 104.1

Name: Flat 12 Hinchtown
Description: In tribute to one of the brightest racing talents out there, we created Hinchtown Hammer Down, a crisp and refreshing ale perfect for the month of May.

Name: Triton Railsplitter IPA
Description: Our flagship beer, and a true example of the style, the Railsplitter India Pale Ale (IPA) is a fresh golden brew with noticeable citrus and floral aromas balanced on a nice malty backbone with a dry finish.

Name: Triton Magnificent Amber 6NR
Description: Rated on 3-18-2013 (Bottle) This beer’s appearance is a small beige head that is mostly lasting, hazy amber body, fast rising carbonation and spotty amounts of lacing. The aroma is toasted malt, pine, earthy hops, and sweet. The flavor is pine hops, semi-sweet, malt, roasted, and burnt. The mouthfeel is light carbonation and this is a medium bodied beer. This beer has a lingering roasted, burnt aftertaste. I do not like the roasted, burnt aspect of this beer.

Name: Triton Fieldhouse Wheat
Description: An American Wheat Ale the way it’s supposed to be. Crisp and refreshing, golden in color with a white head, the Fieldhouse Wheat is moderately hopped with Falconer’s Flight hops for a thoroughly friendly experience. - See more at: http://tritonbrewing.com/year-round-beers/fieldhouse-wheat/#sthash.QAKDfmzz.dpuf

Name: Triton Sin Bin Belgian Pale 6NR
Description: The official craft beer of the Indiana Ice. It is a 6.2% beauty that will only be available in the Triton tasting room and at the Pepsi Coliseum.

Name: Triton Deadeye Stout
Description: Dark and opaque, with a big roasty malty nose, a slight hint of coffee and notes of sweet toffee, all swaddled in oaty creaminess, this beer delivers the full-bodied mouth-feel you expect from a stout.

Name: Triton Peanut Butter Milk Stout
Description: Formerly known as Nutty Professor Peanut Butter Milk Stout, this creamy, full-bodied milk stout is infused with the essence of peanut butter and chocolate and balanced by a hint of sweetness. No tricks, only treats!

Name: Triton The Hempire Strykes Back IPA
Description: The Hempire Strykes Back - This "juicy" IPA is crisp, clean and approachable for the hophead and non-hophead alike! Featuring Falconer's Flight, Summit, Liberty, and Citra hops. This IPA is also infused with hemp flour from Sipp Industries!

Name: Triton Railsplitter Ipa 1/6 Bbl
Description: Our flagship beer, and a true example of the style, the Railsplitter India Pale Ale (IPA) is a fresh golden brew with noticeable citrus and floral aromas balanced on a nice malty backbone with a dry finish.

Name: Left Coast Una Mas Amber
Description: This dark copper lager is light in body and bursting with flavor. Styled after the popular amber lagers south of the border, Una Mas is the perfect easy drinking brew. Small amounts of dark roasted malts add rich color without making it thick or chewy. Munich malt adds a rich, toasty finish to the beer. Una Mas will leave you wanting one more.

Name: Left Coast Voo Doo Stout
Description: Voo Doo is a full bodied, dark brew that is rich and malty with plenty of roasted barley character. This hearty stout is layered with flavors of roasted barley, chocolate, and coffee coming from the highest quality imported malts. Its creamy long lasting head completes the brew, tempting your taste buds to be spellbound.Left Coast Brewing Company is family owned and operated in the iconic surf side town of San Clemente, California. The independent brewery began its craft back in 2004 and over the last 11 years has expanded into more than 25 states and 7 countries. With a slew of 23+ awards under their belt, the brewery that started as a mere 3,500 barrels has since grown to 11,000 barrels and counting.Left Coast prides itself on its commitment to quality and constantly strives to find premium ingredients to achieve the perfect balance of aroma and flavor. The family and brewers that comprise Left Coast are passionate about the art and craft of brewing and seek to invent recipes that they not only love drinking but love sharing. Ingredients, technique and passion poured into every pint, that is the Left Coast way.From our sand to yours… We’d love to share a pint with you, because we believe, ‘People that go Left, are in their right mind.’

Name: Left Coast Barrel Age Voo Doo Stout
Left Coast South County IPA
Description: The OC Brew Ha Ha returns to Orange County as one of the most celebrated and attended craft beer festivals in California. In honor of its 6th year Left Coast Brewery, Artifex Brewing and Pizza Port San Clemente have collaborated on the "South County IPA" using 6 of their favorite hops to commemorate the Brew Ha Ha’s 6th anniversary. This west coast style IPA with intense hop flavors and aromas. Brewed with premium two row pale malted barley and copious amounts of Mosaic, Nelson, Simcoe, Columbus, Centennial, and Cascade hops. This is a citrus bomb that has pine, orange, lemon and grapefruit aromas. With the addition of Mosaic and Nelson hops we achieve tropical fruit and gooseberry flavors. It finishes dry and crisp leaving you in hop euphoria.

Name: Left Coast Hop Juice Triple IPA
Left Coast Orange County IPA
Description: A light bodied IPA that goes down easy. We create a slight sweetness and bitterness by adding Cutie Oranges to the boil. Brewed mainly with Mandarina Bavaria hops from Germany that give off citrus flavors and aromas of tangerine and orange.

Name: Lost Coast Red IPA
Description: Our Red IPA has full-bodied flavor from ample Pale malts while specialty malts provide a deep ruby hue. El Dorado hops are used for their tropical fruit flavors. It’s then dry-hopped with additional El Dorado hops for a delicious fruity aroma, making it perfect for unwinding with friends. Read that? Beer nerd.

Name: Left Coast The Big Office Ipa
Description: The Big Office is a West Coast hop forward IPA. Brewed and dry hopped with copious amounts of HBC 342, Simcoe, and Mt. Hood . Golden in color with a nose of grapefruit and pine needles. A showcase of flavors in pineapple, mango, and passion fruit balanced with a resiny bitterness. Enjoy our summer seasonal at your big office. Where ever that may be.

Name: Left Coast Hop Juice IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Boom Island Brimstone Tripel
Description: Brimstone? You mean fire and brimstone? What could this award-winning, Belgian-style Tripel have to do with divine punishment? Taste it. See how three times the malt brings three times the pleasure? That’s divine. Now, did you detect each of the unique spices and esters working their magic? No? Your punishment is to have another sip.

Name: Boom Island Witness Belgian Witbier
Description: A traditional Belgian wheat beer with real soul. We’re talking multi-tracks of solid gold goodness, citrusy undertones from orange peel, subtle spiciness from coriander, and a refreshingly dry backbeat… all shimmying under a creamy white head.

Name: Boom Island Django
Description: Named for the pioneering jazz guitarist Django Reinhardt, this “hop bier” is a light blonde ale featuring background citrus from orange and lemon peel added to the whirlpool, and some nice melon aroma from the New Zealand-grown hops.

Name: Boom Island Yule
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Resting under a thick beige head, this Belgian-style holiday beer is deep mahogany in color. Rich, dark specialty malts meld with seasonal spices and light fruit that occasionally surfaces, along with the presence of the beer's 11.5% ABV as it warms in the glass.

Name: Boom Island Hoodoo Dubbel
Description: Warning: The dark malt flavors, spicy aromas and mysterious undercurrent of bitterness in the award-winning Belgian-style Dubbel are powerful mojo in the ancient Hoodoo tradition. Prepare to fall under its spell. Enjoy with a black cat bone or serving of John de conkeroo.

Name: Boom Island Belgian Golden Strong Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Boom Island Silvius Begian Pale Ale
Description: Inspired by a mythical, giant-killing soldier we’re tempted to say this gold medal winning pale ale will slay you with its palate-boggling depth of flavors and surprisingly dry finish. Bet we’re not big on wordplay or swordplay. So we’ll just let Silvius speak for itself.

Name: Boom Island Oude Funk
Description: Oude Funk is a 375mL blended Belgian-style sour beer. The first release in our Spontaneous Series, Oude Funk was spontaneously fermented to create a myriad of complex flavors and funky aromas, which mellowed for up to 3 years in oak casks. Our Spontaneous Series pays homage to some of the most ancient of Belgian brewing traditions.

Name: Boom Island Thoprock IPA
Description: Why would anyone name a handcrafted IPA after Thoprock, the notorious heavy metal festival in Belgium? Just how hard do the hops rock? Are they turned up to 11? Can you handle the shredding? Will it make you cast aside your clothing and dance naked in a field?

Name: Baxter Pamola Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Subtle, sophisticated flavors from choice barley and select hops, combined with cold conditioning, give this beer its exceptional drinkability.    Brilliant clarity, bright golden in color. Pours a nice creamy head. Subtle malt and hop aroma. Crisp, clean, effervescent start with a touch of malt character and a balanced bitterness. Hop flavors linger nicely. Finishes clean, crisp and dry with a light body. Beautiful lace left all the way down the glass.

Name: Baxter Innuendo Stout
Description: Sometimes there’s a beer, well, it’s the right beer for its time and place. It fits right in there – and that’s Innuendo, in a New England winter. An Imperial White Russian Stout is about as stupefying a concept as your likely to see, pale in color, dark in flavor and warming all over. Brewed with barley, wheat and oats, then fermented with cacao, coffee, vanilla beans and lactose sugar, this heroic beer will take the edge off of whatever plot twist life throws at you.

Name: Baxter Brewing Stowaway IPA
Description: Bold, complex flavors with a solid malt backbone and assertive hop profile, along with cold conditioning, give this beer its crisp, clean, hoppy finish.

Name: Baxter Bootleg Fireworks
Description: Warning. Producing thundering eruptions of hoppiness. Bursting with the aroma of classic american ipa hops, along with a blast of new Australian hop varietals, Bootleg Fireworks is set to detonate a taste explosion. Though backed up by a light, crisp malt profile, this double ipa isn’t balanced - It’s all about the hops. We packed nearly 6 pounds of green powder into each barrel, and it’s ready to erupt from each can. Boom !

Name: Baxter Ceremony Green Tea IPA
Description: Celebrate our fourth birthday with the flavors of the West Coast and the Far East. In this melting pot we’ve combined Chinook, Mosaic and Sorachi Ace hops with gunpowder green tea and matcha green tea powder. It’s not as formal or traditional as the Japanese tea ceremony, but our Ceremony is steeped in pride and gratitude for our four years making craft beer.

Name: Baxter / DC Brau The Daughters of Poseidon
Description: Pours a black/brown color, takes on a deep mahogany hue when held to the light, pour produced a creamy off white head that left heavy lacing down the glass.

Name: Baxter Tarnation
Description: Brewed in the style of “steam” beers born in 19th-century California, Tarnation is Baxter Brewing’s first lager. American crystal malts provide light toast and caramel notes along with the beer’s rich amber hue, while Munich malt supplies Tarnation’s malty body. The complex malt notes balance the ample bitterness of American Northern Brewer hops (the signature hop for this style) giving the beer great balance. An authentic San Francisco lager yeast ferments the brew, yielding a clean, crisp and satisfying beer. This lager requires several weeks of cold conditioning (“lagering”), but we think it’s worth the wait.

Name: Baxter Brewing Summer Swelter
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Our first unfiltered offering, Summer Swelter Ale is the perfect warm weather beer! Summer Swelter Ale is light and refreshing while still keeping your taste buds interested. The malt base features a hefty dose of wheat for a big, fluffy head and a soft, round body, yet keeps the beer drinkable even during the dog days. The light malt character is more than balanced by a blend of citrusy American hops, giving Swelter a crisp bitterness without being overpowering. The hoppy citrus aroma complements the ingredients that make this beer so unique: lemon and lime peel, Kaffir lime leaves, and lemongrass provide an subtle yet unmistakable floral nose and just a touch of bracing tartness, taking the refreshment of Swelter to the next level.    Pairs well with: Lobster, Fresh Fish, Shellfish – Fried, Broiled, or Raw; Green Salads, Curried Chicken Salad, Burgers and Hot Dogs, Italian Ice…Did we mention lobster?

Name: Baxter Seasonal
Description: Varies by season!

Name: Perrin Caesars Gimp
Description: The Roman Empire’s lust for global dominance and power was only matched by their love of wine, which led to their mastery of the oak barrel. With this in mind we brewed a hybrid Imperial Red Ale fermented with Cabernet Sauvignon grape juice and then aged in California Merlot oak wine barrels. This Roman Imperial Red Ale will excite your baser passions with a deep Imperial red color and purple highlights. Oak, malt and grapes blend together making it hard to tell where one flavor begins and another ends. We all have our vices and we hope you enjoy this one.

Name: Perrin Malted Milk Ball Imperial Porter
Description: This sophisticated ale was made with Cacao nibs, malted milk and French Polynesian vanilla beans and aged for nine months in Woodford Reserve bourbon barrels.

Name: Perrin Gold Ale
Description: A light, crisp & subtly sweet golden ale made with the sessionable beer drinker in mind. This was one of the first beers made at the brewery and it quickly became a popular style because of the accessibility and gateway characteristics it embodies.

Name: Perrin Amber Saison Sour
Description: We brewed an Amber Saison and then put it into fresh oak barrels and aged if for over a year. Each barrel was inoculated upon filling by adding a handful of fresh apple pressing that were fermenting with wild yeast that covered the apples. Each barrel soured and developed its own unique flavor and a truly wild blend was created.

Name: Perrin Apricot Sour
Description: Our Apricot Sour is a light crisp wheat ale was aged for 9 months in fresh oak barrels and soured with lactobacillus and brettanomyces. Apricot fruit was added to match the crisp lactic acid and fruity esters creating a uniquely drinkable fruit sour.

Name: Perrin Unfinished Business
Description: As we continue to push the outer boundaries of stylistic freedom, our brew team continue to swing the sword with our own version of a Japanese Emperor’s Stout. Hand picking 10 specialty malts, the finest flaked oats, golden wheat, and Japanese rice give the body of this beer a silky, smooth, and clean mouth feel. To age this rare beer down, they found a cache of barrels from a small batch, award winning bourbon distillery out of Washington. These heavy toasted rare American bourbon barrels impart hints of light vanilla, coconut, and fresh oak. The dark bourbon notes add warm caramel, ripe tobacco and a soothing boozy finish to this velvety Stout.

Name: Perrin 98 Problems IPA
Description: A serendipitous balance of North American and European specialty malts, paired with a lavish selection of West Coast hops; giving an intense, one - two punch to the uvula. Now with homegrown Michigan Cascade hops! This beer is good for drinking!

Name: Perrin Black Ale
Description: This Black Ale is low in gravity, clean, crisp, and flavor-filled; giving off a bread-like aroma. This beer proves that deep colors do not signify rich beers and our Black Ale is deceptively light on the tongue. A wise man once said, "You underestimate the power of the Dark Side! Give yourself to the Dark Side. It is the only way you can save your friends. Yes, your thoughts betray you" and he was right.

Name: Yards Philadelphia Pale Ale
Description: Not to be boastful, but we honestly believe all others pale in comparison to this one. Crisp and hoppy, Philadelphia Pale Ale is brewed with Pilsner malt and American hops, which impart a surprising citrus aroma.

Name: Yards Jefferson’s Golden Ale
Description: This complex golden ale pays homage to our Founding Father and fellow brewer, Thomas Jefferson. We recreated his recipe, employing honey, rye and wheat, just like the beer brewed at Monticello during Jefferson’s time.

Name: Yards George Washington’s Tavern Porter
Description: Detailed in a letter from the General to his officers during the war, Washington’s recipe employed molasses to aid fermentation and give rich caramel notes to this robust, roasty ale. The recipe reflected his admiration for Philadelphia-style porters, especially those brewed by Robert Hare (whose original brewery stood just blocks from where ours is now). Our Tavern Porter, inspired by Washington’s, is dark, smooth, and complex with just a hint of dried fruit in the finish.

Name: Yards Brawler Champion Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description:
Crafted in the style of an English mild, this malt-forward ale is great when you want to go a few rounds. Its smooth character, hints of caramel and toast and remarkable drinkability define this ruby-colored brew as a knockout session ale.

Brawler's bready essence and luscious malts make it an awesome partner with anything smoked or grilled like ribs, pulled pork, chicken or coal fired pizza. Its lower alcohol content cools off spicy dishes like wings, tacos or Pasta Puttanesca.

Name: Yards Featherweight Hazy Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Tasting Notes: Bright, Citrus, Fruity, Grapefruit, Guava, Hoppy, Light, Passionfruit, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description: Just because it’s light, doesn’t mean it isn’t good in a fight. Put up your dukes and enjoy this light-bodied, low bitterness hazy pale ale with tangerine and citrus hops. And, coming in at only 105 calories, this is the perfect easy-drinker for any weight class.

Name: Yards Philthy Unfiltered Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Bold, Citrus, Grapefruit, Hoppy, Melon - Honeydew, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description: A new unfiltered Hazy IPA. People in Philly don’t have a filter, and neither does our Philthy Hazy IPA. This bold, aromatic ale is loaded with tropical and citrus hops character and has that classic hazy, golden color. And just like the city where it’s brewed, this unapologetic IPA is left unfiltered.

Name: Yards IPA
Description: Our Signature IPA is loaded through and through with assertive American hops. Traditional floor-malted English barley gives IPA its firm malt character while generous amounts of Chinook and Amarillo hops impart aromas of pine and tangerine for a perfectly balanced IPA.

Name: Yards Loyal Lager
Description: 25 years after opening our first garage brewery in Manayunk, we’ve built our dream brewery in the heart of the city – all thanks to our fans who have been loyal since the beginning. As a sign of our gratitude, we’ve used our new world-class brewing system to create Loyal Lager: a crisp, easy-drinking American Craft Lager brewed with two-row malt and aromatic Loral hops. It’s what a clean, high-quality lager is meant to be.

Name: Yards Pynk
Description: Each sip of PYNK starts with a crisp, fruity zing and finishes refreshingly dry. The delightful pink hue comes from heaps of fresh raspberries and cherries in every batch. It’s no wonder PYNK is called the rosé of beer. So let’s raise our bottles and pints to the good things in life — like family, friends, and beer — that bring us all together.

Name: Okanagan Spring Switchback Summer Ale
Description: A true golden ale with a hit of citrus, Switchback’s made for summer days that call for no shoes, no shirts, and sometimes no pants.

Name: Okanagan Spring Chili Porter
Description: Our new seasonal brew combines the rich, flavourful characteristics of a classic porter with the unique addition of chili and chipotle notes. Caramel spice aromas give way to a balanced sweetness and creamy mouthfeel, while the finish delivers a subtle chili bite.

Name: Okanagan Spring Porter
Description: With a rich, full flavour, our Porter is nearly black in colour with a creamy head and a nose reminiscent of a dry stout. Not for the faint of heart, this is a beer for dark beer lovers.

Name: Okanagan Spring Sonder Hefe
Description: Natural, unfiltered and crisp. This golden coloured German-style wheat beer is made with a unique yeast strain that gives it a malty aroma and subtle banana-clove flavours with a dry, yet refreshing finish. Sonder–short for Besondere–means special, referring to the unique yeast strain used for our newest brew.

Name: Okanagan Spring Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: First brewed by Okanagan Spring in 1989, Extra Special Pale Ale is BC’s original pale ale and first craft brand. Clear and copper coloured, it’s fruity on the palate, hearty in hops, and firm in body with a nice dry finish.

Name: Okanagan Spring Brewery Big White IPA
Description: Carve into big, refreshing flavour. This White IPA, named for the Okanagan’s Iconic Playground is a German-style wheat ale brewed with an IPA. They've crafted this White IPA to be a great sessional winter beer, packed with fresh hop flavour and a laid-back, smooth finish making it the perfect go-to for any occasion. Make sure your next seasonal adventure is a big one!

Name: Okanagan Spring Brewmasters Black Lager
Description: Looks like a porter, drinks like a lager. That’s the philosophy behind our smooth, perfectly roasted Brewmaster’s Black.

Name: Okanagan Spring 1516
Description: The decree states that only four ingredients can be used when making beer: barley, hops, yeast and water. The result is a lager with a crisp finish and a rich golden colour.

Name: Okanagan Spring Chili Porter
Description: Our new seasonal brew combines the rich, flavourful characteristics of a classic porter with the unique addition of chili and chipotle notes. Caramel spice aromas give way to a balanced sweetness and creamy mouthfeel, while the finish delivers a subtle chili bite.

Name: Excelsior Brewing Big Island Blond Ale
Description: A light-bodied, approachable ale with a perfect balance of malt and hops, accented by a subtle citrus flavor and aroma. The perfect every day beer. A patio pounder.

Name: Excelsior Sunburn Cherry Wheat
Description: A crisp light bodied Hefeweizen brewed with tart cherries for a mildly tart finish. Mild fruitiness, but not a fruit bomb. Notes of clove and banana are present. Easy drinking, light bodied.

Name: Excelsior ’Spresso Coffee Milk Stout
Description: Made with coffee from UP Coffee Roasters this brew has the nose of a chocolate covered espresso bean. Let it pour over your tongue as notes of espresso and dark chocolate tantalize your taste buds. This one is NOT to be missed! Coffee lovers, chocolate lovers, beer lovers- everyone will love this brew.

Name: Excelsior Brewing Bridge Jumper IPA
Description: A malt-forward IPA dry hopped with a shipload of raw, whole hops. This IPA defines “extreme balance”. An extreme malty sweetness on the front end with a huge hop bitterness to finish clean.

Name: Excelsior Lumpy’s Lager
Description: A Light American Lager. Crafted with flaked corn for a light body, Pilsner malt for sweet malt flavor, and Chinook hops for slight citrus aroma, but low bitterness.  Minnesota’s own Tim ‘Lumpy’ Herron has proven he’s an  everyman, bringing a fan’s enthusiasm and a focus on fun to  the game of golf. His tribute lager matches his personality, combining simple ingredients into an approachable American original. Lumpy’s Lager pairs perfectly with an eagle or a birdie and even tastes great with a bogey

Name: Excelsior ’Spresso Coffee Milk Stout
Description: Made with coffee from UP Coffee Roasters this brew has the nose of a chocolate covered espresso bean. Let it pour over your tongue as notes of espresso and dark chocolate tantalize your taste buds. This one is NOT to be missed! Coffee lovers, chocolate lovers, beer lovers- everyone will love this brew.

Name: Excelsior Sunburn Cherry Wheat
Description: A crisp light bodied Hefeweizen brewed with tart cherries for a mildly tart finish. Mild fruitiness, but not a fruit bomb. Notes of clove and banana are present. Easy drinking, light bodied.

Name: Green Flash West Coast IPA
Description: Green Flash West Coast-Style India Pale Ale is extravagantly hopped, full flavored, medium bodied and copper colored. A menagerie of hops is combined throughout the brewing process to impart specific characteristics. Hops used include Simcoe for a unique fruitiness and grapefruit zest, Columbus for strong hop pungency, Centennial for pine and citrus notes, and Cascade for floral aroma.

Name: Green Flash GFB Blonde Ale
Description: Drop into a light, refreshing blonde ale with hints of honey and orange peel.  This brew is balanced by a mellow malt character, with a crisp and clean finish.

Name: Green Flash Saturhaze IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A laid-back 4.2% Hazy India Pale Ale with tropical and citrus aromas. Enjoy all-time flavor with this all-day style.

Name: Green Flash Tropical DNA Hazy IPA
Description: Brewing beer is in our genes.  Tropical DNA features a complex lush fruitiness with a bright hoppy finish.  This hazy IPA is brimming with tropical citrus aromas that transporet your taste buds to paradise, sip after sip.

Name: Green Flash Soul Style IPA
Description: Our brewers rip-creating huge and complex double and triple IPAs at the pinnacle of craft beer enlightenment. Soul Style is their effortless and pure manifestation of the Single IPA. Citra, Simcoe and Cascade hops are layered, allowing bright tropical waves of flavorful citrus and floral notes to break gently on the palate. Get stoked on a laid back single and ride a wave to soothe your soul.

Name: Green Flash Baja Bound Lager

Name: Evolution Lot 3 IPA
Description: This American style IPA is aggressively hopped at a rate of over 2 lbs. per barrel. Big notes of citrus and pine complement a reserved but firm malt backbone.

Name: Evolution Lucky 7 Porter
Description: Black with garnet highlights, this porter is rich and full flavored with notes of chocolate, coffee and smoke playing off the sweeter toffee and dark dried fruit tones.

Name: Evolution Primal Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A golden, dry, slightly hoppy pale ale. Refreshing & Balanced. Notes of Pine & Citrus in the aroma, earthy middle, clean finish 28 IBU’s, 4.9 ABV.

Name: Evolution Pine’hop’le Pineapple IPA
Description: A tropical take on our classic American IPA, our pineapple IPA packs a tropical fruit flavor with juicy hop character. Brewed with loads of pineapple juice and aggressively hopped to contribute big tropical and citrus notes. After garnering much acclaim in our taproom and brewpub we bring this beer to our fans across the region.  Pairs well with Indian, Cajun, Thai, Jerk, Caribbean, cheeseburgers, sliders, pizza and pretty much anything off the grill

Name: Evolution Lot 6 Double IPA
Description:
Think of this as our Lot No. 3 on performance-enhancing malt and hops. At 8.5% abv, this beer is loaded with tropical fruit and citrus notes. Deep gold in color, massive additions of American varietal hops generate assertive bitterness and big hop flavor and aroma.

Pairs well with Thai, mac and cheese, spicy, Mexican, salty and fried

Name: Evolution Seasonal
Description: Varies by season!

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Propolis Fennel 2015
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Golden Elderflower Saison Brett - Dry Hopped with New Zealand Rakau Hops Pilsner, toasted, and Caramel Malt, Wheat, Spelt, Noble Hops, Elderflower Blossoms, Rakau Hops Ale brewed with Propolis House Microbes and Brettanomyces- cellar +2 years

Name: Hutton & Smith Basecamp Blonde
Description: This ale is light and drinkable with a nicely malted backbone and a touch of bitterness.

Name: Hutton & Smith The Good Schist
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This American Pale Ale has a tropical and citrus hop profile, while balanced by a healthy dose of caramel malt.  It has a medium-body with a slight bitterness.

Name: Hutton & Smith Margarita Gose
Description: Salt, lime and citrus accent this light bodied gose.

Name: Hutton & Smith Igneous IPA
Description: Our dry-hopped India Pale Ale offers a blast of citrus and pine aromas. This brew’s bitterness is well balanced by a  slightly malty body with biscuit notes and a clean finish.

Name: Hutton & Smith Promenade IPA
Description: The Promenade is juicy, tropical, and has a full mouthfeel with medium bitterness – a hazy treat wrapped up by a smooth finish that will keep your mouth watering for more.

Name: Hutton & Smith Tectonic IPA
Description: Get ready for a blast of hop presence – citrus, pine, and tropical aromas highlight this beer. It has a juicy and crisp mouthfeel with medium plus bitterness and hop flavor similar to the aroma.

Name: Three Weavers Expatriate IPA
Description: This bright, tropical, fruit-laden West Coast IPA is brewed with two-row barley, English crystal malt and cutting-edge American hops. Expatriate tastes like home no matter where you are.

Name: Three Weavers Seafarer Kolsch Style Ale
Description: Inspired by the traditional light ale from Köln, Seafarer is made with German Pilsner malt and noble hops. This crisp, pale, lively Kölsch-style ale is the perfect first mate for navigating the sea of life.

Name: Three Weavers Day Job Strong Pale Ale
Description: Strong pale ale, named for all those great people working 9-5 to make it happen.

Name: Three Weavers Southbounder Coffee Stout
Description: Made with Columbian roast from Northbound Coffee Company.

Name: Three Weavers Knotty Double IPA
Description: Bravo, Chinoook, Centennial, Azacca, and Citra hops. Dry hopped with Citra, Azacca, Crystal, Chinook, and Simcoe hops.

Name: Three Weavers Blood Junkie  Double IPA
Description: From our ears to your glass, Blood Junkie is a ruby-hued Imperial Red Ale, brewed in collaboration with our hop obsessed, heavy metal friends at Prosthetic Records In Inglewood, California. Big and malt-driven, yet dry and balanced with a bright hop finish, Blood Junkie will have you throwing horns.

Name: Three Weavers Return Of Sassy Rye IPA
Three Weavers Unity
Description: We've brewed up an Experimental IPA focusing on not yet commercialized hop variety HBC 522. This beer packs a hoppy punch, and is super bright and tropical with notes of lemon, passionfruit, peach, and mango. Super stoked about the amazing bottle art by Nick Fullmer.

Name: Three Weavers Off the Beaten Path
Description: Collaboration with Alpine.

Name: Devil’s Purse Handline Kolsch
Description: Our interpretation of a German style kolsch, mildly hopped with Vanguard This unfiltered rendition has pleasant aromas akin to lemon zest and cut grass, with a dry finish and refreshing taste.

Name: Devil’s Purse Stonehorse Citra
Description: The fourth iteration of our Stonehorse single-hop IPA series, featuring generous additions of Citra hops.

Name: Devil’s Purse Pollock Rip
Description: Packed with Warrior, Apollo, and Chinook hops. This solid IPA has a dry finish with a perceived sweetness and spicy flavors to balance bitterness with added aromas of pithy citrus fruits.

Name: Prost Marzen Oktoberfest
Description: Prost Märzen is a deep orange, malty lager. Originally, it was brewed in March (Maerz). In the days before refrigeration, this was the last month to brew before the weather was too warm. Later, the Oktoberfest celebration was the perfect event to drink the last of the Maerz beer and start brewing again. Starting in the 1970’s the Munich brewers started making paler versions of the Oktoberfest biers. The beer now is a kicked up Helles bier brewed to a slightly higher gravity. At Prost we make a more traditional Märzenbier. Our Märzenbier is orange in color, with a rich malt profile from the abundant use of Vienna and Munich malts.

Name: Prost IPL
Categories: India Pale Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: Prost IPL is a hop-forward lager showcasing the flexibility of German malts and hops. The beer is golden colored with a bright white foam. Aroma is a blend of red berries, bright citrus, and subtle nectar fruits. Finish is smooth and bright with a hint of candied apricot. Extremely smooth and easy on the palate.

Name: Definitive Contee Kölsch-Style Ale
Description: Our take on the regional classic from Cologne, Germany. Brewed with heaps of German and local malts and fermented for many moons at cooler temperatures providing a lager-like ale that is crisp, clean, and refreshing. 4.6% ABV.

Name: Definitive DDH Sensitive Ears Pale Ale w/ Galaxy
Description: A DDH version of our bright and refreshing 5.6% pale ale Sensitive Ears. We doubled the dry hop with even more Citra and a large amount of Galaxy! This beer tastes and smells like pineapple flesh, ruby red grapefruit, and kiwis.

Name: Definitive Sensitive Ears Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Our 5.6% house pale ale. This brew is made with a myriad of malt varieties from far and wide, then dry hopped twice with Citra and Amarillo. Bright and refreshing, Sensitive Ears tastes like the flesh of many clementines and freshly baked lemon meringue pie.

Name: Definitive Ale IPA
Description: Our signature IPA. Dry hopped with Pacific Northwest and Australian hops and bursting with tropical fruit flavors and aromas. 6.7% ABV.

Name: Definitive Particles DDH DIPA
Description: An 8.3% Double Dry Hopped Double IPA with Citra, Simcoe, and Topaz! Rocking a similar hop profile to Definitive Ale but with extra horsepower, this hop-saturated beer tastes and smells like ripe fruit orchards, kiwi peels, and lemon sorbet!

Name: Definitive Float DDH DIPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: An 8.0% full-bodied double IPA dry hopped with Citra and a blend of Simcoe and Loral cryo pellets. Plush on the tongue, this beer tastes and smells like lemon-citrus raindrops, tropical hibiscus petals, and a day floating down the river!

Name: Definitive Lens TDH TIPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Our Triple Dry Hopped Triple IPA! This beer dials in at 10.3% ABV, with a fruity, fluffy body that will put a smile on your face. It tastes and smells like hazy pineapple clouds, orange creme popsicles, and the first days of Summer!

Name: Definitive 35 w/ Blueberries & Mango Session IPA
Description: The original fruited variant of our 3.5% house session IPA is conditioned on delicious summertime mangoes and blueberries, giving a refreshing sweet twist to this crisp, crushable beer. We taste mountains of fresh blueberries, sticky sweet mangoes, and sipping an overpriced smoothie on vacation.

Name: Coppertail Unholy Trippel
Description: Our take on the Trippel style originally brewed by monks in Belgium features fruity / funky notes from the traditional Belgian yeast paired with a sacrilegious American hop character.

Name: Coppertail Night Swim Porter
Description: Dark and luxurious like a midnight dip in the warm gulf waters off St. Pete Beach.  Rich and Roasty with a hint of chocolate.  Both this porter, and a night swim, are best enjoyed with a friend.

Name: Coppertail Kuhler Kolsch
Description: Light bodied with crisp malts, a touch of citrus and delicate hop notes

Name: Coppertail Wheat Stroke
Description: An easy drinking attitude and a touch of citrus peel make this wheat ale our beer of choice when it’s hot and humid out.  Formulated for maximum protection from the Florida heat.

Name: Coppertail Captain Jack Stone Crab Stout
Coppertail Free Dive IPA
Description: Whether you’re diving for stone crabs under Tampa Bay’s Sunshine Skyway or just wishing you were, this beer’s got you covered.  Expect huge hits of citrus and pine aromas layered over a bright malt backbone.  Perfect for a day on the water.

Name: Coppertail Sorcha O’Sullivan IPA
Description: The second beer in our newest line of IPAs, the Alpha Hunt Series. A full flavored IPA that uses cutting-edge Medusa and Idaho-7 hops. Follow the story with the hashtag #whoissorchaosullivan.

Name: Coppertail Independant Pilsner
Description: A craft lager built on independence and our ability to brew our beer our way.

Name: Mission Blonde Kolsch
Description: Kolsch-Style Ale. Our Blonde ale is a crisp and refreshing golden ale. Modeled after the kolsch-style ales from Cologne (Köln), Germany, our blonde ale has a clean, lager-like character, and a smooth, balanced bitterness. The authentic kolsch yeast strain provides a subtle fruitiness, which compliments the Liberty and Hallertau hops used for flavor and aroma. 20 IBU

Name: Mission Brewery Hefeweizen
Description: German Wheat

Name: Mission India Pale Ale Single
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Our India Pale Ale exhibits a complex hop aroma, largely due to the generous usage of Cascade and Centennial hops, as well as a subtle malt character from the various malts used to achieve the wonderful balance exhibited in a world-class IPA. San Diego has become world renown for the wonderful and flavorful beers produced here – and India Pale Ales are no exception. Our national award winning interpretation of the style reflects both the history of IPA and the American variation of this distinct beverage. We hope you enjoy it! 66 IBU

Name: Mission Maiden Voyage
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Imperial berliner with cherries.

Name: Mission Passion Fruit Gose
Description: Our Passionfruit Gose is full-on, unfiltered goodness. We combine the tart sweetness of passionfruit with the unmistakably refreshing characteristics of a gose.   With 4 pounds per barrel of real passionfruit puree added during primary fermentation, the tropical flavor in this beer shines though, but is not overwhelming. It's a beautifully balanced beer, with both the passionfruit and the tart, slightly salty gose complementing each other while still being stand alone players.   As if the harmony between sweet passionfruit and tart gose wasn't enough, we've dry hopped this beer with a generous amount of Citra hops -- a half pound per barrel in the dry hop, to be specific. The juicy, tropical Citra hops give it a citrus undertone and a slightly dank flavoring.

Name: Mission Dark Seas Russian Imperial Stout
Mission Dark Seas Bourbon Barrel Aged
Description: Our award winning Russian Imperial Stout has been aging in Bourbon Barrels for 22 months to add complimenting notes of oak, vanilla, and bourbon to its massive coffee, chocolate, and roasted malts flavor profile!

Name: Mission Plunder IPA
Description: In times of battle, few rules apply. Plunder is no exception. Hopped with nine treasured varieties, this IPA has a refreshing bite with aromas of citrus and pine. With a lighter body and bright hop profile, this San Diego brewed IPA leaves no questions that it is a treasure worth seizing.

Name: Mission Hard Root Beer
Description: Our Hard Root Beer is a hand-crafted adult twist on a classic soda. Creamy, smooth, and sweet but not cloying, the 7.5% ABV in this Hard Root Beer is all but undetectable. With traditional root beer notes of sarsaparilla and vanilla, this is a craft beverage for someone craving something a little different. Serve over ice or with a scoop of ice cream and enjoy.

Name: Black Raven Kitty Kat Blues Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: We took an unassuming pale ale and turned the screws a bit with additions of dried blueberries, vanilla bean and organic mountain-grown catnip. The result is an easy drinking pale ale that finishes like this morning's blueberry muffin. Be sure to hide the cats, they might take a shine to this one.

Name: Black Raven Coco Jones Coconut Porter
Description: Our Tamerlane Brown Porter, with it’s subtle nut and coffee tones takes a delicious turn when infused with freshly toasted coconuts. Rare bird, released once or twice each year.

Name: Black Raven Updraft Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Ravens have learned that flapping their wings all day is exhausting. Updrafts provide opportunities to relax, coast, travel great distances and see the world from new heights. This modern take on a classic style is built on a light pale malt profile. From there, we layer on some exciting, newer hop varietals. These hops contribute a range of flavors and aromatics from light citrus to various tropical fruits.

Name: Black Raven Feather Weather Mocha Stout
Description: The Feather Weather is an American stout brewed with cocoa nibs and local cold pressed coffee. Dark chocolate and coffee flavors, perfectly balanced to combine the best of coffee and beer. Available January through February each year.

Name: Black Raven Grandfather Raven Imperial Stout
Description: In the creator role, and in the Raven's role as the totem and ancestor, the Raven is often addressed as Grandfather Raven. With this stately sense of pomp and tradition we bring you our Imperial Stout. This robust black ale is full with rich dark caramel, unsweetened chocolate, and hints of coffee aromas and flavors. Stately indeed, but at 9.5% ABV, perhaps it is just a vain attempt to encourage the trickster spirit to act respectably. Released annually in the winter.

Name: Black Raven Wisdom Seeker IPA
Description: Folklore and mythology present the raven as an omniscient creature with special powers and abilities. The Wisdom Seeker Double IPA gets its special powers from an enormous amount of hops and malted barley. Brewed in the West coast Double IPA style, this bold brew features massive citrus and herbal hop additions and a full hop aroma. Seek your wisdom cautiously; this hop feast packs a punch.

Name: Black Raven Redfeather Session IPA
Description: This red session IPA is part of our rotating SIPA series. The Redfeather SIPA is brewed in the session IPA style. This beer presents the hop bitterness and flavor of a red IPA but in a more refreshing, lower alcohol version. Additional crystal malts contribute the red hue and malt backbone to layer the hops onto. Available during the spring/summer seasons each year.

Name: Phillips Longboat Chocolate Porter
Description: Longboat pours a beautiful dark brown and oozes bold chocolate flavour. Its rich velvet texture smoothes the senses.

Name: Phillips Tigershark Citra Pale Ale
Description: This citra-focused beer is a pale ale re-imagined. bred to attack the pallet, Tiger Shark is a tropical alpha beast packed with juicy passion fruit and citrus flavour, without the bitter bite.

Name: Phillips Space Goat Dry Hopped Oat Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Phillips Amnesiac Double IPA
Description: Uh, we forget...Oh Yeah, this is a big beer. Mind blowing amounts of hops give this beer tons of flavour and aroma. Not for the faint of heart. The bigger, meaner cousin to the Hop Circle IPA.

Name: Phillips Electric Unicorn White IPA
Description: Electric Unicorn is a hop-infused white ale; best enjoyed while riding a mystical mono-horned laser beast, racing through the galaxy to the sonic backdrop of screaming metal guitars, time to ditch reality and take this India Pale fairy tale for a ride.

Name: Phillips Citricity Grapefruit Zest IPA
Description: This grapefruit zest-infused IPA is charged with freshly peeled fruit juciness. Zesty pith notes mingle in perfect union with bright citrus hop character. Peel back the sunshine and enjoy some citrus paradise.   This hand-crafted brew pours a sunset golden colour with a pillow white head. Freshly peeled grapefruit sparkles off the nose, with crisp citrus flavours set against a backdrop of fruit-forward hops. Finishes clean.

Name: Phillips Pilsner
Description: Proprietary Pilsner malts done in house.

Name: Phillips Ginger Beer
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: With more ginger than Gilligan could handle, our Ginger Beer is true to its name, bursting with bold ginger flavour and aroma.

Name: Crookeder Tooth Pumpkin
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: The big barrel aged brother to crooked tooth, this pumpkin ale is king of the patch. "Crookeder" brings a delicious vanilla bourbon punch to help light up that smile! Pairs well with tricks and treats of all kinds.

Name: Fat Orange Cat The Raven
Description: This porter is not at all sweet. Three dark malts are used in this brew, but the highest percentage is the chocolate malt giving it this distinct flavor.

Name: Fat Orange Cat Brew Baby Kittens NEIPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A lovely hazy pale yellow brew with a tiny hint of sweetness on the nose. Up front we find a relaxed medley of fresh citrus, mangos, and pineapple. It finishes with a hint of pine and invigorating grapefruit with just enough bitterness to cleanse your palette and invite you back for another sip.

Name: Fat Orange Cat Launch IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: New England style IPA with low bitterness and a citrus flavor.

Name: Fat Orange Cat Little Blue Penguin IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Two hops from New Zealand: NELSON SAUVIN and MOTUEKA, plus sauvignon blanc grape juice. This combination creates a complex flavor with a tropical fruit finish.

Name: Fat Orange Cat She’s A Rainbow
Description: The combination of ELLA and AZACCA hops creates a juicy spectrum of fruit flavors.

Name: Fat Orange Cat Sweet Jane Key Lime
Description: Milkshake IPA with key lime and vanilla. The key lime puree adds a tartness to this version.

Name: Fat Orange Cat Do the Escalator To the 13th Floor
Description: Five different hops in this DIPA - small batch was at FOC previously called 13TH FLOOR.

Name: Fat Orange Cat Remember What the Dormouse Said IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Eureka and Citra hops.

Name: Fat Orange Cat Keep Yer Claw Sharp IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Vic Secret & Citra hops. This combination of hops creates a unique and super smooth taste - think Strawberries and Cream without the lactose and without the sweetness that comes to mind.

Name: Erdinger Hefeweizen
Description: The Premium Weissbier at the top of its class. Not only in the context of the Erdinger assortment Erdinger Weissbier with fine yeast applies undisputed as the classical authors, as the white beer absolutely. It is brewed with fine yeast after a delivered prescription and naturally strictly after the Bavarian purity requirement. Today still without the traditional bottle fermentation one does not do here: Three to four weeks it lasts, until the Erdinger Weissbier with fine yeast matured. For the production only finest raw materials are used. Experience of many years and constant quality controls guarantee beyond that the unmistakable taste. A Weissbier for all, those the unforgettable good taste love.

Name: Erdinger Weissbier Non-Alcoholic
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description:
A cool glass of ERDINGER Non-Alcoholic not only tastes fantastic, but is also healthy – thanks to the vitamin B9 that supports a strong metabolism. With its isotonic properties , it provides the body directly with valuable ingredients and thus satisfies thirst even faster.

The Non-Alcoholic drink from Erding is not only a real energizer but also low in calories, with 82 calories in each 11.2 fl oz bottle, and made exclusively from natural ingredients.

A varied and balanced diet as well as a healthy lifestyle are important. ERDINGER Non-Alcoholic supports this while also tasting fantastically full-bodied and refreshing!

Description: The Premium Weissbier at the top of its class. For the production only finest raw materials are used. Experience of many years and constant quality controls guarantee beyond that the unmistakable taste. A Weissbier for all, those the unforgettable good taste love.

Name: Erdinger Sommerweisse
Description: Fantastically refreshing on hot days: ERDINGER Sommerweisse! Delicately fruity hop flavors with citrus notes make it a fresh-hop pleasure.  For their new wheat beer, ERDINGER’s master brewers went for a select mixture of hops and the art of dry hopping – a process which brings out the flavor and mildly aromatic bitterness particularly well. Brewed in accordance with the Bavarian Purity Law.  Sommerweisse is great for drinking straight from the bottle. We have also designed a special glass to ensure the hop aromas and delicate flavors can be enjoyed to the full.  Sommerweisse is only available from May to August – while stocks last.

Name: Revival Night Swim’ah Belgian Wheat Ale
Description: Belgian style Witt flavored with sweet orange peel, coriander, natural raspberries, and hopped with Citra hops. Sweet/tart meets in the middle and makes this the perfect session ale. Ideal for the beach, the campfire, and just about everything Summer.

Name: Revival Zeppelin Hefeweizen Ale
Description: A classic Hefeweizen, Zeppelin is brewed with mix of Pilsner and Wheat malts from Germany and hopped with German Hallerteau hops. Hints of clove and vanilla from the traditional yeast used in fermentation round out this brew's crisp and refreshing taste.

Name: Revival Burnsider Pale Ale
Description: Inspired by the eponymous facial hair of General A.E. Burniside, Rhode Island's 30th Governor, and the freedom and spirit his hairstyle represents, the Burnsider American-Style Pale Ale is made with a special blend of English malts and hopped with Centennial, Galaxy and Simcoe hops.

Name: Revival Hail Beary Blueberry Sour Ale
Description: New England is known for good times and big wins. Hail Beary Blueberry Sour Ale is both, blending delicious beer with fresh blueberries for a taste that scores. Cans go on sale from our Tasting Room tomorrow at 5 PM. With no shortage of passion this edition in our Beary Sour series is truly the Greatest Of Ale Time.

Name: Revival White Electric Coffee Stout
Description: A mix of malts -- Maris Otter from England, Chocolate, Crystal, Roasted Barley and Chocolate Wheat -- along with EKG hops and specially-roasted White Electric coffee from New Harvest roasters create a complex beverage with notes of bittersweet coffee and chocolate.

Name: Revival You Thirsty? 1/6 Barrel
Description: This brew is our entry into the new era of New England IPAs. Unfiltered, with tons of flaked barley, we’ve added 3 times the Citra, Galaxy, Mosaic, and Azacca hops at flame-out and then dry-hopped it 3 times on top. Is this juicy? Yes. Is there mouthfeel? Yes. Is this overkill? Probably, it’s Revival.

Name: Revival Double Black IPA
Description: The heavy roast profile of our Double Black IPA is accented by an explosion of hops. Tones of coffee, vanilla, wood and citrus mix with herbal notes to make this beer the complex beast that it is. Hopped with Chinook, Sorachi Ace, Nugget and Cascade hops.

Name: Revival Conga Double IPA
Description: Conga is Revival Brewings first imperial IPA. Made with extra pale malt, white wheat, white rye, light Munich and crystal malts. Seven different hop addiditions were made in this recipe and a total of 30 lbs. of dry hops were used. Crisp, floral, citrusy and extremely boozy.

Name: Revival Star Child Pilsner
Description: A unique brew not limited to Earth. This Bohemian-style Pilsner is designed to celebrate and spread positive travels. Dry hopped with Mosaic, it's light and crisp, with cosmic drinkability. Open up and find your smile

Name: Tivoli Helles Lager
Description: With 150 years of brewing in Colorado, our roots run deep. Holding true to our German heritage, we continue to lager our beer while embracing modern techniques to enhance it. We painstakingly craft our beers over 42 days to bring out the true flavors of each recipe because we believe that beer has a soul. This Helles lager is what started it all back in 1859. It's rich golden hue marks it as a true tribute to the original Munich style of Lager.

Name: Tivoli Mile Hi Hefeweizen
Description: Brewed for those perfect summer days when the sun is high in the Colorado sky and you're thirsting for something refreshing and delicious. We start with our traditional German Hefeweizen recipe and put a modern twist on it, making a lighter and drier version, with the aroma of sweet spices, very low bitterness and a clean and refreshing finish. Perfect for when you're grilling and relaxing with friends.

Name: Tivoli Hello Darkness Stout
Description: An old friend of Tivoli, Stouts were traditionally brewed as a stronger (stouter) version of a porter and found popularity among the working class of London during the 18th century. It remains a crowd pleaser to this day, and you’ll find our version light and dry, but with an emphasis on the roasted character and aroma of the dark malts we use to brew it. Whether you are surrounded by friends or just enjoying the sounds of silence deep in the Rockies, you’ll find that Hello Darkness is an excellent winter companion.

Name: Tivoli Mountain Squeeze Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Melon - Honeydew, Pineapple, Stone Fruit, Tropical Fruit
Description: At Tivoli, while we always hold our heritage very dear, we also are devoted to delivering new meticulously crafted brews for our fans. Bursting with more juice-tastic flavors than even the Rockies can contain, our juicy IPA is sure to satisfy! We brew it with five different hops, allowing you to savor tastes of champagne mango, succulent honeydew, pineapple, under-ripe peach, and just a touch of orange zest. Mountain Squeeze is bright and made to enjoy in the heat of summer, the cold of winter, and every season in between. Strap in, hang on and ride the juice coaster of flavor.

Name: Tivoli Brutiful IPA
Description: We have a rich brewing heritage but we also pride ourselves in being early adopters of new techniques. By combining classic beers with cutting edge technique, we’ve made a unique brew that stands apart from the trend. In your hand is our Brutiful IPA, a brew developed through close collaboration with our partners at MSU Denver. We’ve created this clean, dry IPA by using traditional Ale malt and yeast strains, and we took it a step further by lagering it. The result is this bright, effervescent champagne inspired IPA that is a prime example of the Tivoli way of always pressing on.

Name: Tivoli Slam Dunkel
Description: First brewed by the Benedictine monks in the mid 12th century, Dunkel beers were further enhanced by the 1516 Reinheitsgebot which decreed that beer could be made only from barley, hops, and water. The style has continued its evolution over the last 200 years. Our modern version is highly sessionable and delivers a deep, full Munich malt character with only slight bitterness, making it the perfect cold weather companion. When the nights are chilly or you want a full-bodied beer for the game, you can't miss with a Slam Dunkel!

Name: Tivoli Bohemian Girl Pilsner
Description: Travelling all the way from Germany, our founder was drawn to the beauty of this region and started brewing here back in 1859. Our Bohemian Girl brand is a tribute to that same wanderlust spirit and appreciation for nature that brings us all to the Rocky Mountains. To recreate this classic Denver brand, we combined Premium Pilsner and Rye Malt with generous portions of Czech Saaz hops. The end result is a light-bodied, dry, crisp golden lager with an aroma reminiscent of fresh baked bread and a floral finish.

Name: Tivoli Rocky Mountain Radler
Description: Originally created for thirsty cyclists outside of Munich, Radler's German roots run as deep as Tivoli's. It only makes sense that we brought this German gem to Colorado where the mountains call to hikers, bikers and campers all summer long. Using apples to complement our Helles lager, we've crafted a refreshing brew with the earthy, floral aroma of apples with the crisp malt sweetness of our Helles lager. A sweet spiciness from ginger adds a peppery kick at the end. Crack one open after your latest outdoor adventure.

Name: Tivoli She’s My Cherry Pie
Description: This Imperial lager tastes so good it brings a tear to your eye! To craft Cherry Pie, we lager Pilsner malt, pack in 2400lbs. of locally grown tart Montmorency cherries and then add subtle hints of cinnamon and brown sugar. Don't let the name fool you, this little number ain't sweet but sure packs a punch. Our unique flavor combination provides an excellent changeup for cold weather sipping and is guaranteed to put a smile on your face ten miles wide.

Name: NOLA Blonde Ale
Description: NOLA Blonde Ale was the very first ale created by the NOLA Brewing team. Originally released in March 2009 this is our most popular and widely distributed beer. NOLA Blonde is a medium-bodied traditional American blonde ale, golden in color with floral and citrus hop aromas.

Name: NOLA 7th Street Wheat
Description: “7th Street Wheat” started out as our Summer seasonal, but due to its popularity has made its own place in our year round ales.  Named in honor of the 7th Street wharf across the street from the brewery, this filtered wheat ale is light-bodied American style with pounds of fresh lemon basil added after fermentation.  The light citrus taste with a hint of spicy herb on the back goes well with almost any seafood dish, and from what we hear, is a favorite at bars as a stand alone refreshing beer.

Name: NOLA Rebirth Pale Ale
Food Pairing: Duck  Game Bird, Cheese - Hard Aged
Description: Rebirth Pale Ale debuted on draft in April, paying tribute to the Grammy Award-winning Rebirth Brass Band and raising money for The Roots of Music, a nonprofit music-education program co-founded by Rebirth drummer Derrick Tabb.

Name: NOLA Brewing Funk Series Dryades
Description: A sour brown ale with plums and cherries aged in red wine barrels

Name: NOLA Irish Channel Stout
Description: Irish Channel Stout is an American style stout that has sweet malt flavors of caramel and chocolate, complimented by a crisp bitterness produced by roasted barley and American Hops. It was named after the neighborhood that the brewery is located in, the Irish Channel. The complex malt bill of pale and roasted malts result in this well balanced stout that is smooth, rich, dark and delicious!  And watch out – ABV 6.8%!  Due to it’s extreme popularity, this brew has been moved from a winter seasonal to a year-round beer.

Name: NOLA Mecha
Description: American Imperial IPA boasting Bravo, Columbus, Centennial and Citra hops. Breware of MECHA's powerful flavor and its attack of half pound per barrel dry-hop aroma. Formally called Mechahopzilla after our Brewmaster, now named MECHA for the lawyers.

Name: NOLA Hopitoulas
Description: Hopitoulas was the third addition to our year-round beer portfolio.  This 6.5%ABV ale is a West Coast style India Pale Ale that combines six malts and six hops with additional dry hopping for three weeks. It takes about a month and a half to make each batch and we think it is worth the wait.  Hints of pine and citrus with a powerful, yet balanced hoppy flavor, Hopitoulas packs a punch that you won’t forget.  Available on draft and in 16 ounce cans.

Name: NOLA Syncopation
Description: After playing with a number of different recipes, NOLA took their time perfecting a blend of Citra, Mosaic, Grungeist, Calypso and Ekuanot hops for a fruity and juicy aroma that finishes all hop. Late hop additions lead to more flavor and less IBUs and coming in at 6% keep Syncopation very drinkable.

Name: NOLA Hoppyright Infringement
Description: “This beer is a “hazy and juicy dry-hopped” imperial IPA that encourages other breweries to just “focus on making good beer.”  Hoppyright Infringement hits 7.6%-AbV.”

Name: Sly Fox Christmas Ale
Description: Expressive mulling spices swirl and mingle in this full-bodied red ale. With one sip you’ll know the holidays are here!

Name: Sly Fox Grisette Belgian Wheat Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Grisette’s storied history dates back to Belgian workers quenching their thirst after a laborious day in the mines. Brewed with a careful combination of wheat and barley malt and fermented with a delicate Belgian yeast strain, Grisette strikes a uniquely refreshing balance between funky saison and fruity hefeweizen. Our medal-winning Grisette is now a perennial favorite that won’t soon be forgotten.

Name: Sly Fox Rt. 113 IPA
Description: This complex, aromatic beer is brewed with an abundance of the finest hops from the Pacific Northwest and England. Every sip will remind you of just why you fell in love with craft beer in the first place.

Name: Sly Fox Vulpulin IPA
Description:
(vul’·pew·lin) : of, relating to, or resembling a fox-like creature grown entirely out of hop bines.

Hop farmers of the Pacific Northwest have reported sightings of an ethereal creature romping around their hop yards under the full moon. The Vulpes Lupulus has been described as a creature made from the bines themselves, causing the plants to wave and dance in the moonlight even when no breeze is present. Nonbelievers say it’s nothing more than a common fox out on her nightly hunt. While no hard evidence has been documented, we happen to believe in these wild tales.

Our fabled brew embodies the spirit of this crafty hop farm dweller. Bursting with Citra, Mosaic, Cascade, and Centennial, Vulpulin IPA grabs your senses and takes you on a midnight frolic through the hops yards.

Name: Sly Fox Baby Sparkles Double Dry-Hyped Pottstown-Style IPA
Description: Our brewers crammed as much hype into this very special Pottstown-style IPA as the tanks could hold. A healthy dose of flaked oats gives the beer its namesake sparkle, while a double dry-hopping of El Dorado, Simcoe, and Citra ratchets this juicy hype bomb up to 11.

Name: Sly Fox Oktoberfest Lager
Description: Ein Prosit! This seasonal gem is best enjoyed under a humongous tent while you and thousands of your closest friends sing enthusiastically. Or anywhere, really. It’s all about the gemütlichkeit, baby!

Name: Sly Fox Pikeland Pilsner
Description: Gold Medal, GABF 2000, 2007; Bronze Medal, GABF 2003. A Northern German style Pilsner brewed with imported German Pils malt and hopped with German and Czech hops. Light in body, light straw in color and dry. Brewed with imported German Pils malt and hopped with German and Czech hops. OG 11 ºP / 44 IBUs

Description: A German-style golden lager brewed with imported German pils malt and Saaz and Hallertau hops. This light-bodied beer offers a gentle, dry finish. A perennial favorite in the Sly Fox pubs and our brewer's go-to session beer.

Name: Stiegl Radler
Description: Real fruit juice gives the new Stiegl Radler a distinct tart aroma and natural cloudiness.

Name: Stiegl Zitrone Lemon Radler
Description: This refreshing thirst quencher with real lemon juice satisfies your senses with its sparkling and invigorating taste

Name: Stiegl Raspberry Radler
Description: Fresh Raspberry juice gives Himbeere its striking bright-pink color and aroma of fresh jam. Maintains the refreshing lightness synonymous with Stiegl Radlers.

Name: Stiegl Radler Grapefruit
Description: Real fruit juice gives the new Stiegl Radler a distinct  tart aroma and natural cloudiness.

Name: Stiegl Weisse
Description: Charms with its lightly fruity wheat flavour, mild character and delicately sparkling quality. The carefully selected Austrian ingredients and a gentle maturation process make this wheat beer an indulgence of the highest quality.

Name: Stiegl
Description: Stiegl Bier is brewed strictly in accordance with the Bavarian Purity Law of 1516. You'll only find pure, spring water from the Alps, choice two row summer barley and the finest hops. Mildly hopped, golden in color, a great head and with a superb finish.

Name: Stiegl Pils
Description: Hazy golden color with floating particles. White foamy 3 finger head lasting around 5 minutes. Strong legs with subtle activity.  Faint aromas and flavors of grains with floral and herbal spices. Sharp and crisp taste of pleasant bitterness. Light slick body with some nice carbonation. Well intensified but short finish, ending with slightly dry bitter mouth coating.

Name: Stiegl Pilsner
Description: Elegant beer enjoyment blended with the pleasing bitterness of hops. Glossy and pale yellow, it is agreeably lively with a dry, thin body. Certain to invigorate the palate with a fresh bouquet of aromatic hops from Mühlviertel and a pronounced bitterness in the finish.

Name: Stiegl Goldbrau
Description: Stiegl Goldbräu boasts an unrivalled, well rounded, balanced and wonderfully thirst-quenching flavour. Mildly hopped with a typical refreshing beer bouquet, golden colour, a magnificent fine head and pleasant aftertaste, Stiegl Goldbräu is the enjoyment of beer at the highest level. 12°

Name: Four String Suncaster Summer Wheat Ale
Description: Our summer seasonal is a refreshing unfiltered wheat beer that finishes dry with a wonderful peach and passionfruit aroma. Summer drinking at its best!

Name: Four String Brass Knuckle Pale Ale
Description: A hard-rocking pale ale that smacks the lips with tasty bitter hops and citrusy grapefruit shots to the nose. It finishes crisp and dry, sustaining like a windmill power chord. All of a sudden it hits you…this is the one.

Name: Four String Switchblade IPA
Description: Explosive notes of ripe tropical fruit and citrus dominate the aroma, with savage amounts of hops used in both early and late additions. This dry-hopped American IPA will close out every show the way rock intended…guitar smashing and hoping for an encore.

Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Maryland- American Double/Imperial IPA- 8.0% ABV. Pours a hazy golden hue. Double dry hopped Hazy DIPA with Citra and Mosaic. Bursts with tropical fruit and juicy resin for a balanced hop bomb.

Name: Oliver Brewing Cherry Blossom Wheat Ale
Description: A sure sign of Spring, cherry blossoms on the trees and Cherry Blossom Ale in the glass. This wheat ale is fermented with 588lbs of pureed dark sweet cherries per 20bbl batch.

Name: Oliver Brewing $$ Bills Y’all
Description: Show me the money! $$ Bills Y'all, a Triple Hazy IPA double dry hopped with Nelson Sauvin and Citra.

Name: Oliver Balls To The Wall Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A refreshing pale ale with a gratifying hop punch. Brewed with Nugget, Mt Hood, and Citra hops.

Name: Oliver Swirl Sangria Sour Ale
Description: A kettle sour ale brewed with lemon, lime, pink himalayan sea salt and orange peel. A collaboration with Downtown Crown Wine and Beer.

Name: Oliver So It Gose
Description: A gose style sour ale brewed with a little coriander and pink sea salt and fermented with blueberry and lemon.

Name: Oliver Brewing 206 IPA
Description: Hop forward, medium bodied with a touch of malt sweetness cutting against the hop bitterness.

Name: Oliver’s/Stillwater Trendsetter Sour IPA
Description: Kettle sour IPA, dry hopped with Pacific Gem and Hallertau Blanc. Notes of dried apricot, overripe plum and caramel fruit cake ... an Autumnal delight.

Name: Oliver Delicate Bubbles IPA
Description: Double dry hopped with Citra and Nelson Sauvin

Name: Sudwerk Hefeweisen Bavarian Wheat
Description: An authentic, unfiltered, Bavarian-style wheat ale. Our proprietary Weizen yeast provides a distinctive aroma and flavor profile true to its Bavarian roots; spicy, slightly fruity, dry and refreshing. No fruit garnish necessary.

Name: Sudwerk Funke Hop Farm
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Brewed with oats and wheat, and fermented out with two strains of saison yeast. It spends about six to nine months in an assortment of barrels-Petite Sirah, Grenache, Chardonnay-while being fermented with Brettanomyces, Lactobacillus, and a house yeast culture from their in-house solera system. It's then blended with an all-Brett beer that's barrel-aged separately, bringing in more tropical and guava notes. Oh, and it's dry-hopped at 1.5 pounds per barrel with Simcoe, Nelson, and Citra.

Name: Sudwerk Bourbonator
Description: This limited batch of Doppel Bock was aged in hand-selected Kentucky bourbon barrels. The brewers allowed the beer to hibernate until it was time to uncage the beastly blend of flavors including vanilla, coconut, hints of bourbon, chocolate, toffee, and the signature, velvet smooth finish of the Doppel. Best enjoyed after dark.

Name: Sudwerk Marzen
Description: Choice hops and five different specialty malts are combined to produce this rich, amber and copper-toned lager. Sweeter in flavor than Sudwerk’s other core offerings, the Märzen has a full robust character with a smooth, zen-like finish.

Name: Sudwerk 3 Best Friends Coffee Vanilla Lager
Description: 3 Best Friends incorporates Madagascar vanilla, cacao nibs, and Honduran coffee. It's the black sheep of the bunch-in a delicious, well-lagered fashion.

Name: Sudwerk Pilsner
Description: A Northern German-style Pilsner brewed in Northern California. Our pilsner is brewed entirely with pale two-row Weyermann, true to the style. A special blend of Bavarian Hallertauer and Tettnanger hops are used during brewing, adding to the sharp finish. Winner of the coveted “Brewers Choice” award for 25 consecutive years and counting.

Name: Sudwerk Rye Of The Lager
Categories: India Pale Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: Brewed with heirloom German rye from the European "rye belt", this hardy cereal crop provides hints of spice complimented by a depth of nutty and rich field grain flavor. Simcoe and Amarillo hops sprinkle in West Coast citrus aromas and a piney bite. Lager yeast ties the recipe together, providing a crisp and refined finish.
