Name: Timmermans Oude Gueuze
Description: Oude Gueuze is an appellation controlee : its label is protected. It is also known as the champagne of beers, especially as it is only available as a limited edition. Timmermans Oude Gueuze’s special flavour derives from its time-honoured method of preparation. It is a blend of old lambic, which has been aged for three years in wooden barrels, and young lambic which ensures spontaneous fermentation in the bottle. The different lambics are carefully selected by the brewer to obtain a perfect flavour. After it has been produced, Timmermans Oude Gueuze, which is refermented for four months in the bottle, continues to improve for 20 years.

Name: Cape May Coastal Evacuation Double IPA
Description: "Coastal Evacuation": a phrase common at the Jersey Shore. Hurricane season hits hard, and we're hitting back with a Double IPA with copious amounts of centennial hops, able to withstand the storm. It's time to evacuate -- are you prepared?

Name: Cape May Devil’s Reach
Description: A Belgian beast, fruity and light, the complexity and character of Devil’s Reach comes from a robust Belgian yeast. Deceptively simple, caution is demanded because, before you know it, Devil’s Reach has swallowed you whole.

Name: Cape May Always Ready
Description: Cape May is home to the Coast Guard, so we salute those who are Always Ready with a juicy, Northeast Pale Ale. With the addition of wheat and oats for a medium body and with brilliant aromas of tropical fruits like pineapple, mango, and citrus zest, this lush hop-bomb is Always Ready.

Name: Cape May Cape May IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The American IPA named for America’s Oldest Seaside Resort, Cape May IPA is loaded with floral and citrus notes, slightly bitter with a zesty finish. A West Coast-style IPA brewed in the heart of the East Coast, it’s the beer that’s Crafted on the Cape.

Name: Cape May Tan Limes Mexican Lager
Description: Tan Limes is our Mexican-style Lager brewed with a touch of locally-sourced sea salt and a hint of Persian lime juice. Fresh and zesty, Tan Limes would be perfectly at home at your local cantina and is best paired with street tacos, brilliant sunshine, and close friends.

Name: Cape May The Grove Citrus Shandy
Description: The Grove drinks like you picked the fruit this morning, squeezed it into a glass, and --poof!-- turned it into the most intensely crushable beer you've ever seen. Snappy, super bright, and ridiculously refreshing, The Grove is sweet and tart, with a brilliant aroma reminiscent of walking through a citrus grove at harvest.

Name: Cape May Follow the Gull IPA
Description:
Originally brewed to celebrate Cape May County's 325th anniversary, we brew Follow the Gull with a ridiculous amount of Citra, El Dorado, Azacca, and Amarillo hops, yielding a juicy and ultra-drinkable hop-bomb bursting with tropical and citrus aromas. Though the anniversary has passed, we loved Follow the Gull too much not to brew it again.

This is a rotating beer series which is subject to change based on current brewery release and retailer availability.

Name: Cape May Orange Crushin’ It IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Refreshing and great for the beach, Crushin' It is soon to be your summer staple. With Citra, Mosaic, and Azacca hops blending together to accentuate the fresh flavors of orange juice, Crushin' It is dry, approachable, and perfectly balanced. Relax in the sand. Enjoy a no shower happy hour. This beer is best paired with good friends, sunshine, and SPF 30.

Name: Cape May White Caps Double IPA
Description: Brewed with hefty portions of wheat and oats, White Caps has a soft mouthfeel, a pillowy head, and a robust body. Featuring Mosaic and Citra hops, this effervescent Double IPA explodes with notes of papaya, mango, stone fruits, and citrus. Like the Atlantic during a nor'easter, White Caps is slightly dangerous, utterly crushable, and thoroughly New Jersey.

Name: Saison Dupont Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Saison Dupont is a classic Belgian farmhouse ale. This is a beautifully balanced, complex beer that has a refreshing fruitiness and long, dry finish. It is bottled unfiltered so it may be cloudy or have a slight sediment but this is normal and perfectly natural.

Name: Brass Dupont Saison Dupont
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Dupont/Lost Abbey Deux Amis Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Dupont Foret Organic Belgian
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Dupont continues to be innnovative in their field while still managing to stay true to producing authentic beers made from time-honored recipes. This has been demonstrated in their work as leaders of the organic movement in Belgian brewing. A true original, Foret was the first 100% certified organic beer to be produced in Belgium when it was released over a decade ago. Every ingredient in Foret reflects Dupont’s dedication to producing quality craft beers — from the organically cultivated hops and barley to the filtered artesian well water, which provides the beer with a distinct and truly unique mineral quality. Foret is brewed using the same recipe and yeast used to make the award-winning Saison Dupont Vieille Provision. It is deliciously smooth, and its light body is balanced by a spicy kick of bold malt flavor. It has distinct aromas of bread, clove and pepper, finishing with a dry herbal note that make it a perfect pairing for almost any type of cuisine.  We introduced Foret to the U.S. market over a DECADE ago. It is Belgium’s first 100% certified organic beer. Brewed from 100% organically cultivated hops and barley and filtered artesian well water. Bottle-conditioned. Deliciously smooth bread and clove and pepper kick, bold, dry and herbal.

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Triomfbeer is our very own beer, brewed in association with the renowned Belgian Brasserie Dupont (known for Saison Dupont, Moinette, Bon Voeux…)

Name: Blackberry Farm Boundary Tree
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This Farmhouse Ale features notes of tropical fruit that complement its bready malt undertones. A soft bitterness, reminiscent of orange marmalade, balances delicate spice notes that result from a warm fermentation.

Name: True North Ales Northern Haze Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Northern Haze is brewed with unmalted barley and wheat atop a blend of base malts to provide a full mouthfeel and a heavy hop/protein haze. Fruit forward ale yeast and ample additions of American and Southern Hemisphere hops provide aromatics of passion fruit, stone fruit, and berries. SILVER MEDAL at 2019 NABA International Competition.

Name: True North Ales Vincianne Belgian Blonde Ale
Description: Vincianne is brewed with Belgian yeast and malt, candi syrup, and noble hops. Effervescent, crisp, and refreshing, with subtle aromas and flavor reminiscent of apple, pear, earth and black pepper. GOLD AWARD winner at 2018 World Beer Cup. GOLD MEDAL at 2019 NABA International Competition.

Name: True North Ales Season Of The Witch Hazy & Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Double dry hopped with Citra, Vic Secret, and Strata. A soft mouthfeel carries explosive flavors and aromas of passion fruit, mango, pineapple, and melon.

Name: True North Ales Squared Double IPA
Description: Squared Double IPA is brewed with a blend of base malts, fruit-forward ale yeast, and copious additions of American hops. Full bodied, with layers of intense aromatics of passion fruit, ripe mango, stone fruit, and fresh cut grass.

Name: True North Ales Secret Test Batch #292 Hazy & Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A tropical blend of El Dorado, Azacca, Motueka, and Sabro hops come together to produce an incredibly aromatic Hazy IPA. Bursting with big aromas of tangerine, mango, pine, coconut cream, mojito lime, and mint.

Name: True North Ales North Shore Session IPA
Description: North Shore Session IPA is brewed with base malts of high character, oats, fruit-forward ale yeast, and American hops. A light, soft, and nutty malt body provides the structure for flavors and aromas of peach, apricot, berries, and melon.

Name: True North Ales Shear Hoppiness Hazy & Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Apricot, Citrus, Fruity, Passionfruit, Peach, Pine
Description: Brewed with 2-row, wheat, and oat malt, and fermented using our fruit-forward house ale yeast, contributing flavors of creamy peach and apricot stone fruit. Shear Hoppiness is heavily dry hopped with Citra, Mosaic, and Amarillo producing flavors of juicy fruit, pine, passion fruit, and lemon candy.

Name: True North Ales Bright & Early Tropical IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Bright & Early pours a deep orange haze. Specialty hops and yeast provide flavors of melon, peach and fresh-squeezed orange juice and aromas of candied lemon, mango, pineapple, and banana. No juice added!

Name: True North Ales Northern Haze Juicy IPA 1/6 Barrel
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Northern Haze is brewed with unmalted barley and wheat atop a blend of base malts to provide a full mouthfeel and a heavy hop/protein haze. Fruit-forward ale yeast and ample additions of Mosaic, Citra, Amarillo, and Mandarina Bavaria hops provide aromatics of passion fruit, stone fruit, and berries. SILVER MEDAL at 2019 NABA International Competition.

Name: Brouwerij West Picnic Lightning IPA
Description: Mecca Grade Estate Malt, Raw Wheat, and Rolled Oats. Heavily hopped with Chinook, Simcoe, and Citra.

Name: Brouwerij West Mor Mor
Description: We use only imported Belgian malt, German noble hops and our house yeast strain we isolated in Belgium. 10.5% ALC/VOL and of course no spices added. Deep black-red in color with full palate and a dry finish.

Name: Brouwerij West Switcheroo Pale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Experimental Hop-Press Pale Ale. Malt: Mecca Grade Estate barley, raw barley and raw wheat. Hops: Hop Tea: Simcoe, Centennial, Chinook. Dry-hopped with Citra

Name: Brouwerij Bounce West Coast IPA
Description: Like a true wildcat, our newest West Coast IPA leaps from tastebud to tastebud with ferocious notes of grapefruit, pine, and passionfruit thanks to the dank combination of Citra, Mosaic, and Centennial hops. While not overpoweringly bitter, Bounce IPA maintains an approachability for every type of IPA lover. Dedicated to the Hop Wizards who paved the way for California IPAs.

Name: Brouwerij West Earth That Was IPA
Description: A Light, Hazy IPA brewed with a blend of American and German barley, raw barley, and raw wheat. Hopped and dry-hopped with Simcoe, Chinook, and Centennial

Name: Brouwerij West Popfuji
Description: An Unfiltered Pilsner that delivers a delicate malt sweetness combined with a subtle fruit and spice character from the use of German Noble Hops.

Name: Brouwerij Thing For Your Head Mango Hard Seltzer
Description: A THING for your head. Tastes like Mango, but you know, hard seltzer style Mango. Naturally gluten-free.

Name: Brouweij West Dog Ate My Homework
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Stellwagen Ocean Bluff
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Ocean Bluff is our Belgian inspired saison. Inherently local by style, we decided to keep it local when choosing the name Ocean Bluff. We sourced 100% of the grain bill from local maltster @stonepathmalt who are just a short drive down route 3 in Wareham.

Name: Stellwagen Cymbals Pale Ale
Description: Tipping the hi-hat to a former tenant of our building that manufactured a certain percussion instrument. Cymbals Pale Ale is brewed with a simple base of barley, wheat and crystal malt as the background for the hops to ride on. A crash of Bright citrus and floral aromas are followed by a splash of flavors including orange, grapefruit, tangerine and papaya.

Name: Stellwagen Whale Pedaler
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A New England style IPA brewed with a recently rediscovered Nordic yeast strain called Kveik. We added a heavy dose of Enigma and Eukanot to the dry hop for flavors and aromas of bright orange peel, stone fruit and a hint of petrichor on the nose. We invited our friends from 3Cross Fermentation Cooperative of Worcester to brew this beer specially for the Great Mass Collab beer festival.

Name: Stellwagen Whale Watcher Session IPA
Description: A light and refreshing session ale. Candied Mango and floral aromas up front give way to a sweet malt and citrus zest flavor with just a hint of bitterness to keep you coming back for another sip.

Name: Stellwagen Tiny Grooves DIPA
Description: There’s nothing quite like cracking open that gatefold double album and rolling…some great tunes! Packed with tropical dank notes of pineapple, lychee and sauvignon blanc grapes. Brewed for drinking ultra fresh and enjoying with your favorite music.

Name: Stellwagen Waves Crash In
Description: Waves Crash In is the first beer developed out of our modulation series of hoppy ales. A classic New England IPA with a soft, restrained bitterness, we get bright flavors and aromas of citrus, orange and lemon with an essence of pine.

Name: Stellwagen We Are Your Oat-verlords
Description: Oatverlords is brewed with an oat heavy grain bill and aggressively dry hopped rakau and Citra.

Name: Stellwagen Modulation #12
Description: For this exploration into our Modulation series, we used a special blend of German grown Amarillo hops. With lots harvested at three different stages, each lot contributes unique flavor and aroma. In Mod12 we get flavor and aroma notes of dank citrus and tropical fruits all built on a soft malt platform.

Name: Workhorse American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Crisp. Caramel. Citrus.

Name: Workhorse Guava Gose
Description: Clocking in at 4.9%, this kettle-soured Gose is bursting with complex flavors and aromas. Unique floral and tropical notes blend effortlessly with the subtle tartness of the Gose. Expect a dry, yet medium bodied finish from the salt addition and the lingering flavors of guava. This one's practically paradise in a can...prepare for pure island vibes with every sip.

Name: Workhorse Margarita Sour
Description: Key Lime Gose brewed with Sea Salt

Name: Workhorse West Coast IPA
Description: A clean malt profile of biscuit and light caramel notes produce the perfect backdrop for flavorful American hops. Citrus and pine through and through.

Name: Workhorse New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Citrus-forward IPA loaded with juicy American hops, bursting at the seams with tropical, fruity hop character.

Name: Workhorse Vienna Lager
Description: Featuring a blend of four German malts, this smooth lager is a true crowd-pleaser. Rich flavors of toasted bread and biscuit blend harmoniously with notes of almonds and caramel to produce this classic style.

Name: Workhorse American Pilsner
Description: Showcasing a blend of traditional noble hops in the brew kettle, this crisp easy-drinking beer is a year-round favorite. A small dry-hopping charge near the end of fermentation boosts the floral character of this beer.

Name: Workhorse Rosé Ale
Description: Tart, dry and effervescent ale fermented atop raspberry purée. Meant to refresh!

Name: Workhorse Piña Colada Tropical Ale
Description: Tropical ale brewed with coconut and pineapple. This is the second offering in their cocktail series.

Name: Common Roots Time APA

Name: Common Roots Coffee Cup

Name: Common Root Bright Light Double IPA
Description: Modern style DIPA made with all Citra hops

Name: Common Roots Daylight Double IPA
Description: Modern Style Double IPA with strong juicy, citrusy flavors and passion fruit aromas.

Name: Common Roots Beta
Description: Our experimental rotating IPA series. Each batch uses different hops, ingredients and techniques to continuously develop one of our favorite hop forward beer styles.

Name: Common Roots Good Fortune IPA
Description: This modern style IPA is brewed with Galaxy, El Dorado, and Amarillo hops for a tropical aroma and citrusy finish.

Name: Odd13 Codename: Superfan
Description: Codename: Superfan is a deliciously modern take on the American IPA style, brewed with a variety of juicy American Hops from the Pacific Northwest.

Name: Odd13 Noob Pale Ale
Description: The first batch brewed at our production facility, Noob is an American IPA. Heavy dry hopping with Mosaic and El Dorado combine with restrained bitterness to create a juicy flavor and aroma profile. The hops and yeast work together to provide hints of blueberry and orange candy.

Name: Odd 13 Brewing Moon Master IPA
Description: IPA with Vanilla and hopped with Amarillo, Azacca, Centennial, and Idaho-7.

Name: Odd13 Humulus Kalecumber Sour
Description: Kettle sour with cucumber, mint, and a touch of kale

Name: Odd13 Hawaiian Bartender
Description: Hawaiian Bartender is a showcase of brettanomyces, hops, and fruit. The malt bill is designed to feature a silky smooth mouth feel that highlights everything else going on. An assertive but not overwhelming tartness compliments the acidity and fruit flavor from the mango, the pineapple, and the centennial hops. The result is a refreshing but flavorful beer that is complex but drinkable at the same time.

Name: Odd13 Vincent Van Couch
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Vincent is a moderately sour beer with a grain bill and souring regime similar to a traditional Berliner Weiss. It features floral and citrus notes from significant late hopping and dry hopping. Brett Funk blends with the hops and acidity to create a truly unique beer.

Name: Odd13 Buzzin Cuzzin Coffee Oatmeal Stout
Odd13 Eric’s Ex Wife IPA

Name: Odd13 Intergalactic Juice Hunter DIPA
Description: Double IPA with Galaxy, Amarillo, and Simcoe. Contains lactose.

Name: Beachwood Into The Great Unknown Lambic
Careful With That Passion Fruit Eugene
Description: Careful with that Passion Fruit, Eugene is back for a second time! For this beer we take a blend of 9-14 month old barrels, add Passion Fruit for one month, and bottle condition with wine yeast for three months. The passion fruit shines through and combines perfectly with the flavors and acidity from the original blend. Fruity, funky, sour… this beer could be dangerous in the wrong hands.

Name: Beachwood Chaos Is A Friend Of Mine Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Beachwood Blendery Umeboshi
Description: Lambic/Gose-inspired ale made with plums and Bamboo Jade sea salt. Bright stone fruit and our house funk dominate the aromatics followed by flavors of juicy plum and melon. There is a solid acidity all the way through, rounded out by the sea salt, and a finish reminiscent of sweet tarts.

Name: Beachwood Propagation Series No. 3.3e4
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Berliner Weisse with Passion Fruit.

Name: Careful With That Peach Eugene
Description: Lambic-inspired ale with peaches. Glorious aromas of juicy ripe fruit gets your mouth watering before you take your first sip. Bold acidity and our house funk partner nice with big flavors of fuzzy peach. Sweet and full bodied with a tart finish, leaving you immediately wanting another sip.

Name: Come In Grape Your Time Is Up
Description: Lambic inspired ale with late harvest muscat grapes.

Name: Beachwood Brewing Pride Of Chops Ipa
Description: Take pride in what you brew and what you drink! To commemorate the 20th anniversary of O’Brien’s Pub in San Diego, California, we brewed this marvelously hoppy and aromatic India pale ale. A blend of Amarillo, Nelson Sauvin, & Mosaic set the tone for this splendid celebratory ale. Cheers!

Name: Back East Pomegranate Berliner
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A traditional Berliner Weisse, this light-bodied wheat ale is crisp and refreshing, with a tart flavor accentuated by the addition of fruit.

Name: Back East Misty Mountain IPA
Description: Misty Mountain is a great example of the American-style India Pale Ale synonymous with Craft Beer. This assertively hopped beer has a great hoppy aroma, crisp hop bite, and smooth medium body.

Name: Back East Ice Cream Man IPA
Description: A juicy New England IPA brewed with Citra hops. Juicy with citrus notes, reminiscent of an orange creamsicle. Rated #5 on Draft Magazine's list of "Top 50 IPAs"

Name: Back East Big Day Off DIPA
Description: Brewed in collaboration with the listeners at Radio 104.1, this hazy double IPA is brewed with Citra and El Dorado hops. Characterized by notes of candied cherries and tropical citrus.

Name: Back East Susy Greenberg IPA
Description: A light and juicy IPA with added mango that is not of this world! It will make you walk the streets like you're the queen (or king) of the town.

Name: Back East Octoberfest
Description: Brewed with imported Munich malts and noble German hops, this traditionally brewed beer has a hearty malt character perfect for cooler weather.

Name: Back East Bomo Mosaic Pilsner
Description: A bohemian style pilsner brewed with Mosaic hops. Crisp and refreshing with grapefruit flavors.

Name: Back East Seasonal
Description: Rotating Seasonal beer offering. Please reach out to support@drizly.com to ask which one the retailer is currently selling.

Name: Weldwerks Juicy Bits IPA
Description: Our version of a New England-style IPA featuring a huge citrus and tropical fruit hop character from the Mosaic, Citra, and El Dorado hops and softer, smoother mouthfeel from the adjusted water chemistry, higher protein malts, and lower attenuation. The end result is a beer reminiscent of citrus juice with extra pulp, thus the name Juicy Bits.

Name: Weldwerks It’s A Unicorn Thing IPA
Weldwerks Air Pinky
Description: New England-style Sour (kettle-soured) Triple IPA brewed with chardonnay grape must, Nelson Sauvin & Citra hops, and aged on French oak spirals.

Name: Weldwerks Grandma J’s Strawberry Rhubarb Pie Berliner
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: To create our latest #pastrysour, we decided to recreate a beer as close to Grandma J’s original strawberry rhubarb pie recipe as possible. We started by adding lactose sugar to our kettle-soured Berliner base, then fermented it with over 500 lbs of strawberry purée. After fermentation, we aged the finished beer with rhubarb purée, graham cracker and vanilla to give it the signature pie character. The sweetness of the strawberries and lactose and perfectly balanced by the tartness of the base beer and rhubarb, resulting in a beer that even Grandma J would be proud of.

Name: Weldwerks Evil Haze Factory DIPA
Description: Double IPA brewed with a villainous amount of Galaxy, Nelson Sauvin, El Dorado and Lotus hops, as part of our dastardly plans to take over the world (or at least to upset the beer purists)

Name: WeldWerks From Mosaic With Love IPA

Description:
Brewed with 100% Mosaic hops

Established in 2015, WeldWerks Brewing Co. is an award-winning craft brewery located in Greeley, Colorado recognized for brewing an array of beer styles including Juicy Bits, one of the most highly regarded hazy IPAs in the country. WeldWerks brings innovative and quality craft beer to the community it serves, garnering numerous medals and acclaim in their first three years of operation including multiple medals at both the Great American Beer Festival and World Beer Cup, as well as being named USA Today’s Best New Brewery in a 2016 10 Best Reader’s Poll. WeldWerks is passionately committed to giving back to the community it serves, establishing The WeldWerks Community Foundation, a 501c3 nonprofit dedicated to supporting local nonprofits through events like The WeldWerks Invitational. At WeldWerks, "Fine Tuned Beer" is way of life, turning up all the dials to ensure outstanding excellence in craft beer, service and beyond.

Description: Sorbet is an IPA with peach and mango. Inspired by Kai’s favorite milkshake from West Chester. Reminiscent of Kai and Claudia’s first date, when they were going to school in West Chester. Huge notes of peach, mango, and vanilla.

Description: A mouth-wateringly bright squeeze of lemon with a flourish of lavender

Name: KYLA Hard Kombucha Sunset Trio
Description: A POGalicious punch of ripe, palate-pleasing fruits

Name: KYLA Hard Kombucha Coconut Crush
Description: A coconutty concoction with a zesty zing of yuzu

Name: KYLA Hard Kombucha Pineapple Ginger
Description: A triptych of tropical flavors with a touch of adaptogenic turmeric

Name: KYLA Hard Kombucha Pink Grapefruit
Description: A crisp burst of tangy grapefruit with a dash of sweet blood orange.

Name: KYLA Hard Kombucha Ginger Tangerine
Description: A refreshing ginger flavor with the sweet-tart tang of tangerine.

Name: KYLA Hard Kombucha Hibiscus Lime
Description: A brilliant red brew with floral aromas and bright, tropical-citrus flavors.

Name: KYLA Hard Kombucha Berry Ginger
Description: A bramble of berries balanced by a zingy snap of ginger.

Name: Castle Danger Ode IPA
Description: Ode IPA is a culmination of our love of hops and the many variations of India Pale Ales we have brewed through the years. This beer shows how we like to use hops where flavor and aroma are at the forefront, ending with medium bitterness. Citra, Azacca, Amarillo and Centennial hops lend bright citrus and tropical fruit in flavor and aroma. It is an Ode to all the great IPAs already out there, a true marriage of hops and love. Something new, something borrowed, something Ode.  FIND OUR BEER

Name: Castle Danger Red Hop Rising
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: A hoppy red ale brewed when the fall air starts setting in. It is red hued like the sun rising on Lake Superior. Red Hop is a malty, rich, full-bodied ale balanced by Citra, Mosaic and Simcoe hops. This beer is a crowd pleaser, enjoyed by malt lovers and hop aficionados alike. A brew that was designed for the changing colors of fall, so enjoy it with your favorite fall past times!

Name: Castle Danger George Hunter Stout
Description: This beer is brewed in honor of our brewer and founder’s great-great grandfather. George Hunter was an Irish immigrant from Belfast who owned and operated the Iron Range Brewing Co. in Tower, MN during the late 1800’s up until Prohibition. George Hunter Stout is an American version of the style with aromas of molasses, licorice, maple, coffee and cream that are also echoed in the flavor. Just like the hearty Irishman that he was, George Hunter Stout is a big, roasty, full-bodied brew that will stand up to the cold winters of Minnesota.

Name: Castle Danger 17-7 Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: 17-7 is named after our address in downtown Two Harbors, which is also home to our taproom that overlooks Lake Superior. 17-7 was born out of necessity while brewing on our original 93-gallon system in Castle Danger. We love hops and IPAs, but brewing an India Pale Ale takes several extra days for adding more hops so we created our pale ale recipe to keep up with demand. 17-7 is a hop-forward pale ale brewed with our own 7 hop variety and has enough of a biscuit-malt backbone to keep it honest.

Name: Castle Danger White Pine
Description: White pines were once a staple in the landscape of the North Shore. Our White Pine Project IPA is a beer with a purpose – to help reinstate the white pine population in our back yard. Proceeds from this beer will go directly to planting targeted areas along the North Shore that will stand for future generations to enjoy. This IPA flaunts a robust aroma of bright citrus, tropical fruit, and pine, with just enough bitterness. The mellow golden malt character and effervescence carry these towering hop flavors as high as a stately white pine.

Name: Castle Danger Double Crossing IPA
Description: Originally brewed as our Second Anniversary beer in 2013. It was so good, we keep it coming back each spring. We put an amazing amount of hops into this beer, over 4lbs per barrel! It has a lot of tropical fruit, citrus & apricot going on in both flavor & aroma. Despite the crazy amount of hops, it is a very well balanced double India Pale Ale.

Name: Castle Danger Mosaic IPA
Description: Mosaic Fresh Hop IPA is brewed with fresh Mosaic hops, picked fresh off the vine and immediately shipped to the brewery and put into the beer. Hops grow in a way to protect the Lupulin glands, which produce the hop flavors we love. Hops are traditionally pelletized which lock in the majority of oils for long term storage but removes some of the delicate flavors they can offer. Fresh hopped beers are a way for brewers to use hops in their purest form. Enjoy this farm fresh beer in fall just weeks after the hop harvest.

Name: Castle Danger Choice Pilsner
Description: Choice Pils is brewed in the tradition of classic German pilsners with our own dangerous twists. We use fine German malts and pure Lake Superior water for a great start, and finish with Saaz and Cascade hops for a floral, citrusy, and spicy zing. We chose to blend a classic European style with American craft brewing ingenuity. Here’s to making good choices.

Name: Tin Roof Perfect Tin
Description: American-style amber ale brewed with a variety of the finest specialty malts available. These malts combine to form a distinct flavor profile with hints of toffee and chocolate. Its mild bitterness never lingers longer than you ask it to. The final product is a malty, medium-bodied, and easy drinking session beer.  You’ll love this malt masterpiece! Pairs well with most grilled or roasted meats.  Also great for chilis, stews, and brining.

Name: Tin Roof Turnrow Harvest Ale
Description: Spiced Ale brewed with fresh ground coriander. Turnrow’s light straw color and low bitterness make it the perfect compliment to the warm, humid days and traditions in the South. The coriander provides just the right amount of citrus spice to balance this refreshing brew.

Name: Tin Roof Not Too Sweet Watermelon Wheat
Description: Refreshing American Wheat Ale brewed with a hint of watermelon.  This brew has a noticeable watermelon aroma, but the actual flavor of the fruit is mild and balanced.  Tin Roof Watermelon Wheat is perfect for our sweltering Southern summers.

Name: Tin Roof Voodoo Bengal
Description: American-style pale ale with layers of intense flavors. Generously hopped, this brew draws on pale, honey and caramel malts to provide the perfect balance between bitterness, aroma, and malt character. Pairs well with anything spicy…especially crawfish, gumbo, and jambalaya.

Name: Tin Roof Voodoo
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Voodoo is a heavily dry-hopped American Pale Ale, which relies on flaked wheat and oats to enhance the tropical and fruit flavors provided by the hops. Expect melon, passion fruit, tangelo, and pine flavors and aromas from the use of Citra and Simcoe hops. Heavy dry-hopping and the use of oats and wheat result in a naturally hazy beer.

Name: Tin Roof Juke Joint
Description: India Pale Ale with a solid malt backbone, huge floral and citrus aroma, and a nice strong bitterness up front that fades and does not leave you puckered. Juke Joint is the aroma hop lovers dream.

Name: Tin Roof Parade Ground
Description:
Robust Porter brewed with a special blend of New Orleans Coffee Company mocha and French roast coffee. This smooth brew is full of coffee
and chocolate flavor.

Name: Tin Roof Not Too Sweet Watermelon Wheat
Description: Refreshing American Wheat Ale brewed with a hint of watermelon.  This brew has a noticeable watermelon aroma, but the actual flavor of the fruit is mild and balanced.  Tin Roof Watermelon Wheat is perfect for our sweltering Southern summers.

Name: Mendocino Red Tail Ale
Description: The Legend is our flagship brand. It is brewed in the traditional old world manner, using premium two-row malted barley, hops and our own special proprietary yeast strain. It is an amber ale with a rich complex refreshing flavor and a crisp dry finish.

Name: Mendocino Blue Herron Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Blue Heron Pale Ale is a delightful, medium bodied smooth ale, with a distinctive crisp mouth-feel and a fresh hoppy finish. It is brewed using premium two-row Pale malted barley, generous amounts of both Cluster bittering hops and Cascade finishing hops and our own special proprietary yeast strain.

Name: Mendocino Black Hawk Stout
Description: Black Hawk Stout retains the big traditional flavors of an Irish-style stout and yet offers a refreshing dry crispness that is rare in many dark beers. Bottle Conditioned Black Hawk Stout is replete with a rich, roasted malt flavor that makes this not-so-heavy stout, creamy and ever so smooth. It has a subtlety that surprises and converts even the most reticent stout drinker.

Name: Mendocino White Hawk Select IPA
Description: White Hawk is a traditional IPA .The IPA recipe is based on the original 1880 brew that was sent to India for the British troops.The advent of India Pale Ale was born of a need to supply beer in the 1800?s to British troops in India. This hearty, heavily hopped ale was brewed to endure the rigors of the long voyage from Great Britain.

Name: Mendocino Talon Double IPA
Description: An aggressive and old-school American Double IPA here, and a well named one, as this beer rips out your palate and the flies off to regurgitate it into the mouths of its frenzied young. Its combo of five malts and six hops creates a unique experience too. Anyone who touts themselves as a true hophead should seek out this beer now. Malts: Specialty 2 Row, Wheat, Munich, Vienna, CaraMunich 40. Hops: Warrior, Cascade, Amarillo, Summit, Pilgrim, Centennial. Dry Hop: Amarillo, Summit, Simcoe.

Name: Mendocino Peregrine Pilsner
Description: Peregrine Pilsner is a rich Czech Style Pilsner brewed with the finest Pilsen malt and noble hops from the Saaz region. It is brilliant gold, full bodied with a dense white head and with lively carbonation. With a clean crisp palate, dry finish, delicate lingering floral notes, Peregrine is the pinnacle of what a pilsner should be.

Name: Tin Man Red
Description: Circuit Bohemian Pilsner is bright in color and clarity with a mild aroma and a crisp, energizing flavor.  Alloy American Pale Ale delivers a fine-tuned blend of golden hue, light body, robust hops and exemplary taste. River Irish Red Ale holds a multitude of rich, sweet flavors with a slight hint of malt tacked on for a clean, dry finish. Overlord Imperial IPA features a harmonious balance of columbus, cascade and centennial hops with a sweet, pineapple aroma.

Name: Tin Man Cafe Leche
Description: Cafe Leche, our Milk and Coffee Porter, is infused with Evansville’s own TJ’s Roaster coffee beans as well as lactose to provide a rich flavor and mouth feel. TJ’s Guatemalan coffee lends a robust and slightly floral coffee aroma, supported with a generous portion of dark caramel malts. The flavor is a perfect blend of coffee and beer: sweet dark malts and cold brewed coffee combine for a flavor with gentle roast, floral earthiness, and pleasant sweetness. The addition of lactose to the beer completes the experience by providing a sweet and satisfying finish, making this beer perfect for any time of day.

Name: Tin Man Damascene Apri
Description: Unique, refreshing, and far from ordinary, Tin Man’s Damascene Apricot Sour is a blend of traditionally soured ale and apricot juice. Pouring a straw-pale color, this beer’s aroma has hints of lactic acid bite dominated by the smell of fresh apricot. The tartness from the sour ale is balanced by the distinct taste and sweetness of apricot, creating a flavor reminiscent of sour candy and fresh fruit. Exceptionally refined and highly drinkable, Damascene Apricot Sour is a delicious example of what craft beer can be.

Name: Tin Man Csar
Description: Fall in line under the rule of Csar. Join with your comrades over a strong, dark beer with warring classes of dark chocolate and coffee united by the balanced flavor of hops. Drink. Enjoy. Share. Devote yourself to the Csar!

Name: Tin Man IPA
Description: You will obey your overlord and drink this full-bodied IPA. You will enjoy the harmonious balance of its columbus, cascade, and centennial hops. You will be lured into our empire by its sweet, pineapply aroma and chinook dry hopping. You will be ruled by Overlord.

Name: Tin Man Overlord IPA
Description: You will obey your overlord and drink this full-bodied IPA. You will enjoy the harmonious balance of its columbus, cascade, and centennial hops. You will be lured into our empire by its sweet, pineapply aroma and chinook dry hopping. You will be ruled by Overlord.

Name: Tin Man Wired White IPA
Description: Give your motherboard a jolt. Wired White IPA intertwines flavors of Meyer lemon, bergamot orange, and hops to electrify and refresh. Hard-wire your taste receptors - Become One Of Us.

Name: Tin Man Pilsner
Description: Circuit Bohemian Pilsner conducts a thrilling buzz to your senses with bright color and clarity, mild aroma and crisp, energizing flavor.  The joining of Circuit’s ingredients crafts an unbreakable connection between flavor and refreshment, resulting in an eminently drinkable beer that makes it easy for you to become one of us.

Name: White Birch Hop Session IPA
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Hop Session is in. Starting with a blend of west coast hops for a balanced, bitter effect. We close the session out by late hopping the beer for a nice resiny mouth feel.

Name: White Birch Brewing Our Humble Porter
Description: The tradition of porter is long and confusing. Ask five brewers what a porter should be like, and you’re sure to get five different answers. Our Humble Porter was brewed without personal certainty of any kind. Instead, we looked to the past and came up with a beer resembling the porter at it’s height in England’s mid-19th century. Neither boastful nor reluctant, this beer was crafted with honesty, care, and an eye towards history. Drink up!

Name: White Birch Belg Pale Ale
Description: This straw colored beer greets with an aroma of noble hops, pears and Belgian esters.  The flavor follows nicely with a moderately spicy hop and Belgian yeast effect buoyed by a soft malt body.  The finish is crisp and dry.    We enjoy this beer with spicy foods, grilled steaks, grilled chicken and mandarin salad.  Where you take it is only limited by your imagination.  For those interested in styles, the name of this beer comes from the color over trying to meet any particular style.

Name: White Birch Blueberry Berliner Weisse
Description: Napoleon’s troops referred to Berliner Weisse as the “Champagne of the North” due to its lively and elegant character. Today this style is described by some as the most refreshing beer in the world. Our Blueberry Berliner Weisse is fermented with a great blueberry puree. This New England approach brings a refreshing blueberry flavor and aroma to a German classic. We feel our approach creates an authentic interpretation of the traditional “mit syrup” or with syrup method of serving this classic summer refresher. We hope you enjoy this unique year round beer.

Name: White Birch Brewing Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Napoleon’s troops referred to Berliner Weisse as the "Champagne of the North" due to its lively and elegant character. Today this style is described by some as the most refreshing beer in the world. Our approach was to brew this beer with Lactobacilius for a refreshing and authentic interpretation of a classic summer refresher.

Name: White Birch Raspberry Berliner Weisse 1/6 Barrel
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: White Birch Hop Session Ale
Description: Hop Session is in. Starting with a blend of west coast hops for a balanced, bitter effect. We close the session out by late hopping the beer for a nice resiny mouth feel.

Name: White Birch Small Batch Ale New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Mankato Imperial Red Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Seasonal Ale
Description: Mankato Brewery’s Imperial Red Ale is made to warm you up during the last dregs of winter.  Brewed with brown sugar and sweet orange peel, complimented with flavors of caramel, raisin, and a hint of hops.

Name: Mankato Organ Grinder Amber Ale
Description: The malt is the key to Organ Grinder with the hops taking a break. Much like its German inspired relatives, you see its brilliant amber color and smell its rich malt base. The flavor follows the aroma, and is toasty with a touch of sweetness and a slight noble hop presence.

Name: Mankato Fresh Hopped IPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Brewed only during the time of the year that beer drinkers love and wait patiently for each year… Hop Harvest Season. Mankato Brewery prides itself on using the freshest, Minnesota hops (Minnesota Hops Co. in Madelia, MN) possible in this IPA. Fresh Hopped IPA will reward you for your patience with fresh flavors of citrus and aromas to match. We “HOP” you enjoy this annual favorite of ours!

Name: Mankato Mint Stout
Description: Dark and minty, Mankato Brewery’s Mint Stout is something a bit different. Starting with the flavors of dark chocolate and coffee, we then complimented it with an amazing mint flavor and aroma. Some think it’s the perfect thing for after dinner, while others think it’s great all day.

Name: Mankato Haymaker IPA
Description: With the hops and malt fighting for contention, Haymaker IPA won’t back down. The rich, malty base provides the windup for the hops’ crisp, bright citrus flavors. Go toe-to-toe with this well balanced and devilishly drinkable IPA, and this double dry-hopped phenom will knock you out.

Name: Mankato Pumpkin Grinder
Description: Monkey may not win any awards for his Jack O’ Lantern carving skills, but Pumpkin Grinder sure has! This silky pumpkin ale balances subtle tones of pumpkin and spice with a rich malt backbone, making for a satisfying mélange of fall flavor. Find it in liquor stores now and on tap. If you can’t find it ask your favorite place to get some!

Name: Mankato Kato Lager
Description: A Munich Helles Style Lager brewed in the German tradition, as a nod to the classic from the Mankato Brewing Company, that once brewed in our Key City.

Name: Mankato Imperial Red Ale
Description: Mankato Brewery’s Imperial Red Ale is made to warm you up during the last dregs of winter.  Brewed with brown sugar and sweet orange peel, complimented with flavors of caramel, raisin, and a hint of hops.

Name: Altamont Mac Drizzle Gold Golden Ale
Description: Thizz ale is what it is! A hop forward golden ale with notes of melon, gooseberry, passion fruit and lychee. Everywhere you drink it, it's a party yall... Go S-T-YOU-P-I-D!

Name: Altamont Maui Waui Triple IPA
Description: Everything you love about Maui Waui, but with 3x More Citra & Mosaic hops that will go straight to your dome! Mind-blowing guava, pineapple & mango flavors and aromas. But watch out she's a real home-wrecker.

Name: Altamont Maui Waui IPA
Description: A more tropical approach to your "West Coast" style IPA; Maui Waui has proven to be one of our more popular beers! This single malt IPA is light in color and body; with a soft bitterness. The Mosaic and Citra hops give strong aromas and flavors of guava, pineapple and mango.

Name: Altamont Hella Hoppy DIPA
Description: A huge danky-resinous Double IPA for those extreme hop heads. With hella pounds of hops per BBL of beer, the hop aroma & flavor are sticky on both the nose & palate.

Name: Altamont Maui Waui Tropical IPA
Description: Pineapple & Passionfruit - An even more tropical approach to our classic Maui Waui; a Mosaic/Citra IPA. Infused post-fermentation with natural tropical fruits.

Name: Altamont Scarcity Triple IPA
Description: A triple IPA brewed for San Francisco Beer Week, and as the name states, it ain’t around much; only once a year. With loads of Citra and Centennial hops, the tropical/citrus flavors and aromas are intense. This beer finishes smooth and dry, with little residual sweetness.

Name: Altamont Juice Above The Clouds Double IPA
Description: A IIPA that is far from a NE style IIPA; the anti-haze beer! This IIPA is 100% 2-row malt and 100% Mosaic hops; it’s juicy, above the clouds, hoppy, crystal clear, pillowy soft, not bitter, and in your M-F’n face with hops! Keeping true to our West Coast/ABW style; this beer has a huge aroma and even bigger flavor: notes of melon, mango, pineapple, guava, and cannabis. MAKE BEER CLEAR AGAIN!

Name: Altamont Maui Waui DIPA
Description: A single malt IPA that is light in body & color; with a soft bitterness. Mosaic and Citra hops give strong aromas & flavors of guava, pineapple & mango.

Name: Good River Class V IPA
Description: This big and bold west coast style IPA has a strong hop flavor and aroma. A dry finish combined with citrus and pine encourage every sip. Class V (5) is named after the whitewater classifications of I (1) through V (5),  Class I being a tame, lightly rough water flow while Class V+ being a fast, dangerous, whitewater section of a river. The name says it all for this very big, bold, but balanced double IPA.

Name: Good River Horsethief Mango Blonde
Description: An easy-drinking, well-balanced Blonde Ale, and with MANGO of course! Wheat and honey malts set the stage for the mango addition, while retrained hop bitterness lets everything else shine.

Name: Good River Owl Eyes Cherry Porter
Description: A full-bodied, robust porter with notes of coffee, chocolate, toffee, dark fruits, and just enough tart cherry to balance its malt-forward character. Named after one of our favorite spots in the Grand Canyon where everything is bigger.

Name: Good River River Right Tropical Wheat Ale
Description: This Unfiltered Wheat Ale is sessionable, silky-smooth, and full of bright tropical fruit. Mild tartness accentuates the coconut and passion fruit, which are a perfect combination. It's a day at the beach in a can.

Name: Good River Fu Fighter Belgian Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Named after the Futaleufu River in Chile and our efforts to protect the river. This is a big, bold beer that remains remarkably dry and drinkable. The combination of yeasts produce unique and complex fruit flavors and aromas.

Name: Good River Hey Fishy Fishy Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A juicy, aromatic, and satisfying HAZZZY IPA. The oats and flaked barely create a silky mouthfeel, while the Idaho and Cashmere hops lend generous citrus and fruit notes.

Name: Good River Gunny Black Lager
Description: The Gunny is named after the Gunnison River in the Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park.  This a traditional Schwarzbier, a German black lager, that brings together a wonderful group of subtle flavors that combine into something far greater.  A restrained roast, caramel malts, German Noble hops, and a clean lager yeast make for a flavorful, very drinkable black lager. This is no Stout or Porter - it has just enough roast to darken the color, provide complexity, and build on a delightful Pilsner-like aroma and flavor.

Name: Good River American Pilsner
Description: Your great-great grandfather would be happy you are drinking this beer. It is a clean, crisp, and brilliantly clear lager that packs much more flavor than you might expect.  Soft malt and slight sweetness in the delicate aroma mingle with subtle, floral hops. A high percentage of corn lends the perception of slight sweetness even though the beer is quite dry. A respectable level of hop bitterness and flavor hearken back to pre-Prohibition days when American lagers were...well...better. This is a substantial Pilsner that is at the same time approachable and flavorful.

Name: The Temptress Imperial Milk Stout
Description: The Temptress is seduction in a glass.  Curvy in all the right places, this Imperial Milk Stout pours with a thick milk chocolate head.  Chocolate and caramel malt give it a rich and complex body, while the lower carbonation gives the beer a silky mouth feel.  She's voluptuous, with a soft alcohol warmth that grows deeper with every sip.

Name: Lakewood Lemonale
Description: Cascade, citra, and lemon drop hops with 2-row, wheat, and honey malt grain come together to make this light-bodied golden ale the perfect platform for a hint of real lemon juice. Like it a little more on the lemon side? Feel free to add a squeeze.

Name: Texas Porter
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Duck  Game Bird
Description: Texas Blacklands malt creates the roasty backbone of this easy drinking brew. Notes of coffee and toffee add a pleasant, mild sweetness to this well balanced Porter.

Name: Lakewood Brewing Co. Please ‘N Thank You Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A "tried and true" unapologetic American Pale Ale with floral citrus like aroma and a dry, crisp finish.  Medium bodied and easy drinking with the perfect balance of hops and malt.

Name: Lakewood Brewing Co Raspberry Temptress
Description: Lakewood Brewing Co.'s decadent imperial milk stout blended with fresh, tart Oregon raspberries.

Name: Lakewood IPA
Description: Rather than brew a bitter bomb, our balanced American India Pale Ale bursts with tropical flavors like grapefruit, papaya, and tangerine from a blend of Bravo, Citra, Mosaic, and Mandarina hops. This everyday IPA is bold without being brash.

Name: Lakewood Brewing Co. Punkel Pumpkin Spiced Dunkel
Food Pairing: Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Salads  Greens, Tomatoes
Description: Brewed without any pumpkin, Punkel is a dark, malty German Lager but with a lighter body enhanced by cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, and ginger.  It's Oktoberfest turned up to 11!

Name: Lakewood Brewing Bourbon Barrel Temptress Bopper
Peabody Heights Down The Ocean Apricot Blonde Ale
Peabody Heights Unforgiveable Curses Belgian Tripel
Peabody Heights Mr. Trash Wheel’s Lost Python IPA
Peabody Heights Can You Fig It Dunkel
Peabody Heights Old Oriole Park Bohemian Lager
Description: Old Oriole Park 5th Anniversary is dedicated to 5 years of brewing Old Oriole Park in Baltimore City. This Bohemian Pilsner is light and drinkable with a touch of sweetness

Name: Old Yale Knotty Blonde Ale
Description: Old world hops meet new in our Knotty Blonde; carefully crafted to have a subtle grapefruit flavor with a frothy, creamy head. Clean and crisp, this beer pairs best with lighter meals like a salad or your favourite sushi

Name: Old Yale Himalayan Salted Caramel Porter
Description: Our Porter is brewed with a variety of specialty malts, which lends smoothness and depth to its body. Additions of Himalayan salt, lactose and vanilla add a sweet caramel finish leading to lingering saltiness on the palate – rich, dark & delicious

Name: Old Yale Moon Dance Mango Wheat
Description: Each batch of Moon Dance Mango Wheat is made with 900 fresh, ripe mangos. And, the very smooth texture lets the mango flavor shine through. Try a Moon Dance with your favourite seafood dish.

Name: Old Yale Off Trail Pale Ale
Description: A generous heaping of whole leaf cascade hops are carefully balanced with malted barley and combined to deliver our refreshing Off Trail Pale Ale. We suggest pairing with a juicy burger or your favourite pizza.

Name: Old Yale Sasquatch Stout
Description: Coffee, chocolate & mystery Voted “Best Beer in Canada” for 2014, our Sasquatch Stout is smooth with notes of mocha, coffee and roasted barley. Match our Sasquatch with a steak, oysters or even chocolate cake!

Name: Old Yale West Coast IPA
Description: Our West Coast IPA boasts huge hop flavor, but also a balanced drinkability. We pack over 50lbs of the much sought-after Citra and Galaxy hops into this IPA. We suggest pairing the intense hops with your favourite spicy dish.

Name: Old Yale Pina Colada ISA
Description: If you like Pina Coladas and getting caught in the rain, then this brew is perfect for you. Based on our favourite summer cocktail, this ISA is crafted in a Northeastern IPA style. Loaded up with fresh Pineapple, toasted Coconut and two outstanding hops; Vic Secret and El Dorado, our Hazy ISA delivers a hint of juicy sweetness and heaps of tropical flavour.

Name: Old Yale Head Shaker Honey Lager
Description: A collaboration with Reel West Coast, this Honey Lager is crafted for an outdoor lifestyle. Local honey adds a touch of sweetness that pairs perfectly with the clean, crisp Lager finish; A truly can’t miss West Coast experience.

Name: Brewer’s Art Beazly Golden Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Golden  Blonde Ale
Food Pairing: Fish - Meaty  Oily, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm
Description: Our answer to the Belgian devil beers (i.e. Lucifer, Duvel, etc.). Both rich and dry, this beer is all too easy to consume in large quantities. Hopped with Styrian Goldings.

Name: Brewer’s Art Zeke’s Coffee Porter
Description: Rich, Chocolate-y Belgian Porter brewed with Aromatic and Coffee Malts, steeped 24 hours with Mexican Chiapas in partnership with Thomas Rhodes of Zeke’s Coffee!

Name: Brewers Art Choptank’d Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Brewer’s Art Green Peppercorn Tripel
Description: A belgian style tripel spiced with green peppercorns. A blonde ale with a hint of spice and smooth finish

Name: Brewer’s Art Birdhouse Pale Ale
Description: A tribute to The Boys of Summer, this nice Pale Ale will warm you up even in the heart of winter.

Name: Edmund’s Oast Something Cold
Description: Our Ultra-Deluxe Premium Blonde Ale, crafted with the finest barley, hand-selected hops, and superlative water, is built for the fridge and  destined for your hand. Refreshment and  refinement never tasted so premium.

Name: Edmund’s Oast Hush That Fuss
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Bright, hoppy orange aromas greet the nose long before a glass of Hush That Fuss touches the lips. In turn, its creamy mouthfeel both satisfies and refreshes the imbiber.  This wheated, hoppy take on American Pale Ale relies on both Amarillo and Centennial hops for its fuss-hushing aroma

Name: Edmund’s Oast Sour Boysenberry Plum
Description: American Sour Ale brewed with boysenberry and plum

Name: Edmund’s Oast Sour Concord Grape
Description: Our series of fruited American Sour Ales come from a love of fresh fruit flavors combined with mouth-watering acidity. We take the same golden sour base beer and referment it with different fruit combinations.

Name: Edmund’s Oast Bound By Time
Description: Made with good old-fashioned hop-bursting techniques, exorbitant dry hopping, and cutting-edge haze-infusion technology, Bound by Time is an offering to those looking for something brimming with hop character and as unadulterated as a butterfly’s wing.

Name: Edmund’s Oast Singular
Description: Session India Pale Ale brewed with 100% Idaho 7 hops.  Singular, with its light golden hue and round body, exhibits bright notes of mango and fresh pine forest, finishing with a touch of drying papaya skin & eucalyptus.  Hoppier than your average Pale Ale, while lighter in alcohol than your typical IPA, Singular explores the Session IPA spectrum by providing copious amounts of hop flavor and aroma in a sessionable format.

Name: Denver Beer Co. Princess Yum Yum Raspberry Kolsch
Description: Princess Yum Yum is a sparkly beauty. Brewed as a German style Kölsch and fermented with real raspberries, she has the color and clarity of a ruby. At 4.8% ABV she is enticing and inviting, yet the tart, dry finish makes her just as complex as any royal. There are plenty of reasons you’ll want your own Princess Yum Yum.

Name: Denver Beer Co. Juicy Freak Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Pear, Stone Fruit, Tropical Fruit
Description: Rich American hop notes of orange, mango, pear and stone fruit create a Juicy IPA that is smooth, creamy, and exploding with citrus.

Name: Denver Beer Co. Pretzel Assassin
Description: This classic Vienna Lager is crisp and easy drinking. Munich and caramel malts are used to create a malty flavor with a touch of breadiness and a light sweetness. German noble hops round out the flavor profile of this clean, authentic amber lager. No pretzels were harmed in the making of this beer, but we can’t vouch for pretzel safety while you imbibe! 5.0% ABV

Name: Denver Beer Co. Seasonal – Peanut Butter Graham Cracker Porter
Description: Rotating seasonal series - product availability may differ from the image shown, and varies based on brewery production and retailer inventory. Please contact customer support with any questions.

Name: Denver Beer Co. Incredible Pedal IPA
Description: This American IPA greets you with lush floral, citrus, and tropical fruit on the nose. A medium bodied ale with a touch of sweetness, she will gear you up for a finish full of tangerine and grapefruit. Incredible Pedal is a hoppy beauty that takes you for a ride! 7.0% ABV

Name: Denver Beer Co. Graham Cracker Porter
Description: Like a campfire in a glass, this robust beauty has seductive notes of vanilla, smoked cedar, and mulling spices. A dark pour with mild lacing, she is a rollercoaster of lush chocolate diving into a semi-dry finish of roasted malt and biscuit. 5.6% ABV

Name: Denver Beer Co. Hey! Pumpkin
Description: Brewed for sweater weather  As the leaves change and cooler weather signals the arrival of fall, Hey! Pumpkin is a celebration of the season. This pumpkin brew has a gorgeous copper hue resulting from the bushels of real pumpkin used in the mash. With a nose full of cinnamon, nutmeg, and spice, she is an autumn melody that will have you reaching for your sweater. 5.4% ABV    Availability: September, October, November

Name: Denver Beer Co. Tart Delight Citrus Sour
Description: This one is so. . .tartsy.  Whatcha tryna do, be a fancy margarita or something?  Fermented with lime juice and a touch of pink himalayan sea salt for a thirst-quenching tart tickle, our lime sour was brewed with wheat and munich malts for a clean and crisp finish.  Easy drinking, refreshingly tart, it’s a delight!

Name: Calicraft Brewing Cool Kidz IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Cool Kidz IPA, featuring all the cool hops! Our take on the modern-day, juicy IPA. Mosaic and Citra hops burst from the glass, bringing loads of bright citrus and ripe tropical aromatics. A malt bill filled with oats gives smooth body and balances the hops - giving a juice like impression and minimal bitterness. Move over standard IPAs, there’s a new kid on the block!

Name: Calicraft Cali Coast Kolsch
Food Pairing: Fish - White, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Shellfish, Root Vegetables, Fruit - Dried
Description: Mt. Shasta-grown malt adds body, whole Noble and Crystal hops give it a bright, crisp, refreshing finish. Sessional Kolsch with great complexity

Name: Calicraft Brewing Tiki Time
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Fresh, Guava, Light, Round, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Chicken, Fish - White, Pasta, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Turkey
Description: Tropical Wheat with juicy guavas, tart passionfruit and bright oranges balance out this light wheat beer.

Name: Calicraft The City IPA
Description: We love The City! From San Francisco to New York or from LA to Chicago, The City is where it's at. This beer is a tribute to our city, San Francisco, and to all the great IPAs that came before us. Brewed in classic NorCal style, balanced and dry, dank and citrusy, bitter and juicy, this IPA captures the best of this classic West Coast beer. It's The City IPA for The City by The Bay.

Name: Calicraft Cruz Ca Lager
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Fish - White, Mushrooms, Pasta, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Turkey
Description: Light and dry with a crisp finish. Balanced and easy drinking- notes of stone fruits with a refreshing carbonation.

Name: Calicraft Spritzer POG
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cured Meats, Dessert - Fruit, Mushrooms, Pasta, Shellfish, Tomatoes
Description: Organic Passionfruit Orange Guava Spritzer

Name: Calicraft Spritzer Pineapple
Tasting Notes: Crisp, Fresh, Fruity, Funky, Tart, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Stinky, Lamb, Nuts, Pasta, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Turkey
Description: Organic Pineapple Mango Spritzer

Name: Calicraft Spritzer POM
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Stinky, Cured Meats, Dessert - Fruit, Lamb
Description: Pomegranate Blueberry

Name: Kentucky Bourbon Barrel Stout
Description: Kentucky Bourbon Barrel Stout is brewed and aged with Alltech Café Citadelle Haitian coffee and aged in world-famous Kentucky bourbon barrels. The result is a complex stout with dark-roasted malts, hints of caramel and vanilla and a lightly roasted coffee finish.

Name: Kentucky Kolsch
Description: A full flavoured Kolsh style ale true to form of the German beer style originating in Cologne.

Name: Kentucky Peach Barrel Wheat
Description:
Kentucky Peach Barrel Wheat Ale is a light, crisp ale perfect for lazy, sun-drenched summer days.
Images of your real (or fanciful) old Kentucky home in bourbon country are conjured up with every sip, thanks to the brew’s six-week aging period in fresh Kentucky bourbon barrels. The barrel-aging process balances hints of caramel and vanilla and subtle cereal notes with the juiciness of a fresh ripe peach, creating a golden color. Enjoy this light-bodied, refreshing offering before the bright rays of summer fade into fall.

Name: Kentucky Pumpkin Barrel
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Varies by season!

Name: Kentucky Pumpkin Barrel Ale
Description: Kentucky Pumpkin Barrel Ale is a barrel-aged ale brewed with Kentucky-sourced pumpkin, richly spiced with cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice. As the ale is aged in fresh bourbon barrels, the sweetness of caramel and vanilla are imparted upon the brew and complement its spicier base. At 10 percent alcohol by volume (ABV), this robust, limited release seasonal makes for a flavorful sipping beer to slowly warm up with as the weather cools.

Name: Off The Rail Nur Ein Kolsch
Off The Rail Into the Black Oatmeal Stout
Description: A complex beer, our stout has loads of oatmeal, coffee, and malt flavours which contribute body and a long lasting mocha coloured head. Nugget hops lend their characteristic herbal aroma to combine with the mild floral influence of Williamette hops. This stout with a deep rich colour is an extremely enjoyable, easy drinking beer.

Name: Off The Rail Kama Citra Ale
Description: A light session beer with a crisp clean bitterness from the magnum hop. Lovely tropical fruit aromas and flavour from the citra hops which dominate through the finish. We have adapted this recipe from an English beer publication and know you will enjoy it as much as we do.

Name: Off The Rail Crazy Train IPA
Description: Going Off The Rail for a Crazy Train! English style IPA with plenty of malt balance and substantial amounts of Chinook and Cascade for a full, rich flavour.     Canadian Brewing Awards 2017 – Silver Medal Winner

Name: Off The Rail Raising Haze NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Malt, oats & wheat give this northeast style a lovely hazy appearance. Full flavoured, fruit forward and juicy best describe this new addition to our IPA lineup.

Name: Off The Rail Comet Launcher Double IPA
Description: Our first in a serious of new IPA’s, our Comet Launcher is a nod to our newly found delight in the Comet hop. Blended with some of our other favourites, this stronger IPA has a lovely aroma and wonderful malt balance with pine and grapefruit flavours most prominent.

Name: Off The Rail Czechmate Pilsner
Description: Our Czech style pilsner combines premium pilsner malt and just the right amount of bittering hops to give this medium-bodied pilsner a full, well-rounded flavor. A unique taste boldly finished with the noble Czech Saaz hop.

Name: Off The Rail Passionation Hefe
Description: A blend of wheat and 2 row Pilsner malt with a burst of passionfruit! A light, refreshing Hefeweizen for a warm summer day.

Name: Big aLICe Brewing Co : Lemongrass Kolsch
Description: Pouring a beautiful gold, this easy-drinking beer is our take on a classic style. Hopped with Sorachi Ace, Cascade, and Centennial hops.  Herbal and lemon notes on the aroma, followed by a mellow lemongrass and bready flavor with a crisp, dry finish.

Name: Big aLICe Brewing Co : Hibiscus Gose
Description: This gose gets its pinkish hue from hibiscus. The floral and fruity nose precedes a slightly tart flavor that is soft and refreshing. Finishes crisp with subtle notes of salt and coriander.

Name: Big aLICe Brewing Co : Brunch Crusher
Description: Our popular Brunch Crusher (Tangerine & Pineapple Sour) with added Coconut

Name: Big aLICe Brewing Co : Queensbridge IPA
Description: A dank and hazy East Coast style IPA hopped with Pacific Northwest and New Zealand hops, this juicy IPA is bound to leave you wanting more. Leading with strong tangerine flavors and notes of melon, lychee, and gooseberry, this refreshing IPA is almost too easy to drink.

Name: Big aLICe Brewing Co : BQX Brooklyn-Queens Connector
Description: Brewed with a generous amount of Citra, Simcoe, Amarillo, and Centennial hops, the aroma is full of tropical fruit notes. Pouring a hazy golden yellow, mouthfeel is extremely soft with aromas of mango, papaya, and berries. Flavors of juicy grapefruit, orange, and melon with minimal hop bitterness on the finish.

Name: Big aLICe Brewing Co : NYS Pils
Description: Brewed with 100% NY State ingredients from New York Craft Malt and Upstate Hops, this beer highlights the great ingredients available in our home state. Unfiltered with a pale straw color, there are notes of honey and graham cracker on the nose. Flavors of graham cracker, minerals, and NY terroir are accompanied by a soft, dry finish.

Name: Big aLICe Brewing Co : Green Door
Description: Mixed Culture Rice Lager brewed in collaboration with Brooklyn Kura using Sake and Lager Yeast.

Name: Alewerks Wheat Ale
Description: An American style unfiltered Wheat Ale. An effervescent and light ale, it is a refreshing summer afternoon thirst quencher. Wheat beer’s history goes back to the Pharaohs of Egypt. By the 16th century it was popular in Germany where it is usually served quite cold, and with a slice of lemon. American Wheat Beer, which can be traced to the colonial brewer’s need to stretch scarce European imported malt with adjuncts like wheat, has a less fruity, more balanced taste and finish than its German relative, the result of American hops and yeast.

Name: Alewerks Chesapeake Pale Ale 1/2 Barrel
Description: Kegs are intended for Kegerator use only. TAP NOT INCLUDED. NOTE: An additional deposit charge per keg may be placed on your card for first time customers only. A representative from Drizly or the store will be in contact to confirm all details prior to delivery. Empty barrels will be picked up upon delivery of new kegs. Name: Alewerks Superb IPA
Description: Superb IPA is not the first IPA we brewed, and it will not be the last, but it's one we wanted to enjoy all the time. Amarillo & Simcoe hops furnish an impression of Mango and Passion Fruit while a touch of Wheat and Oats provide a light, yet full mouth-feel.

Name: Atwater Vanilla Java Porter
Description: A robust Porter made with chocolate malt. This malt Beverage is brewed with coffee beans with Natural Flavor added (Vanilla Extract), and we balance it with U.S. Golding Hops. Our award winning brew is sure to please! Open it!

Name: Atwater Dirty Blonde
Description: Brewed to be a bright straw color, lightly sweet, with wheat added to create a crispness at the back of the palate. Crushed Orange Peel & Coriander are subtly added to the final stage of the hot side, which lend to the clean head aroma.

Name: Atwater Traverse City Cherry Wheat
Description: The addition cherries from Traverse City, MI, prior to fermentation, Atwater’s Cherry Wheat brings a bright tartness together with the crispness of an American Wheat ale.

Name: Atwater Whango Mango Wheat
Description: American-Style Wheat Beers are similar in malt bill to their German Weizen cousins, but exhibit much less yeast characteristic. These may be filtered or unfiltered and exhibit low to medium hop bitterness and aroma.

Name: Atwater Hey Diddle Diddle
Description: Tribute beer to Mike Sadler, brewed with apricots, blood oranges, and a hint of Belgian yeast and rose petals.

Name: Atwater Bloktoberfest
Description: Absolutely traditional in design and execution, Atwater’s Bloktoberfest exhibits bready, nut-like characters with a clean, light sweetness brought to heel by a crisp hop finish.

Name: Atwater Blueberry
Description: Blueberry Cobbler is deceptively complex outing that features bready malts the dryness of fermented blueberries, light vanilla and blueberry aromatics. Strong, yet the flavors play well together.

Name: Florida Beer Key West Southernmost Wheat
Description: Key West Southernmost Wheat makes you think of summer and so does its taste. The minute I took a sip I was glad it was still warm out as my first impression was that this is a great warm weather beer. The fizzy quality of this beer from the unfiltered yeast makes it a nice thirst quencher. Key West Southernmost Wheat pours a light golden color with a head that quickly fizzles out. The taste is a tangy citrus with the help of key lime that’s used in the brewing process.

Name: Florida Beer Company Swamp Ape IPA
Description: Firsthand accounts describe an intense beast with a potent aroma and bite. Proof that the elusive monster exists? Or proof that brewing with five distinct varieties of hops creates an unbelievable, relentlessly hopped India Pale Ale? One taste and you’ll know, Swamp Ape is for real.

Name: Florida Beer Company Devil’s Triangle IPA
Description: This unfiltered brew has been generously hopped with cascade, centennial, columbus and warrior hops, backed by 3 specialty malts.This gives this IPA a bigger and fresher citrus hop aroma and flavor throughout.

Name: Florida Beer Co. Hurricane Reef IPA
Description: Uniquely adapted for travel in any environment, the versatile amphibious plane, the “Goose” is a symbol for air-sea travel and exploration. Brewed for the unchartered territory ahead, Hurricane Reef continues the spirit of adventure with the “Goose” discovering uniquely crafted beer styles throughout the tropics and the Caribbean. American Style India Pale Ale with a subtle citrus aroma, crisp resiny bitterness balanced by a medium malt.

Name: Florida Beer Company Lager
Description: An American-style Amber lager using a perfect blend of two-row, caramel and Carapils® malt, Northern Brewer and German Tradition hops. This combination of ingredients imparts a slight roasted malt and sweet caramel notes, a subtle spice and richness, finishing with a crisp, clean lighter.

Name: Florida Beer Sunshine State Pils
Description: Brewed in the traditional German Pilsner style, this beer has an aggressive hop bitterness, slight mineral character and a light body. Sunshine State is a clean, crisp offering brewed with Noble hops & extra pale pilsner malts for a refreshing aroma & flavor.

Name: Brouwerij 3 Fonteinen Beersel Zwet.be
Description: A porter brewed with lambic yeast.

Name: Brouwerij Drie Fonteinen Oude Kriek
Description: 3 Fonteinen Oude Kriek is the result of macerating hand-picked whole sour cherries on young lambic for at least four months, in a proportion of one kilogram of fruit per litre of lambic. The kriek lambic is then blended again with more young lambic to obtain a minimum intensity of 35% fruit, and is bottled immediately afterwards. These bottles are then stored in our cellars for at least five months so that the kriek lambic can develop into a beautiful, traditional, and refined Oude Kriek. With a pleasant tartness and organic notes of almond and cinnamon as it warms in the glass, 3 Fonteinen Oude Kriek, will age perfectly but may lose some of the vibrant red colours and forest fruit aromas. This unfiltered and unpasteurised lambic is all-natural with no artificial juices, syrups, or sugars added. Traditional Lambic is living, cultural heritage rooted in the Zenne valley!

Name: Brouwerij Drie Fonteinen Homage
Description: A blend of lambic beers brewed at 3 Fonteinen, with an addition of 30% whole fresh raspberries from the fabled Payottenland and 5% sour cherries. This unfiltered beer will enjoy a spontaneous refermentation in the bottle. No artificial colors or flavor enhancers are added. Lambic is brewed only from 60% barley malt, 40% unmalted wheat, hops and water.

Name: Brouwerij Drie Fonteinen Oude Geuze Golden Blend
Description: The Golden Blend is made with 4 year old Lambic that accounts for 25 % of it’s contents, the rest of the blend is made up by a "secret" combination of 1, 2 and 3 year old Lambic.

Name: Browerij Drie Fonteinen Oude Geuze Cuvée Armand & Gaston
Description: A Gueze made up of Drie Fonteinen brewed lambic from 2013, 2014 and 2015.

Name: Brouwerij Drie Fonteinen Oude Geuze
Description:
Drie Fonteinen is the only remaining traditional geuze blender in Belgium, using only 100% spontaneously fermented lambic beer, aged in oak casks, with no artificial sweeteners or other additives. The blendery is connected to the very popular Drie Fonteinen Restaurant in Beersel, on the outskirts of Brussels. The proprietor, Armand Debelder, buys pure lambic from three breweries in Belgium, ages them in oak, and blends them, employing the skill, knowledge, and supreme passion for real geuze that his father handed down to him.

Like any traditional geuze, Drie Fonteinen’s Oude Geuze is tart, earthy, and incredibly complex, but also spritzy as champagne and greatly refreshing.

Name: Brouwerij 3 Fonteinen Beersel Lager
Description: Brewed in collaboration with Armand Debelder and Frank Boon at De Proef, essentially a recreating of the original Bohemian Pilsener.

Name: Bolero Snort One Hoof in Front of the Other
Description: Cross my heart and hope to die, putting in lots of hops at a time. We got your back and like bovines, whoooaaa ohhh... One Hoof in Front of the Other! We laid down a dreamy base with loads of wheat and oats and fermented with our favorite yeast to make pure juice! Azacca/Denali in the whirlpool with more of those bangers plus Citra/Galaxy in the dry hops. Huge notes of ripe orange, mango and peach. A fun little beer as a nod to one of our favorite feel good songs. Are you ready to walk the mooooooon?!?

Name: Bolero Snort OG PE Bullazed
Description: We brought back the OG hop schedule from the very first batch of Bullazed and then amped the volume up a touch. Huge hits of Amarillo, Falconers and Columbus in the kettle before a massive double dry hop of Simcoe, Amarillo and Falconers and conditioned on pineapple!

Name: Bolero Snort Another Steer Older
Description:
Celebrating another year of beer, we've put together the hoppiest beer we've ever made. Dubbed Another Steer Older, this beast of burden stampedes your taste buds boasting a massive compliment of Galaxy and Bru-1 hops and Citra Lupulin.

To celebrate this momentous occasion we added a hearty portion of Milk Sugar and Vanilla and made this one of the boldest offerings to ever hit the pasture.

Name: Medusa Brewing Laser Cat
Description: Plenty of dense citrus, tropical fruit, and herbal notes to assault your hop-loving senses. Dry-hopped with absurd amounts of Citra and Nugget.

Name: Medusa Brewing Activate!
Description: With Activate! we've taken a robust porter and infused it with local coffee, masterfully roasted by Jesse Medley of Union Coffee Roasters. Our black ale's rich cocoa and subtle caramel notes provide a lovely base to freshly roasted Burundi, a bourbon varietal described as tart, juicy, with fruity characters of strawberry, blackberry, apricot, lemon, and grapefruit.

Name: Medusa Brewing Vicarious American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Whether brewing at home or creating a beer here at Medusa, it’s always more fun to invite our friends. The beer in this can was an idea we put together with John and Joel of Foundation Brewing in Portland, ME. Featuring a meld of Maine-grown Two Row, German Vienna, and Malted Oats, to deliver a smooth, well-rounded mouthfeel. With hints of white grape and tropical citrus from a hop bill that includes Azacca, Hallertau Blanc, and Massachusetts-grown Magnum, this simple beer was designed to be shared with friends.

Name: Medusa Brewing Laser Kitten American IPA
Description: The gentler sibling to our outrageous Imperial IPA Laser Cat, LASER KITTEN is an American-style IPA that arrives at session strength.  It still packs plenty of Citra and Mosaic for a citrusy, fruity punch, while the body is kept extra pale, light, and dry to let those hops shine!

Name: Medusa Brewing Friendly Territory
Description: Explore the brewing terroir of Massachusetts! Friendly Territory's pale, dry body is crafted entirely with 2-Row Barley and Warthog Wheat from Valley Malt (Hadley, MA) and features an array of hops from Four Star Farms (Northfield, MA): an alluring blend of Centennial, Crystal, Cascade, Magnum, Mt. Rainier, Pepite, and Chaos, resulting in lush aromas of tropical citrus with a crisp herbal background.
