Name: Crazy Mountain Brewing Amber Ale
Description: Crazy Mountain Amber Ale was named after a mountain on the Selvy Family's ranch in Central Colorado. "Loco Mountain" translates from Spanish to "Crazy Mountain," and this beer is crazy good. This delightfully floral American style Amber Ale displays a wonderful balance while still maintaining a profound hoppy goodness. We load this beer with a ridiculous and obscene amount of West Coast hops that are added late in the boil, resulting in a hoppy beer without any bitterness.  Crazy Mountain Amber Ale is available in our tasting room year round. 6 pack 12-ounce cans are available at select locations.

Name: Crazy Mountain Livin’ Pale Ale
Description: We utilize two types of American hops in such a way that we put the flavor of these hops center stage and let their bitterness fade into the background. The hop-forward character of this Pale Ale shines through in the unique, tropical fruit flavor of two American hop varieties. Enjoy this offering with a fresh approach to how a Pale Ale expresses its inner hoppiness.

Name: Crazy Mountain Hookiebobb IPA
Description: grated Parmigiano Reggiano cheese Grilled lemon chicken kebabs with spicy garlic sauce Homemade shrimp potstickers with a red chili sesame oil dipping sauce A Colorado approach to the American take of an English classic, we use three aggressive, yet floral American hops teamed together to make a bright, citrusy, and floral IPA. A deep caramel malt helps to balance the bitterness of the hops and lets the complex hop bill do its hoppy thing.

Name: Crazy Mountain Double India Red Ale
Description: "The "IRA", as it's known around here, marries a ruby red color and rich body with the hop flavors of an IPA. Our unique ale yeast strain adds a delicious layer of complexity. One of the first beers we made, and an enduring favorite."

Name: Crazy Mountain Creedence Pilsner
Description: This Pilsner is modeled after the classic bohemian Pilsners of Europe. We use high-quality Pilsner malt to lend the beer a nice delicate flavor and aroma. We add classic Czech hops to give a slightly spicy cedar nose with a light floral finish. This delicately malted, easy-drinking beer was our tribute to the 2015 World Ski Championships.

Name: Wynkoop Colorojo
Description: A bodacious, sticky, double red with luscious caramel and malt notes and deep layers of hops.

Name: Wynkoop Rail Yard Ale
Description: Our flagship brew is a smooth, amber beer that combines the malty goodness of an Octoberfest lager with the slight fruitiness of an ale. Hearty but refreshing.

Name: Wynkoop Patty’s Chile Beer
Description: A light German-style beer made with Anaheim chiles and smoked Ancho peppers. A 2006 Great American Beer Festival Bronze Medal winner in the Fruit and Vegetable Beer category and a Wynkoop specialty.

Name: Wynkoop Mile High Pale Ale
Description: Wynkoop will release Mile High Pale Ale MHPA new canas the newest addition in their can lineup just before the July 4th holiday weekend. The beer, a sessionable (at 5.5% A.B.V.) version of the popular Mile H.I.P.A.

Name: Wynkoop Belgorado
Description: Belgorado is a wet hopped Belgian-style IPA made with barley grown in Colorado’s San Luis Valley and fresh hops handpicked (by head brewer Andy Brown and a few pals) at Misty Mountain Hops farm near Montrose, CO.

Name: Wynkoop B3K Black Lager
Description: This German-style black lager has a deep color and gently roasted flavors balanced by an understated hoppiness. A thirst-quenching version of dark beer.

Name: Wynkoop Pumpkin Ale
Description: Ale brewed with fresh roasted pumpkin, puréed pumpkin, flaked pumpkin, honey and spices.

Name: Lone Tree Brewing Company – Peach Pale Ale
Description: A perfect complement to citrus hops the peach character truly shines in this pale ale. No extracts in this beer. Only true peaches are blended in with unique malts chosen for their ability to showcase pale ale characteristics. The hop proﬁle enhances the peach experience without overwhelming the pallet. Bite into a Peach Pale Ale and experience beer with fruit in a new exciting way. Sipping by a brilliant sunset is highly encouraged.

Name: Lone Tree Brewing Company – Mexican Lager
Description: Malt, hops water yeast and a touch of sweet corn. Plain and simple. This beer is made for everyone! Light, refreshing, thirst quenching, and full of great ﬂavor. Created to help everyday life become a little brighter. Pair with mowing the lawn, sitting on a porch, shoveling snow, or simply watching the day go by

Name: Lone Tree Brewing Company – Vanilla Caramel Amber
Description: Full-bodied, caramel notes from carefully selected crystal malts finishing with smooth vanilla from pure Madagascar vanilla beans

Name: Lone Tree Brewing Company – Red Ale
Description: Searching for a malt forward delicious Red Ale that is light on bitterness? Look no more.  This Irish Red is a perfect light bodied dark beer with a pleasant caramel roasted malt character and a light toasted malt ﬁnish. A touch of chocolate malt and English hops create a masterpiece of ﬂavors on your pallet.  Pairs well with those not wanting a bitter beer face. Pairs well with moonlit evenings by the campﬁre.

Name: Lone Tree Brewing Company – Strawberry Kiwi Blonde
Description: The ultra refreshing thirst quencher is here for Spring and Summer.  We took a highly drinkable blonde ale and added juice from strawberries and kiwis to create a beer you won't want to put down.  This fruit forward blonde will pour with a pink hue, tropical aromatics, and feature a sweet finish.  Grab this seasonal offering while you can and enjoy with friends under the sun.

Name: Lone Tree Brewing Company – Double IPA
Description: A Hop above the rest!  American pale malt and a touch of honey malt provide the backbone and balance for this solid higher gravity Double IPA . Seven hop additions in the boil from 6 different hop varieties, followed by a 3 day dry-hop create strong tangerine/citrus aromas followed by a pleasing bold earthy bitterness. A true hop head pleasing double IPA .

Name: Lone Tree Brewing Company – India Pale Ale
Description: Introducing your new "go to" IPA.  This West Coast style IPA has bold hop character with copious amounts of late addition hops that really create a pleasant hop aroma and flavor.  With Centennial, Cascade, Zythos, and a CTZ dry-hop, this is surely to become one of your favorite India Pale Ales.

Name: Smog City Sabre Toothed Squirrel Amber Ale
Smog City California Love Imperial Red Ale
Description: Our first official collaboration beer. Porter of Smog City and Zambo of 21st Amendment, San Francisco, got together to create Califronia Love, an Imperial Red brewed with pinot noir grapes, citrus peel and aged on medium toast oak spirals. Designed to bring the best of NorCal and SoCal together; California Love features wine grapes from wine country and citrus peel from SoCal. Together they blend beautifully into our newest release, California Love.

Name: Smog City Coffee Porter
Description: A coffee-beer, rather than a beer with coffee. A robust porter aged on fresh locally roasted, fair trade ground coffee. Enhanced flavors of chocolate, roasted malt, and of course coffee are present. "Like a chocolate covered espresso bean.

Name: Smog City Amarilla Gorilla
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This IPA is definitely from the jungle!  With notes of mango, papaya, apricot, and a touch of citrus and pine in the nose, this is one big, beautifully hoppy IPA.  Enough malt balance and restrained bitterness keeps it very drinkable.

Name: Smog City IPA
Description: Our flagship IPA is classically West Coast with notes of orange, tropical fruit, and floral honey. The lightly toasted caramel malt balances a resinous hop aroma and a firm yet balanced bitterness makes this beer a full-blown Hop Lover’s paradise.

Name: Smog City Little Bo Pilsner
Description: This pale lager is all about subtlety and balance. Aromas hint at delicate hop spice, a touch of honey and rustic white bread. The light malt meets traditional Czech Saaz hops to lend a crisp and refreshing finish.

Name: Jailbreak The Infinite Amber Ale
Description: Easy drinking & infinitely smooth, this amber ale is classic in style yet uniquely approachable. Hints of roast and caramel lend to a slightly sweet malt with a semi-dry finish.  Includes growler!

Name: Jailbreak Desserted Chocolate Coconut Porter
Description: An all natural concoction of flavors, Desserted is a balanced porter complimented with toasted coconut and dark chocolate. Semi sweet though not sticky, it’s a guilt free dessert in a glass.  **Includes growler!**

Name: Jailbreak Feed The Monkey
Description: A German style hefeweizen that combines traditional notes of clove and banana with subtle citrus aromas and flavors to provide balanced and complexity. No fruit required!  Includes growler!

Name: Jailbreak Welcome to Scoville
Description: An artisanal style IPA combining mildly bitter hops, garden fresh jalapeno peppers, and cilantro.

Name: Jailbreak Big Punisher
Description: A well balanced double IPA with a malt backbone and complimented with generous amounts of citrus and tropical fruit hops.  Rich, delicious, and rewardingly punishing.

Name: Silver City Tropic Haze IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A seemingly magical reaction between a specialized yeast strain, oats, wheat, and an experimental hop variety results in a blossom of rich, tropical fruit flavor that is a feast for the eyes, with a silky-smooth texture and clean finish.

Name: Silver City Ripe ‘N Juicy Double IPA
Description: Like cutting into a fresh cantaloupe... if it were filled with a metric sh*t-ton of ripe, fragrant hops soaked in pineapple juice. Ripe ‘N Juicy gains its signature dense, hazy body from the reaction of a specialized yeast strain with a hearty dose of flaked wheat. A massive canvas for a brilliantly fruity hop experience.

Name: Silver City Sun Glitter Peach IPA
Description: Seasonal - Peach IPA

Name: Silver City St Florian IPA
Description: Benefiting Washington State Fire Fighters. Saint Florian is a balanced IPA that’s uses Washington grown Cascade & Columbus hops that are boldly citrus, floral and piney.

Name: Silver City Rain Or Shine Passionfruit Hard Seltzer
Widmer Brothers Hefeweizen
Description: Meet the beer that started it all. Our naturally cloudy flagship brew starts with the highest quality wheat. It's bold, clean flavor and pronounced citrus and floral aromas are what define American-style hefeweizen. So pour yourself a cool, cloudy glass, finish with a lemon and enjoy the original.

Name: Widmer Brothers Drop Top Ale
Description: Drop Top is a rich, flavorful amber ale, with an exceptionally smooth and easy taste. Uniquely brewed with honey malt and just a touch of milk sugar, Drop Top's silky character yields complex flavors without a trace of harshness. It all adds up to a brew that's as easy to appreciate as it is to drink.

Name: Widmer Brothers Brrr Hoppy Red Ale
Description: Brrr is a one-of-a-kind winter warmer. Generously hopped, Brrr’s citrusy hop aroma and smooth bitterness exemplify the Northwest-style red ale. ‘Tis the season to warm up with a cold one.

Name: Widmer Brothers Snow Plow Milk Stout
Description: Snow Plow Milk Stout, a classic winter beer with a soft and creamy mouthfeel and roasted chocolate notes, was first brewed in 1999 as the first winning recipe of the Collaborator Project, an annual homebrewing competition with the Oregon Brew Crew. Contrary to most winter ales on the market at the time which used some dark malts and were very hoppy, this beer was extremely dark, used a ton of specialty malt (which had to be hand-loaded, making it one of our most labor-intensive brews), and had a sweet characteristic from the use of milk sugar.

Name: Widmer Brothers Upheaval IPA
Description: Upheaval IPA unleashes a huge hop flavor and aroma with serious bitterness and a balanced finish. Hazy and bold, Upheaval is left unfiltered for the full IPA experience.

Name: Widmer Brothers Seasonal
Description: You look like you’ve had a busy day today, but with tropical notes of lemon, mango, and grapefruit and a crisp hop finish, this easy-drinking IPA will keep the good times rolling well into the night. Tiny Drinker may be small but it’s mighty in flavor and one you’ll want to hold a little closer. 4.1% ABV and 43 IBU

Name: Widmer Brothers Okto Festival Ale
Description: LOOSEN YOUR LEDERHOSEN. OUR FULL-BODIED OKTO FESTIVAL ALE IS INSPIRED BY BAVARIAN OKTOBERFEST, AND WE PAY FITTING TRIBUTE WITH ITS DISTINCTIVE MALT FLAVORS, MILD FLORAL CHARACTER AND CRISP CLEAN FINISH. PROST! TO THE LAND OF THE PROST!

Name: Rickard’s Red Ale
Description: The Rickard’s original. With a slight hoppy bitterness, this full-flavoured medium-bodied ale features candy-like caramel malt sweetness and a signature red copper colour.

Name: Rickard’s White
Description: Rickard’s White is unfiltered, creating its rich, cloudy appearance. Crafted from unmalted wheat and malted barley, with a hint of hop bitterness.

Name: Rickard’s Red IPA
Description: In crafting Rickard's Red IPA, our brewers combined the distinct hop character of an IPA with the rich malty notes they've perfected in Rickards Red.

Name: Rickard’s Red Session Lager
Description: Featuring a refreshing light malt character with an overlay of clean hop bitterness, this is truly a must-try lager.

Name: Rickard’s Lederhosen
Description: Inspired by the legendary beer halls of Germany, this dark amber lager has a smooth medium body and a striking hoppy finish.

Name: Rickard’s Blonde
Description: With a smooth, refined finish and stunning golden hue, this is truly a beer with character. Medium-light in body, with a malty sweetness and noble-type hop aroma and flavour.

Name: Rickard’s Grapefruit Radler
Description: A thirst-quenching mix of our premium lager, natural flavours, and lemon and grapefruit juice.

Name: Bad Weather Minnesota Windvane Red Ale
Description: Our flagship year-round release WINDVANE stands strong through all types of weather and is a great fit for all seasons. Pouring a deep brilliant red, this is your go-to beer. If you want something hoppy, you definitely have it. American hops give WINDVANE a swift bitterness with piney, citrus and resinous flavors. If you want something with strong malt shoulders, you have that too. Roast malt layers add complexity and keeps the beer dry to showcase the hops.

Name: Bad Weather Sun Pillar Belgian Blonde Ale
Description: Subtle spicy yeast notes are accompanied by the sweetness of Belgian Pilsen malt and candi sugar. Bubble gum and clove permeate the soft aroma coming off a silky white tuft of foam.

Name: Bad Weather Tippin’ It Down ESB
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Balancing chewy malts and herbal hops, an Extra Special Bitter is a British beer style that's ironically low in bitterness & all about drinkability. We infused our version w/ Earl Grey Tea to add spicy and floral notes. A perfect choice for when you can't decide between a cup o' tea or a pint o' bitter.

Name: Bad Weather Immortal Toast White Stout
Description:
White Stout w/ Coffee, Chocolate & Vanilla
“Made from an archaic recipe rediscovered in the j̶u̶n̶k̶ treasures on my dad’s workbench, this beer was worth the dig. Fresh ground coffee, dark chocolate and sweet malt waft up from this rich brew. Raise your glass to the memory of my dad, Greg.”

Name: Bad Weather The Hopcromancer IPA
Description: Biscuit like malt character with lots of juicy hops. Generously hopped throughout the boil, and dry hopped twice for extra depth of hop aroma. Pineapple, citrus, melon, and just a hint of pine. Pours gold with a thick white head.

Name: Bad Weather Munich Helles
Description: The incredibly difficult to brew Bavarian Helles lager. It is a test of patience to brew this beer. 2 months it sat in the tank and lagered. A style of beer invented in Munich by the Spaten brewery in 1895. Aromas of clean, cracker like pilsner malt. Every so subtle floral/spicy hop aroma. Bready pilsner malt flavor that is clean and slightly sweet, and a soft hop bitterness. Crisp, clean, dry traditional lager character that pours pale straw with a creamy white head and is brilliantly clear or stupid bright! Some will argue that it is the “Perfect Beer”.

Name: Bad Weather Migration Ale
Description: A beer brewed for the calm before the storm. MIGRATION ALE has a cracker-like malt character decorated with notes of stone fruit and flowers. Rose hips are added to the boil, lending a light herbal bouquet on the nose. This floral addition complements the hops balancing out the German malt sweetness. MIGRATION is perfect for when spring is in bloom, or when you just need reminding of spring.

Name: Finnegans Irish Amber Ale
Description: The flagship brew that kicked off our whole beer-as-a-charity movement, FINNEGANS Irish Amber is a full-flavored, medium-bodied ale with a creamy, malty finish. While most beers provide a temporary bliss, FINNEGANS Irish Amber fills your soul with deep-rooted goodness that can’t be filtered out by your liver.

Name: Finnegans Freckled Rooster
Description: May we present a beer so French it ponders its own existence. Freckled Rooster is a refreshing, limited-release Bière Blanc ale. French-inspired with aromas of melon, stone fruit and Sauvignon Blanc grapes. Complemented nicely by a spritzy mouthfeel and slightly spicy mid-palate. Summer just got more interesting.

Name: Finnegans Armor Laker Blonde
Description: A light-bodied Blonde Ale with a slightly floral, slightly fruity aroma. Armory Laker Blonde is a deliciously crisp, clean collaboration between the historical Minneapolis Armory and the history-making FINNEGANS brewery. It’s fun, fresh, and classically-blonde. Like if Marilyn Monroe were a cool old building you could drink.

Name: Finnegans Tipped Cow
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A refreshing Belgian-inspired Saison. Tipped Cow is the perfect spring and summer Saison. You’ll find hints of pepper, mandarin orange, fresh cut grass, and pine. It’s light but flavorful, and perfect for thirsty farmhands to drink ‘till the cows come home.

Name: Finnegans Dead Irish Poet
Description: Meet our new limited release Extra Stout, Dead Irish Poet. Its complex, dark and brooding taste profile and higher alcohol content are a fitting homage to the long line of complex, dark and brooding Irish writers like James Joyce, William Butler Yeats and Oscar Wilde. This unique Cork-style stout has a smooth roasted quality, with dark chocolate and stone fruit notes. Perfect for a night at the pub or an Irish Wake.

Name: Finnegans Hoppy Shepherd Session Ale
Description: To honor of the stoic and solitary men who provide Ireland with its much-needed wooly warmth, we proudly brew Hoppy Shepherd. An uncommonly drinkable IPA made from Admiral, Centennial, Citra and Jester hops with aromas of apricot, grapefruit and tangerine. We find it perfect for stirring conversation from even the most sheepish shepherd.

Name: Finnegans Brim Reaper Rye IPA
Description: Excellent balance of fruit, citrus, and pine with subtle spice from the rye.

Name: Highland Gaelic Ale
Description:
A deep amber-colored American ale, featuring a rich malty body. Cascade and Willamette hops add a complex hop flavor and aroma. This ale is exceptionally balanced between malty sweetness and delicate hop bitterness. It has a universal appeal and is our workhorse, accounting for about half of our total production.
This was our first beer and was originally named Celtic Ale in honor of the Scots and Irish who originally settled the Appalachian region. We had to change the name – unbeknownst to us, Bert Grant Brewery had trademarked “Celtic Ale." The term "Gaelic" more commonly refers to the language of the Celtic peoples in Scotland and Ireland and particularly to the Scottish Highlanders. The dark amber color is similar to a Scottish Ale but the flavor and body is more in the style of American Amber.

Name: Highland Thunderstruck Coffee Porter
Description: Get struck by coffee aroma and flavor with subtle spice and fruit notes. This coffee porter is brewed with 1.5 lbs of Dynamite Roasting coffee per barrel.

Name: Highland Black Mocha Stout
Description: Highland’s most robust beer, having a very malty body with a large, roasted chocolate flavor, all achieved solely through the use of special roasted barley grains. It is black in color with a very clean finish and moderate hop flavor.  While the porter style was developing, some brewers produced a stout porter and over time generated a new style known simply as stout. These beers traditionally contain a distinct roasted malt flavor and can run the gamut from a dry stout, such as Guinness to a sweet stout such as Watney’s Cream Stout. Our Black Mocha falls in the sweet stout range and derives its chocolate and coffee tones from the use of appropriate roasted malt grains and is very often used as an after dinner libation or an accompaniment to dessert.

Name: Highland Daycation IPA
Description: Sit back and relax or grab your pack and go - this IPA is up for anything. Lively and light-bodied, Daycation celebrates Mosaic®'s stone fruit and herbal notes, while El Dorado®, and Azacca®™ dry hop adds layers of bright citrus. Balanced by a varied malt profile, with enough bitterness to satisfy hop enthusiasts, this beer is crafted to bring you back for more.

Name: Southern Prohibition Suzy B
Description: An easy drinker that’s full of flavor, our unfiltered ale is perfect for any occasion. This dirty blonde with a pinch of wheat has a nice honey malt backbone and a balanced bitterness, set apart by its pleasant cascade hop aroma.

Name: Southern Prohibition Mississippi Fire Ant Imperial Red Ale
Description: Our first high gravity offering, this dry hopped imperial red ale has a huge malt presence only to be out shined by its hop additions. Dark mahogany red with a nice fluffy head, the Fire Ant showcases roasted and toasted caramel notes layered between spicy, herbal and fruity hops.

Name: Southern Prohibition Suzy Smash
Description: An easy drinker that’s full of flavor, we dry-hopped our unfiltered blonde ale. This dirty blonde has a pinch of wheat and a nice honey malt backbone with a balanced bitterness, set apart by its pleasant cascade hop aroma.

Name: Southern Prohibition Jack The Sipper
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: ESB utilizes traditional ingredients for a flavorful yet balanced harmony of English hops and English malts. Manageable ABV along with rich toasty and fruity flavors allows the victim to sip on multiple pints for a true UK experience down South.

Name: Southern Prohibition Devil’s Harvest Extra Pale Ale
Description: This devilishly dank dry hopped American pale ale uses rich Munich malt to balance out the hop additions. With a full mouth feel and bold aroma, Devil’s Harvest is a flavorful hop bomb.

Name: SoPro Crowd Control Imperial IPA
Description: Crowd Control is a dry-hopped Imperial IPA showcasing Mosaic hops. A solid malt backbone accompanied with a fruity and sticky hop overlay contain one another for a great balance of aroma and flavor. Drink fresh and don't resist.

Name: Southern Prohibition IPA
Description: 2015 IPA is SoPro’s yearly IPA installment. The IPA this year features an up-front hop bite with tropical and pine flavors creeping throughout. Finishing dry and bright with a lingering sticky flavor, this IPA is not a candidate for first timers but reserved for the hop head who needs a revival from the mundane.

Name: Ale Asylum Ambergeddon
Description: Asylum Ambergeddon  6.7% abv.  Style: Amber Ale  [Body: Medium-Full]  [Color: Amber Red]  Available: Year-round in WI and IL  Motto: The end is near for weak amber beers.    Run of the mill, malty ambers be forewarned: your extinction is imminent. That’s because Ambergeddon brings the malt AND the hops, the latter seriously lacking in your garden varietals. It’s a west coast style amber, which means you get tons of hoppy goodness on a firm bed of malt. Ambergeddon: Huge hops, big malt. Good luck.

Name: Ale Asylum Ünshadowed
Description: Vibrant as a summer sun and über refreshing, our classic German Hefeweizen is soft on the palate with an effervescent finish.

Name: Ale Asylum FVCK COVID Version 2.0 Hazy Pale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The second installment of our FVCK COVID series. How about a shirt or neck gaiter to match the beer? Visit our Merchandise store at www.aleasylum and you can wear what we're all thinking.

Name: Ale Asylum Hopalicious
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Hopalicious is a refreshing American Pale Ale unique enough for the connoisseur, approachable enough for the novice, and drinkable to everyone. Sure, we could have made it “Bitterlicious”, or even “Maltalicious” for that matter. But we didn’t. We made it Hopalicious. And we made it for the everyday hophead who wants bold, citrus hop flavor without crazy bitterness.

Name: Ale Asylum Bedlam IPA
Description: This beast is a beauty. It is heavily hopped and fiercely aggressive, with an unmistakable aroma and flavor profile in a sea of India Pale Ales. What started as an experiment in the Ale Asylum original brewery has gone on to become one of the highest rated Belgian-style India pale Ales in the world.

Name: Ale Asylum FVCK COVID Pilsner
Description: A great fvcking beer for these strange fvcking times. How about a shirt or neck gaiter to match the beer? Visit our Merchandise store at www.aleasylum and you can wear what we're all thinking.

Name: Radiant Pig Save The Robots East Coast IPA
Description: The party's just getting started for East Coast IPAs and we're keeping things moving with a fresh take on the style. This hazy, unfiltered gem has juicy, tropical, citrus flavors that span the multiverse of hop varieties. A big IPA that drinks easy whether you're a human or a disco-breaking, beer-swilling robot.

Name: Radiant Pig TV Party
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: An old school American beer style gets a new school twist. This pale ale is hazy, juicy, and bursting with hop goodness. It's crushable. It's bold without being abrasive. It's our kind of party. It's a TV Party

Name: Radiant Pig Own the Night
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Own the Night is juicy, hazy, and delicious. It boasts huge aromas of tropical fruit and mango from the double dry hop additions of Mosaic, Citra, and El Dorado. Background notes of Simcoe and Falconer's Flight provide just the right amount of bitterness. This one's for all the night owls.

Name: Radiant Pig Gangster Duck
Description: A Gangster Duck ain't afraid to stray from the flock. We borrowed from a few different beer styles to create a tasty red with a style all its own. It smells like an IPA  bursting with fancy hops but has a smooth malty finish. And just enough of a bite.

Name: Radiant Pig It Ain’t Easy Double IPA
Description: If you're after something easy-drinking you're in the wrong place. This double dry-hopped DIPA features favorites like Citra, Mosaic, El Dorado and is best savored slowly.

Name: Southampton Beir de Mars
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: Traditional, French-style, Spring beer. Fruity and smooth.

Name: Southampton Pumpkin Ale
Description: Our Autumn amber brew with the unmistakable flavor of “pumpkin pie”

Name: Abandoned Building Irish Farewell
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: This Irish Red ale is a crystal-clear ale, with a clean, crisp flavor centering around its malt backbone. With a lovely red hue and a touch of malty sweetness, this easy-drinking seasonal beer is available on draft around St. Patrick’s day.

Name: Abandoned Building Odin Quadruple
Description: A classic Belgian Abbey Quadrupel with dark-fruit notes including cherry, plum, and raisin.

Name: Abandoned Building Hydra Pale Ale
Description: An ABB staple, this ever-shifting pale ale currently features Zythos & Mandarina Bavaria hops. A super juicy, super citrusy Pale Ale.

Name: Abandoned Building Belladonna Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout
Description: Aged for 9 months in freshly emptied Four-Roses Bourbon Barrels. This Imperial Stout has a big, rich, and full-bodied flavors including hints of Vanilla & Bourbon.

Name: Abandoned Building Dirty Girl IPA
Description: Named in celebration of the amazing women in agriculture who make local beer possible, Dirty Girl features 5 hop varieties lending big citrus and bitter pine characteristics to the medium malt backbone’s subtle sweetness.

Name: Abandoned Building Pan Galactic IPA
Description: Coming to you from a galaxy far, far, away, this juicy, summery IPA serves a blast of hoppy, grapefruity, pineapply magic. This beer is Zaphod Beeblebrox-approved—the guide mentions alcohol, and says that the best drink in the galaxy is the Pan-Galactic IPA. Get ready to expand your mind.

Name: Abandoned Building Other End
Description: This hazy, double dry-hopped Imperial IPA is loaded with tropical and citrusy hop aroma and flavor. A real treat for IPA-lovers seeking a complex, lively flavor profile and fruity aroma to write home about.

Name: Strike Colossus Of Clout Irish Red Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red

Name: Santa Cruz Imperial Amber Ale
Description: Screaming Hand combines tropical and resinous hops with a balanced, medium-bodied caramel malt base. Generous dry hopping with Amarillo and Centennial hops boosts the floral and citrus aroma, creating a balanced and drinkable beer.

Name: Strike Lucky Bullet Belgian Wheat
Description: Our version of a traditionalBelgian Style Wheat Beer.Unfiltered with the addition of herbal and spicy notes from coriander, chamomile,and bitter orange peel. Brisk effervescence with a modest bitterness and a dry finish.

Name: Strike Santa Cruz Blonde
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: We’ve teamed up with Santa Cruz Skateboards to create the crisp, refreshing session craft beer "Classic Dot Blonde Ale". Coming in at just 4.5% ABV, it’s a refreshing way to finish the day or keep on going.

Name: Strike Called Up Extra Pale Ale
Strike Double IPA
Description: A hoppy, west coast Double IPA.

Name: Thimble Island American Ale
Description: There's just something about an Ale. This is our first and flagship beer!

Name: Thimble Island Sea Foam
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Nuts, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens
Description: This NE Pale Ale is dry hopped with Citra to create a smooth floral and citrus aroma and taste.

Name: Thimble Island Coffee Stout
Tasting Notes: Cherry, Chocolate, Coffee, Creamy, Dry, Malty, Mocha, Rich, Roasted, Silky, Smooth, Toasty, Velvety
Description: This beer features whole coffee beans from our local CT coffee shop, Willoughby's. This brew presents itself as a modern American craft-brewed stout

Name: Thimble Island Ghost Island Double IPA
Description: First brewed in early 2014 as part of our "Uncharted Series" of limited edition and experimental beers, Ghost Island Double IPA quickly became one of our most popular brews.  Ghost Island is bold and complex with an intense crispness and smooth finish.  We dry hop it with Citra™ to add vibrant grapefruit and citrus aromas and flavors creating a dynamic and refreshing brew.

Name: Thimble Island Sea Mist
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This brew is super juicy bursting with Mosaic and Amarillo hops. It has an abundance of bright citrus and tropical flavors.

Name: Thimble Island India Pale Ale
Description: Our IPA blends the best components of classic American IPA's with highlights from the new generation.

Name: Thimble Island Riptied Hard Craft Seltzer
Description: Our very own hard craft seltzers in a variety pack of 12 cans and 4 different flavors! Mango, Triple Berry, Grapefruit and Black Cherry!

Name: Oakshire Amber
Description: Our amber ale holds a special place in our hearts as the first beer we ever crafted. A delicious balance between malt & hops creates a sessionable brew enjoyable throughout the seasons.

Name: Oakshire Sun Made Cucumber
Description: With a juicy melon hop aroma yielding to bright honeydew flavor, Sun Made Cucumber is quenching, tart and uniquely inspired – just like you!

Name: Oakshire Sun Made Raspberry
Description: Sun Made Raspberry marries traditional Berliner Weisse tartness with real raspberries for a bright, fresh flavor with a crisp, clean finish.

Name: Oakshire Overcast Espresso Stout
Description: Oregon- American Stout- Overcast is a dark & silky oatmeal stout that channels the gray skies of Western Oregon. It has a rich, smooth & full coffee flavor that is warming on a cold, rainy day. Pairs well with BBQ, oysters, cheddar cheese & tiramisu!

Name: Oakshire Citrafonix IPA
Description: Grapefruit and lime juice paired with sweet and bitter orange peel compliment Citra and cascade hops in the one of a kind thirst quenching IPA

Name: Oakshire Watershed IPA
Description: Presenting hop aroma and flavor of fresh grapefruit and resinous pine, Watershed IPA strikes a balance between bitter and sweet, finishing crisp and clean.

Name: Oakshire Lagerbier
Description: Inspired by Europe’s Pilsners, our Lagerbier uses only the finest malts and noble hops to create an aromatic, full-bodied and balanced lager.

Name: Alley Kat Buena Vista Brown Ale
Description: Inspired by the countless amazing views in Alberta, we named our Brown Ale, Buena Vista! Our brown ale recipe has not changed. It is still a hearty, London-style brown ale, traditionally hopped with US Goldings hops. It serves as a refreshing all-purpose beer for those who enjoy dark ales. The major thing to note for Buena Vista Brown Ale is the emphasis on the malt. That doesn’t mean we don’t use any hops though. We brew Buena Vista with Goldings to add a light floral hoppy note to the taste.

Name: Alley Kat Scona Gold Kölsch
Description: Originally brewed as a cream ale, Scona Gold took a hiatus from our line-up before being re-introduced in 2014 as a traditionally brewed Kölsch style ale. Kölsch is a German style, which is sometimes referred to as the lager of ales and our Scona Gold is no exception! Voted Canada’s best craft beer of the year in 2015, Scona Gold Kölsch is a delightfully crisp and refreshing beer. This golden ale is sure to please; even the most die-hard lager drinkers will enjoy this treasure. Go for the gold, a Scona Gold.

Name: Alley Kat RazzyKat Raspberry Sour
Description: Natural raspberry puree gives this wheat beer the perfect sweet and sour raspberry flavour and aroma. The original recipe for RazzyKat is older than Alley Kat itself, and we’ve been around furr-ever! So what better way to celebrate our 25th anniversary than by bringing back this fan favourite raspberry sour.

Name: Alley Kat Aprikat Apricot Ale
Tasting Notes: Apricot, Balanced, Crisp, Flavored, Stone Fruit
Description: When Alley Kat opened in 1995, Aprikat was the first apricot ale in Alberta, and one of the first fruit beers in the province, making it the perfect invitation to get anyone hooked on craft! One of Alberta’s favourite craft beers, Aprikat, is based on a North American style wheat ale. Our award winning brilliantly clear wheat ale stands out with its orchard fresh aroma and mouthwatering taste of apricots. We add a natural apricot extract to produce a perfect, not-too-sweet flavour and aroma backed with a slight graininess from the wheat ale base. No one forgets their first!

Name: Alley Kat Fish Bone New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The newest addition to our core line-up celebrates Alley Kat nearing our anticipated 25th anniversary; we reeled in inspiration from our vintage fish bone logo as the perfect homage to our humble history! This cloudy unfiltered IPA is our take on a New England India Pale Ale. We brew this beer with a blend of classic American hops and new-age tropical hops to produce an "East meets West" NEIPA. With strong aromas of tangerine, citrus, and pine, this catch of the day will make you feel like you’re in the tropics all year 'round!

Name: Alley Kat Full Moon Pale Ale
Description: We can’t promise inner peace, but our Full Moon Pale Ale definitely has a zen-like balance of smooth body and light carbonation. Our original Pale Ale recipe features a perfect balance of citrus and piney hops with a caramel malt finish and is dry hopped with Centennial and Cascade for good measure. We’ve come up with a beer that, not only delights the palate, but leaves it wanting more. Full Moon isn’t a palate wrecker, it’s a palate pleaser. Carefully crafted to have a bright and full hop flavour, while not overpowering the subtle malty notes that provide a solid backbone for this well balanced, sessionable Pale Ale.

Name: Alley Kat Main Squeeze Grapefruit Ale
Description: Our Main Squeeze Grapefruit Ale has a wheat backbone just like our Aprikat Apricot Ale. We use fresh ruby red grapefruits in every batch we brew. The natural citrus notes of the grapefruit are complemented by Cascade hops, both for bittering and for dry-hopping. We squeeze our fresh grapefruits in-house! We use the juice at the end of the mash, and throw grapefruit rinds in at the end of the boil. One batch uses about 75 grapefruits!! MMM so fresh. Cheers to you and your Main Squeeze!

Name: Grand Canyon Sunset Amber
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Duck  Game Bird, Mushrooms, Root Vegetables
Description:
Nothing captures a warm Grand Canyon sunset quite like our Sunset Amber Ale. This traditional American Amber Ale pours a rich red color with bronze and gold highlights. A medium bodied brew with a high level of sweetness with malt finish. Crack open your next adventure or sit back,
relax and enjoy the painted skies at sunset.

Name: Grand Canyon Pumpkin Springs Porter
Description: Brewed with the essence of pumpkin pie, this fan favorite Porter captures all of the delicious and spicy flavors of fall, Pumpkin Springs Porter is a harvest inspired ale brewed with pumpkin, fresh ginger, and a secret blend of fall spices, medium bodied with a warming finish drinks smooth with an explosion of complex flavors.

Name: Grand Canyon Kachina Throwback Ale
Description: A brewery favorite reimagined to commemorate our partnership with the Arizona Coyotes as the official craft beer of our NHL franchise. This  American Wheat Ale, is clean, refreshing and light. Different from a typical european style wheat beer, an american wheat is clear with subdued fruit flavors with an subtle hop character for the American touch.  Its an ideal style to knock back a couple while cheering on your Arizona Coyotes.

Name: Grand Canyon Horseshoe Bend Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A full bodied brew with complex characters of bitter sweetness but light in body, complete with powerful grapefruit and tropical flavors and subtle caramel notes. A single sip of Horseshoe Bend’s distinct taste and spicy character will dazzle your senses and keep you craving your next big thrill. Take your next adventure over the edge with our Horseshoe Bend Pale Ale.

Name: Grand Canyon Black Iron IPA
Description: A tribute to the black iron that paved the way to the Grand Canyon, this brew is well balanced with bitter and malty flavors accented by a sharp hop aroma. This hazy orange brew offers fruity orange notes, then peppery spiciness and finishes with a robust bitterness. Quench your thirst on a hot summer day in Arizona with a cold and refreshing Black Iron IPA.

Name: Grand Canyon Trail Hike Session IPA
Description: A session style IPA brewed to commemorate the Centennial of Grand Canyon National Park. The session style IPA is a perfect companion for a hike into the canyon. Light and refreshing, bursting with juicy hop aromas and flavors without biting bitterness. A portion of all proceeds from the sales of Trail Hike IPA will go to Grand Canyon Conservancy, the official nonprofit of Grand Canyon National Park.

Name: Grand Canyon American Pilsner
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Chicken, Dessert - Fruit, Pasta, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Tomatoes
Description: A golden brown, lightly balanced, Bohemian style lager with floral and earthy aromas. The smooth bitterness of this brew is beautifully complimented with a subtle malty favor. It’s crisp, clear and enticing. Discover a Grand Canyon state of mind with our American Pilsner.

Name: Ritual Extra Red
Description: We tend to do things a little differently here at Ritual, so when the call came in to make a new style Red ale, we immediately deferred to the full-flavored segment of the taste spectrum. We certainly didn’t skimp on the malts (after all, we used eight different varieties), giving this beer a multi-layered complexity of caramel and toffee.

Name: Ritual Barrel Aged High West Extra Red
Description: Our West Coast style Extra Red has been sitting in High West barrels for over a year!

Name: Ritual Hellion
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Ritual Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A fresh West Coast Pale Ale, brewed with a nod to the classic 'C' hops.  These classic hops bring a citrusy, floral, earthy flavor and aroma that blend together like well woven fabric.

Name: Ritual Big Deluxe Imperial Oat Stout
Description: A massive wall of flavor and so dark it actually absorbs light – at least we think it does! A deeply rich and complex Russian Style Imperial Stout brewed with no less than 10 different malts is the backbone. We brewed this one with oats to add an additional layer of silkiness along with a healthy dose of locally roasted coffee to make this a truly amazing beer. Sip slowly with a friend and enjoy the rich flavors.

Name: Ritual Hop-O-Matic IPA
Description: From the sharp aromatics of citrusy pine that permeates your nostrils to the hefty malt backbone, Hop-O-Matic will slice and dice its way through your palate! But wait, there’s more! This refreshing India Pale Ale highlights the avid appreciation we have of the finer, bold nuances of our little green friends by imparting a delightfully playful nose and even livelier mouthfeel.   A herbaceously spicy, pungent, and dank brew. This fragrant beer imparts an initial blast of bitterness that gives way to sweet, toasty malts and a zesty citrus profile, then takes it up ten notches with a complex mélange of hops that won’t go down without a fight. What can we say? We’re proud of this one.

Name: Ritual Single Rye Hop Lemon Drop IPA
Description: This Rye IPA is the first in a series of single hop IPAs. This clean, simple malt backbone is designed to flaunt the sublime hop character of our choice. Single Rye IPA will be released on draft on a rotating basis with each batch showcasing a different hop variety.

Name: High Hops The Honeyed One American Red
Description:
This sweet red ale is brewed with Nugget hops and honey malt.

*Contains no honey

Name: High Hops Habanero Hunny American Red
Description: Don’t be fooled by her grin, this happy little bee is delivering something fiery to your beer – a ton of Habanero Peppers! Without her help in pollinating the peppers, this beer would not exist. Feel the sting!

Name: High Hops Blueberry Wheat
Description: Enjoy this American Wheat Ale anytime.  As you pop the seal, the blueberry aroma comes blasting out at you like a ferocious spring wind.  Subtle hop flavors provided from Cascade and Mt. Hood hops are the perfect compliment to this wheat-based beer.  Before you know it, you are at the bottom of the can and opening another.

Name: High Hops The Power Of Zeus
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This powerful pale ale was brewed with Zeus hops to create a pale ale as hoppy as our friend, Zeus the Toad, who greeted us when we planted the first Zeus hop plant in our on-site hop field.

Name: High Hops Pinkalicious
Tasting Notes: Berry, Citrus, Crisp, Fruity, Light, Tart
Description: Sour Ale with Lemon Verbena and Raspberries

Name: High Hops The Dark One
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Chocolate, Malty, Rich, Roasted, Smooth, Toasty
Description: A devilishly delicious milk stout brewed with Galena hops to bring out a little mischief in everyone.

Name: High Hops Brewery The Hoppy One
Description: Made with local grains from Root Shoot Malting including Malting’s White Wheat, Aromatic Munich, and Munich Malts. Hopped with Chinook, Cascade, and Centennial in the boil and dry-hopped with Cascade and Centennial.

Name: Rodenbach Vintage 2012 Oak Aged
Description: Rodenbach Vintage is the unique result of selection by our Rodenbach brew masters, the barrel after two years of maturation has produced the best beer, "the best barrel of the year". The label is always the number of barrel stated and the year which marks the beginning of maturation.     Rodenbach Vintage is 100% matured old beer, resulting in superior Rodenbach Grand Cru. Its taste is complex, round, intense and refreshing. Typically, the apple tart fruitiness combined with caramel, wild honey and oak with a hint of vanilla, cherry and licorice. Its aroma has hints of caramel and oak, as well as notes of green apples mixed with honey and chocolate. The soft sour, fruity aftertaste is long and nicely balanced like a grand cru wine.

Name: Rodenbach Caractere Rouge
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: The brewer allow the beer to macerate with fresh cherries, raspberries and cranberries. After this maceration in oak, the beer re-ferments in the bottle. The result is RODENBACH Caractère Rouge, an exceptional RODENBACH with fruit maceration and a 7% alcohol volume. The brew is more than unique and extremely exclusive, as only 900 75-cl bottles were produced (first batch). Geunes serves this wilful beer as part of his other unique range of beer varieties in his restaurant, ’t Zilte, at the Antwerp MAS museum.

Name: Rodenbach Grand Cru
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A blend of 1/3 young beer and 2/3 of beer aged 2 years in large oak vats. The more important proportion of oak matured beer contributes to its fruity taste, complexity and intensity. The finish is worthy of a great wine.

Name: Rodenbach Classic
Description: Rodenbach Classic sets the bar for Flemish red-brown ales. This ale owes its sweet and sour fruitiness and refreshing taste to the fact that it is partially matured in oak casks.

Name: Rodenbach Vintage Oak Aged Red Ale
Description: Light Brown in color slight see through. No head. This beer is described as light bodied but it actually is medium bodied nice color, nice aromatic fruity esters emanating from the beer. From the bottle to the pour it looks and acts like a fine wine. Slightly aromatic fruity character. My wife thought it was raspberry. She has a good palate so I listen to her on this. No hop taste, low bitterness, slightly vinegary, sour going in with a slight sweet fruity, oaky finish. The carbonation in the beer highlights and pushes the flavors to last in your palate. Love the complexity of the malts, fruity and tart, oak finish. This is an outstandingly made beer great for company at dinner. Would go outstanding with fish or light meats such as chicken or lamb. I would buy this beer again.

Name: Rodenbach Ale
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A blend of 75% young beer fermented in steel tanks and 25% old beer aged 2 year in large oak casks. Rodenbach bears the proud title of "the most refreshing beer in the world".

Name: Rodenbach Vintage Oak Aged
Description: Rodenbach Vintage is the unique result of selection by our Rodenbach brew masters, the barrel after two years of maturation has produced the best beer, "the best barrel of the year". The label is always the number of barrel stated and the year which marks the beginning of maturation. Rodenbach Vintage is 100% matured old beer, resulting in superior Rodenbach Grand Cru. Its taste is complex, round, intense and refreshing. Typically, the apple tart fruitiness combined with caramel, wild honey and oak with a hint of vanilla, cherry and licorice. Its aroma has hints of caramel and oak, as well as notes of green apples mixed with honey and chocolate. The soft sour, fruity aftertaste is long and nicely balanced like a grand cru wine.

Name: Mammoth Double Nut Brown Porter
Description: Reminiscent of coffee and dark chocolate, this dark ale exhibits a mild sweetness and finishing roast dryness. This big ol’ Brown Porter is a Mammoth legend. And what’s nice to know is that no nuts were harmed or used during the brewing of this beer.

Name: Mammoth Lair Of The Bear
Description: Aged in Heaven Hill barrels.

Name: Mammoth395 IPA
Description: An ode to the Owens Valley and the Highway 395 corridor, this Double IPA is distinctly bolder than out Epic IPA and celebrates the aromas of wild local fresh hops, sage, and juniper.

Name: Mammoth Epic IPA
Description: Fearless and bold, our Epic IPA earns its name vanquishing hops at a rate of no less than two pounds per barrel. And yet, this heroic outlaw still achieves a noble balance of clean bitterness, smooth malt, and citrusy hops, making it the perfect sidekick for your next wilderness tale.

Name: Mammoth Brewing Co. Sierra Wave Cloudy Dipa
Description: The Sierra wave is a lenticular cloud formation that occurs when specific wind patterns come off the Sierra Nevada mountain range. Essentially, the clouds undulate in a beautiful wavy pattern that can linger over the Mono Basin for hours. This phenomenon is most often seen in late winter and in spring. Sierra Wave Double Cloudy IPA has a plethora of hops that give it aromas and flavors reminiscent of passion fruit, pineapple and citrus. Come to the Eastern Sierra and experience a Sierra Wave sunset along with this fine seasonal brew.

Name: Mammoth Brewing Fire & Eisbock
Description: Brewing in the land of fire & ice (the Eastern Sierra) since 1995 has brought us to this style of beer, where we use a long intense boil to concentrate color, flavor, and natural sugars. Then, after fermentation, we freeze no more than 2% of the water content out of the beer. This concentrates the alcohol and smooths out the flavor for a true winter seasonal. Like the bliss of a “one swing stick” into ice, this beer will distill your attention down to the single focus of the bend of your elbow. Fire & Eisbock will age well, but do drink one now to compare with our barrel-aged eisbock.

Name: 8th Wonder Brewery Cougar Paw Red Ale
8th Wonder Brewery TEX Blonde Ale
Description: A Smooth & Satisfying Blonde Ale

Name: 8th Wonder Haterade Gose
Description: A traditional sour German wheat beer brewed with coriander & sea salt.

Name: 8th Wonder Cloud 8 Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This clumulus lupulus precipates flavors of ripe pineapple and juicy sweet tangerine when Citra, Simcoe, and Amarillo hops combine with 2row barley, flaked oats, and wheat

Name: Funky Buddha Floridian Hefeweizen Wheat Beer
Description: Funky Buddha Floridian Hefeweizen Craft Beer is an unfiltered and pleasant German-style wheat beer. Full of flavor but light on the palate, this Florida beer is made exactingly with natural ingredients. Authentic hefeweizen yeast gives this Funky Buddha beer compelling aromas of bananas, citrus and cloves. A hazy golden color reminiscent of a Florida sunset complements the full flavor of unfiltered beer. Pour this slightly bitter hefeweizen into a weizen glass and pair with mild or sharp goat cheeses, arugula salad with lemon vinaigrette, grilled shrimp, beer-battered onion rings with spicy aioli, whole wheat crust pizza or honey-drizzled baklava. Whether it's the quality of the ingredients, the caliber of the beer, or just watching a breathtaking Florida sunset, Funky Buddha is all about creating enlightening experiences through craft beers. Inner peace starts with great beer. Please drink responsibly. Floridian Wheat Beer. Funky Buddha Brewery, Oakland, Park, FL

Name: Funky Buddha Hop Gun IPA
Description: Funky Buddha Hop Gun IPA Craft Beer is a big, bold India pale ale bursting with pineapple and grapefruit flavor. Brewed with payloads of American cascade and centennial hops, this Funky Buddha beer features a dose of smooth caramel malts for a balanced finish. Made with culinary-inspired natural ingredients using time-honored techniques, this moderately bitter IPA beer goes great with Thai red curry, chipotle wings, hoisin-glazed roast duck, fresh-baked cherry pie and washed rind cheeses. Whether it's the quality of our ingredients, the caliber of our beer, or just watching a breathtaking Florida sunset, Funky Buddha is all about creating enlightening experiences through craft beers. Inner peace starts with great beer. Please drink responsibly. Hop Gun India Pale Ale. Funky Buddha Brewery, Oakland Park, FL

Name: Funky Buddha Premium Hard Seltzers Variety Pack Spiked Sparkling Water
Description: An escape from the conventional, Funky Buddha Premium Hard Seltzer is an enlightened spiked sparkling water. This spiked seltzer variety pack contains four uniquely flavored seltzers, including Juicy Blood Orange, Crisp Pink Grapefruit, Lush Key Lime Cherry, and Tropical Mango Guava. Featuring natural flavors and made from real stuff like cane sugar and blue agave syrup for a crisp, clean taste, this gluten-free spiked seltzer water offers full flavor without unnecessarily added sugar. Enjoy a Funky Buddha seltzer can while working in the garden or taking a brisk walk on the beach. Each 12 oz can of hard sparkling water with alcohol has 90 calories and only 1 gram of carbohydrates** with zero grams of sugar*, so you truly can lighten the funk up with Funky Buddha.     *Not a low-calorie food. **Per 12 fl. oz. serving of average analysis: Calories 90, Carbs 1 gram, Protein 0 grams, Fat 0 grams. Please Drink Responsibly. Funky Buddha Brewery, Oakland Park, FL

Name: Funky Buddha Pineapple Beach Blonde Ale
Description: Funky Buddha Pineapple Beach is a tropical and refreshing blonde ale kissed with gnarly waves of juicy pineapple. A dose of floral, American hops and crisp pilsner malt makes this beer ideal for any sun-soaked day. Pair this craft beer with grilled shrimp skewers, Neapolitan style pizza, balsamic glazed salmon, beef wellington, or peach cobbler a la mode. 20/100 IBUs (International Bitterness Units), 5% alcohol by volume. Pour into a shaker pint or tulip and serve at 40 degrees F.

Name: Funky Buddha Chant Session IPA
Description: Brewed for full-on flavor without the added weight, Funky Buddha Chant Session IPA Craft Beer is balanced and supremely repeatable. An India pale ale with fewer calories* than in typical IPAs, this IPA brew channels intense notes of citrus, mango, and pine from the addition of mosaic hops. Pour this craft IPA beer into a pint glass and pair with blackened Mahi-Mahi tacos, Thai coconut curry, grilled chicken Caesar salad with shaved parmesan, or orange sorbet. Or enjoy this Funky Buddha beer's flavors and aromas of peach, tropical stone fruit, and citrus straight from the beer can. A repeatable IPA beer perfect for those who like to stay active, relaxed, and enlightened; simply sip, chant, repeat. Inner peace starts with great beer.     *Per 12 fl. oz. serving of average analysis: Calories 99, Carbs 4 grams, Protein 0.8 grams, Fat 0 grams. Please drink responsibly. Funky Buddha Brewery, Oakland Park, FL

Name: Funky Buddha Vibin Groovable Lager
Description: Funky Buddha Vibin' Groovable Lager Craft Beer is made with big, bold flavors and natural ingredients. This golden-pale body lager beer is delicate and balanced, ideal for pairing with good tunes, as well as roast turkey, salmon, goat cheese or chicken nachos. With a subtle bitterness, this Florida beer showcases a combination of culinary-inspired ingredients and time-honored brewing techniques. Whether it's the quality of the ingredients, the caliber of the beer or just watching a breathtaking Florida sunset, Funky Buddha beer is all about creating enlightening experiences through unique craft beers. Enjoy a brew from this beer 6 pack right from the cans or poured into a shaker pint. Inner peace starts with great beer. Please drink responsibly. Vibin' Lager. Funky Buddha Brewery, Oakland Park, FL

Name: Funky Buddha Paloma
Description: Paying homage to Mexico's most refreshing highball, Funky Buddha Paloma is an imperial tart ale that is brewed with real agave nectar, aged in reposado tequila barrels, and blended with grapefruit, lime juice, and sea salt. This craft beer has flavors and aromas of citrusy grapefruit, oaky vanilla, and tart lime. Pairs well with spicy fish tacos, Chicken enchiladas, truffle street corn, and fresh guacamole. Please drink responsibly. Funky Buddha Brewery, Oakland Park, FL

Name: Ghostfish Grapefruit IPA
Description: Brewed with grapefruit peel and a mysterious new hop codenamed “Experimental Grapefruit”, this IPA is a serious citrus bomb. Lively and bright, bracingly bitter, and eminently refreshing, you’ll wish it grew on trees!

Name: Ghostfish Meteor Shower Blonde
Description: Sparkling, crisp and highly refreshing, this is a beer of elegant simplicity. Brewed with the finest malted millet and California-grown brown rice, then kissed by Noble German Perle hops for a light bitterness and classic floral aroma. Perfect for those new to craft beer, or for serious beer aficionados searching for an easy-drinking break from more intense and aggressive brews.Light-bodied and malt-forward, with notes of honey, sweet rice, corn, and honeydew melon. Easy drinkin'!

Name: Ghostfish Shrouded Summit White Ale
Description: A hazy golden body capped with a snowy head. A wintry burst of juniper and citrus, on an updraft of Belgian-style aromatics. This beer was our “Everest”–a proper witbier, without wheat or barley! Through a feat of determination worthy of a mountaineer, we proved it was possible, and now we invite you to join us on the Summit.

Name: Ghostfish Vanishing Point Pale Ale
Description: For our take on the classic American pale ale, we decided to throw inhibition to the wind and jump in with both feet. With several types of artisan gluten-free millet & rice malts, and four varieties of Washington-grown hops, one sip will make your preconceptions about gluten-free beer Vanish into the great beyond!A balanced beer with malt flavors of caramel and biscuit with classic American hop flavors of stone fruit and citrus.

Name: Ghostfish Kick Step IPA
Description: Ghostfish and The Mountaineers were both founded on the idea of transcending limits. We thrive on a spirit of wonder, a sense of adventure, and a commitment to the wild places of the Pacific Northwest. We’re powered by strong passionate communities who support our missions. Whether it’s distinctive craft beer made from high-quality, low-impact grains, or unique, life-changing experiences in the outdoors, we believe life is meant to be lived and lived well–no matter who you are. This is Kick Step IPA: a liquid representation of our shared value with The Mountaineers.A classic NW style IPA, golden in color with complex hop aromas of citrus, mango and pine. Sturdy, yet light bodied with a dry finish.

Name: Ghostfish Peak Buster Double IPA
Description: This beer is beyond “big”! We piled a mountain of Equinox, Azacca, Centennial, and Summit hops on a heavy foundation of millet and buckwheat malts, then blew it sky-high with raw cane sugar. With over-the-top hop flavors of pine and passionfruit and a surprising stone-dry finish, this Giant is a force to be reckoned with

Name: Ghostfish It Came From The Haze
Description: Golden yellow, thick and juicy with noticeable bitterness; you can say it's a "west coast" hazy! This batch is dry-hopped with Sultana, Experimental 09326, Huell Melon, Cashmere, Ahtanum, Citra, Loral, and Sabro hops that release a blend of tropical fruit and citrus aromas. Taste the complexities of herbs and pine while you hunt down Sasquatch hidden in the label.

Name: Tampa Bay Brewing Reef Donkey APA
Description: Dry-hopped American Pale Ale made using a secret selection of hops to give this nice dry beer a lemon/lime aroma and citrus & slight tropical fruit flavor. Although this brew Hits the classification of an APA, it drinks like a session IPA perfect for a day on the boat fishing the reef. Reef Donkey is slang for the Greater Amberjack gamefish which inhabit our coastal wrecks and reefs.

Name: Tampa Bay Brewing Company True Blonde Ale
Description: An exceptionally light colored beer fermented at slightly lower than normal ale temperatures to produce a smooth, crisp, and slightly citrus finish. Expect a light bodied ale with a slight hop nose. Not a Light Beer! Just light in color and body.

Name: Tampa Bay Brewing Company Full Moon Madness Subtropical Porter
Description: A dark roasty porter body is the backbone for TBBC’s signature subtropical porter. This beer displays a beautiful blend of banana, vanilla and roasted malts, making it easy to drink, and satisfying on even the hottest Florida day. The Full Moon Madness marks the 20th anniversary of TBBC.

Name: Tampa Bay Brewing Florida Tart
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Tampa Bay Brewing Old Elephant Foot IPA
Description: Highly hopped, medium bodied ale; a true hop head beer! This hoppy IPA is bittered by generous portions of Northern Brewer and Centennial hops for 80 IBUs and finished with Cascade in the kettle and then dry-hopped with some more Cascade and Centennial.

Name: Tampa Bay Brewing Hop Silo Series
Tampa Bay Brewing Gourds Gone Wild
Description: Originally brewed in collaboration with Southern Brewing and Winemaking, this pumpkin ale has since become our highly anticipated, award-winning fall seasonal. With a brown ale as its backbone, this deep copper beer has all the aromas of the season, pumpkin pie, vanilla, graham cracker and nutmeg with tastes of creamy sweetness and spice.

Name: Monday Night Blood Orange IPA
Description: A juicy IPA. Pirates love citrus fruits almost as much as they love blood. If the phrase “you are what you eat” is true, then pirates are blood oranges. If the phrase “you are what you drink” is true, you’re about to be an incredibly delicious, juicy hop bomb of an IPA. We add bits of real blood orange to every beer, so you know it’s good.

Name: Monday Night On A Boat Golden Ale
Description: Sit back, relax and cruise. I’m On A Boat is an easy drinking golden ale that’s enjoyable floating on the water, or hanging on shore. A low ABV crusher, I’m On A Boat is brewed with Pilsner malt and wheat for a crisp and clean drinking experience. Finished with Lemondrop hops for just enough bite…but at only 20 IBU’s, you’ll need to keep your cooler fully stocked.

Name: Monday Night Fu Manbrew
Description: A bright, spicy Belgian-style wit. An effervescent, easy-drinking wheat beer, brewed with Belgian yeast, German hops, and a whisper of ginger from the Far East. This mustachio’d Belgian-style wit believes that good beer defies borders. The name Fu Manbrew was crowdsourced with some help from our friends at Scoutmob. They call the mustache a “Flavor Savor” for a reason.

Name: Monday Night Rucksack Hefe
Description: Introducing Rucksack. Our newest summer seasonal, this German-style wheat beer is a well-earned respite after long day on the trail or in the hammock.  Hazy and unfiltered, Rucksack’s wheat malt delivers a bready character that screams citrus fruit when combined with Mandarina Bavaria hops. Steeping this beer with orange peel post-fermentation only accentuates this fruitiness.  Pair Rucksack with roast pork, fried chicken and even lobster rolls.  Hit the trail with Rucksack and be ready for adventure.

Name: Monday Night Han Brolo
Description: Brewed with lactose sugar, this unfiltered pale has a chewy malt backbone with explosions of hops, resulting in a stratospheric experience.  A juicy, hazy pale ale. Unfiltered and flavorful, Han Brolo has a full-bodied, chewy mouthfeel. A huge dry hop gives this beer notes of tangerine and grapefruit. A lactose addition during brewing adds silkiness. At only 4.7% ABV, it’s a beer you can keep coming back to without sacrificing flavor.

Name: Monday Night Slap Fight IPA
Description: Slap Fight will woo you in with a West Coast-style malt bill, but slaps you across the face with its tropical hop profile. Light in body, heavy in character, this IPA features Munich and Crystal pale malts for a clean, rich mouthfeel. Comet, Equinox and Mosaic hops lend a pungent herbal aroma, peppered with hints of papaya, orange and grapefruit. Present this beer to a friend. If he does not drink it immediately, slap him as hard as you can. Repeat.

Name: Monday Night Don’t Call It Hotlanta
Description:
What’s the fastest way to make an Atlanta native cringe?

Say “Hotlanta.”

Take your senses on a trip ITP when you sip on this quadruple-dry-hopped IPA. With the unpredictability of Atlanta’s spring weather, this cloudy double IPA pops with sunny tropical notes on the nose. It drinks dank and finishes with a bit of bitterness, much like an Atlanta sports fan. Don’t Call It Hotlanta checks in at a bridge-collapsing 8.5% ABV, so enjoy it after your hour-long evening commute.

Name: Tommyknocker Blood Orange IPA
Description: India Pale Ale with natural blood orange flavor.

Name: Tommyknocker Small Patch Pumpkin Harvest Ale
Description: A hearty brown ale brewed to celebrate the fall harvest season. Brewed with a hint of spice and a touch of molasses, Small Patch has a malty backbone rounded out by an addition of real pumpkin to the mash and brew kettle.

Name: Tommyknocker Drift Blonde Ale
Description: Easy drinking, light, and refreshing.

Name: Tommyknocker Cocoa Porter
Description: ALE BREWED WITH COCOA AND HONEY MALT

Name: Tommyknocker Tundrabeary Ale
Description: A slightly tart, refreshing pale ale made with raspberries, blueberries and other natural fruits. Just as the cinnamon black bear on our label craves the flavor of mountain tundra berries, you'll find our Tundrabeary Ale to be irresistibly delicious.

Name: Tommyknocker Blood Orange Haze
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This is a New England Style IPA with Blood Orange

Name: TUPPS National Standard Blonde
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Chicken, Dessert - Fruit, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Lamb, Mushrooms, Nuts, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables
Description: Crisp and crushable. Hasn’t that always been our collective standard? Built for the lake, the pool, the game, the patio, the party, the... you get the idea. It’s what we do best!

Name: TUPPS National Standard Blonde Ale
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Fruit - Sweet, Lamb, Mushrooms, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: Crisp and crushable Blonde Ale. Hasn’t that always been our collective standard? Built for the lake, the pool, the game, the patio, the party, the... you get the idea, it's what we do best!

Name: TUPPS Juice Pack Double Dry Hopped Pale Ale
Food Pairing: Chicken, Dessert - Fruit, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Pasta, Pork, Salads  Greens, Turkey
Description: This massively aromatic double dry hopped pale ale is bursting with tropical and stone fruit aroma while drinking crisp and incredibly refreshing. Tons of flavor and super crushable.

Name: TUPPS Full Grown Scallywag
Tasting Notes: Chocolate, Creamy, Mocha, Rich, Roasted, Silky, Smooth, Vanilla
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Nuts
Description:
Scal-ly-wag (noun) - a person who behaves badly but in an amusingly
mischievous rather than harmful way; a rascal. Batten down the hatches, matey. This Imperial Stout is full of coconut and vanilla flavors that keeps you wanting more.

Name: TUPPS Full Grown Man Imperial Stout
Tasting Notes: Chocolate, Coffee, Malty, Mocha, Rich, Roasted, Silky, Thick, Velvety
Food Pairing: Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Fruit - Dried, Nuts
Description:
This robust stout is brewed with molasses and aged on cocoa
nibs for a bunch of aroma and full imperial stout flavor.

Name: TUPPS DDH (Monthly rotating series)
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Apricot, Floral, Fruity, Grapefruit, Hoppy, Intense, Silky, Stone Fruit, Tropical Fruit

Description: This incredibly smooth and juicy New England style IPA is brewed with an ever rotating selection of hops making it super balanced with very little lingering bitterness. This series will change every month and the series will need to be specified on the order.

Name: TUPPS DDH VARIANT IPA (Monthly rotating series)
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Floral, Fresh, Fruity, Smooth, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Cured Meats, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Fruit - Sweet, Lamb, Mushrooms, Nuts, Pasta
Description: This is the twin brother to our rotating monthly series of Hazy IPA's. We take the base beer used in the DDH series and add adjunct ingredients to kick it up a notch. Some examples are Key Lime Pie, Chili Mango and Orange Creamsicle. Specify which series when ordering!

Name: Great South Bay Brewery Seasonal
Description: We offer 3 different seasonals throughout the year: Mango Starfish Summer Ale, Splashing Pumpkin Pumpkin Ale and Winter Blows Winter Ale.

Name: Great South Bay Blonde Ambition Ale
Description: Once a summer seasonal, our most popular brew has now become out more popular beer. Being brewed year around this light blonde ale is nothing but simple. Fruity, yet subtle this brew is exactly what youll be looking for if you want something easy to drink, yet full flavored.

Name: Great South Bay Blood Orange
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A well balanced Blood Orange Pale Ale. A traditional pale ale in nature brewed with Blood Orange puree. This brew is one of our longest running beers at GSB. Coming in at 5.2% ABV, this beer starts off with the notes of a pale ale, while finishing nice and smooth, from the blood orange.

Name: Great South Bay Brewery Blood Orange Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: One of flagship beers brewed here at GSB. A traditional Pale Ale brewed with Blood Orange natural flavors to make it smooth and well rounded. Coming in at 5.2% ABV, this beer will have you wanting more.

Name: Great South Bay Massive IPA
Description: This true American IPA, is brewed with Citra and Mosaic hops. Coming in at 7% ABV, Massive was named for when it was first produced being a big, over the top IPA. Now, we have fine tuned the recipe to make it closer to a east coast style.

Name: Great South Bay Brewery Therapy Session IPA
Description: Low abv (4.5%), but full of flavor. Anyone looking for a crushable, full bodied IPA, this is your new go-to!

Name: Great South Bay Tipsy Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Great South Bay Tipsy Tea is a hard, alcoholic tea.

Name: Lupulin Blissful Ignorance Double IPA
Description: This Double IPA is loaded with waves of some of the juiciest hops available. Citra, Mosaic, Columbus blend together to make this hop juice. Intentionally left hazy to create a soft mouthfeel and enhance the flavor of this wonderfully hoppy beer.

Name: Lupulin Brewing Hooey
Description: A super hoppy, hazy concoction of the juiciest hops available. Hazy IPA? That’s a bunch of Hooey!

Name: Lupulin Apricot Blonde
Description: A fun and refreshing blonde ale infused with apricot. Summer in a can

Name: Lupulin Sexy Hops IPA
Description: Sexy Hops is a series of one-off IPAs brewed with the sexiest hops available today. Each beer will be a different and unique showcase of some of today's hottest hops.   Sexy Hops #1 - We dropped loads of New Zealand Kohatu and Australian Vic Secret dry hops into a base of the finest Maris Otter malt. Bright waves of passion fruit, pineapple, tropical fruit and lime abound in this sexy brew.

Name: Lupulin/Barrel Theory Operation CoHoperation
Description: Collaboration with Barrel Theory - A most mind blowing mash up of malt, hops, and hop hash. Two worlds colliding with a force so great that the resulting element is greater than the sum of its parts. From that collision poured this golden liquid hop juice. Enjoy!

Name: Lupulin Straight Hash Homie Double IPA
Description: Straight Hash Homie is made using only pure, 100% Lupulin powder. In the boil, while whirlpooling, and dry hopping(or Hash Hopping), not a pellet or cone saw the beer. Bursting with flavors of fresh tropical fruit, with a soft bitterness.  Don’t get left holding the bag! This beer is a limited edition beer!

Name: Pollyanna Acclamation Belgian Style Golden Ale
Pollyanna Eleanor Porter
Description: Robust Porter with chocolate, coffee, and dark fruit notes

Name: Pollyanna Summerly Raspberry Wheat Ale
Description: Summerly Raspberry Wheat Ale - Brewed with real raspberry, this brew is dry, slightly tart, and refreshing.

Name: Pollyanna Four Chord Wonder Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: American Pale Ale with a simple balanced hop characteristic

Name: Pollyanna Mazzie American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Pollyanna Fun Size
Description: You’re not you when you’re thirsty, so satisfy that craving with a fun sized treat. This Milk Stout is like having Halloween on Christmas, so don’t be ashamed to drink your dessert before dinner. Whatever your candy fancy may be, enjoy this ‘lil delight. Brewed with a hefty amount of lactose milk sugar and sticky oats, we threw in a whole bunch of peanuts, vanilla beans, cocoa nibs, and sea salt because, well, size truly does matter sometimes.

Name: Pollyanna Pils
Description: Bohemian style Pilsner - A blend of German Hallertau and Czech Saaz hops, this crisp and clean pils shows off a soft, delicate malt backing as well as a classic, somewhat fruity, spicy, and floral hop backing.

Name: Azadi Brewing: Kavi
Description: Cardamom Golden Ale // Inspired by the poetic landscapes of Kashmir, this crisp golden ale offers delightful notes of cardamom, lemon, pepper and a little pine. Refreshing and easy drinking.

Name: Dutchbag Brew Co: Somewhat Informal
Description: Sour Saison // Fermented on a blend of Franco-Belgian farmhouse yeast,  a light, approachable sour saison. Lightly tannic, sour, and extremely drinkable.

Name: Histrionic Brewlab: Forest Trek
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazy IPA // A beautiful bouquet of mandarin, pear, and juicy fruit blend effortlessly with a touch of pine in this bold, flavorful hazy IPA.

Name: Azadi Brewing: Gir
Description: Kesar Mango IPA // Brewed using Gir Kesar Mango grown in western India, this juicy, yet bitter IPA features a bright orange pulp hue and is balanced with Mosaic, Citra and Azacca hops to create welcomed characteristics for IPA and mango lovers alike.

Name: Brewer’s Kitchen: Mañana de Mallorca
Description: Spanish Tea IPA // Made from a Spanish sangria tea featuring four different types of dried Spanish melon, Seville orange, hibiscus, and el dorado hops.

Name: Brewer’s Kitchen: Green Mountains Only
Description: DDH Hazy Double IPA // Tangerine, melon, and stone fruit in this big brew featuring citra, simcoe, amarillo & centennial. And no, the mountains are not blue.

Name: Brewer’s Kitchen: Tolo Tolo
Description: Mexican Lager // Hopped with tettnanger, motueka, and a little citra, this Mexican lager has a crispy tortilla vibe with a hint of lime pith. Smooth and mellow.

Name: Surf Brewing Mondo’s Blonde Ale
Description: Named after a local beginning surf beach just North of Ventura. Brewed in the style of an American Cream Ale, Mondo's is a refreshing lighter bodied ale, with a mild bready malt character and just a hint of corn to add a crisp finish and accent the subtle hop bitterness. Pairs well with salad or grilled chicken. Silver Medal winner at the 2012 LA County Fair Commercial Beer Competition.

Name: Surf Brewery Scientific Series B-03: Robust Porter Aged In Merlot Barrels
County Line Rye Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Named after a surf spot bordering Ventura County & LA County. Brewed as an American Pale Ale with a twist, a healthy dose of rye adds a subtle spiciness and frothy white head while generous amounts of pleasantly spicy and floral American hops compliment the gentle rye character. Pairs well with a sloppy burger at the beach! Gold medal winner in 2012, Silver medal in 2013 and Bronze in 2015, at the LA International Commercial Beer Competition.

Name: Surf Black IPA
Description: Our Cascadian Dark Ale features vibrant citrusy and floral American hops balanced against a complex malt profile of toasty dark malts with a hint of roasted barley. Just like an early morning surf session, once you start you keep going back.

Name: Surf Shaka Citra Session IPA
Description: Danky hop aroma slaps you in the face as soon as you pick this up! Stays clean and crisp throughout and finishes smooth. Could drink this all day.

Name: Surf Brewry Belgian White IPA
Description: Just in time for the Holiday Season, we are excited to change things up with a Belgian style white IPA. Focused on delivering complexity with a blend of Belgian Yeast strains and traditional West Coast hopping. This will be the closest thing we Californians get to a white winter.

Name: Surf Brewing Ariel IPA
Description: Aerial IPA is a hop-forward American style India Pale Ale, named after an aggressive surfing maneuver. Starting off with a strong aroma of dank resins and citrus from generous dry-hopping, Aerial boasts similar flavors on the palette balanced against a restrained bready malt backbone, finishing with a lingering hoppiness that isn’t overly bitter. The light body keeps the beer refreshing and allows the hops to shine through without too much malt sweetness to negate the power of the aggressive hopping. Enjoy with crispy fish tacos with a simple cilantro and tomato salsa

Name: St Ambroise Blonde Pale Ale
Description: St-Ambroise Pale Ale is the McAuslan Brewery flagship beer. Introduced in February 1989, it is a hoppy, amber,full-flavoured ale. Its’ floral hop aromas are balanced by a well-structured combination of various specialty malts in the body. The long finish is appetizing and tangy with orangey-citric notes. Accompanies most poultry, and seafood.

Name: St. Ambroise Apricot Wheat Ale
Description: Natural apricot flavour is married to barley and wheat malts to give St-Ambroise Apricot Wheat Ale its uniquely delicious, subtly sweet taste. A natural, delightfully refreshing choice for adventurous palates that appreciate a light ale with a playful twist.

Name: St-Ambroise Oatmeal Stout 1/2 Barrel
