Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: OUR YEAR ROUND PALE ALE LOADED WITH SIMCOE, MOSAIC AND CTZ

Name: Faction Spring IPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Faction Penske File
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Pale Ale hopped with Mosaic and Equinox

Name: Faction Anomaly Milk Stout
Description: Pale in Color but meant to smell and taste like a stout. Made with TCHO Cacao nibs, Cafe Santana coffee, star anise & lactose sugar.

Name: Faction Brewing IPA
Description: Our seasonal IPA hopped with Mosaic and Ekuanot

Name: Faction Pilsner
Description: A traditional Czech-style pilsner with castle pilsner malt and saaz hops.

Name: Stoudts American Pale Ale
Description: American Pale Ale, "the original hoppy session ale," with a crisp, medium body and light amber color. Generous additions of Warrior and Cascade hops provide a refreshing bitterness and vibrant citrus aroma.

Name: Stoudts Fat Dog Stout
Description: A unique ale merging the smooth and complex richness of an Oatmeal Stout with the assertive hoppiness of and Imperial Stout. Silky black in color with a prominent roasted malt character with a chocolate and coffee-like finish.

Name: Stoudt’s Fat Dog
Description: This unique ale merges the smooth and complex richness of an Oatmeal Stout with the assertive hoppiness of Imperial Stout. Fat Dog has an inviting silky-black color, a prominent roasted malt character, and a chocolatey, coffee-like finish.

Name: Stoudts Double IPA
Description: A Strong and full-bodied ale with intense hop characteristics and a deep golden color.

Name: Stoudts Fourplay IPA
Description: Our Fourplay IPA started as a four part single hop series and featured the same malt recipe in each providing a full bodied malt backbone to compliment the abundance of a hop flavor. This new year-round version uses the same base recipe, but two hop varieties instead of one resulting in a citrusy, hoppy & resinous IPA accented with orange, coconut & chocolate notes in the finish.

Name: Stoudts Pils
Description: Pils is reflective of a traditional German-style Pilsener. It is delicately dry with a firm bitterness.Brilliant straw color with medium body, and noble hop aroma. A terrific thirst quencher. An Excellent aperitif.

Name: Big Wood Jack Savage American Pale Ale
Description: Chances are good you know someone just like Jack  Savage. He’s the kind of guy that always has a plow on his  truck with a cooler in the back. If you want to hear a good fish story, or need somebody to run the barbecue, you bet he's your man. Brewed with all American hops, Jack  Savage is a good time—gone great.

Name: Big Wood Morning Wood Stout
Description: 2014 City Pages Best Local Beer Winner and 2011 & 2012  ABR Winner for Best Beer! The blast of coffee flavor in  this beer will send you right back to this morning when  you woke up, stretched, and thought “Hey, this is gonna  be a great day!” Morning Wood is brewed with Fuggle and  Cascade hops and adds hints of oatmeal and chocolate to make every coffee?lover’s secret beer dreams come true. Morning Wood uses only fresh roasted Dunn Brothers Coffee Beans.

Name: Big Wood Bad Axe IPA
Description: 2013 Rochester Craft Beer Expo winner for Best Beer! This  one might take a few trees down without trying. It's the  one all the lady axes think they can change. He might be  a tough guy in the flannel shirt who tears off bottle caps  with his teeth, but don't worry he's easy to get along  with. Brewed with a mix of Columbus and Centennial hops,  it pours pale amber and goes down surprisingly easy.  Well, maybe not so surprising, considering it's from Big  Wood Brewery.

Name: Big Wood Wicked Ex IPA
Description: meet her, it's all girl‐next‐door sweetness. Then things take a turn for the vengeful. The spiteful. The bitter. In the Big Woods, she's known as the Wicked Ex. She's an IPA,Big Wood style: super loaded with hops and shot through with bitterness. Starts sweet, gets bitter,  and just won't quit. But that's part of the deal with a  Wicked Ex, isn't it?

Name: Big Wood Bark Bite IPA
Description: Check out the chompers on this one. He doesn't quit. Long  after your day is done, Bark Bite is still working hard,  bringing the bite. Because where Bark Bite's from, you  don't stop until the last drop. And then you kick back,  relax, and say things like "See this lake? It was a  babbling brook before I got here." Brewed with citrus  hops, it's front loaded for a big refreshing bite.

Name: Big Wood Fine! IPA
Description: A hop lover’s dream IPA! Brewed with Mosiac, Simcoe and Azacca hops this beer has tropical and pear aromas with distinct citrus and mango flavors. A touch of sweetness. A touch of maltiness. Hopped to the hilt.

Name: Big Wood Amigo Grande Mexican Lager
Description: Inspired by "that one time in Mexico," Amigo Grande embodies a certain south‐of‐the‐border style. A bit bigger and a bit friendlier than most, this refreshing Mexican Style Lager is the hidden beach of Big Wood Brewery. It’s also the only wingman you'll need in the summer sun when the living is easy and the lakes are  calling.

Name: Russian River Pliny The Elder
Description: Pliny the Elder is brewed with Amarillo, Centennial, CTZ, and Simcoe hops. It is well-balanced with malt, hops, and alcohol, slightly bitter with a fresh hop aroma of floral, citrus, and pine. Best enjoyed FRESH! That is why we make it in such limited supply. Actual bottling date is printed on each bottle!

Name: Russian River Blind Pig IPA
Description: Full-bodied, very hoppy, with citrus, pine, fruity notes and a nice dry, bitter finish!

Name: Russian River Mind Circus Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Mind Circus IPA has a mild bitterness and a thick, luscious mouthfeel. This style of IPA is what is being called in the beer world a “Hazy IPA” Dominantly herbaceous and grassy, with moderate tropical notes as well as some bright citrus. This unique hazy IPA gains its flavor of grapes and grass from the Nelson hops, and its tropical notes of pineapple and mango from the Strata hops. It is unfiltered leaving a “haze” and some yeast for more texture. Oats were also used to add to the softer mouthfeel and hazy appearance.

Name: Russian River Great Beer/Great Wine Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: There is an old familiar saying in the wine business: “It takes a lot of great beer to make great wine!” Winemakers, cellar workers, and grape pickers alike rarely (if ever) reach for a nice big glass of red wine in the middle of harvest. Wine is quite delicious, but not very refreshing on a hot summer day. The beverage of choice during harvest is BEER! Ice-cold, refreshing, and thirst-quenching BEER! The beer in this bottle is a toast to our winemaking friends who work around the clock during harvest to make world-class wine right here in our own back yard! Cheers!

Name: Russian River Brewing Company Sts Pilsner
Description: STS Pils is a classic European style Pilsner. It is straw in color and often times will have a slight haze due to the fact that it is unfiltered. STS Pils is a hop forward pilsner with a mild malt foundation, strong lager yeast characteristic, and a dry, bitter finish.

Name: Russian River Intinction Sauvignon Blanc Barrel Aged Pilsner
Description: Although we have made this beer once before, it was only available on our guided tour and for special events.  The base beer is a Pilsner aged in Sauvignon Blanc barrels with the addition of Sauvignon Blanc grape juice from the 2018 harvest for a secondary fermentation.  The juice and barrels are from Dutton Vineyards in the Russian River wine appellation here in Sonoma County.  There is no lactobacillus or pediococcus added to the beer, only brettanomyces.  The tart acidity comes from the wine grapes.  This beer is delicate and beautifully balanced, a perfect refresher on a warm summer day!

Name: Russian River Velvet Glow Helles Lager
Description: Velvet Glow is an homage to an old Grace Brother’s Brewing beer brewed right here in Santa Rosa!  The Grace Brother’s brewery was around from 1933 to 1966, where they created many iconic beer brands including Velvet Glow and Happy Hops.  This Helles style lager is a clean, crisp, and refreshing beer with a bright straw color, aromas and flavors of bread crust and biscuit.  There is a very low bitterness with a mild hop aroma.

Name: Hoofhearted Are We Having Fun Yet
Hoof Hearted Rose Gose
Description: Just when you thought you had done slurped up all the neon. Rosé Gosé is hot pink in appearance with a tart berry flavor. Brewed with loads of hibiscus, Himalayan pink sea salt, and coriander.

Name: Hoof Hearted Brewing Belloq Stout
Description: Smooth caramel & chocolate notes get a massive coffee rogering. Competitively intellectual flavor that makes you feel smarter than you look. Pair with a corduroy blazer and look out world.

Name: Hoof Hearted Slo Turbo
Description: Double IPA brewed with New Zealand Hops - 8.5% ABV

Name: Hoof Hearted $60 Nachos
Description:
$60 Nachos? That’s what happens when you let dad outta the house!

Wanna drink some ice-cold beer? Wayyyyelll Imma letcha! Prime that cheddar-cheese pump w/ the gooiest Citra, Simcoe, & El Dorado. Does it smell? NO! It stank! Plus – it itches. *SNORT*

Name: Hoof Hearted Did We Just Become Best Friends IPA
Description: Rotating dual hop series IPA.

Name: Hoof Hearted Dorks Of Hazard IPA
Description: Brewed in collaboration Embassy Boardshop and #dudleyclips.

Name: Dundalk Calling
Description: A nice strong Imperial IPA full of nothing but Citra and Conan yeast. Dont let this one fool you, it is strong but balanced.

Name: Speed Wobbles
Description: Just the shimmy, not the shake. This is the first beer in a series of customized batches. The Bustin Boards crew and the Key brewers dropped in a gnarly combo of Amarillo, Mosaic, Simcoe, and Chinook to land this satisfying IPA that you can ride with all day

Name: Key Semi Charmed Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Key Brewing Bail Money
Description: This West Coast-style India pale ale is the second collaboration between the Dundalk brewery and Bustin Boards, the custom skateboards company based in Baltimore. The first, Speed Wobbles, was for summer, and Bail Money complements the fall season with its strong pine flavor and berry aroma notes, said Key co-founder Mike McDonald.

Name: Key Brewing Expeditiously IPA
Description: Enjoy this New England STyle IPA triple dry hopped with Simcoe, Citra, and Nelson Sauvin

Name: Key Brewing The Traditional Helles Lager
Description: A medium-bodied, golden-in-color lager with a clean malt flavor start and a slightly sweet and spicy hop finish.This beer is clean and crisp for an easy and refreshing year-round drink.

Name: Marz Arnie Palmer Meets The Dragon Lady
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Marz Jungle Boogie with Pineapple
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Marz Ruby’s Tears Gose
Description: The Gose style of beer originates from Leipzig, Germany but now we make it in Bridgeport. Ruby's Tears has a low hop bitterness and a complementary spice from the use of ground coriander seeds, with a slick salinity from the addition of lime sea salt.

Name: Marz Midway Chipa Double IPA
Description: Northeast Style DIPA with different hops in each batch.

Name: Brew Rebellion Blueberry Tart Sour Ale
Brew Rebellion Sour Batch Boys
Description: Mixed fruit sour Tart Ale with Lactose.

Name: Brew Rebellion Saturday Morning Cartoons Breakfast Cereal Milk Stout
Description: This sweet milk stout boasts flavours of dark chocolate, milk chocolate lactose milk sugar, caramel, biscuit bread, fruity pebbles cereal, oreo cookies and cream, oranges, grapes, bananas, clove spice, lemon candy, starburst candy, tangerine gummy bears, stone fruit peaches, apricots, apple pie hints, hazelnut nectar and coconut hints. Lots of fruity pebbles flavors, Reese’s peanut butter cup notes, dark chocolate, milk chocolate lactose milk sugar, oranges, grapes, blueberries, dark fruit prunes, raspberries, bananas, clove spice, dragon fruit, passion fruit, lemon candy, starburst candy, tangerine gummy bears, coffee, molasses, caramel, vanilla, sweetened condensed milk hints, stone fruit peaches, apples, pecan pie, hazelnut nectar, tobacco hints, coconut hints, rocky road ice cream, cookies and cream and sherbet ice cream. Finishing dry but with a variety of fruity pebbles cereal, citrus, sugary lactose, earthy notes, caramel, vanilla, sherbet ice cream and pecan pie hints. No alcohol in the taste, dark as night full body, creamy velvety and rich mouthfeel, super easy to drink

Name: Brew Rebellion John Paul Jones Chocolate Strawberry Stout
Description: Fresh strawberries brewed with an American chocolate stout. Tastes like a chocolate strawberry.

Name: Brew Rebellion Pineapple Honey
Description: With the fresh taste of real honey and tropical pineapple, this tangy and refreshing beer brings out the best of the summer months. Pairs well with chicken, sea food and vegetarian dishes.

Name: The Blendery Careful With That
Description: THE BLENDERY CAREFUL WITH THAT

Name: Beachwood Tovarish Imperial Espresso Stout
Description: Tovarish is a bold Russian imperial stout brewed with a base of British Maris Otter barley and heaping amounts of roasted barley and specialty malts. It’s finished with a touch of blackstrap molasses along with espresso brewed with the finest Arabian Mocha-Java coffee from our friends at Peet’s. Tovarish is remarkably rich and complex. Savor the layers of roast and dark fruits with every sip.

Name: System Of Stout Vanilla
Description: "System of a Stout" is an imperial stout infused with all the traditional ingredients of a savory cup of Armenian coffee: cardamom, molasses, coffee (of course), and brandy. In the kettle, the beer is lightly dosed with green cardamom for exotic spice notes. Molasses adds a richness that seamlessly blends in. The finished beer was then aged for several days masterfully roasted coffee from Portola Coffee Lab in Costa Mesa. The beer was then aged for several weeks on Armenian brandy-soaked oak chips for yet another dimension of flavors and aromas. Take your time and enjoy this endlessly complex and nuanced beer.

Name: Beachwood Brewing Thrillseeker IPA
Description: Thrillseeker is a "West Coast-style" India pale ale that is sure to push your senses to the edge. It starts with a base of American 2-row malt and a restrained dose of extra light caramel malt to let the hops punch though. It’s then generously hopped with Chinook, Summit, Centennial, and Simcoe for a massive citrus and tropical hop profile. Thrillseeker is dry hopped with Simcoe and Chinook for an über fresh resiny aroma.

Name: Beachwood Greenshift Double IPA
Description: Greenshift is a gargantuan double India pale ale with a wide spectrum of hops. Citra, Amarillo, El Dorado, Nelson Sauvin, Galaxy, and Warrior varieties in the kettle create a planetary array of flavors. An infinite wavelength of aromas come from a supernova-sized charge of Citra, Mosaic, and Nelson Sauvin.

Name: Barrelhouse Paso Petite
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: We co-fermenting our red Foeder Sour with local Petite Sirah grapes and aged it in oak barrels where it developed aromas of dried cherry, plum, and raisin. Its deep garnet color, rounded soft tannins, and firm acidity make this complex sour ale perfect for slow sipping and contemplation.

Name: Barrelhouse Big Sur Double IPA
Description: Big Sur, a masterpiece of colossal redwoods, treacherous cliffs, and dangerous surf breaks. With nearly 70 miles of rugged coastline and frigid sharky waters, adventure here isn’t for the faint of heart. Introducing BIG SUR Double IPA, brewed big to stand up to life’s most rewarding adventures.

Name: Barrelhouse Brewing Company Big Sur Double IPA
Description: Big Sur is one of the world’s most unforgettable coastlines. BIG SUR DOUBLE IPA, is one of the world’s most unforgettable IPAs. We brew this beer big to stand up to life’s most rewarding adventures. Cheers!

Name: Barrelhouse Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: BarrelHouse Juicy IPA is our take on the popular New England Style IPA. This IPA boasts a complex mouthfeel, low bitterness, and an extremely juicy aroma. To achieve maximum juiciness, we used English style yeast, a complex cooling process, and endless hop additions. Get juicy!

Name: Barrelhouse Night Ryder Black Rye IPA
Description: This Imperial Black Rye IPA breaks down and rebuilds the boundaries between dark malts and brilliant, complex, hoppy IPA aromas that were pioneered here on the West Coast. This beer imparts huge pine and spicy rye complexity with a subtle malt sweetness. Forager Series… Venture off the beaten path. Cheers!

Name: Black Hog Coffee Milk Stout
Description: Based on a sweet stout recipe and enriched with cold Toddy-extracted Organic Colombian Supremo and Espresso Roasted coffee. Exclusively poured on Nitrogen gas lines for a silky texture with a pillowy white head. The result is a rich, creamy stout with hearty roasted coffee flavor and a quick finish. When three fourths of a glass of our coffee milk stout sits, cascading, waiting for the last two inches of black velvet sexy loveliness to top it off, creating the bright white fluffy head….all you can do is take a deep breath and concentrate on patience, knowing that from the first clean robust sip to the last drop, Black Hog Brewing Co. coffee milk stout always hits the mark.

Name: Black Hog French Vanilla Coffee Milk Stout
Black Hog Pumpkin Spice Latte Coffee Milk Stout
Black Hog Hazy
Description: This new hazy ale features Citra hops!

Name: Black Hog Easy Rye’ Da IPA
Description: An easy drinkin’ low abv rye india pale ale jack nicholson, peter fonda and dennis hopper made a movie about a man that went looking for america and couldn’t find it anywhere. our rye ipa gets your motor runnin’, but won’t burn you out. we chopped down the abv on our session style rye so you can cruise on it all day long. take it easy, have a few and remember it’s all about freedom man. lean back and take a long slow sip paired up with an aged grassy cheddar from carr valley creamery in wisconsin, home of the harley davidson. ride responsibly! a percent of proceeds from the sale of our easy rye’da ipa go to the national motorcycle safety foundation. ABV: 4.7%

Name: Black Hog Ginja’ Ninja
Description: GINGA NINJA red india pale ale brewed w. fresh ginger Once upon a time there was a young brew master who fell in love with a ginger haired maiden. he loved her fiery locks, quick wit and samurai sharp personality. he proposed marriage and crafted a beer for her, an original red ale brewed with refreshing fresh ginger and a touch of hoppiness that typified her personality. when she took her first sip at their wedding she knew she had made the right choice. try tyler’s ginga ninja red ipa brewed with 6 lbs of fresh ginger in every batch and hopped with centennial, cascade & bravo hops. if not at your wedding then on a hot afternoon as you wait on your pig to finish roasting, or while chompin on a crisp apple and a creamy wheel of camembert. ABV: 6.5%

Name: Black Hog Homegrown And Hazy
Description: This NEIPA is made with CT grown hops and malts. It’s Homegrown and It’s Hazy. ENJOY!

Name: Two Pitchers Bayou
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Chocolate, Coffee, Creamy, Herbal, Malty, Rich, Roasted, Round, Silky, Smooth, Toasty, Velvety
Description: In an ode to the Bayou, this smooth, creamy milk stout is blended with New Orleans style coffee - cold brew, chicory, and a touch of maple. Laissez les bons temps rouler!

Name: Two Pitchers Tropic Plunder IPA
Tasting Notes: Bright, Crisp, Fresh, Fruity, Hoppy, Passionfruit, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description: This tasty IPA is loaded with mosaic and citra hops and blended with a touch of passion fruit and lychee post-fermentation. Juicy IPA, IPA shandy...call it what you want - we call it delicious and seriously crushable.  Mosaic and citra hops provide a juicy profile that strikes the perfect balance with subtle additions of tropical fruit. A soft mouthfeel and a clean, rounded finish that avoids piney bitterness make Tropic Plunder the epitome of an easy drinking, sessionable IPA.

Name: Two Pitchers Radler
Tasting Notes: Bright, Citrus, Crisp, Fresh, Fruity, Grapefruit, Light
Description: Rated 94 points and top-30 fruit beers in the nation by Beer Connoisseur, this crisp blend of lager with fresh grapefruit and blood orange is simply the best Radler in the world. Refreshing, easy-to-drink, and absolutely delicious, Radler is perfect for any occasion. Prost!

Name: Two Pitchers Nordic Jam
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Berry, Bright, Cherry, Crisp, Fresh, Fruity, Jammy, Light, Red Fruit, Smooth
Description: We've packed this lager with cherries, elderberries, and strawberries - all staples of a Viking warrior's diet - to create a downright delicious party in a can. Jam on, friends.

Name: Two Pitchers Disco Queen
Tasting Notes: Apple, Balanced, Bright, Crisp, Dry, Floral, Fresh, Fruity, Light, Pear
Description: This delicious bubbly blend of lager and rose-inspired fruits might be the grooviest thing we've ever brewed. Strap on your skates, and boogie down - her royal highness is ready to party.

Name: Two Pitchers Pop Top
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Citrus, Crisp, Fresh, Fruity, Light, Red Fruit, Round, Smooth, Tart
Description: This crisp wheat ale blended with pomegranate lemonade will have you hightailing it to the great outdoors to pop your top and soak up some suds n' sunshine.

Name: Two Pitchers Snake Bite
Tasting Notes: Apple, Balanced, Fresh, Fruity, Green Apple, Light, Smooth, Tart
Description: Crisp apple up front, a splash of tart cranberry, and a subtle malt backbone - Snake Bite is refreshing, balanced, and not too sweet. Cheers!

Name: Opa-Opa Milk Stout
Description: This creamy, impenetrable, full bodied ale gets some of its buried sweetness from the use of lactose (milk sugar). The chocolate and black malts creates its deep color and its balanced roasted coffee flavors.

Name: Opa-Opa Double IPA
Description: A bold yet balanced imperial IPA, 9.2% ABV. Intense grapefruit flavors throughout brewed with Cascade, Columbus and Simcoe hops.

Name: Opa-Opa A-10 Warthog
Description: A strong, very aggressively hopped India Pale Ale, with a full aroma and increased bitterness, lending plenty of malt giving it its body.

Name: Opa-Opa Watermelon
Description: A light bodied ale, with low bitterness and a smooth watermelon flavor! A great summer beer!

Name: Opa-Opa Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: A nice no-nonsense Pumpkin Ale….aroma is a nice mellow mix   of pumpkin, sweetness and spices, crisp quenching taste!

Name: Other Half Green City
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazy East Coast IPA with loads of oats and hopped with Simcoe, Citra, and Centennial. Fruity, juicy, with a delicious creamy body and slight bitter finish. Brewed in Rochester.

Name: Other Half DDH Double Mosaic Dream
Description: Double Dry Hopped Double Mosaic Dream is our standard Double Mosaic dry hopped a second time with a mosaic lupulin powder. Lupulin powder is a new hop product that is similar to our standard hops but with all the extra plant filler stripped away. It’s pure hops and it’s awesome.

Name: Other Half Triple Idaho 7 Daydream
Description: The same base as Triple Citra but with one of our new favorite hops, Idaho 7, which is super pineapple forward.

We brewed a beer with a similar grain bill for @sharedbrewing while we were there and dreamed up this Other Half version with Citra, Galaxy, Cashmere, Nelson Sauvin and Mosaic. Name: Artifex Brewing Feeling Colors Double IPA
Description: Feeling them Colors. This Version is for the July 4th. Hopped with Cashmere, Vic Secret, Citra

Name: Artifex Trigger Finger
Description: West Coast Style IPA dry-hopped with cascade and mosaic. This beer is named after one of our partners, who actually has a trigger finger! Not related to firearms...

Name: Artifex Moog Trippin DIPA
Description: Crisp and refreshing. Dry hopped with Mosaic, Amarillo, and The Bruce.

Name: Artifex Yippee Ki Yay
Description: 5th Annual Brew Ho Ho Collaboration was brewed at Artifex Brewing Company with Chapman Crafted Beer. This years version is an Imperial Red IPA brewed with Red X malt and rye malt. We generously hopped it with Simcoe and Chinook giving it a piney and grassy aroma.

Name: Artifex No Name IPA
Description: Dry hopped with Simcoe, Centennial, and Mosaic.

Name: Artifex Ian Is The New Black
Description: Crisp, clean, and classic. Hopped with Simcoe, Amarillo, and Mosaic.

Name: 450 North Dank Candy Sticky Lollipop Dream IPA
Description: Enter the hidden realm of the humulus lupulus. 450 North ushers in the age of dank candy. A yeah round DIPA series contains potent amounts of juicy resinous hops. Each can in the series packs a different hop blend. Creating a rainbow of flavors to taste and explore

Name: 450 North Citrafest IPA
Description: This Session IPA is bursting with citrus and hop notes from the moment you take your first sniff. Brewed with mostly Citra hops and a touch of El Dorado and Amarillo, Citrafest has a great balance of hop flavor and little malt presence. This beer is deliciously drinkable so don’t be surprised at how quickly your beer disappears. 5.0%ABV, 45 IBU, 5 SRM

Name: 450 North Star Burst IPA
Description: Star Burst is hopped with Citra, Simcoe, and Mosaic at a rate of 3.25# per barrel

Name: 450 North Blizzard Of Haze IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Blizzard of Haze is hopped with Citra, Simcoe and Mandarina Bavaria hops. The hazeman cometh.

Name: 450 North 450 Nugs DDH IPA
Description: 450 Nugs is brewed with a 50/50 blend of Citra and Mosaic.

Name: 450 North Seasonal
Description: Varies by Season!

Name: Los Angeles Ale Works Digimax
Description: Time for a digital rewind into an electric juicy fruit bomb. Notes of orange blossom, guava, pineapple and marmalade will have you taking it to the max.

Name: Los Angeles Ale Works Hops Of Hope
Description: Double dry hopped with a proprietary blend of the finest hops, this beer supports the ALS Therapy Development Institute in helping find a cure for ALS

Name: Los Angeles Ale Works Not A Pineapple Beer
Description: Fruit up front, coconut on the back, and an extremely dry finish make this beer very drinkable, but be careful… it’s still a double IPA.

Name: Los Angeles Ale Works Lunar Kitten IPA
Description: The first in our Kitten trilogy, Lunar Kitten is single-hopped with Simcoe, and dry-hopped to enhance aroma. Pilsner, Maris Otter, and rye malts provide a solid base for pronounced fruity and piney Simcoe hop expression. Perfectly crushable with just the right amount of cat-titude.

Name: Los Angeles Ale Works La Phil 100 Brut IPA
Description: Los Angeles Ale Works celebrates the LA Phil 100 with a Brut IPA that spotlights dynamic aromas of Los Angeles. Aptly named Centennial hops provide bright notes of lemon peel and mountain pine, while New Zealand Wakatu hops counterpoint with lime and honey fragrances. Inspired by the pastoral groves that blanketed our landscape during the LA Phil’s founding, we packed this beer with juicy orange zest. Adding Jasmine rice to our Pilsner malt bill dries out the beer and delivers a light grain-scented finale. Take a beat and enjoy this bubbly straw-hued brew in a Champagne coupe or sip it straight from its 21st century can.

Name: Los Angeles Ale Works Meseeks Joose Joosey IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Look at me! MeSeeks Joose is full of can-do hops and squared shoulders. Every batch is unique and designed with a singular purpose: to complete the task at hand. Thirst! Ooooo yeah! For maximum joose, store cans upside down.

Name: Los Angeles Ale Works Pacific Playground
Description: Sip on the West Coast’s signature beer style with this dry-hopped West Coast IPA. Azacca, Ella, and Bru-1 lend notes of citrus and earthy stone fruit to this easy-to-drink style.

Name: Rhinelander Thumper IPA
Description: Pours a pale golden color with a one finger head and moderate retention and lacing. The decidedly hoppy aroma comes through with a touch of grass and citrus. The taste is very much what the aroma suggests. A full malt flavor enhanced with grass and citrus comes through nicely. It is easy drinking, light in body with a great hoppy bite with a slight astringency for a full smooth finish. Available year round.

Name: Floyd’s Spiked Lemonade
Description: For Floyd’s Spiked Lemonade to be a classic, we start with fresh squeezed lemons & pure cane sugar blended with our sugar brew, creating the perfect spiked lemonade…clean & crisp.

Name: Floyd’s Spiked Half & Half
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Whether you zig or zag, we’ve got you covered. Floyd’s spiked half & half is the perfect balance of brewed black tea, fresh squeezed lemons and pure cane sugar, blended with our sugar brew to create the perfect spiked half & half….clean & crisp.

Name: Floyd’s Spiked Iced Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives

The First Hard Seltzer Flavored with Real Fruit Juice

Crafted in California's wine country, Ficks Hard Seltzer is flavored with pure, not-from-concentrate fruit juice for authentic flavor - with zero added sugar. At just 100 calories and between 1-3g of carbs, each can of Ficks tastes like real fruit because...well, it is.

Variety Pack contains 3 cans each of Ficks Grapefruit, Blackberry, Lime, and Cranberry Hard Seltzer.

Name: Ficks Grapefruit Hard Seltzer
Tasting Notes: Bright, Citrus, Crisp, Flavored, Floral, Fresh, Fruity, Grapefruit, Light, Sweet, Tart
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Dessert - Fruit, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fruit - Citrus, Nuts, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: The simple combination of pure grapefruit juice, sparkling water and alcohol fermented from California oranges. Ficks Grapefruit Hard Seltzer is as refreshing as it is bittersweet. Pink grapefruit juice floats among light bubbles for an authentic taste in every sip, making Ficks the preeminent pamplemousse.

Name: Ficks Blackberry Hard Seltzer
Tasting Notes: Berry, Bold, Dark Fruit, Flavored, Fresh, Fruity, Light, Rich, Smooth, Sweet

Name: Ficks Premium Moscow Mule Mix
Description:
Fiery ginger juice, a hint of lime - all that's needed is a proper copper mug.

With half the calories and carbs of a typical Moscow Mule, Ficks lets you mix a quality craft cocktail while maintaining your active lifestyle.

The simple combination of pure lime juice, sparkling water and alcohol fermented from California oranges. Its immersive citrus flavor is emphasized with light bubbles for a refreshing standalone beverage, or (pro tip) next level sparkling margarita mixer.

Real cranberry juice floats up among a bevy of bubbles like cranberries in a bog to deliver authentic taste in every sip.

Name: Ficks Mango Hard Seltzer
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bold, Bright, Creamy, Flavored, Fresh, Fruity, Guava, Leather, Light, Rich, Silky, Smooth, Sweet, Tropical, Tropical Fruit

Name: Rockyard Tusky Amber Ale
Description: We’re bringing this classic style American Amber back from the Ice Ages, bigger and better than ever!

Name: Rockyard Dino-Mite Dry Hopped Sour Ale
Rockyard The Gondolier Cherry Kriek
Description: The Gondolier is a bright, crisp, easy-drinking sour which finishes slightly sweet and pours with an alluring pinkish hue. The base was brewed with a mix of European pilsner and wheat malts with a touch of rolled oats and raw wheat. After primary fermentation with a saison yeast, it was transferred into cabernet wine barrels and topped off with nearly a pound of cherries per gallon of beer in each barrel.

Name: Rockyard Primadonna German Pilsner
Description: This German style pilsner is brewed with 100% German Malted Pilsner and 100% German grown hops.  Clean, crisp, dry, old school.

Name: Hub Wave Train Vienna Lager
Description: We reinvented the Amber Ale with this beer. Inspired by Vienna-Style Lagers, this ale has balanced earthy and toasty flavors with a delicate crispness.

Name: Hopworks Survival Stout
Description: Pours black with a fluffy tan head. A nice malty & smoky aroma of roasted coffee, chocolate & caramel. Taste begins with roasted espresso followed by bitter chocolate, sweet caramel & toasted grains with some bitterness on the finish.

Name: Hopworks Urban Brewing Rotating IPA Series
Description: An IPA focused on blending medium malt body and hops with the slightly tart, bright flavor of prickly pear fruit of the Nopal cactus.

Name: Hopworks Gear Up IPA
Description: Gear Up is a Northwest-Style IPA with a dry and tropical-hop profile. The recipe was made to provide a direct line to complex hop aromas and flavors of ripe passionfruit, pineapple, and mango. The beer is also HUB’s first foray into the world of 12 oz. six-pack can.

Name: Hopworks Urban Brewery Ferocious Citrus IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazy IPA with organic, citrus-forward hops, grapefruit juice and San Juan Island estate wheat.

Name: Big Storm Brewing Co. Wavemaker Amber Ale
Description: Wavemaker Amber Ale is perfectly balanced with caramel malt flavors, subtle floral presence and pleasant hop bitterness.

Name: Big Storm Brewing Co. Tropic Pressure Golden Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: A highly drinkable, Florida Ale steeped with hibiscus flowers for just the right amount of natural sweetness. Tropic Pressure pours the color of skin that has been kissed by the sun. Nose smells of perfume and a village lost in paradise: blossoming flowers, honey/honeysuckle, and freshly baked island bread cooling on the windowsill. Close your eyes, and you can almost feel the breeze hear the ocean.

Name: Big Storm Brewing Co. Oats in Hose Oatmeal Stout
Description: Rich enough to warm you up in winter, but smooth and refreshing enough to quench your thirst, Oats In Hose is our winter seasonal beer. This beer is a fun interpretation of a creamy oatmeal stout, and is reminiscent of your grandmother’s oatmeal cookies. The comfortable, but full mouthfeel comes from over 200 pounds of oats we use in the brewing process to balance out the roasted, smokiness of a traditional stout. Keep and serve cold as hail.

Name: Big Storm Brewing Co. Arcus Pale Ale
Description: This Southern Pale Ale is brewed with local wildflower honey from Pasco county. This lends it a refreshing sweetness that is well balanced with Mosaic hops. Arcus rolls in (like the cloud formation for which it gets it's name) with a 6.2% ABV. You'll taste a clean sweet finish after it's intense citrusy hop aroma.

Name: Big Storm Brewing Co. Dunder & Blixem Winter Ale
Description: Over 180 years ago, the reindeer you now know as Donner and Blitzen were originally named “Dunder and Blixem,” which translates in Dutch to “Thunder and Lightning.” These historic reindeer are the inspiration for our traditionally brewed spiced ale, with cinnamon and orange peel. It's great for sipping during the holidays and beyond.

Name: Big Storm Brewing Co. Sunny Key Lime Wheat Ale
Description: This flavored wheat ale is a true sip of Florida sunshine. Our Key Lime puree is straight from the Florida Keys, it adds a smooth taste and sweet  lime aroma. Subtle malt characters paired with the citrus flavors of the key limes make this beer burst with flavor.

Name: Noon Whistle Cozmo Pale Ale
Description: Falconer Flight hops give off a Grapefruit nose. Light orange hue from the malt makes this a balanced and crushable beer for the entire day.

Name: Noon Whistle Vortex Gummy New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: NEIPA loaded with Simcoe and Citra hops.

Name: Noon Whistle Smack That Sour
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: American Wild Ale

Name: Noon Whistle Brewing Bernie Milk Stout
Noon Whistle You Big Gummy
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Loaded with Mosaic, Vic Secret and Azacca hops this NE IPA is complex but clean. The juicy mouthfeel and the thirst quenching flavors of citrus, pineapple and tropical fruit will leaving you wanting more.

Name: Mad River Jamaica Red Ale
Description: This beer was originally brewed for a famous Reggae festival that happens each year here in Humboldt County. A malty bitter American Amber style ale. This mahogany hued ale brings an intense spectrum of hop flavors from the spicy aromatic to lingering bitter, all underscored by a full- bodied caramel richness. Try this brew with a little Jamaican Jerked Chicken.

Name: Mad River Steelhead Exra Pale Ale
Mad River Redwood Stout
Description: Formerly known as Steelhead Extra Stout. A black opaque ale with rich creamy roasted malt character and a very mild hop compliment. Dessert beer. Try a stout and vanilla ice cream float.

Name: Mad River Steelhead Double IPA
Description: Pours dark amber with a medium caramel head. Smells of citrus, pine hops. Tastes are pine and citrus hops with a nice sweet caramel background. Has mild carbonation with a balanced finish. Overall a very interesting beer.

Name: O’Hara’s Irish Red

Name: Austin Street The Light & The Glass Amber

Name: Austin Street Half Light Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Half Light is a saison brewed with 100% Maine ingredients and fermented with a blend of traditional saison yeast and brettanomyces. Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Anodyne is an American IPA featuring a simple grain bill of 2-row malted barley and a large dose of malted wheat. Description: A Winter White Ale because what else is Winter? The cold sets in and hangs for months it seems. Everything slows down. Time warps… and you’re covered with a wash of white. Thought I meant winter, didn’t you? Jadis will take you away from winter, even if temporarily.

Description: An addicting little cascadian Black IPA using Belgian dark malts and dry-hopped for intense aroma. Release some bottled-up Anger and learn to enjoy life a little.

Name: Conundrum Red Ale
Description: Have you ever heard of an ESB? In most cases, it stands for Extra Special Bitter, and man is this red extra special. Conundrum walks the line between a malt-centric sweet ale and a hop-centric bitter ale so well, it’s tough to describe. Quite the conundrum indeed! Think if it in simplest terms: it has a sweet malty profile like the Brown Bear Ale at first, though mostly caramelly instead of chocolaty, but then the taste sensation in your mouth changes to the floral bitterness of our secret hop recipe. If you love the Independence Pass Ale, but sometimes just want something a little ‘mellower’, something with a little more malt profile, this beer may be what you’re looking for. If you like our Brown Bear but are thirsty for something with a bit more snap, give it a try! So far, everyone’s loving the stuff

Name: Aspen Brewing The Mountain Imperial Stout
Description: Paying tribute to the brave men who pioneered the ski industry following their service in World War II, our 10th Mountain Imperial Stout is an imperial version of the traditional English oatmeal stout.  A decadent beer worthy of sipping by the fire or sharing with friends.

Name: Aspen Brewing Independence Pass Ale

The secret of its success lies in using only best-quality ingredients, and in the well-balanced, very specific, complex brewing and refermentation process that takes over 90 days.  After brewing and first fermentation – which takes about 30 days – the beer is tasted by the brewmaster and his staff. At this stage this beer is called “single-fermented.” Typical Duvel flavors and aromas are already emerging, but the beer is lower in alcohol and carbonation, and the taste is slightly lighter and crisper.

Name: Duvel Tripel Hop
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description:
In 2007 the brewers at Duvel started innovating with a third hop variety to give Duvel a surprising
twist and some extra bitterness. Six Tripel Hops later, in 2016, Duvel went in search of the ultimate
Duvel Tripel Hop. More than 5,000 fans tasted and voted, and Citra was clearly the favorite. The
Duvel Tripel Hop with citra not only won a gold medal at the Brussels Beer Challenge, it was also
awarded the consumer trophy at the Zythos Beer Festival.
Our brewers do not simply add a third hop variety when creating the Tripel Hop, we also apply a
special process of dry-hopping. In this case, besides adding the usual hops during the cooking
process, extra hop cones are added at a later stage in the brewery process (during the lagering
process). This intensifies and refines the hop aromas in the finished beer. The aromatic third hop is
grown in the Yakima Valley in Washington and enriches the flavor palate with fresh hints of
grapefruit and tropical fruit.

Name: Duvel Barrel Aged Ale
Description:
Duvel Barrel Aged is a unique tasting beer that was developed with great respect for the authentic taste of Duvel, but with a surprising twist. The gold-coloured specialty beer is aged for nine months in oak bourbon barrels. The barrels come from renowned American bourbon distilleries: Four Roses Distillery, Woodford Reserve, Jack Daniels, Heaven Hill and George Dickel.

The barrels are still saturated with the original bourbon and this creates a slightly stimulating Duvel mouthfeel with powerful notes of bourbon, vanilla and caramel. Duvel Barrel Aged is a unique 11.5% ALC tasting beer with a sensational flavour that’s delicious in combination with raw or smoked fish, sushi, grilled or smoked meat, cheeses, exotic fruit and chocolate.

Duvel Barrel Aged stands for refined enjoyment, shared with friends and family, and is perfect for serving at the end of a festive meal.

As the beer will mature for a longer period, this “barrel-aged” Duvel will be darker in color than the traditional Duvel, with a higher alcohol percentage and less bitterness.

The barrels that were selected have had a long life and can boast a real evolution in terms of taste. The oak bourbon barrels originate from two distinguished American bourbon distilleries: the Four Roses Distillery in Kentucky (nominated 'distiller of the year' in 2011, 2012, 2013 and 2015) and the Buffalo Trace Distillery in Kentucky('most award winning distillery in the world'). In the distilleries' maturing basements each barrel has matured bourbon for five to seven years.

Name: Bissell Brothers Engram
Description: What defines a memory? With all our scientific progress, we still don't fully know. The closest humans have come is the engram, theorized to be the physical storage units in the brain for these lasting impressions we retain during our lifetimes.  Our Engram, the newest addition to the Bissell Brothers lineup, is our first wheat beer, and is redolent - in aroma and taste - of fresh sliced pineapple from the usage of Denali hops. The mouthfeel, derived from a grain bill comprised largely of malted wheat, is one of silky smooth perfection, and the manageable 5.5% ABV (we have found this to be essential to both craft beer enthusiasm and summertime drinking in general) allows you to enjoy this beer liberally.  It is refreshing for us to know that the human experience remains at least partially unquantifiable, and that memory remains largely subjective. We hope you make some of your own with this beer.

Name: Bonfire Brewing Crimson pHire Sour
Description: While we were brewing a batch of our Firestarter IPA our boiler had a malfunction. There were two options -- lose the batch or innovate. Our brewers decided to get creative and the result was our first sour mash process! With that as our inspiration, we developed the Crimson pHire -- a sour ale with our flagship IPA malt bill, kettle soured, with blood orange puree.

Name: De La Senne Taras Boulba
Description:
Taras Boulba is the perfect session beer — loaded with complex yeast flavors, hopped to perfection, and as drinkable as any beer you’ve ever tried. At 4.5% alcohol, it’s built for drinkability — we suggest buying it by the case.

You’re no doubt wondering where the name comes from and what the hell the foreign text says. It’s all been explained to us by the brewers, but we’re still not entirely clear about it. What we can understand is that a young Flemish man has gone and married a French-speaking Wallonian girl, and his father, Taras Boulba, is very angry. (Smeirlap means ‘fool’ in a bizarre local dialect, which combines Flemish and French, somehow.)

This is all a bastardization of the original story by Gogol, whose protagonist was Ukrainian and Eastern Orthodox. His son marries a Polish girl, a Roman Catholic, during the religious war between the two countries in the 1600s, and the Ukrainian father simply kills his son to eliminate the shame.

The label says this is “just the beginning of the story,” so surely the brewers have something else up their sleeves. We can’t wait.

Can you just trust us on this one? This beer rocks. Hard.

Description: Day Trip: Extra Hoppy Golden Ale, is brewed in celebration of those brief but wondrous escapes. Inspired by a favorite Brussels beer, I brewed Day Trip to have an inviting fruity nose, spicy hop flavor, and a dry bitter finish: the perfect liquid companion for a day of bold wandering.
