Name: Enlightenment Transcendence
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: While watching the colors of an autumn sunset bleed into the ripples of a quiet pond, have you ever experienced the feeling of complete oneness between yourself and the universe around you? This is a beer brewed for such moments. After a warm fermentation and double dry hopping, two batches of Transcendence were pitched with wild yeast and allowed to sleep throughout the summer. Before bottling, a third batch of fresh, young beer was blended in. What has emerged is a dry, funky and intensely fruity farmhouse ale that transcends the sum of it’s ingredients. So if you go exploring, I hope you will find Transcendence a comforting companion during you own moments of inner reflection.

Name: Enlightenment Biere Brut
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Enlightenment Brut is an American bière de champagne brewed in the style of a Belgian strong golden ale and conditioned using the traditional méthode champenoise. An extended warm fermentation using multiple yeast strains combined with the traditional bottle re-fermentation, riddling, and disgorgement processes produces a beer with and immense fruity aroma, subtle spiciness, a crisp zesty carbonation and a dry refreshing finish. - See more at: http://americancraftbeer.com/item/070213011806enlightenment-brut.html#sthash.NUzY7cRQ.dpuf

Name: Enlightenment Titania
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A collaboration between Enlightenment Ales and Kissmeyer Beer & Brewing, Titania is a Nordic-style saison brewed with Massachusetts wildflower honey, a selection of flowers and botanicals and fermented with our farmhouse yeast. Best enjoyed on a hot midsummer night, we hope you’ll enjoy this fanciful ale with friends, lovers and good cheer.

Name: Enlightenment Cosmos
Description: To quote the great Carl Sagan, “We are a way for the Cosmos to know itself.” Personally, I find that winter stargazing is a great way to aid the Cosmos in this self-discovery. To this end, I brewed Cosmos, the beer, in the style of a robust Foreign Export Stout to have as a companion on those cold, clear nights of celestial exploration. With its big, warm body, rich chocolate and caramel flavors, and delicate oatmeal smoothness, Cosmos stands up to the coldest of New England nights. So whether you’re exploring your inner and outer universe high in the White Mountains or marveling at the night sky through your backyard telescope, Cosmos Stout will help keep your body (to say nothing of your mind) rooted here on Earth.

Name: Enlightenment Great Punkin
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Braven Vibes Summer Ale
Description: Picnics on the beach. BBQs on the roof. Concerts in the park. Summer in the City. Our Summer Ale brewed with Lemon and Lime, Vibes brings a refreshing flavor and attitude to every gathering. Day or night, keep the Vibes flowing!

Name: Braven Black Pale Ale
Description: A drinkable contradiction – a Black Pale Ale. Earthy, citrus hop undertones accompany the stout-like snap of chocolate and espresso in this dark spin on the classic American Pale Ale. Surprisingly crisp, Braven’s Black Pale Ale offers a drinkability that is as welcoming to the craft beer novice as it is rewarding to the experienced connoisseur.

Name: Braven White IPA
Description: Braven’s White IPA lives just a step off the beaten path. A delicious blend of two distinct styles, White IPA delivers the hoppy bite of an American IPA that’s balanced by the soft wheat character and hints of spice of a Belgian White. Our unique White IPA offers maximum character and flavor in every easy-to-drink pint.

Name: Braven Crowded Places IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This New England IPA is brewed with Citra and Galaxy hops giving it a juicy and floral taste, El dorado hops were added for bittering. A smooth mouthfeel is a result of flaked oats and wheat added to the mash. Crowded places is refreshing and drinkable all year long.

Name: Braven Froot Moon NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Moon Froot. What does that even mean? No one knows what it means, but it's provocative. It gets the people going! Our hazy New England Style IPA has all the juicy, tropical fruit aromas and flavors you would expect from this exciting style.

Name: Braven Bushwick Pilsner
Description: The return of the style that made Bushwick famous. Old school, dry and refreshing, Bushwick Pilsner is a ballpark-ready brew. Your granddad would love this beer.

Name: Cerveza Mexican Colibre Blonde
Description: This bright beer showcases a deep golden color and light notes of malt and hops. The ideal medium bodied beer for all occasions.

Name: Tijuana Morena
Description: This Dark beer is unique amongst all others. Its smooth body, light caramel flavor and mahogany color are a result of the special combination of several malts. Because of its sweet aftertaste it is believed to be a delicacy among beers. 4.5% Alc. Vol. Facts: It is a 100% Pure Beer! Brewed only with Barley Malt, Hops, Yeast and Water under the Strictest Guidelines of the International Purity law of 1516. It is a distinguished, elite, gourmet beer for the most demanding palates. It is the only Hand Crafted, Limited Production, Lager beer in Mexico!

Name: Cristal Cerveza del Peru
Description: Brewed since 1921, Cristal is Peru’s No. 1 selling beer, combining a light-bodied liquid with strong Andean imagery. It has been the No. 1 selling U.S. import from South America over the last eight years, primarily appealing to the approximately one million Peruvian consumers in the U.S.

Name: Shiner Cerveza De Verano
Description: Cerveza de Verano, the beer of summer, is a refreshing, Mexican-style lager brewed with agave for a subtly sweet and earthy flavor that’s sure to leave you wanting more.

Name: Cerveza Bahia
Description: With its lime flavor, Bahia is another alternative to traditional beers. Bahia offers a fresh taste and is great for special moments. This light colored pilsner contains a natural lime extract, with moderate levels of alcohol and bitterness.

Name: Covington Kolsch
Description: Covington Kolsch is the beer our brewery was founded on. It is an easy drinking wheat ale with a slight citrus flavor and aroma from the German noble hops it is brewed with. It is fermented at higher ale temperatures, then cold conditioned like most lagers so you get the best of both worlds. A fruity aroma like an ale with a crisp, clean finish like a lager.

Name: Covington Anonymous IPA
Description: Covington Brewhouse’s Anonymous IPA is the first result of a scientist and a rock ‘n roll brewmaster collaborating on the best kept secret in downtown Covington, Louisiana.   Once the recipe was formulated, our brewmaster began sneaking it into events. That’s where the name anonymous came from. Questions like “what is this?” and “where can I get this?” were answered by “It’s anonymous”, creating the buzz for our “Anonymous IPA”.   The beer is a blend of six different malts, six different hops and a lot of tender love and care from our brewing team. The maltiness and beautiful darker than average color comes from the Munich, Aromatic and Caramel malts with a splash of pale chocolate malt. The amazing hop flavor and aroma created by the six different hops are going to remain anonymous. So far nobody has figured them out.   This brave new beer is brewed by and for innovators. Go ahead. Expect the exceptional. We think you’ll like what’s brewing.

Name: Covington Brewhouse Pontchartrain Pilsner
Description: Pontchartrain Pilsner is a combination of Old World German and Czech style pilsner with a local twist. This refreshing local take on the classic styles is perfect to enjoy by itself or paired with fresh seafood dishes. Light in body with the beautiful golden straw color that is a hallmark of the genre, Pontchartrain Pilsner’s thoughtfully crafted blend of German Perle and Czech Saaz hops imbue it with a wonderful mellow herbal hop aroma.

Name: Covington Brewhouse Festbier
Description: Brewed in the tradition of the German Maerzen style, this classic autumn brew has a rich, amber color with a blend of malts and earthy hops that produces a smooth, deep toasty flavor that’s perfect for changing seasons.

Name: Covington Rock & Roll Summer Ale
Description: In the classic tradition of Farmhouse Ales we brew our Saison during the winter months and serve it in the summer and infused it with a dose of American Rock N Roll! Our Saison has a lower ABV than the modern version and closer to the original style so it’s easy drinking to beat the summer heat.  What else would you expect from our all-star team at Covington Brewhouse?

Name: Utepils Glocal IPA
Description: GLOBALLY SOURCED + LOCALLY BREWED; THE UTEPILS IPA BLENDS OUR BELGIAN ALE YEAST WITH TRADITIONAL EUROPEAN-SOURCED HOPS AND AMERICAN WEST COAST VARIETALS.

Name: Utepils Moment Czech Style Dark Lager
Description: Utepils 2018 Moment beer is very dark, almost black in the glass, but it has a surprisingly light body. It’s brewed with Czech hops, which give it a nice balance and aroma. The malt flavor comes through with suggestions of toasted bread, chocolate and dark fruit

Name: Utepils Pilsner
Description: NORWEGIAN FOR THE FIRST BEER ENJOYED IN THE SUNSHINE AFTER A LONG, DARK WINTER. OUR SIGNATURE PILSNER IS BREWED WITH CZECH-GROWN BARLEY AND HOPS; FERMENTED WITH A CZECH LAGER YEAST STRAIN.

Name: Winter Hill Frequency Kolsch
Description:
VISUAL
Clean and bright

AROMA
Pleasingly malty with a touch of noble hop

FLAVOR
Crisp and sharp with a subtle malt sweetness on the finish

Name: Winter Hill Suburban Home
Description: Light and Crisp Ale with Mild Floral Notes and a Crackery Finish.  An "Easy Drinker for Hard Times'

Name: Winter Hill Russian Ending
Description: Burly and Roasty with Well Disguised ABV

Name: Winter Hill Johnny Juice Bomb IPA
Description: Fruity and Balanced with Mild Bitterness.

Name: Winter Hill Mosaica IPA
Description: Tropical Single hop IPA.

Name: Mike Hess Habitus Double IPA
Description: Winner of the gold at the 2014 World Beer Cup® in the rye beer category, Habitus is a very drinkable, high gravity, crisp and spicy rye IPA, hopped generously throughout the brew process and then dry-hopped with over a pound per barrel of Sterling and Chinook hops. Earthy and spicy notes from both the hops and the rye malt, complimented by the floral and piney aromatics.

Name: Mike Hess Assaulted By Feather Pillows Double Hazy IPA
Description: The grain bill is stacked with oats and wheat to keep it light, fluffy and hazy. It's hopped up with loads of Amarillo, Sabro and Strata, a magical combo that is tropical fruit forward, flavors like apricot and mango jump out.

Name: Mike Hess 4:59 Little IPA
Description: Stop watching the clock; happy hour starts now! 4:59 is a little IPA that packs the flavor and aroma of a bigger IPA into a crushable session beer. Hop-bursting techniques give 4:59 a delicious citrusy bitterness that dominates its sweet barley malt. Drink without sacrificing the IPA flavor you love.

Name: Mike Hess Little IPA
Description: Stop watching the clock; happy hour starts now! 4:59 is a little IPA that packs the flavor and aroma of a bigger IPA into a crushable session beer. Hop-bursting techniques give 4:59 a delicious citrusy bitterness that dominates its sweet barley malt. Drink without sacrificing the IPA flavor you love.

Name: Burial The Keeper’s Veil Honey Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A beer constructed from our love for Asheville’s incredible wildflower population. Brewed with exclusively Riverbend Malt 6 row and wheat, alongside NC raised honey, this beer gets the majority of its flavor from the addition of seven herbs and flowers, ranging from heather, elderflower, passionflower, hibiscus, rose and chamomile. Enjoy a cornucopia of tea, orchard fruit, and floral aromas.

Name: Burial Tin Cup Camp Stout
Description: A team favorite, this easy sipping stout showcases our love for the tin mug at the campfire. A house blend of Counter Culture Coffee beans works with a complex cadre of dark malts, flaked adjuncts and lactose to forge this 5% all day delight. Just a little a reminder of another beloved Burial ale.

Name: Burial Surf Wax IPA
Description: If you want the ultimate, you've got to be willing to pay the ultimate price. But are you crazy enough? Show those guys that are inching their way on the freeways in their metal coffins that the human sprit is still alive. Mosaic. Citra. Centennial. Columbus. Lots of barley. Touch of wheat. The sea swallows the Sun. And who knows if it rises again. Vaya con dios

Name: Burial Hellstar Dark Lager
Description: Cast into the clutches of eternal damnation. And crucified by all the noise. It’s dark lager. You need to have it but you don’t know it yet. You're infested with deceit. Someone told you that all black beer is heavy. Well that's just stupid. Oh we're as heavy as the chains of Hell. But this beer ain't. Open your heart to evil. Sip on the depths of our black souls.

Name: Burial Other Forms of Evil Pilsner
Description: May the darkness always be with you. May you still discern peace from the light. And if you shall, perhaps you know the ardent fortunes all around you. The latest in our merging of hallowed Keller Pilsner with ominously forsaken IPA principles. Made from a blend of our favorite German Pils and dosed with Epiphany Craft Malt’s Oats. Double dry-hopped with Strata and Grungeist, our new favorites from US and German hop-breeding programs.

Name: The Dudes’ Kolschtal Eddy
Description: June gloom got you down? We know, life in SoCal can be so hard. Cheer up buttercup, Kolschtal Eddy is here to make it all better. Clear bodied with a straw-yellow hue, this brew is an easy going Dude, but still has a little “hop” in his step. One sip, and you’ll realize life isn’t so bad.

Name: The Dudes Boysenberry
Description: It’s a tasty fruit with SoCal roots. We give you our Boysenberry Wheat Ale. First commercially cultivated by Walter Knott at his Buena Park farm, the boysenberry is known for its sweet, tart, juicy deliciousness. It’s mostly used in jams, pies, syrups, and now… beer! That’s right, we took a perfectly good wheat beer and added a little zing to it. Hey, sometimes you just gotta grab life by the berries.

Name: The Dudes Surfrider Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The Dudes’ and The Surfrider Foundation love our oceans, waves, and beaches and believe there are many things we can do to protect them.  So a portion of the proceeds from each Surfrider American Pale Ale sold will go towards keeping them clean.  Plus, with Australian Summer, New Zealand Motueka, German Hull Melon, and American Simcoe Hops, we think you’ll be contributing to this cause a lot.

Name: The Dudes’ Double Trunk Double IPA
Description: They say an elephant never forgets. When it comes to this double IPA, you won’t either. This gentle giant certainly certainly has mad hops, but ferments out dry (,) so it’s not too malty on the finish. Clocking in at 10.8 percent ABV, it’s definitely not for the timid mice amongst you. Put on your trunks and dive in.

Name: The Dudes’ CalifornIPA
Description: Great. Another West Coast IPA. Nope. This here is 16 ounces of pure CalifornIPA. This dude is distinct and diverse, just like the Golden State. We’re talking about a plethora of west coast malts and California yeast being handcrafted to create this California-style IPA. At 6.9% ABV, this one is for all of the dudes and dudettes across California – no matter where you like to kick it.

Name: The Dudes’ Bohemian Hopsody IPA
Description: Southern California, are you ready to rock?!  Good.  Because you this the official beer of 95.5 KLOS, The Rock of Southern California. Crisp, bright and hop forward, this dude is ready to get down anywhere you are. At just 5 percent alcohol by volume, it’s the perfect brew for those who like to rock and roll all night and party every day.  For those about to rock, we “salud” you!

Name: Driftwood Blackstone Porter
Description: Brewed on Victoria Island this porter is full and rich with boatloads of dark chocolate and coffee notes coming from the specially selected dark malts. Seasonally available this is a perfect pint to settle into on a cold evening.

Name: Driftwood White Bark Wheat Ale
Description: This traditional Belgian-style wheat ale is brewed with the addition of freshly-ground coriander and Curacao orange peel. Citrus and floral aromas outshine the hops and dominate the nose of this dry and quaffable beer, while the use of raw wheat adds cloudiness and enhances its mouthfeel.   Malts: Pilsner, Raw Wheat   Hops: Hallertauer

Name: Driftwood Farmhand Saison Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Our interpretation of this Southern-Belgian farmhouse ale employs a long-grain bill and the addition of freshly-ground black pepper to the Brew Kettle. We use the versatile Ardennes yeast from Belgium, adding notes of bubblegum, banana and cloves to this Saison’s sturdy malt backbone.

Name: Driftwood Naughty Hildegard ESB
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Showcasing Mosaic hops and a delicate blend of malts, this Extra Special Bitter was brewed with the very finest ingredients available. Naughty Hildegard ESB supports big flavours of guava, mango and citrus to deliver a juicy hop-malt balance that is deceptively easy to drink. A Pacific Northwest jam on a UK classic.

Name: Driftwood Oumuamua Milk Stout
Description: This milk stout, also know as sweet or cream stout, is black in color and brewed with cara, chocolate and roasted barley. Presenting a dominate malt sweetness with notes of chocolate, caramel and a hint of roast in the aroma and on the palate. Lactose sugar deepens and rounds out the pleasing rich malt and medium body of this unforeseen galactic visitor!

Name: Driftwood Raised By Wolves IPA
Description: Featuring one of the new wave of hop breeds accentuating the fruit-forward characteristics of North American native hops, Equinox is yet another answer to brewers craving distinctly North American hops. Paired with the intensely-fruity previously-named Brett Trois (actually it is wild Saccharomyces), this delivers layers of mango, melon and papaya.

Name: Wasatch Apricot Hefeweizen
Description: This smooth and unfiltered fruited hefeweizen has a beautiful apricot nose and a refreshing, slightly tart finish. The bounty of the orchard is now portable.

Name: Wasatch Polygamy Porter
Description: Why have just one? Polygamy Porter is a smooth, chocolatey, easy-drinkin' brown porter that's more than a little naughty. Take some home to the wives!

Name: Wasatch Ghostrider Pale IPA
Description: This dry-hopped and unfiltered IPA is the embodiment of drinkability. Juicy citrus flavor is balanced with a Premium Pale and Munich malt backbone that won't harsh your mellow.

Name: Island Hop IPA
Description: Boasting notes of pineapple and orange, our tropical IPA is fruity, unfiltered and easy-drinking at 5% ABV. Welcome to paradise - where hops abound and parasols are optional.

Name: Wasatch Devastator Double Bock
Description: If you're going to sin, sin big. Our Double Bock is sweet, toasty and rich, but finishes gentle. This beer has developed a serious cult following. Imagine that - a cult following in Utah...

Name: Wasatch Black O’ Lantern
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: What kind of madman would cross an imperial stout with a pumpkin ale? Our brewers, as it turns out. This rich, chocolatey frankenbrew is dry-spiced and scary good. Boo.

Name: Yazoo Amarillo Pale Ale
Description: A new version of an American classic. Our pale ale bursts with citrus and herbal hop aroma and flavor, featuring the newly discovered Amarillo hop variety – along with generous Perle and Cascade hops.  Made with English Pale, Munich, Vienna, and Crystal malts, this beer gives a great malty body with a cleansing hop finish.

Name: Yazoo Hefeweizen
Description: An authentic example of a Bavarian Hefeweizen.  This beer is made with mostly wheat malt and uses a true Hefeweizen yeast that gives it a fruity banana aroma with just a hint of cloves.  The tart finish makes this the perfect summer beer.

Name: Yazoo Amarillo Pale Ale 1/2 Bbl Keg
Description: A new version of an American classic. Our pale ale bursts with citrus and herbal hop aroma and flavor, featuring the newly discovered Amarillo hop variety – along with generous Perle and Cascade hops. Made with English Pale, Munich, Vienna, and Crystal malts, this beer gives a great malty body with a cleansing hop finish.

Name: Yazoo Daddy-O Pilsner
Description:
Daddy-O Pilsner honors Linus’ granddad, Parker “Bullet” Hall, known to all his grandkids as “Daddy-O”. He was an All-American at Ole Miss, and was the first NFL player to be Rookie of the Year and MVP in the same year, in 1939.

Daddy-O Pilsner is brewed with pilsner and Vienna malts, a touch of flaked corn, and a blend of classic and new American hops.

Name: Baltika #4 Dark Lager
Description: A dark beer produced using caramel and rye malts. This combination of ingredients endows the beer with a harmonious hint of bread flavors and the specific aroma of caramel malt. The ingredients are water, light caramel and rye malt, maltose syrup and hops.

Name: Baltika #7 Export Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager

Name: Baltika #3
Description:
The Baltika #3 Classic beer was first launched in 1992 and has been traditionally the most popular beer among Russian consumers since the mid-90ies due to its invariably high quality.

The year of 2004 witnessed a "new birth" of the Baltika #3: the glass bottle received a new shape and label, which was accompanied by the first canning of the brand. In May 2006 the Baltika #3 was produced in an innovative package: a premium 1 liter PET-package that looks practically the same as the half-liter glass bottle. In 2007 the Baltika #3 bottle received an embossed lettering. At the same time the brand was produced in a one-liter aluminum can that was new for the market. In April 2008 a 1.5-liter PET bottle with a "football" design was produced for the Baltika #3, especially for the Russian Football Championship. The PET-glass material has high protective qualities and keeps the most popular Russian beer fresh for a longer period.

Name: Wild Rose Cherry Porter
Description: Rich and sensual, the flavour is reminiscent of Black Forest cake with sweet chocolate notes and a slightly smoky character from the roasted malts.

Name: Wild Rose Velvet Fog
Description: It has a hazy, golden colour, is light bodied, contains 4.5% alcohol by volume and has the fresh, sharp flavour of wheat malt with a touch of citrus character.

Name: Wild Rose Ponderosa Gose
Description: Our new summer seasonal, Ponderosa Gose, is a refreshing tropical gose with a wild citrus taste, perfect for our hot Alberta summer days.

Name: Wild Rose IPA
Description: A beautiful copper-coloured ale, rich in caramel malt character and well balanced with plenty of hops. An authentic India Pale Ale, this IPA is handcrafted for the true ale drinker.

Name: Wild Rose Electric Avenue Golden Lager
Description: A road linking all places where wild is the way. From the legendary Electric Avenue in Calgary to Bourbon Street to George Street to King Cross. Electric Avenue is at home everywhere people thirst for bolder refreshment. All natural ingredients make this crisp, golden lager a favourite for the whole wild world.

Name: Wild Rose Wraspberry
Description: You won’t find any preservatives in this thirst quenching ale. But additives? That’s a different story, as each brew of Wild Rose WRaspberry Ale is infused with thousands of natural, juicy-red additives called raspberries.

Name: Shmaltz Star Trek Klingon Imperial Porter
Description: Raise a goblet of Klingon Imperial Porter to the strongest warriors in the galaxy. Discover the ruby undertones that pay homage to Klingon Bloodwine and fallen warriors who hold honor above life. There is no honor in attacking the weak, so take pleasure in besieging this 7.3% ABV Imperial Porter. But like this mighty elixir, Klingons also have a sweet side: Witness the wedding ritual where the gods forge two hearts so strong that once joined together cannot be opposed. (Just ignore the part of the ceremony where the groom swings his bat’leth at the bride!) A Klingon proverb states: Death is an experience best shared, and so is the first Star Trek limited release of 2017! Qapla’!

Name: Star Trek Vulcan Ale 4b
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Star Trek™ Vulcan Ale? Make It So, Number One.   ​​​​​​​Federation of Beer announces that Shmaltz Brewing Company of Clifton Park, NY has brewed a new Star Trek-themed beer called Vulcan Ale – The Genesis Effect, that is now available on Planet Earth. Under license by CBS Consumer Products, Vulcan Ale – The Genesis Effect will pay homage to the Star Trek franchise and its legacy, tying into the storyline of The Wrath of Khan as well as Shmaltz’s own brand of He’brew craft beers.   Developed by Shmaltz Lead Brewer, Richie Saunders, Vulcan Ale – Genesis Effect is a Red Session IPA. It uses a blend of hops meant to invoke a sense of intergalactic wonder and adventure – Galaxy, Warrior and Comet, to name a few.

Name: He’Brew Funky Jewbelation
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: A blend of 6 ales aged in 73% rye whiskey and 27% bourbon barrels. The blend consists of He'Brew Jewbelation 15, Vintage Jewbelation, Bittersweet Lenny's RIPA, He'Brew Origin, Reunion Ale '11, & He'Brew Messiah.

Name: Shmaltz He Brew Death Of A Contract Brewer
Description: Death seems so obvious: the end of life, no mas, kaput. But Humans stand an optimistic animal. Many traditions suggest alternate endings: Resurrection, reincarnation, rebirth, afterlife. Even the atheist view of Eternal Oblivion doesn't seem quite final, more of a shift in spiritual states of (un)consciousness. As usual, Jewish tradition prescribes... Food. 7 days of family, community, and bagels (beer!), called, Shiva, meaning "7" in Hebrew. The flip side to the 7 days of Creation with the 7th as a holy day of rest. The first meal of Shiva is "the comfort meal." And the number 7 provides powerful mojo: 7 Jewish wedding blessings, 7 Liberal Arts, 7 Lucky Japanese gods, 7 stars of the Big Dipper, 7 colors of the rainbow, 7 seas, 007 license to kill, 7 dwarves, We are 7 by Wordsworth with a child's view of death, 7 deadly sins, Best of 7 finals in NBA, NHL, MLB, 7th Inning stretch, no. 7 on Elway & Tiny Archibald. George Costanza yearned to name his firstborn, "7" as a living tribute to no. 7 Mickey Mantle. The 7 Award however must go to the immortal George Carlin for 7 Dirty Words, inspired by another hero Lenny Bruce. Coming into 17 years of beer, and Year no. 1 with our own Brewery, we commemorate this conversion with Death Of A Contract Brewer, our Shmaltz homage to new life - L'Chaim! Jeremy Cowan, proprietor

Name: Shmaltz Brewing Coney Island Lager
Description: A beer inspired by The Playground of the World. Classically brewed to pair perfectly with whatever amuses you.  Coney Island Lager is a dry-hopped, classic American lager, melding a complex malty backbone with expressive hop notes for a refreshingly balanced experience.

Name: Hops & Grain Porter Culture
Description: Dark, pleasing, sturdy, decorous. Culture in the roots and roots in the culture Love to fuel the liquid and liquid to fuel the love Inspired by the greenest and green to be inspired ’Tis a time and a place for everything Because everything needs a time.

Name: Hops & Grain Pale Dog
Description: Pale Dog Pale Ale is an homage to our chairman. Full of malt character with a dry, crisp and hoppy finish.  We start with a base of the highest quality 2 Row malted barley our eyes have ever seen.  We blend that with a small amount of Vienna and Caramel malts to add distinct character and mouthfeel and then mash strategically for both attenuation and a balanced malty sweetness. Throughout the boil we use a blend of Oregon grown Nugget and Cascade hops to lend flavors of resinous fruit and dank pine. The kettle hop additions provide an enticing aroma and noticeable but balanced bitterness and we dry hop in the fermenter to deliver a mouthful of hoppiness.

Name: Hops & Grain Lupulin Rodeo IPA
Description: Lupulin Rodeo IPA is part of our commitment to the excessive usage of hops! Blending 6 of our favorite varieties together to create a beer with a rich, grapefruit pith dankness and a juicy, tropical finish.

Name: Hops & Grain The One They Call Zoe
Description: The one they call Zoe is an interesting breed of beer. Brewed in a mildly traditional manner, it’s very similar to many of the German lagers of the old world but dry-hopped to add an extra layer of complexity. Zoe is based on pale and vienna malts, light to golden in color with a beautiful white layer of foam resting on top, constantly delivering floral and citrus dry-hop aromatics with every sip. This beer is meant to be paired with, well, life! It’s also meant to be paired with a few more. With notes of lightly toasted bread, floral hops and an incredibly smooth finish we hope that Zoe is everything that you’ve been searching for in a pale lager.

Name: Hops & Grain River Beer
Description: River Beer is our take on a classic style, Premium American Lager. We blend high quality German malt, fresh hops and the finest lager yeast to create a beer of extra fine quality and superb drinkability. In the glass, the beer is crystal clear, crystal clean and pairs well with 5 more. Light and bready malt character blends with a slight noble hop aroma that leads into a delightfully crisp and clean finish.

Name: 5 Rabbit Gringolandia Ironica IPA
Description: 5 Rabbit's Gringolandia Ironica IPA is the very picture of a modern IPA: rich gold in color, dry and cleanly bitter on the palate, bursting with citrus and luscious tropical aromas from our mix of citra, azacca and amarillo dry-hops. It's light on its feet, with our signature bright, fun character. Say it the way we do in Latin America: "EE-pah!

Name: Gringolandia Ironica IPA
Description: 5 Rabbit's Gringolandia Ironica IPA is the very picture of a modern IPA: rich gold in color, dry and cleanly bitter on the palate, bursting with citrus and luscious tropical aromas from our mix of citra, azacca and amarillo dry-hops. It's light on its feet, with our signature bright, fun character. Say it the way we do in Latin America: "EE-pah!

Name: 5 Lizard Witbier
Description: A creamy and refreshing wheat beer with some spicy complexity and light touch of passion fruit for a delicious and slightly exotic flavor. It’s low enough in alcohol to be a great quaffing beer, but has a complex flavor profile with a lime top-note, soft, creamy texture, in-your-face fruitiness, an acidic snap and a subtle spicy finish.

Name: Crux Pct Porter
Description: t’s not uncommon to find Pacific Crest Trail hikers at Crux enjoying a well-deserved day off from the grueling 2,600-mile hike. The trail runs just outside of Bend along the crest of the Cascades. They come to enjoy great company, a rewarding pint and the expansive view of the mountains they’ve been traversing. PCT is not your typical porter— it’s for explorers. You’ll discover robust flavors driven by a roasted and chocolate malt bill paid off with refreshing day-in and day-out drinkability.

Name: Monkish Crux
Description: Belgian-style Abbey Single spiced with elderflowers. Related to the Oblate, monks would often brew and consume this beer as a table beer. With a slight indulgence, the beer has a stronger hop and elderflower presence. This golden-colored beer is crisp, spicy, and quenchable.

Name: Crux Stout
Description: Stouts have a rich, deep and dark history— dating back over 400 years in Europe as a strong porter. Well, forget all that. Yes— this stout is classically dark, but close your eyes and take a sip. You’ll likely be surprised by how easy it is on the palate with notes of caramel, chocolate and roasted coffee driven by a wonderfully nuanced blend of dark crystal, black, roasted and chocolate malt.

Name: Crux Gimme Mo
Description: A slightly sweet, lower ABV, IPA providing welcome relief from the onslaught of bitter hop bombs out there. Its complex aromatic layers, suggest mango, melon, pine and berries, are driven by whole-leaf Mosaic and Citra hops which are then balanced by an acidulated and pilsner malt bill. Finally, its silky smooth mouthfeel will leave you asking for “mo!”

Name: Crux Half Hitch IPA
Description: Medium bodied with intense hop flavor and aroma. Complimented by fruity, floral, and citrus American Mosaic Hops. The intention of this beer is to exhibit the fresh and bright character of Mosaic hop.

Name: Crux Pilz
Description: This is not your father’s pilsner. It’s more like the pilsner that belonged to his stern father, the one with all the rules but who gave you treats whenever your parents weren’t looking. Brewed with traditional Pilsner malts, imported Czech Saaz and local Oregon Sterling hops, this pilsner’s first sip shows up with clean lager flavors, and then opens up with surprising complexity and softness—developing biscuity flavors, spicy herbal notes and a hint of lemon.

Name: IndieFerm Black Feather Porter
Description: Black Feather Porter is named in honor of Black Feather Horse Rescue in Plymouth and all the work they do caring for neglected animals.  This is a straight-ahead Porter with notes of coffee and chocolate from the dark roasted malts.

Name: IndieFerm Farmhouse Red
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Farmhouse Red is a cross between a red ale and a saison.  So you can look at it as either a funky red ale or a dark saison.  It has plenty of roasted malts and the dry complexity of a saison.  ABV is 7% and the IBUs are around 30.  ​

Name: IndieFerm Hopshaker Pale Ale
Description: Hopshaker Pale Ale.  A pale ale with cascade, citra, and chinook hops.  Pine and citrus flavors are featured in this slightly hop-forward but balanced beer. Light bodied and easy drinking, very clean finish.  6% ABV, 40 IBU.

Name: IndieFerm Full Of Stars Imperial Stout
IndieFerm Gratzer
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Gratzer is kind of a weird beer.   Gratzer is made using oak smoked wheat malt which gives it a mild smokey aroma.  People ask us if there is bacon in the beer.  There most emphatically is not!  If you can imagine a Gose with smoke instead of salt, you are in the right ball park.  ABV is 6% and the bitterness is mild. Color is a light gold.

Name: Powell Dive Bomb Dark Ale
Description: Like the unpredictable dive of the east van crow, this Brown Porter will shock your senses with an explosive bomb of flavour. Hidden behind the slight upfront hop bitterness is a deep roasted malt character with hints of caramel, toffee, chocolate, and nuts. Your taste buds won’t be disappointed.

Name: Powell Pretty Little Thing Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This low alcohol, dry, and effervescent table saison was dry-hopped with Ekuanot and Amarillo hops bringing flavours and aromas of lemon, lime, papaya, and bright stone fruit.

Name: Powell Ode To Citra Pale Ale
Powell Faux Bruin Oaked Sour Brown Ale
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Faux Bruin is a 15% blend of 3 year aged sour brown ale along with 85% new world kettle sour brown ale. The entire batch was conditioned on oak chips imparting flavours and aromas of toasted coconut, vanilla, and wood.

Name: Powell Vices Bourbon Coffee Stout
Description: Vices is an export stout  that was brewed with the addition of coffee from Agro Roasters and aged with oak chips soaked in Evan Williams bourbon.

Name: Powell Lazy D’Haze IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A North Eastern Style Hazy IPA showcasing the juiciness of Amarillo and Equinox hops. Intense aromas of grapefruit, orange, apricot, melon, and berries are highlighted by the use of pale ale malt , vienna malt, and wheat. Let’s enjoy these Lazy D’haze.

Name: Conshohocken 2 Hour Delay Winter Wheat IPA
Conshohocken Heaps Of Green IPA
Description: Heaps of Green IPA is brewed with malted wheat and oats and loaded with late addition Amarillo, Bravo and Mosaic hops.  This unfiltered IPA is sticky, citrusy and full bodied.

Name: Conshohocken Island Of The Sun Double IPA
Conshohocken Ring The Bell Unfiltered Pilsner
Hacker Pschorr Oktoberfest Marzen
Description: Hacker Pschorr Original Oktoberfest makes any celebration authentic! Original Oktoberfest has a nose of black currents and earth, with a malt driven flavor expertly balanced by Hallertau hops.

Name: Hacker Pschorr Weissbier
Description:
Traditional Bavarian wheat beer with refreshing taste and balanced flavor.
A complex blend of citrus, banana, clove, honey, and nutmeg.

Name: Hacker Pschorr Munich Gold
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description:
Among the first Hacker Pschorr beers to be exported to the US, Munich Gold is a stronger version of a traditional Helles. This brilliantly golden lager
features a medium body, hints of nectarine and golden raisin, and a nose of praline and delicate grain.

Name: Hacker-Pschorr Munchner Kellerbier
Description: Munich Kellerbier Anno 1417 shines with a seductive golden honey color. A beer with a distinctive character: earthy, bold, quaffable and yet refreshingly mild and light. Just like a real Bavarian. Creamy and effervescent, typical of unfiltered beers, a delightful ticklish mouthfeel. Aromas of caramel, honey and plum dominate and emphasize the beer’s malty, spicy flavor. Unmistakable hints of apple and grapefruit bring in a fruity freshness.

Name: Hacker Pschorr Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: “Munich Gold” closely resembles our Münchner Hell in terms of taste and mainly owes its popularity to a slightly higher original gravity and the malty note. The result is a full-bodied yet mild taste which delivers an increasingly bitter note before culminating into an aromatic finish. A real treat for true beer connoisseurs!  The types of barley grown in the Swabian Jura and in the Upper Palatinate Region of Bavaria are excellently suited for the production of this timeless classic.   Hacker-Pschorr has been brewing beer in the traditional Bavarian manner since 1417. The high-quality beers the brewery produces are all brewed in accordance with the Bavarian Purity Law and contain only water, malt and hops.

Name: Cruz Blanca La Floridita Sparkling Rosé Ale
Tasting Notes: Acidic, Bright, Crisp, Floral, Fruity, Passionfruit, Tart, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Chicken, Fish - White, Salads  Greens
Description: Our sparkling rosé ale offers a refreshing burst of bubbles and fruit. Brewed with generous amounts of hibiscus and passionfruit, this tasty ale exudes sunshine. Cheers to warm smiles and cold beer!

Name: Cruz Blanca Marisol Key Lime  White Ale
Tasting Notes: Bready, Bright, Citrus, Dry, Floral, Herbal, Light, Smooth, Yeasty
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: This is Marisol. A white ale brewed with a splash of key lime and green coriander, a dose of sun, and plenty of beach vibes. It’s another way to enjoy Summer in Chicago. And like Summer, Marisol is only here for a limited time.

Name: Cruz Blanca Palm Shade Tropical IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Bright, Citrus, Floral, Fruity, Grassy, Hoppy, Pineapple, Smooth, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Chicken, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - White, Fruit - Sweet, Pork, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: This refreshing, hazy IPA combines crushable, deeply-quenching drinkability with a bright citrus aroma. Our malt build offers a soft canvas for fruit-forward hops with subtle bitterness and vibrant notes of mandarin orange and pineapple.

Name: Three Kings – Christmas Double IPA
Tasting Notes: Cinnamon, Citrus, Currant, Fruity, Red Fruit, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Duck  Game Bird, Fruit - Dried, Salads  Greens
Description: Inspired by Ponche, Mexico's holiday fruit punch. This festive delight is cheerfully hopped with Mosaic and Citra Cryo, brewed with a touch of lactose, and finished with tamarind, hibiscus, currants orange, and cinnamon. Salud!

Name: Pastry War Märzen Especial
Description: This classic style was originally brewed in Vienna and brought to Mexico by European immigrants in the mid-1800’s after the “Pastry War” between France and Mexico. Ironically, the style fell out of favor in Europe but became a favorite in Mexico. How can anyone pass up an amber that offers a beautiful balance of semi-sweet malt flavors and crisp hop character? Certainly not us. It’s the Mexican equivalent of “Festbier” or “Oktoberfest” - a true classic that many will love. Prost! 5.5%

Name: Cruz Blanca Mexico Calling Lager Especial
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bready, Bright, Fresh, Light, Malty
Description: Some calls are totally worth answering, so kick back and enjoy a Mexican lager brewed with heaps of Vienna malt, subtle hops, and absolutely zero adjuncts. The result is an endlessly refreshing sunny lager with balanced sweetness and light bitterness. Add this to your favorites list!

Name: Indiana City Yacht Rock Wheat Ale
Description: A solid gold hit. Yacht Rock is a smooth wheat ale brewed with orange peels and coriander, then fermented with Belgian witbier yeast. Tonight’s the night. Grab a can and your skipper’s cap, crank up the loggins and sail away. Bon Voyage!

Name: Shadow Boxer Oatmeal Stout
Description: Indy’s premier Stout. Shadow Boxer is a rich full-bodied oatmeal stout, featuring dark roasted malt aroma with hints of vanilla and robust coffee-like flavor. In honor of the brawlers. Fists at your chin. Plant your feet. Jab. Jab. Overhand right. Repeat. Lace up!

Name: Indiana City Shadow Boxer Oatmeal Stout
Description: Shadow Boxer is a rich full-bodied oatmeal stout brewed in honor of the brawlers, featuring dark roasted malt aroma with hints of vanilla and robust coffee-like flavor. Fists at your chin. Plant your feet. Jab. Jab. Overhand right. Repeat. Lace up!

Name: Indiana City Earthworm War DDH IPA
Description: Brewed in the style of a New England IPA, Earthworm War by Indiana City features whirlpool and massive double dry hop additions of Michigan Copper, Falconer Flight, Cascade hops, creating a super fresh, juicy beer with very low hop bitterness. This one's hazier than your head after a spin in the teacups– Juicier than the truth itself. Earthworm War is the third release of twelve in Indiana City's 2018 Craft Brew Doodle Crew series

Name: Indiana City Black Lantern Black IPA
Description: Black Lantern is crafted in the style of an American IPA with an addition of rich roasted malt. It’s a medium-bodied, hop-forward black ale with bright, herbal, earthy hop aroma along with complex resinous hop and mellow malt flavor that finishes smooth. Black Lantern is a beer for the darkest of days and the blackest of nights.

Name: Tomoka Hazy Sunrise Wheat Ale
Description: What’s that glorious golden glow, streaming out from the hazy morning heavens? It’s a light & refreshing Hefeweizen, with a kiss of Florida citrus! Brewed with wheat & pilsner base malts, this easy-drinking beer is great any time of day (with no judgment from us!)

Name: Tomoka Brewing Pumpkin Chai Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Tomoka Tom Yum Gose
Description: Brewed and dry-peppered with 4 different types of hot peppers, and coriander, salt, and lemongrass, the yummy flavors in a spicy thai soup dish!

Name: Tomoka Oceanside White IPA
Description: Originally a collaboration brew we did with Green Room Brewing in JAx Beach, this wheat IPA became part of the line-up due to popular demand. Intensely hoppy, but the wheat base creates a sweet, smooth balance making this an easy-drinking IPA.

Name: Tomoka Twist Of Cane Double Double IPA
Description: Brewed with Fresh-pressed Florida Sugar Cane, this DIPA is a nice balance between malty, hoppy, and dry with a perceived sweetness and mouthfeel!

Name: Tomoka Hop Quest Blood Orange IPA
Atlas Ponzi IPA
Description: An American IPA hopped with criminal disregard. Featuring generous additions of Cascade, Chinook, Centential, Mandarina and Ahtamun hops, followed by hints of Munich malt, Ponzi’s aroma writes checks that its flavor cashes. If it seems too good to be true, you’re probably drinking Ponzi.

Name: Atlas Rowdy Rye
Description: Both fun and aggressive, Rowdy is a hop forward rye ale full of flavor.

Name: Atlas Ninja Sauce
Description: Not your typical Belgian Pale Ale, Ninja Sauce balances tropical Mosaic hops with subtle spice and bright citrus notes from the Belgian yeast. Light bodied, fruity, and ever so drinkable.

Name: Atlas Dance Of Days Pale Ale
Description: Dance of Days is a pale ale generously hopped with beautiful and bright Citra and Mosaic hops. We add wheat malt to the grain bill of the Pale Ale to give the beer a robust body and silk mouth feel that perfectly compliments the floral and citrus flavors from two of our favorite hops. Named in homage to the DC punk scene, this well balanced Pale Ale has hop flavor and aroma for days.

Name: Atlas Blood Orange Gose
Description: Light bodied and effervescent; slightly sour and a touch saline; sweet orange aromas up front followed by faint notes of berry. Atlas’ Blood Orange Gose makes for a beautifully refreshing summer beer. Just enough sourness to quench your thirst on a DC hot summer day. The salinity will keep you coming back for more while the low ABV makes sure you don’t regret it in the morning.

Name: Santa Fe Brewing Happy Camper IPA
Description: A classic beer for those beer lovers who love their hops, Happy Camper IPA will take the Pepsi Challenge (or IPA challenge, as we say in New Mexico) against any other pretenders to the throne. Was it divine providence that made this beer the king of the IPA world? Was it a tireless pursuit of glory? No, this IPA has a top-secret recipe to thank for its success, and this meticulously formulated combination of several different hops combined with a very specific brewing process give Happy Camper IPA a spicy, citric, and floral infusion of hop character, which is masterfully counterbalanced with the full-bodied maltiness characteristic of the Santa Fe Brewing Company’s distinctive beers.

Name: Santa Fe Brewing Imperial Java Stout
Description: This is the kind of beer that gives the word "stout" a reputation. Extra generous quantities of barley malt, followed by vigorous fermentation leaves this "imperial" heavy weight with 8% alcohol A.B.V. and a body as full as chocolate bread pudding. A complimentary and complex array of bitter notes comes form potent American hops, earthy British hops, black-roasted malts and, of course, coffee. Santa Fe Brewing Company uses only top-quality ingredients like organically grown East Timor coffee beans blended with New Guinea coffee beans, locally roasted by O’hori’s Coffee House. Its heavenly flavor and aroma can’t be beat or imitated.

Name: Santa Fe Brewing Social Hour
Description: After a long day of giving 110%, sometimes you just want to give between 49-67% and have social hour with your friends. That’s why we made Social Hour. It’s a hazy, wit-style ale inspired by the classic Zombie cocktail with tropical hints of pineapple, pink guava, coriander and mint. And who knows, maybe one Social Hour will lead to another Social Hour will lead to another Social Hour and suddenly you’re standing on a bar during GABF playing air guitar.

Name: Santa Fe Black IPA
Description: This Black IPA transcends style. The idea is simple, but the flavor is complex. It is everything you want in a great IPA, but with a little bit of chocolate. The crisp, dry punch of hops leaves you wondering how this beer has such a balanced flavor. The secret is Midnight Wheat. Aromas of passion fruit, citrus, and pine cut their way through the dark malts to both titillate and challenge the senses. The dry finish and dark ebony color are distinctive characteristics for this winter seasonal and make for a smooth and approachable beer for the masses.

Name: Santa Fe 7K IPA
Description: 7K IPA is brewed way up in Santa Fe, NM, and is a dry, West Coast-ish style IPA with notes of grapefruit, citrus and tropical flavors. The hop profile combines Simcoe and Mosaic with Eldorado and Amarillo playing backup. On the palate, it starts with a touch of caramel malt sweetness that balances out the hops and finishes with a fruity, slightly resinous hop flavor and clean bitterness. It’s fruity and intense with a clean hop profile and leaner malt base than other IPAs. So if you’re searching for the next great IPA, just look up. Higher. No, higher. There we are.

Name: Santa Fe Brewing Oktoberfest
Description: Though it is not necessary to drink this beer out of a mug that is larger than your head while dancing to polka music and wearing your lederhosen, you will find this lager's unbridled festivity difficult to resist. This ode to Germany's classic fall lagers is as clean, clear, and quaffable as any that has ever weighed down the table of a German Beer garden. The crisp maltiness of classic Munich malt compounded with the delicious notes of Bavarian hops gives this clean-finishing beer just the right flavor for the end of the summer.

Name: Riverwalk Citrabus
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Is it a pale ale? Is it an IPA? The versatile CitraBus defies definition with a jacked-up flavor profile in a format that can be enjoyed anywhere along the Riverwalk: A fancy dinner– you betcha! A backyard BBQ– check! Jumping out of a plane dressed as a Civil War colonel? Suuuure, if that’s what you’re into. Point is, the winning combination of Citra and Columbus hops ensures that wherever you may need a beer, the CitraBus will deliver.

Name: Riverwalk Bitter Growlette
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Amber 32 oz Beer "Growlette®" Growler    Pricing includes one color imprint $2.95 each  Orders less than 144 add $1.00 each  Minimum Order 96  Set up $100.00 first color, 50.00 each additional color  Each additional color per item $0.75 (up to 4)  Imprint size 4"h x 4.25"w per side  Wrap imprint dimensions 4" x 9"

Name: Riverwalk Jersey Street IPA
Description: What was old is new, and what's new becomes old again, as nostalgia makes way for fresh ideas and classics that stand the test of time. This beer was born at the intersection of tradition and innovation, using Citra, Mosaic, and El Dorado hops in a unique process developed over time. Like it's namesake, this beer represents a fresh take rooted in a long legacy. It's a destination worth seeking out, and we hope to see you there.

Name: Riverwalk Stratabus New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: RiverWalk Turbine Double Double IPA
Description: Brewed in celebration of our new wind-powered brewery! This DIPA is loaded with Vic Secret hops creating big notes of pineapple and lemon citrus. Big on flavor with a soft mouthfeel, Turbine showcases the possibilities of our new space.

Name: RiverWalk Screen Door Summer Ale
Description: Just like putting on the screen door, the arrival of this beer is cause for celebration. It’s a signal that summer has finally arrived! We open our doors, our windows, our hearts and our minds. In that spirit, we’ve created a bright extra pale ale that delivers full flavors of citrus and hop goodness without wrecking the palate. Brewed with pilsner and wheat malts, it’s our refreshing approach to a true summer ale.

Name: Scofflaw Dirty Beaches Tropical Wheat
Description: WE GOT DOWN AND DIRTY WITH OUR TROPICAL WHEAT. A SPIRITED COLLAB WITH VICTORY BRANDS. THIS HYBRID WHEAT & IPA WHETS YOUR PALATE. JUST LIKE YOU BEACHES LIKE IT. EASY DRINKING WITH A SOFT CREAMY BODY AND WAVES OF TROPICAL FRUIT AROMAS. DIRTY BEACHES IS FILTHY GOOD.

Name: Scofflaw Double Jeopardy Double IPA
Description: THIS JUICY DOUBLE IPA IS WORTH THE RISK! TROPICAL HOPS LEAD DJ’S INTENSE CITRUS FLAVOR AND AROMA, THEN FINISHES WITH A BITTERSWEET BOOZY TINGLE. ITS ONLY OFFENSE IS NOT BEING TRIED TWICE, SO IF CONVICTED, BEWARE OF THE BLACKOUT!

Name: Scofflaw Hooligan IPA
Description: IF YOU CAN PIN DOWN A HOOLIGAN, YOU'LL GET PUNCHED-UP AROMAS FROM MOSAIC AND CALYPSO WITH NOTES OF PASSION FRUIT, MANGO, AND PINEAPPLE. A TRUE OUTLIER... THIS COMPLEX IPA IS OUR BREWERS GO-TO.

Name: Scofflaw Basement IPA
Description: SHHHH!!! DON'T ASK WHAT IS HAPPENING IN THE BASEMENT! DEVELOPED IN OUR ORIGINAL UNDERGROUND BREWERY, THIS JUICY AND DANK IPA IS LOADED WITH CITRA HOPS IN EVERY SIP. BUT YOU HAVE TO LEAVE YOUR PARENT'S BASEMENT TO GET IT.

Name: Scofflaw POG Basement IPA
Description: MEET BASEMENT’S OUTGOING LITTLE BROTHER. A LITTLE LESS BUSINESS, A LOT MORE PARTY. WE ADD IN PASSIONFRUIT, ORANGE AND GUAVA FOR A BIG ASS TROPICAL KICK TAKING YOU OUT OF THE BASEMENT AND STRAIGHT TO THE ISLANDS

Name: Scofflaw Hard Seltzer Variety
Description: SELTZER IS EASY ON THE CALORIES AND CARBS, BUT MAKING A SELTZER ACTUALLY TASTE GREAT IS HARD. OUR HARD SELTZER HAS 5% ABV, MINIMAL CARBS AND ALMOST NO SUGAR. DEFINITELY NO HINTS OR ESSENCES, JUST REAL NATURAL FLAVOR. YOU'RE WELCOME.

Name: Brau Brothers White Cap Crystal Wit
Description: Light in color, big in flavor. White Cap is a thoughtful blend of wheat, pale malt, coriander, and orange peel. Fermented cold, a traditional Belgian yeast provides classic notes of banana and bubblegum, with muted clove essence.

Name: Brau Brothers Hopsession Super Pale Ale
Brau Brothers Bancreagie Sour Peated Ale
Brau Brother Barrel & Bog Sour Ale
Description: Big, dark ale aged in used whiskey barrels for several months. Soured, and finished with brett and cranberry.

Name: Brau Brothers Moo Joos Oatmeal Milk Stout
Description: Moo Joos blends the body and sweetness of a milk stout with the satin mouthfeel of a classic oatmeal stout.  Together, they contribute subtle complexities that build a unique, yet extremely drinkable dark ale.

Name: Amstel Light
Description:
Amstel Light beer is a lager beer with less calories, a refreshing taste and a mild bitterness.

Founded in 1870, for almost 150 years Amstel has brewed a unique beer for all those people and moments in life so valuable they should be savoured and so good they must be shared

Name: Rock Art Vermont Maple Wheat
Description: Each season we brew this wheat ale with real Vermont maple syrup. The ale is light golden color just like real maple syrup. This has a light maple flavor with a mildly sweet body. Pale, wheat and carapils malts are used with Tettnanger and Cascade hops and pure Vermont Maple Syrup.

Name: Rock Art Nawch Hoppa Double IPA
Description: Nawch Hoppa is a really nice double IPA with an earthy quality and prominent notes of pine and resin. Prominent Hops include Falconer and Amarillo

Name: Rock Art Twin Tip
Description: Twin Tip is our winter seasonal Double IPA and features crystal malts which give it a slightly sweeter and darker amber malt body. The Chinook and Amarillo hops are featured in this Double IPA, giving it hints of grapefruit, citrus, and pine.

Name: Eagle Rock Manifesto Witbier
Description: The soul of a beer belongs to Yeast. Magical organisms breathing life into liquid. Transforming sugar into vibrancy and effervescence. Rousing your senses to explore.

Name: Eagle Rock Stimulus Intelligentsia Coffee
Description: Stimulus is a 7% Belgian Amber made with Intelligentsia Coffee. The idea was to make a coffee beer that wasn’t black in color, and did more than just accentuate a “roasty” flavor. The coffees produced by Intelligentsia are so nuanced and flavorful that we wanted to accentuate those flavors and find complementary components we could draw on in the beer.

Name: Eagle Rock Yearling American Sour Ale
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Yearling is Eagle Rock’s take on a Flanders Red sour ale that sees the inside of wine barrels for a year to develop it’s tartness and oaky flavors. Brewed in celebration of the anniversary of Eagle Rock Brewery.

Name: Eaglerock Populist IPA
Description: Honoring the tradition of the West-Coast IPA, this beer has the bright aroma of orange blossoms and hints of pine needles. A brisk but smooth bitterness is balanced by a sturdy malt frame, enabling the delicate fruity character of the hops to shine through.

Name: Eagle Rock Umlaut
Description: Pilsneresque ale. A German inspired American ale; somewhere between here and there; or Pilsner and Kolsch; or brisk and refreshing

Name: Delirium Tremens
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: This strong Belgian pale ale is a lot more fun than the name implies. (The name—Delirium Tremens— actually refers to the confusion and jitters that can come with alcohol withdrawal.) Applauded across the globe as one of the best beers in the world, Delirium Tremens Beer pours clear and golden with a voluminous white head. Boasting sweet and fruity banana, citrus, and clove notes, the beer is vaguely reminiscent of a Hefeweizen, but with a more tart edge. With reviews that range from luscious and malty to smooth and spicy, we suggest you try this complex “world’s best beer” for yourself. Its ceramic bottle and blue label (sporting a pink elephant) help make it distinctly recognizable.

Name: Delirium Red
Description: Colour and sight: Deep dark red colour, with a light pink, compact and lacing head. Scent: Soft fruity aroma, with hints of almond and mildly sour cherries. Flavour: Sweet and fruity, with a nice balance between sweet and sour. An excellent dessert beer.

Name: Delirium Noel
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: This beer is reddish brown with a tiny bubbled white lace. It has a smooth and creamy mouth feel that builds on the palate with flavors of yeast, fruit, and spice. A nice beer to drink with grilled meat and cheeses.

Name: Delirium Nocturnum
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Food Pairing: Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy
Description: Colour and sight: Dark brown-red. A compact white-yellow, stable and lacing head. Scent: Touches of caramel, mocha and chocolate. Spices such as liquorice and coriander are also present. Flavour: Initially, a very good mouthfeel of alcohol and softness. This is followed by an increasing bitterness, partially from the hop, but also from the roasted malt and chocolate malt. Towards the end a nice balance between bitterness, sour and sweet.

Name: Delirium Deliria
Description: Brewed by women, this heavy blonde beer has 8.5% ABV and second fermentation in the bottle. This beer has a pale blonde colour and fine, white creamy and lacing foam. The aroma is very balanced, with a fruity and flowery background and a first impression of chardonnay, that further evolves to a spicy, mild hop aroma. The flavour is very balanced with fruity notes of apple and chardonnay grapes. Deliria has a fine, mildly bitter aftertaste and a wonderful, round mouth feeling with a nice evolution.

Name: Spencer Trappist Ale
Description: Spencer Trappist Ale

Name: Spencer Monks Reserve Ale
Description: Fragrant, robust, and full bodied, this classic Trappist Quadrupel is mahogany in color and crowned with a dense, tan, frothy head. Its multi-forward flavor profile yields to a warm finish.

Name: Spencer Trappist Imperial Stout
Description: A massive, roasted, malt-forward American Trappist take on the Anglo-Russo Imperial Stout tradition.  Luxuriantly frothy foam, waves of coffee, chocolate and caramel sensations, a generous blend of dark fruit flavors.  Intense and robust.

Name: Spencer Monks’ IPA
Description: Our slightly hazy IPA made in small batches each month to ensure freshness. It is brewed with Citra, Mosaic, Amarillo, and Simcoe hops. It is a very drinkable IPA at only 30 IBUs.

Name: Spencer Premium Pilsner
Description: Straw colored with a light, creamy head, Spencer Premium Pilsner is an authentic German-style Pilsner. Traditional noble German hops provide herbal notes, a floral nuance and the classic closing bitterness. Crisp, clean and refreshing - perfect after a day at work.

Name: Sound Dubbel Entendre
Description: Comforting aromas of chocolate malt and dark toffee, with a hint of banana and stone fruits. A dark abbey style ale with a subtle rich maltiness and a dry, spicy finish. *** 2012 NABA Silver Medal Winner. Availability: Bottles and Draft

Name: Sound Tripel Entendre
Description: Complexity and balance from a simple recipe of the finest ingredients obtainable. Clear and light in color, this strong Belgian ale drinks smooth and easy but has the complexity to complement the finest meals or to savor alone at the end of the evening. *** 2012 US Beer Open Gold Medal Winner.

Name: Mortal Kombat Raiden Imperial Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This amped up Imperial Saison has a blast of hops and CO2 that will hit your tongue with a bang. The aroma jumps out of the glass with its earthly and herbal notes not far behind.

Name: Dieu du Ciel Isseki Nicho Imperial Dark Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This "Imperial Dark Saison" is a collaboration between DDC and Shiga Kogen. It has the grain bill of an Imperial Stout, hops grown at Shiga Kogen and is fermented with Saison yeast.

Name: Dieu du Ciel Peche Mortel
Description: Péché Mortel (French for "Mortal Sin") is an intensely black and dense beer with very pronounced roasted flavours. Fair trade coffee is infused during the brewing process, intensifying the bitterness of the beer and giving it a powerful coffee taste. Péché mortel is brewed to be savored; we invite you to drink it in moderation.

Name: Dieu du Ciel Grande Noirceur
Description: The Grande Noirceur is an intensely black and dense beer with pronounced roasted flavours. The bitterness is very imposing but is balanced by a malty-caramel taste. The alcohol content is quite high, but its presence remains discrete in this beer.

Name: Dieu du Ciel Aphrodite
Description: Black ale with aromas and flavours of vanilla, dark chocolate, bourbon and roasted malt. The vanilla and cocoa marry nicely, without out-competing each other, to produce a surprisingly well balanced beer. This beer is mildly hoppy, but the cocoa introduces a touch of bitterness. Its colour may be intimidating, but it is a very smooth beer within reach of most beer drinkers. This highly appreciated dessert beer is brewed with organic fair-trade cocoa and first rate vanilla beans.

Name: Dieu Ciel Penombre Black IPA
Description: Black IPA. Again, an american invention. This style was born at the "Vermont pub and brewery" around 1997. It could be said that this beer tries to be an hybrid between a regular IPA and a porter. The Pénombre presents a light body and well expressed tofferaction tastes. The whole is however dominated by an evident bitterness, which stays always in balance with the other tates found in the beer. In the after taste, the bitterness and hops flavours are growing slowly dut surely, sip after sip.

Name: Dieu du Ciel Rose de Hibiscus
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: The Rosée d’Hibiscus is a soft spoken wheat beer. The rose colour comes from the hibiscus flowers added during the brewing process. The aromas and flavour of this tropical flower are very prominent in the beer, giving it a slight acidity and a very agreeable fragrance. It is the perfect thirst quencher on a hot summer day.

Name: Logsdon Farmhouse Seizoen Bretta
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This unfiltered seizoen is naturally refermented and carbonated with select yeast strains, producing fruity and spicy flavors that are balanced by hops and a soft malt character. Special Brettanomyces yeast provides added dryness and crisp complexity.

Name: Logsdon Peche ‘n Brett
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Our Seizoen Bretta oak aged and loaded with tons of local organic peaches (a pound and a half per gallon).

Name: Logsdon Fresh Hop Seizoen
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Fresh Hop Beer 2011 - We spent the hot summer day hand selecting 9 varieties of organic hops growing at our friends Eric and Jennifer Miller Larch Creek Farms in Dufur, Oregon. We drove them straight to the brewery and loaded up our conditioning tank with Seizoen and all the fresh hops we could stuff in.

Name: Logsdon Farmhouse Far West Vlaming
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Our organic red ale is brewed in traditional West Flanders style. A combination of light, crystal, and dark barley malt, wheat, and oats are brewed with local whole-cone hops and a variety of select yeast and lactic bacteria. We age our red ale in oak barrels for a period of time to develop complex richness, soft tannins, and fruity tart character. The aged beer is then blended with young beer to create the desired balance of malt sweetness with a dry finish.

Name: Logsdon Cerasus Kriek Organic
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A Flanders-style Red Ale, oak-aged, with 45 pounds of local cherries per barrel.

Name: Logsdon The Conversion
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Home About Contact Beer Locator. U.S.A & Canada Our Beers Food Paring Photo Gallery The Team In The News & Testimonial Tasting Room Our Farm Animals Europe Distributors Breweries in the Gorge Links PRESS HR Photos Logsdon Farmhouse Ales ​Logsdon Barrel House & Taproom    Only on tap for now    Monikken Kruin Quadruple. This is a malt heavy beer brewed in tghe Trappist tradition with our signature Northwest farmhouse twist. This 2015 holiday cheer is made using Nothwest organic pilsner and crystal malts and whole groat oats. Monikken Kruin is dry for the style, yet rich with carmel maltiness and balanced with a generous addition of Northwest hop varieties. Translated as "The Monks Tonsure", or Monk's bald head, this beer pays homage to the biggest and best of the Abbey spirit from our farm to you. ​8.0% ABV  Only on tap for now   The Conversion - Series 2 This sour wit is the second beer in our Conversion Northwest Sour Ale series. It is a white beer that is brewed in the farmhouse tradition and opened to fermentation from a variety of wild yeast and lactic bacteria. The Conversion series represents our transition to wild ales; tart and juicy with lots of traditional farmhouse goodness - Our conversion to the wild side.

Name: Blaugies Saison D’epeautre
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Brasserie De Blaugies Fantome Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Blaugies La Vermontoise
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Collaboration with Hill Farmstead. A spelt saison with American hops.

Name: Brasserie de Blaugies Biere Darbyste
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Ale brewed with fig juice. A traditional style named for John Darby, preacher of temperance whose parishioners were oddly moved by a "soft drink" they insisted was just fig juice...

Name: Blaugies La Moneuse Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Blaugies La Moneuse Special Winter Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Mystic Brewery Wave Break
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Introducing Wave Break our extra hopped Table Beer. Dry hopped with Santiam and Perle, creating a crisp, refreshing take on Table Beer. Brewed for those summer months to come.

Name: Mystic Television IPA
Description: This IPA is hopped with Azacca, Amarillo, and Santiam. It’s got big flavors of grapefruit, orange rind, and lemon zest with a slight bitter finish.

Name: Mystic Grapefruit Frappe
Description: Grapefruit Frappe uses a massive amount of Ruby Red Grapefruit with lactose and Mosaic hops to support it. This beer is pleasantly tart with soft, full mouthfeel.

Name: Mystic Brewery Von Lune Helles
Description: Helles Lager from our later alter ego, Von Lüne Lagers. Light, crisp, and refreshing.

Name: Wild Beer Company Somerset Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Epic by name, epic by nature, this Farmhouse Ale is a transcontinental fusion of Belgium’s eclectic beer culture and the feisty hops of North America brought to life with the aid of West Country artisanal brewing wizardry and judicious use of the US-grown Sorachi Ace hop. On the nose, the hops deliver a big splash of tropical fruit, followed by ripples of well-seasoned spiciness spreading outwards. In the mouth a tangy, bittersweet fruitiness holds sway, while tangerine oranges tap dance their way across the tongue in the finish. Also Marketed under the Alias: Somerset Saison.

Name: Wild Beer Company Iduna Cru
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: When we think of England, we think of classic pints drawn from casks, we think of tradition. But the guys at England's Wild Beer Company are into edgier, tradition-bucking stuff. According to importer Lime Ventures, the idea for this brewery--an incubator, if you will, for new brews experimenting with yeasts, bacterias, barrels, fruit, spices and the like--was born over glasses of Jolly Pumpkin La Roja and Gale's Prize Old Ale. Their Iduna Cru is a Saison-style brew that uses hops from New Zealand and Somerset=grown apple juice. Using wild yeast, the beer is round and fruity, sweet and dry.

Name: Wild Beer Company Bliss
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: We love nothing better than Belgian-style saison but with this blissful version we’ve added our own Wild interpretation of the style by adding a dash of funky Brettanomyces yeast plus roasted apricots and a hush-hush blend of spices. All of this makes for an extraordinary beer with an array of aromas that leap out of the glass followed by a spicy, fruity, tart and peppery palate and a long lingering finish.

Name: Wild Beer Evolver IPA
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: The exploration of yeast strains and the different results we can achieve are beautifully exemplified in Evolver, a pale ale with a difference. 100% fermented with Brettanomyces. For the first 3 months the beer tastes the same as a fresh pale ale, then the differing flavour compounds start to shine through and after 6 months the Brett really takes hold.  The brettanomyces yeast is particularly good at keeping hop flavours fresh for far longer than traditional brewing yeasts. The Evolver takes on a more complex character over time as the yeast and the hops combine to produce a new and exciting beer that will continue to evolve as the yeast slowly matures the beer.   This is a beer that can be drunk fresh, as a normal pale ale or left to evolve and mature into a unique and unusual beer.

Name: The Wild Beer Co Somerset Wild
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: The Wild Beer Smoke N Barrel 750ml
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Bottle & keg; Seasonal - Spring (but available year round in bottle). Previously 4.0%. Editor’s note: It is not known when the increase in abv took place so it is not practicable to consider splitting the listing for this beer.  Lager + Smoking + Rosemary + Sage + Cherry Wood.  Smoke infused larger... yes please! A smoked lager from our home built smoker using retired 500L sherry butts to infuse malt with cherry wood smoke, rosemary and sage. Delicate, sweet smokiness with a hint of the herbaceous - as refined and crisp as you could wish for.

Name: Une Annee Tripel Ale
Description: The Tripel is often considered the most approachable of Belgian ales. An exhuberant flaxen hue, ours has a medium body with big fruit flavors, moderate spice and hints of American Bravo and Willamette hops poking through.

Name: Une Annee Le Seul XVI
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Une Annee Freres Bangers & Lace
Description: This Cascara Wit is brewed in collaboration with Bangers & Lace and HalfWit Coffee Roasters, our brothers behind the bar, helping to promote great beer. Cascara cherries are added to bring complexity.

Name: Une Annee Maya
Description: A Chicago Brewery focused on making great beer with an emphasis on Belgian and French styles. Founded early 2012, Une Année is brewing at a location in the Kinzie Industrial Corridor and is available at most better bottle shops, bars and restaurants throughout Illinois and Wisconsin.

Name: SoMe Brewing Templeton Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: SoMe Brewing Mainely Pale Ale
Description: Brewed with 100% Maine grown and Malted 2-Row, Oats, and Wheat from Maine Maltsters. This Pale is crushable at 5% and very hoppy.

Name: Trinity Elektrick Cukumbahh
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: It’s officially summer and that means cucumbers are just starting to come into harvest. Cool cukes are such a nice cooling summer treat, and we decided to make a summer Saison with them. Adding ~24lbs of English cucumbers per barrel, and just enough lemon zest to lend an overall brightness to the beer, this recipe is certain to become an epic summer time favorite.

Name: Trinity Saison Beams
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Trinity Mr Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
