Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Trinity Chocolate River Stout
Description: Just in time to keep you warm during the colder months of winter! It's body is huge, it's dark malt character is huge, it's hop profile is gigantic, and it's ABV is enormous. It's basically everything that you would expect from a noteworthy Imperial Stout,and more! We brew this beer with rich milk chocolate then age it on whole Madagascar Vanilla Beans and Dagoba Cacao Nibs.

Name: Trinity Rhode Island IPA
Description: The first I.P.A. available throughout Rhode Island since Ballantine I.P.A. The most bitter of the Pale Ale family, India Pale Ales malty flavor is accented by fruity aromas, a dry bitter finish and bright copper color. Unfiltered.

Name: Crown Valley Big Bison Barrel Age
Description: Our famous Big Bison Ale has been aged in our very own Missouri Moonshine whiskey barrels, straight from our distillery to the Brewery. The charred oak characteristics add some vanilla and oak flavors to our already exceptional Belgian style Dubbel.

Name: Crown Valley Serrano Sidekick
Description: Spicy with light earth tones and a very slight roasty character; overall light mouth feel.

Name: Crown Valley Gunslinger IPA
Description: This beer is known for its robust, malty, alcoholic, and intense hop profile. We balanced the rich malt flavor with powerful hop notes from the use of five different hop styles.

Name: Crown Valley Coffman Coffee
Description: This Coffee Porter is full-bodied and smooth with coffee added and rich undertones of chocolate malt.

Name: Crown Valley Gingerbread Cider
Description: Gingerbread cookie flavored cider.

Name: Crown Valley Big Bison Barrel Age
Description: Our famous Big Bison Ale has been aged in our very own Missouri Moonshine whiskey barrels, straight from our distillery to the Brewery. The charred oak characteristics add some vanilla and oak flavors to our already exceptional Belgian style Dubbel.

Name: Amager/Prairie Collaboration Tulsa Twister
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Amager Cigar City iquic
Description: Who Xiquic was, is a bit hard to explain - but we all know the hero twins: Wayne Wambles and Jacob Storm - headbrewers of Cigar City Brewing in Tampa, FL and Amager Bryghus, Denmark respectively. Since his first visit at Amager back in 2011 Wayne has been quite the idol for us. We don’t believe it’s possible to find anyone with a bigger heart in brewing - combined with the utmost passion and sense for detail. Therefore it was a great honor to us that Wayne accepted our invitation to come brew at Amager Bryghus - even on his birthday! A recipe was created from what seemed like an endless stream of emails. The Cigar City signature cedar wood was ordered and a birthday cake was baked. We had a fun day - we hope you’ll have fun enjoying this double mash cedar infused black pepper Imperial Stout, yeah, no kiddin’. It’s a bit of a beast - but a gentle one.

Name: Amager Bryghus/Evil Twin The Real Hr. Frederiksen
Description: A spiced collaboration edition between Amager Bryghus and Evil Twin of the Amager signature beer Hr. Frederiksen. In this version with vanilla, chili pepper and cinnamon added.

Name: Amager Bryghus Hr. Frederiksens Væsel Brunch
Description: Collaboration blend with Mikkeller/Amager. A blend of Hr.Fredriksens (Amager) and Beer Geek Brunch Weasel (Mikkeller) - then aged in Bourbon barrels.

Name: Amager The Dank Dane
Description: "Dank as a Dane" is said to be local slang for the exceptionally sweaty and smelly young Danish backpackers that you will see touring the Bay Area - and San Francisco in particular. Riding a BART, chasing street cars, gasping their way up hilly boulevards, insisting to jog the Golden Gate or climbing prison islands. You know the drill… However, modern day hipster backpackers are also said to be fond of their hoppy beers which is why they may theoretically end up with a very exhausted look on their faces while enjoying a huge glass of quenching IPA at San Francisco’s by far coolest, new brewpub, Cellarmaker. This spring we had the pleasure of a brewing visit from Tim Sciascia and Connor Casey of Cellarmaker fame. The collaboration beer we brewed we tried to keep in the tradition that has gained Cellarmaker a reputation for being one of California’s finest new breweries: lots of hops yes, but subtle, delicate, balanced and highly drinkable. We hope that you’ll find "The Dank Dane" to be exactly that.

Name: Brouwerij Alvinne Gaspar Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Gaspar is one of the hoppiest beers in Belgium. Unfiltered, unpasteurized, bottle conditioned with a well balanced, complex hop aroma and a long lasting sparkling hop bitter finish. Serve cool (54° F) in a tulip-glass. 18° Plato; 20 EBC; 115 IBU (Hallertau, Goldings and Saaz)

Name: Brouwerij Alvinne Extra IPA
Description: Brewed with Chinook and Amarillo.   DISCLAIMER: This is a new version of the "Alvinne Extra", introduced in 2008. If you had an older version, you should rate "Alvinne Extra Bitter".

Name: Brouwerij Alvinne Wild West Blackthorne
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Oak aged beer (Wild West), we’ve added 15 kg of sloeberries (Blackthorn) to every barrel (Bordeaux wine barrels).

Name: Brouwerij Alvinne Undressed Brown Ale
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Almost unhoped brown ale, the base for Morpheus Wild and Kerasus, undressed. For the fans of the true ‘oud bruin’ style.

Name: Brouwerij Alvinne Kriek Van Mortagne
Description:
Blend of Kerasus and Cuvée de Mortagne aged on red wine barrels (usually Bordeaux, mostly St-Emelion, Pomerol or Margeaux), with cherries added straight to the barrel.

Alvinne is a 1200hl microbrewery in Flanders, Belgium. It has become an official brewery in 2004 and is located in the village of Moen, at the edge of the Mortagne touristic area and in the area where the historic breweries of the old Flemish Brown beerstyle are situated. Their own yeast strain is called ‘Morpheus’ and was the reason to start experimenting with mixed fermentation, resulting in sour ales. Alvinne’s main mission is now to create innovative sour beers through a new style of Flemish blond sours by using the mixed fermentation method. You could call it the missing link between Oud Bruin and Lambic. Because of this, Alvinne has gained international attention and respect. We already experimented with over 30 different kinds of fruits, herbs, plants, berries, flowers and vegetables. Next to the sour range, Alvinne has an interesting beer list that were aged on carefully selected used barrels, such as Cognac, Porto, Sherry, Calvados, Brandy, Red Wine and White Wine.

Name: Brouwerij Alvinne Podge Belgian Imperial Stout
Description: Specially brewed for Belgian beer enthusiast, tour guide, and CAMRA activist Chris Pollard, AKA Podge.

Name: Griffin Claw Lou Lelemon
Description: Made with Yuzu Lemons

Name: Griffin Claw You Figure It Out
Description: We had to beg Dan to make this and it turned out awesome! Rich, dark, and velvety smooth, we added hints of coconut and vanilla to our milk stout to remind you of the tropical vacation you forgot to take this year. Guaranteed to cure what ails you!

Name: Griffin Claw Norms Raggedy Ass IPA
Description: Golden in color this pale ale features true English hop character, flavor and bitterness. Medium bodied with a slight malt character that compliments the fruity esters and intense hop aroma.

Name: Griffin Claw Screamin Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Our autumn seasonal. An Amber Ale brewed with roasted pumpkin in the mash then spiced with ginger, allspice, nutmeg and cloves. Spicy and refreshing. A great tail gating beer.

Name: Modist Dream Yard American IPA
Description: A juicy hazy American IPA made from oats and wheat. A New England IPA meets a 100% wheat malt bill. Fantastically hazy with aromas of apricot, peach, and citrus. Over 3.5 lbs of Citra, Bravo, and Ella hops per barrel make this beer an incredibly juicy and citrusy treat with an approachable level of bitterness.

Name: Modist False Pattern Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Modist Wouldst Thou Like To Live Deliciously Stout
Description: Stout brewed with golden promise, peanuts, cocoa nibs, and milk sugar.

Name: Space Junk IPA Modist Brewing
Description: A Double Dry-Hopped Cream IPA brewed with malted oats, malted wheat, and milk sugar. Dry-hopped and double dry-hopped with our hand-selected Sabro, Galaxy, and Strata.

Name: Modist Double Ghost Vision IPA
Description: Made entirely of oat and wheat malts - then massively dry hopped with citra, then massively dry hopped with citra. It’s an aromatic AF haze bomb thats crazy smooth

Name: Modist Shook Mango Milkshake IPA
Description: Oats + barley + milk sugar + vanilla beans + tons of mango + tons of Citra and Mosaic hops.

Name: Westbound & Down Colorado Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: American IPA full of citrus nose with dry hopping with Cascade, Simcoe, Centennial and Citra hops that are balanced with formidable malt flavor from Maris Otter malts

Name: Westbound & Down Mocha Imperial Stout
Description: Blending two different roasts from Sweet Bloom gives a bouquet of nougat, caramel and almond toffee. The liquid cacao provides layers of smooth semi-sweet chocolate.

Name: Westbound & Down Coconut Imperial Stout
Description: From the brownie-batter-essque base to the luscious toasted coconut and marshmallow flavors, this stout is a dessert in a glass. Chocolate forward flavors with no signs of roast.

Name: Westbound & Down Double IPA
Description: A ludicrous amount of Vic Secret, Galaxy, Mosaic, and Cryo Mosaic hops pack big aroma of tangerine, blueberry, papaya, and other tropical fruits. Even with all of those hops you do get a nice sweet biscuit malt profile, that ends in a clean dry finish.

Name: Westbound & Down Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Moosehead Lager
Description: A smooth clean-tasting lager that offers a good balance between malt sweetness and hop bitterness.

Name: Alpine Lager
Description: Created and brewed by 4th generation P.W. Oland, this was the first lager brewed by Moosehead Breweries in 1937. This classic lager is light-coloured, medium-bodied, and made with Styrian Golding and Nugget hops.

Name: Moosehead Lager 13.2 Gallon
Description: Kegs are intended for Kegerator use only. TAP NOT INCLUDED.  NOTE: An additional deposit charge per keg may be placed on your card and adjusted following successful return. A representative from Drizly or the store may contact you to confirm additional details prior to delivery.   Empty barrels will be picked up upon delivery of new kegs. Name: Moosehead Strawberry Lemonade Radler
Description: Our award-winning lager combines with lemonade and strawberry juice for a taste that’s refreshingly different. Developed with 15% real juice and brewed to 4% alcohol by volume, Strawberry Lemonade Radler is the perfect addition to the Moosehead Radler family.

Name: Georgetown Bodhizafa IPA
Description: This IPA gets its light silky texture from rolled oats. The flavor and aroma both express mandarin and citrus all around. Over five pounds of hops per barrel makes this IPA truly Bodhilicious. Gold medal winner in the American Style IPA category at the Great American Beer Festival in 2016!

Name: Georgetown Brewing Lucille IPA
Description: Floral, citrusy and awesome. Anything so innocent and built like that just gotta be named Lucille.

Name: Georgetown Meowsa! DIPA
Description: Medwards says "If you force fed a watermelon a steady diet of mandarin oranges and pineapples and then dropped said watermelon into a wood chipper, the resulting aromas and flavors that came out of the business end of the wood chipper would be the best way to describe this new DIPA.  As much as I dislike the term ‘juicy' this DIPA is very juicy and has very little bitterness for the style.” Straight from the brewer’s mouth.

Name: Georgetown Rogers Pils
Description: Yakima grown Czech-style Sterling hops give this refreshing pilsner a spicy and earthy hop aroma. Malt character is accentuated by a Bavarian Lager Yeast that ferments dry but round and complex.

Name: Georgetown Manny’s Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A careful selection of Northwest hops, premium barley, and our unique yeast give this ale a rich and complex malty middle with a snappy hop finish. Crisp, clean and smooth with hints of citrus and fruit.

Name: Georgetown Citrus Galaxy IPA
Description: Behold, this newly discovered galactic sensation, Citrus Galaxy IPA!  We traveled across the farthest reaches of known space (Georgetown district) to bring you this cosmic array of flavors and aromas that burst with fresh cut oranges, ripened pineapple and mangoes.  So warm up the rockets and prepare yourself for liftoff into this crushable citrus voyage.  Cheers to adventure!

Name: Two Beers Evolutionary IPA
Description: Evo is a showcase Northwest IPA, hopped with Yakima Valley Simcoe, Amarillo and Centennial, then aggressively dry-hopped with Simcoe and Columbus.  Deep copper in color, it boasts a deep floral aroma with strong notes of grapefruit and tangerine citrus on the palate.

Name: Two Beers Fresh Hop IPA
Description: This super seasonal IPA is a Two Beers tradition not to be missed.  A brewery-wide road trip provides us with some the first hops of the Yakima Valley hop harvest. The result is a intoxicatingly aromatic IPA that’s new and exciting every year.

Name: Two Beers Stop Trying To Make Brut Happen IPA
Description: Dry and crisp like a glass of champagne, this boozy beer is a limited release. Get your pints and 4-packs at The Woods.

Name: Oceanside Ale Elevation 83 Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Oceanside Ale Works Funk-N-Delicious Blueberry Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Oceanside Ale Works Funk-N-Delicious Strawberry
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Oceanside Ale Works has broken the mold with this new Strawberry Lambic Style Sour, creating something truly unique. Sweet, sour, and smooth all at once, this brew will tantalize your tastebuds with notes of strawberry jam, sour candies, light hops, and fresh fruit.

Name: Oceanside Ale Works Dude Double IPA
Description: Award winning Oceanside Ale Works micro-brewery serves up Dude Double IPA an American style India Pale Ale from your own back yard.   With a hard hitting bitterness this golden drink pours with a satisfying head. It brings with it an earthy pine aroma, great body and a long finish.

Name: Copper Kettle Milk Stout
Description: A rich and luxurious English style sweet stout brewed with lactose.

Name: Copper Kettle Mexican Chocolate Stout
Description: A dry black ale with dark roasted malt flavors blended with bittersweet chocolate, red Mexican chili peppers, and ground cinnamon for an exotic punch on the palate. Inspired by a 500 year old Aztec recipe for Mexican hot chocolate.

Description: Strikingly bold imperial IPA with a coniferous aroma and flavor

Name: Copper Kettle IPA
Description: Citrus, tropical fruit, and pine all come through in this dank IPA

Name: Superior Pale Ale
Description: Brewed for Northlanders who live near the greatest lake. American hops lend citrus notes to this crisp, clean, and easy drinking pale. Hold fast.

Name: Duluth Coffee Pale Ale
Description: 2019 Great American Beer Festival Gold Medal Winner - America's best outdoor city demands a beer that pushes boundaries. This mildly hopped pale is crafted using single-farm sourced beans from Duluth Coffee Company. Hold Fast.

Name: North Tower Stout
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Stinky, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fruit - Dried, Fruit - Sweet
Description: Bronze medal winner at the World Beer Cup in the Oatmeal Stout category (2018). Malty accents of chocolate, coffee, and dark fruit are balanced with a restrained hop presence in this stouthearted ale.

Name: Caribou Lake IPA
Description: Hop aromas of pine and berry harken to lakes of the far North. A prominent malt backbone balances moderate hop bitterness. Hold fast.

Name: Precious Material Helles Lager
Description: Old Bavaria meets Great Lakes adventure. German hops and Lake Superior water create an invigorating beer - bright and refreshing. Hold fast.

Name: Raspbecrush Tart Wheat Ale With Raspberries
Description: As inviting as a Lake Superior raspberry patch! Raspbecrush is a kettle-soured wheat ale with pail-loads of raspberries. Light, refreshing, and deliciously tart.

Name: Snake River Pale Ale
Description: An American pale brewed with domestic malt and plenty of Cascade hops. Golden in color, it has a citrusy hop flavor which is followed by a crisp, firmly bitter finish. 3 time award winner at Great American Beer Festival & 2 time award winner of World Beer Cup

Name: Snake River Zonker Stout
Description: A rich, well-balanced foreign style stout with a huge amount of roasted barley as well as chocolate, black, and caramel malts. The intense roast character is the main attribute of this black colored beer.  6 time award winner at Great American Beer Festival & 4 time winner at World Beer Cup

Name: Snake River Earned It IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This Vermon….er… New England style “Hazy” IPA is brewed with cryogenically frozen hops, sent to save the world from boredom! Citra, Mosiac, El Dorado and Loral hops come together to make a citrusy and floral aroma. A low bitterness and light malt body make this beer very drinkable.

Name: Snake River Pako’s IPA
Description: This full flavored, fully hop-evident IPA will have the hopheads rejoicing. 6.8% ABV and 60+ IBUs with explosive hop aroma from a pungent Simcoe/columbus blend. Gold Winner at Great American Beer Festival

Name: Snake River Alpha Prime IPA
Description: Alpha Prime is an American IPA. Just the right amount of citrus and pine hop flavor make this beer a refreshing summer IPA. The Galaxy and Comet hops combine to give you an out of this world taste experience.

Name: Snake River Jenny Lake Lager
Description: An amber colored Vienna style lager. An authentic German lager yeast strain insures a mild profile. Imported German malts impart a rich, caramel flavor which is balanced with the subtle use of continental hop varieties. 4 time award winner at Great Americna Beer Festival & award winner of World Beer Cup

Name: Three Magnets Big Truck Stout
Description: We created this beer with perfectly brew Big Truck Organic Espresso and Brimley Stout. We dreamed of the best stout you’ve ever had combined with the best coffee you’ve ever had. We created Big Truck Stout.

Name: 3 Magnets Rain Rain Rain Triple IPA
Description: For our 100th batch we wanted to make something special. So we made a triple version of our best selling beer, 3M Rain IPA. Using over 5 lbs of hops per barrel the beer was brewed for the adventurous puddle jumpers of the Pacifica NW.

Name: Three Magnets Ledge Sesh Ipa
Description: Our IPA brewed for the WA State Legislative session is features a malt base of American pilsner, rolled oats, Munich, and rye. Couple that with a heavy dosing of Amarillo, Citra, Centennial, and Simcoe hops in both whirlpool and dry hopping and you get the perfect beer to forget about politics. Sip and enjoy!

Name: Urban Artifact Sliderule Chocolate Raspberry Gose
Description: A dark gose with 800lbs of raspberries and 7.5gallons of liquid cacao per 30bbl batch.

Name: Urban Artifact Epicurean Salted Rye Gose Beer
Urban Artifact Otto Cycle Balaton Cherry Midwest Tart Ale
Urban Artifact Pocket Watch
Description: A midwest fruit tart ale with 1,000lbs of concord grape, 1,000lbs of red plum, and 1,000 lbs of black currant per 30bbl batch.

Name: Urban Artifact Midwest Fruit Tart Variant
Description: Urban Artifact's rotating Midwest Fruit Tart beer series. Availability of the beer is subject to change based on supplier and retailer inventory.

Name: Boon Oude Geuze
Description: Traditional belgian lambic. 100% spontaneously fermented. Refermented in the bottle. Tart, dry, sparkling and refreshing.

Name: Boon Kriek Mariage Parfait
Description: Kriek Mariage Parfait is an Old Style Kriek of exceptional excellence. 400 g of wild cherries per litre are fermented together with a strong Lambic of spontaneous fermentation and aged on 6,200 litre oak foudres (large wooden casks) for 5 to 6 months. Kriek Mariage Parfait is naturally clarified and referments in the bottle. It is unsweetened, unfiltered, unpasteurised and has no artificial flavours, preservatives or colourings added. Brewed in Lembeek, the village that gave Lambic its name. Pour slowly in a flute glass without disturbing the yeast sediment in the bottle and enjoy this epitome of traditional Lambic brewing.

Name: Brouwerij Boon Oude Geuze A L’ancienne Vat 92
Boon Oude Geuze Mono Blend Vat 110
Description: VAT 110 owes its slightly dry but very full-bodied flavor, with a hint of vanilla and dry fruit, thanks to foeder no. 110. This foeder used to serve as a cognac cask and has been used as a Lambic cask by our brewery since 2009. This Traditional Old Geuze is characterised by a wealth of flavours that developed from by the Brettanomyces yeast strains in the cask.

Name: Oude Geuze Boon Black Label
Description: The balanced sourness, flavors of green apples and grapefruit and a long bone-dry finish characterise this this geuze. The Lambics used for this blend are aged for 1, 2 & 3 years on oak casks.

Name: Boon Oude Geuze Mono Blend Vat 109
Description: Aged in barrel Nr 109  - ex Cognac barrel (4th fill, previous fills were blended into geuze, because the cognac flavours were too noticeable)

The holidays are right around the corner and our latest beer is your perfect holiday companion.
Meet: #GBL - Gingerbread Latte!

This warming winter beer is brewed with gingerbread spices, molassas, vanilla, brown sugar, lactose and a healthy dose of @novocoffee . If you like #PSL this is going to be your new favorite winter beer!

Name: Barreled Souls Currantly Blacked Out

Name: Barreled Souls Maple Pour Over
Description: An Oatmeal Stout brewed with Coffee and Maple Syrup.

Name: Barreled Souls Hip Hops Are F%*#ing Dead
Description: A triple IPA in collaboration with Finback brewery with Nelson Sauvin, El Dorado and Citra Hops.

Name: Mother Earth – Sin Tax – Imperial Peanut Butter Stout
Description: DON’T LET IT FOOL YOU. This is an imperial stout first and foremost. Deep dark malts lend espresso notes and British crystal malts contribute the perfect toffee and caramel flavor. A dry finish with molasses character compliments of brown cane sugar, and just enough residual sugar to finish full-bodied but never cloying. The peanut butter is simply featured to augment what is already there…a fantastic example of a legendary beer style.

Name: Mother Earth – Primordial – Imperial IPA
Description: Constituting a beginning; giving origin to something derived or developed; original." Need we say more? True to its Imperial roots! This brew clocks in at 9.5% ABV, and over 100 IBUs! It is made with four varieties of grains resulting in a bold dark amber color and four varieties of hops, creating a subtle citrus aroma, and bitter, hoppy finish. Winner of a gold medal at the 2009 Santa Cruz National Organic Challenge, this recipe surely will not disappoint

Name: Mother Earth – Big Mother – Triple IPA
Tasting Notes: Blueberry, Pineapple, Rose Petal, Strong, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description:
AN EVER-CHANGING RECIPE WITH EACH VINTAGE, Big
Mother is everything you expect from a IIIPA: Big, but not too boozy, massively hopped, and just enough malt character to balance the higher alcohol and lingering bitterness. A whirlpool and dry hop assault lends aromas and flavors of apricot, navel oranges, red grapefruit, and papaya.

Name: Mother Earth – Hop Diggity – Double IPA
Description: This DIPA is a bad ass. Straight up. It’s hopiness isn’t just limited to the floral nose or lingering bitterness but a full hop flavor all the way through your palate. We bitter with a Super Alpha, and follow it up with a few flavoring additions throughout the boil. A massive dry hop of Simcoe and Amarillo create a huge aroma profile that really comes through in a big way

Name: Mother Earth Kismet IPA
Description: This IPA will “wow” those tastebuds and wake up your nose! Fruitiness in the aroma and a mango-like finish from the NZ Nelson hops used are sure to get you to believe in fate!

Name: 903 Brewers Land Of Milk And Honey
903 Brewers Sasquatch Imperial Chocolate Milk Stout
903 Brewers Cerveza Por Favor
Description: Straw in color, our Mexican Cerveza has a crisp, clean flavor profile. Lightly hopped, with a great balance between malt and bitterness, with a touch of citrus aroma. Thirst quenching, this brew is best served ice-cold with slice of lime.

Name: 903 Brewers Republic Of Texas
Description: Bringing the smooth crisp taste of a light pisner with all the flavor and complexety of a easy drinking light lager, the Republic of Texas doesn't hold back on flavor. Its beautiful light gold color and array of deep rich malt flavor makes for the perfect easy drinking light craft beer.

Name: 903 Brewers Rotating Beer Series
Description: At 903 Brewers, when we come to our wit’s end... we add passionfruit to it! At the heart of our passionfruit wit is an homage to the Belgian classic, an ultra crisp wheat ale with a honey bready malt base, subtle layers of coriander and orange peel, and an effervescent mouthfeel. Additions of passionfruit give this beer a pop of tropical fruit flavor. Wit’s End is a sessionable treat sure to lend some tropic chill to your day.

Name: 903 Brewers Limited Release
Description: This is a robust porter infused with a classic Texas ingredient, pecans. It is full bodied and a little on the sweet side. Its bold flavor comes from roasted malt, its generous hop additions, and toasted pecans.

Name: Kern River Brewing Class V Stout
Description: NOT FOR THE TIMID!. This is a non-traditional beer with a complex flavor profile ranging from coffee to chocolate, the sweetness is complemented with Chinook and Cascade hops to produce an extraordinary finish. This beer is like the Kern at high water - "Not for the Timid".

Name: Igor Unchained Kern River
Description: The first in our Wild & Scenic Specialty Series – a bold, full-bodied ale equally as intense as the climbing rock it’s named after.

Name: Kern River Just Outstanding IPA
Description: This India Pale Ale has a strong malt character and a large hop profile. We dry hop this beer with Simcoe and Amarillo hops to give it that great floral aroma and citrus finish. If you like a strong IPA, you'll find this one just outstanding.

Name: Kern River Long Swim
Description: Brewed with Centennial, Amarillo, Citra, Cascade, and Eureka hops.

Name: Kern River Winter Ale
Description: Double IPA using Falconer’s Flight hops (8% abv, 78 IBU)

Name: Kern River Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: This fall seasonal ale is brewed with real pumpkin and a hint of allspice. It pours slightly orange in color with a light sweetness and spicy finish. This beer is no trick and all treat.

Name: Columbus Melk Stout
Description: Melk Stout brings a rich, complex malt profile of dark chocolate, coffee, and roasted barley. A generous addition of lactose sugar during the brewing process leaves us with a smooth, full bodied, sweet stout that is perfect for an Ohio winter.

Name: Columbus Brewing Company IPA
Description: India Pale Ales were originally brewed to withstand long ocean voyages by increasing the quantity of hops and malt used in their Pale Ale predecessors. Our take on IPA pours pale orange with a balanced malt presence and finishes with a combination of grapefruit, pine, and tropical fruit notes from Pacific Northwest grown hops.

Name: Columbus Brewing Company Lucy Belgian IPA
Columbus Cowboy Bernie Imperial IPA
Description: Giddy up! Cowboy Bernie is a friend and a truly unique character. This limited Imperial India Pale is deep golden in color with a refreshing, firm bitterness and aromas of orange, orchard fruit, pineapple, and spice. Prominently featuring the experimental Bru-1 hops from Brulotte Farms in Yakima, Washington.

Description: Pale malts provide a stage for the huge hop presence. Creeper is our limited release Imperial IPA featuring an ever evolving blend of American hops.

Name: Alpine Beer Co. Duet IPA
Description: Alpine’s original West Coast-style single IPA is made with Simcoe and Amarillo hops to strike a harmonious hop balance. Duet pours a hazy straw color and is topped with bright white beer foam. It offers a blast of resinous aromatics with notes of evergreen pine, orange zest, and hints of cedar. Big hoppy flavors mingle with geranial notes, while hints of citrus fruit and an overall lingering piney quality lend a touch of complexity to an otherwise simple and delicious IPA.

Name: Alpine Beer Co. Nelson IPA
Description: Named after Nelson Sauvin, an outstanding hop varietal from New Zealand, this beer has achieved legendary status. Nelson hops are introduced through the brewing and dry-hopping of this complex and well-balanced IPA. A hazy straw hued ale, Nelson is topped by bright white beer foam and offers a tropical hop aroma. The pine and fruity hop notes linger and are complemented by the smooth addition of European rye malts. Now this stunning and multifaceted IPA can be enjoyed by more than just a lucky few.

Name: Alpine Beer Co. Hoppy Birthday
Description: Hoppy Birthday is known as “The most celebrated beer in the world”. A session IPA, it benefits from a heavy dose of dry-hopping and is truly a gift to the senses. This bold brew has an intense hop-bitterness, but the pine aroma is the star of the show. With a RateBeer rating of 99 and a “world-class” ranking from BeerAdvocate, you should definitely enjoy Hoppy Birthday more than once a year.

Name: Alpine Beer Co. Windows Up
Description: Windows Up is a single IPA made with Mosaic and Citra hops. It pours a hazy straw color and is topped with bright white beer foam. Piney aromas mingle with fruity notes, while hints of citrus fruit and an overall lingering resinous quality lend a touch of complexity to this dank IPA.

Name: Alpine Beer Co.  HFS IPA
Description: Shout it from the mountaintops!  HFS is our GABF 2016 Bronze medal winner in the Strong Ale category. This West coast-style American IPA is light bodied and full of hop flavor and aroma. It pours a pale gold with a light, fluffy, off-white head. Featuring a combination of Mosaic, Simcoe, and Citra hops, HFS presents a bold tropical fruit explosion with hints of grass and pine balanced by a light and bready malt character.

Name: Alpine Pure Hoppiness
Description: A West Coast Double IPA so mega-hopped it will take you to hop heaven. We've used hops in the boil, more hops in the giant hopback, and added to that, an incredible amount of dry-hopping for that cutting-edge hop bite. Once you've tasted this unique beer, all others pale in comparison.

Description: With a focus on flavor & aroma instead of just intense bitterness, Relay IPA will produce flavors of pine, passion fruit, tangerine, mango & pineapple. Using Columbus, Simcoe, Citra, Centennial & Amarillo hops.

Name: Thorn Brewing Shades of Haze Series – Scarlet
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Dos Equis Lager Especial is a crisp golden pilsner-style beer made from pure spring water and the choicest hops. With a balanced composition and a smooth, clean finish, it’s the party guest who is always invited and never overstays his welcome.

Firstly brewed by German brewmaster Wilhelm Hasse in the end of the 19th century in Mexico and imported since 1983 in the USA, authentic Mexican lager beer.

Name: Von Trapp Trosten Lager
Description: Trösten translating to “comfort beer”, a dark lager with rich notes of chestnut and toast. Carafa and smoked malts create rich flavors lingering on a surprisingly light, smooth finish. Brewed for the cold winter nights in Vermont, but can be enjoyed on any occasion.

Name: Von Trapp Oktoberfest Pint
Description: The Bronze Medalist at the Great International Beer Festival and Attitash Oktoberfest “Best Brew Award” in both 2015 and 2016.  Oktoberfest is brewed with a blend of light and dark Munich Malts, which not only adds to its depth but delivers a residual sweetness. Carmel and toffee notes linger but are balanced by the subtle hops additions in this beer.   We use hallertau and Tettnang hops which adds a floral yet peppery aroma to this beer. It's our take on this traditional fest beer.

Name: Von Trapp Pilsener
Description: The Bohemian Pilsner is light straw to golden in color. A touch of Munich malt is added to give the beer a sweet caramel finish. It is smooth and crisp with a clean malty aroma. We use Saaze and Perle hops: providing a predominant peppery bitterness and spicy floral aroma. Bitterness is on the high end, but balanced out well. We lager in cold storage for 30 days to help produce a smooth finish for this complex lager.

Name: Busch Light
Description: Busch Light is brewed longer to create a lighter body and fewer calories while always delivering that classic taste. Crisp, refreshing, light beer. Pairs well with turkey burgers, pizza, or chips. It's made with the finest ingredients, including a blend of premium hops, exceptional barley malt, fine grains and crisp water. This recipe, unchanged since 1955, delivers a refreshingly smooth taste & easy finish.

Name: Busch Beer
Description: Busch Beer is made with the finest ingredients, including a blend of premium hops, exceptional barley malt, fine grains and crisp water. This recipe, unchanged since 1955, delivers a refreshingly smooth taste & easy finish.Crisp, refreshing lager. Pairs well with burgers, pizza, or chips.

Name: Busch Ice
Description: Busch Ice, introduced in 1995, undergoes an exclusive ice-brewing process, which takes the beer to a temperature below freezing. The ice crystals are then removed giving the beer its sweet, smooth finish and higher alcohol content.  Ice beer (Eisbock) was first brewed in Germany by accident during an unseasonably cold year. The bock beers brewed for spring froze, concentrating the flavor and increasing the alcohol content. Crisp, refreshing iced beer. Pairs well with burgers, pizza, or chips.

Name: Busch Non-Alcoholic
Description: Busch Non-Alcoholic Beer is brewed with the finest ingredients, including a combination of malt and select unmalted grains for a smooth, full-bodied, malty flavor. Crisp, refreshing non-alcoholic beer. Pairs well with burgers, pizza, or chips.

Name: BEST DAMN Sweet Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: We call our Sweet Tea mission “We Put the TEA in Party!” Our delicious, easy-drinking BEST DAMN Sweet Tea is aged on real black tea leaves during the brewing process for a crisp, refreshingly smooth iced tea taste. Exclusively available in select select states in the Northwest and Midwest areas.

Name: BEST DAMN Root Beer
Description: We call our Root Beer mission “Throw back a throwback.” Delicious, easy-drinking BEST DAMN Root Beer is aged on real vanilla beans during the brewing process for a full-flavored, well-balanced take on one of our favorite classic tastes.

Name: BEST DAMN Cream Soda
Description: We call our Cream Soda mission “Soda-licious You’ll Love It!” Our deliciously smooth BEST DAMN Cream Soda is aged on real vanilla beans during the brewing process, adding a touch of sweetness to a timeless recipe.

Name: BEST DAMN Cherry Cola
Description: Our refreshing BEST DAMN Cherry Cola combines caramel and cola spice notes with a delicious cherry taste. Aged on cherries after brewing, the result is a flavorful take on the timeless taste of Cherry Cola. We hope you love it as much as we do.

Name: BEST DAMN Peach Hard Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Best Damn Hard Iced Teas are caffeine free and aged on real black tea leaves for a refreshingly smooth iced tea taste. Peach Flavor.

Name: Scarface Sour Raspberry
Description: A handful of raspberries minus the seeds…all sweet and slightly sour. That’s what’s going on with every swig of Scarface Sour Raspberry! The zing and the zest of a tasty little berry…try this tasty goodness on your buds… your tastebuds!

Name: Sing Sing Sour Grape 10%
Description: No maximum security for this one… Sing Sing Sour Grape is out there. It’s a sweet and sour crush in your mouth…and super grapey. Not the purple stuff you drank when you were a kid, but twice as tasty. What’s on the grapevine is true…try it yourself!

Name: Alcatraz Sour Apple
Description: The taste is a jailbreak…it’s busting out! It’s like biting into a slightly under ripe apple…but sweeter. It is a favorite of many because of its refreshing bite and delicious appley taste. Bust out some Alcatraz Sour Apple the next time you’re kickin’ back.

Name: Syndicate City Sour Peach
Description: The nectar of a juicy peach, without the pit! Syndicate City Sour Peach is an assault of the taste buds! All that’s missing is the fuzz, which frankly, I could do without. Save yourself a trip to the grove, and chill with the peachy goodness of this delightful flavor.

Name: Juice Joint Watermelon
Description: Imagine the most refreshing fruit on the planet perfected with a spell of Johny. Our newest flavor redefines chemistry! Ok, stop imagining. Juice Joint Watermelon is served.

Name: Ice Lemonade
Description: The taste is a jailbreak ... it’s busting out! It’s like biting into a tart lemon... but sweeter. It is a favorite of many because of its refreshing lemony taste. Bust out some Hard Squeezed Ice Lemonade the next time you’re kickin’ back.

Name: Texas Ale Project Fire Ant Funeral Amber Ale
Description: AN ANTIDOTE TO THE BIG STING. A traditional amber ale complexly built from a careful selection of 7 different malts. American grown hops harmoniously round out the wonderfully rich malts. Balanced without the bite.

Name: Texas Ale Project Good To Go Pale Ale
Texas Ale Project The Caucasian Imperial Stout
Description:
White Russian Imperial Stout, inspired by "The Big Lebowski's" beverage of choice, White Russian (aka Caucasian).
An optical illusion...the aroma and flavors you'd expect from a bold Stout but with a golden appearance. This Ale is brewed exclusively with light-colored malts. Local cold brew coffee added to achieve stout-like roasty undertones.
Lactose and whole Madagascar bourbon vanilla beans balance out the 75 IBUs and retain some sweetness. Then
we age the beer on American oak.

Name: Texas Ale Project 100 Million Angels Singing Double IPA
Description: An assertive but very smooth Double India Pale Ale, brewed and dry-hopped with copious amounts of Simcoe and a blend of other delicious American-grown hops.

Name: Texas Ale Project Payne Pilsner
Description: Citrus Pilsner. Unfiltered Pilsner brewed with Czech Saaz, Lemondrop, and Citra Hops.

Name: Coney Island Mermaid Pilsner
Description: A dry hopped American Rye Pilsener. Obey the siren song of the mythological Coney Island Mermaid. Four spicy hops flow into seven golden malts. Perfect as a momentary distraction, or equally enchanting as a parade towards deeper delights. When beer tastes this good, and you don’t have scurvy, you don’t need a lime!

Name: Coney Island 1609 Amber
Description: 1609 isn’t a year. It’s a landmark in time. When explorers first set foot on that massive dune along the Atlantic, they set in motion a chain of events that would one day give us The Playground of the World. And to that, we drink.1609™ is a bold amber ale with a malt-forward, slightly nutty character and a strong citrus hop nose.

Name: Coney Island Home Plate Ale
Description: Leading off is Melanoidin malt and 2-row malted wheat, giving this beer its brilliant straw color. Up next is a trio of Cascade, Nelson and Amarillo hops, hitting it out of the park with their delightful aroma. Rounding out the Home Plate lineup is a well-balanced bitterness sure to please dedicated and casual hop fans alike.

Name: Coney Island Beach Beer
Description: Craft beer made simple: malt, water, hops and yeast, brewed in harmony. A crisp and refreshing ale, with a light body and a hint of citrus. Inspired by the spirit of summer.

Name: Kulshan Red Cap Red Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: Red Cap is a beer that gets along with just about everyone. Easy to drink yet full of flavor, it showcases Munich Malt, Crystal Malt and Roasted Barley living in harmony with Willamette and Golding hops. Medium in body and creamy on the pallet, it lingers pleasantly and has a malty sweet finish.

Name: Kulshan Bastard Kat IPA
Description: Brewed with passion and precision, Bastard Kat is an American West Coast IPA with a prolific full hop flavor and aroma predicated upon the citrus notes of the Cascade Hop. Brewed for your next adventure.

Name: Holidaily Riva Stout
Description:
Riva the Bernese Mountain Dog was named after a ski run at Vail Resort called Riva Ridge. One of the originaltrails and the longest single run on Vail Mountain, it was named by a Vail founder who was a member of the 10th Mountain Division for the battle they fought in the Italian Apennines during World War II. The design is a nod to the run as well as the history behind
the name.

Name: Holidaily Brewing Patchy Waters Gluten Free Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Holidaily Brewing Beulah Red Ale
Description: Beulah Red Marble, quarried in Beulah, Colorado, is so rare that all the known marble was used in the Colorado capitol building. With color reminiscent of a mountain sunset, Beulah Red Ale has toasted malt characteristics, notes of caramel, and a subtle floral hop aroma.

Name: Holidaily Brewing Favorite Gluten Free Blonde Ale
Description: Grandpa was a small town optometrist who called his granddaughter and Holidaily founder his “Favorite Blonde.” Inspired by the man who helped others see the value of a good time, our blonde ale has a subtle hop character and mellow malt flavor.

Name: Holidaily Brewing Fat Randy’s Gluten Free IPA
Description: Hungry for adventure and thirsty for a world-class American IPA, Fat Randy journeyed to the land where the buffalo roam. He pairs his aromatic, easy drinking IPA with close friends and the great outdoors. A toast to Fat Randy – the man, the myth, the legend.

Name: Fat Head’s Sunshine Daydream Session Ale
Description: As refreshing as wading in a cold stream in the morning sunshine or a walk among the tall trees, this beer has big hop aromas and flavors of citrus, peach, orange and tropical fruit with a nice light malt backbone. Like a sweet coming, never fade away dream... because it's deliciously real. This is a very drinkable session ale. (Our fans call it an obsession.) Peace, Love & Hoppiness!

Name: Fat Head’s Bumble Berry Honey Blueberry Ale
Description: Brewed with fresh harvested spring honey stolen from some very angry bees (we have the welts to prove it) and infused with fresh blueberries. Creating a light, refreshing ale with a nice blueberry aroma, crackery malt flavors, a hint of sweetness and a refreshing blueberry finish. Get yo buzz on!

Name: Fat Head’s Bone Head Imperial Red Ale
Description: We can boldly say that this hoppy red is unlike any other you’ve tried. Hopped-up to the max, deep ruby in color, with a smooth as silk mouthfeel and an almost pungent piney aroma. Malts bone-up their magic with a hearty, biscuity, almost rustic touch of flavor and a slightly bitter fruitiness. A creamy head always tops it off. Recently Bonefide with a gold medal at the GABF.

Name: Fat Heads Goggle Fogger
Description: When this brew first came out of the tanks our brewer took a sip. Then downed some more. He put on his glasses, tilted his head and said "Damn, that's a Goggle Fogger!" The "Hefe" prefix means "with yeast" which gives this unfiltered wheat beer a somewhat cloudy or "foggy" appearance. Light aromas of wheat, bubblegum, clove and spice.

Name: Fat Head’s Trail Head Pale Ale
Description: Go off the grid and give back some good vibes. Brewed with whole flower Simcoe and Citra hops, A portion of the proceeds from every pint of Trail Head Pale Ale goes directly to the Cleveland Metroparks Trails Fund, which supports the rehabilitation of the park's more than 270 miles of trails. Now grab your gear and hit the trail!

Name: Red Cypress Never Nude Blueberry Wheat Ale
Red Cypress Spook Hill
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Spook Hill rolls up your palette with juicy mango, papaya, and subtle woody notes. Though crafting a perfectly balanced Pale Ale can be an uphill climb, Spook Hill finishes fruity and refreshing.

Name: Red Cypress Devil’s Chair IPA
Description: Devil's Chair IPA packs a sinister punch of bright, fruity hops and a dry, bitter finish that won't let go! Legend has it that if an unopened can of beer is placed on the Devil’s chair in Cassadaga, Florida at midnight, it will be empty the next morning. It seems The Prince of Darkness also enjoys a cold beer.Suggested Pairing Bacon and Blue cheeseburgers, Garlic, Pork Enchiladas

Name: Red Cypress Subdivisions Pilsner
Description: Subdivisions conforms to the “timeless old attraction” of a classic pilsner. Our crisp lager presents a clean, simple malt bill spiced with traditional Saaz hops. Rush in before it’s gone!

Name: Buffalo Bayou 1836
Description: We call 1836 a "Copper Ale" because it's copper colored, but it fits no specific style. Much like Houston, "1836" is one of a kind. This blend combines our three favorite brewing traditions: the British Bitters, the Belgian Trappist ales, & the American Hop Movement. In honor of Texas Independence Day, this brew is our pride and joy.

Name: Buffalo Bayou Lenin’s Revenge Imperial Stout
Scuttlebutt Amber Ale
Description: This is an American style amber ale with distinctive hop flavor and aroma. The hop character is a result of the blending of Mt. Hood and Willamette hops. It is highlighted by the light amber color and balanced by malt undertones. We recommend this beer for those who enjoy hop characteristics, but don’t want to be overwhelmed by them.

Name: Scuttlebutt Gale Force IPA
Description: Aggressive Hop Flavor with a Medium Malt Body

Name: Scuttlebutt KEXP Transistor IPA
Description: A Pleasantly Bitter IPA. Crisp and session friendly, this beer features a floral and woody hop bouquet and beautiful golden hue. Brewed with Columbus, Chinook, Glacier and Nugget hops, Transistor IPA weighs in with 68 IBU’s and is 5.6% abv. The label and packaging for Transistor IPA were designed by Dave Narcizo, co-founder of Lakuna Design and drummer for Throwing Muses. Narcizo joined Throwing Muses in 1983 and has been an active voice on the rock music scene ever since.

Name: Scuttlebutt Demarcation IPA
Description: Earthy, bitter, but not unbalanced, dry finish. Aroma: Stonefruit, sweet citrus, white pepper, floral.

Name: Duck Rabbit Amber Ale
Description: The Duck-Rabbit Amber Ale is a medium bodied beer with a lovely tawny copper / bronze color. The lightest of all our dark ales, this is a great introduction to full flavored beers. This brew emphasizes malt complexity with layered caramel malt flavors. We put a lot of effort into getting The Duck-Rabbit Amber Ale just right and we're extremely proud of the result. Enjoy! ABV: 5.5%

Name: Duck Rabbit Baltic Porter
Description: The Duck-Rabbit Baltic Porter is deep, rich and velvety soft. A full blooded roasty character is balanced by complex alcohol notes. Strong (9% alcohol by volume) yet unfailingly subtle, this special brew warrants sipping and savoring.

Name: Duck Rabbit Marzen
Description: The Duck-Rabbit Märzen is the lightest of our Germal-style lagers. This is a beer designed for outdoor autumn festivals! Soft malt flavors take center stage here. This one is subtle and beguiling.

Name: Day of Dead Amber
Description: Nice copper color with a creamy head. It is a rich pleasant ale perfectly balanced between soft toffee and caramel notes and a floral-hoppy bitterness. It has a semi-dry finish with subtle coffee notes.

Name: Day of the Dead Blonde Ale
Day Of The Dead Porter
Description: •Dark brown color with red highlights. A full body beer with rich roasted malt and chocolate notes. It finishes with good hop, creamy toffee and caramel followed by delicate coffee notes and smooth chocolate aftertaste.  •Alc. Vol. 5.0 %  •Bitter 18 IBU  •Malt: 2 row, caramel, chocolate, black  •Hops: mt hood, liberty

Name: Day Of The Dead Immortal Beloved Hefeweizen
Day of Dead Hefeweizen
Description: Golden color wheat beer with a delicate balance of banana esters and clove phenolics. Excellent medium body and moderate bitterness.

Name: Rush River The Unforgiven Amber Ale
Description: Rich in flavor and mildly sweet, this amber ale is dry-hopped in the conditioning tank to add a subtle herbal nose. The robust caramel color and flavor is complemented with a frothy head that leaves a thick lacing on the glass. A classic session ale, great with food.

Name: Rush River Scenic Pale Ale
Description: A refreshingly light pale ale, Scenic is smooth and drinkable. Copious amounts of Citra and Mosaic hops lend aromatics of grapefruit, apricot, and tropical fruit, with minimal bitterness and a slightly spicy finish.

Name: Rush River Nevermore Chocolate Oatmeal Stout
Description: Available December through March. This late-Winter seasonal is extremely dark and flavorful. Rolled oats give it a smooth feel, while the addition of premium cocoa makes this stout a sure crowd-pleaser. Somewhere between coffee and chocolate cake.

Name: Rush River Double Bubble Imperial IPA
Description: Originally our summer seasonal, demand has forced us to offer the Double Bubble all year long, and we don’t mind one bit. This hop-whopper is the bigger brother to our very popular Bubblejack India Pale Ale. Light in color, the hops do the talking in this full-bodied ale. For this version, we’ve doubled the hops, and added three pounds of local honey per keg. Extremely smooth and slightly sweeter than the original, a little bit goes a long way.

Name: Rush River Bubblejack IPA
Description: Incredibly smooth, this ale is truly a phenomenon in taste. This American Style IPA is brewed with a lighter grain bill which allows the various Yakima Valley hops to shine. Bubblejack IPA is also dry-hopped prior to packaging for an added hop aroma.

Name: 14th Star Maple Breakfast Stout
Description: Brewed with maple syrup and cold brew coffee, this wonderfully complex stout starts with a rich smooth coffee flavor, then eludes to a dark chocolate character, and finishes a hit of sweetness.

Name: 14th Star Valor Ale
Description: Hoppy Amber Ale that has a malt complexity that finishes crisp and with hints of grapefruit.

Name: 14th Star Raspberry Vermonter Weiss
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Our Raspberry Vermonter Weiss is a sour wheat beer brewed with Vermont malt and hops and a helping of fresh local raspberries along with raspberry puree to impart a bright fruit flavor and a huge aroma of fresh raspberries in every sip of this beautiful deep pink beer.

Name: 14th Star Tribute Double IPA
Description: Our Tribute Double IPA is a celebration of hops, pure and simple. A simple and smooth malt base serves as the stage for the hops to perform. Tribute has a beautiful golden color, an aroma brimming with citrusy hops, and a deliciously smooth hop flavor and dry finish.

Name: 14th Star B-72 IPA
Description: Our B-72 Double IPA is coming at you to drop a hop bomb on your taste buds! Brewed with copious amounts of Australian and American hop varieties this brew packs a punch with its juicy citrus flavor and tropical fruit aroma.

Name: Dock Street Amber Ale
Description: The flagship Dock Street recipe from the 1980's, made right here in West Philly. Brewed with American Cascade hops and 2-row pale and caramel malts. It's medium-bodied, exceptionally balanced and always admired for its clean smooth finish.

Name: Dock Street Barracuda
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Berliner Weisse -This tart, sessionable ale is brewed with raspberry and hibiscus that lend an alluring rose-colored hue alongside their delightful fruity and floral contribution, but don't let the good looks fool you - this beer packs a punch like its toothy namesake. First, it's kettle-soured with probiotic cultures to develop a tart acidity, then fermented with our house ale strain until it is crisp and dry. Perfect for a day out on the water, or inland, where the only Barracudas are on throwback radio or in 16oz cans.

Name: Dock Street Prince Myshkin Russian Imperial Stout
Dock Street Golden IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: American IPA - We designed this golden-hued, clear IPA so that hop flavor and aroma are the primary experience. Oats and a touch of caramel malt make for a mouth coating light body balanced with medium bitterness. Mosaic, Citra, Simcoe, and Amarillo hops create flavors and aromas of tropical fruit, citrus, and just a hint of pine. Can art, featuring a gold doubloon and our trademark anchor, by Philly-based artist Eric Hinkley.

Name: Dock Street Bohemian Pilsner
Description: Brewed in the style of the original Pilsner beers of Bohemia. We use an enormous amount of Czech Saaz hops and pilsner malts to produce its bright golden color and soft, nutty flavor. The balance is clean and crisp with a gentle hop nose and a long, dry finish.

Name: Marin Brewing St. Brendan’s Irish Red Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: Our Irish Red Ale is very true to style; rich and malty with a grand amount of character. This beauty is brewed to commemorate the discovery of the Americas by St. Brendan the Navigator, who beat that Italian guy by about 1000 years. 6.0% alcohol by volume.

Name: Marin Doppel Weizen Wheat Ale
Description: “Doppel Weizen” means “Double Wheat” in German. Our double-strength American-style version is full of flavor, crisp and light, served at 40°- 45° with a slice of lemon... Refreshing!

Name: Marin White Knuckle Double I.P.A.
Description: "White Knuckle Ale" is a Double India Pale Ale. That’s right, twice the malt and twice the hops in one 14 barrel batch. It is named in honor of the exciting bike trail on Mt. Tam. If you are a "hophead", this one’s for you; fat, chewy, resiny and pungent! Pour into a wide-mouthed glass and get ready to rip!

Name: Marin 3 Flowers Ipa
Description: 3 Flowers IPA is a straw colored Rye IPA. The three flowers referred to are Citra, Cascade, and Chinook hops, which are cast into the brew liberally, and contribute a lovely citrusy, floral aroma and a firm yet balancing bitterness. Malted rye and flaked rye, gently added to the grist of this refreshing brew, bestow an engaging dry spiciness and luscious mouth feel upon the imbiber. Please feel free to have another.

Name: Buffalo Bill’s Brewery Orange Blossom Cream
Description: A light ale with hints of fresh orange. Brewed with sweet orange peel, orange blossom extract and honey.

Name: Buffalo Bill’s Strawberry Blonde Ale
Description: Enjoy the refreshing taste of Summer in every sip of Strawberry Blonde Ale with Ginger! This sessionable brew has fresh, floral notes of strawberry, and hints of spicy ginger, 5.2% ABV.

Name: Buffalo Bill’s Brewery Pumpkin Ale
Description: An amber style ale, originally brewed by George Washington, brewed with fresh roasted pumpkins, malted barley. Cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg are added. Bottled form is brewed under contract by Portland Brewing Co.

Name: Buffalo Bill’s Brewery Orange Blossom Cream
Description: A light ale with hints of fresh orange. Brewed with sweet orange peel, orange blossom extract and honey.

Name: Carsons Red Dawn
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Wheat Ale
Description: The Red Revolution awakens with a copper sunrise framed by a firm tan head. Luscious wheat and caramel malt connect with earthy hops to form a firm alliance. One taste of this Dawn and you’ll join our cause.

Name: Carsons Harlot Blonde 4nr
Description: Harlot Honey Blonde Ale is the perfect combination of sweet honey malts and flowery hops. The Willamette hops ensure light body for a refreshing brew.

Name: Carsons EVille Wheat
Description: This wheat kicks ass and takes names! Strong, fresh, aggressive American hops smack your face, but you want more. Intense citrus, spicy hop and wheat malt flavors erupt yet finish amazingly smooth. The Eville will grow in you!

Name: Carsons Red IPA
Description: RIPA approaches with a haunting red glare and monstrous Northwest Pacific hop profile. Chew through the rich toasted malts to encounter a bone dry hop bite and a smooth warm finish. Drink again soon or may you RIP.

Name: Carsons Rye IPA
Description: RIPA approaches with a haunting red glare and monstrous Northwest Pacific hop profile. Chew through the rich toasted malts to encounter a bone dry hop bite and a sooth warm finish. Drink again soon or may you RIP.

Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red

Name: The White Hag Meabh Rua Irish Bog Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red

Name: The White Hag Searbh Rua Imperial Sour Red Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Aftershock Brewing Oatmeal Raisin Cookie Ale
Description: If you are a fan of a incredibly delicious ale and fresh oatmeal raisin cookies, then this is definitely the beer for you, as the combination of the two is simply astounding and ridiculously good.

Name: Aftershock Espresso Stout

Name: Aftershock 3rd Degree IPA
Description: The American IPA has come a long way since its invention. It seems society's palate is craving more hop profile than ever. So what is a small micro-brewery to do in this day and age? 3rd° is our answer to that question. Medium bodied and over-hopped with CTZ, Centennial and more, it is sure to be a favorite among craft connoisseurs. We brew 3rd° in small batches to help guarantee its freshness.

Name: Grayton 1890 Founder’s Ale
Description: Full bodied and deep amber in color, 1890 Founder's Ale showcases its robust malt complexity with notes of caramel, toffee and roasted walnuts. American cascade hops are used to balance this beer with a bright, piney finish.

Name: Grayton 30A Beach Blonde Ale
Description: LIFE SHINES on Scenic Highway 30A. But 30A is much more than a strand of idyllic beach villages along Florida's Gulf Coast. This light-bodied blonde ale greets your palate with a subtle citrus nuance and mild malt sweetness. 30A Beach Blonde Ale is a refreshing and sessionable ale that conjures up that relaxed coastal attitude anytime, anywhere. So kick off your flip-flops, grab a cold 30A Beach Blonde Ale, and relax. Slow down, you're here.

Name: Grayton Pale Ale
Description: In the long history of brewing, Pale Ale holds a proud position. Various forms of the Pale Ale have emerged but in the late 20th Century, U.S. craft brewers seized the style as their own. This aromatic and complex beer boasts an array of citrus notes from American hops whose character is balanced by a slight malt sweetness and a dry finish that is guaranteed to make you want another.

Name: Grayton 30A Rose Gose
Description: Inspired by our sunsets. Bright berry notes interplay with unique salty & tart foundation

Name: Grayton Salt Of Gulf
Description: In our interpretation of this German classic, we used Gulf Salt from our friends over at Gulf Coast Salt Works. Fermented with both lactobacillus and ale yeast, this brew boats a bevy of juxtaposed flavors. The low pH during fermentation causes the yeast to create unusual esters remise of apricots and peaches while the spicy citrus characters stem from the coriander added to the whirlpool.

Name: Four Corners El Chingon IPA
Description: Four Corners El Chingon India Pale Ale Craft Beer is a quintessentially American IPA. Hecho en Tejas with a combination of Columbus, Cascade and Centennial hops, this American beer is given a final kick of Falconer's Flight, 7C Blend at the end of its boil. That blend is packed full of additional Crystal, Columbus, Cluster, Citra, Chinook, Centennial and Cascade hops. A robust build of Munich malt and pale malt topped with Santiam leave this IPA beer fairly bitter yet pleasantly hoppy with plenty of flavor to go around. At 72 out of 100 International Bitterness Units, this Texas beer shines through its vibrant earthy and citrusy flavor. Bring this six pack of beer along to your next game day with friends. Pop open a can of El Chingon beer alongside rich dishes like pork or lamb. There are many IPAs, but only one can be called El Chingon. Brew great beer. Elevate beer culture. Drink Responsibly. Four Corners® Brewing Co., Dallas, TX

Name: Four Corners Local Buzz Honey-Rye Golden Ale
Description: Four Corners Local Buzz Golden Ale Craft Beer is a crisp Texas honey beer with a hint of zesty spice. This craft golden ale is brewed with a pale malt base, a Munich body and a nice helping of rye malt. That combination, hecho en DTX, gives this craft brew a subtle yet spicy finish. Hundreds of pounds of wildflower honey in each batch give this blonde ale its signature flavor. Each sip blends caramel and honey flavors seamlessly with citrusy hop notes. Pop open a can of this honey-rye golden ale for a pleasant evening out on the porch, or pair it with rich, flavorful dishes like chicken, fish or pasta. These crowd-pleasing beer cans are the perfect addition to any backyard barbecue line-up. Brew great beer. Elevate beer culture. Drink Responsibly. Four Corners® Brewing Co., Dallas, TX

Name: Four Corners La Chingona Double IPA Craft Beer
Description: Four Corners Brewing Co. La Chingona Double India Pale Ale starts with strong floral notes as you approach your first sip. The opening is bright and citrusy, leading in to a familiar but soft hop bite. This craft beer is then carried by malty sweetness through the middle, provided by a heaping helping of white wheat in the malt bill. The sweetness then tapers at the close, reigning in the hops and leaving your palate ready for the next gulp. Like all Chingonas, this beer hits hard at 8.2%; but never mind that, it’s well hidden behind a sweet, inviting flavor profile that leaves you wanting more. ¡Que vivan las Chingonas! Drink Responsibly. Four Corners® Brewing Co., Dallas, TX

Name: Four Corners El Grito Lager
Description: This is craft beer sans pretention. An homage to the crisp, clean beer we were all raised on, but with care and quality that makes our handcrafted brews special. Pilsner malt and corn provide a light, accessible body and are complemented by the slight suggestion of Mt. Hood hops. Four Corners El Grito Lager is a crisp patio pounder that blends in seamlessly with your backyard cookout, afternoon by the pool or tailgate.

Name: Southern Star Bombshell Blonde Ale
Description: Brewed with American Pale and Vienna malt that combine to give this ale its distinctive smooth, creamy body. Just enough hops are added to this rich, golden colored ale to perfectly balance its bready finish. Fermented at a cool temperature to give a clean finish.

Name: Southern Star Blood Belt Pale Ale
Description: We've taken our beloved Pine Belt Pale Ale and seriously kicked it up a notch by infusing Blood Orange, with a rich red color and a fruity blood orange aroma and flavor.

Name: Southern Star Black Crack
Description: Aged in Bourbon barrels, this specialty will have all of the rich malt flavor of its' base beer, our Buried Hatchet Stout, complimented by a caramel, woody sweetness and vanilla notes from prolonged contact with American Oak. Dark tobacco, medium char and hints of the original Bourbon make this hard to find release a real treat.

Name: Quaff On Strawberry Blonde
Description: Our Six Foot Blonde infused with fresh strawberries, what could be better! Available year round.

Name: Quaff On Six Foot Blonde
Description: Brewed to be crisp and refreshing, Six Foot Blonde is supremely quaffable with light golden malts and just a hint of hops to round it out.

Name: Quaff On Hare Trigger
Description: Hare Trigger IPA honors Quaff ON! Brewing Company’s tradition of producing well-balanced, drinkable beers. We craft beers that are not only true to the beer style, but true to the Quaff ON! Brand. So what about Hare Trigger? The obvious connection between a hare and an IPA is ‘hops’ but why is that big rabbit carrying a gun? Today’s craft beer drinkers expect the hops in an excellent IPA to ‘get to the point’ quickly. Hare Trigger comes through on that score, with an aroma that promises everything that the taste delivers, along with just the right amount of bitterness and a finish that compels Quaffers to ‘fire’ another

Description: The golden hue of our PCH pays homage to traditional porters which were not typically as dark as they are today. Historically, the addition of molasses and caramelized sugar would create a darker color. Our PCH, a modern interpretation of this old world style, replaces those traditional ingredients with a generous portion of cacao nibs, vanilla beans, and milk sugar resulting in a complex memorable beer.

Description: A full flavored American Pale Ale with a clean taste and crisp finish. Earthy tones with notes of grapefruit and honeydew. A complex, yet understated malt character balanced with a restrained bitterness makes this an exceptionally sessionalble year-round favorite.

Name: Martin House Brewing Company Gateway Blonde
Description: The name of this beer is an homage to the excellent mountain biking trail in our backyard – Gateway Park Trail, but its also a great gateway to craft beer.  This beer is our go-to session ale.  Pale in color with an understated noble hop flavor, this beer is what our brewers reach for after a long day. Even though it’s easy drinking, the acidulated malt provides a unique but subtle kick on the finish.

Name: Martin House Brewery Watermelon Crush Sour
Description: This is THE beer for watermelon lovers. What's cool about watermelon crush, is that it really is crushable. It's not too sweet. Just a delicious, slightly lighter beer, brewed with watermelon juice. It's simple and amazing IF you like watermelon. Watermelon Crush releases this week across our usual retailers in Texas in 6packs. So be sure to request it from your favorite spot that carries our beers.

Name: Martin House Brewing The Salty Lady
Martin House Brewing Company Cellarman’s Reserve IPA
Description: A classic American-style IPA is good any time of the year, and thats why we are happy to bring you our Cellarman’s Reserve Single Hop IPA Series with year-round availability. In order to highlight the hops, the base of the beer is a simple recipe comprised only of 2-row and Munich malts. A 7% abv gives us just the right amount of balance for 65 IBUs of hoppy goodness coming from using only one single hop varietal for bittering, flavor, and dry-hopping additions. Next comes the Martin House twist. While its availability is year-round, the hops we use will not be. From time to time, whenever our Cellarmen feel like it, we’ll switch out that single hop. While the beer overall will remain the same, the drinker will get to experience the nuances of each hop varietal.

Name: Coopers Sparkling Ale
Description: The pinnacle of the brewers’ craft. The ale by which all others should be measured. With its famous cloudy sediment and its distinctive balance of malt, hops and fruity characters, the old ‘Red Label’ is a tasty slice of Coopers history.

Name: Coopers Extra Strong Vintage
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description:
Something special is happening…or should we say brewing - at Coopers.

2018 marks 20 years since we released our first limited batch Vintage Ale. To celebrate this very special occasion, our brewers have used the finest seasonal ingredients to lovingly craft an ale that offers an intriguing balance of flavours within a unique, and very special flavour profile.

Name: Coopers Original Pale Ale
Description: With its fruity character, and robust flavour, Coopers Pale Ale is perfect for every occasion. Naturally fermented in the 'Burton-on-Trent' style, a secondary fermentation creates the trademark sediment that gives 'Pale' its fine cloudy appearance. This cloudy residue can be stirred through the beer by tipping or rolling the bottle before drinking. Tobes and Cole approved!

Name: Coopers Best Extra Stout
Description: Now here's a beer with punch. Cooper's Stout is a beacon for lovers of a hearty brew. With its robust flavour comprising a blend of fruit, chocolate and hop bitter notes it's everything a stout should be. Brewed naturally using a top fermentation method, Cooper's Stout's unique rich, dark texture comes from specially roasted black malt.

Name: Coopers Lager
Description: This all malt beer is brewed with the finest ingredients. It is fermented at low temperature using a traditional lager yeast. Coopers Premium Lager is smooth drinking, with a crisp, refreshing finish. This superior lager is another Coopers original.

Brewed with ample amounts of roasted pumpkins, select seasonal spices, vanilla and marshmallow, Fluffy Pumpkin hits the spot for those of us longing for both the holiday table and the campfire ring.

Name: Odyssey Beerwerks Psycho Penguin Vanilla Porter
Description: Embrace the wild side of life with Psycho Penguin, a Brown Porter brewed with whole Madagascar vanilla beans. Rich flavors of sweet crystal malts along with artfully roasted grains balance well with the silky smoothness of the vanilla. A light hop addition adds sufficient bitterness to keep this beer tempered and insanely drinkable – a welcome beer for all seasons of the year. Whether you’re an everyday porter drinker or an interested novice, our Psycho Penguin Vanilla Porter will drive you mad!

Name: Odyssey Beerwerks Heliocentric Hefeweizen
Description: Harness the power of the mighty sun with Heliocentric Hefeweizen! A style known for its signature banana esters and clove spiciness, Hefeweizens have been made for centuries in Germany and hearken back to an older era of ale brewing. Literally meaning “yeast wheat,” Hefes are served unfiltered with abundant haze and bright, bready wheat flavors. Adhering to Reinheitsgebot (German beer purity law), we brew Heliocentric with malted grain, pure Arvada water, European hops, and healthy German Weizen yeast. Embrace the light and enjoy Heliocentric all year long!

Name: Odyssey Ghost Drifter Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: In the Pacific Northwest where rows of hops stripe the landscape, it is said that a thick morning fog will fetch the Ghost Drifter. Hops farmers have stories of hearing the muffled snort of a distant horse in their fields. Attempts to discover the equine were always futile, but often the farmer would find unshod hoof prints near the hops with a few hops flowers freshly plucked lying on the ground. It is thought that the horse carries a rider with a keen love of hops. Odyssey has researched these reports and discovered that the Drifter seems to prefer Centennial, Chinook, Cascade, and Willamette hops. This American Pale Ale is our salute to the rider of the fog. Hops added throughout the brew process and into the fermenters exemplify the APA beer style well. Poured into a glass, the hops aroma will drift into your nostrils before your lips touch the glass. The hops flavors will wake up the taste buds, but even with all the hops, there is very little lingering bitterness. This is a session beer.
