Name: Pothole Filler Imperial Stout Brewed With Molasses
Description: A dark rich black stout utilizing humongous amounts of roasted barley, black malt, flatted barley and Warrior, Green Bullet and Willamette hops. Thick enough to fill potholes!

Name: Howe Sound Megadestroyer Imperial Licorice Stout
Howe Sound Devils Elbow IPA
Description: An English IPA, heavily hopped yet deliciously balanced malt profile.

Name: Howe Sound Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager

Name: Moa Brewing Blanc Evolution
Description: Moa Blanc Evolution is a Belgian style Witbier, with a small amount of coriander added during its extended maturation period giving it a unique spiciness. Rich and mouth-filling, it really is a true wheat lover’s beer.

Name: Moa Temperance Pale Ale
Description: Moa Temperance Pale Ale is a light, easy drinking, full-flavoured mid-strength New Zealand Pale Ale. Hopped and dry hopped with Motueka and Nelson Sauvin, this beer has a solid 40 IBUs with characteristic tropical fruits dominating the senses - melon, mango and passionfruit are evident along with some citrus bite

Name: Moa Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Moa South Pacific I.P.A. is a New Zealand take on a popular North American beer style. Using famous Cascade and Nelson Sauvin hops, the dominant features in this beer are unique to New Zealand and the Moa bottle conditioned brewing method. Its hoppy strength displays powerful floral, citrus and tropical notes backed up with a strong malt backbone.

Name: Moa Imperial Stout
Description: A very strong, upfront and rich offering of this famous Moa style. Aged in oak Pinot Noir barrels, this beer not only displays coffee and mocha characters but also some sweet and savory notes unique to Moa Imperial.

Name: Moa Noir
Description: Moa Noir is a traditionally brewed European style dark lager with an abundance of distinct aromas and flavours. Chocolate and richly roasted coffee beans dominate the senses with a full flavoured palate, giving Moa Noir a long smooth finish. A perfect beer for the changing of seasons.

Name: Spinnakers Peach Paradise Hefeweizen
Description: A turbid German wheat beer brewed with Silk Road's Peach Paradise tea. Notes of citrus & clove from the Hefe Yeast compliment the bright peach flavors of this delicious tea.

Name: Spinnakers Chocoholic Milk Stout
Description: CHOC-O-HOLIC There is more to the relationship between chocolate and beer than tastes and indulgences, both being prehistoric from an ancient past. It is impossible to know which came first but here we present these two fermented foods in a modern relationship, designed to last until the last drop.  Sirene Chocolate Milk Stout, brewed with our deep well aquifer mineral water, malted barley and wheat, Sirene chocolate husks, lactose, hops and yeast.

Name: Spinnakers Juice Monkey IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This juicy, double dry hopped IPA has a restrained bitterness and a big citrus aroma. Please juice responsibly. This beer is brewed in small batches and is best consumed very young due to the volatility of the hop aromas. Savor not cellar.

Name: Spinnakers Blue Bridge Double Pale Ale
Description: Victoria’s blue bridge is as iconic for the city as the Spinnakers Brewpub is for quality, Victoria beer. The Blue Bridge Double Pale Ale is a lighter than expected golden amber colour that has a thick and slow-dispersing head. The smell is hopped with a citrus back that gives it a solid base to be a great tasting beer. The taste slightly is different from expected. Aromatic hops make for a bitter blanket of flavour, but not in an overpowering way. There is a slight edge of strong-ale-ness that shows the 8.2% alcohol content. This beer is not overly complex but has a pleasant, vibrant and well hopped flavour. Another quality beer to come out of the amazing Spinnakers Gastro Brewpub.

Name: Spinnakers Black Lager
Description: A roasted, cold-fermented German style Schwarzbier with coffee and chocolate notes.

Name: Monkish Ninja Star
Description: Blonde ale / single

Name: Monkish Feminist Hibiscus Tripel
Description: Belgian-style tripel ale spiced with hibiscus. Heavily infused with hibiscus, the beer displays a pink tinge. The beer greets you with a malty sweetness that quickly dissipates into a dry and tart grapefruit, lemonade finish.

Name: Monkish Anomaly
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Monkish Selah
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Dry-hopped farmhouse ale with Brettanomyces. Dry Hopped with Galaxy, Mosaic, Sorachi Ace

Name: Absolution Purgatory Hefeweizen
Description: Pale yellow and brewed in the traditional manner, creamy on the tongue with hints of banana and clove that round out its spicy notes with a smooth finish.

Name: Absolution Strawberry Trespasser Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This golden Belgian-style saison is rich with bready notes and a subtle sweetness on the palate and just a slight tart finish. We've added 13 pounds of organic strawberries per barrel to this offering from the Trespasser Series, giving the beer a beautiful strawberry blonde hue. The natural strawberries provide a soft, yet crisp flavor and aroma. Enjoy with your favorite foods or by itself as a refreshing treat on these hot summer days.

Name: Absolution Penance Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A delicious hop-driven Pale Ale balanced with just a hint of malt. The aromatic and citrus flavors from Palisades hops are subtly soothed by Maris Otter and Munich malts, reflecting New and Old World heritage.

Name: Absolution 405 No Coast IPA
Description: A big hoppy India Pale Ale that fuses west coast style with east coast tropical haze.

Name: Absolution Anniversary Ale
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: Fascinating combination of Old & New World. Caramel tones of European malts combine with the bite of NW Pacific Jade and New Zealand hops under the influence of Australian yeast. Confident well balanced flavors, yet deceptively strong.

Name: Neshaminy Creek Punkless Dunkel Pumpkin Wheat Ale
Neshaminy Creek Leon Russian Imperial Stout
Description: Leon is a big beer. So big, it has twice as much malt as any other beer we brew.. On top of the copious amounts of two row barley, Munich, Victory, Chocolate, Black Patent, and Caramel 80 malt in this beer each 15 barrel brew has 50 pounds of freshly in-house handmade marshmallow fluff as well as 16 pounds of bittersweet bakers chocolate, and 30 pounds of crumbled graham crackers. Leon clocks in at just over 80 IBUs and 11.6% ABV. Does it taste like a Smore’s? That’s for you to decide, but either way this is one fun beer to make, not to mention drink.

Name: Neshaminy Creek County Line IPA
Description: Our search for a location to start this brewery took us across much of Lower Bucks County, many times traveling down the well known divider between northern Philadelphia, southern Bucks, and Montgomery counties, County Line Road. One of the original names we thought of for the brewery was that of County Line Brewing. We don’t know how or why we didn’t settle on that name, but in recognition of our location so close to Philadelphia and that potential namesake, we decided to pass the name on to our flagship IPA which comes in at 6.6% ABV and is chock full of Warrior, Chinook, Columbus, Simcoe, and Centennial hops. It’s got a bready malt backbone to counter some of that hop bitterness, but not so much that this five hop combination won’t put a smile on your face. Dry hopped for nearly two weeks, County Line IPA has a lingering hop bitterness showing a complexity of resinous pine notes, citrusy lemon, and grapefruit that many IPAs on the East Coast lack.

Name: Neshaminy Creek Shape Of Hops To Come Imperial IPA
Description: “Can I scream….” for more hops? You sure can. Two row American barley jammed packed with as much Apollo, Newport, Simcoe, Topaz, and Citra hops we could get our hands on, The Shape of Hops to Come is an 8.5% ABV American-styled imperial IPA hopped with Apollo, Newport, Simcoe, Topaz, and Citra hops that’s got a ton of bitterness, along with juicy, dank resiny pine-like, and citrus forward hop character that is worthy of it’s name. Dry hopped for two weeks this hop bomb has as much hop power we can muster!

Name: Neshaminy Dank Hill
Description: Dank Hill Wheat DIPA is a 9.0% ABV Double IPA brewed with barley and white wheat, and hopped with Apollo, Chinook, Simcoe, Equinox, and Amarillo, then dry hopped for two weeks with Simcoe and Amarillo.  Bursting with tropical, citrus, and pine notes, this brew is dank, and resinous and coats your pallet with a metric shit ton of hops.

Name: Locavore Black Berry Betty
Description: Grab Betty, Bambalam, and take a run through the blackberry patch. Light bodied and spicy with a touch of blackberry.

Name: Locavore 5th Season Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Reminiscent of hot days and cool nights, we created an extra season just to enjoy this flavorful aromatic pale ale. All the flavor of Amarillo hops without the bite.

Name: Locavore The Vig Barrel Aged Russian Imperial Stout
Description: An extremely popular brew for dark beer lovers, “The Vig” is the juice (or take) charged by gambling bookies. Luckily, our “Vig” charged the staves of fresh bourbon barrels a cut of their flavor for over a year. As a bookie might claim, it was worth the wait.

Name: Locavore Lilly Hammer
Description:
A somewhat complex malt and hop bill allows a smooth malt flavor to peek through the citrusy hops flavor and aroma.
We like it hoppy but keep it well balanced. Hoppy and aromatic

Name: Locavore Jolly Farmer Watermelon Wheat
Description: The “Jolly Farmer” is Locavore’s premier summer seasonal release. An American Wheat grain bill provides a smooth and light bodied mouth feel without the cloudy appearance of chewy finish of a German Hefeweizen. The addition of fresh watermelon pulp post fermentation adds mild aroma yet astonishingly refreshing flavor. 5.3% ABV, 16 IBU

Name: La Chouffe Golden Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Golden Ale, strong, spicy, lightly hoppy, with evolving taste. Natural beer, bottle conditioned, unfiltered, not pasteurised and without any additives

Name: Houblon Chouffe Dobbelen IPA Tripel
Description: A unique marriage between the English tradition of IPAs, the new American revolution of Imperial IPAs and the classic Belgian way of brewing. Houblon Chouffe, although very much hopped as it is, showcases the unique balance between a very strong IPA and a very special Belgian Tripel exclusively created for this ale (Big malty body, distinct dryness, expressive estery fruitiness). - IBU: 59, Original Gravity: 1092

Name: N’Ice Chouffe
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description:
A solid winter warmer, this
complex ale offers abundant
notes of spice, fruit and dark
berries, complemented by malty
overtones. Brewed with thyme,
Curaçao orange peel and dark
candy sugar, N’ice CHOUFFE
is the perfect beer to see you
through long winter nights

Name: D’Achouffe McChouffe
Description: This dark brother to the famous blond La Chouffe first hit the market back in 1987. The Mc Chouffe aims to steer a middle course between a traditional dark Abbey beer, belonging to the ‘dubbel’ beer style, and a Scotch ale (although the latter generally offers a more pronounced malty taste than see in the Mc Chouffe).

Name: Brasserie D’achouffe N’ice
Description: N’Ice CHOUFFE is a strong, brown beer that will warm you in the depths of winter. Spicy (thyme and curaçao) and tinged with hops, this is a very balanced beer. N’Ice CHOUFFE is an unfiltered beer which is re-fermented in the bottle and in barrels.

Name: Genesee Cream Ale
Description: Depth of flavor of an ale with the smoothness of a lager.  That's how Genesee Cream Ale became an American original.  Today, every batch of Cream Ale is skillfully brewed to achieve its smooth character and a remarkably creamy white head worthy of its name

Name: Genesee Beer
Description: The beer that started it all in 1878! Genesee's Standard American Lager, Brewed with six-row barley malt, corn grits and hops from the Yakima Valley, Genesee Beer will forever be a classic.

Name: Genesee Ice
Description: When you're looking for a rich, full-flavored beer, Genesee Ice is the perfect beer for you. Our brewmasters begin with only the purest natural ingredients. Then, ice crystals form in the beer during its aging process before it's filtered for the rich flavor Genesee Ice is known for.

Name: Genesee Light
Description: A Rochester favorite since 1978! A true light beer.  Smooth drinking, refreshing and light bodied.

Name: Genesee Light 1/2 Barrel
Description: Kegs are intended for Kegerator use only. TAP NOT INCLUDED.  NOTE: An additional deposit charge per keg may be placed on your card and adjusted following successful return. A representative from Drizly or the store may contact you to confirm additional details prior to delivery.   Empty barrels will be picked up upon delivery of new kegs.   For special requests, please contact: kegs@drizly.com --------------- How many beers are in a keg? 1/2 Barrel = 15.5 gallons = 165 beers 50 Liter = 13.2 gallons = 140 beers 1/4 Barrel = 7.75 gallons = 82 beers 1/6 Barrel = 5.2 gallons = 55 beers

Name: Gulden Draak Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Gulden Draak has a strong scent of alcohol, which hampers the ability to easily define its aroma. Still, there is a powerful fragrance of barley, ripe plums, and cherries. Different testers worldwide mention a sweet coffee aroma. Compared to the aroma, the taste is influenced somewhat less by the alcohol. It hints at sour cherries and brown sugar. The aftertaste is somewhat bitter. Gulden Draak also has a high alcohol content for a beer at 10.5%.

Name: Gulden Draak 9000 Quad Ale
Description: Gulden Draak, lonely at the top for 25 years, now gets company  The birthday present: Gulden Draak 9000 Quadruple, an enrichment of the Gulden Draak range.  An ode to the past and to the city of (9000) GHENT The Gulden Draak is named after the gilded statue on top of the belltower of Ghent. Such eminent symbol, that has been standing firm for over 6 centuries, deserves equally grand beers. The unsurpassed Gulden Draak as dark tripel of 10,5% alcohol gets, after 25 years of growing success, quite an addition, the Gulden Draak 9000 Quadruple.

Name: Gulden Draak Brewmaster’s Reserve
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Our brewmaster, Jef Versele, crafted this exclusive Gulden Draak Brewmasters Edition as a tribute to his grandfather Jozef Van Steenberge and the 230th birthday of the brewery. His inspiration came from his numerous trips to the United States and his deepest respect for the craft beer culture. This exclusive Gulden Draak combines the technology and the craftsmenship of the traditional brewing process. By letting the beer mature on whiskey barrels it gives it a distinctive and gental finish that you have never tasted before.

Name: Gulden Draak Calvados Barrel Aged
Description: Gulden Draak Barrel Aged Calvados is the second in the series of Gulden Draak Quad barrel aged beers. The brewer ages Gulden Draak Quad 9000 in Calvados (Apple Cider Brandy) barrels for roughly 4-6 months. An ideal length of time for the residual flavors of the barrels to meld with the beer. This is a beer unlike any you’ve ever tasted. Once again Jef Versele from Brewery Van Steenberge produces a gem for all to enjoy. Cheers!

Name: Gulden Draak Imperial Stout
Food Pairing: Cheese - Hard Aged, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description:
Gulden Draak Imperial Stout is a limited edition brew from the noble line of Gulden Draak beers, brewed by brewery Van Steenberge.

A beer characterized by its deep, dark color and dry, delicious bitterness. It delivers a rich, complex, robust flavor that doesn't give away the 12% ABV inside. Experience Gulden Draak the way you never have before.

Name: La Trappe Quadrupel Trappist Ale
Description: Quadrupel is La Trappe’s heaviest ale with a stunning amber colour. Its warm and intense flavour is rich and finely balanced.

Name: La Trappe Dubbel
Description: La Trappe Dubbel has a deep brown colour and attractive beige froth. The use of caramel malt gives it a gentle aromatic caramelised quality. It has a rich malty flavour with a touch of sweetness. Post-fermenting La Trappe Dubbel is a smooth drink, and yet has some real body and intense flavour to it.

Name: La Trappe Oak Aged Quadrupel
Description: In 2009, the Koningshoeven brewery reinstated an age-old tradition: aging La Trappe Quadrupel in oak barrels (also known as ‘barriques’).  This way of aging ale results in a unique, complex flavour.

Name: La Trappe Isid’or
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Named after brother Isidorus, Koningshoeven Abbey’s first brewer. Brewed to mark the occasion of the Trappist brewery’s 125th anniversary in 2009.

Name: La Trappe Jubilaris
Description: La Trappe jubilee has a caramel-like flavor with a good bitterness and despite "only" 6% alcohol, a full bodied flavor.

Name: Straffe Hendrik Tripel
Description: The last authentic Tripel Style Beer brewed in Bruges Straffe Hendrik was an authentic Bruges' Tripel beer: a strong and rich beer with lots of flavours (malt, caramel and hop) and 9% abv. In the past, lots of Bruges' breweries produced a Tripel Style Bruges' Ale, a ‚ÄúBrugse Tripel‚Äù. In fact, it was a local speciality. Today, Straffe Hendrik is the last authentic Bruges' Tripel Beer. In 1988, the label was transferred to another brewery and the production in Bruges decreased until it stopped completely. In 2008, exactly 20 years later, Xavier Vanneste brought the label back to Bruges. Ever since, Straffe Hendrik is being brewed in Bruges according to the original recipe and enjoys once again an excellent reputation amongst the people of Bruges who have "their Tripel" back. Straffe Hendrik, a rich bitter ale Straffe Hendrik brewed with a subtle mixture of 6 different kinds of malt. The taste is strong with a lot of hop (Saaz and Styrian Golding) of the best quality. The second fermentation in the bottle assures a longer shelf life. Straffe Hendrik is a very rich beer with lots of flavours.

Name: Straffe Hendrik Quad
Description: Straffe Hendrik Quadruple is a rich and intense dark Belgian ale. It is brewed with a subtle blend of specialty malts, which give the ale an extremely dark color and a chewy, malty complex character. The quadruple combines a clean dryness with a warm full bodied mouth feel and essences of fruit. Secondary fermentation in the bottle creates a living ale that can be aged and will have an evolution of taste profiles over time.     It is brewed by the last active brewery in the historical city of Bruges. The town archives first mention the brewery in 1546. Since 1856, the famous brewing family Maes-Vanneste has owned the brewery.

Name: Straffe Hendrik Heritage
Description: Belgium- Quadrupel- 11.0% ABV. Pours a beautiful brown color with a creamy head. A malty, yeasty aroma with notes of dark fruit, plums, raisins, caramel & Belgian yeast. A creamy taste of molasses, bready malts, caramel, yeast & dark fruit. Finishes with a kick of floral hops!

Name: Straffe Hendrik Wild Tripel
Description: This is the regular Straffe Hendrik Tripel, but this time fermented with wild Brettanomyces yeast strains.

Name: Upright Brewing Seven
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Seven is the most aromatic beer. The brewery’s saison yeast is fully expressed in the aroma with lots of fruitiness while the hops provide light spice notes. The beer has some heft mid-palette but finishes dry with a lightly lingering bitterness. Seven is satisfying on its own but pairs great with a variety of typically fragrant cuisines such as Thai or Indian.

Name: Upright Sideline Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Side Line Saison is a dry hopped beer using a light but flavorful blend of pils, pale, and caramel malts along with some raw Oregon grown triticale. The beer was fermented in our open tanks with the house blend of yeasts and shows a historic edge without being overly bitter or aromatic. It brings the hops from the side line, employing crystal, two distinct lots of santiam, and an experimental variety.

Name: Upright Brewing Five
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: "Five is a farmhouse pale ale that was born after enjoying a few small production European brews that use a heavy hand of hops. Ours blends several Mt. Angel grown varieties to create a deep and complex flavor with an underlying earthiness. Pale fruit aromas created during the fermentation brighten the profile and bring the beer balance."    Malts: organic pale,organic caramel  Unmalted: rolled barley  Hops: willamette, liberty, perle  Also: xanthohumol (bottles only)

Name: Upright Scrap Iron
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Scrap Iron is an industrial saison inspired by 19th century Belgian ales full of rustic character and complexities.

Name: Upright Brewing Gose
Description: Based on an obscure centuries old German style that incorporates salt and coriander into a distinctly tart wheat beer with a dry champagne like finish. 2010 World Beer Cup Bronze medal winner.

Name: Gouden Carolus Classic
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Gouden Carolus is one of the strongest and most exciting beers in the world. After lengthy maturing and conditioning, it is bottled unfiltered.

Name: Gouden Carolus Noel
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: This is a strong dark ruby-red beer with character from specific herbs added in the different stages of the brewing process. Three different kinds of hops, and 6 different kind of herbs and spices make this Christmas beer a ‘special class’.

Name: Gouden Carolus Tripel
Description: In spite of modern brewing technology, this beer is brewed according to ancient traditions. It unites, now as in the past, the best products of our soil: rich barley and fine hops.. It's refined character, with a pure and rich taste, will captivate you. It is matured at length in cellar and bottle, and is guaranteed to be brewed only from pale malts. It is traditionally top-fermented and is 100% pure. The Gouden Carolus Triple has a unique colour and a full flavour due to its well-balanced hopping. To properly savour the Golden Carolus “Triple”, pour slowly in one movement leaving the yeast deposit in the bottle. This beer may be served cool but not chilled: 7-8°C is recommended. In 2002 this beer won the Gold Award in the World Beer Cup, San Diego, USA in the “Triple” category.

Name: Gouden Carolus Cuvee van de Keizer Blue
Description: Every year on the 24th of February, the birthday of "Charles the fifth", the Brewery brews the Gouden Carolus "Cuvee of the Emperor" in a limited quantity and with an eye on the highest quality and tradition. This unique brewing, with only extra fine Belgian hops and with a higher alcohol level, guarantees a better evolution in the time, than the already known Gouden Carolus. This beer, as all our beers, is 100 % natural, with no preservatives, no adjuncts and no chemicals. We bottle it in bottles of 75 cl and closed with a quality cork. Excellent to store several years. Every year the public is invited to assist to the brewing process.

Name: Gouden Carolus Cuvee Van De Keizer Red
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Temperance Brewing Birdsong Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: There’s a concert in our midst. Look up, and soak it in. Listen close, and you just might hear something. With its unique combination of peppery sweetness, refreshing acidity, and a hint of farmhouse funk, Birdsong is your patch cable to the live mix in the treehouse.

Name: Temperance Gatecrasher IPA
Description: Gatecrasher gets into the sold-out show without a ticket. It doesn’t have to shout for people to listen. It arrives fashionably late but closes the place down. Our India Pale Ale stands apart from the bitter crowd and entices with bountiful aromatic hops and a touch of malt sweetness, proving there’s more than one way to crash a gate.

Name: Temperance Escapist IPA
Description: Getting into the party is one thing. Getting out when the time is right is another. Our American IPA comes on strong with four types of aromatic hops and the right amount of bittering, then smoothly makes its way to the exit, lingering only in your memories.

Name: The Commons Urban Farmhouse
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: The Commons Fleur De Ferme
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A dark farmhouse ale with hibiscus, lavender and chamomile added at the end of the boil. Malted Spelt provides a silky full body that supports the late-kettle flower additions.

Name: The Commons Biere De Garde
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: Our Biere de Garde was inspired by the farmhouse beers brewed in Northern France and our friend Steve Jones, Proprietor and Cheesemonger at Cheese Bar in Portland, Oregon. Traditionally, Biere de Garde was brewed while the climate was cooler, then garded (lagered) during the cool months. This beer offers a soft and clean, malt forward flavor with a reserved hop profile.

Name: Commons Fleur De Blanc
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Fleur de Blanc is a white farmhouse ale with rose and elderflowers. Refreshing with a creamy body from malted spelt.

Name: The Commons Flemish Kiss
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Right out of primary fermentation this beer is decidedly an American Pale Ale, but as it enters secondary, a bridge to Belgium is built with a dose of Brettanomyces Bruxellensis. A 5 week maturation results in slightly dry, fruity beer with a hint of floral Brett character that will evolve over time.

Name: De Ranke Noir De Dottignies
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: The heaviest ale on our menu with a very rich taste, coming from the six different kinds of malt we use. These malts also give it that rich, dark, nearly black colour. The royal doses of Challenger and Saaz hops bring the typical balance between sweet and bitter.

Name: De Ranke Saison De Dottignies
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Saison de Dottignies is a high-fermenting saison with a relatively low alcohol content which makes for a well-balanced beer.

Name: De Ranke XX Bitter
Description: XX-bitter is our most bitter, high-fermenting beer. Despite its low alcohol content, it produces a very rich, long lasting, full flavour.

Name: De Ranke Xxx Bitter
Description: XXX-Bitter is a variation on the existing XX-bitter, where we add an additional 50% more hops.  Taste: Full-bodied bitter beer. Despite its higher IBU-value, the large amount of aroma-hops makes this beer taste smoother than XX.

Name: Wild Heaven White Blackbird Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Tasting Notes: Dried Fruit, Dry, Earthy, Floral, Fruity, Pear, Spicy
Description: Belgian-style Saison brewed with pink peppercorns and Asian pears. Viniferous, dry, earthy, fruity, spicy.

Name: Wild Heaven Wise Blood IPA
Description: A lush, tropical IPA bursting with bright fruit flavors. Balanced with notes of pine and sweet orange/citrus.

Name: Wild Heaven Altair IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Citrus, Fruity, Hoppy, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description: Super juicy and drinkable IPA with bright citrus notes highlighting big tropical flavors. Brewed with all late addition hops and lupulin powder. Unfiltered, unbitter, unbridled.

Name: Wild Heaven Emergency Drinking Beer
Description: A one-of-a-kind session beer reminiscent of a crisp pilsner married with a traditional gose. Brightness and complexity come from additions of citrus zest, Portuguese sea salt and lemongrass.

Name: Wild Heaven Emergency Drinking Beer Watermelon Blend
Description:
Our most popular beer + fresh
juiced watermelons, available
in cans for the first time. EDB,
our one-of-a-kind light craft
beer with citrus zest and sea
salt, proved to be the perfect
base to celebrate summer. Our
team hand-juiced watermelons
pils-style session to ensure an authentic flavor

Name: 14er Brewing Rocky Mountain Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: 14er Sour Bells Tropical Ale
Description: A slightly tart tropical ale brewed with Lychee, Guava, and Hibiscus. Fruity tropical and sour. Uniquely Crushable brewed for the end of summer 17'.

Name: 14 Er Brewing Mountain Massive IPA
Description: The Mt Massive IPA is hop forward, tropical fruit, grapefruit, and juicy hops on the nose. The taste is hoppy with bright drinkable citrus, grapefruit, and guava, rounded by a solid but not overwhelming bitterness. Incredibly smooth, bright, and drinkable.

Name: 14er Brewing Double Mt Massive IPA
Description:
Extra Tropical, Double Juicy, And More Massive Hops

Brewed with Citra, Amarillo, Mosaic, Cascade and Centennial Hops

The Double Mt Massive IPA is unfiltered hop juice, packed full of the best American juicy hops. Incredibly dry for a double, this is in the 14er style--a bold and fantastic Colorado IPA.

Name: 14er Brewing Sunshine Peak Coffee IPA
Description: Sunshine Peak Coffee IPA: is brewed for the early riser, the first track seeker, the climber, the trekker, and the adventurer covering miles to see the perfect sunrise. This bright and fruity Coffee IPA is brewed with American hops: HBC 472, Citra, Amarillo, and Mosaic. Cold steeped with locally roasted coffee from Huckleberry Roasters Phantom Limb Blend, the tropical citrus hops and bright fruity coffee fuse for the ultimate adventure #HowWeClimb.

Name: He’Brew St. Lenny’s Belgian Style Double IPA
Description: Shmaltz Brewing is having one hell of summer. The brewery is no longer a contract brewery, and they have just opened their new brewhouse in Clifton Park, New York. Over the weekend, Shmaltz launched a celebratory brew – Death of Contract Brewer, in honor of the new digs. Now, a collaboration – St. Lenny’s Belgian Style Rye Double IPA, aka the Immaculate Collaboration. St. Lenny’s is a collab with St. Louis, Missouri’s Cathedral Square Brewery. This beer is the brewery’s Lenny’s RIPA, with Belgian Ale yeast. Hops, rye, and a little Belgian flair are coming your way soon.

Name: He’brew Genesis Dry Hopped Session Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This is the new recipe replacing the original He'Brew Genesis ale. Balanced between a West Coast style pale and amber ale with just enough malt sweetness to highlight a flurry of hop aroma and flavor. Witness the evolution of our original creation.

Name: He’brew Bittersweet Lennys R.I.P.A.
Description: Commemorating the 40th Anniversary of the death of Lenny Bruce: A Rye based double IPA. Brewed with an obscene amount of malts and hops. Shocking flavors - Far beyond contemporary community standards. The Most Radical Jewish Tribute Beer ever created.

Name: He’brew Hop Manna IPA
Description: Hop Manna is the answer to hop heads' prayers for a delicious IPA bearing floral and citrus goodness.  Winner of a Gold Medal at the World Beer Championships.

Name: Bockor Omer Traditional Blonde Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: OMER. traditional blond is made of excellent summer malted barley from the Loire region (France) and pure water. During the brewing process sugars are liberated that will serve later to nourish the yeast. During the cooking process 3 varieties of hops from Germany, Slovenia and the Czech Republic are added to give the beer the specific aroma and bitterness.

Name: Bockor Omer
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Made of excellent summer malted barley from the Loire region (France) and pure water. During the brewing process sugars are liberated that will serve later to nourish the yeast. During the cooking process 3 varieties of hops from Germany, Slovenia and the Czech Republic are added to give the beer the specific aroma and bitterness.

Name: Cuvee des Jacobins Rouge
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Cuvée des Jacobins Rouge is a Flemish Sour Ale, red in color with a beguiling balance of malty sweetness and acidic sharpness. It is made from spontaneously fermented and barrel-aged beer of at least 18 months in age. The beer is cooled overnight in a large, shallow metal vessel called a coolship and then fermented and aged in large oak foudres which are made in France and assembled on-site at Bockor.

Name: Vander Ghinste Cuvée des Jacobins 1/6 Barrel
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: De Dolle Arabier Bottle
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Arabier is a pure malt beer brewed with flower Nugget-hops from Poperinge. It has the special dry-hopping taste and aroma, so appreciated by beer lovers all over the world. It is one of the two main beers from De Dolle Brouwers available throughout the year. Aging time is limited due to the fact that hop bitterness declines with age. Store arabier cool and dark and serve cool at 10°C.

Name: Stille Nacht Reserva 05
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: De Dolle Special Extra Export Stout
Description: Of dark almost black chocolate color. Nose: musky, slightly sweet and spicy, Lots of chocolate , coffee and some hazelnut notes on the palate intermingling with notes of licorice. Very lively on the tongue! It finishes with a dry explosion of black espresso flavors.

Name: The Rare Barrel Wise Guise Red Sour 2016
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Wise Guise is a blend of Ensorcelled and our golden sour. Fermented with a variety of yeast and soured with Lactobacillus and Pediococcus, this moderately tart beer showcases flavors of candied raspberry, lemon, and orange peel.

Name: The Rare Barrel Blurred T
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description:
Tart Saison Beer Aged in Oak Barrels with Tempranillo Grapes

Blurred T is a tart saison aged with tons of crushed and de-stemmed Tempranillo grapes. The lingering body of the beer is complemented by the black cherry and dark jam qualities of the grapes. With a light acidic backbone, this wine-hybrid is an approachable take on a complex style.

Name: Rare Barrel Shadows Of Their Eyes
Description: Shadows of Their Eyes is a dark sour beer aged in oak barrels. Fermented with Brettanomyces yeast and Lactobacillus bacteria, this sour features aromas of dark chocolate that compliment notes of black cherries, tart plums, and vanilla.

Name: Rare Barrel Across The Sea
Description: A blend of golden sour beers aged in oak barrels with coriander and sea salt, this beer has whispers of a style almost lost in time. Fermented and soured with a medley of microorganisms, across the sea is where you’ll find the undercurrents of citrus and tides of brine that flow to a bay of liquid gold.

Name: Rare Barrel Guava Happens
Description: Guava Happens is a blend of golden sour beers aged in oak barrels with pink guavas. Fermented with an adventurous blend of yeast and bacteria, this fruited sour cruises the open road through the tropics. The scent of fresh guava wafts in the sea breeze and mingles with notes of ripe mangoes, papaya, and pink lemonade. Tart and easy-drinking, this sour is meant for you to enjoy the ride and embrace guava happens.

Name: East Brother Beer Co. Belgian Tripel
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Cured Meats, Duck  Game Bird
Description: Admiral Maltings malts, earthy English hops, and Belgian candi sugar capture the spirit of a place half a world away.

Name: East Brother Beer Co. Oatmeal Stout
Description: English-inspired with notes of rich milk chocolate, dark fruit — soft, comforting finish.

Name: East Brother Beer Co. Red IPA
Description: An easy-going American IPA with a distinctive malt balance - ton of peach and stone fruit hop character.

Name: East Brother Beer Co. Red Lager
Description: Vienna style amber with a biscuity malt presence — clean, crisp, familiar.

Name: East Brother Beer Co. Bo Pils
Description: Bohemian style, golden with a lemony noble hop character — light, grainy finish.

Name: Last Wave Board Breaker
Description: A holiday favorite here at Last Wave. This hearty beer revels in layered complexity with a strong Belgian yeast presence mixed with cardamom, cloves, sweet orange peels, raisins & cinnamon.

Name: Last Wave Endless Daze
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The extra hours of daylight that come with summer at the Jersey Shore make the days seem endless. We know that just means more time to enjoy good beers with good people. This northeast IPA gets some help from a Norwegian Kveik yeast strain (another area known for long summer days). Endless Daze features a hazy body that blends perfectly with the notes of pineapple and berry that flow from big Denali and Galaxy hop additions after flameout. The Kveik yeast strain delivers an intriguing layer to this beer that makes it crushable and complex.

Name: Last Wave Impact Zone
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A big, bold double New England-style IPA that’s bursting with notes of ripe peach and citrus undertones and a smooth finish.

Name: Last Wave Lightly Salted Shore Ale
Description: Brewed to capture the essence of summer at the Jersey Shore. It starts with the light, crisp body of a refreshing Kolsch-style ale and then kicks it up a notch (as we do here at the shore) with a hearty dose of whirlpool hop additions of Denali, El Dorado, and Azacca hops. This provides a tropical bouquet of flavors and aroma without adding any bitterness. Dubbed a “Shore Ale,” a pinch of salt puts the finishing touches on this crushably flavorful beer.

Name: Last Wave Late Takeoff
Description: As the summer fades and the familiar sights and scents of Autumn take hold, the time comes for a beer that can complement the beauty that comes with fall at the Jersey Shore. It’s also about those storm swells that lend themselves to barreling rights that require the supreme commitment of a Late Takeoff. This English-style Brown Ale welcomes those crisp afternoon sessions with open arms and a hearty grain bill. Late Takeoff offers up notes of toffee and a slight nuttiness that’s complimented by locally roasted Sumatran coffee from Port Roasters and a dash of chicory.

Name: Oasis London Homesick Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: A bright Texas session ale made with copious amounts of English Challenger hops and a classic English yeast strain –this beer is sure to make you feel right at home, no matter where you find yourself.

Name: Oasis Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A classic American pale ale, "deep" golden in color, malty and smooth, accented by premium North American hops.

Name: Oasis Luchesa Lager
Description: Enchanting. Ethereal. Fleeting. Is that a woman in the distance, or are your eyes playing tricks on you? Luchesa Lager is brewed in the traditional German Kellerbier style, where subtle malt notes marry with assertive Hallertau and Saaz hops. Like a mirage, your empty glass will leave you wondering: “Was she ever really there?”

Name: Starr Hill Northern Lights IPA
Description: A classic American-style India Pale Ale, Northern Lights weighs in at 52 IBUs and 6.5% ABV. Characterized by its full-flavored bitterness and poignant citrus-floral aroma, a perfect blend of barley and hops makes this a very balanced IPA. For the craft beer connoisseur, Northern Lights is a deliciously crafted piece of the heavens.

Name: Starr Hill Double Platinum IPA
Description: Double Platinum is dry-hopped with Simcoe and Centennial hops to achieve a strong aroma of citrus and pine, balanced by a smooth, malty backbone.

Name: Starr Hill Jomo Lager
Description: Jomo Vienna Lager is a smooth, multiple-award-winning Vienna-style lager. Fermented with Southern German Lager yeast, its crisp, clean taste, and noticeable hop aroma are effectively balanced with a slight malty sweetness.

Name: Due South Category 3 IPA
Description: Brewed with loads of malts and hops, this golden India Pale Ale is true to the style while maintaining a balance between malty and bitter.  A special blend of American hops give this beer its unique flavor.  Although fruity and citrusy, this beer has only four ingredients: malt, hops, yeast and water.

Name: Due South Citrafied Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Featuring one of the most popular hops in the world, Citrafied is a smooth, crushable pale ale. Upon opening this can expect to #GetCitrafied with a whirlwind of hop flavors and aromas. The perfect beer for the boat, the beach — and everything in between.

Name: Due South Category 5 IPA
Description: The most powerful IPA in the Due South Category series, the Cat 5 is big on hops and big on flavor.  Clocking in at 8.5% ABV and 96 IBU’s, the first bands of malts will make way for the surge of hops on the palate.  Designed for the true hophead, this is not a beer for the faint of heart.

Name: Due South Category 5 Oaked IPA
Description: This imperial India pale ale is packed with pounds upon pounds of hops from the Pacific Northwest, then dry hopped with a copious amount of the fruit-forward Citra hop. We then age it for almost three weeks on new American oak to create a package of woodsy, citrusy, and pithy bitterness that will wow your senses.

Name: Coastline Lager
Description: Craft doesn’t have to be complicated. This crisp and refreshing beer is made with pale malts and a hint of rice to create the ultimate session beer. Enjoy it by the pool, on the boat, while you’re grilling, and everywhere your Florida adventure takes you.

Name: Atlanta Brewing Soul Of The City Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This new American Pale Ale celebrates the brewer's spirit of innovation, utilizing pale malt, flaked oats and a combination of Citra, Denali and Crystal hops from the pacific northwest. A soft, bright, and tropical take on a classic style.

Name: Atlanta Brewing Hartsfield IPA
Description: Contemporary IPA built around Citra and Mosaic and featuring a rotating hop. Ripe, exotic and bursting with modern hop character.

Name: Atlanta Brewing Hoplanta West Coast IPA
Description: Updated recipe of an old favorite. This west coast IPA is balanced with bold citrus flavors, brewed with Eureka!, Centennial, and Chinook hops.

Name: Atlanta Brewing Homestand Pilsner
Description: Bohemian lager at is core, Homestand is brewed with pilsner malt from Riverbend Malt House in Asheville, NC. A generous dry-hop of Mosaic and Cascade provide additional layers of complexity and an American twist.

Name: New Glory Life Pass Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: American Pale Ale brewed with Citra, Mosaic, and Simcoe hops and fermented with our neutral ale yeast.

Name: New Glory Gummy Worms Chewy Pale Ale
Description: American Pale Ale chock-full of “juicy” Pacific Northwest Hops and “chewy” wheat malt and fermented with our expressive ale yeast. Packaged in its purest form, unfined and unfiltered.

Name: New Glory UBAHDANK West Coast IPA
Description: This IPA will smack you in the face with its dank aromas and flavors. Its super sticky hop character is supported by a subtle foundation of Northern American malts. Mosaic hops provide an array of citrus and tropical fruit aromas reminiscent of grapefruit, orange, melon, papaya, tangerine and passion fruit. An uncharacteristically smooth bitterness leaves this beer insanely drinkable and will keep you coming back for more. Packaged in its purest form, unfined and unfiltered.

Name: New Glory Grandaddy Burps Double IPA
Description: American Double IPA brewed with Columbus, Mosaic, and Eureka! Hops, and Eureka! hop oil and fermented with our neutral ale yeast. Packaged in its purest form, unfined and unfiltered.

Name: New Glory Craft Brewery Do You Even Mosaic Broh? IPA
Description: What can I tell you about Mosaic? Let’s start with some facts: premiering in 2012 as “HBC 369” this hop very quickly took craft brewers by storm. With a then never before seen level of complexity and flavor from one varietal. Notes of overripe berries and tropical fruit balance nicely with a unique herbaceous dank character; Mosaic is one in a million. We love this hop so much, we decided to brew this beer, so that we could ask you all one very important question: “Do You Even Mosaic Broh?”

Name: Liquid Riot Cannonball Extra Pale Ale
Liquid Riot Sour Trouble Brown Ale
Categories: ALE, Brown Ale, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Liquid Riot Easy Like Sunday Morning Stout
Description: Imperial Oatmeal Stout made with Maine maple syrup and Guatemalan coffee from Speckled Axe Roasters.

Name: Liquid Riot Mob Scene IPA
Description: Balanced, medium bodied IPA using NZ and US hops producing lively fruit flavors including lime zest, papaya, and grapefruit peel, mixed with hints of a bag of weed.

Name: Liquid Riot Bobo Pivo
Description: Classic Czech-style Pilsner brewed for Novare Res. Clean, crisp, balanced, and refreshing

Name: Armada Brewing Neptune’s Dagger Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A crushing pale ale loaded with a custom blend of hops lending all the flavor of an IPA with the softness and low ABV of a pale ale.

Name: Armada Brewing Savage Queen Double IPA
Description:
A copper tinted Double IPA that takes no prisoners. A crisp citrusy flavor with a light malt sweetness.

Flavor Notes: Citrus, Candy, Berry

Name: Armada The Lost Beach IPA
Description: The once mystical beach has vanished without a trace. Or maybe we are lost? For now we are left with only the memories of once visiting the beautiful land.

Name: Armada Brewing Tomb Of The Pharaohs Pilsner
Description:
A golden Pilsner with a delicate noble hop bitterness. Clean and crushable.

Flavor Notes: Crisp, Noble, Delicate

Name: Resilience Pompadour
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This soft and hazy golden American Pale Ale is loaded with Idaho Gem, Mosaic, & Simcoe.  Aromas of spruce, flavors of citrus and peach.

Name: Resilience Geppetto
Description: Very dark (33+ SRM) with a beige head, this milk stout is characterized by the flavors of chocolate, soft coffee roast and marshmallow--all derived from the grain bill, lactose and late addition of whole bean coffee.

Name: Resilience Brewing Company Combover IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Citrus, strawberry and spruce notes fill the palate, Galaxy hops dominate in this American IPA.

Name: Resilience Ponyhawk
Description: Huge waves of grass, pine and citrus coat the palate as the Simcoe, Mosaic and Galaxy hops do their work

Name: Resilience Double Dry Hopped Hop Weave
Description: Hazy with dominant notes of tropical fruit, citrus and a touch of pine. Loaded with Azacca, Cashmere and Citra that play nicely with the beer's complex grist

Name: Noble Ale Works Breakaway Pale Ale
Description: An American-style Pale Ale is brewed in true California fashion.  Pale golden in color with a hoppy bouquet of orange blossom,  honeydew and grapefruit zest, this light to medium-bodied  brew has a light, French bread-like character and finishes dry,  with lingering notes of green tea and passionfruit.

Name: Noble Ale Works Citra Showers
Description: Citra is our first choice for our new Double IPA series that showcases our favorite hop varieties, one by one, with each consecutive release. This hop bursts with juicy layers of mango, lemongrass, and grapefruit. Look forward to many upcoming releases within this series of single hopped Double IPAs

Name: Noble Ale Works Nobility Imperial IPA
Description: This semi-annual brew is a classic example of a West Coast double or Imperial IPA utilizing Citra hops in pre and post fermentation

Name: Noble Ale Works I Love It! IPA
Description: We tried to make the best California IPA we could, and maybe we didn't make the best one in the state, but all we can say is, "I Love It!" This is a culmination of what we've learned (so far!) from making our single-hopped series; we utilized some of our favorite hops: Mosaic, Simcoe, Citra, Centennial, Amarillo, Equinox, and couple others. Golden in color, medium in body with flavors reminiscent of Frankenberry, magnolia flowers, and ruby red grapefruit. The finish is dry and crisp.

Name: Noble Ale Mosaic Showers
Description: Mosaic, Is another release in our Double IPA series that showcases the beauty of one single hop variey while utilizing the same recipe. This hop is one of our favorites here at Noble and is utilized in our Breakaway Pale Ale. This hop has ginormous flavors of mango, watermelon and juicy fruit. Look forward to more releases from this series.

Name: Lake Monster Loonatick Fresh Hop Ale
Lake Monster Buddy Check Session Ipa
Lake Monster Empty Rowboat IPA
Description: Brewed for the hop-head in all of us, our India Pale Ale is made with the finest American malts and a unique blend of classic and new American hops. It has a firm bitterness, intense citrus-hop aroma, and enough flavor to knock you overboard.

Name: Lake Monster Last Fathom Black Lager
Description: A malt-forward German-style Dunkel made with Minnesota wild rice.

Name: Lake Monster Calhoun Claw Pilsner
Description: Inspired by the classic lagers of Bohemia, our Pilsener has a crisp body balanced by a quick snap of refreshing bitterness. Brewed with a blend of Czech and American hops, this beer is full of flavor but still easy drinking.

Name: Strathcona All That And Then Some Pale Ale
Description: A light bodied pale ale with pilsner and white wheat malts, featuring Mosaic hops. We also added Citra, Simcoe, and Sorachi Ace hops to further enhance the citrus character and floral tones of this sessionable ale.

Name: Strathcona Love Buzz Raspberry Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A bright, refreshing European Sour Ale made with fresh raspberry juice that is moderately carbonated, light in body with a mild, tart finish.

Name: Strathcona London Calling British IPA
Description: This is first and foremost a classic, English IPA. This style is recognized for a flavouring more balanced between hops and malt as opposed to the more hop-forward IPAs of the Pacific Northwest. This is also reflected by the low hop aroma. The light hop flavouring comes from the traditional English hops Fuggles and UK Goldings. This light gold coloured beer has a moderate citrus flavour, low fruityness and a dry finish.

Name: Strathcona Premium Pilsner
Description: Our premium pilsner is a smooth and crisp beer brewed in the traditional Czech style (it originated in the city of Pilsen). It has a light straw colour and nicely balanced hop/malt flavouring with light bitterness. There is a slight floral, spicy aroma that comes from the Saaz hops.

Name: Strathcona Lemon Mandarin Radler
Description: A precise blend of lemon peel, fresh mandarin juice and beer. A light, effervescent beer that is thirst quenching and easy to drink with a tart, clean finish.

Name: Uhl’s Loh Down Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Loh Doun is a itty bitty beer meant for hot summer days, mowing lawns or just doing nothing. This hazy pale was hopped at the same rate in the kettle as Hop Down with Citra, El Dorado and Amarillo.

Name: Uhl’s Outta The Wild Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A Hazy IPA with Galaxy, Citra and Ella hops. Yes, this is pure juice. With a pilsner base, this is by far one of our most satisfying beers in mouthfeel, hop character and juicy flavors.

Name: Uhl’s Double Down DDH DIPA
Description: Hazy DDH DIPA with, yup, more Citra, El Dorado & Amarillo hops than the fermenter should have taken.

Name: Uhl’s Into The Woods Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A hazy New England style IPA coming in at 7.2% abv. Hopped with tons of Ariana, El Dorado and Idaho Gem hops.

Name: Uhl’s Enigma Hop Down IPA
Description: The Enigma Hop Down is our same Hop Down recipe with an addition of Enigma hops at the same rate as the Citra, El Dorado and Amarillo. The nose is filled with white wine grape esters and hints of citrus and pine. A little more perceived bitterness due to the high alpha acids in Enigma, 18.5%!!

Name: Dugges Mango Mango Mango
Description: It might sound like an echo, but it’s not. This collaboration with Stillwater Artisanal explores the true depth of Mango flavor. Three layers of taste and aroma from fruit and hops. Go Mango!

Name: Stillwater Dugges Tropic Punch Ale Swedish Sour
Description: Tropic Punch Ale is a joint effort with nomadic brewer Brian Strumke of Stillwater Artisanal. We brewed this sour ale with lactobacillus and let it ferment with plentiful Mango, Passion fruit and Peach. Sweet from Sweden!

Name: Dugges Smooth Imperial Stout
Description: Smooth is one of a kind but yet part of a duo. A single imperial stout that we let rest on two different types of Swedish High Coast Whisky oak barrels. A few of the barrels were peaty and the others, you guessed it, smooth. One of the ways we like it. Skål!

Name: Dugges Coffee Vanilla Black Stout
Description: This flavored beer is a layered dream! It’s sweetly soft from the malts. It’s robust from da Matteo roasted Colombian Tabi coffee. And, it’s made elegant by the addition of plush vanilla.

Name: Larimer RBF Raspberry Sour
Description: Life can be a sour bitch. But some days it brings puppies, kitties, and rainbows your way...and all is right in the world.  RBF is our pink Himalayan salted Gose out on a blind date with raspberries.

Name: Larimer La Resistance Sour Ale
Description: A Gose-style sour ale brewed with coriander and pink Himalayan salt. 4.6% ABV  A percentage of sales from this beer goes to Planned Parenthood of the Rocky Mountains.

Name: Larimer 99 Problems But A Peach Ain’t One
Description: …hit me! 99 problems jumps forward with mouthwatering notes of peach, and then follows up with subtle hints of ginger. Don’t let the “Sour Ale” description fool you, this well balanced and sessionable ale rolls as more of a tart peach, than that of a full mouth pucker.  Perfect for a day on the patio, or in front of a nighttime campfire. 5.2% ABV A percentage of sales from this beer goes to Youth on Record.

Name: Larimer Regulators Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: 6.6% ABV hazy NE-style IPA. Brewed with raw oats, wheat, lactose sugar, and triple dry-hopped with Mosaic, Citra, and Amarillo. Low IBUs but huge juicy citrus blast of hop aroma and flavor.

Name: Larimer Domestically Challenged Pilsner
Description: For our friends who can't be tamed, we know how to make any brewhouse into a brewhome. Let us be your  humble servants in enforcing our domestic policy that every person should have the right to enjoy this delicious Pilsner. Domestically Challenged is brewed with Perle hops and lager cool and slow before receiving numerous dry-hop additions of Citra. 5.6% ABV

Name: Blindman Citrus Florida Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Blindman Lemons & Limes Kettle Sour
Description: Citrus forward but not puckering sour beer.

Name: Blindman River Session Ale
Description: Blindman River Session Ale is our flagship beer. Featuring an intense dry hop aroma and delicious hop taste with muted bitterness, it finishes dry and leaves us wanting another. It's a beer we can hand to friends knowing they'll dig it. It's a style we keep coming back to, no matter where our tastes may wander.

Name: Blindman Longshadows IPA
Description: Dry, resinous west coast American ale with hoppy notes of citrus, spice and funk.

Name: Blindman Five of Diamonds Pilsner
Description: Clean, bright, pilsner ready for all your days out in the clean, bright outdoors.

Name: The Tap Intergalactic Acid
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Super sessionable, low bitterness with lots of bright and funky tartness. The malt is mashed for 36 hours until it literally becomes sour by breaking down the glucose in the malt, producing lactic acid. Often times in Germany this beer is flavored with raspberry or Woodruff (sour apple) syrup which we special order and are available at the brewpub. We keep things real legit.

Name: The Tap Solar Plexus Double IPA
The Tap Mosaicus IPA
Description: This IPA features a slightly hazy, bright orange color, and medium body. Reminiscent of a West Coast IPA with a little bitterness up front with a delightful balance of fruit and resin.

Name: The Tap Marzin Scorsce Oktoberfest
Description: Pouring a deep amber with a thin lace of head, this beer has sweet breads in the nose, mixed with some citrus buried deep in back. It drinks very smooth, with just a nice bubbly sweetness of toffee and caramel. The finish has a touch of bitterness but the sweetness is definitely the overriding presence in this beer. Very delicious, and would've been worth raising a stein with. Excellent beer.

Name: Pizza Boy Eternal Sunshine Dry Hopped Sour Ale
Description: Slightly hazy golden yellow color, white head. Aroma of meadow and lemongrass. Taste is fresh flowers, bitter herbs.

Name: Pizza Boy Park Pounder IPA
Description: Park Pounder is super hazy, with notes of tangerine, lychee and clementine.

Name: Pizza Boy West Shore IPA
Description: A west coast style IPA over-the-top hoppy and oh so dry. Hopped with Simcoe, columbus and a touch of citra.

Name: Pizza Boy You’ve Got A Friend In IPA
Description: A simple, elegant, thirst quenching IPA brewed for the summer months. Dry hopped with restraint, we utilized Cascade and a touch of Simcoe for their highly aromatic and tropical qualities.

Name: Pizza Boy Hazelton Native
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A dank and citrusy West Coast style IPA brewed with Pale Ale and a smidge of Caramel Pils with Cascade and Amarillo hops leading the way from kettle to double dry hopping.

Name: Barrel Brothers Plum Punch
Description: An unstoppably drinkable kettle sour packing a 1-2 punch of ripe plum and zippy citrus. Think "fresh squeezed lemonade meets a Plum Sour cocktail" to engage the senses like a bare-knuckle boxing match for your tastebuds. It's never been this much fun to get Punch'd! Plum Punch.

Name: Barrel Brothers ‘Mango Punch’ Sour with Mango
Description: An unstoppably drinkable kettle sour packing a 1-2 punch of tropical mango anc candied citrus. Think "lemonade stand meets mango daiquiri" to engage the senses like a bare-knuckle boxing match for your taste buds. It's never been this much fun top get Punch'd! Mango Punch.

Name: Barrel Brothers The Brothermaker Double IPA
Description: We packed the Hop Spanker full of Azacca Citra, Mosaic and Amarillo hops, not once but twice to supply the BrotherMaker with a double dose of hop homies. 2-Row Pale Ale and Wheat back up this heavy hitting hop line up with a balanced malty sweetness.

Name: Barrel Brothers Naughty Hops IPA
Description: Dry hopped with our revolutionary 'Hop Spanker' technology Naughty Hops tantalizes with aromas of green tea and citrus, with a full malty backbone and a not-too-bitter hop finish, leaving you saying "Thank you, may I have another?"

Name: Cantillon Saint Gilloise
Description: Two-year-old lambic that is dry-hopped and bottled with a small amount of sugar liquor to begin refermentation in the bottle.

Name: Cantillon Saint Lamvinus Lambic
Description: Everyone knows some of our best friends are wine growers from the Libourne region in France, more specifically those who make Saint Emillion and Pomerol. They respect the tradition and let their wine ferment in a natural way.  Fermentation, origin and vintage are still kept up.  Our collaboration resulted in a product uniting the best of their wine and of our beer : the Saint-Lamvinus.  The grapes, of the merlot and cabernet-franc varieties, are soaked in Bordeaux barrels containing two to three years old lambic. The beer is not blended before the bottling. The foam is caused by the addition of a liquor which starts the fermentation.

Name: Cantillon Iris
Description: From the brewery's website: "Although it is a spontaneous fermentation beer, the Iris is very different from the Lambic. The amber colour and the bitter and slightly caramelized taste make it a complex beer."

Name: Cantillon Fou Foune
Description: Apricot lambic

Name: 8 Wired A Fist Full Of Cherries Sour Ale
Description: We barrel aged our first beer in 2010. Since then we have built up what we believe is one of the largest barrel ageing programmes of any brewery in the Southern Hemisphere. Here we produce many different sour beers, some traditional, some not. - Søren Eriksen - Brewer

Name: 8 Wired Le Fut
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A complex sour red ale brewed in the Flemish tradition and aged in French oak barrels for two years. Blended from 15 unique barrels to create the perfect combination of acidity and sweetness, funk and fruitiness.

Name: 8 Wired Wild Feijoa Sour Ale
Description: Ale brewed with feijoas and aged in wine barrels.

Name: 8 Wired iStout
Description: Beware, this is a BIG beer. Brimming with luscious roasted coffee and chocolate malt flavours which are balanced by a brisk bitterness and bold freshness from the hops.  If you’re feeling politically incorrect try it with your favourite cigar, or a dram of your best single malt whisky. Or, if your tooth is sweeter, why not jump in at the deep end with the most decadent dessert of all; half a bottle in a glass with a generous scoop of vanilla ice cream on top (beer geeks like us know it as the Imperial Stout Float). Or simply enjoy it on its own as a decadent dessert or night cap - the perfect winter warmer!  If you don’t already know the history of Russian Imperial Stouts please check it out on the internet, it’s a good story. But remember, although based on that century-old classic style, this beer is a very modern interpretation, like all our beers!

Name: 8 Wired The Big Smoke Porter
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: We’ve taken our best porter recipe and added a good measure of the famous Bamberg Rauchmalz (beechwood smoked malt). The smoke mingles beautifully with the rich, dark roasted chocolate flavours of the porter without being overpowering.

Name: Knotted Root Thick Strawberry Goo
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Thick Strawberry Goo is a smoothie-style Berliner Weisse. Brewed with over 420 pounds of strawberry, raspberry, and passionfruit. Tart and jammy at 5.6%, the “Goo” brewed with a little bit of lactose, a dose of Madagascar vanilla beans, then dry-hopped with Motueka.  Think strawberry jam, red sour patch kids, and tart cherries.

Name: Knotted Root Beyond Description
Description: We’re “beyond” excited about how this second batch came out. Bursting with notes of palisade peaches, mango froyo, and orange sorbet, we truly can’t wait to share this one with you.

Name: Knotted Root Suspended in the Trees
Knotted Root Cheap Fabric & Dim Lighting IPA
Description: Cheap Fabric and Dim Lighting is an Unfiltered, Double Dry Hopped Citra-focused IPA. When you're the master of your domain, selling beltless raincoats with Harry Fleming, and writing checks for $19.45, you can deliver into this hoppy ale and yell, Serenity Now! And remember, it's not a lie if you believe it. Think cold pressed clementine juice, strawberry gummy bears, and fruit punch.

Name: Knotted Root Blue Light Rain
Description: “Blue Light Rain” is an Unfiltered German Pilsner brewed in a traditional manner. Fermented cold and for an extended period of time, we used Callista hops to impart a noble, grape-like character. German Barke malt provides some body in this light and dry beer. Clocking in at 5.3%, it’s the perfect late summer beer as you walk and wonder why. Think bready, earthy, crispy with a hint of lemon.

Name: Wild Barrel Vice Strawberry Sour
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Wild Barrel Brewing Vice Cranzu Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Wild Barrel Brewing Vice Blueberry Cherry
Wild Barrel Brewing Vice Black Currant Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Wild Barrel Hazy Viking
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Dry hopped w/ Citra & Vic Secret

Name: Epic Big Bad Baptist Pecan Pie Stout
Description: With a nod to our Big Bad Baptist fans south of the Mason-Dixon, we’re taking on a southern classic dessert, the bourbon pecan pie. Brewed with cinnamon and pecans to pair perfectly with the bourbon & coffee notes of Big Bad Baptist, everyone from the east, west, north and south can skip the pie and pass the beer.

Name: Epic Brewing Big Bad Baptist Sextuple Barrel
Description: This beer represents the culmination of a half-decade of pushing the boundaries of barrel-aged beer. The very final effort in our annual numbered series which began in 2016, Sextuple Barrel Big Bad Baptist includes all of our favorite ingredients. We hope you enjoy this last beer of the series as much as we enjoyed making it.

Name: Epic Brewing Big Bad Baptist Chocolate Raspberry Stout
Description: The road to romance is paved with Chocolate and Raspberries! Tangy and tart raspberries blended gloriously with the rich, chocolaty goodness of Big Bad Baptist. Take your time and savor this luxurious blend with someone who is more than a friend. An easy crowd pleaser on a Sunday social or other gathering with or without powdered doughnuts.

Name: Epic Brewing Big Bad Baptist Chocolate Peanut Butter Stout
Description:
We found a winning combination with Big Baptist Baptist and peanuts. This year, we are taking it to the next level with more peanuts and more cacao. So
pour a glass and take a ride to liquid dessert heaven.

Name: Epic Brewing Bigger Badder Baptista
Description: 2017 was our first release of the Big Bad Baptista, a barrel-aged stout inspired by Café de Olla, and you loved it so much we had to release more in 2018. We missed it in 2019 so for 2020 we wanted to bring back the Baptista, but with a vengeance! Inspired by the smokey bite of Mezcal, we added a pinch of smoked malt, and a dash of salt to the mix of the Café de Olla spices. The Bigger Badder Baptista is the Vaquero Bandito of the Baptist family. Don’t mess with this hombre, he’s the Baddest Baptist yet.

Name: Carib Royal Extra Stout
Description: Royal Extra stout is a rich, dark, fairly sweet stout, which conveys power, strength and potency/virility.

Name: Carib Lager
Description: Launched on May 16th, 1950, this full bodied, clear and refreshing lager with 5.2% ABV is the flagship brand of Carib Brewery and the preferred brew of Trinidad and Tobago.

Name: Carib Sorrel Shandy
Description: Blend of lager beer with artificial sorrel flavour and artificially coloured

Name: Carib Ginger Shandy
Description: Blend of lager beer with natural ginger flavour and caramel flavor.

Name: Carib Lime Shandy
Description: Lime Shandy can be described as having a pleasant citrus, fruity, tangy and refreshing taste, with a fresh lemon-lime aroma and taste.

Name: Living The Dream Arapahaze
Description: Idaho 7 and Mosaic Dry Hopped Double Hazy NEIPA

Name: Living The Dream 7 Speed IPA
Description: American style IPA dry hopped with Simcoe, Mosaic, & Falconer's Flight hops. Well balanced with All-American malts.

Name: Living The Dream Schüss Bomber Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager

Name: Living The Dream American Lager
Description: Crisp, clean American Lager w/ a dry and refreshing finish.

Name: Notch Brewing Left Of The Dial Session IPA
Description: Celebrating the modest ABV of British IPAs, yet with the passion and stone fruit aromas of US hop varieties, Left of the Dial uses British malt, hard water and a new wave hop profile.

Name: Notch Brewing Session Pils Czech Pale Lager
Description: Notch Session Pils salutes the session pale lagers of the Czech Republic: crisp, herbal, and hoppy. The Czech culture is a beer culture, and their beer of choice is this low gravity pale lager known as Světlé Výčepní.

Name: Notch Brewing Raw Power
Description: Small in stature, big in character. A New England lower strength IPA with all the character of something bigger.
