Name: Frost Beer Works Lush Double IPA
Description: A double IPA with luxuriant aromatics and succulent flavors. The combination of hops from both hemispheres and our ale yeast complement each other to create rich, juicy character.

Name: Frost Beer Works Research Series Double IPA
Description: Our Double IPA Research Series gives us the opportunity to make bold moves with hops involving varieties, dosage rates, and process, all in search of discovering new territories of aroma and flavor.

Name: Frost Beer Works Double Shush
Description: Shush scaled up to a imperial IPA. A rousing beer with citrus and hints of spice.

Name: Frost Beer Works Double Ponyboy
Description: Double dry hopped imperial IPA bursting with heavy additions of Citra and Mosaic hops. Stay platinum, Ponyboy.

Name: Strange Breakfast Grapefruit IPA
Description: Start your day off right, with a glass of grapefruit, IPA that is. This citrus hop bomb using Citra and Amarillo hops is just what the doctor ordered!

Name: Strange 1000 Barrel Double IPA
Description: In honor of hitting 1000 barrels brewed since we opened in 2010, we went big time with a hop monster. Over 3 pounds of Simcoe, Amarillo, and Summit hops per barrel in this light gold 8.25% ABV easy-drinking Imperial

Name: Strange Breakfast Grapefruit IPA
Description: Start your day off right, with a glass of grapefruit, IPA that is. This citrus hop bomb using Citra and Amarillo hops is just what the doctor ordered!

Name: Strange Cherry Kriek
Description: We named this Strange Brew ‘Cherry Cherry’ because that’s what it is. There’s so much cherry in this beer even its foamy head is red! A Dark Belgian Wheat recipe crammed full of Montmorency Tart Pie Cherry goodness

Name: Strange Farmhouse Ale
Description: Fruity, spicy, malty with just the right amount of Czech Saaz hoppiness. This big, bold beautiful Belgian ale will sneak up on you with it’s easy drinkability and its high alcohol. Enjoy this brew  carefully so as not to Get ‘Housed!

Name: Shebeen Hadouken IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Smooth subtle fruit flavors of peach and apricot in this very drinkable New England IPA.

Name: Shebeen These Are A Few of My Favorite Things
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Shebeen Alpaca Blanca
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This New England IPA is full of Azacca and Mosaic, giving it a fresh melon/citrus flavor.

Name: Shebeen Space Farmer
Description: Blended with Saaz and Ekuanot hops this beer combines elements of a New England IPA and an old school West Coast IPA.

Name: Equilibrium Brewery MC² Double IPA
Description: MC² is Photon’s big brother. We literally took Photon’s hopping rate and squared it. This DIPA is our tribute to the amazing relationship that energy and mass are balanced, proportional to the speed of a photon squared. It pours a hazy tangerine color, releasing bright tropical notes of mango, pineapple, and apricot. MC² tastes like succulent mango juice loaded with chewy hop resins. It’s very drinkable for 8.0%; be careful, this one can sneak up on you.

Name: Equilibrium Raining Belma IPA
Description: Raining Belma From a Lactose Sky is a natural lyrical progression from Raining Belma, which starts with the same grain bill, supersizes the hop bill, and adds a touch of lactose. For this next tough-as-nails-beer is our heavy metal series we present you flavor and aroma: strawberries and cream over a citrus backdrop.

Name: Equilibrium dHop26 IPA
Description: The next dHop is here. This uses a special Haas pellet in between a normal T90 and LUPOMAX. Based on this processing of the hop cone, we felt that this beer would play very nice with our Energy treatment to further extract the deliciousness that this hop could offer. dHop 26 pours a vivid yellow with an aroma of bright citrus, earthy grass, and blueberry. Flavors of bright orange, red currants, and assorted berry lead with a touch of floral earth that morphs together into a beautiful representation of the Mosaic hop. Light and easy to drink, an escalating rainbow melon #EQjuice finish builds up to a great finish.

Name: Equilibrium Super Fractal Julia Set
Description:
The Julia Set is named after the French mathematician Gaston Julia. This complex set exists as a by-product of the Mandelbrot set and was devised while studying complex dynamics during the early 20th century. This set of complex numbers can cause drastic changes in the sequence of iterated functions.
Tying this into the newest beer of our series, we scaled up from Fractal using a super simple grain bill of 2-Row and our specific fractal fermentation profile before intensely hoping it with a Mosaic and El Dorado whirlpool and a dry hop of Citra, Mosaic, Strata and El Dorado.

Name: Champion Malibu Nights DIPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft
Description: This bright pink IPA is brewed with tangerines and hibiscus for a crisp and refreshing taste, and dry-hopped with Citra and Amarillo for big fruity aromas.

Name: Champion Brewing Wheeze the Juice IPA
Description: A juicy IPA dry-hopped for maximum flavor with mandarina bavaria, el dorado, and cascade hops.

Name: Champion Brewing Shower Beer Pilsner
Description: This award winning beer is perfect for any relaxing occasion. Shower Beer took home the 2015 Gold Medal at GABF and hasn't looked back. This bohemian pilsner sings with clean, fresh maltiness and spicy aroma contributions from 100% traditional czech saaz hops. If you haven't had a beer in the shower, it is about time you did.

Name: Champion The Pils Are Alive
Description: Our dry hopped pilsner has long been a fan favorite. This seasonal variation contains a nice amount of citra hops.

Name: Champion True Love Mexican Lager
Description: A party in a can. Clean and refreshing lager beer inspired by classics from south of the border and brewed with our friends at Cockfight Skateboards. Enjoy with a lime or as is.

Name: Colorado Native Amber Lager
Description: Colorado Native Amber is one of those beers that feels like it fits right into any Colorado occasion. Sessionable for warmer afternoons yet still flavorful for when you’re looking to shed the day with friends. Crisp, malty sweetness. Moderate hopiness. You’ll like it. Possibly love it. Maybe even smuggle it. Whether it's a hot summer afternoon or you just got done hitting the ski slopes - this is the beer for you.

Name: Colorado Native West Slope IPA
Description: Guess you could call this a Colorado-style IPA if there ever was a thing. It’s made with only Colorado-grown hops from the Western Slope. It’s only sold in Colorado. And it’s the only IPA with a ski pass. So yeah, that makes Colorado Native West Slope IPA our kind of IPA. 	This IPA has a medium body mouthfeel with lingering citrus hop notes.

Name: Colorado Native IPL
Description: We don’t believe the world needs another IPA. We do, however believe there is room for a beer that is similar to an IPA, but is one that allows the hop characters to shine through as only a lager can do... "An IPA done better", if you will. To get this clean, crisp character, we brewed an "IPA style" beer, using lager yeast. The lager yeast is superior, in this case, because it doesn’t create all of the fruity esters and fusel alcohols that ale yeast create... so it allows the delicate hop oils to shine through in the beer. Our IPL takes longer to brew and is more expensive to make than an IPA, but once you try this IPL, we think you’ll agree........ It’s worth the extra time and expense.

Name: Colorado Native Mtn. Pass Pils
Description: Colorado is a beer state. In fact, it’s been that way before it was even a state. So naturally, we brewed a Pils to pay tribute to those first beers that quenched the thirst of early pioneers. Crisp as a bluebird day, Colorado Native Mtn. Pass Pils will remind you why you came here in the first place. This pilsner pours a bright gold color with an impressive white crown and has aromas of bright hop notes followed by fresh biscuit aroma. Taste of a clean hop bite with fresh grain notes.

Name: Colorado Native Seasonal
Description: Seasonal beer offered by AC Golden Brewing Co.!

Name: Greenpoint Tremendous
Description: The failing Greenpoint Beer & Ale Company should support AMERICAN hop farmers. Stop funding dumb Australian imports. Bad (and SAD) deal! This is the most TREMENDOUS Imperial IPA ever made. Believe me I know, everyone agrees.

Name: Greenpoint Resist
Description: IPA brewed with wheat, oats, Mosaic and Columbus.

Name: Greenpoint No Wave Double IPA
Description: This Double IPA bursts out of the can with aromatics reminiscent of lightly toasted sourdough, freshly mashed blueberries, and a touch of pineapple skin (is that even a thing?). Brewed with spelt, raw wheat, flaked oats, and wildflower honey. Hopped with Mosaic lupulin, Hallertau Blanc, and Motueka. Double dry hopped with Mosaic and Blanc

Name: Greenpoint Particle
Description: Ultralight Pilsner malt with Centennial hops.

Name: Transient The Juice Is Loose Double IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hops burst out of this glass with absolutely no bitterness. Bright fruit flavor of passion fruit and citrus. We will make more. We must make more..

Name: Transient Rainbows & Waterfalls
Description: Galaxy, Mosaic, and Belma hopped.

Name: BlackStack Still Watching? Double IPA
Description: Are you there beer nerds? Its me, Blackstack. This is a beer for binge...watching and falling asleep on the couch. A hop hug so loving you’ll think it might carry you up to bed. Citra, El Dorado, Ella, and Rakau in “9 seasons with 22 episodes each” amounts. Bottoms up to being down for one more episode of collapsed cakes and overcooked pastries.

Name: BlackStack Worst Behavior IPA
Description: Coming back on our worst behavior. Citra and Nelson hops. Just say when. A beer for rough housing and running by the pool. An ale for acting extra and texting exes. This one's for getting physical and failing physicals. We played by the rules on the last few drops but, f*** it, hold my phone. When.

Name: BlackStack Thunder Lizard
Description: Thunder Lizard is a resounding expression of gratitude. A reverberating token of appreciation. The Science Museum of Minnesota asked us at Blackstack to make a beer to honor the outpouring of support from thunder lizard fans. We used Zeus hops from Minnesota's own Mighty Axe hops and Azacca in the whirlpool. Dry-hopped with Falconer's Flight and Australian Vic Secret, or, as we call it, the thunder from down under. All the better to thank you with.

Name: Schlenkerla Marzen Smokebeer
Description: Original Schlenkerla Smokebeer - Märzen  Bamberg's speciality, a dark, bottom fermented smokebeer, brewed with Original Schlenkerla Smokemalt from the Schlenkerla maltings and tapped according to old tradition directly from the gravity-fed oakwood cask in the historical brewery tavern.    Data:  Original gravity: 13.2%   Alcohol: 5.1%   Bitterness: 30

Name: Schlenkerla Dopplebock
Description: From the Germany  "Following century old recipes all malts made at the Schlenkerla brewery are dried by wood fire. While for the classic “Aecht Schlenkerla Rauchbier” traditionally beech has been – and still is – used, the malt for “Schlenkerla Oak Smoke” is kilned with oak wood. The resulting Oak Smoke Malt has a smoother and more multi layered smoky note than the intensely aromatic Beech Smoke Malt. The hence complex smokiness in “Schlenkerla Oak Smoke” is paired with the multifaceted bitterness of finest Hallertau aroma hops. With 8% alcohol and Bernstein color it matures for months in the deep brewery cellars underneath Bamberg into a special treat for smoke beer lovers for Christmas." -- Rated 99 on RateBeer

Name: Schlenkerla Helles Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: “Schlenkerla Helles” is brewed with fine Bavarian aroma hops from the area around the city of Nürnberg. It's lagered in century old caves underneath the historic Schlenkerla brewery and maltings. Schlenkerla Helles is boiled in the same copper kettles and bottom fermented by the same yeast as the historic Schlenkerla Smokebeer. Its subtle smokiness without using smoke malt makes “Helles Schlenkerla Lager” a unique representative of the classic lager beer style “Bavarian Helles”.

Name: Aecht Schlenkerla Fastenbier
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: The Original Schlenkerla Lentbeer is an unfiltered smokebeer, brewed according to the Bavarian Purity Law of 1516. Bottom-fermenting yeast gives the reddish brown lentbeer a natural cloudiness. Its smokey aroma is already noticeable in the smell, combined with a fine hoppy note. In the drink the fullbodied, highly drinkable lentbeer shows its strong malty flavour, rounded up with the smokey taste and a light bitterness. Due to the nourishing yeast, the Original Schlenkerla Lentbeer has the "Brotzeit already included" (German word for afternoon snack).

Name: Aecht Schlenkerla Rauchbier Weizen
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Schlenkerla Smokebeer Wheat is an ale with light smoky aroma. As Bavarian wheat beers, it is being brewed with a mixture of both barley malt and wheat malt. The portion of barley malt is hereby a classic Schlenkerla smokemalt, while the wheat malt remains unsmoked. Served unfiltered with its natural haziness, Schlenkerla Wheat reaches its full aroma through bottle fermentation with fine top fermenting yeast.

Description:
The world's No. 1 German beer, Beck's is renowned for uncompromising quality by consumers in over 85 countries. True to its original recipe, Beck's beer has been brewed in the same way using four key natural ingredients for more than 140 years. The hops used to brew Beck's today still come from the Hallertau region, and every bottle of Beck's is brewed according to the uncompromising German Reinheitsgebot (Purity Law).

Description: Keylightful is Keystone Light’s fruity cousin that ups the fun-factor as an easy-drinking brew. It brings together a refreshingly sweet duo of raspberry and lime twisted with a splash of your always smooth go-to beer. Each sip delivers just the right amount of delicious, natural fruit flavor that everyone can get behind. It has 125 calories, 10.6g of carbs, and 4.1% ABV. The berry taste is sweet but not too sweet, with a great tartness blend, while finishing clean, crisp and smooth, just like a light beer. Because It’s light and sweet, this session beer is a great choice for any social drinking gathering, including pool parties, beach days, tailgating, backyard barbeques, boating, concerts, picnics, camping, bonfires, and holiday gatherings. And for those big holiday get-togethers, such as the Fourth (4th) of July, Valentine's Day, Halloween, St. Patrick’s Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day, Mother's Day, Thanksgiving, and Friendsgiving, Keylightful is a great beer option everyone can enjoy.

Description: Refreshing Hard Seltzer made with real fruit and pure, simple ingredients!

Name: Pakka Black Cherry Hard Seltzer
Description:
Black Cherries are known for being some of the
sweetest types of both cherries and fruits growing
today, and this flavor of Pakkā works wonders with
its strong taste, bottling the wonderful delectable
real fruit and giving it a kick of carbonated seltzer.
The natural cherry juice mixes well with the hard
and crisp taste of the Pakkā Hard Seltzer.

Name: Pakka Grapefruit Tangerine Hard Seltzer
Description:
For citrus and fruit lovers alike, the Pakkā Hard
Seltzer Grapefruit Tangerine adapts the taste of
those two fruits and infuses it with the flavor of
the seltzer and alcohol to make a perfect mix of
acidic and crisp. The explosive tart flavor of pure,
genuine grapefruit and tangerine still fits in with
the alcohol and seltzer while also maintaining that
classic orangey feel, making it a wonderful drink
with a true twist of tang.

Name: Pakka Mixed Berry Hard Seltzer
Description:
A refreshing seltzer made with a combination of raspberry, blackberry,
blueberry and strawberry!

Name: Pakka Cherry Lime Hard Seltzer
Description: Sweet and tart were made for each other!  The Cherry-Lime one-two punch gives this Pakkā Hard Seltzer a tangy blend of the genuine fruit.  The unique sweetness of our black and red cherry juice makes it different from many of the other hard seltzers you’ve tried!

Name: Switchback Ale
Description: Switchback Ale was developed as a flavor concept, not adhering to any style guidelines. Using only traditional ingredients, Switchback Ale is an unfiltered, reddish-amber ale which is particularly well-balanced, allowing for complexity of flavor coupled with an unusually smooth and refreshing character. Five different malts, select hop varieties, and our own specially cultivated yeast create an ale which leads with hop fl¬avors and a subtle impression of fruit (our yeast’s contribution), followed by a palate pleasing malty finish.

Name: Switchback Ale 1/6 Barrel
Description: Switchback Ale was developed as a flavor concept, not adhering to any style guidelines. Using only traditional ingredients, Switchback Ale is an unfiltered, reddish-amber ale which is particularly well-balanced, allowing for complexity of flavor coupled with an unusually smooth and refreshing character. Five different malts, select hop varieties, and our own specially cultivated yeast create an ale which leads with hop fl¬avors and a subtle impression of fruit (our yeast’s contribution), followed by a palate pleasing malty finish.

Name: Switchback IPA
Description: Formulated specifically to maximize a fresh character and hop flavor that lasts throughout its shelf life; Switchback IPA generously blends Centennial, Amarillo, Cascade, Chinook and Simcoe hops. A complex aroma pairs with a light malt touch to create a delightfully flavorful IPA with citrus and floral accents. The Switchback IPA Can travels anywhere and raises the bar for a premium IPA experience.

Name: Switchback Citra Pils Keller Bier
Description: Born as a classic pilsener lager, Citra-Pils gets the added bonus of a lively, citrusy aroma from Citra hops to create a fascinating blend of pilsener and IPA sensibilities. The result is a complex beer which is clean, crisp, and refreshing. Citra-Pils is our special “twist” on the classic pilsener style of lager beer. We brew this lager in the most traditional way, using only Light Pils malt and Saaz hops. After a six-week lagering process, we dry hop this beer with a blend of Citra and Saaz hops. The bright lemony citrus notes of the Citra complement the noble Saaz character perfectly, yielding a delightfully refreshing pilsener with a decidedly nontraditional twist.

Name: MadTree Happy Amber
Description:
AMBER ALE
Caramel | Floral | Bready
Year-round: 6-pack and draft
ABV: 6% | IBU: 30From restaurant foodie to backyard griller, Happy Amber is here to elevate any meal. Infused into a gourmet dish or just sipped from a can while barbecuing, find your happy place and enjoy this award-winning beer.HOPS
Cascade, Chinook
MALTS
2-Row, Munich 10L, Melanoidin, Carmel 80L, Victory

Name: MadTree S’more Gratitude
Description:
STOUT
Choclate| Vanilla | Rich
Seasonal | 6-packs and draft
ABV: 7.5% | IBU: 32A rich, yet balanced stout from a collaboration with local vegan dessert maker Grateful Grahams, S'more Gratitude has vanilla beans and lactose as well as cocoa powder and cacao nibs. Inspired by the classic campfire treat, this beer brings all the goodness with a lot less mess. Go ahead and get S'more.HOPS
Cascade
MALTS
2-Row, Oat Flakes, Chocolate Malt, Dark Munich 30L, Carafa Special Type 1
ADJUNCTS
Lactose, Vanilla, Cocoa Nibs

Name: MadTree Psychopathy IPA
Description:
IPA
Bright | Citrus | Floral
Year-round | 6-pack and draft
ABV: 6.9% | IBU: 60A staple beer to keep stocked in the fridge, this reliable IPA bursts with bright citrus flavors followed by a smooth finish. PsycHOPathy is the go-to option for any day, especially the ones hanging out with friends.HOPS
Cascade, Chinook, Centennial
MALTS
2-Row, Vienna, Caramel 40L, Carap

Name: MadTree Galaxy High
Description:
IMPERIAL IPA
Pungent | Fruity | Assertive
Limited | 4-packs and draft
ABV: 9.5% | IBU: 120At Galaxy High, the beer has 120 IBUs, 9.5% ABV yet finishes nice and dry. Join two Australian hops as you encounter a crazy collection of tropical and dank flavors throughout this Imperial IPA. It’s big on your palate… disruptive even. Think 'trophic cascades' disruptive.HOPS
Galaxy, Topaz
MALTS
2-Row, Vienna, Caramel 40L, Carapils, Dextrose

Name: Fire Island Lighthouse Ale
Description: Fire Island is known for being easy going with a lot of character  so Fire Island Lighthouse Ale has been crafted the exact same way. A soft carbonation and light caramel finish make Fire Island Lighthouse Ale easy to drink  yet it has the toasty round body of a classic American Ale to give it real substance. It's a beer for all seasons  all foods  and all friends. Or as we like to say  the kind of beer you want to have a beer with.

Name: Fire Island Sea Salt Ale
Description: Brewed with a German pilsner malt base, Munich specialty malts, Magnum bittering hops, and real Atlantic Sea Salt, Sea Salt Ale cools you down even on the hottest of days.

Name: Fire Island Red Wagon IPA
Description: This IPA is a pale bronze color with a wonderfully spicy and peppery hop aroma balanced by resins, cracker wheat and tangy fruit. Bitter and spicy hops kick in powerfully followed with gooseberry fruit and honeyed malt. Some malty sweetness comes through in the finish balancing the shatteringly bitter hops and sharp fruit.

Name: Fire Island Pumpkin Barrel Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Medicine Hat Sin Bin Red Ale
Description: The iconic hotel that sits in the downtown core of Medicine Hat has been a part of our city’s history for over 100 years, and the stories those walls could tell could make some blush. The Sin Bin Red Ale is also meant to contribute to some great stories for those that enjoy this damn fine brew. The Sin Bin Red Ale is made to be infinitely drinkable; with its malt-forward profile, and just enough hops to keep the malt in check. The Sin Bin is brewed with anticipation of converting some light lager drinkers over to the ale side. Not as malty as an Irish Red Ale, nor as hoppy as an American Amber/Red Ale, the Sin Bin will prove to satisfy the taste buds to a point that you will have a difficult time telling stories because you’ll be too busy enjoying the Red Ale. 5.0% abv 17 ibu’s.

Name: Medicine Hat Burnside Blood Orange Blonde Ale
Description: A.P. Burns was a noted businessman, contractor, builder and rancher in post-1900 Medicine Hat. One of his business endeavours was as a principal in the Burnside Development Corporation that was formed with several prominent early citizens including: H.L. Tweed, C.R. Mitchell, Charles S. Pingle & Dr. C.S. Smith. Each shareholder brought either capital or land from what is now the Burnside area into the corporation for the purpose of developing the area into an urban subdivision. Over 100 years later, Burnside still sits as bare land, but the views of the red rock coulees is spectacular when the sun is setting. It’s a glow that resembles the color of a fire, similar to what you’d expect from a blood orange ale. The Burnside Blood Orange uses our Hatfield Blonde as the base and then we add copious amounts of real blood orange puree. The end result is the perfect thirst quencher, one of Mitch’s mom’s favorites and we are sure A.P. Burns would be quite fond of it as well.

Name: Medicine Hat Patio Series Witbier
Description:
The Belgian Witbier has been synonymous with warm weather and the great outdoors since the thirteenth century. Our take on this historic style pours a hazy off-white, with bright citrus and herbaceous notes from the use of coriander seeds, unmalted wheat, orange peel, and other unique aromatics.

Classic in influence and modern in presentation — we hope you enjoy this taste of Belgium from our family in Medicine Hat.

Name: Medicine Hat Industrial Ave IPA
Description: Industrial Ave is where it all started for Medicine Hat Brewing Company back in 1912. This street owns our heritage and you see many of the original buildings from those years still standing within the city. The Industrial Ave takes on the name of our heritage and is considered the big brother to our Aberdeen Pale Ale. This IPA is made to satiate the self-proclaimed hophead. There are copious amounts of American style hops used in the brew kettle and dry hop additions to assault the senses with citric aromas and flavours. This beer boasts a 6.7% abv but the ibu’s are one that we must claim as questionable because once you reach a certain point, ibu’s are immeasurable without a spectrophotometer – Industrial Ave is in that range.

Name: Wallace Brewing Company Redlight Irish Red Ale
Description: The Irish Red style is a favorite among craft beer lovers and is a great introduction into the craft beer movement for the novice drinker. This beer takes its name from Wallace’s former Red Light district, and has an attractive ruby red color that leads into a complex caramel malty experience with hints of biscuit, nut, toffee and cherry/plum flavors. With medium body and spicy/flowery mild hop bitterness, this RedLight Red is sure to hook you in for another.

Name: Wallace Brewing Company Vindicator IPA
Description: The Vindicator falls in the middle of the merger between the traditional English IPA and the robust, heavily hopped American IPA. The Vindicator is a well-balanced, very drinkable example of the style. Lots of 2 row base malt mixed with caramel and other specialty malts, including 20% ID-grown pilsner, provide a medium to full body for the strong, assertive hop flavor and aroma provided in this bold IPA.

Name: Wallace Brewing Huckleberry Shandy
Description: Supporting the berries is a smooth blend of Wallace Brewing's Idaho Select Lager and homemade lemonade consisting of simply lemons, sugar and water. Delicate berry and slightly tart lemonade on the nose, juicy berries shine through on the palate that's anchored by a crisp lager and bright carbonation.

Name: Bloomington Brewing Company Ruby Bloom Amber Ale
Description: Beautiful rich red-amber in color. Smooth with a hint of sweetness.

Name: Sebago Runabout Red
Description: Runabout Red Ale is a classic. It is brewed with three malt varieties which create the sweet malty backbone and deep amber color. The bready malt character transitions to grassy hops that glide on your palate with every sip.

Name: Simmer Down
Description: Designed for your Summer activities or relaxing your day away. Floral notes of citrus and passion fruit with a clean and crisp finish. Summer in Maine is in Session.

Name: Sebago Haze FWD
Description: Haze Fwd is our refined version of the New England IPA. Generous late additions of both classic and new school hops round out this tropical, hazy IPA.

Name: Sebago Simmer Down Summer Session
Description: Designed for your Summer activities or relaxing your day away. Floral notes of citrus and passion fruit with a clean and crisp finish. Summer in Maine is in Session.

Name: Great Western Original 16 Copper Ale
Description: Brewed with the finest 100% two-row Prairie barley, including a blend of roasted black and caramel malts, and five choice hop varietals. Our special and unique double-aged process results in an unparalleled smooth and refreshing beer.

Name: Great Western Original 16 Pale Ale
Description: Original 16 Canadian Pale Ale is brewed using only the finest, two-row Prairie barley—the best in the world—as well as five choice hop varietals and 100% Copeland malt. The result is a smooth, refreshing beer, with a real beer taste.

Name: Strand Blonde Ale
Description: Refreshing and flavorful, this Blonde Ale is well-balanced and features a lightly malted palate. There is a gentle fruitiness, with a bit of hop character and just a touch of bitterness.

Name: Strand Harvest Ball
Description: Beyond the northern reaches of Los Angeles county lies the great ranching community of Fillmore where growers have been quietly raising oranges for generations. Each year as the summer falls into autumn the Slolee ranch celebrates the coming harvest with a sacred gala; family and friends gather illuminating the night with food, drink and laughter.

Name: Strand 24th Street Pale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Belfast Bay Lobster Ale
Description: Dark ruby color, moderate head of foam, big fruity nose. Robust fruity palate is packed with apple-pear character, nice malt backbone, barely balancing hops in the finish.

Name: Belfast Bay McGovern’s Oatmeal Stout
Description: A rich bodied, small-batch brewed Oatmeal Stout, from the East Coast’s Microbrew capitol.

Name: No Label Ridgeback Ale
Description: Dark American Amber with strong flavors of caramel and roasted malts. Balanced with just the right amount of Cascade and Golding hops for a sweet but slightly bitter ale. Named after our dog Hailey.

Name: No Label 1st Street Blonde Ale
Description: This Blonde Ale is dedicated to the city of Katy, Texas. Because Katy was known for its rice farming, we decided to brew this beer with a touch of rice, giving it a smooth, clean, and crisp finish.

Name: No Label Brewing El Hefe Weizen
Description: A traditional German Hefeweizen. This beer is light and refreshing with strong notes of banana, cloves and citrus. Perfect for that hot summer day. Named after the boss of the house.

Name: No Label Seasonal Brews
Description:
A very different Dark Wheat Ale. This beer is brewed with a touch of Star Anise at the end of the boil giving it a clean smooth finish with a hint of licorice.
Caution, this beer will bite.

Name: Lost Rhino New River Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Three hop additions in the boil and dry-hopped, our American-style Pale Ale offers the refreshing zest of nature through lemony, piney aromas with a touch of sweet tropical fruit.

Name: Lost Rhino Face Plant IPA
Description: A strong, malty backbone balances the mountain of whole cone hops we pack into our American Style IPA. Moderate grapefruit bitterness and herbal aromas take your pallet for a ride.

Name: Rochester Mills Red Ale
Description: This deep red-colored Irish-Style Ale features a rich, malty flavor profile, medium body and a low level of hop bitterness for a smooth, great tasting, easy to drink beer. This beer also pairs well with many styles of food making is very versatile. A great “gateway” beer for introducing patrons to the craft beer segment.

Name: Rochester Mills Milshake Stout
Description: The combination of four different malts, along with a low hop level creates a deep dark beer featuring rich, sweet roasted flavors. The addition of lactose (milk sugar) adds complexity, body, and a residual sweetness lending a smooth creamy texture to this full-flavored brew. Once a Seasonal offering in the pub, now prominently featured due to popular demand.

Name: Rochester Mills Juice Bigalow IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The Juice is Loose. Rochester Mills New England Style IPA was once a limited release but now is available year round. Juicy tropical fruit aromas and flavors with a subdued bitterness have been achieved from a considerable amount of Citra and Mosaic hops added to this brew. Enjoy the Haze.

Name: Rochester Mills Juice Deuce Double IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Even more abundant with citrusy, fruity loopy-like hop aroma and flavor, this idiosyncratic Double India Pale Ale is deep orange in color and presents with a pleasantly soft mouthfeel. This is beautiful. What is that, Velvet?

Name: Backcountry Double IPA
Description: We use generous late-addition hops along with a carefully crafted malt bill to create this Double IPA that is nicely balanced. Expect big notes of Citrus, Mango, Peach, and Grapefruit; all these flavors and aromas come from the hops. This beer is unfiltered, so it will be a little cloudy at first. It should clear up with time

Name: Orf Ambrose Amber Black Ale
Description: This mash‑up of a Vienna amber with a scwharzbier has a smooth body that finishes with a touch of sweet smoke.

Name: Orf Hoprocker Indian Red Ale
Description: It’s an Irish red ale crossed with an IPA. A floral nose and plenty of hop bitterness are balanced out by caramel malty sweetness.

Name: Orf Oocheenama Asian White Ale
Description: East meets West, and it’s exceptional. Spiced with ginger, nutmeg, orange peel, and jasmine flowers, this sophisticated union of a Belgian white ale with an East Asian rice lager pairs perfectly with both traditional and new-world Asian cuisines.

Name: Orf Salutation Golden Ale
Description: A golden‑hued hybrid of a Czech Pilsner, a Pacific Coast pale ale, and a German Kölsch. Medium‑light body, with a hint of citrus scent.

Name: Dixie Lager
Description: Uniquely formulated and brewed to meet the demand of a quality brew which could be generously consumed but still leave room for the spiced foods which are now synonymous with Creole and Cajun cooking. Dixie lager uses lightly roasted tow row barley malts, rice and Cascade hop; the result is this crisp and flavorful beer. A century of New Orleans brewing tradition lives today in every bottle of Dixie Lager.

Name: Dixie Jazz
Description: At only 92 calories and 3.1g of carbohydrates, this award winning beer, developed by the late, world-renowned Father of Light Beer, Dr. Joseph Owades, retains the taste and character of full bodied lagers—making this a truly unique light amber beer. It is the result of a challenge to produce a superior tasting, super-premium light beer.

Name: Dixie Blackened Voodoo
Description: Rich and malty like the great German dunkels that inspired it, Dixie Blackened Voodoo Lager balances premium roasted barley malts with Mt. Hood and Cascade hops. The result is a dark, mysterious brew known for its bewitching character and magical spirit.  ABV: 5.5%

Name: Dixie Light
Description: Formulated with the challenge of providing light beer drinkers a premium beer experience that delivers the flavor and satisfaction of the original Dixie Beer. Have a sip, and you’ll see the challenge has been met with Dixie Light. ABV 3.8%

Name: Local Option Morning Wood
Description: Mourning Wood is an oak-aged coffee amber ale. Fresh American oak used during the aging process and Dark Matter’s El Salvador San Jose pulp-natural coffee aromatically drive the beer yet they remain subtle components of the beers’ overall flavor profile. This amber colored, medium-bodied, and extraordinarily well-balanced ale has a delicate taste that is appreciated by beer drinkers of all palates.

Name: Local Option Blood Ov The Kings
Description: Blood Ov The Kings  Style: Red Wheat Ale  ABV: 6%  Availability: Draft, 500mL Bottles    At the peak of summer 1631 King Gustavus Adolphus led thousands of Swedish troops into Northern Germany. Following the destruction and subsequent plundering of Brandenburg Adolphus’ army marched through the endless wheat fields en route to Bavaria. Brewed with copious amounts of red wheat, Blood ov the Kings is aromatically driven by bread, biscuit and notes of exotic fruit. Hazy and medium bodied the beer has a rich and creamy mouth feel with a dry, bitter, and slightly sweet finish. Unbound by the Reinheitsgebot, Blood ov the Kings would certainly have been the vital fluid of victory for the Swedish monarch as he spilled blood across the wheat fields of Northern Europe

Name: Local Option Voku Hila
Description: Vokuhila is a strong pale lager. This helles bock is golden in color with a large, creamy, persistent white head; aromatically driven by robust toast and bread notes derived from continental European pale malts with moderate spice from noble German hops. Vokulhila will be appreciated by lager and mullet enthusiasts alike.

Name: Funky Bow G String
Description: Smooth and drinkable! Nice flavorful light malts allow the summer and cascade hops to shine through. With hints of sweet orange and coriander, this pale is unique as it is smooth.

Name: Funky Bow So Folkin’ Hoppy
Description: A delicious hoppy IPA. A generous addition of hops with a kiss of malt sweetness balances this IPA very well.  The nose is upfront with the galaxy hops, lending nuances of grapefruit, pine, and tropical notes.

Name: Funky Bow Jam Session IPA
Description: Light straw-colored malt bill that lends a nice dry, crisp, yet slightly sweet finish. The hops used are Azacca, centennial, Ella and citra. Tropical fruit, pine-citrus aroma. The flavor is tropical fruit up front, star anise spice in the middle and a citrusy, hoppy finish that leaves your mouth watering for more.

Name: Orlando Brewing Right On Red
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: A medium bodied, Irish style ale loved for its impeccable balance. The moderate caramel sweetness from the malts harmonizes with organic Columbus and Fuggles hops to create this crowd pleasing, copper colored brew.

Name: Orlando Brewing Organic Blonde Ale
Description: This flavorful, light bodied beer is crisp and refreshing. Our Blonde Ale is light straw in color and has a 4.7% ABV, making it our version of a light beer. We used the perfect touch of organic Hallertau hops to create Blonde Ale’s low hop bitterness and crisp, dry finish.

Name: Orlando Brewing I-4 IPA
Description: This smooth, full bodied West Coast style IPA is dry hopped with a hefty amount of Cascade hops to deliver a zesty citrusy aroma. It’s certainly easier to drink than to drive I-4.

Name: Bar Harbor Cadillac Mountain Stout
Description: A full-bodied stout with focused chocolate flavors and plenty of hops and malt, Cadillac Mtn. Stout was selected World Champion Dry Stout 1995 and the best hard-to-find beer in America by Men’s Journal.

Name: Bar Harbor Blueberry Ale
Description: A light fruit ale, made with Maine wild blueberries. As opposed to many of the sweeter fruit beers on the market, our addition of fresh Maine wild blueberries in this light ale yields a subtle blueberry aroma, without the sweet aftertaste. A mixture of the following Mutton malts, pale, crystal, and Munich, are combined with wheat to give this ale its lighter body, and we only use minimal amounts of Target and Willamette hops.

Name: Bison Brewing Reunion 10
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Belgian Style Scotch Ale

Name: Bison Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: In the past era, hard working rural "Saisonniers" consumed 5 liters per day of this style beer. We re-created it for today’s modern worker using Belgian yeasts and sour mashing for a refreshing spiceness and acidity to enliven your palate. Bottle conditioning leaves some sediment, so decant by slowly pouring into a wide mouth glass. Refill this bottle at your favorite local brewery.

Name: Bison IPA Organic
Description: For our 22 ounce IPA brews, we play around a bit. We brew the same malt profile each time, but experiment with different hops. Kind of like "research" for beer aficionados - a noble study of hop flavor and aroma.  Willamette is a mid alpha hop bred decades ago from Fuggles. We like it for its woody or grassy tones and a smooth bitterness. Some say its too mild for West Coast IPA, but we find it quite drinkable.

Name: Henry Weinhard’s Redwood Flats Amber
Description: Amber Ales are mostly an American invention. And with its beautiful copper color and subtle hop aroma, our Redwood Flats Amber is our traditional take on a modern American classic. Featuring a unique blend of American hops and malts, Redwood Flats Amber is bold and assertive, with a strongly hoppy flavor that?s easy to drink and even easier to love.

Name: Henry Weinhard’s Blue Boar Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The term "Pale Ale" was originally used to describe any beer that was simply not dark. But today it's a unique beer unto itself. When done right, Pale Ale is one of the things that just makes everything seem right with the world. And our Blue Boar is Pale Ale done very, very right. Double-hopped for a light, citrusy flavor, it's everything a Pale Ale should be.

Name: Henry Weinhard’s Woodland Pass IPA
Description: Originally developed for British sailors stationed in India, IPAs were aggressively hopped to help prevent spoilage on long ocean voyages. Now that spoilage isn't as big a problem, we've eased up on the hoppiness just a hair to let the caramel malts shine through. It's a big beer with big flavor that really lets you appreciate hops in all their glory.

Name: Henry Weinhards Private Reserve Lager
Description: An American Pale Lager, Henry Weinhard's Private Reserve blends Henry's German heritage with the natural ingredients of the Pacific Northwest. If you want to impress your friends, you can say it's brewed with 100% Cascade hops specially grown in Oregon. But all you really need to know is that it's crisp, clean and one helluva beer.

Name: Legacy Join Or Die Sedition Pale Ale
Legacy Hell Fire IPA
Description: The name says it all! This IPA is an all out hop attack on your senses bursting with 8 different hop varieties, big citrusy nose of grapefruit and lemon zest with hints of mango, ample bitterness, with a nice malt background to carry the hops to victory!

Name: Legacy That Guava Beer
Description: This is a great summer fruit ale, not cloying, just great malt flavors accented by fresh white guavas. Huge flavors up front with a fantastic aroma then finishes smooth, dry and refreshing. Enjoy that guava beer. You should have been around, the fermentation smelled awesome.

Name: Baird Red Rose Amber Ale
Description: This original amber ale is inspired by the "Steam" style of beer. Whereas a "Steam" is a lager beer fermented at an elevated ale-type temperature, Red Rose is an ale fermented at a lower lager-type temperature. Like a "Steam," Red Rose combines a crisp lager refreshingness with a robust ale fruitiness. A lovely citrus-pine hop character is present from start to finish.

Name: Baird Beer Kurofune Porter
Description: Kurofune (means "Black Ships") was the word the Japanese used to describe the American gunboats that came to open Japan to western trade. Kurofone Porter is sleek and forceful, but leaves a winning bittersweet taste of chocolate and coffee on the tongue. "Do not resist the superior might; cunningly acquiesce, and embrace." Kampai!

Name: Baird Dark Sky
Description: Imperial Stout is the biggest of the black beers and to drink Baird Dark Sky is to experience a foreboding libation. The aroma is gorgeously complex (dry hopping with American Centenniel & Amarillo hops) and the flavor is a stunning smorgasbord (chocolate, toffee, herbs, coffee, licorice, etc.). The mouthfeel is soft and enveloping. The finish is piquantly acrid and warming (alcohol approximately 7.6%).

Name: The Carpenters Mikan Ale
Description: This year (2006) marks the sixth annual release of The Carpenters Mikan Ale. As the name suggests, it is an ale made with fresh mikans (a tangerine-like Japanese fruit). We receive the mikans as a gift from the Heda orchard of our carpenter friend, partner and mentor  Mitsuo Nagakura. It would not be an exaggeration to say that he is the complete embodiment of the dedicated, uncompromising and passionate Japanese craftsmen whom we so respect and whom we strive to emulate. The Carpenters Mikan Ale is our modest attempt to pay tribute to Nagakura-san as well as to all great Japanese craftsmen.

Name: Fish Tale Amber
Description: Medium-bodied with an appealing amber hue, this is the First Ale of the Republic. Its organic pale, Munich, and crystal malts create a gentle sweet character that is difficult to resist. From organic Hallertauer hops come a zesty flavor and aroma that beautifully balance Organic Amber's malt profile. The result: Truly delicious ale that salutes organic farmers and all the goodness they bring to our tables.

Name: Fish Tale Beyond The Pale Pale Ale
Description: Pours a deep golden-yellow color. The aroma is floral and citrusy due to the 5 blends of Northwest hops added during the brewing process. This beer is medium-bodied with a balanced, complex flavor of fruity & spicy hops!

Name: Fish Tale Organic Pale Ale
Description: Fish Tale Organic India Pale Ale is a medium-bodied beer with a rich golden color. The organic pale and crystal malts lay down a firm malt body. This provides the backbone for an assertive hop profile featuring organic Pacific Gem. The moment the Mighty Fish Brewers sampled this pungent and resinous New Zealand hop, they knew it would be perfect for their Organic I.P.A. The result: A Cascadian treasure.

Name: Birra 32 Admiral
Description: Amber-coloured top-fermented beer with ruby bottle conditioned.

Name: Birra 32 Curmi
Description: Spiced beer obtained with barley and barley malt, high fermentation and refined in bottle.

Name: Birra 32 Audace
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Strong, spiced, top-fermented ale, bottle conditioned.

Name: Birra 32 Nebra
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Amber-coloured top-fermented beer, bottle conditioned.

Name: Killian’s Irish Red
Description: Rich amber color and a thick  creamy head. Introduced into the U.S. in 1981. Gold medalist (amber lager) at 1998 World Beer Cup.

Description: Appearance: Very dark chocolate brown with a thick caramel colored foam cap. Aroma: Dark chocolate bouquet with subtle roasted coffee notes.

Name: Flying Monkeys Amber Ale
Description: Copper-hued and medium bodied, our Amber Ale boasts a sweet biscuit-y front with a dense beige head. Underlying its creamy texture are toasty, bready malts with restrained hints of hop bitterness in its beautiful balance.

Name: Flying Monkey Juicy Ass
Description: Juicy is the word we use when we talk about hops. This award-winning American IPA moshes bright, fruity notes, dank hoppy bitterness, and fresh verdant resins with sticky malts for a softly carbonated, unfiltered flavour. From the busy minds and happy hands of the Flying Monkeys comes Juicy Ass IPA, Art within Art

Name: Loowit Brewing Two Sixteen Red Ale
Description: A pleasant, easy drinking red ale named for the Forest Service’s trail designation for the Loowit Trail that circles the base of Loowit (Mt. St. Helens). Two-Sixteen won a gold medal in the Irish Red Ale category at 2014 Washington Beer Awards

Name: Loowit Shimmergloom Stout
Food Pairing: Cheese - Hard Aged, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: A smooth, full-bodied stout that pours with a creamy brown head and a body of deep, dark black that is as mesmerizing as it is terrifying. Shimmergloom will take wing to the night sky, blotting out the shimmering stars like a shadowy dragon on its deleterious approach to burn your ramparts, crush your resistance and leave you wanting more.

Name: Loowit Mint Condition Stout
Description: A hyper-collectible chocolate mint creme stout. New in box. Never opened. A+++ feedback rating.

Name: Loowit Son Of A Gunship IPA
Description: This deadly predator of the skies is full of hoppy American firepower ready to blow up the bad guys.

Name: Moose Lake Red Axe Irish Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red

Name: Moose Lake Log Roller IPA
Description: This IPA has plenty of floral, citrus and pine notes which is smooth, fairly dry and has easy-drinking maltiness.

Name: Omission Ultimate Light Golden Ale
Description: Omission Ultimate Light Golden Ale is smooth, easy drinking and full of flavor. Citrusy hops and a clean finish leave you wanting more. With only 5 carbs and 99 calories, you can have another without feeling full. Like all Omission beers, Omission Ultimate Light Golden Ale is crafted to remove gluten. Our newest beer, Omission Ultimate Light launched in early 2017.Average Analysis per 12 Fl oz. serving – Calories 99, Carbohydrates 5g, Protein 1.5g, Fat 0g

Name: Omission Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Omission Pale Ale is a hoppy and easy-drinking American Pale Ale. Brewed to showcase the Cascade hop profile, Omission Pale Ale’s floral aroma is complemented by caramel malt body, making for a delicious craft beer.

Name: Omission IPA
Description: Omission IPA is a bold, hop forward Northwest-style IPA. Pacific Northwest hops give it notable pine, citrus, and grapefruit aromas and flavors. The bitterness is what you would expect of a NW IPA, but this beer is balanced and smooth due to the perfect level of malt sweetness. The finish is crisp, clean, and refreshing – it’s a true IPA lover’s IPA.

Name: Omission Pomegranate Blueberry Acai Hard Seltzer
HopFusion Feisty Blonde Honey Vanilla Blonde Ale
Hopfusion Hairpin Rye Pale Ale
Description: We finely tuned 3 grains, a copious amount of hops added throughout the boil and then balanced it with rye to create this one-of-a-kind ale. Some may call it an IPA, a Pale Ale or maybe even a variation of an Irish red. We really don’t care for labels, we just know it nails the dry, crisp taste and depth we were looking for.

Name: HopFusion Coco Anejo Stout
Description: We start with our Imperial Milk Stout - Fur Slipper; Silky smooth with notes of roasted hazelnut, dark chocolate and toffee and then aged on Roasted Coconut. Mind blowing coconut infusion!

Name: Hopfusion Fur Slipper Imperial Milk Stout
Description: The biggest question we get is “seriously, how can this be 9 percent”? Silky smooth with notes of roasted hazelnut, dark chocolate and toffee; our Fur Slipper is a fusion of the traditional Milk Stout with the rich tones of a Russian Imperial. We use a mash tun busting combination of 8 grains with Magnum and East Kent Goldings hops to balance the additional milk sugars. The first time we brewed it, we sat in silence with our eyes closed just to breathe it all in. We do that a lot… don’t judge us.

Name: East Nashville Beer Works Miro Miel Honey Blonde Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Fish - White, Mushrooms, Pasta, Pork
Description: Blonde Ale made with real local honey

Name: East Nashville Beer Works Cumberland Punch American Wheat Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Fish - White, Lamb, Pork
Description: American Wheat Ale, Bright and Citrus flavors

Name: East Nashville Beer Works Haze Lite Session Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Flaked oats and flaked wheat provide a creamy backbone, allowing the hops (Huell Melon and Mosaic) to shine. Light body with a nice, dry back end and low perceived bitterness. Aromas of mango, passion fruit, papaya, and pineapple make this a juicy, all-day crusher.

Name: East Nashville Beer Works East Bank Citra IPA
Tasting Notes: Bright, Citrus, Crisp, Floral, Fruity, Hoppy, Tropical
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White
Description: Citra IPA, bright and hoppy

Name: Veza Sur Brewing Co. Mangolandia Mango Blonde Ale
Description: An American blonde ale brewed with a ton of fresh, ripe mango that we throw directly into the fermenter. A touch of malted wheat gives a delicate mouthfeel, which is topped off with a juicy burst of mango flavor: It's Miami summer in a glass!

Name: Veza Sur Brewing Co. Mala Yerba Session IPA
Description: The fusion of the West Coast and Latin America. Mosaic, el Dorado and Amarillo hops create a bouquet of citrus and tropical fruit aroma. Mala Yerba's fruity hop aroma combined with low ABV and medium body make it the perfect introduction to the world of India Pale Ales.

Name: Veza Sur Brewing Co. La Yuma Dark Lager
Description: A medium bodied Vienna style lager with an amber color that is brewed with Perla Negra malts from Patagonia. Very easy drinking, with a subtle malt finish, you won't have just one!

Name: Veza Sur Brewing Co. Spanglish Latin Lager
Description: Inspired by our roots. Crisp and Refreshing. Perfect for a hot Miami day. Medium to light bodied with a slight noble hop aroma, Spanglish is the crowd please to any Pachanga!

Name: Islamorada Blonde Ale
Description: A simply brewed Citrus Ale that is just what the "doctor” ordered for a hot day in the sun. It is the perfect recipe of hops and natural citrus flavors that will get you back on your feet and into the nearest boat. The ideal complement for a long day of island running. Islamorada Ale pairs perfectly with spicy foods and shellfish

Name: Islamorada Sandbar Sunday Wheat Ale
Description: A perfectly crafted American Wheat Ale, that gives your fun in the sun day and everyday the drinkability it's always needed. Just add a key lime and this brew is perfectly paired with light seafood & poultry. The American hop varieties will impart a mild spice note and a subtle island citrus character. Great to pair with your catch of the day.

Name: Islamorada Yacht Rockin’ Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Islamorada Channel Marker IPA
Description: This IPA does not need a compass to point you in the right direction to return to the islands. The flavors of this Session IPA will get you to sit, relax, and enjoy the beautiful island sunset from any local spot.

Name: Bent Brewstillery Nordic Blonde Ale
Description: This is a clean, crisp, delicately balanced beer with subdued sweetness and a pleasantly refreshing tang in the finish. Because of the low hop bitterness and dry, light body, this beer is easily mistaken for a lager or light beer. These qualities make it a great anytime beverage. This beer is brewed using our local pure water without any additives.  This beer was our very first recipe. It was our introduction into craft beer. We brewed what we wanted to drink, and this quickly became a favorite among our friends and family who weren’t ready for the more brutal styles on the Bent Brewstillery beer menu. This beer is best when fresh.

Name: Bent Witty Blonde
Description: Dry-hopped white ale

Name: Bent Brewstillery Moar Scottish Session IPA
Description: A turn of the 20th century Scottish IPA brought back to life and made to be drunk in quantity! Spicy resins, apricots, tangerine zest and a bit of honey graham cracker. Low in alcohol, with loads of hop flavors, finishing dry with mouthfilling, ripping pithy tannins. Something hoppingly different for you IPA fans out there!

Name: First Magnitude Vega Blonde Ale
Description: A bright, crisp, light bodied beer with a hint of citrus. Perfect for stargazing and daydreaming.

Name: First Magnitude Wakulla Hefe
Description: Our refreshing, German-style wheat beer is full of the banana, clove, and vanilla notes associated with this style. Medium-light bodied and hazy from suspended yeast, this is a thirst quencher of the first magnitude, named for the largest of Florida’s First Magnitude springs.

Name: First Magnitude 72 Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: There aren’t many constants in life. Two that we can rely on at FM are that water from cool, clear first magnitude springs are a constant 72 degrees Fahrenheit year-round, and that hops never fail to make us smile. 72 pale ale is a beer for the hop lover. It has a prominent citrus and somewhat floral aroma paired with a bready malt note in the background. The beer has an enticing, light copper color and is balanced, but leans decidedly towards the hops in its flavor and aroma. It is medium-bodied with a semi-dry finish that leaves a lingering herbal/spicy sense on the tongue.  72 features American two-row as a base malt with Munich malt to balance the hop flavor and Crystal malt to provide color and a bit of sweetness. Chinook hops provide the bittering while Cascade and Centennial hops are used for flavor and aroma. The aroma is enhanced by dry hopping.

Name: First Magnitude Drift English Mild Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Sometimes it seems our lives are spent fighting the current as we make our way upstream, but sometimes it’s best to jump in your kayak and go where the river takes you. Drift is First Magnitude’s dark, malt-focused beer. It is a robust English Mild that is full of malt flavor, but still has a medium body and can be fully enjoyed in warmer weather.     Drift is brewed with American two-row pale malt as a base and has Crystal 20, Munich, Brown, Aromatic, Chocolate and Black Patent malts for a complex malt profile. Warrior hops are used for bittering and Hallertau Mittelfruh adds a subtle hop character. British Ale yeast gives it just a hint of fruity esters and a well-rounded flavor that will have you asking for another pour.

Name: Track 7 Bee Line Blonde Ale
Description: Bee Line Blonde is a light ale Track 7-style. The body is crisp and reminiscent of a lager.  Munich and Vienna malts provide nuance, and the incorporation of Sacramento-area wildflower honey to the kettle gives Bee Line its dry finish. The hop profile is restrained with just enough bittering and flavor additions to remind you that Track 7 is a West Coast brewery.  The result is a delicate ale with hints of flowers on the nose and a subtle spice on the pallet.  Looking for something unassuming, easy-drinking and sessionable? Make a beeline to this blonde.

Name: Track 7 Nukin Futz
Description: This creamy and crazy ale takes our Burnt Fog Smoked Porter recipe, drops the smoked malt and adds peanut butter, chocolate and lactose sugar. The combination produced a creamy peanut butter cup of a beer fitting of a celebration and capable of easing the winter doldrums. Nukin’ Futz was brewed for our 3rd anniversary on New Year’s Eve but will continue as an occasional release.

Name: Track Seven Left Eye Right Eye Double IPA
Description: Features a blend of 5 hop varieties that delivers an intense hop experience with a smooth finish. Big tangerine and grapefruit aromas power Left Eye, Right Eye while the malt flavors are purposefully subdued. Fresh and lively hop character.

Name: Track 7 Brewing Company Hazy Panic IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: SpindleTap Houston Haze IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: SpindleTap Boomtown Blonde
Description: Boomtown is our easy drinking blonde made with the hot Houston weather in mind. Bread notes from the malt balanced with German Hersbrucker hops shine in this refreshing beer.

Name: Spindletap Brewing Hop Gusher IPA
Description: West coast ipa with tropical notes of grapefruit pineapple mango and melon. Easy drinking quite refreshing quenches-your-throat – kind of ipa!

Name: Spindletap Brewery Calavera Lager Vienna
Description: Clean, crisp and refreshing, anchored by a subtle Vienna malt complexity - the perfect accompaniment to whatever you're celebrating.

Name: Belhaven Speyside Ale
Description: A smooth, full-bodied golden ale from Belhaven, with sweet vanilla oak and subtle whisky notes

Name: Belhaven Black Scottish Stout
Description: This deluxe stout is brewed for a full roasted chocolate flavour with a hop character that complements a blend of triple malts. Drink, savour and enjoy.

Name: Belhaven Twisted Thistle IPA
Description: A stunning India Pale Ale (IPA), don't think that Belhaven's Twisted Thistle has anything jaggy, spikey, prickly or otherwise pain-inflicting in its nature. Quite the opposite. Your taste buds will tingle with pleasure after a sip or two of this golden nectar. A real treat from our master brewers in Dunbar.

Name: Pair O Dice Lucky Lucy Strawberry Blonde
Description: This blonde ale is brewed with over 300 pounds of local, Plant City strawberries. There is a pleasant aroma of strawberries on the nose and a supple flavor of strawberry on the palate, while still being light, dry and refreshing, with a slight tartness from the fruit. A beautiful fruit beer to celebrate Florida’s strawberry season that still tastes like a beer

Name: Pair O’ Dice Hop Bet Red IPA
Description: An American Red IPA with a medium body and grapefruit and floral notes on the nose. It has a nice hop character that is balanced with a big, caramel malt backbone. The hops linger for a minute, but do not destroy the palate, creating a complex and enjoyable American Red IPA.

Name: Pair O Dice Lowball Session IPA
Description: Today’s beer trends have many brewers striving for great brewing heights. High gravity. Crazy ingredients. In-your-face flavors that wreck your palate in 12 ounces or less. We’ll never be those brewers. No offense to anyone — it’s just not our thing. We strive for balance. Our Lowball IPA is a testament to our dedication to drinkability. This light-bodied, hop-bursted golden brew showcases the piney, resinous and tropical fruit notes of 100% Mosaic hops. It’s a full-flavored IPA with an ABV low enough to keep your wits about you and calling bluffs when you see ’em. #getapair

Name: Pair O’ Dice Barrel Aged Pit Boss IPA
Pacific Western Cariboo Blonde Ale
Description: An easy drinking, summer lager that is white gold in color with a crisp, light malt finish. Crafted to purity law standards this natural blonde the smartest Blonde you’ll ever find.

Name: Pacific Pilsner
Description: A West Coast classic since the eighties. Pac Pil is brewed using an ISO-certified, all malt recipe but the standout ingredient is our BC spring water, essential to a great Pilsner brew. Keeping true to the original Czech style that it is based on, this is a crisp, clean, golden lager that has a good malt character but is accented toward the hop with its aroma and dry finish.  TASTING NOTES Our Pacific Pilsner features the tart, delicate flavour of quality Canadian malt perfectly balanced bitterness with Saaz hops. With just a hint of citrus, it is perfect with fish or shellfish including a West Coast favorite – sushi.

Name: Cariboo Honey Lager
Description: Just a hint of honey gives this beer nice body and it will leave you tracing your glass with your finger craving more. We crafted a lager with just a hint of sweetness not an overbearing honey flavor. Paired it with all foods especially when you have the munchies because this honey doesn’t interrupt Game Time when it’s Go Time.

Name: Cariboo Malt
Description: In the red corner, weighing in at 8% alcohol by volume, Cariboo “Lights Out” Malt Liquor! A heavyweight beer hailing from Northern British Columbia, made with choice Canadian grains and brewed to high test. Move over Rocky, there’s a new champ in town. Pick some up today and remember, float like a butterfly and sting like a Boo!  Tasting Notes Pairs well with that chicken that you chased down in training this morning!

Name: Forgotten Boardwalk Funnel Cake Boardwalk Ale
Description: Ale brewed with vanilla beans & lactose sugar.

Name: Forgotten Boardwalk What The Butler Saw
Description: Undressed Wit Brewed with Spices. Wheat & Yeast with Tantalizing Spice & Citrus Finish.Tucked away in the dark confines of the boardwalk during the turn of the century were mutoscopes. Inside one of these gems was a silent slideshow featuring a voyeuristic butler looking through a keyhole. The film, What the Butler Saw, let you privately take a peep while standing in plain view. Don’t be naughty, enjoy responsibly!

Name: Forgotten Boardwalk 1916 Shore Shiver IPA
Description: Resiny hop reminiscent of stone fruits mellowing to a spicy finish.

Name: Forgotten Boardwalk Pocket Trick
Description: Bright notes of mango and sweet orange, smooth and medium bodied.

Description: American Blonde

Description: Oatmeal Stout

Description: IPA

Description: Double IPA

Name: Narrows Peanut Butter Blonde Ale
Description: Peanut Butter Cookie is a 5.5% malt forward, easy drinking ale with peanut butter. The result is full bodied and nutty with a distinct aroma of fresh peanut butter cookies.

Name: Narrows Long Division IPA
Description: Long Division is a 7.4% ABV IPA brewed with 2-Row, Marris Otter and flaked barley, and hopped with generous amounts of Wakatu and Waimea hops from Freestyle Hops. The result is a fresh, vibrant, and creamy beer with notes of lemon-lime and tropical fruit.

Name: Narrows Hilltop Haze Double IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Void of clarity, Hilltop Haze has a brain-bending amount of Mosaic and Simcoe in dry hop, and a malt foundation almost all pilsner. With intense aroma of berry, citrus and pine this Double IPA cloaks itself as something smaller, something less potent. This mind trick leads us to believe mysteries still exist in the haze.

Name: Narrows Giant Pacific Octopus IPA
Description: A bitter, moderately strong American pale ale that uses its clean, supporting malt to showcase its hop character.

Name: Alter Brewing Co. Center Line Golden Ale
Description: This extremely clean golden ale gives you plenty of malt on the nose, with hints of fruitiness on the back end. The flavor of the beer is friendly to most palates and drinks more like a lager than an ale. We use classic noble hops in the boil to keep this beer a traditional mainstay on our menu.

Name: Alter Brewing Co. Hopular Kid Extra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Classic pale ale that is quite complex when it comes to aroma and flavor. Fermented with a fruit-forward ale strain to compliment the bevvy of hops used in both the boil and the fermenter. Centennial, Citra, Amarillo, Simcoe and Mosaic team up to give it characteristics of melon, stone-fruits, and lemon. Some may call it Tropical. We call it Hopular Kid.

Name: Alter Brewing Co. Hell Hazed Over Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Our full-sized NEIPA that gets in your face with mango, ripe-fruit, and pineapple aromas. This is from the Sultana, Amarillo, and Mosaic dry-hopping schedule. You can expect a heavy mouthfeel, but still finishes relatively dry for the style. You can file this under “juicy”.

Description: Blonde Ale

Description: Coffee Porter

Description: Hazy India Pale Ale

Name: Alpha Factor IPA
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bitter, Citrus, Grapefruit, Hoppy, Pine
Description: Cascade, Centennial, Simcoe and Amarillo Hops for a Piney and Dank Finish

Name: Wild Leap Local Gold
Description:
A hybrid style that blends elements of a German
Kolsch, English Bitter and American Blonde Ale to
create a dry, crisp, light and refreshing ale that is
enjoyable year-round.

Name: Wild Leap Gratuity Light Beer
Description: Gratuity is a crisp, refreshing, cold conditioned light beer. 10% of the profits will be donated to support the service industry.

Name: Truck Chaser Creamsicle
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This double IPA combines the flavors of ripe orange, vanilla bean and milk sugar with a big juicy IPA to bring you back to the days when you chased the ice cream truck, not the beer truck.

Name: Alpha Abstraction, Vol. XV (15)
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The fifteenth edition in the Alpha Abstraction series, Alpha Abstraction Volume XV is a juicy, double dry-hopped IPA with El Dorado and Idaho 7 hops.

Name: Postmark Blonde
Description: A crisp, clean, craft Blonde with a slight spicy, floral aroma. Your go-to session beer.

Name: Postmark Spruce Tip Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Spruce Tips left over? Why not?! This Saison has the addition of Spruce Tips in the boil to give it a sprucy fresh finish while still maintaining those big fruit aroma notes.

Name: Postmark Dry Irish Stout
Description: A semi-light bodied Stout with a dry bitterness and complex notes of roasted coffee.

Name: Postmark Mosaic IPA
Description: Tropical | Golden | Polished | A golden IPA filled with the tropical notes of the Mosaic Hops. A profile perfect for a NW IPA.

Name: Squatters Hop Rising
Description: A mighty, hop-lover’s dream, Hop Rising adds malty backbone to an intense Imperial IPA. This insanely smooth dry-hopped ale has everything: 9% ALC/VO, 72 IBUs, and yes, that’s our master brewer Jason Stock pitching in on the label.

Name: Squatters Chasing Tail Orange Golden Ale
Description: This fan favorite Golden Ale infused with naval orange, is ripe with Celeia and Super Galena hops. This little puppy has grown into her paws at 5.2% ABV, with an unfiltered appearance and a fetching new pale orange color. Who say’s you can’t teach an old dog new tricks?

Name: Squatters Juicy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Squatters Juicy IPA is a fresh squeezed glass of hazy deliciousness. Packed with bright, citrus aromas and notes of ripe stone fruit, this unfiltered Northeast IPA finishes smooth, creamy and pulp-free.

Name: Squatters Off Duty IPA
Description: Like your favorite hammock, this IPA is perfectly relaxed and balanced. The smoothness of premium barley lies in equilibrium with the hoppiness of a classic American IPA. Kick back and reward yourself with this multiple award-winner.

Name: Intuition Ale Works Jon Boat Coastal Ale
Description: An English golden ale cool-fermented to enhance its crisp and refreshing lager-like characteristics.

Name: Intuition Ale Works People’s Pale Ale
Intuition Ale Works Easy On The Eyes Session IPA
Description: Easy-drinking, session IPA with a bright citrus aroma from the Centennial and Citra dry-hopping.

Name: Intuition I-10 IPA
Description: The West Coast comes to Jax with this extremely hoppy, true India Pale Ale.

Name: Lake Superior Kayak Kolsch
Description: Bright yellow-gold hue. Fresh floral hop aromas follow through on a dry, lightish-bodied palate with clean pale malt flavors and a floral hop finish. A refreshing thirst-quenching style. Earned the Silver Medal at the World Beer Championship.

Name: Lake Superior Sir Duluth Oatmeal Stout
Description: Dark blackish hue. Pours with a creamy, tan-colored head. Pine-like, smoky aromas lead to a medium bodied palate with smooth mouthfeel and toasty finish. Some taps on Nitro! Earned the Gold Medal at the World Beer Championship.

Name: Lake Superior Oktoberfest
Description: Copper-colored with a malt accent flavor. All ingredients are imported from the Fatherland for an authentic profile. Earned the Gold Medal at the World Beer Championship.

Name: Indie Brewing Pacific Kölsch Highway
Description: Clean, crisp, refreshing. A balanced beer with soft, crackery malt presence and clean lager-like finish.

Name: Indie IPA Del Rey
Description: Yellow nectarine, juicy-fruit and tangerine notes featuring Citra and Equinox hops.

Name: Indie Brewing Nobody Walks In LA IPA
Description: Double dry hopped, double IPA featuring Sabro, Styrian Cardinal and NZ Chinook hops.

Name: Indie Brewing Fuzzy Recollection Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This is a hazy IPA with a huge amount of peaches added throughout fermentation. Dry hopped with Mandarina Bavaria, Taiheke and Sabro.

Name: Schilling Beer Co. Poppy’s Moonship
Description: Sessionable and effervescent, this progressive variation of traditionally tart wheat ale is brewed with gentle salinity and fermented with our house culture.

Name: Schilling Beer Co. Fall of Babylon
Description: Dark, brooding and tailor-made for cold seasons in the North Country. Lingering coffee, roast and bitter chocolate define this limited-run beer

Name: Schilling Beer Co. Modernism
Description: Czech-style black lager: Modernism is inspired by the Czech black lager tradition. It features a deep complexity from the decoction process and a hop schedule typical of Bohemian beers. Notes of dark malts, bittersweet chocolate and caramel dominate. The finish is dry

Name: Schilling Beer Co. Konstantin
Description: Konstantin is a rich, light-ruby colored seasonal lager. Double-decocted for complexity. Drier and lighter in color than most German-style Märzens, biscuit and bread-like malt note shine in the flavor and aroma.

Name: Flagship Brewing Co. Kill Van Kolsch
Description: Originating in Cologne (Koln) Germany, Kolsch beer is renowned for its light body and clean, crisp taste. Brewed with a nod to the old world German processes, Flagship Kill Van Kolsch continues this tradition of delicate and balanced beer.

Name: Flagship Brewing Co. Blood Orange IPA
Description: This variant of our Flagship IPA showcases some of our favorite hop varieties enhanced with Blood Orange puree. The combination is extremely juicy with intense but pleasant citrus fruit flavor. Deep orange hues hit the tongue bursting with flavor and balance with a refreshing finish.

Name: Flagship Brewing Co. Fresh Kills IPA
Description: Each Hop in this IPA lends a unique flavor that when blended produces bursting fruit flavors from Citrusy Grapefruit to Tropical Mango in harmony with an ever so slight Roast Character from The Golden Malted Barley.

Name: Flagship Brewing Co. Metropolitan Lager
Description: An Amber Lager brewed with Floral Bavarian Noble Hops. Smooth, crisp and exceptionally balanced.

Name: Horny Goat Imperial Chocolate Peanut Butter Porter
Horny Goat Chocolate Peanut Butter Porter
Horny Goat Laka Laka Pineapple Hefeweizen
Horny Goat Hopped Up & Horny IPA
Big Top Hawaiian Lion Coconut Coffee Porter
Description: Our Hawaiian Lion combines bold flavors from the finest ingredients in a majestic way. It starts with a proprietary blend of local Java Dog Coffee, roasted the moment before going into the brew to maintain the fresh flavor released from the beans. This custom coffee blend is then paired with over 150 pounds of fresh coconut to create a roaring aroma with a rich and smooth flavor.

Name: Big Top Trapeze Monk Belgian Style Wit
Description: Come let our trapeze monks entertain your taste buds with our citrus infused, highly carbonated witbier. This Belgian has a pale and cloudy body that will soar you into the crisp finish you’ve be waiting for.

Name: Big Top Okefenokee Imperial Stout
Description: Like North Americas largest blackwater swamp, this imperial stout is born of dark grains balanced by hops of English ancestry for a big flavor in a slow moving way. Enjoy this pleasingly ominious stout for the swamper in all of us, just be careful when the sun goes down.

Name: Big Top Circus City IPA
Description: This beer sets the bar with its eye catching unfiltered hazy hue and amazing head that last. It’s euphoric aroma, great taste and smooth yet bold hoppy finish will absolutely stun not only your palate but your mind. Be prepared to be amazed!!

Name: Fuller’s London Pride
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: London Pride is a smooth and astonishingly complex beer, which has a distinctive malty base complemented by a rich balance of well developed hop flavors from the target, challenger and northdown varieties in the brew. At 4.1% a.b.v in cask (4.7% a.b.v in bottles)London Pride is an ideal session-strength premium ale.

Name: Fuller’s London Porter
Description: A modern take on the 19th century porter style, Fuller’s rich, chocolatey London Porter recaptures the brooding beauty of pre-Victorian London. It’s evocative of simpler times but it’s a wonderfully complex pint.

Name: Fuller’s London Porter 1/2 Barrel
