Name: Fuller’s ESB
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: The Extra Special Bitter is an English style that used to be one of the stronger draughts across the pond but is relatively mild in the current beer climate. However, that doesn't hinder its bright nose full of fruit, savory toffee flavors, and lush bready mouth-feel. This is a beer for any occasion, and with the new, more affordable 4-packs it will be my beer for every occasion.

Name: Atlantic Coal Porter
Description: There is a much debate in the brewing world about the difference between porters and stouts. At one time the two were even considered synonyms. Nowadays porters are often more malted, while stouts tend to be more roasted in flavor. When we decided to add a dark beer to our repertoire we chose to pursue the rich, chocolate tones of a porter. This ale continues to gather accolades in the beer world for its strong malt backbone and well-balanced, bitter hops.

Name: Atlantic Bar Harbor Real Ale
Description: When we opened back in 1991 this was our first beer. We created this recipe while brewing with our mentor Pierre in his friend's garage in Montreal. We wanted to develop a beer that was smooth and easy-drinking, yet still retained an assertive body to set it apart. The result was a beer with nice caramel tones and a balance of the malt and hop profiles. Over time we have refined the ingredients to achieve what we feel is a perfectly balanced session brew.

Name: Atlantic Bar Harbor New Guy IPA
Description: With the recent explosion of over-the-top hopped IPAs, we wanted to return to an India Pale Ale that was well-hopped, but still balanced and smooth. Our brewers wanted to name it after one of our hardworking staffers, so we decided to name it after Dave—the new guy. This beer is made with one hundred percent Columbus hops and only one malt, yielding a nice earthy tone and spicy flavors. Columbus hops have a citrusy profile, which is more subtle than that found in most IPAs.

Name: Atlantic Blueberry
Description: Nearly twenty years ago, a local farmer stopped by our brew pub looking to sell his truck full of wild Maine blueberries, providing the inspiration for our Bar Harbor Blueberry Ale. That year our beer debuted at the first-ever Maine Brewer’s Festival where it was enthusiastically received. This brew stands alone as a beer first, ending with a subtle berry finish. Unlike many fruit beers on the market, which are imbalanced with sweetness our amber ale isn’t overly fruity—just enough berry flavor to complement the hops.

Name: West Sixth Pay It Forward Cocoa Porter
Description: This fourth beer offered year round in cans is a celebration of malt.  Dark and rich with overtones of coffee and dark chocolate, it's chewy and yet smooth at the same time.  Brewed at almost imperial porter strength, we add over 60 pounds of the best cacao nibs in each 40 barrel batch.

Name: West Sixth Half Bite IPA
Description: An India Pale Ale that has hops taking the show. Just like the West Sixth IPA, it’s brewed with Columbus, Citra and Centennial hops. This session beer has a big nose of earthy spice with compliments of citrus. Following through with lots of pleasant hop flavor, this beer maintains drinkability while being packed with everything we love about our IPA.

Name: West Sixth IPA
Description: Our India Pale Ale is a new take on this highly popularized style. Citrus is the obvious star. Over the backbone of bready malt and pine stickiness you will find notes of peaches, lemon zest, danky grassiness, pine needles, and tangerines. Each sip is followed by a dangerously drinkable amount of resinous glamour.

Name: West Sixth Cerveza
Description: In the style of a Mexican Lager, West Sixth Cerveza is crisp with a pleasant cracker like malt character with notes of corn and a low amount of hops to create a quenching and sessionable lager. Crack a West Sixth Cerveza or add a slice of lime to a freshly poured pint- this brew is satisfying and approachable to all!

Name: Fountain Square Backyard Porter
Description: Our Porter is brewed in the traditional English style. It has a deep brown colour and a creamy tan head. The mouth feel is highlighted with soft notes of chocolate and slight undertones of roasted coffee. Hop bitterness is nicely balanced with the malt and hop aroma very low, typical of the English style.

Name: Fountain Square Hop For Teacher Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A beer dedicated to the hop heads among us. An aggressively hopped American pale ale that is fairly light in colour with a noticeable citrus aroma due to late hop additions. The slightly bitter finish will keep the hop heads coming back.

Name: Yoho Brewing Tokyo Black
Description: Tokyo Black is the second brand at YoHo. A robust porter, well balanced between the malt and the hops. The complex chocolate and roast flavours of dark specialty malts are combined with a floral and slightly spiciness from Perle hops.

Name: Yoho Brewing Suiyoubi No Neko Belgian Style White Ale
Description: "Wednesday Cat" a Belgian-style white ale made for Hump Day. Fluffy and refreshing, this Belgian style white ale has notes of Oranges and Spice from the Belgian yeast. Let this cat help you get through the rest of your week.

Name: Yoho Brewing Yona Yona Pale Ale
Yoho Aooni IPA
Description: In 18th century, Indian Pale Ale, well-hopped and high-alcohol Pale Ale, was brewed to protect beer from spoilage during long sailing from England to India. Aooni India Pale Ale fascinates you with the balance of assertive bitterness and its strong body.

Name: Ravinia Brewing Company Baldwin Porter
Description: Brewed with chocolate malt and roasted malt, Baldwin has beautiful notes of coffee and chocolate without adding any adjuncts. Our seasonal porter has a medium body and a creamy finish and is available September through February to keep you warm all winter long.

Name: Ravinia Brewing Company Flight of the Rooster Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A fan favorite, Rooster is brewed with an "irresponsible" amount of Nelson Sauvin Hops and which produces big white grape notes, a creamy, silky mouthfeel, and a dry, champagne-like finish.

Name: Ravinia Brewing Company Fancy Bounce Gose
Description:
This unique Gose is brewed with Thai Ginger, Himalayan Pink Sea Salt,
Sorachi Ace, and Forbidden Black Rice. Fancy Bounce delivers big notes of
ginger up front that settle into a creamy finish, for a balanced, refreshing
Gose you can drink all day.

Name: Ravinia Brewing Company Food Truck Pilsner
Description: Crisp and light, Food Truck pilsner has a biscuity creaminess for a beautifully balanced finish. This Continental-style pilsner bridges the gap between traditional European pilsners and the frequently over-hopped American pils.

Name: Foothills People’s Porter
Description: People's Porter is a robust English-style brew with a dark, ruby hue. Complex chocolate, caramel and toffee notes give way to an herbal bitterness, finishing with a pleasant hint of espresso.

Name: Foothills Hoppyum IPA
Description: Do you like hops ? This American style IPA (India Pale Ale) is highly hopped with Simcoe, Cascade, and Centennial hops Made with English pale and light caramalts, Hoppyum is an orange color, with a citrusy Simcoe taste and aroma. We hope you enjoy it !

Name: Foothills Torch Pilsner
Description: A well structured, Czech-style pilsner. Torch is strong in alcohol with a rich, full finish. Good mouth feel and well-balanced Czech Saaz hops ensure that Torch is not your typical pilsner.

Name: Birdsong Brewing Wake Up Porter
Description: Our Wake Up Porter is an irreesistibly smooth brew with locally roasted coffee and fresh vanilla beans. We use Central Coffee Co.'s Sumatra Lingtong coffee and carefully chosen speciality malts to create a warm foundation and light body. Madagascar vanilla beans lend a subtle sweetness on the finish that you'll notice at the end of every velvety sip.

Name: Birdsong Brewing Jalapeño Pale Ale
Description: The Jalapeño Pale is in a class by itself. Using our Free Will Pale as a foundation, we add a generous amount of fresh, hand-cut jalapeños mixed with a hint of awesome. Don’t be scared to try it! The Jalapeño is refreshing, crisp, and pairs well with the peanuts we have in the tap room!

Name: Birdsong Brewing Paradise City Session IPA
Description: Bright tropical notes and clean finish make Paradise City a perfect all year brew. A light ABV and balanced body help to create a flavorful, aromatic IPA that’s 100% drinkably dank. Grab a can and head on down to where the grass is green and the beers are chilly.

Name: Birdsong Brewing Movin’ On Up Hazy Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Balanced and crushable, Movin’ on Up combines Idaho Gem, Strata, Cashmere, and El Dorado hops for bright aromatics and a pleasant bitterness. Flaked oats and wheat allow the hops to shine. On the finish you'll notice tropical fruit notes and a hint of sweetness.

Name: Moody Tongue Caramelized Chocolate Churro Baltic Porter
Description: Big flavors do not have to be synonymous with one-and- done beers. We love dessert just as much as we love dark beer and we think that enjoying more than one of either should never be a problem. In this medium-bodied Baltic Porter we use a combination of specialty malts and caramel to capture rich flavors like chocolate, caramel and vanilla alongside lager yeast that brings a clean, dry finish. Pair this Baltic Porter with dishes such as chocolate mole or caramel flan.

Name: Moody Tongue Sliced Nectarine IPA
Description: The inspiration for the Sliced Nectarine IPA came in the form of a summer farmers market and the abundance of fresh fruits and produce. The resulting IPA showcases a bright tropical aroma of stone fruits that balances the grapefruit acidity of the Chinook hops. The beer’s crisp profile refreshes and delights taste-buds and craves pairings such as slow-roasted pork shoulder or a slice of warm peach pie.

Name: Moody Tongue Aperitif Pilsner
Description: This light, refreshing 5.0% German pilsner carries the aromatics of a croissant alongside the flavor of a French baguette.

Name: Moody Tongue Peeled Grapefruit Pilsner
Description: At Moody Tongue, our goal is to create beers which excite the palate – and we are always on the search for multi-dimensional ingredients which complement traditional beer styles. Grapefruits, with their high acidity, are a natural candidate to wake the palate and provide balance with the sweetness of malt. In this Pilsner, we capture sweet, sour and bitter tastes from the grapefruit within a light, refreshing body. Enjoy this Peeled Grapefruit Pilsner with sunshine and a grill, and the pairing opportunities will be endless.

Name: Black Shirt Brewing Red Porter
Description: Roasted black coffee and loads of dark chocolate notes up front, then a touch of sweet caramel show its presence; finishes dry and bitter.

Name: Black Shirt Brewing Red Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: American Red Saison is an updated version of a rustic Belgian-style beer. Bright orange/tangerine aroma with a hint of pear and apricot that compliment

Name: Black Shirt Brewing India Red
Description: Brilliant clear deep Amber with a bubbly thin off white head. Lovely sticky hop nose with floral and orange zest resins with a touch of pine and sweet amber caramel. Smooth and well rounded flavor with bright floral hops and mild bitterness with a good dose of amber Malts and floral, leafy resins. Very balanced yet crisp and hoppy with a very approachable bitterness. Malty sweet backbone with an amber ale kiss that calms it all down.

Name: Black Shirt Brewing Timekeeper Rye Pale Ale
Description: Timekeeper is filled with overtones of juicy tropical fruits & undertones of pine, citrus, and a subtle hint of dank notes. Finishes perfectly bitter while still being relatively soft and refreshing.

Name: Wingman P-51 Porter
Description: P-51 is a robust and clean-finishing porter. Rich malty flavors highlight hints of chocolate and coffee. At 8% ABV, this dark beer will warm even the coldest Puget Sound nights.

Name: Wingman P-51 Peanut Butter Cup Porter
Description: Delivers chocolatey, peanutty, porter goodness. It's like drinking peanut butter cups blended with porter beer. That's because the brewers add healthy doses of chocolate and peanut butter to the P-51 porter. Enjoy!

Name: Wingman Ace IPA
Description: Ruddy in color, Ace IPA drops a hop bomb of flavor. Brewed with 5 distinctly Northwest hops, the Simcoe, Citra, Centennial Cascade, and Bravo Hops will have you wanting to drop pint after pint.

Name: Hangar 24 Chocolate Bomber
Description: Rich and decadent, full bodied beer salutes American pilots who airdropped packages of chocolate into post WWII Berlin. The intense, roasted malt flavor is derived from two types of chocolate malt and raw cocoa nibs. Whole vanilla beans introduced post fermentation adds complexity and enhance the dessert like qualities.

Name: Hangar 24 Orange Wheat
Description: Crisp, Tangy, and Refreshing. The citrus aroma, light airy mouthfeel, and tangy finish are this unfiltered beer’s trademarks. This is accomplished by adding whole locally grown oranges throughout the brewing process, which perfectly coalesce with the wheat and barley base. Our oranges are purchased through the Old Grove Orange company (affiliate of the non-profit Inland Orange Conservancy) whose main objectives are to save the local orange trees from disappearing, spread the word about the local citrus growing heritage, and to feed the hungry with the unutilized oranges. Please visit them at www.inlandorange.org. All we need to do to save the orange trees is to eat or drink locally grown oranges! Show Less

Name: Hangar 24 Pacific Coast Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Pacific Coast Highway is one of the world's greatest roadways and is the starting point of all kinds of adventures. To celebrate these adventures, we brewed Pacific Coast Hazy to be easy on the palate, but unfiltered full of west coast hops and packed with flavor.

Name: Hangar 24 American Light Lager
Description: American Light is an elevated light beer, low in calories and carbs without sacrificing flavor. Pouring a brilliantly clear, pale straw color, this light lager offers clean cracker and  bready malt notes with a slight sweetness. Moderate carbonation and a light bitterness allow for a smooth, crisp finish rounding out American Light into an easy-drinking and refreshing independent craft beer.

Name: Adroit Theory The Devil Made Me Smoked Porter
Description:
Fire and Brimstone – the fitting destination at the end of a terrible path. The faces: Gacy, Manson, Dahmer… Why do they do it? Where does the evil come from? Are they products of their environment, or is there a darker force at work? Many questions, but few answers. Fill your glass, and brood on the wickedness latent in the human heart. Then raise the glass in a toast to judgment and justice. Just don’t look them in the eyes, for you might see yourself. 

Subtle Smokiness with Traces of Ground Chili-Peppers, Light Body with Firm Roast, Flash of Chocolate, and a Growing Heat that Builds with Each Sip. Dry Finish.

Name: Adroit Theory Black As Your Soul Stout
Description:
Big, Roasty, Full Bodied Malt Flavors Give Way to Cherry & Hazelnut Notes.

Tear off your suit-and-tie straight jacket. Submerge yourself in the riches of an alternate life, outside the corporate fishbowl. Obscured in the depths of this Russian Imperial Stout is the dark fruit of shadowy contemplation. Linger too long, ponder too deeply, and you may find your humanity is indelibly etched with the inkblot that is your soul.

Name: Adroit Theory Dia De Los Muertos Oreo Stout
Description:
Chocolate and Creme, Silky Smooth, Roasted Grains, Dried Fruit, Boozy yet Smooth Finish.

Our latest Russian Imperial Stout with the addition of Oreo Cookies. There is a place where the restless souls wander. Burdened by the weight of their own sadness, they cannot enter heaven. So they wait; trapped between our world and the next. Searching for a way to rid themselves of their pain- in the hope that somehow, someday they will be reunited with the ones they love.

Name: Adroit Theory What Evil Lurks
Description:
Pumpkin, vanilla, maple syrup and extended Rum aging bring a subtle warmth.

Slinking in the shadows of our barely-acknowledged selves there lives an illusive suggestion so complex, yet so exquisitely simple, as to create a soul-stealing madness in any who look too closely, seek too keenly. Skulking about, awaiting the precise moment to rise up and be known. To peel flesh from bone so our flaws are exposed, and we are set free. Madness comes with a price…

Name: Six Rivers Kona Moon Coffee Porter
Six Rivers Rosie’s Strawberry Wheat
Description: Named after an adorable, lazy pit bull terrier, this American style Wheat Ale is fermented with over 400lbs of real strawberries for a light refreshing Summer treat! *Seasonal Release Available April - September

Name: Six Rivers IPA
Description: This English style IPA is our proud flagship ale, brewed with all imported Maris Otter English malts, Cascade and Columbus hops. A hophead’s delight! Big & flowery with a long and lingering finish

Name: Six Rivers Chili Pepper Ale
Description: HOT! Spicy ale made with assorted chilies blended with our wheat ale."

Name: Ironfire Collateral Damage
Description: 14 month barrel aged imperial porter

Name: Ironfire Sinner Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: It’s a sin to call this beer a pale ale, it’s so much more than that. Synner is slightly bitter with a punch in the face of hop aroma and flavor. Brewed in the tradition of a So-Cal session ale,it’s copper in color with a medium malt body. This ale is brewed to be dry on the palate and have a distinctive fruitness found in the aroma. Synner is sure to satisfy both novice and experienced ale drinkers.

Name: Ironfire Six Killer Stout
Description: Six Killer Stout is not for the faint of heart. Six malts, six hop varieties, six ingredients—it’s a triple threat. Brewed in the style of a traditional stout with 100 percent Arabica Hazelnut coffee beans to get your clips spinning. Feeling strong? Step up to Six Killer and see who's boss!

Name: Ironfire Nuhell IPL
Categories: India Pale Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: An India Pale Lager. Tons of Nelson hop flavor and aroma, we think you will approve.

Name: Orange Blossom Pilsner
Description: Our flagship beer, Orange Blossom Pilsner or OBP for short is a honey beer made with 2.3 teaspoons of real, local orange blossom honey in every bottle. It is not sweet because the sugar in the honey is fermented. That’s why it is so crisp and clean.

Name: Orange Blossom Weisse Weisse Baby
Description: Weisse Weisse Baby is Bavarian style wheat beer that is as fresh as it gets. Brewed with traditional Bavarian yeast from Weihenstephan, WWB is somewhere in between a kristal and a hefe with its slight haze. WWB is a delicious easy drinking all day long kind of brew that you’re going to love.

Name: Orange Blossom Back in the Day IPA
Description: Back in the Day IPA is an old school American IPA using the classic 4 “C’s” hops. Cascade, Centennial, Chinook and Columbus. These hops are known for their citrusy notes and were once the backbone of American IPA’s. We also use a nice, simple malts to let the hops shine through.

Name: Orange Blossom Squared Honey Pilsner
Description: When you make a pot of coffee, but only use half the water, you get some pretty rich coffee. That’s the approach we took with this offering. OBP Squared, with half the water has 11% alcohol by volume. Twice that of original OBP. The result is a bold, distinct taste of its own. Made with twice as much real orange blossom honey, all-natural ingredients and no refined sugar, it really is the king bee of beers. Why not give OBP Squared a try today!

Name: Iron Maiden Trooper
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Saranac Adirondack Amber is craft brewed with pure Adirondack water  bottom fermented and fully lagered to carefully balance the sweetness of two-row malt with the delicate bitterness of American Cascade and German Hallertauer hops. Look for a golden amber color and medium body. You?ll discover a distinctive flavorful beer that is deliciously drinkable. Enjoy!

Name: Robinsons Trooper Iron Maiden English Ale Gift Pack With Glass
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Iron Maiden Trooper is a deep golden ale inspired by the British band. Brewed with malt flavors, citrus notes and a refreshing hint of lemon. This gift pack includes one 16.9OZ bottle of Iron Maiden's The Trooper Beer and one The Trooper branded pint glass.

Name: Green Man Porter
Description: Dark, full-bodied, and rich in flavor, Green Man Porter is wonderfully easy to drink. It offers a creamy, smooth mouthfeel and finishes with distinctive chocolate notes. This traditionally crafted, award-winning British-style Porter, like a true rock star, enjoys a legendary following.

Name: Green Man ESB
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Wheatseeker is a German-style Hefeweizen, fermented with a yeast strain used in Germany for hundreds of years.  A light-bodied easy-drinker, with a wheat and yeast combination that creates a slightly spicy character.   We hopped it with German grown Opal hops, which lends a slight citrus effect.

Name: Green Man Trickster IPA
Description: Trickster is massively dry-hopped with a rotating cast of our favorite lupulins. This version featuring Columbus and Centennial is a dank and delicious brew with soft herbal notes, highlighted with tangerine, pine, lemon, and grapefruit aromas. Show Less

Name: Greenman Trickster IPA
Description: What’s this? An intriguing disguise to tempt and delight-that’s my surprise. If you crave a dank treat and others don’t lure, you’re already discovered the hoppy cure. Spiced with Simcoe, El Dorado, mosaic and the Ghost of Ted.

Name: Fiddlehead Second Fiddle Double IPA
Description: Big, juicy, Double IPA.

Name: Fiddlehead Hodad
Description: Porter brewed with house toasted coconut flakes, cacao nibs, vanilla bean and lactose.

Name: Fiddlehead Landscape With Haystack
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Rustic Saison base, foeder aged with brettanomyces and mixed culture.

Name: Fiddlehead Mastermind Double IPA
Description: BIG juicy aroma, smooth finish, brilliant color, aaaand 8.1% ABV.

Name: Laughing Dog Anubis Imperial Coffee Porter
Description: A complex Imperial Coffee Porter made with Evans Brothers cold-pressed coffee. Subtle chocolate, and coffee notes are balanced by black malt bitterness and malt sweetness. Available year-round in 22oz. bottles and kegs.

Name: Laughing Dog The Dogfather  Bourbon Barrel Imperial Stout
Description: This year’s Dogfather Imperial Stout will all be aged in charred bourbon barrels. Seven malt varieties and subtle hop additions give it a complex flavor profile.

Name: Laughing Dog Sneaky Pete Imperial IPA
Description: Sneaky Pete is a blend of five hop types: Simcoe, Glacier, Centennial, Vanguard and Hallertauer, with Simcoe playing the dominate role at 30%. In addition, three separate malts were used: Honey Malt, Rye Malt, and Munich Malt. The brew has a copious aroma of white grapefruit, citrus overtones, a complex rich middle and long flavors in the finish; a real beauty. Finished with wild clover honey.

Name: Laughing Dog Devil Dog Imperial IPA
Description: An all out assault on the senses. Devil Dog is an Imperial IPA with a floral / citrus hop aroma and flavor. This beer ages well and will take on some barley wine characteristics with time. Available in May in 22oz. bottles and kegs.

Name: Lightning Thunderweizen
Description: The Thunderweizen is brewed in the style of a traditional German Hefeweizen: lots of wheat, vigorous fermentation, and completely unfiltered for a full, refreshing flavor that perfectly compliments San Diego’s perpetual good weather. Despite the hints of banana, citrus, clove, and other spices, we do not add additives to our beer - that impressive flavor is naturally produced.

Name: Lightning Elecrostatic Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: Our bier de garde, or beer at the ready!  Typically brewed in Western Europe in the spring for use on the farm in the fall, we have ours available year-round.

Name: Lightning Sauerstrom Ale
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: You are about to enjoy Lightning Brewery’s Sauerstorm Ale, a German-style Berliner Weisse - a beer style characteristic of summer beer from the Berlin area of Germany. Traditionally this beer is served with a dash of tart raspberry syrup to enhance both beer and fruit flavors. We have brewed this beer with pilsner malt, malted wheat, water, hops and yeast. Please note Sauerstorm Ale is bottled unfiltered for greater flavor. If you like more haze in your beer, you may gently roll the bottle before decanting to your glass.

Name: Ass Kisser Smoked Porter Bourbon Aged
Description: Bourbon Barrel aged Smoked Porter Aged for 90+ days.

Name: Brouwerij West Tripel
Description: Our Tripel pours a hazy deep gold with a creamy head. Upfront aromas of fresh plums, orange, white flowers and a hint of hay evolve into aromas of caramel malt and cola as the glass warms. A very balanced flavor profile and a creamy mouthfeel lead into a light malt sweetness with a final transition into a hint of warming alcohol and soft drying bitterness.

Name: Hermitage Brewing Copious IPA
Description: A West Coast IPA with a combo of classic and modern hops including Centennial and Citra.  Citrusy and fruity with a solid bitterness for balance.

Name: Brouwerij West Dog Ate Homework
Description: The first batch of our blackberry saison is out for distribution - dog ate my homework, 7% alc/vol with approximately 1lb of fruit per liter. Why Blackberries? Blackberries have a wonderful sweetness that is not TOO sweet or full. They are rich in color and aroma and have a unique drying charcter that is felt across the whole pallet. I am not a fan of sweet beers, so it was important to me that this beer have lots of deep blackberry fruit and a deep respect for the saison’s dry palate.

Name: Iron Triangle Dark Porter
Description: Crisp - Chocolatey - Roasty - A pre-prohibition porter that is less sweet than its English counterparts, but still bursting with dark malt flavor. It’s a refreshingly dark beer.

Name: Iron Triangle Bavarian Style Pale Ale
Description: What happens when you blend and IPA with a Hefeweizen? ... Magic. Paying homage to both styles we decided to call this beer "Bavarian Pale Ale" or "BPA".

Name: Iron Triangle IPA
Description: Piney - Herbal - Hoppy - Our homage to the original IPA’s that started the craft beer movement. A perfect balance between classic and aggressive “West Coast” versions of the style.

Name: Iron Triangle Lager
Description: Bright - Refreshing - Floral - Inspired by European brewing traditions brought to America prior to prohibition. ITB Lager is our beer flavored beer Made for LA

Name: Yellow Dog Shake A Paw Smoked Porter
Yellow Dog Chase My Tail Pale Ale
Description: his West Coast Style Pale Ale is brewed for balance while being hop forward. Its slightly orange/red coloured ale has a hoppy aroma and smooth crisp after taste with hints of citrus, grapefruit, and lemon. This easy drinking pale ale is a perfect thirst quencher.

Name: Yellow Dog Go Get It Ginger Lime Gose
Yellow Dog High 5 Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Rip Current Java Storm Coffee Porter
Description: Imperial Porter with a Kona and Sumatra coffee

Name: Rip Current Body Surfing Belgian Blonde
Rip Current Lupulin Lust Double IPA
Description: 8.2% San Diego-style IPA with complex grapefruit, lemon, tangerine and pine-like character. The hops are supported by a clean, dry and bready background character. We made this beer for all of you big hoppy beer lovers. This beer won’t last long, so get it before we drink it all.

Name: Rip Current Choppy Surf Czech Style Pilsner
Persephone American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Editor’s note: first appearance at Alibi Room 500th menu party, dry-hopped with Citra, and later at Tap & Barrel, dry hopped with Amarillo

Name: Persephone IPA
Description: A classic Northwest IPA with big citrus and grapefruit flavours with hints of mango and passionfruit on the nose. Medium bodied, with a light biscuity malt character.

Name: Persephone Keller Pilsner
Description: A crisp refreshing unfiltered lager with a bright, floral hop aroma. Very light in colour and body. The slight bready malt flavour is balanced with a firm bitterness and spicy flavour from a massive amount of Czech Saaz hops.

Name: Schöfferhofer Grapefruit Hefeweizen
Description: Schöfferhofer Grapefruit is the World’s First Hefeweizen Grapefruit Beer!  When perfectly crafted sparkling German wheat beer meets the Caribbean flavour of juicy Grapefruit, magical things happen. Crisp, sweet, and tangy, Schöfferhofer Grapefruit is your go-to partner for those sunshine moments!

Name: Schöfferhofer Pomegranate Hefeweizen
Description: Introducing the newest addition to the Schöfferhofer Hefeweizen family, Schöfferhofer Pomegranate! It is a 50/50 blend of Hefeweizen beer and natural Pomegranate juice resulting in a refreshingly tart and tangy taste experience.

Name: Schöfferhofer Hefeweizen
Description: Schöfferhofer German Wheat Beer Hefeweizen is brewed in Bavarian tradition using wheat malt. The live yeast gives bottle conditioning guaranteeing a refreshing fruity flavor. The yeast sediment also leads to the cloudy nature of the beer. Care needs to be taken when pouring. Tilt glass and pour slowly. Before pouring last quarter  roll bottle gently back and forward until sediment is dissolved.

Name: Schofferhofer Grapefruit Hefeweizen 1/2 Barrel

Name: Wellbeing Heavenly Body Non-Alcoholic Golden Wheat
Description: Heavenly Body Golden Wheat is based on a Great American Beer Festival award-winning recipe. This American-Style Wheat has more flavor than its light lager cousins. We add a hint of Cascade and German Traditional hops for a slight citrus character that balances the lighter malts. It's dry, crisp and smooth, with a full-bodied mouthfeel.With only 68 calories, this is the perfect NA craft beer for after sports, yoga, marathon training, or anytime you are taking care to watch what is going in your heavenly body.

Name: Wellbeing Intentional Non-Alcoholic IPA
Description: Intentional IPA delivers the distinctly (and delightfully) bitter characteristics of Mosaic and Citra hops and is punctuated with pineapple and peach notes. This IPA offers a full-flavored, alcohol-free experience.

Name: Wellbeing Hellraiser Non-Alcoholic Dark Amber
Description: Hellraiser Dark Amber is the beer to drink when you are out with your friends ready to have a great time. This hop-forward amber has the perfect balance of floral aroma and spicy hops to delight the palette of craft beer enthusiasts everywhere.

Name: Two Henry’s Blueberry Vanilla Wheat
Description: Pronounced vanilla and blueberry nose. Very aromatic. Light wheat in color. Blueberry and blueberry sweetness on the taste, clean body, and lingering blueberry and lingering vanilla finish. Reminiscent of a blueberry muffin, but in a beer.

Name: Two Henry’s 7 Mile Bridge IPA
Description: A malt forward take on the IPA, biscuit and crystal malts combine with spicy English hops and some fruity Simcoe dry hop on the nose. Six different hops give a complex, robust herbal and cistric hop flavor. Medium bodied with a reddish amber color.

Name: Two Henry’s Golden Age Gilded Lager
Description: This Lager boasts a clear, golden color. Smooth and crisp with a slight noble hop aroma and flavor. We think this is the beer most like what the Henrys would’ve enjoyed at the turn of the century Florida.  Light body.

Name: Two Henry’s Blueberry Vanilla Wheat
Description: Pronounced vanilla and blueberry nose. Very aromatic. Light wheat in color. Blueberry and blueberry sweetness on the taste, clean body, and lingering blueberry and lingering vanilla finish. Reminiscent of a blueberry muffin, but in a beer.

Name: Jackalope Lovebird Strawberry Raspberry Wheat
Description:
The abundance of strawberries and raspberries married with wheat
results in a light yet flavorful brew.

Name: Jackalope Thunder Ann American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Brewed to highlight beautiful citrusy American hops, making it a friendly, yet bold American Pale.

Name: Jackalope Fennario IPA
Description: Fennario celebrates the American IPA style with resinous hop aroma and approachable bitterness with notes of stonefruit and citrus.

Name: Jackalope Details To Follow Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed with late addition Ekuanot and Azacca hops, Details To Follow Hazy IPA is a medley of lush flavors and aromas with sustained notes of citrus, orchard fruit, melon, berry, orange peel, lime, mango, and papaya.

Name: Tin Whiskers Wheatstone Bridge
Description: Invented by Samuel Hunter Christie in 1833 and improved and popularized by Sir Charles Wheatstone in 1843, a Wheatstone bridge is an electrical circuit used to measure an unknown electrical resistance by balancing two legs of a bridge circuit, one leg of which includes the unknown component. But don't over think this one, instead picture Sir Charles Wheatstone basking in the sun, drinking a beer and enjoying the fame and popularity that undoubtedly comes with popularizing someone else's invention.

Name: Tin Whiskers Flip Switch IPA
Description: An American IPA with deep citrus aroma, malty backbone and a relaxed bitterness.

Name: Tin Whiskers Gamma Ray Double IPA
Description: We set out to make a Double IPA that didn't feel too weighed down by its malty characteristics, one that exploded with flavor without the heavy body often associated with the style. The result is Gamma Ray, a surprisingly drinkable hop bomb bursting with tropical citrus and floral notes, but light enough in body to come back to for another round.

Name: Friends & Allies Springdale White Ale
Description: Hops: Mandarina Bavaria, Magnum Malt: Pilsner, Wheat Color: Cloudy Pale Straw Body: Moderate Flavor: Creamy and Effervescent Aroma: Cracker, Vanilla, Herb/Spice, Light Citrus, Apples, Pears

Name: Friends & Allies Fresh Coast IPA
Description: Hops: Comet, El Dorado, Cascade, Centennial IBUs: 100+ Malt: 2-Row Color: Golden Orange Body: Light/Moderate Flavor: Hop Forward, Low Malt Complexity Aroma: Tropical Fruit, Pine, Citrus, Danky

Name: Friends & Allies Noisy Cricket Session IPA
Description: Hops: Mosaic, Simcoe, Amarillo, Cascade, and Centennial IBUs: 100+ Malt: 2-Row and Rye Color: Light Honey Body: Light/Moderate Flavor: Citrus and Honey Aroma: Oranges, Tangerines, Light Toast

Name: Lonerider Shotgun Betty Hefeweizen
Description: Shotgun Betty is a sexy, tough cowgirl who is always armed and dangerous. Don’t be fooled by her good looks, she will have you for an appetizer! That’s why we picked her to represent our Hefeweizen. Shotgun Betty is a wheat beer with rich, banana-clove nose and refreshing dry finish. Sound good? Try one. But beware, once Betty gets a hold of you there is no escape.

Name: Lonerider Peacemaker Pale Ale
Description: Peacemaker is a west coast style American Pale Ale that uses several hop varieties to produce a unique and bountiful hop aroma with a balanced bitterness. A special blend of American and European malts make this a very well rounded, characterful beer. - See more at: http://www.loneriderbeer.com/beers/peacemaker/#sthash.j7djEyzt.dpuf

Name: Lonerider Hoppy Ki Yay Ipa
Description: We’ve rounded up some great malts and hops for Hoppy Ki Yay IPA, our year round IPA. This straw colored ale is hopped with Columbus and Amarillo and rounded out by a mild body from the malts.

Name: Lonerider Saloon Style Pilsner
Description: Tight-lipped and stoic, our sessionable Saloon Style Pilsner has only one mission – quenching thirst. This straw colored beer, medium bodied and crystal clear, is sure to leave you wanting another.

Name: Lucid Air Enlightened Ale
Description: We call this an “Enlightened Ale” – a perfectly filtered beer that knows its place. With its smooth, effervescent, light body and clean and crisp finish, it’s the beer you want to grab anytime of the day – whether you’re tooling around the lake, finishing your yard, sitting around a campfire or riding shotgun in an open-AIR plane! This is your new everyday beer with an attitude.

Name: Lucid Dyno
Description: We’ve carefully fine-tuned a blend of hops from the Pacific Northwest to create crisp aromas and flavors of tangerine, pine and fresh cut flowers for our American Pale Ale. DYNO revs up with late hop additions igniting the right flash of bitterness along with intense citrus and floral bursts to make this a full bore hop hot rod.

Name: Lucid Foto
Description: Late hops, dry hops and then even more hops – a whopping 4# per barrel are used to give this West Coast IPA an explosion of powerful citrus aromas and flavors. The late hopping process in FOTO allows Lucid to present the full flavor and aroma of carefully selected hops while perfecting a great balance between citrus and bitter, creating a perfect FOTO finish!

Name: Lucid Duo Double IPA
Description: DUO’s the double-hopped sledgehammer from the North that is far from Minnesota Nice!  We’ve loaded this with Simcoe, Citra, Falconer’s Flight and Chinook hops to give you sky-high IBUs!  Each face-slapping sip pounds your palate and breaks down your hoppy beer boundaries.

Name: Wheatland Spring Farm Chores Wheat Ale
Description:
Table Beer 4.8%
50% Estate grain; 70% Regional grain
Tasting Notes: Lychee, Guava, Kiwi

Crisp and uncomplicated. This is our sessionable, hoppy golden wheat ale. This table beer keeps the bitterness low, while delivering a heady and tropical aromatic profile. All of the wheat in this beer is estate-grown at Wheatland Spring Farm + Brewery. Farm Chores is the perfect reward after a hard day’s work in any field.

Name: Wheatland Spring Test Of Time IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description:
American IPA 6.9%
25% Estate grain; 100% Regional grain
Tasting Notes: Apricot flesh, pine, kettle corn

Once in a while, we come across a constellation of qualities that hold their novelty. Test of Time is a vibrant IPA. Centennial and Crystal hops combine on a base of estate grown wheat, along with regionally grown Pale and Pilsner malts to create this timeless unfiltered American IPA. Double dry hopped with Simcoe and Citra.

Name: Wheatland Spring Rauch Tater Märzen
Description:
Notes: Layered biscuit, molasses, savory sage, subtle smoke, earthy

This is our first collaboration and meant to celebrate the season, the harvest, and the small farms that make local agriculture possible. We partnered with our farming neighbors, Moutoux Orchard, to create this Imperial Märzen made with smoked sweet potatoes, sage, and brown sugar. The name, Rauch Tater, hints at our approach to this beer. With a wink to northern Bavarian Rauchbier, which uses smoked malt for often deep smokey flavors, we opted for a subtle smoke component — more earthy than smokey— as a guidepost for the flavors to meet. Instead of smoked grain, the sustainably-grown sweet potatoes from Moutoux Orchard were smoked at our farm with local apple and cherry wood. The sweet potatoes were then put in the 100% Virginia grain mash with local sage. The waft of smoke provides an earthy taste that connects the malt and molasses with a velvety mouthfeel from the sweet potatoes. This is capped with a savory and dry finish at the top, thanks to the sage.

Name: Wheatland Spring Found Artifacts Pilsner
Description:
Unfiltered Pilsner 4.8%
100% Regional grain
Tasting Notes: Homemade bread, peeled cucumber, herb garden

A time-capsule in a glass, reflecting both rugged tradition and refined modernity. Found Artifacts is a classically-inspired, unfiltered German Pilsner. Its unique expression is driven by a showcase of regionally-grown and malted Pilsner malt. Fermented with a traditional lager yeast, it carries subtle undertones of freshly leavened dough, and delicate cracker that waft to the nose as an invitation for the first taste. Hints of fresh herb, lemon zest, and mild cucumber intertwine in a mid-palate taste, before the crisp effervescence and refreshing dryness prepare you for another sip.

Name: Point Cascade Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Point Cascade Pale Ale is handcrafted combining special top-fermenting yeast and a dry hopping process to create this truly classic American Pale Ale. The intriguing character is derived from generous quantities of the choicest Yakima Valley Cascade hops and the finest crystal, 2 row pale, and Munich malts. The result is a delicious American Pale Ale with a signature fragrant hop bouquet and soft malt palate.

Name: Whole Hog Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Handcrafted using real pumpkin and savory pumpkin pie spices with hints of all natural cinnamon and nutmeg.  Perle hops balance with rich Munich, Roasted, and Caramel malts for the full-bodied taste and exceptional flavor.

Name: Forbidden Root Money On My Rind Wheat Ale
Description: Juniper and grapefruit have become a legendary combination in pop culture, known for their ability to refresh and satisfy. So we take a witbier, spike it with juniper berries and the deliciousness of pure grapefruit, and add a peppery hint of grains of paradise.

Name: Forbidden Root Sublime Ginger Wheat Ale
Description: Storms come and go, and in the end, there's just a refreshing breeze. So with this shimmering golden wheat beer, the escape is sure to be fresh, cooling and sustaining. We start with a dry and creamy wheat beer, and add fresh botanicals and a splash of key lime juice for a tangy flavor with the delicious bite of ginger. The flavor is bright, layered, and thoroughly satisfying. This beer resonates with the Caribbean otherworldliness of the Florida Keys.

Name: Forbidden Root Wildflower Pale Ale
Description: WPA entices with a bright, refreshing hop aroma with a citrusy character, along with added depth from the subtle addition of Elderflower, Marigold, and Sweet Osmanthus flowers, and just enough clean maltiness to balance. On the palate, it is full-flavored up front, then builds to a crisp bitterness, with waves of range citrus, spicy and fruity hop flavors enhanced by a hint of exotic blossoms. Finish is complex and scrips, with a lingering clean bitterness. It’s a breath of fresh air, like a bouquet picked along a country lane.  The name of our WPA (Wildflower Pale Ale) derives its inspiration from the Works Progress Administration, a massive public works project of the New Deal era in the 1930s. Providing jobs for about a third of the nation’s 10 million unemployed, the WPA drew people to work on the nation’s roads, bridges, highways and dams.  Equally as important were arts projects like public murals, documentary photography, landscape beautification and more.  It truly represented the best of the American spirit.

Name: Forbidden Root Fernetic Black Ale
Description: A collaboration beer with our friends at Fernet-Branca, brewed with a trove of botanicals including rhubarb root, saffron, angelica, star anise and 14 others.

Name: RavenBeer Annabel Lee White
Description: A Belgian style "wit" (white) beer that is meant for to cool you off in the hot weather. (or any other time). Light effervescent, refreshing and slightly sour. Refreshing with slight citrus, coriander & sour orange peel notes.

Name: The Imp and the Madhouse Oyster Stout
Description: Our oyster stout is made with whole Chesapeake Bay oysters from Madhouse Oysters of Fishing Creek, MD.  Oysters are added to large teabag-like sacs and suspended in the hot wort for 15 minutes.  Our 6.0% stout is neither a dry nor a sweet stout. It is a smooth and very drinkable stout that is a bit salty in the finish.  The stout’s name comes from Poe’s short story The Imp of the Perverse where the narrator brags about his clever murderous deed and expresses no remorse in his heinous crime.  He continues to insist that we all have in our heads an Imp dictating to us self-destructive impulses. The reader eventually comes to realize the narrator’s insanity and discovers that he is locked away within a “Madhouse.”

Name: RavenBeer Tell Tale Heart Ale
Description: Your first experience with this IPA is the citrus bouquet from its rocky white head. The initial taste is subdued but gradually becomes intense without any harsh bitterness. The Heartier the Better.

Name: RavenBeer The Raven Special Lager
Description: The Raven Special Lager is a perfect balanced lager beer that goes well with any kind of food, but particularly with spicy food or when you just want to sit down and enjoy a beer with friends.  With a shot of Woodford Reserve chased with chilled Raven Special Lager is a near perfect combination. The rich golden colored beer is an exceptionally smooth Southern German lager, somewhat malty but well balanced between the hops and malt.  Experiencing the clean finish and pleasant lingering aftertaste of The Raven Special Lager, one can truly say that The Taste Is Poetic.

Name: Verboten Something Orange
Description: Our refreshing American wheat features natural orange blossom honey, and orange peel for a bright, citrus flavor

Name: Verboten Brewing Roll In Ze Hay
Description: Leipzig style Gose dry hopped with Nelson Sauvin hops

Name: Verboten Stealth Haze Juicy Ipa
Description: Hazy/Juicy IPA made with oats, wheat malt and hopped with over 3 lbs per barrel of El Dorado, Mosaic, and Citra.

Name: North High Hefeweisen Ale
Description: This beer smells and tastes, like, bananas! A smooth sweetness and hint of clove also party on your palate. This session beer has a burst of flavor

Name: North High Pale Ale
Description: Light in color but not in hop presence. The citrusy sweet hop presence makes this beer a gateway to the world of hops.

Name: North High Grapefruit Walleye
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Mahr’s Saphir Weisse
Description: The Mahr’s brewery & biergarten, in the beautiful and historic Franconian city of Bamberg, has been in operation since 1670, and run by the same family for over 100 years. With his Saphir Weiss, Stephan Michel, who represents the fifth generation of family brewmasters, has taken the traditional German weissbier to a new level- adding a metric ton of new & exotic “Sapphire” hops to each batch. The result is an unusually spicy and tangy variation on the Bavarian classic.

Name: Mahr’s Brau Ungespundet
Description: It pours with a big, creamy, long-lasting, head; has a golden-bronze color; a wonderfully fresh, perfumy; hop aroma; a remarkably smooth, almost oily, malty, palate; very fresh flavours; and a spritzy finish. It is beautifully balanced, but leans to the dry side. This is a delicious, appetising beer and a true taste of Germany’s fast-vanishing artisanal tradition.

Name: Mahrs Pilsner
Description: Beer sensory characteristics: Not just any pilsner, recognizable by its brilliant golden yellow hue, Mahrs Bräu Premium Pilsner seems to shine in the glass. The white foam of the head has finely textured, compact bubbles and is a joy to the eye. Delicately effervescent pearls of carbonation are the hallmark of its freshness. The distinctive aroma of hops entrances the olfactory senses. Light and dry in body, with a tender herbal soupçon of bitterness that guarantees to delight your taste buds. The finish is pure, round, and harmonious. Light on the stomach, with an unbeatable taste, make for pure beer enjoyment.

Name: Mahrs Hell
Description: At the brewery tap, this may be listed as Vollbier.

Name: Peoples Farmer’s Daughter
Description: Wheat ale brewed with lemongrass.

Name: Peoples Mound Builder IPA
Description: American Style India Pale Ale. We used an American base malt with the addition of Caramalt to give this now classic style a redish hue. Mound Builder includes an aggressive use of Columbus hops, which is a high alpha hop with a full flavor profile, and Centennial hops. The beer is also dry-hopped with Amarillo hops, which is a citrusy hop with notes of orange and grapefruit. People’s Mound Builder IPA is a hoppy, yet smooth American twist on the English IPA

Name: Peoples Amazon Princess
Description: American Style India Pale Ale. We used American base malt with a small addition of Crystal malt to give this beer an orange hue. Hopped exclusively with Simcoe hops giving this beer a tropical flavor and aroma. Passion fruit and grapefruit dominate the flavor and aroma characters. Brewed one year after our very first brew day and released one year after our first delivery day, this beer is also known as our 1st Anniversary IPA.

Name: Peoples Pilsner
Description: People's Pilsner is a German Pilsener style beer brewed by People's Brewing Company in Lafayette, IN.

Name: Pacific Plate Eye of the Storm Hibiscus Wit
Description: A traditional Belgian witbier brewed with tropical hibiscus, providing a beautiful pink hue and balanced tart flavor. This beer is calming and refreshing, much like the center of a mature tropical cyclone, where the weather is normally calm. Let the EYE OF THE STORM be the calm in your day.

Name: Pacific Plate Horchata Stout
Description: Inspired by Nicaragua’s Cerro Negro, Central America's youngest and most active volcano, our Horchata Milk Stout highlights the bitterness of dark roasted malts,  while being balanced by milk sugars, cacao, Madagascar bourbon vanilla, and the explosive flavor of Ceylon cinnamon. A delicious tribute to the traditional Horchata drink sold in Latin American marketplaces.

Name: Pacific Plate White Rhino Double IPA
Description: A Brews for APUs collaboration, a Wheat DIPA brewed with Amarillo, Citra, & Mosaic hops.

Name: Pacific Plate Rainbow Sherbert Milkshake DIPA
Description: Double IPA with lactose, aged on blood oranges, raspberries, & limes. Finished with vanilla.

Name: 33 Acres of Sunshine Witbier
Description: Wondrously, people may ponder, how is ‘Sunshine’ made? With vital gear prepped and necessities intact, adventurous natures gesture the way. Centred in lively ambiance, teeming winds and waves amplify magnificent terrains. An exquisite alchemy forms as firing swells synch between greatly planting feet, and grand drafting hands, surfacing vast expanses. This picturesque balance serenades the dynamic first breath, through last drop, and beyond the dawning horizon.  Thanks to summers’ launching acclaim, this romantic French Blanche can willingly co-star any season’s forecast and choice current scene. Showcasing flares for the prismatic, 33 Acres of Sunshine synthesizes an unfiltered flaked wheat base. Joining the array, glowing hops of Aurora and Styrian Golding awaken peppy anise seed, dazzling coriander, and candied orange ovations. Emanating such vivid traits, this divine beauty is a main-staying source to be gratefully wetted with. Vive le coeur du soleil!

Name: 33 Acres Ocean Pale Ale
Description: This is a full flavoured beer integrated with a distinct floral hop which gives it a quality unique to our Pacific Northwest surroundings. This style is evolutionary from a typical IPA with an assertive hop, lower alcohol content, and slight pine aroma. Low in malt character, this beer has a refined quality and a refreshing temperament.  We’ve used ingredients harvested near the Pacific Ocean including Galena, Cascade and Citra hops. Substantive hop flavour paired with a bit of caramel complete the composite to end with a medium finish. Typically consumed in good company amid the Pacific and pine.

Name: 33 Acres of Nirvana IPA
Description:
Along the paths to IPA immortality, a few wise guides suggested forging an original trail like none before. As is accustomed to the Pacific Northwest, natures' whispers were honoured realizing the voicings within.

With a higher % then average, these skillful co~creations invigorate bitter-fresh pine with infused offerings of pink+orange citrusness. Iconically, this beer actually smells like green spirits. One whiff, a taste, and wholly smile, can begin any journeys into 33 acres of Nirvana afterlife.

Name: 33 Acres Darkness Schwarzbier
Description:
When embers crackle into charred sultry puffs, a mystical serenity draws near. Hinterland’s stilling hush nestles quietly while being calmly at rest. Belly and lungs fill then clear with soothing huffs as drumming thumps begin revealing extraordinary realms. Entering fantastic possibilities and potentials, worlds within worlds manifest...

The enchanting Schwarzbier hails from Germany's historic middle ages. Progressing upon the hallowed dark essentials, this bier swiftly joined the flagship ranks, flowing especially well. Conceived by cozy Pilsner mixed with slow-fired Cara Vienna, Black Prinz and Caramel Munich 40 malts, 33 Acres of Darkness has evolved into a supernatural lager. Summoning hoppiness through nicely biting Perle and Magnum hops, gently toasted sugars evoke rich cocoa and subtle coffee blitzes. These tidy undertones ebb sips to settings, while easy-going textures socially invite further quenchings.

Durstig?

Name: Rockmill Witbier
Description: Crisp, refreshing body with citrus bouquet & subdued bitterness.

Name: Rockmill Saison Noir
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Candied fruit, sweet potato créme brûlée, hints of caramel & mild tobacco in finish.

Name: Rockmill Cask Aged Tripel
Description: Tripel aged in whiskey barrels from local micro-distillery Middle West Spirits.

Name: Rockmill Petite Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Subtle peach with pistachio and honey. Our lightest Saison, best Paired with Sunshine.

Name: Concrete Beach Sola IPA
Description: Like the sun’s rays, Sola IPA glows with a golden veil. Four hop varieties give Sola an intensely juicy, tropical, bright citrus aroma and flavor, complemented by a touch of toasted malt character.

Name: Concrete Beach Stiltsville Pilsner
Description: A Miami-style pilsner that’s loaded with citrus hop character. Concrete Beach's opus to the renegade village on stilts in Biscayne Bay where weekend residents celebrate the peace, tranquility and spirit of Stiltsville that will live on for eternity. Stiltsville Pilsner balances big, fruity hop aromas with the flavors of a light, crisp lager. Miami, meet your pilsner.

Name: Concrete Beach Rosé Ale
Description: Rosé Ale is an innovative beer inspired by the classic Rosé wine. With a touch of tannins, a splash of Zinfandel grape, a hint of blueberry and subtle sweetness, this clear-filtered, deep pink beer is perfect for wine and beer fans alike.

Name: Runa Bianca Ale With Spices
Description: "BLANCHE" type beer, produced with a mixture of barley malt, non-malted wheat and oat flakes, flavored by adding coriander and orange peel, the hopping is mild. Referenced in barrel or bottle and matured for 6 weeks. Alcoholic grade 4.5% in volume.

Name: Tibir Ale W/Grapes
Description: Beer with addition of the Timorasso white wine grapes, oak aged.

Name: Quarta Runa W/Peaches
Description: A belgian ale with "Volpedo Peaches" (well-known peaches from the town of Volpedo, near Montegioco) added during fermentation.

Name: Amadeus Biere Blanche
Description: Unfiltered beer containing aromatic wheat which confers its fruity and acidulous taste. It is a beer which undergoes two successive high fermentations. The use of wheat gives to the product an excellent foam behaviour as well as a pale and opalescent color. Also named as Saint Landelin Bière Blanche.

Name: La Divine Saint Landelin
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: La Divine de St Landelin is a high density top fermentation beer with specially selected yeasts. After a prolonged storage period the beer is packaged in a traditional swing-top cap. It has fruity, woody and caramel aromas as well as a certain bitterness persistent upon the palate. Soft and generous, La Divine is a “grand cru” of St Landelin and has an abv of 8.5%.  Ingredients: Malt, wheat, rice, hops, spices.  Note: Labelled as 8% abv in the USA.

Name: Gayant La Goudale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: In the XIV century, the good beers were called Goudale, Goudalle or Good Ale. There were sold for 2 deniers a pot at a merchant called Goudalier.

Name: Maredsous Triple Ale 10
Description:
Maredsous Triple is served in the abbey on special occasions. Its elegant smoothness hides its alcohol content and makes it the connoiseur's beer.
Maredsous Tripel is a golden-bodied Belgian triple, redolent with festive sparkle, creamy body and a luscious head. Its elegant smoothness belies the strong alcohol content. You'll revel in its balanced, long, and warming finish.

Name: Maredsous Blonde #6
Description: Golden beer with a characteristically fresh bouquet and sweet after-taste.

Name: Maredsous Blonde
Description: Pours a deep, orange-amber hue. A superb "session" beer from Belgium, with al ovely nose of spices, banasa, clove, and grains. On the palate a breadiness adds some complexity. Fruity, sugary tones come through. Finishes dry, with nice carbonation.

Name: Maredsous
Description: Maredsous is the authentic beer of the Benedictine monks of the abbey of Maredsous in Belgium. The abbey is located in the Belgian Ardennes, south of the City of Namur, in the Province of Namur, next to a picturesque village called Denée.

Name: Corsendonk Christmas Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: First brewed in 1998, this Christmas release by Brouwerij Corsendonk (Oud, Belgium) was hit almost immediately.  Christmas Ale has received a world class rating on BeerAdvocate.com, and is highly anticipated as soon as the weather turns cold.  This dark Belgian ale is one of 5 offerings by Corsendonk, and is bottle conditioned.    Its aroma of chocolate malt and spices is reminiscent of the wonderful smells of holiday baking in Mom’s kitchen. On the palate this silky smooth ale is predominantly malty, with smoky, spicy and citrusy notes, and a long, lingering finish that is lightly tart and malty. Round and well-balanced, it will be a welcome addition to holiday tables and parties.    Style: Belgian Strong Dark Ale    Taste Expectations: Big malty taste, with dark fruit notes (figs, grapes, raisins) from the malts/yeast. Spicy – w/ coriander notes.  Some chocolate flavor.    Food Pairings: This ale pairs well with holiday meals. Duck/Goose/Ham/Turkey.  Candied/sugar glazes pair nicely also.

Name: Corsendonk Pale Ale
Description: Imported from Belgium. A pale golden abbey ale brewed by master craftsmen in the classic Belgian tripel style. Dry and delicate, with a distinctive hop bouquet and palate character, this bottle-conditioned ale has the finesse of methode champenoise and will mature in bottle, becoming softer and smoother.

Name: Green’s Endeavour Dubbel Dark Ale (Gluten Free)
Description: In the classic dubbel fashion, a hint of dark-sugar and toffee flavor; and a traditional Belgian yeast bouquet.

Name: Green’s Tripel Blonde Ale
Description: "Tripel" is a style that was originated by Westmalle Trappist Brewery in the 1930s, when they began to sell Westmalle Trappist Tripel. Rich and full-flavored, tripels are satisfying beers beloved by beer aficionados. Many breweries now produce a tripel, but a tripel made from all gluten-free ingredients, without barley, is a particular accomplishment.    Taste    Fairly light body for beer of this strength; spice and herb nose with flavors of candied fruit. Aromatic, long finish.    Serving Suggestion    Steamed asparagus, artichoke, squash, or other full-flavored, rich vegetables. Excellent with beef dishes or with wild game.    Accolade    World Beer Championships Gold Medal - 93 Points - 2011.    Product Sizes and Quantities    16.9-ounce (500 ml) bottles / 12 per case  Stats    ABV: 8.5% - OG: 1.072 - IBU: 32   Ingredients: Water, millet, buckwheat (soba), brown rice, sorghum, hops, yeast. Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Medium-bodied with subtle caramel and nut flavor nuances. Refined, herbal hop aroma and finish.

Name: Green’s India Pale Ale – Gluten Free
Description: 5.0%abv. Bottle re-fermented and naturally gluten free, this is an elegant and classic IPA. Serve cool.

Name: Denizens Third Party Tripel
Description: This Belgian-style tripel follows traditional brewing practices with the addition of Belgian candi sugar. Golden in color, this beer has aromas of fruit and spice produced by the Belgian ale yeast during fermentation and finishes smooth.

Name: Denizens Lowest Lord
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: An English tradition, the extra special bitter is a more hop/malt forward version of the English Bitter. Our version uses a blend of English and American hops leaving a floral and herbal character balanced by notes of toffee and biscuit from the malt.

Name: Denizens Southside Rye IPA
Description: Rye makes up 15% of the malt bill in this American IPA. Hop-forward in style, this beer has strong notes of red grapefruit, orange marmalade, and pine. Malt flavors of soft caramel, biscuit, and spicy rye lay the groundwork for the American hops to shine.

Name: Denizens PGC Premium
Description: We named this American premium lager in tribute to Prince George’s County where our 2nd brewery location will reside. The use of high quality European malts and a small percentage of flaked rice, creates a flavorful pale lager that is light in body and highly crush-able.

Name: Kasteel Barista Chocolate Quad
Description: The name ‘Barista’ conjures thoughts of the fragrance of steaming coffee below a layer of expertly created froth. This may sounds rather far-fetched for a beer... However, the aromas and the flavours of caramel, cacao and roast malt match seamlessly with the ‘black gold’ and chocolate. This beer builds bridges with the world of hot beverages, with warming alcohol in the finish. One to enjoy all the year round: with a meal, in front of an open fire or on an outdoor terrace.

Name: Brigand Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Brigand is a strong and powerful beer with a somewhat neutral, very lightly malted smell. A taste of alcohol sweetness, slightly malty/herbal/hoppy, touches of citrus zest with a very slight bitterness that becomes stronger in the finish.  Full mouth feel, no noticeable sticky aftertaste.

Name: Great Raft Awkward Uncle
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Our Christmas beer, Awkward Uncle, is available on draft and in bottles at the brewery and SHV / Bossier retail accounts.  A NOLA draft launch will take place at Avenue Pub on Monday, 12/22 at 6 PM. It will also be released in Ruston / Monroe markets the week of Christmas. Name: Great Raft All My Tomorrow’s,
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Great Raft Commotion American Pale Ale
Description: This pale ale has a slightly fruity aroma, with an upfront hop bitterness of grapefruit and citrus.This bold but balanced, dry-hopped ale is faintly sweet but balanced by generous amounts of the finest American hops.

Name: Great Raft Life Itself Key Lime Pie Gose
Description: A traditional German gose (go-suh) with fresh lime juice. Slightly tart and salty, with a bright citrus accent from the coriander and lime.

Name: Progression Brewing Flourish Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Dry, Crisp, Slightly tart and refreshing. Single hopped with Hallertauer blanc, And fermented with a mixed culture blend of Saison yeasts from both Belgium and France. This yeast imparts complex tastes and aromas of both fruit and spice.

Name: Progression Sequence New England Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Hazy, soft, and citrusy, New England Pale Ale featuring deep pensive aromas and notes of fresh grapefruit, mangos, peaches, and watermelons, rounded out with undertones of fresh squeezed oranges.

Name: Progression Omen Imperial American Stout
Description: Bold, expressive and decadent. Features an abundance of roasted aromas combined tastes of dark chocolate, fresh espresso, & dried fruit.

Name: Progression Brewing Momentum NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed with an isolated mixed cultured Kveik strain of yeasts from Norway, this clean fermenting yeast has a high temperature tolerance of up to 91 degrees. Allowed to free rise during primary fermentation with the first round of dry hops. Then a second round of dry hop to further exemplify its tropical qualities and characteristics. Silky slick, clean and magical tropical citrus notes shine through and through.

Name: Big Elm 413 Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Big Elm IPA
Description: Our handcrafted IPA is generously hopped, subtly assertive, and decidedly balanced. We use some of the finest Pacific Northwest hops, select American and German malts and a classic American West Coast ale yeast to breathe life into this superb beer. - Cheers!

Name: Big Elm Fat Boy Double IPA
Description: Double Dry Hopped, Double IPA, bursting at the seams with juicy, tropical American hops!

Name: Warped Wing Ermal’s
Description: Summer. 1959. A picnic. Ermal Fraze, a kindly tool-and-die man, wrapped his calloused hand around an ice-cold, flat-top can of beer and asked, "Anybody bring a can opener?" To his horror, no one replied, "Yes." Out of the ashes of this indignity, Ermal rose like a phoenix. And later, the pop-top can, whish is still used today. Grab a can of Ermal's Belgian Style Cream Ale. Its light, creamy body. Mild spice accents. And a symphony of citrus notes. They're inside. So let them out.

Name: Warped Wing Self Starter Session IPA
Warped Wing Brass Punk German Style Pilsner
Twisted Pine La Petite Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Saisons originated in Belgium as a key provision for toiling farmers during harvest time. Lucky for us, the abundant Colorado sunshine makes it Saison season year-round. La Petite pours hazy straw gold like a sunlit haystack with delightful aromas of lemon peel, peppercorn and orange blossom. Now put your pitchfork aside, relax, and refresh yourself

Name: Twisted Pine Hoppy Boy IPA
Description: Hoppy Boy India Pale Ale is Twisted Pine Brewing Company’s flagship beer. With a rocky ivory head, star-bright golden orange color, and massive hop aroma, Hoppy Boy is the quintessential American IPA. Citrus, resin, and a hint of malt not only greet your nose, but also your taste buds, while a smooth, lingering bitterness leaves your palate refreshed with every sip. Hoppy Boy IPA is a perfect marriage of malts and hops that is as bold as it is balanced, and thus exemplifies what American craft beer is all about.

Name: Twisted Pine Hop Zealot
Description: We crafted this ale for those-some call them fanatics-devoted to the bountiful bines of the hop plant. Hop Zealot pours like a golden beam of sunshine with a massive blast of hop aroma that’ll make a true believer out of any IPA lover.

Name: Twisted Pine Rasberry Wheat
Description: Perfect for a hot summer day, or any day for that matter, this refreshing, raspberry-flavored American Wheat Beer blends soft and chewy malt flavor with crisp yet decisive raspberry tartness that is sure to refresh any palate. This beer is as unpretentious as it gets: raspberry and wheat are a match made in beer heaven and everyone who’s tried it agrees!

Name: Vapeur En Folie
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Vapeur Cochonne Amber Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: 9%vol. 33, 75 and 150cl Beer very amber in color, strong, nose fruity and delicate, soft and round with the palate; slightly hopped but correctly spiced (roasted chicory, coriander, and sweet orange peel, among other ingredients). Bottle fermented and complex. On the Port-y side fresh. Spiced distinctly with orange, corriander and chicory. Should cellar nicely.

Name: Saison De Pipaix Vapeur
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Vapeur D Antan
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Bellwoods Brewery White Picket Fence Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Blended foeder saison. A symbol synonymous with Bellwoods Brewery; our White Picket Fence has undergone a complete overhaul and its repurposed form much better reflects the direction of our brewery. Brewed with the addition of wheat, oats, and rye, WPF is fermented and conditioned in foeders for 6 months, blended with fresh saison, then gently dry-hopped before bottle conditioning. Labour intensive in process, but rewarding in result

Name: Bellwoods Farmageddon
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A special edition of our classic Farmhouse Saison, this version is a blend of young and old barrels ranging in age from 6 months to 1.5 years. Because we're such a micro operation, each batch of Farmageddon varies slightly, reflecting the small batch blends we do, using an evolving house microflora (including multiple strains of brett from different sources). If this all sounds confusing, fear not -- all you need to know is that the refined, effervescent beer that hibernates in these bottles is a dynamic labour of love, changing and improving with time.

Name: Bellwoods Jelly King
Description: This mixed fermentation ale is soured with a 5-strain house blend of lactobacillus, and heavily dry-hopped with citra. The result is juicy, sour, and thirst-quenching. Lots of fuzzy peach, tangerine, and cedar hop aroma and flavours with very low bitterness.

Name: Bellwoods Bring Out Your Dead
Description: Our annual (so long as we didn’t open a production facility that year) imperial stout aged in cognac barrels has emerged from oak classy as ever, ready to impress in a glass near you.

Name: Good Beer Company Abuela
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Farmhouse blonde ale rested in French oak Central Coast Pinot Noir barrels. Abuela picked up elegant vinous and tannic character from the barrel aging. Abuela has a refined and subtle citrus tartness, integrated barrel and wine character, and a dry finish that wipes the palate clean.

Name: The Good Beer Lemon Season
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: The Good Beer Co Wild Lady
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Blond farmhouse ale bottled with Brettanomyces

Name: Good Beer Nectarine Oro
Description: Our fruity and tart farmhouse ale fermented with a mixed culture, then aged in French oak barrels with nectarines.

Name: Red Betty IPA
Description: A style of ale that was fashioned to survive the long voyage from England to India during the British colonization. Hop, hops, and more hops! Red Betty IPA has an intense aroma and a long lingering finish. A beer for the connoisseur, this is the Brewmasters choice.

Name: Red Betty Imperial IPA 220Z
Description: Dry hopped with whole leaf hops from the Yakima Valley, combined with Maris Otter English barley, which is floor-malted in age old tradition. A long maturation ensures plenty of flavour, with strong aromatics of grapefruit, tangerine and mango.

Name: Kasteel Donker
Description:
A strong Belgian brown ale.
After extensive tasting, trying to fulfil increasingly strict requirements, the brewmaster obtains a creamy, dark Belgian brown ale: Kasteelbier. The quality of the past is still unmatched and the beloved taste is very much of the present. Kasteelbier is a dark, artisanal beer, soft and mild, full and creamy. It can age for many, many years, as indicated on the bottle. 11% abv, serve at 12°C

Name: Kasteel Triple
Description: A tripel, as solid as a castle. A full bodied beer, brewed with Belgian hops, to enjoy quietly, with a powerful, distinctive flavour: flowery, hop bitterness and soft alcohol.

Name: Kasteel Trignac XII
Description: Kasteel Tripel matured in Cognac casks from Brouwerij Van Honsebrouck

Name: Kasteel Rouge
Description:
Its unique dark red colour is obtained by mixing Castle brown that has been left to mature for at least 6 months with sour cherries.

Kasteel Rouge is aptly named for it’s deep, dark red color brought on by the addition of sour cherries to a base of brown ale, which is then left in the barrel for a six month period. This ale will surprise many with the sour of the cherries and the 8% alcohol level.

This beer has gastronomic qualities and can be drunk as an aperitif, with a BBQ, to accompany a dessert or simply as an outstanding real ale.

Name: Saint Somewhere Serge
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Nice and dark mahogany with deep ruby red colors shining through wen put up against a light source. Light tan head quickly dissipated to a thin film of tiny bubbles and slight lacing around the rim.

Name: Saint Somewhere Pays du Soleil
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Pays du Soleil is brewed as a saison and not a dubbel, although it has a resemblance to both.

Name: Saint Somewhere Divina
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: An amber ale brewed in the spirit of the abbey ales of Belgium. Lectio Divina gets its color from candi sugar, as it is made without dark or crystal malts. It is brewed with the same care and attention to the Art of Brewing that is practiced in the monastic breweries of Belgium.

Name: Saint Somewhere Anne
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description:
Pours bright and clear, a golden yellow with a good-sized white head this dissipates to a thick film. Some fine bubbles cling to the glass just short of the head and hold like a still life version of the waterfall before evaporating like a fog.
Smell is rich and malty with strong notes of citrus, grape and green apple blended together. Hops is present weakly, a supporting player. Nicely balanced and well presented.
Taste is malty and sour with a grape note prominent. Not as balanced as the nose, however.
Light to medium body with a medium effervescence. Finishes cleaner than expected and with a hint of dryness and vinegar acidity. Overall a fine beer.

Name: Sibling Revelry Third Wheel Belgian Tripel
Description: Full malt body and a sweet, welcome-balanced finish.

Name: Olly Olly Gluten Free Pale Ale
Description: Light bodied and barely bitter, this GF beer is a traditional pale ale to match the citrusy blend of hops.

Name: Sibling Revelry Imperial Cosmic Cocoa Stout
Sibling Revelry Spiked Seltzer
Description: Spiked Seltzer is brewed with all natural ingredients for a premium, small-batch flavor including Grapefruit, Pineapple Kiwi, Cherry Lime and Raspberry.

Name: Dubuisson Saison Surfine
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Dubuisson Scaldis Amber Strong Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: The Scaldis Amber is flushed with a bitter-sweet taste, and a pleasing consistency, courtesy, in part, of its balanced caramel malts. Those malts also introduce a strong streak of roasted nuts, adding to this beer's stand out flavour. Despite its initial filtering, the re-fermentation has given the beer a natural cloudiness, while also making for a mild and tender mouth-feel.

Name: Dubuisson  Scaldis Peche Mel
Description: True to Dubuisson's roots, this is a high ABV version of a fruit beer. Peaches taste more dried than fresh and it's slightly sweet.

Name: Fantome Strange Ghost
