Name: Birrificio Del Ducato Chimera
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: This is a top fermented beer which undergoes a secondary fermentation in bottle. It draws inspiration from the great Belgian Abbey beers. With the color of a friar’s robe, it has aromas of caramel and alcohol preserved fruit (pear, plum and morel) with light roasts. The mouth is warm and complex with an unexpected dry finish that makes drinking easier. “To all those who still hold dreams and will never cease to search for the happiness they deserve”.

Name: Birrificio Del Ducato New Morning
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Dedicated to the beauty of a new spring morning with the first sun rays warming the blossoming flowers. Nuova Mattina pours a hazy orange color with a scent reminiscent of field flowers. A complex, intriguing, voluptuous and thirst quenching ale, a hopeful hymn to the day that lies ahead. Brewed with ginger, coriander, green pepper and chamomile

Name: Birrificio Del Ducato La Luna Rossa
Description: Blend of Krisopolis (a new beer, that will be available in the future, fermented in barrels for 2 years, then Morello cherries are added to it), with a part of Ultima Luna (Barley Wine matured in Amarone barrels, with Marasca Morello cherries) and a part of young beer.

Name: Birrificio Del Ducato Chrysopolis
Description: The idea of ​​this beer was born in December 2008, five years before its marketing. It had to be a brass with raw materials and techniques similar to those used for lambic production, which never sees steel but ferment directly into the wood. It was not a matter of imitating it, but of drawing a new path, running a road that had not yet been beaten. Initially I used Chrysopolis's first batches only as a base for the La Luna Rossa blend. The recipe is very simple: 65% Pilsner malt and 35% wheat, the amazement program tries to mimic the turbid mash while retaining a large amount of dextrin and even some starch residues in the must. During boiling, add the flowered honey hop that let's age in the air for a few years. After cooling, we transfer the must directly into barrels. The first batches of Chrysopolis were inoculated with a mixture of Brettanomyces, Lactobacilli and Pediococchi this with the precise intent of addressing the fermentation. After at least 12 months of fermentation and aging in barrels, comes the time of the blend, where different bats of different ages are assembled in distinct proportions to create the true Chrysopolis. Assembling different barrels can create shades, give complexity, blend corners, give color brushes, create lights and shadows. It is a delicate and evocative phase, a special moment and for me with great emotion, one of those moments when I I realize to do the nicest craft in the world. -John  In the glass, nose and palate Chrysopolis has a golden yellow color, rather opalescent, with a very low, slightly perceptible sparkiness. The smell is very complex and intriguing, revealing a bouquet full of hints that bring us back to the memory of wisdom and dark cellars dispersed in Flemish Brabant: lemon, cedar, horsehair, salami mold, rust and leather. Taste is the sharp lactic acidity with a typical bitterness from Brett, slightly faded by acetic reminiscences. Wood is present but in an absolutely discreet manner, remaining politely in the background. The final is very intense and persistent, showing great finesse.

Name: Jackrabbit Brewing Saison Farmhouse Style Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This beer is different from other domestic saisons because it is less hoppy and does not use the Dupont yeast strain or a similar strain. Our Belgian yeast strain produces fruity and spicy notes along with some tartness and is a strong attenuator. Saison is a very diverse style and we wanted a beer that was refreshing but still had a complex flavor profile. Malt, unmalted wheat, hops, and yeast all make a noticeable contribution to this beer. The flaked wheat also gives this beer some body since it has a low finishing gravity. Hops are used in moderate amounts to provide good hop flavor and aroma without overwhelming bitterness or harshness.

Name: Jackrabbit Bad Habit Belgian Style Abbey Ale
Description: Rich flavors from Belgian yeast and dark crystal malt dominate in this flavorful brew which has a smooth finish and a mild chocolate aftertaste.

Name: Jackrabbit Maple Pecan Oatmeal Stout
Description: Roasted barley, oatmeal, Vermont maple syrup & lightly toasted pecans are combined to produce this fall stout. Enjoy with your favorite flannel.

Name: Jackrabbit Alpha Mosaic Imperial IPA
Description: We brewed our Uglier Bunny with Mosaic hops to create this juicy Imperial IPA with a rich tropical fruit flavor and earthy undertones.

Name: Church Street Devil’s Advocate Belgian-Style Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Devil's Advocate begs the question: What happens when you take a ton (literally) of Pilsen malt, put it through a decoction mash, boil it up, add 500 lbs of Belgian Candi and cane sugar, and then add some Belgian yeast? The answer: A spicy, sweet, and dangerously drinkable Belgian golden strong ale.

Name: Church Street Q Street IPA
Description: A super crushable IPA featuring Saaz and Cascade hops. High carbonation lends to a pleasant effervescence that balances out this spicy, fruity brew

Name: Church Street Brewing Brimstone IPA
Description: Brimming with Cascade aroma, giving this tangerine-beauty a fruity and refreshing nose—don’t be surprised if you find yourself sniffing more than sipping! Large quantities of late addition hops contribute to the high IBUs, creating a bold bitterness that’s rounded out by notes of citrus and grapefruit with a slightly dry hoppy finish.

Name: Only Child Brewing Le Perfectioniste
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Yeast is the star here. A true earthy & rustic Farmhouse Ale, fresh, effervescent & funk-tastic. Nelson Sauvin isn't a bad addition either

Name: Only Child Charmingly Introverted Double IPA
Description: Full Stick of Hop Dynomite.

Name: Only Child Brewing School’s Out!
Description: There are no better feelings had than from the warmth of the Sun’s rays, longer days and all the joys of Summer, especially for us Chicagoans, who face absurdly brutal winters and all the chaos that ensues during the bitter-cold months. Let’s all enjoy summer while we can. Summer’s here, but it doesn’t stay for long. This sessionable IPA features huge citrus and floral notes that go well with boats, backyard BBQs and sunny days. Crack one open, kick off your flip-flops, and put your feet up…School’s Out and Summer break is upon us!

Name: Attention Hog
Description: Our Unfiltered, Bottle Conditioned Pale Rye Ale with Kolsch Yeast is almost entirely brilliant…It tastes amazingly crisp & fruity.

Name: Casey East Bank – Apricot
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: East Bank Apricot is Troy Casey’s East Bank beer, which is an old-world style farmhouse ale made with local Colorado honey and fresh local apricots.

Name: Casey East Bank – Peach
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Farmhouse ale fermented and aged in neutral oak wine barrels for 3-5 months with local honey and peaches.

Name: Casey East Bank – Peach/Nectarine
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Farmhouse ale fermented and aged in neutral oak wine barrels for 3-5 months with local honey, peaches and nectarines.

Name: Casey Funky Blender Cherry – Bing
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Farmhouse Ale aged in oak barrels with Bing cherries

Name: Valiant Axiom Trappist Style Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: This beer has a delicious Graham cracker aroma with a slight malty highlight. Cherry combines with raisin, some spiciness and a few alcohol esters. The flavor has a rich caramel sweetness that leads into a diverse mixture of malt characters. There is also a taste of clove with a little herbal hops and a light hotness. In the finish you will find a flicker of warmth and a mildly dry sensation as well as low sweetness and medium mouthfeel.

Name: Valiant Brewing Alpha Drive Double IPA
Valiant Citcoe Drive
Description: Citra and Simcoe, that’s it. What else is there to explain? Keeping things extremely simple, we’ve crafted a balanced single India Pale Ale that has an elevated portion of hop juicy flavor in addition to being disciplined with hop bitterness. A bright, tropical aroma with notes of passionfruit and citrus will give your senses the drive needed for adventurous minds!

Name: Toolbox Troubadour Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Across the centuries, from rural France to West Hollywood, lyrical poets have encouraged their listeners to discuss and question the world around them. Through their poignant and sometimes controversial compositions they provoke conversation and spark invention. Modern poets such as Bob Dylan, Willie Nelson, and many others have continued this long held tradition of storytelling.   Through collaboration and discussion we gladly present Troubadour, a French Saison consisting of barley and wheat, fermented with saison yeast and Brettanomyces bruxellensis var. drie for 4 months in Hungarian oak Chardonnay barrels and refermented in the bottle for an additional 4 months. Enjoy. Share. Discuss. Continue the tradition.

Name: Toolbox Eau D’vine
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Aged in French oak white wine barrels with California Chardonny Grapes.

Name: Toolbox Sangria
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: San Diego Weisse

Name: Toolbox Bog Sauce
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Berliner Weisse w/ Cranberries & Raspberries

Name: Aslan Hook Stash Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: In collaboration with Mt. Baker Ski Area we brewed a beer to celebrate the life of former Pro Patrol and Mt. Baker Legend, Randy Hook. An easy drinking, light bodied classic pale ale, this beer was brewed with American 2-Row barley, hard red wheat, and hopped exclusively with Nelson Sauvin. The dryness of this beer accentuates the dank white grape notes that dominate the flavor and aroma. This beer is best enjoyed at a ski lodge after a long day on the mountain.

Name: Aslan Mandarina Queen IPA
Description: This Queen of an IPA is nearly an exclusive representation of Mandarina Bavaria hops. A luscious and viscous mouthfeel with strong notes of Florida oranges, dried coconut & honeydew melons dominate. This beer reminds us of a certain "fruit" drink that was super popular at shopping malls back in the day.

Name: MadeWest Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Heavily hopped West Coast style pale ale bursting with a bright citrus and fruity hop complexity. It has just enough malt presence to allow the loads of hops to shine through, including a generous dry hopping. This crisp hop forward beer has a dry refreshing finish.

Name: MadeWest Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A hazy IPA packed with a jaw-dropping quantity of Mosaic hops. This aromatic IPA has a ripe juicy character with notes of fresh peaches and mango. A soft, silky mouthfeel is complemented by a smooth, refreshing finish.

Name: MadeWest IPA
Description: West Coast style IPA showcasing tropical cutting edge hop varietals. A light malt base of two row, wheat and a touch of pilsner provide a platform for a complex bouquet of pineapple, papaya, mango and candy-like stone fruit and citrus tones. This IPA has a mellow bitterness and a smooth pleasant dry finish.

Name: LIC Coded Tiles
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: DDH with Cascade, Citra, and Simcoe.

Name: LIC Higher Burnin IPA
Description: El Dorado, Belma and Mosaic hops and 4 different malts

Name: Cricket Hill American Pale Ale
Description:
A delightful marriage of caramel sweetness
and speciality hops, this beer has an aroma
that hints of citrus and rock candy. The subtle
complexity of this beer compliments grilled
or roasted meats or try it with your best dish.
You will not be disappointed!

Name: Cricket Hill Breakfast Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Even though we call it Breakfast Ale, this belgian style ale can be enjoyed anytime of the day or night. Brewed with the best quality malts and fermented with a traditional Trappist yeast, this combo allows the flavors and aromas of tangy fruit, banana and clove to shine through every sip.

Name: Cricket Hill Hopnotic IPA
Description:
Four different bittering hops and generous dry hopping result in a beer with a huge hop nose and flavor indicative of grapefruit and tropical fruit. Well-balanced with a solid malt backbone, Hopnotic will impress any IPA enthusiast and
stands up to spicy food or your favorite burger.

Name: Cricket Hill Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Our version of this fall favorite is brewed with select malts, pumpkin, specialty hops, and a pumpkin-pie spice blend of cinnamon, allspice, ginger and nutmeg.  Well-balanced with a rich caramel color and smooth finish, it’s great to enjoy during the harvest season.

Name: Zilker Brewing Parks & Rec Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Barebottle Rainbow Road Shortcut Hazy Pale
Description: You aren’t going to beat Princess or Yoshi without the Rainbow Road Shortcut, which as it turns out, is both a killer cheat on Mario Kart 64, and also a super juicy hazy pale ale, with a recipe including lightning strikes, red Koopa shells, Citra, Mosaic, and El Dorado hops.

Name: Barebottle Hypnotic Tropics Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Featuring the dynamic Idaho-7 hop, this hazy pale will leave you in a daze of citrus zest and stonefruit.

Name: Barebottle Pineapple Shakes IPA
Description: Fermented with 30 gallons of fresh pineapple juice, Pineapple Shakes gets a tropical boost. Smooth, aromatic, and drinkable. Pineapple shakes is one of our best ‘Shakes Beers’ yet.

Name: Geary’s Hampshire Special Ale
Description: Once Maine’s legendary seasonal specialty, Hampshire is now available year round. Hampshire has a huge toasted malt flavor balanced by assertive hoppiness. The finish is long and lingering with the malt and hop notes blending with alcohol warmth. Original gravity - 1070; alcohol by volume - 7%; two row English malts (pale, crystal and chocolate); Cascade, Mt. Hood and East Kent Golding hops.

Name: Geary’s Pale Ale
Description: Our flagship.  This is a classic British pale ale with a nod to the legendary beers of Burton-on-Trent.  Copper-colored, dry, clean, and crisp with lots of late hop taste, in an appetizing complex with ale fruitiness from imported Hampshire yeast.  Original gravity - 1047; alcohol by volume - 4.5%; two row English malt (pale, crystal and chocolate); Cascade, Mt. Hood, Tettnang and Fuggle Hops.

Name: Geary’s Summer
Description: The style of this ale is traditionally European, similar to a German kolsch: full bodied with a spicy hop tang and a rich, crystal clear golden color. Alcohol content is approximately 6% by volume.

Name: Rubicon Monkey Knife Fight
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Rubicon Capricorn Black Ale
Description: This dark brew is a very unique creation originally conceived at home by one brewer. It is a combination of styles that came from his love of Stouts and Porters coupled with his thirst for bitterness and aroma found in an IPA. It is an IPA with a heart of darkness, an India Black Ale.

Name: Rubicon Ipa 29th Anniversary
Description: 1987 was a long time ago… gas was 89 cents a gallon, the Simpsons made its way into your living rooms, and no one who drank beer had the faintest idea what lupulin was. 29 years later, we’re still here making award-winning beer. To celebrate, we present to you this vibrant IPA loaded with Citra, Mosaic and Simcoe hops. Notes of passionfruit, blueberry, grapefruit, and dankness will envelop your senses as you reach for the next sip… THIS is the one you’ve been waiting for! Coming soon to the brewpub, taproom and to stores near you!

Name: Rubicon 25th Anniversary IPA
Description: A single malt and single hop make up this special brew. We used Pale Crisp Malt and the classic Cascade Hop. Light gold pale color with a clean dry finish. Flavors of fruit and citrus with pleasant floral aromas. Served unfiltered - it is simple, yet deliciously complex.

Name: Wild Onion Crazy Fingers
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A juicy American dry hopped with Mosaic hops for your drinking pleasure.

Name: Wild Onion Misfit IPA
Description: A velvety, chewy IPA with the perfect blend of hop bitterness, aroma, and malt body. Centennial and Citra hops give Misfit a pleasantly bitter kick, along with a hint of citrus.

Name: Wild Onion Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Celebrate the harvest season with our classic autumnal brew. This crisp ale brewed with spices has hints of pumpkin pie and a rich, malty aroma.

Name: Hop Valley Citrus Mistress
Description: This seasonal IPA features 4 different hops with multiple flavors and aromas complimented with the addition of grapefruit peel. It creates a bouquet of citrus, peach and tropical fruits with enough Munich malt to produce a classic burnt orange color.

Name: Hop Valley Divine Shine Hybrid Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This unfiltered, hazy beer packs a punch of flavors with a lower ABV. Hop bursted with Galaxy and Mosaic hops combined with a unique blend of grains create a multi-grain hybrid ale with tropical aromas, a bright color, and a velvety smooth finish.

Name: Hop Valley Alphadelic
Description: You can run, but you can’t hide from the hops in this true Northwest IPA brewed by hop lovers, for hop lovers.

Name: Hop Valley Bubble Stash IPA
Description: Our brewers reached into their secret stash of Mosaic cryo-hop resin to create a tropical dankness in this new age IPA. Take a hit of these bright sweet fruit notes in this easy drinking bubbler. You won’t want to pass this one!

Name: Something Brewery Maximum Effort Blood Orange DDH Citra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Description: An American extra pale ale, brewed in West Coast style, with higher alcohol and more hops for an extra kick! It is light copper in color, medium bodied, and brewed with lots of Cascade hops for a big citrusy aroma and flavor to go with the rich malty sweetness.

Name: Boston Beer Works Watermelon Ale
Description: Boston Beer Works salute to summer ale. A refreshing light ale brewed with an all natural watermelon flavored extract, and garnished with a slice of watermelon on every glass.     The beer is a slightly hazed, copper gold coloring with a steady flow of carbonation and a frothy, bright white head. It has aromas of syrupy/sugary sweet watermelon, with a slight toasted grain backbone. Flavors are toasty and smooth initially, with a biscuity backbone, followed by a sharp, sweet watermelon blast. The beer starts off smooth, but becomes watery quickly in mouth. Lightly sweet watermelon aftertaste, with a light, almost limp finish.

Name: Thornbridge Kipling South Pacific Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Kipling is a soft, but full flavoured, South Pacific Pale Ale with flavours of passion fruit and kiwi.

Name: Thornbridge Halcyon IPA
Description: Cask & bottle conditioned; Seasonal - Autumn. Previously 7.7%.

Name: Thornbridge Jaipur IPA
Description: A citrus dominated India Pale Ale, its immediate impression is soft and smooth yet builds to a crescendo of massive hoppiness accentuated by honey. An enduring, bitter finish.

Name: Thornbridge Wild Raven Black IPA
Description: Originally released a for the Chesterfield CAMRA festival.  Renamed as Wild Raven in 2013 due to another beer going by the name "Raven" elsewhere The recipe for the brew came from James Kemp, who joined the team a few months ago. Previously crowned the New Zealand Home Brewing Champion in 2008 and winner of a Liberty Award, Kemp used Maris Otter, Black Patent and Chocolate malt along with Nelson Sauvin, Centennial and Sorachi hops. The beer, called Raven, has bitterness and hop character and plenty of malt flavours to give it complexity. James moved on to Buxton brewery and is now a freelance brewer

Name: Hopsters Harborwalk Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Prominently featuring Citra hops, our Citra Pale Ale delivers grapefruit & tropical fruit aromas w/ a semi-dry finish.

Name: Hopsters Newtonian IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Grapefruit, Peach, Pineapple, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description: A double hopped IPA juice bomb bursting with bright flavor. This beer boasts strong hoppy citrus and tropical aromas from Citra and Amarillo hops that are balanced with the fruit and spice of Galena hops. The Newtonian drinks intensely with the fruit and floral notes of mango, grapefruit, pineapple, melon and peach, and finishes with a soft, silky mouth feel.

Name: Hopsters Comet Mosaic IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Berry, Citrus, Earthy, Pine, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Description: Double dry hopped with a generous helping of Mosaic Hops gives this New England IPA a wallop of tropical fruit aromas including citrus, berry, herbal, earthy and pine characteristics. With two-row malt and white wheat for a soft mouth feel, balanced with the tart bitterness of Comet Hops, this juicy hop bomb has a totally tropical taste.

Name: Hopsters Juicy Fruit IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Tasting Notes: Pear, Pineapple, Stone Fruit, Tropical, Tropical Fruit, Watermelon
Description: A juicy double dry hopped New England IPA that shows off the El Dorado hop flavors of tropical fruit, pineapple and mango. Aromas of pear, watermelon, stone fruit and candy, along with the addition of Denali hops, give this NEIPA it's totally tropical taste.

Name: New English Brewing Zumbar Imperial Stout
Description: Brewed with whole bean "El Mundo" Colombian coffee from our good buddies over at ZUMBAR COFFEE on Roselle Street. This Stout is full of chocolate flavor courtesy of 22Lbs of Belgian 72% dark chocolate and the aforementioned Coffee kick in the ass all submerged in thick, black stout goodness and weighing in at 9.3% ABV.

Name: New English Pure & Simple IPA
Description: To make a beer different from anything else they brew, the New English team selected UK Golden Promise as 100% of the base malt, Carapils and light crystal malts. 6.5% ABV was decided to be the sweet spot: not too over the top, but not a session beer either. To ensure enough bitterness to be a west coast style IPA, the IBUs were set at 75, achieved with Nugget and Centennial as the early kettle additions.  Flavor and aroma come from late kettle additions of Citra and Mosaic, with loads more of both these wonderful hops added as dry hops in the fermenter.

Name: New English Humbly Legit IPA
Description: New English Brewing Company’s newest beer is a West Coast-Style IPA called “Humbly Legit IPA”. The devilish forces of alcohol and bitterness, 7.5% ABV and 70 IBU’s, could overwhelm but, as with all our beers, the angelic forces of subtlety and the sublime element of balance are also present. The grain bill is redolent with the complexity of rye malt, lightly toasted crystal and victory malts. The 90 minute boil both caramelizes and concentrates the wort. Large helpings of bittering hops up front are complimented by Cascade late in the kettle. Centennial and Cascade dry hops develop a pleasing floral and citrus aroma.      While we Humbly ask your indulgence, we are confident that this ale is a Legit IPA in the best West Coast tradition. We hope you enjoy it!

Name: Peekskill NYPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This bright, hoppy ale is brewed with Honey Malt and 100% late-hopped with Mosaic and Citra from Carpenter Ranches.

Name: Peekskill Amazeballs
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Peekskill Brewery Simple Sour
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Brewed with wheat, corn and brettanomyces. This Sour is quick, dry and refreshing.

Name: Peekskill Brewery Skills Pilsner
Description: An international style Pilsner with German malts, New Zealand hops and Czech lager yeast.

Name: Parkside Motel 5 Hop Pale Ale
Description: The Parkside Brewery has used 5 different hops to brew up the Parkside Motel Pale Ale. This beer comes in 473ml cans and pours clouded-golden in colour with a finger and a half of lacing head. There are some noticeable chunks that are floating the beer as well. The aroma is big with tropical fruit flavours of mango, orange, lemon and passion fruit. This likely has a strong Mosaic Hop contingent in the recipe. Tasting the beer it has a balanced sweetness and bitterness along side the big fruity hop flavour. Not overly bitter, there is just enough to balance the sweetness and make for a big flavoured, easy drinking beer. This brew takes the new-school mentality of a North East IPA, and scales it into a more balanced package of a 5.8% pale ale.

Name: Parkside Dreamboat Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Made with Superior Pilsner malt, flaked wheat and oats, this unfiltered IPA has waves of fresh melon and hand-squeezed citrus notes from a happy blend of Cashmere, Lemondrop, Citra, and Azacca hops. A juicy treat that lingers like a hazy dream.

Name: Parkside Graffiti IPA
Description: Brimming with pithy grapefruit, light pine, and floral hop notes, and a bold yet balanced bitterness which lingers on one’s palate.

Name: Parkside Dawn Pilsner
Description: Dawn pays homage to traditional German Pilsners with a sublime balance between malt and hop. Old and new hop varieties make Dawn appealing to both traditionalists and adventurous Pilsner lovers alike. A refreshing and sessionable lager.

Name: Hidden Springs Zero Fucks Given
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Oude Quetsche Tilquin à l’Ancienne
Description: The Quetsche Tilquin à l’ancienne (6.4% alc/vol) is a spontaneous fermentation beer obtained from the fermentation of destoned fresh purple plums in young lambics, blended with 1, 2 and 3 years lambic to reach a final concentration of fruits of 250 gr fruit per liter.

Name: Gueuzerie Tilquin Oude Mûre Tilquin à L’ancienne
Description: Beer of spontaneous fermentation, the Oude Mûre Tilquin à l’Ancienne is made from the fermentation of 350 gr of blackberries by liter of lambic. Unfiltered and unpasteurized, this beer is refermented in the bottle.

Name: Gueuze Tilquin Squared
Description: This is a higher abv version of the Gueuze Tilquin à l’Ancienne containing the blend of 1, 2 and 3 year old lambics aged in oak barrels. Due to over-carbonation, the beer underwent a second barrel aging process before being bottled a second time. Unfiltered and unpasteurized, this beer is refermented in the bottle.

Name: Gueuzerie Tilquin Groseille Rouge
Description: Oude Groseille Rouge Tilquin à l'ancienne is produced by the fermentation of frozen organic redcurrants in one year old lambic and then blended with 1, 2 and 3 years old lambic to reach a final concentration of 260 grams of fruit per liter of lambic. It is a different version from the Experimental Fruit Series - draft version, which is lighter in alcohol.

Name: Unity Vibration Bourbon Peach Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Unity Vibration Raspberry
Description: Our Kombucha Beer is a wonderful evolution of our traditional Kombucha. “Triple Goddess” is a marriage of our 30-day brewed Kombucha, organic dried hops and either organic raw ginger root, organic fresh raspberries, organic peaches, or three types of hops, juniper and grapefruit rind. All aged and open-air-fermented in oak barrels and then bottle conditioned. The combination creates exquisite flavors that have depth and complexity as well as healthy nutrients. Like our organic Kombucha, it is raw, made with organic ingredients, gluten free, vegan and bottle conditioned and lends itself to healthy and beneficial bacteria. Unity Vibration was the first to release an all-kombucha based Kombucha Beer nationally. ALL OF OUR KOMBUCHA BEERS ARE GLUTEN-FREE!

Name: Unity Vibration K.P.A.
Description: This bourbon barrel aged Kombucha is double-hopped, blended with Juniper berries and just a bit of grapefruit.

Name: Unity Vibration Kombucha Ginger Brew
Description: This funky, bubbly beer balances appealing herbal flavors with an acidic tartness. Vegan, organic, and local.  Wild ale aged in oak bourbon casks with ginger and dry-hopped.

Name: Freigeist Salzspeicher Sour Porter
Description: Named after the ancient salt towers of old Lübeck (made famous in the classic 1922 horror film “Nosferatu”), Salzspeicher is a mix of two great historical Porter styles, the traditional sour German and it’s salty old English contemporary.

Name: Stillwater Atlantis Gose
Description: Brewed with oyster shells and seaweed

Name: Freigeist Kopenickiade Peach
Description: Köpenickiade brewed with Vineyard Peaches.

Name: Wild Ohio Blood Orange Tangerine Tea Beer
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Who said oranges and beer are not compatible? The tart citrus created by blood oranges and delectable tangerines make this beer flavor a favorite for a hot summer day. Likewise, this brew can bring you the forgotten touch of sun in the middle of a cold winter. The combination of tartness and sweetness can pamper your taste buds regardless of the season or the day of the week.

Name: Wild Ohio Blueberry Tea Beer
Description: If you want to give your taste buds a flavor eruption, you need to jolt them with the right blend. When we combined juicy and succulent blueberries with small hints of lavender, we knew we did the right thing. With the first sip, you understand just how much you’ve been missing out on. The touch of lavender doesn’t just complement succulent northern blueberries; it takes the taste to previously undiscovered heights!

Name: Wild Ohio Mango Tea Beer
Description: Cascade hops may seem boring, but when they are combined with ripe and luscious mangoes, you acquire a flavor beyond what you thought possible! We use special beer-brewing secrets to bring you a special tropical flavor in a bottle. The smooth taste of our Mango Hops beer will leave you desiring more. This beer will bring the joy of a tropical paradise to the comfort of your own home!

Name: Wild Ohio Brewing Gluten Free Peach Tea Beer

Name: Dorchester Brewing Indigo Sunrise Sour
Description: This Kettle Sour is a nod to the early riser in all of us. The color of a Dorchester sunrise with blueberry, plum and tangerine fruits. It delivers pucker and punch.

Name: Dorchester Brewing Galaxy Lights
Description: Session New England IPA

Name: Dorchester Ligth Year Journey
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Hemel & Aarde
Description: Made with the most heavily peated malt in the world from the Bruichladdich distillery. Almost pitch black and opaque, small head. Furiously peated aroma, hiding the malt, licorice and dark chocolate somewhat. Very full bodied, thick mouthfeel, like fluid bread. Dark chocolate, loads of peat, lapsang souchong tea, chocolate cake, culminating in an almost endless aftertaste that also has licorice.  Alcohol varies by batch.

Name: De Molen Hel & Verdoemenis
Description: The third RIS, Rasputin a Belgian IS. Tsarina Esra a Scandinavian/US RIS Now Hel & Verdoemenis, used old malts for this one like brownmalts.

Name: De Molen Pek & Veren
Categories: Smoked Beer  Rauchbier, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: In the old west it was custom to treat crooks, quacks and charlatans with tar and feathers. Then they were driven out of town backwards on their horse or donkey. At least, if you can believe the Lucky Luke comics. Did you know that Louis Pasteur in the beginning of his career was regularly accused of quackery? And now he is regarded as one of the main founders of microbiology. Brewers to this day still much profit from his findings. But we do not like pasteurizing like many large breweries do because that kills the beer. Our Pek & Veren is a beer that is similar to a solid doppelbock with smoke flavour.

Name: GP Brewing Blow Out Stout
Description: British hops, roasted malts, and flaked barley result in a viscous, thick stout, with heavy chocolate and noticable coffee flavours and aromas.

Name: GP Brewing Tk IPA
Description: Pacific Northwest hops give strong orange, grapefruit, and light floral aromas and flavours. New Zealand hops add subtle tropical and passion fruit notes.

Name: GP Brewing Mercury
Description: Balanced sweet grain and toasted bread flavours throughout, with subtle citrus notes on the finish.

Name: GP Brewing True North Lager
Description: A combination of base malts creates subtle toast and strong fresh bread flavours, with very slight caramel notes.

Name: Blatant Imperial Stout
Description: A mild aroma pairs dark cocoa with fruity hints of raisin. A chewy flood of malts engulfs the tongue with bitter chocolate and cocoa powder; threads of coffee underscore the sip. Expertly hidden alcohol combines with the sharp malt bitterness for a finish that’s dangerously drinkable for such a hefty beer.

Name: Blatant IPA
Description: Blatant Brewery is proud to present our newest brew: BLATANT Imperial Stout! This one is a winner folks: it’s dark and incredibly bold (what else would you expect from BLATANT?). This is going to be shipping to stores throughout the state immediately, so make sure to support your local brewery and grab some when you spot it!

Name: Cape Ann Fisherman’s Pumpkin Stout
Description: Fisherman’s Pumpkin Stout is a dark stout accentuated by flavors of the Autumn season. Using real pumpkin, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice, the Cape Ann Brewing Company took a fresh take at the common fall seasonal. This rich dark stout offers an inviting pumpkin spice aroma that gives way to the delicate essence of real pumpkin.

Name: Cape Ann Brewing Imperial Pumpkin Stout
Description: 11% ABV, 43 IBU’S    The Big Brother version of our original fall seasonal.  The Imperial is more robust and intense in flavor with a noticeably spirituous finish.

Name: Cape Ann Fisherman’s Pumpkin Stout
Description: Fisherman’s Pumpkin Stout is a dark stout accentuated by flavors of the Autumn season. Using real pumpkin, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice, the Cape Ann Brewing Company took a fresh take at the common fall seasonal. This rich dark stout offers an inviting pumpkin spice aroma that gives way to the delicate essence of real pumpkin.

Name: Cape Ann Brewing Fishermans Brew
Description: Fisherman’s Brew is an American Amber Lager, brewed by the docks of America’s oldest seaport, Gloucester, Massachusetts, from the finest 2-row barley imported from Munich, Belgium and England. At 5.5% ABV and a well balanced 30 IBU’s, this smooth lager offers a toasty malt flavor followed by a dry, hoppy finish.

Name: Emelisse Black & Tan
Description: The Black & Tan is a blend of Imp Russian Stout and TIPA (Double IPA) and is barrel aged on a Isley barrel.

Name: Emelisse Russian Imperial Stout
Description: A dark full bodied Imp Russian stout.

Name: Emelisse Espresso Stout
Description: The Emilisse Stout is enhance by a blend of fine Italian espresso beans used in the brewing process. It boasts a blend of 90% Arabica and 10% Robusta, which combine to give the Emilisse Espresso Stout an extra-spicy, full-bodied palate.

Name: Solace Brewing The Fig Lebowski Stout
Description: Brewed with figs, vanilla, and lactose. Inspired by the “cookie that’s not a cookie,” the Newton.

Name: Solace Partly Cloudy IPA
Description: A double dry-hopped, New England style IPA. Hopped exclusively with El Dorado and Citra. This is our juiciest IPA yet!

Name: Solace Sun’s Out Hops Out
Description: Crisp easy drinking Session IPA. Brewed with Citra and Mosaic hops.

Name: Great Basin Outlaw Milk Stout
Description: Outlaws and gentle folk alike are captivated by this dark beer. It marries the deep coffee-like flavors of roasted barley with a silky texture contributed by rolled oats.

Name: Great Basin Tectonic Event Imperial IPA
Description: An ode to the West Coast style IPA made famous by San Diego breweries. A refreshingly simple malt profile makes way for a highly complex and bitter showcase of what hops can do.

Name: Great Basin White Eye PA
Description: What was once a witbier, has been re-imagined as a Belgian style white IPA. We’ve left behind the traditional spices, and in their place, created a stunning vision of Simcoe, Citra, El Dorado and Centennial hops. The result is an unfiltered, straw colored brew with bright notes of citrus and pine that help get your head out of the clouds and into the light

Name: Great Basin Bitchin Berry
Description: A fruit-forward beer drawing distinctive flavors from a truly generous addition of real berries - never extracts - backed by a palate with hints of citrus, spice, and floral aromas. Bitchin’ Berry boasts an aggressive, full berry flavor and aroma

Name: Masthead Single Origin Coffee Stout
Description: We partnered with our friends at Six Shooter Coffee to bring you this mash-up of our two favorite beverages.

Name: Masthead Sleigh All Day Red IPA
Masthead IPA
Description: Our crushable year-round IPA.

Name: Masthead Brute Force Double IPA
Description: A truly mind-numbing amount of hops are plowed into this beer. A dank and citrusy aroma greets you.

Name: New England Supernaut IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: If there were an astronaut that was exceptional, they would be quite super, correct? Perhaps even a "Supernaut", yes? Maybe even find inspiration in an old, Balek Sabbath song? Sure. And this is a pretty super tasting beer with rich, full passion fruit, pineapple and mixed berry flavor. This all Mosaic hop favorite pops up throughout the year and fits well into any season.

Name: New England Brewing Imperial Stout Trooper
Description: Nearly a dozen types of malts and grains go into this FORCE-full, American Imperial Stout. Hints of coffee, tastes of dark fruit, and a subtle chocolate background make this Stout the perfect brew to welcome the Winter months. Brewed solely during the onset of the colder months, this one-time-a-year release will make you come over to the dark side... of beer.

Name: New England Brewing Sea Hag
Description: A ghostly apparition reportedly skirts the shores of New Haven harbor; a whispy widow eternally searching for her lost-at-sea husband. It is truly a sad tale of loss. But hey! At least she's got a beer named after her, huh? Our flagship beer pours in with a citrus, fruity nose and a crisp floral finish that is well balanced with its Pilsner, Munich, and Crystal malt blend.

Name: New England Brewing G-Bot DIPA
Description: The beer. The 'Bot. The legend. This sought-after Double IPA packs in a whole mess of hops in order to churn out a bombastic citrus taste full of orange peel, mildly dank whiffs of pine, and a deceptively easy-flowing flavor. There's just enough haze in this one to satisfy the "Hops Heads" while it's not to bitter/crazy for first-timers to enjoy this fruity brew.

Name: Vault Black Swan Nitro Russian Imperial Stout
Description: A Russian Imperial Stout with imminent notes of bakers chocolate and cold brewed coffee. This stout finishes with a complex and inviting balance of roasty and bitterness.

Name: Vault Fives Cees IPA
Description: IPA hopped with Cascade, Centennial, Chinook, Columbus, and Citra. Aromas of citrus and tropical fruit with notes of tangerine creamsicle, fresh cut grass, and a lingering hop dankness

Name: Vault All Boats Rise DIPA
Description: A west coast DIPA aggressively hopped with Citra and El Dorado. Aromas of citrus, stone fruit and pear give way to notes of grapefruit zest and tropical fruit with a pleasant lingering hop finish

Name: Vault Trading Futures NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: New England IPA hopped with Amarillo & El Dorado. A serious juice bomb bursting with notes of papaya, peach rings, and overripe honeydew with a subtle yet welcome bitterness.

Name: Offshoot Relax [It’s Just Hazy]
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Relax [it’s just a hazy IPA] embraces the new way to enjoy IPA - unfiltered, fresh and full of hop flavor and aromatics... without the bitterness to stand in the way of kicking back with a juicy beer. It features a combination of Citra, Centennial, Simcoe and Amarillo hops, imparting fruity, tropical and citrusy notes to complement the round, soft mouthfeel of a hazy IPA.

Name: Offshoot Escape West Coast IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Escape into this West Coast IPA any day of the week. Clean, crisp, and clear, this concoction of Mosaic, Strata, Simcoe, and Amarillo hops submerges the senses with notes of tropical passionfruit, grapefruit zest, and pine. Crack one open, kick your feet up, and Escape.

Name: Offshoot Retreat Double IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This hazy DIPA is brewed with a simple malt bill and hopped heavily with fruit-forward Mosaic, Cashmere and El Dorado. Laced with delicate and aromatic tropical notes along with a bright berry medley and a crisp mouthfeel, it’s like diving into the Pacific on a 90-degree day. Seriously, nothin’ beats the heat, like Retreat.

Name: Offshoot Unwind Hoppy Pils
Description: Refreshing and crushable Pils, dry-hopped with Citra, Nelson, Simcoe and Sterling.

Name: Dust Bowl Therapist Imperial IPA
Description: Science will try to tell you that the tongue cannot detect more than 80 bittering units, but this hop centric imperial IPA will not leave you wanting more. So, have a seat and leave your worries to the Therapist.

Name: Dust Bowl Brewing Confused Therapist Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: We applied the Hazy beer processes to Therapist and added Vermont ale yeast for a Therapist with more pineapple and tropical notes and even bigger aroma than the original.

Name: Dust Bowl Brewing Hops Of Wrath IPA
Description: Our flagship IPA uses a variety of hops to create layers of hop flavor and aroma.  Citrus and floral notes are upfront, and an assertive, yet not overpowering, bitterness balances the malt base. This is an easy-drinking IPA for hop heads everywhere!

Name: Dust Bowl Taco Truck Lager
Description: This easy-drinking light lager has a nice mild character. Two-Row pale malt and the use of flaked oats and white wheat give the beer a clean, crisp character with a little sweetness, light body and smooth mouthfeel. Very low bitterness. Easy drinking and satisfying!

Name: Fort Hill Brewery Jigsaw Jazz Double IPA
Description: A bright, citrusy Double IPA with a deceptively light body and dry flavor. To compose this brew, we borrowed techniques used by Belgian brewers to achieve a big beer without much sweetness. The Citra dry hop gives this beer its bright citrus notes and aroma. Draft, Cans

Name: Fort Hill Fresh Pick IPA
Description: Bursting with Simcoe, Citra, and Mosaic hops, our IPA packs a punch of tropical hop goodness in a glass. Even at 7.0% ABV, Fresh Pick is extremely drinkable and refreshing.

Name: Fort Hill Brewery G-Fresh
Description: Our Farmer's Fresh Session IPA gets even juicier with the addition of grapefruit for an extra citrus kick. This brew is light, hoppy, and refreshing - perfect for summer sipping.

Name: Fort Hill Brewery Hoperation
Description: For this brew we tested some new experimental hops and rounded it out with sweet orange peel, as well as Galaxy and Citra hops.  We ended up with a delicious IPA packed with flavors of papaya, passion fruit, citrus and a hint of mint!  This beer has a creamy mouthfeel and a refreshing tropical finish.

Name: River North Mountain Haze
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Brewed with barley, wheat, oats and more than two-and-a-half times the dry hopping in Colorado IPA, Mountain Haze blankets the palate with an avalanche of Citra. Low on bitterness but big on juicy aromatics, it’s a haze fan’s newest obsession.

Name: River North Brewery Fifteener Double IPA
Description:
A West Coast-style double IPA brewed with Simcoe, Centennial and Falconer’s Flight hops, Fifteener represents the next great endeavor in River North’s IPA offerings. While you may be familiar with Colorado’s famed fourteener mountains, this stratospheric double IPA takes it a step further, challenging you to conquer your next summit.

At 10 percent ABV and 82 IBU, Fifteener has all the towering clout of a traditional West Coast hop bomb, but with just enough late-addition hops to give it a nouveau twist. Remarkably dry and crushable, it’s a steadfast companion to your outdoor adventures no matter the altitude.

Name: River North Colorado IPA
Description: West Coast Style IPA

Name: River North Pils
Description: A Rocky Mountain lager for all four seasons. Brewed low and slow, the way it should be. Brewed year-round.

Name: Boomtown Chavez Ravine Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazy IPA brewed with Lemon Drop and Amarillo hops.

Name: Boomtown Brewery Limelight IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Our classic IPA is robust and made with a blend of Citra, Amarillo, and Mosaic hops. Hoppy notes of guava, grapefruit, and stone fruit are balanced with malty caramel tones and a solid yet clean bitterness. Not overly bitter, this is a big beer with big flavors. Tropical fruit and sweet caramel will put anyone in the limelight.

Name: Boomtown Mic Czech Pilsner
Description: The classic Pilsner styles of The Czech Republic and of northern Germany are blended in our version of Pilsner lager to accentuate the best of both worlds. The malt profile is rounded and bready like the Bohemian style but ends clean and dry like the German style. A blend of classic Noble Hops from Czech and Germany combine to create a subtle flowery aroma and a firm clean bitterness. Balance is the key to our fine lager.

Name: Boomtown Bad Hombre Mexican Style Lager
Description: Classic Mexican-Style Lager brewed with pilsner malts, corn, and rice. It’s a traditional German-Style, light, crisp, and clean. Hallertauer Hops add spicy and floral notes common to this style.

Name: Lead Dog Brewing Citra Solo IPA
Description: This nectar is blessed by hop bursting with six massive additions of Citra Hops creating an incredible aroma and flavor consisting of grapefruit, passionfruit and melon. We keep it unfiltered so that you can enjoy it how the brewers intended it to be. With that said, drink it up, keep it cold and enjoy!

Name: Lead Dog Conan’s Wrath NE IPA
Description: Everyone knows Conan the Barbarian was a badass. We created a beer that uses a combination of yeast strains, one being the ‘Conan’ strain. This brew takes right after the man himself. Instead of a fruit forward hazy, we created this hazy to encompass a broad range of flavors and aromas.

Name: Lead Dog Brewing Gnar Gnar Double IPA
Lead Dog Basic Pumpkin Spiced Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: When black cats prowl and pumpkins gleam, may luck be yours on halloween! The best way to feel lucky is by getting into the spirit with this well-balanced pumpkin ale. We brewed it with pumpkin spices and aromatic caramel malts to bring out the holiday season. Don’t be scared to try it. It’s all yours if you buy it!

Name: Masons Rekkr IPA
Description: Unfiltered IPA dry hopped with Topaz and Citra

Name: Mason’s Hipster Apocalypse IPA
Description: A hazy and juicy showcase for the Idaho-7 hop varietal.  Dank and piney with strong tangerine characteristics.

Name: Mason’s Double Hipster
Description: After a year in development, here it is….. Double Hipster a Hazy, Hop forward DIPA.

Name: Morgan Street Virgin Territory IPA
Description: Hoppy, clean with a hint of citrus.

Name: Morgan Street Black Bear
Description: Black Bear has moderate malt flavors that finish clean and sweet, and are balanced out nicely with just a hint of bitterness. It is overall dark, but very pleasantly sweet with no harshness that most would expect from a dark beer.

Name: Morgan Street Golden Pilsner
Description: Gold medal world cup pilsner 2010  Bronze world cup pilsner 2001

Name: Morgan Street Oktoberfest
Description: This classic German lager is noted for its smooth, clean, and rather rich malt character. The maltiness is often described as soft and complex. There is a light to moderate toasted malt aroma that is brought out by its initial malty sweetness, but the beer has a moderately dry finish.

Name: Wayfinder Crusher Destroyer
Description: Cleanly fermented, punchingly aromatic and dry with a weighty dry hop.

Name: Wayfinder Relapse Cold IPA
Description: Plenty brutal IPA with bucketloads New and Old School hops. Wester than West Coast.

Name: Wayfinder Funeral Bock
Description: Double-decocted black bock brewed strongly with Münich and Roast malts and fermented extremely cold with our secret heritage lager yeast and finished with an excessive, hibernative lagering schedule. This iteration of German bockbier is our dirge to the Fall.

Name: Wayfinder Export66 Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: A treat for every beer connoisseur, made with richer malts, alt und Neu-Bavarian hops, and a proprietary lager yeast.

Name: Gun Hill Brewing Beast Coast IPA
Gun Hill Iso Fruited Sour Double IPA
Gun Hill Brewing Company Divided Sky
Gun Hill Mel’s Every Day Beer
Twin Lights House Party
Description: Our limited release House Party is our 6.8% American IPA. This beer is brewed with pilsner, oat malt, and flaked oats in the mash. We used chinook for a touch of bittering and a huge charge of citra & mosaic in the whirlpool, as well as in the dry hop. This results in a full bodied IPA with aromas and flavors of citrus and tropical fruit from the citra along with mixed berries, stone fruit and pine from the mosaic.

Name: Twin Lights Double Vision
Description: Our second core beer is brewed with pilsner malt, oat malt and flaked oats. A small amount of Chinook was thrown in for bittering with a hefty whirlpool addition of Mosaic and Simcoe. Additionally we used copious amounts of Mosaic & Simcoe in our dry hop additions. The final result is a hazy, crushable, juicy IPA.

Name: Twin Lights Coastline
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Coastline is our introductory into the NEIPA style. Brewed with pilsner, oat malt and a ton of flake wheat and oats. We went with a blend of Sultana & El Dorado for our whirlpool and dry hop additions. With over 5.5 lbs per bbl, this hop combination brings our a nice blend of pineapple, citrus, berry, and stone fruit notes. Perfect for an end of summer beach day or a late night bon fire.

Name: Twin Lights Mother Funkie
Description: Our first seasonal release comes in at an easy drinkin' 4.3% ABV. Pilsner and wheat in the mash, little dash of Saaz in the beginning of boil and crushed coriander seed and himalayan sea salt at the tail end of boil. We ferment this with a special house yeast which produces a slightly tart beer with undertones of pineapple and mango. Before packaging we dosed this batch with copious amounts of fresh cucumbers.

Name: Cerebral Brewing Momentum IPA
Description:
The pace of progress can mimic many motions. Sometimes its sudden, like a lane change at rush hour. Sometimes its subtle, like slowly turning up the heat on a pot of water. A boiling by degrees. But don’t fear, we wouldn’t throw anything at you we didn’t think you could handle. This little ditty is singing a song of lemon-lime, gooseberries, melon and, uh, maybealittlebita kiwi yeah?
HOPS: Nelson, Galaxy, Motueka

Name: Cerebral Popular Science IPA
Description: India Pale Ale loaded with Mosaic, Samba, Citra & Simcoe

Name: Cerebral Rare Trait IPA
Description: Modern aroma hops are not bred by chance. Peach, passionfruit, and various citrus notes take years of breeding to produce in a viable plant. We have a huge amount of appreciation for the hop farmers and scientists working towards new and interesting flavors and aromas in the hop market

Name: Cerebral Brewing Rare Treat NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: We took our house IPA and added 280lbs of peach gummy rings & lactose.

Name: Lone Star Lager
Description: Lone Star Beer uses the finest hops from the Pacific Northwest with hearty grains from the Central and Northern Plains. Malted barley and corn extract combine to provide Lone Star with nature's finest ingredients for brewing. Lone Star's ingredients give this beer its full natural flavor. The choicest hops lend complexity and aroma to this beer, and its proprietary mashing regimen creates the perfect balance of alcohol, body, and character.

Name: Lone Star 24/7
Description: Lone Star 24|7 is a deliciously refreshing low-alcohol and low calorie Lone Star beer, coming in a gorgeous golden Lone Star can and bottle. With only 2.1% ABV and 68 calories, it is the perfect beer for day-time drinking occasions in the Texas sunshine.

Name: Heater Allen Marzen
Description: This is our Vienna-style lager--an amber lager with some malt attributes similar to Dunkel, but lighter and clearer. Vienna-style lagers were an early attempt to make paler beers. While the style has largely died out where it started, we enjoy the great balance of malty flavors in this beer.

Name: Heater Allen Schwarz
Description: We recently changed this recipe to drop the smoked malt component to 5% from 8%, and like it even better than the last version. We think we’re back in real Schwarzbier territory now, especially after reading more about the dark beers of old Eastern Europe. The beer’s aroma is malty/espresso, with a hint of smoke. On the palate, malt, chocolate and espresso flavors take center stage, along with a hint of smoke. The sweet smokiness just offsets the more bitter/roasty notes, producing a smooth, rich brew. The hops provide balance, but virtually nothing to the aroma. This is the perfect beer to serve with a barbecued steak or tri-tip. It’s also excellent with just about any chocolate dessert!

Name: Heater Allen Pils
Description: This is our take of the renowned Bohemian-style pale lager that you might find in Bavaria or the Czech Republic. Ours is a little more golden, rounder, and a little more malt driven than many other versions.  The beer possesses strong hop character that is balanced by its rich, round, malty palate.  Refreshing and balanced, this beer is a favorite of our winery friends during harvest. (1.012 FG, 4.9%, 36.6 IBU, 3.6 SRM)

Name: Heater Allen Helles Lager
Description: The harder water in Germany doesn't take well to loads of hops, so the Germans made a less hoppy version of Pilsner that they call "Hell," meaning pale or light in German. This is a smoother, more malt-oriented beer than Pils with just a hint of Hersbrucker hops in the aroma.

Name: DAB Dortmunder Dark
Description: A dark beer of premium-class and most popular in its region: these dark brown to black beers have a mild-roasted malty character without the associated bitterness. As speciality beers, they have a full body with a gently enhanced malty flavour and an aroma with low to moderate levels of sweetness. Hop bitterness is low to medium in character.    Original – incomparably malty flavour – easy to drink. A real delight!

Name: DAB Original Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: Slim and elegant, fine sparkle, full taste.

Name: Asahi Super Dry
Tasting Notes: Crisp, Dry, Fresh, Grainy, Light, Smooth
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Cheese - Stinky, Chicken, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Fruit - Sweet, Lamb, Mushrooms, Nuts, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Tomatoes, Turkey
Description:
Fresh  crisp and clear - with a sharp delivery that slakes thirst before slipping gently on.

When Asahi Super Dry was introduced, it brought an entirely new genre of beer to japan, and then to the world.

Brewed to the authentic Japanese recipe to deliver its dry, crisp taste and quick clean finish, Asahi Super Dry complements all occasions.

Its distinctive taste is known as karakuchi (dry). 

A taste we are dedicated to creating, by using only the finest ingredients and continuously advancing our brewing technology.

Name: Asahi Beer Super Dry
Description: With its refreshing barley flavor and crisp aftertaste, Asahi Super Dry is by far the most popular high-quality beer in Japan.Since its debut in 1987 as Japan's first dry beer, it has continued to improve the taste and excitement ofbeer. Its taste has set a new standard that is acknowledged around the world today.

Name: Asahi Black Kuronama
Description: Production in Japan was stopped in September 2015. If you have a dark Asahi beer after that, it is Dry Black.

Name: Asahi Brewmaster
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager

Name: Carlsberg Danish Pilsner
Tasting Notes: Apple, Crisp, Floral, Grainy, Grassy, Hoppy, Malty, Smooth
Food Pairing: Beef, Chicken, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Sweet, Lamb, Nuts, Turkey
Description:
Carlsberg Pilsner is a premium Danish lager with a 5% ABV. It's a crisp, refreshing, perfectly balanced beer that has a full flavor and hoppy aroma. Carlsberg Danish Pilsner is brewed with the principals learned from over 100 years brewing experience to produce a lager with distinctive citrus and floral hop aromas that delivers great depth of flavor, making it the perfect beer for those that value authentic and quality drinking experiences. That's why at Carlsberg we've been exporting our finest beer since 1869.

Carlsberg originates from Copenhagen, Denmark. J.C Jacobsen, our founder, brewed Denmark's first ever pint using a yeast that became the basis for many modern-day imitations. We Danes love to share, it's in our nature.  In fact, almost all modern-day lagers are derived from the original yeast, Saccharomyces Carlsbergensis, used to brew Carlsberg. Enjoy the perfect pint of Carlsberg at home or in the pub! Can small refinements make a big difference, and create the most balanced pilsner beer in the world? Probably.

Name: Carlsberg Elephant Strong
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bitter, Caramel, Hoppy, Malty, Smooth, Strong
Description: The strong Carlsberg Elephant is a so called light "Bockbier", and was brewed for the first time in 1959. It is vinous and fruity with characteristic taste impressions of apples, melon , banana and Carmel balanced by a dry bitterness. You also sense the hints of oak, bark, roots, nuts and pine. needles.  Once enjoyed, never forgotten!

Name: Carlsberg Danish Pilsner  1/2 Barrel
Tasting Notes: Apple, Crisp, Floral, Hoppy, Malty, Smooth
Description:
Carlsberg Pilsner is a premium Danish lager with a 5% ABV. It's a crisp, refreshing, perfectly balanced beer that has a full flavor and hoppy aroma. Name: Kasztelan Unfiltered
Description:
In the village of Sierpc, the birthplace of natural honest beermaking, they have been brewing beer for over 800 years. Kasztelan is unfiltered, straight forward with honest ingredients for pure enjoyment.  The village itself is everyone’s idea of kind and easy-going, simple, natural way of life that is all too uncommom today. It’s a place where the ingredients that go into Kasztelan are grown and harvested.

Pure natural spring water, barley from local growers, and brewing in a natural, less processed way, make Kasztelan ideal for enjoying relazed times with freinds.

Name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro Pale Lager Beer
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: Peroni Nastro Azzurro is an Italian lager beer. Crisp and refreshing with a subtle citrus aroma, this import beer has a 5.1% alcohol by volume. Light and clean like a pilsner beer, this is a crisp and refreshing European lager with a delicate balance of bitterness and citrus and spicy aromatic notes, combined with a fast and clean finish. Peroni beer has a big personality — bold, spirited, authentically Italian and effortlessly stylish. This case of beer bottles is perfect to share refreshing drinks with friends during all seasons. Peroni Nastro Azzurro is brewed with the highest quality hops (Saaz-Saaz and Hallertau Magnum) that give the Italian beer its balanced aroma, which is light on the palate. With a clean, refreshing taste, it’s the perfect beer for any occasion. Brewed with the same flair and attention to detail through three generations of master brewers, Peroni Nastro Azzurro uses only the finest ingredients.

Name: Crabbie’s Original Alcoholic Ginger Beer
Description: Crabbie's Original is a refreshing, light bodied ginger beer with a spicy fresh ginger flavor, notes of citrus and a warming finish.

Name: Crabbie’s Scottish Raspberry Alcoholic Ginger Beer
Crabbie’s Orange Alcoholic Ginger Beer
Description: Following a secret recipe, the steeped ginger is matured for 8 weeks. Its then combined with real Orange Extract giving a deliciously zesty flavour.

Name: Crabbie’s Cloudy Alcoholic Lemonade
Description: Made with selected squeezed lemons. Offers authentic refreshment - best served cold!

Name: Clausthaler Original Non-Alcoholic
Description: Clausthaler is the inventor of N/A beers. As the pioneer from Germany, Clausthaler has won countless taste awards and shows its dedication to N/A beers with an all N/A portfolio.

Name: Clausthaler Grapefruit Non-Alcoholic
Tasting Notes: Bright, Citrus, Crisp, Fresh, Fruity, Grapefruit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Chicken, Fish - White, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: A perfect blend of Clausthaler Original Non-Alcoholic Beer and Grapefruit Drink made with all-natural grapefruit juice. Clausthaler Non-Alcoholic Grapefruit is the first Grapefruit non-alcoholic blended beer in the U.S. and is the ultimate refreshment for any occasion!

Name: Clausthaler Dry Hopped Non-Alcoholic
Description: Clausthaler is the Non-Alcoholic beer pioneer from Germany. Clausthaler Dry Hopped is the world's first crafty N/A beer. Full-bodied and hoppy with hints of malty caramel, it brings together German craftsmanship, the world’s foremost non-alcoholic brewing technique, and Cascade Hops imported from the USA.

Name: Clausthaler Santa Clausthaler Non-Alcoholic Beer
Description: Santa Clausthaler features a crisp and well-balanced taste of Clausthaler Original premium non-alcoholic beer blended with flavors of cranberry and cinnamon.

Name: Loyal 9 Cocktails – Loyal Lemonade
Description:

Name: Kombrewcha Lemongrass Lime

The good things in life aren’t complicated. And neither is Kombrewcha. We’ve simply crafted a hard kombucha with organic ingredients, refreshing carbonation and brewed it to 4.4% ABV through natural fermentation. 

We set out to create a beverage for those seeking balance in life. Between alcohol and organic ingredients. Between taste and a healthy lifestyle. Between a refreshing drink and a revitalizing get-together. Lemongrass, lime, and citrus combine in a subtle complexity for a refreshing and dry finish.

Name: City Steam The Naughty Nurse
Description: The Naughty Nurse has become quite the popular lady in the Nutmeg State. With her classy and sensual elegance, combined with just the right amount of...ahem...bite, she has made many a friend both inside and outside of our brewpub. Don't let that "come hither" look fool you, though - she is all business when it comes to performance. In fact, she is our best seller! If the Nurse needs a match, it can be a nice beefy burger, or almost anything else on a pub style menu. And with her moderate alcohol content, she can stand alone and make your next Session last a long, long time! This fine ale is brewed for a spicy, slightly bittersweet finish using traditional English malt, hops, yeast and manners. Available short or tall, of course!

Name: Hi Sign Brewing Christie Blonde Ale
Oak Creek Hefeweizen
Description: This traditional unfiltered wheat beer won a Gold Medal in the 22nd annual Great American Beer Fest in Denver, cialis CO.  It is made with up to 50% wheat malt instead of all malted barley which lends a lighter note. lt is deep gold in color with a very low hop bitterness level and a dense head of white foam. This Munich style, German wheat beer is medium bodied, with a traditional banana & clove aroma. It pairs well with German Weiswurst (white sausage) or lighter fare like salads, seafood or sushi.  It is traditionally enjoyed as the summer beer of choice in Bavaria.

Name: Lumberyard Flagstaff IPA
Description: This is a heavier bodied ale with a higher bitterness. The blend of several varieties of American Hops make this copper colored ale especially pleasing for pale ale lovers. Prominent hop aroma with citrus and floral notes. Hop emphasized with a firm bitterness accented by a subtle malt sweetness.

Name: Alexander Keith’s IPA
Description:
Brewed slowly using select malted barley, and our 
finest nugget and zeus hops, Alexander Keith's 
India Pale Ale is mildly bitter with subtle notes 
of black liquorice.

Name: Alexander Keith’s Red Amber Ale
Description:
Crafted from three varieties of barley and the choicest 
hops, this full-bodied amber ale balances sweet caramel 
flavours with spicy notes.

Name: Alexander Keith’s Premium White
Description:
An unfiltered ale with a refreshingly crisp finish, 
Alexander Keith's Premium White features notes 
of coriander and cinnamon.

Name: Outer Light Lonesome Boatman
Description: Like a good fishing vessel, our even-keeled amber ale exemplifies quality and balance. Bready, toasty specialty malts impart a hint of tangy sourdough, backed by the spicy and floral flavors of Cascade,and Goldings hops. Chart your own course with one of our most complex offerings. 30 IBU; Hops: Magnum, East Kent Goldings, Cascade; Malts: Pale, Caramel, Brown, Blackprinz

Name: Outer Light Libation Propaganda Coffee Stout
Description: A specialized blend of locally roasted whole bean coffee and chocolaty American roasted barley make our smooth, velvety coffee stout a treat for both beer and coffee lovers. Supplying a different type of jolt, this delightfully aromatic brew is propaganda worth sharing. 5.5%, 31 IBU; Hops: Perle; Malts: Pale, Caramel, Black, Roasted Barley, Oats, Blackprinz

Name: Outer Light Cloudbreak Double IPA
Description: Our Double IPA features light malt and a hazy appearance that suddenly yields to bright, big hop flavor. Pacific hops impart notes of papaya, berry and black tea with an enticing tropical fruit aroma. One sip will part the clouds and lead you to the summit of flavor. 8.5%, Lots of IBU; Hops: Idaho 7, Mosaic; Malts: Pisner, Oats, Carapils, Acidulated

Name: Homestead Tenpenny Amber Ale
Description: Our house Amber Ale, Tenpenny Ale balances sweet, caramel malt with a mildly bitter, fragrant hop nose. Underneath those flavors lurks a powerhouse yeast that contributes the classic ale ester profile rather than the too clean flavors in modern beer. Tenpenny Ale is unpasteurized and never filtered, it’s beer the way it was intended to be.

Name: Homestead Galactic Heroes IPA
Description: To honor one of our favorite bands operating in one of our favorite genres of music we created the happiest beer we could imagine. Erupting with West Coast IPA notes of grapefruit, juicy orange and lemon, this towering beer lays it down thick and heavy without being a palate wrecker. With a subtle balance of sweet and alcohol to balance out all the hop notes it’ll put a big old smile on everyone’s face.

Name: Homestead Pioneer Ohio Pilsner
Description: The Germans have as many variations on the Pilsner as we do on the IPA and this one is a real classic – designed to conform to the Reinheitsgebot this Pilsner starts bitter and finishes clean. The all-German malt bill and all-German hops combine to create a beer as close to Germany as you can get without getting on a plane.

Name: Red Truck High Trail Amber Ale
Red Truck Hard Day Northwest IPA
Description: Northwest IPA
