Oaken Barrel Red Ale
Description: Oaken Barrel's accolades include the critic's choice award from Indianapolis Monthly for the "Best Brewpub in Indy". The chefs take pride in the quality and creativity of their specials. Ask about the daily food and beer specials on your next visit.

Name: Circle Envy Amber
Description: Envy is the perfect balance between malt and hops. Not too dry nor too sweet, it is a full-bodied and complex beer without being overly heavy. The dried fruit notes derived from rich and earthy British malts and slightly higher fermentation temperatures conjure flavors reminiscent of an old-world ESB. Compare it to the last amber you had and you'll know why we call it ENVY.

Name: Circle Blur Texas Hefe
Description: Blur is a unique blend of traditional Bavarian styling with a little Texan ingenuity. This Texas twist on the German wheat beer brings a hint of caramel to a crisp and refreshing style. The citrus aroma plays off the light and creamy body to create a beer that has no rival whether you enjoy it in the sun or in the shade.

Name: New Albanian Black & Blue Grass
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: New Albanian Black & Blue Grass is a spiced Belgian ale with blue agave nectar and spices.  This medium-bodied, fruity and spicy beer is excellent with all kinds of food.  Available on draft and in 22oz. “Bomber” bottles.

Name: New Albanian Hoptimus
Description: Color: Tawny golden. Flavor: Full bodied, with aggressive hops and noteworthy bitterness.

Name: Franconia Seasonal
Description: Varies by season.

Name: Brew Hub Diver Down Red Ale
Description: This is an imperial red ale brewed with two-row caramel Munich barley and Magnum and Williamette hops. The beer is a rich, malty ale with a ruby-red hue and a thick, frothy head of foam.

Name: Brew Hub Rome City IPA
Description: This IPA. packed with the juicy goodness of hops, is an homage to our flagship brewery in Lakeland, Florida. The town, most known for its 38 lakes, royal swans and endless citrus groves, was at its founding almost named Rome City. No one really knows why. So here's a beer to celebrate what almost was, for a reason no one knows. Cheers!

Name: Shannon Irish Red
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red

Name: Hilliard’s Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Simple beer, complex taste and aroma. A special yeast and unique fermentation profile give this beer hints of coriander, orange peel, and maybe a bit of pepper. Castle Malting Pilsner Malt and Golding Hops, no spices added.

Name: Hilliard’s The 12th Can
Description: BEER  LIST    The 12th Can    Amber Ale    Saison    Blonde    Pils    BOOMBOX IPA    Chrome Satan    Murdered Out Stout    Original Singe    Oak Aged Saison    OMG Cookies    E.xtra S.pecial B.elgian    The Fino Countdown    Opulator Doppelbock    Spirit Animal Series: Suffering Bastard Saison  THE 12TH CAN  Before the start of the 2013 football season, Sports Radio 950 KJR asked for a local beer dedicated to the fans and we answered with a session pale ale we call The 12th Can. From the the first game to the last, it was an amazing ride for Seattle fans far and wide, and The 12th Can was there for all of it.  We think the perfect game-day craft beer can’t be dumbed down in taste or ingredients, but it shouldn’t be so over the top you need to switch to something lighter after only one. We brew it with Cascade Hops (C Hops!) to produce a beer unmistakably NW in flavor and super drinkable from beginning to end. Pairs well with victory.

Name: Ross Shrewsbury
Description:
Our flagship lager is inspired by the river that runs to the south of our hometown of Red Bank—the scenic Shrewsbury. Low in bitterness and high in malt character and complexity, the subtle use of hops makes a balanced, refreshing lager with a crisp, dry finish, perfect for drinking on a boat, a beach, a deck, or just about anywhere!

Pair Shrewsbury with sausage and pork dishes, spicy jalapeños, gruyere cheeses, chicken of all kinds, barbecued meats, and nutty desserts.

Name: Ross Passaic Honey Porter
Description: Our honey porter is inspired by the Passaic River—a hard-working beer; a hard-working river. Brewed with organic Monmouth County-grown wildflower honey and fermented with Madagascar Bourbon vanilla beans and Peruvian cacao nibs, this is a dark, rich, creamy, flavorful treat.

Name: Ross Navesink IPA
Description:
Our flagship ale is inspired by the river that runs alongside our hometown of Red Bank—the mighty Navesink. Brewed with 8 varieties of hops, fermented with grapefruit, and double dry-hopped to perfection, Navesink IPA presents notes of apricot, citrus, peach, and mango for a tart, fresh, juicy hop bomb!

Pair Navesink with grilled fish, spicy tacos, juicy hamburgers, curry dishes, and hot wings, gorgonzola or cambozola cheese, carrot cake, and fruit salad.

Name: Backwoods Copperline Amber Ale
Description:
Backwoods Brewing pulls all of its water used in the brewing process from Bear Creek in Carson, Washington, one of the freshest water sources the natural region has to offer. 

Floral and sweet on the nose with hints of strawberries, on the palate there are notes of honey, malt and caramel. This is balanced out by a slightly bitter finish. Showcases hyper-local ingredients.

Name: Backwoods Blueberry Wheat
Description: We balanced out the blueberry, providing a pleasant aroma, but not an overpowering taste. Not bitter, but not too sweet, this is the Goldilocks of fruit beers!

Name: Backwoods Blueberry Wheat
Description: We balanced out the blueberry, providing a pleasant aroma, but not an overpowering taste. Not bitter, but not too sweet, this is the Goldilocks of fruit beers!

Name: Crooked Mcswagger’s Own Amber Ale
Description: Pours a reddish-copper-brown hue and evokes fruity ale aroma, mild citrusy hops and balancing, toasty, toffee, nutty malts.

Name: Crooked Can Cloud Chaser Hefeweizen
Description: Brewed and cellared just how they would in the mother country, this German wheat beer has voluminous fruit and spice characters to be experienced in smell and taste.

Name: Crooked Can High Stepper IPA
Description: Citrus forward multiple hop addition ale with a full flavored clean finished - at 7% ABV and 90 IBUs, this American IPA is a step up from the average. The High Stepper has a golden chestnut color with well balanced malt profile. The hop notes are larger than life with citrus, floral aromas and flavors. This beer exhibits a personality all on its own with seven hop additions, and will impress the most discerning hop head.

Name: Cadejo La Roja
Description: Aromatic, with good balance of hops bitterness and swetness of caramelized malts

Name: Cadejo Hija de Pooh
Description: Smooth flavor of light malts and dry finish, unique aromas provided by the use of tropical honey

Name: Cadejo La Mera Belga
Description: Citrusy of orange peel with strong aroma and taste of camomille flowers and coriander

Name: Mispillion River Holy Crap!
Description: Holy Crap! evolved by accident, when our brewer blended two different styles of beer. After months of digging for the recipe, we learned: you can’t suppress a brewer’s gust instinct. This 9.0% ABV Imperial Red Ale leads with a strong malt body and finishes with the dry bitterness of a 65-million year extinction. Hold on to your butts!!!

Name: Mispillion River Reach Around IPA
Description: Let’s face it, everyone loves a Reach Around…IPA and at 6% ABV, this beer goes down easy.

Name: Mispillion Not Today Satan IPA
Description: Even Hell is looking for more diversity these days. That is why a lot of folks claim Billy, from Human Resources, was appointed the new Lord of Darkness. Like Billy, this beer is a little unexpected. The unholy joining of El Dorado, Centennial, Columbus, Cascade, and Mosaic hops and 7.3% Alc. by Vol. leaves souls begging for a drink of water. Not today, Satan. Not today.

Name: Gun Craft M4 Amber Ale
Description: This Amber Ale is brewed with premium pale, amber malts ans lightly hopped for a robust, balanced malt-focused flavor. It's lightweight with modest alcohol and extremely easy to imbibe, so you can enjoy all day long just like the rifle of freedom it's named after.

Name: Gun Craft FAL Belgian Style Black Ale
Description: Gun Craft Belgian Style Black Ale is just as smooth and refined as the rifle it;s named after. This Belgian Style Black Ale is made black, but smooth and refined using roasted malts (Midnight Wheat) that doesn't create the bitter notes of most heavily roasted malts. The refined nature of this beer, its subtle Belgian yeast character and malt notes that impart slight cocoa along with roast coffee flavors.

Name: Gun Craft Tactical American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This American Pale Ale is brewed with the highest quality malt and hops blended to a precise caramel malt character. A clean bitterness from the US Magnum hops, delicious Citra hop flavors and aromas of grapefruit, melon and lime. This is a brew that won't back down and will keep you standing your ground.

Name: Urban Legend Elizabeth
Description: A light bodied Red Ale brewed with Delta hops. Delta, is a cross breed of Fuggle and a Cascade variety. Earthy, slightly spicy with a hint of citrus this Red Ale brings a twist to the traditional Red Ale.

Name: Urban Legend Brewing Co. Mugshot
Description: Black with some chocolate brown appearance. Head dissipates quickly. Nothing jumps out flavor wise. Not overly alcoholic which is nice.

Name: Urban Legend Scaylla’s Grasp
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Scyllas Grasp is a American Pale Ale (APA) style beer brewed by Urban Legend Brewing Company in Westmont, IL.

Name: Rivertowne Maxwell’s Scottish Ale
Description: The Maxwells have made the art of brewing a family tradition for centuries. This Scot comes alive, as five different varieties of malt create a deep, surprisingly smooth finish. Intrigued? Go ahead and lift its kilt!

Name: Rivertowne Suburban Housewife Kölsch
Description: Kölsch Brewed With Blackberries & Cucumbers. A traditional German ale with a nontraditional twist. Fermented at cooler temperatures, this beer has a crisp finish that is accentuated by the blackberries and cucumbers. Nothing is too over the top in our new go-to session beer.  Time to take the kids to soccer practice!

Name: Rivertowne Hala Kahiki
Description: A beer so enticing you may think it's nectar from the gods. The name "Hala Kahiki" (hahlah-kah-hee-kee), originates from the Hawaiian words for pineapple. Feel the way it rolls off your tongue? Our sweet and refreshing beer will take you away ...have a sip ...grab a lei!

Name: Second Chance Mulligan Amber Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: Smooth caramel malt notes and light, earthy British hops combine for an easy drinking, malty red ale.

Name: Second Chance Beer Company Tabula Rasa Porter
Second Chance Clever Hoppy Name Pale Ale Beer
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Refreshing, fruity dry hop flavors from Mosaic and Citra. Crisp, clean pale malt. Tropical fruit flavors of passionfruit and papaya with a hint of tangerine.

Name: Country Boy 4th Anniversary Imperial Red Ale
Description: An imperial red ale aged in sherry casks with blackberries.

Name: Country Boy Nacho Bait
Description: Cougar Bait blonde ale brewed with fresh habanero peppers.

Name: Reinaert Amber Ale
Description: A guaranteed original amber beer, by the fermentation in the bottle, this beer has a pleasant taste evolution, a beer for connoisseurs.

Name: Reinart Wild Ale
Description: Fermented three times with two different yeasts, including a strain of brettanomyces - the "wild yeast" of lambic brewing. Pale golden color with an enormous rocky white head. Brett and spicy aromatic notes, with a malty-juicy note on the palate. Finishes with Brett and dry hop notes. April 2003 selection - Michael Jackson’s Rare Beer Club. 94 points - World Beer Championships

Name: SoCal Black Bear Porter
Description: SoCal Black Bear Porter has a dark, heavy, extremely flavorful finish with remnants of chocolate and coffee flavors balanced by a generously hopped aroma.

Name: SoCal Seismic IPA
Description: SoCal Seismic IPA is our California rendition of the popular English India Pale Ale. Abundance of English and American hops create a big, bold and aggressively hopped beer that is so intensely smooth, it will knock you off your feet.

Name: Death Valley Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Death Valley Desert Pale Is a classic pale ale made with lots 2-row malt and hopped with clean Cascade hops from Yakima Valley. If you're a fan of California Pale Ales; you going to love this beer!

Name: Indian Wells Orange Blossom Amber Lager
Description: Our salute to Belgian style fruit Lambic beers, with a distinctly Californian twist. We add select parts of whole oranges at precisely the right point to our amber recipe beer, and the result is this magical, orange sweet beer we call Orange Blossom Amber. This brew is crafted with only natural ingredients, specially malted barley, our proprietary yeast strain, and pure spring water from our historic Indian Wells Spring.

Name: Pig Minds Brewing Death Grip IPA
Description: Lovely American IPA brewed with Maris Otter base malt and centennial and citra hops. This IPA was brewed for the IBU enthusiast! 100IBUS....Cheers and pucker up for the hop wave that resides on your tongue well after you have finished your beer!

Name: Pig Minds Sweep The Leg IPA
Description: West coast IPA brewed with galena, simcoe and citra hops for all the hop heads. Pucker UP!

Name: Refuge West Coast Red Ale
Description: The West Coast is known for massively hopped citrus-forward hopped IPAs. A typical Irish-Style Red Ale is a balance of mildly toasted malts. Both styles are great in their own right, but together, they can be something special. So, we took our well-loved Rampart Red Ale and dry hopped it with a pound of Cascade hops per barrel! The Cascade hops blend notes of floral grapefruit with the light toasted flavor of the red malts for a beer that's incredibly well balanced. The core recipe behind West Coast Red dates back to the first weeks of Refuge, and it's always been one of our favorites.

Name: Refuge Blood Orange Wit
Description: This beer is the freshest to taste and the easiest to drink among others we offer, and it has also happened to be the best selling one. By using over 200lbs of fresh blood oranges in every batch, we came up with a beer that explodes with flavor yet balances its sweetness with just a pinch of tartness. It is this balance combined with an extraordinarily light wheat body that makes this brew perfect for any occasion, any time of the year!

Name: Chilero Brunette
Description: Dark amber in color with a rich, creamy head and a slightly sweet finish. Perfect for barbecues, tailgating or any occasion that calls for a medium dark beer with a bold, refreshing taste.

Name: Chilero Gold
Description: The new gold standard for a superior quality Central American import beer. Crisp, clean, refreshing taste that goes down smooth with or without a lime wedge. Whether in the sun at the beach or with friends at the bar, Chilero Gold adds next level chill to any occasion.

Name: Chilero Michelada
Description: A Central American staple, Chilero Michelada combines the crisp golden goodness of beer with the refreshing, flavorful blend of tomato juice, lime juice, salt, pepper and spices. Savory, tart, spicy and all around delicious.

Name: Athletic Brewing Run Wild Non-Alcoholic IPA
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Hard Aged, Chicken, Cured Meats, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens
Description:

The ultimate session-able IPA. Perfectly balanced and brewed with all organic malt and a blend of five Northwest hops. The approachable bitterness and classic piney, citrusy aroma blend perfectly with the subtle, yet complex malt profile. Run Wild IPA stands shoulder to shoulder with the best full- strength IPAs in terms of taste and has the awards to prove it.

Name: Athletic Brewing Upside Dawn Non-Alcoholic Golden Ale

Description: <0.5% ABVRefreshing, clean and balanced. This light-bodied golden ale is brewed with premium organic malts from the US & Germany paired with a combination of English and American hops that add earthy, spicey and citrusy character. Upside Dawn stands shoulder to shoulder with the best full- strength Golden Ales in terms of taste and has the awards to prove it.Crafted to remove gluten, and lab tested to under 10 ppm.

Don’t let anything slow you down this season. Go All Out!---------Summer - Cerveza Atletica Mexican LagerCerveza Atletica is a refreshing Mexican Light Copper Lager, perfect for summer. The brew has a light copper hue with an aroma and flavor of delicate bread crust and golden treacle that are balanced with light spicy and floral notes from the noble hop, German Hersbrucker.PLEASE INDICATE YOUR CHOICE IN YOUR CART NOTES AT CHECKOUT

Name: Wynwood Brewing La Rubia
Description: Coming from a big Puerto Rican family, my dad and I live for family get-togethers and backyard barbecues. We wanted the perfect beer for those occasions so we crafted la rubia with only the finest ingredients. It’s not a lager and it’s not a pilsner. It’s a blonde ale. Light-colored, sunny, easy drinking y con sabor.

Name: Wynwood Brewing Pop’s Porter
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Pork
Description: Pops was retired when I said, “hey Pops, let’s start a brewing company.” His response? “Make me a beer I can enjoy when I’m grilling and then we can talk.” Of course I hit him with a rich, chocolaty, malty beer and named it after him. Now you can find him at the brewery sharing stories and his dark porter. He’s pretty proud of its GABF® gold medal too.

Name: Wynwood Laces IPA
Description: Paying homage to the streets of Wynwood, Laces is an ipa ready to enjoy with your neighborhood crew. Like the shoelaces that have been tied together and thrown over power lines, our brew ties together a mix of mosaic, amarillo and falconers’ flight hops and finishes clean with citrus and tropical fruit notes. Just like the many reasons people throw shoes over telephone wires, laces is a brew to be enjoyed on many occasions, from your daily grind to a night out.

Name: Begyle Brewing Tripel Stamp
Description: Like other abbey ales, Tripels are strong, yeasty-malty beers. But they are also pale, and have a notable hop profile. Hop bitterness may be higher than a typical ...

Name: Begyle Brewing Zeus
Description: Don't Bring Me Down, Zeus is a true style double IPA that has a malt backbone big enough to balance the excessive hop profile and alcohol warmth. Heavily hopped with Bravo, Glacier, and Zeus.

Name: Ballantine XXX Ale
Description: The world famous three ring sign (Purity, Body and Flavor) has been used since 1879, making it older than any Motorcycle, Escalator or drinking straw. When you are ready to revel in history and enjoy one of America’s finest Ales, reach for a Ballantine and enjoy its flavorful body and taste that no other beer can provide.

Name: Ballantine Ale
Description: Ale in nature, Ballantine touts an elevated alcohol level of 3.80% by weight and 4.85% by volume, all for the purpose of accommodating its hefty bitterness and aromatic hop character.

Name: Ballantine IPA
Description: With a deep golden to amber color, Ballantine India Pale Ale is delightful to behold after a lively pour in its characteristic “tulip” pint glass, with a strong foamy head. At 7.2% ABV and with 70 IBUs of bitterness, this refreshing brew is unique among IPAs in that it has been both dry hopped as well as includes hop oils imported directly from the United Kingdom in order to capture the balanced but defined hop flavor of Peter Ballantine’s original brew. Originally aged for over a year in oak barrels, our innovative proprietary brewing method ensures that every drop of Ballantine IPA comes in contact with American oak.    First introduced in America in the late 1800s, Ballantine IPA was a beer for connoisseurs. It has been credited as an inspirational influence for the present day craft beer revolution in America. Handcrafted by our master brewers, this delightfully hoppy brew resurrects its deep heritage and storied past to embody an IPA worthy of the original Ballantine name. For well over a century, the interlocking Borromean Rings showcased on our label have come to signify Purity, Body, and Flavor, just like the delicious Ballantine India Pale Ale inside. We hope you enjoy it.

Name: Raleigh Brewing Company Hell Yes Ma’am Belgian Golden Ale
Description: Hell Yes Ma’am is fruity, spicy, pleasantly warming, & dangerously drinkable. This beer is bursting with elements of pear, apple, bubblegum, & pepper. Mid-palate you’ll find a delicate grainy sweetness that finishes clean & spicy, warming you up as it goes down.

Name: Raleigh Brewing Coffee Hidden Pipe Porter
Description: Robust and bold, this ale is brewed with locally roasted coffee from Oak City Roasters, resulting in flavors of cocoa, creamed coffee, espresso, molasses, and dark fruit; a perfect everyday sipper for those colder evenings with friends.

Name: Raleigh Brewing The First Squeeze American Wheat Ale
Description: Citrus is the name of the game with this effervescent American Wheat beer. We add 2 lbs of blood orange peels into every batch for a refreshing blast of orange character. You can’t go wrong with one of these in the hot North Carolina summer.

Name: Steadfast Golden Blonde Ale
Description: Flavorful, aromatic, satisfying... things you’re probably not used to saying about the Gluten-Free beer in your fridge. Steadfast Golden Blonde Ale is a whismiscal yet complex refresher of a beer. Brewed with a Belgian yeast and lightly spiced for a citrus aroma, this ale lives where quality and flavor intersect.

Name: Steadfast Sorghum Pale Ale
Description: Flavorful, aromatic, satisfying... things you’re probably not used to saying about the Gluten-Free beer in your fridge. Think again! Steadfast Sorghum Pale Ale is our Gluten-Free take on a quintessential American beer style. Made with sorghum, molasses, invert sugar, and an aggressive hop profile, this ale lives where quality and flavor intersect. Thank you for your support - you have ours. Together, we’re Steadfast!

Name: Steadfast Pumpkin Gluten Free
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Flavorful, aromatic, satisfying...things you're probably not used to saying about the Gluten-Free beer in your fridge. Think again! Steadfast Pumpkin Spice Ale is our festive Autumnal offering that drinks wonderfully with food or on its own. Brewed with pumpkin and a complex blend of spices, this ale lives where quality, flavor, and the SPIRIT of the season intersect. THANK YOU for your support - you have ours. Together, we're STEADFAST

Name: Infusion Vanilla Bean Blonde
Description: Our crisp Blonde with Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla Beans. Made with 2 row, Crystal 10, Crystal 20 with Saaz, and Tettnang hops.

Name: Infusion Pistachio Porter
Description: We thought a nice, rich brew was in order during the colder months. Brewed with English malts and a generous amount of cocoa powder.  This beer is warming and full bodied. As the brew warms, the chocolate character and sweetness rolls out of the top of the glass.

Name: Infusion Radial IPA
Description: Is our way of the thanking the West Coast for providing us with an incredible IPA. This Brash beer is light in color and packed full of hoppy goodness. With over 22 pounds of American hops, this should please even the craziest hophead.

Name: Angel City Brewery IPA
Description:
The City of Angels: a big city, filled with big characters who come up with really big ideas. So what happens when you need to create a beer that captures the spirit of LA?

You go big. Angel City IPA: It’s big. It’s bold. It’s got lots of character and it embodies Los Angeles like no other.

A medium-bodied, copper-hued beer brewed with enough hops to satisfy. It’s the perfect treat for the hop inclined.

Name: Angel City L.A. Blonde
Description: Brewed to honor the passion and diversity of the City of Angels, L.A. Blonde is a bright, golden-hued, easy-drinking ale that’s as unpretentious as it is sessionable. We take pride in our city, just as much as we take pride in our beer. We are L.A.

Name: Angel City Sunbather Session Sour Ale
Description: Soak in the sour. Imbibe in the hops. Drink in the sun! Introducing Sunbather, a session sour ale dry hopped with Citra hops. The result is refreshingly tart and juicy. It’s the perfect beer to enjoy while soaking up that California sun.

Name: Blacklist Golden Ale
Description: Easy drinking, approachable, malt oriented American craft beer, often with interesting fruit, hop, or character malt notes. Well balanced and clean, is a refreshing pint without aggressive flavors.

Name: Blacklist Finally IPA
Description: Sometimes waiting makes things better. Finally stretching our west-coast-wings, we introduce you to our California-yeast cousin. Bright, fresh hop notes with minimal malt to get in the way of your alpha-acid fling. So squint your eyes, look straight at the sun, ‘cause the only sense you need for this affair is your tastebuds.

Name: Blacklist CraHazy
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Mother Road Tower Station IPA
Description: Parched motorists on Route 66 anticipated hospitality at Tower Station, opened in 1936. This unfiltered India Pale Ale greets you with a copper-orange hue and fluffy white head, releasing aromas of tangerine and pineapple. Pilsner and Pale malts balance hop-derived flavors of grapefruit peel and pine to finish the journey.

Name: Mother Road Conserve and Protect Golden Ale
Description: Cheers, you're a hero for wildlife! For every can of Conserve and Protect sold, Mother Road Brewing Co. will donate a portion of the proceeds to the Arizona Game and Fish Department to help with on-the-ground conservation of more than 800 wildlife species. Learn how you can help at AzWildlifeHero.com/join.

Name: Lost Highway Imp Black IPA
Description: Lost Highway Imperial Black IPA is a robust imperial IPA that balances the malt characteristics with 100 IBUs of bitterness and finishes with roast and coffee flavors from the Black Patent malt. This big, balanced beer drinks smoothly.

Name: New Planet Blonde Ale
Description: Perfect for year-round enjoyment—think of our Blonde ale as your go-to rafting, camping, and skiing companion. This approachable beer is easy-going, refreshingly light and crisp, with subtle hints of citrus.

Name: New Planet Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Our Pale ale is full of bright, citrus fruit flavors with a balanced hop character. This beer feels at home at the top of a 14er, at the finish line of your latest triathlon, and at your backyard cookout. Brewed with Bravo, Cascade, and Falconers Flight hops.

Name: New Planet Raspberry Ale
Description: Raspberry Ale is an award winning ale with the right balance of fruit flavor and aroma. Made from sorghum, corn extract, natural raspberry puree, orange peel, hops, and yeast. Not overly sweet, the Oregon grown fruit puree creates a beautiful body color with a natural raspberry flavor.

Name: WarPigs Foggy Geezer IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: All the sickest LDACs dig this crazy new style. Super fruity and dank with a firm bitterness. Citrus, peach and tropical fruit aromas. Draft and cans.

Name: WarPigs Four Phantoms Blonde Ale
Description: Ethereal American Blonde ale rising triumphant from the daily trials of monotony. Intense citrus, tropical and stone fruit character from start to finish

Name: WarPigs Salmon Pants Lager
Description: Collaboration with Mikkeller and Three Floyds

Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Golden  Blonde Ale

Name: Brasserie Caracole Troublette Wheat Ale
Description: A Blanche de Namur style wit/blanche with a nose and taste so heavy on citrus wheat and fine, sour wit yeast.

Name: Brasserie Caracole Nostradamus Belgian Brown Ale
Enki Victoria’s Gold Cream Ale
Description: This cream ale is delicate, virtuous and light-bodied. The mild and toasty malt base is perfectly balanced with subtle hops that hint at the flavors of stone fruit. The mouth feel is wonderfully creamy with a satisfying dry finish.

Name: Enki Cacao Porter
Description: Like Grandma’s semi-sweet chocolate chip cookies hot from the oven, CACAO’s aroma is irresistibly tempting. The tightly-laced tan head and dark brown color invites your palate to experience CACAO’s richly smooth texture and creamy dark chocolate flavor, giving way to a clean, earthy hop ending.

Name: ENKI Tail Feather IPA
Description: This beer pours a brilliant goldenrod color and carries a long lasting, silky head. A hefty blend of classic Pacific Northwest hops gives this beer the iconic bitterness IPA drinkers have come to expect. A juicy burst of pummelo and fresh cut flowers excite the palate, thanks to dry hopping process. Deliberately unbalanced to delight hop-craving aficionados we use just enough malt to give a full body and smooth mouth feel. The bitter finish lingers on long after drinking.

Name: Bowen Island Reef Break Hemp Blonde Ale
Description: Light, refreshing and full of flavor. This hemp infused blonde ale is medium-bodied with a creamy mouthfeel, light floral aromas and caramel notes with a subtle hemp finish.

Name: Bowen Island Twisted Trail Pale Ale
Description:
Hand-crafted in the traditional style, this Pale Ale has just the right combination of malt and hops. It was inspired by the hopped beers of the Cascadian region. Brewed with 45 IBUs of Pacific Northwest hops, it's a well-balanced beer with a brilliant copper colour and deliciously malty body. 

Pair this Pale ale with smokey and sharp cheeses, grilled meat, mexican dishes and buffalo wings.

Name: Bowen Island Deep 6 Lager
Description: This North American style lager has been aged slowly to enhance its malty, slightly sweet character. Creamy at the beginning, followed by a slightly malty sweetness on the back of your tongue. This easily drinkable lager has a clean and crisp finish

Name: Lucifer Golden Ale
Description: Lucifer entered the market in the mid 1980s under the label of Liefmans breweries. It was an extension to the popular segment of strong, blonde beers. After Liefmans Breweries disappeared, Lucifer fell into the hands of our neighbours and friends Duvel Moortgat. However, they only wished to concentrate on Liefmans’ fruit beers. Lucifer was in danger of dying a silent death. But we didn’t let it get that far, our conscience couldn’t allow this to happen. Het Anker received the right to produce and commercialise Lucifer. May we roast in hell if it doesn’t follow the success of our own beers!

Name: Lucifer Belgian Ale
Description: LUCIFER    INTRODUCTION     Lucifer entered the market in the early 1980s under the label of the Riva brewery. It was an extension to the popular segment of strong, blond beers. In 2009, brewery Het Anker obtained the right to brew and commercialize Lucifer.    Lucifer is a strong, blond beer (8.0%) with a gold yellow color and creamy white head. Its fruity aroma with subtle notes of bitter hops, followed by a long and perfectly balanced finish, will definitely seduce you!

Name: Lucifer  Het Anker Belgian Golden Ale

Name: Sycamore Brewing Southern Girl Blonde Ale

Name: Sycamore Brewing Mountain Candy IPA

Description: Hop-bursted and double dry hopped, juicy flavors of stone fruit and rainbow candy with notes of citrusy dankness.

Name: Resident Perky Blonde Ale
Description: She’s a perky classic American blonde ale with a slightly sweet finish that is sure to have you coming back for more. Medium dry, crisp, malt forward, did we mention perky?

Name: Resident Urbanite IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: West Coast IPA heavily hopped with Mosaic, Simcoe and Amarillo hops. Dry American IPA with a heavy-hop aroma/flavor consisting of melon, tropical fruit, pineapple and grapefruit notes.

Name: Resident Chasing Citra IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Single hop Citra IPA

Name: Twisted X Gulf Kolsch
Description: This Kölsch-style blonde is made with a blend of the finest European and Domestic malts for a smooth taste and clean finish.

Name: Twisted X Chupahopra
Description: This is a full flavored IPA with a pronounced hoppy finish that is created by adding Amarillo (when available) hops at the end of fermentation. This ale, the only ale in our lineup at the present time, will withstand the long voyage to your local bar or refrigerator. With an alcohol by volume of 7.5%, as our friend Polo would say, "Asusta me one time!" (Scare me one time).

Name: Saltwater LocAle
Description: Our version of an all day beer that has a smooth Honey Biscuit finish to it. Perfect for the beach, boat, or yard work

Name: Saltwater Sea Cow Milk Stout
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel
Description: Named after our native Florida Manatee, the Sea Cow, who resides in the murky brackish waters of Florida. This milk stout has notes of roast and smoke that is balanced by the sweetness from the lactose used in the boil.

Name: Saltwater Passion Pit Fruit Beer
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Sweet, Shellfish
Description: Passion fruit flavored Golden ale

Name: Sunup Bearded Blonde Ale
Description: Our Blonde has a nice bready cracker malt aroma with lemon peel, citrus hop nose, derived from Cascade and Falconer’s Flight hops. The flavor mirrors the aroma creating an easy drinking pale malt flavor and slightly floral and citrus hop bitterness.

Name: Sun Up White Russian Imperial Coffee Stout
Description: This big boy, is the big brother in our portfolio with huge coffee, bittersweet chocolate, dark caramel, roasted grain, vanilla, sweet cream & dark fruits, like plum, raisin & prunes. The flavor is a huge burst of rich coffee & cream and dark unsweetened chocolate. The fruitiness from the dark roasted malts brings in the flavors of stone fruits & creates a full almost chewy mouth feel and plenty of body. The big alcohol of this brew creates nice alcohol warmth. Along with being a desert all by itself, White Russian will pair well with big flavored foods like duck, venison, wild turkey, goose, aged cheeses like Gouda, Parmesan or sharp cheddar. If dessert is more to your liking, pair with dark chocolate truffles, chocolate cheesecake, chocolate raspberry mousse cake or a double chocolate chip cookie. Yum!

Name: SunUp Trooper IPA
Description: Copper colored, with a strong hop aroma of grapefruit, citrus, even pine (in addition to the hops bitterness). Medium malt flavor is present resulting in a crisp, dry beer with balanced character. We brew the Trooper IPA because we like hops! And lots of them! This is currently our best selling brew.

Name: Braxton Storm Golden Cream Ale
Description: The storm rolled in, and we rushed into our garage, family and neighbors alike, chased by the coal-black clouds slinging lightening bolts like grinder sparks. Seemed like whatever the day brought, we never strayed far from that garage. It was the hub of our early lives, a haven, the place we learned how to sharpen a mower blade, how to tell the truth, how to help your neighbor. We also learned how to brew beer here. In fact, the Storm you’re holding was first brewed in our garage, during the relentless backlash of Hurricane Sandy. We take immense pride in offering you a cold sip of this golden cream ale, a dream that started in a small garage, and like a storm, grows with unrelenting power.  A traditional American lawnmower beer, this golden cream ale features a medium body with a creamy palate feel. The aroma is a balance between subtle corn and malt-like notes with a very slight earthy and spicy hop presence. Pale straw in color with brilliant lightning-like clarity, Storm makes a great session beer being low in alcohol and bitterness, but complete with flavor. However, unlike the typical cream ale, no DMS or harsh corn like aroma is present.

Name: Braxton Dead Blow Stout
Description: In the Midwest, there are certain things you can count on. Like hard work, hot summers, and the love a father feels for his family. We’re serious about these things here. That’s why our dad was never too busy to put down his hammer, sit with us on a red dusk night, and share a story or two. And we loved those times. The thing was, dad wore the years of patina on his face and knew it was just part of his job. So in honor of those dads, we call this deep tropical stout Dead Blow, to remind ourselves that hardness and goodness sometimes go together.  Dead Blow is a Tropical version of the Foreign Extra Stout. Eighty pounds of macerated dates made its way into this brew, partnered with a Dry English Ale yeast to provide a vibrant fruity/tropical aroma with a slight amount of fruity esters. The Dry English ale yeast helps this beer attenuate lower, however leaving a residual sweetness on the finish as well as increase the fruity characteristic received from the Dates. Dead Blow is a dry, roasty, fruity, full bodied, smooth stout, that is lighter on bitterness.

Name: Braxton Revamp IPA
Description: Revamp is an easy drinking American IPA that brings forward notes of tropical fruit flavor with a bright citrus flavor.

Name: Troubled Monk Golden Gretz
Description: This Red Deer streetscape as seen through the lens of a Troubled Monk glass highlights the transition from the old to the new. The past to the present. The deja vu to the downtown view. Savour the future you're helping to create as our Golden Gaetz glides effortlessly out of your glass.

Name: Troubled Monk Pesky Pig Pale Ale
Description: Pesky Pig Pale Ale celebrates both the rambunctious favours of hops and the wild spirit of Francis the Pig, who escaped his fate at a local slaughterhouse in 1990. Malts quietly tame the bitterness of hops to let the hop favour dominate in a crisp, citrusy pale ale. Pesky Pig starts with the fresh favour of grapefruit and finishes with undertones of papaya and tropical fruits. Its subdued bitterness makes it easy to drink and the perfect choice for lighter meals.

Name: Troubled Monk Troubled Tea
Categories: Hard Iced Tea, Specialty Beer  Alternatives
Description: Gluten free spirit, low in sugar and steeped with real tea. Its refreshing taste is sure to please anyone looking for a real tea taste. This is Alberta’s Hard Iced Tea!

Name: Barley Island Sheet Metal 6Nr
Categories: ALE, Golden  Blonde Ale, Wheat Ale
Description: Brewed with wheat, malt, and a hint of spice, Just beneath its smooth, soft surface lies a beer with a shot of real personality.

Name: Barley Island Brass Oatmeal
Description: Full-bodied, smooth, mealy texture from the oats, rich, malty, complex flavor from the dark grains, black color, rich creamy head.

Name: Barley Island Barfly IPA
Description: Our American IPA has an intense hop aroma and flavor. The hop character is citrusy, floral, and fruity (orange/grapefruit) from the use of Summit hops. The complex malt flavor profile supports the strong hop flavor. BarFly is a continuation of our tavern theme. Every tavern has its share of barfly’s - people who visit frequently.

Name: FiftyFifty Brewing Co Donner Party Porter
Tasting Notes: Bold, Chocolate, Coffee, Earthy, Malty, Nutty, Rich, Roasted, Sweet, Thick, Toasty, Tobacco
Description: Donner Party Porter is one tasty porter that will get you through the harshest winter. This complex pint’s flavor profile includes hints of oatcakes, molasses, smooth rich dark chocolate, mocha, and espresso. That, my friend, is what we call a robust, almost historical porter and why we say “your friends never tasted so good!”ABV: 7.2%Goes best with: Any cold, desolate evening where you need your good friends, good food, and a good beer to get you through.Find your balance...in the wilderness.

Name: FiftyFifty Brewing Co CAPA Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bitter, Bold, Bright, Citrus, Fresh, Fruity, Grapefruit, Hoppy, Smooth
Description: Here is our hat tip to the timeless and tasty West Coast Style Pale Ale, which offers a fantastic floral aroma, bursting with hop character. Citra hops dance around your palate on this easy-drinking, pale ale. An exceptionally smooth, medium-bodied malt finish rounds out this deliciously drinkable pale ale. ABV: 5.4%Goes best with: Smooth and perfect to drink with Fish Tacos after a Standup Paddle session on the lake, or whenever you crave a classic pale ale.  Find your balance...on the lake

Name: FiftyFifty Brewing Co Totality Imperial Stout
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bold, Chocolate, Dark Fruit, Fresh, Leather, Malty, Mocha, Nutty, Roasted, Silky, Smooth, Strong, Sweet, Thick, Toasty, Tobacco, Velvety
Description: Everyone has their price. For some, it’s measured in dollars, for others, it’s measured in powder days. For those that have the gift of passion for the dark side, it’s measured in pints of Totality Imperial Stout. Dark brown to black in color, and nearly opaque, Totality has a velvet-like mouthfeel, moderate hints of dark dried fruit, espresso beans, and dark chocolate, with just a hint of hop bitterness striking the perfect balance. Welcome to the Dark Side, friends. ABV: 9.9%Goes best with: A crisp, cold starlit evening with good friends, good food, and a little bit of dark mischief. Find your balance...on the Dark Side.

Name: Michael Waltrip Two-Time Blonde Ale
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Pasta, Salads  Greens
Description: Light/Clean/Refreshing Flavorful. A bright and clean Blonde Ale with hints of honey, tangerine and passionfruit. Bright yellow with a frothy head and nice clarity. A crisp and clean finish and zesty carbonation.

Name: Michael Waltrip Two-Time Checkered Past Coconut IPA
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Hard Aged, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: This is a full bodied IPA with a tropical nose highlighted by coconut and pineapple with light citrus zest in the background. Toasted marshmellow and graham-cracker sweet malt notes take a back seat to bright tropical fruit flavors and lingering smooth coconut. Clean finish and moderate but balanced bitterness.

Name: Michael Waltrip Two-Time Vamanos Mexican Lager
Description: This is a clean and crisp international pale lager with hints of sweet grainy malt and light floral hop aroma from the use of fine noble-hops. Very light-bodied and clean with brilliant clarity and a refreshing carbonation

Name: Lamme Goedzak
Description: A full-bodied blond ale for true beer fans who don't fear robust hoppy bitterness

Name: St. Sebastiaan Dark
Description: Dark top-fermented abby ale brewed according to the purity law of 1516.

Name: Scheldebrouwerij Hop Ruiter
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Hop Ruiter (Hop Rider) has a full, almost rustic malt body, and pairs Belgian yeast-driven flavors with American assertive hoppiness. It is dry hopped, with two noble varieties which add complexity, delicacy and a bit of funk.

Name: Solemn Oath Lü Kölsch
Description: A Great American Beer Festival medal winning Kölsch. Light-bodied and exceptionally sessionable.

Name: Solemn Oath Snaggle Tooth Bandana
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A massive Citra hop-driven grapefruit, pineapple, and ripe mango aromatic burst out of this medium-bodied West Coast IPA. 6.5% ABV.

Name: Solemn Oath Butterfly Flashmob Belgian IPA
Description: Copious amounts of piney, citrusy American hops make a light malt sweetness their bitch in this full-flavored Belgian IPA. Aggressive bitterness, massive hop flavor and super fruity Belgian yeast.

Name: Reissdorf Kolsch
Description: Reissdorf Kölsch is the beer speciality from Cologne with a tradition starting 1894. A Kölsch with a pleasant, full-bodied, and uniquely light and sweet taste in premium quality, that is brewed for the adepts who prefer something special.

Name: Reissdorf Kolsch Single
Description: Reissdorf Kölsch is the beer speciality from Cologne with a tradition starting 1894. A Kölsch with a pleasant, full-bodied, and uniquely light and sweet taste in premium quality, that is brewed for the adepts who prefer something special.

Name: Revolver Brewing Blood and Honey
Description: A local U-Pick farmer down the road from the brewery dropped by with a bucket of crystallized honey and asked us if we could do anything useful with it. Brewmaster, Grant Wood inspected the honey and the beautiful color reminded him of blood oranges which were in season at the time, and the amazing aroma brought him back to a previous desert recipe he made – blood orange sorbet with graham cracker and spice. This was the foundation of his inspiration for the blood honey beer. An unfiltered deep golden ale made with malted two-row barley and wheat. This American beer is finished with blood orange zest, Texas honey and other spices that bring special flavors to this unique craft beer. This blood and honey beer is ready for all seasons. Drinkable for summer picnics, full flavored for fall tailgating, subtly spicy for holiday treats, and refreshing for warm springtime events.

Name: Revolver Backyard Bee Kolsch Honey Ale
Description: An extremely pale ale with a clean, crisp finish. An addition of honey to the boil gives complexity to the beer's subtle fruit character without adding sweetness. This beer is light and fruity with a dry finish and a hint of honey with 4.5% ABV.

Name: Revolver Hop Device Hazy IPA Beer
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: With hot temperatures and long days in the country-side, we wanted to brew a Hazy IPA that was full of aroma and flavor without tongue-curling bitterness on the finish. We utilize Cryo Hops®, a cryogenic hop-processing technology that separates lupulin from the hop cone, which allows us to provide an intense tropical hop aroma and dial-in a hoppy smooth flavor with low bitterness and dry finish.

Name: Fairwinds Siren’s Lure
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Fairwinds Howling Gale IPA
Description: West Coast-style IPA. Massive kettle additions and a double dry-hop process with Simcoe, Mosaic and Citra hops bring this brew to an explosion of tropical and citrus aromas and flavors.

Name: Centerpoint Brewing Blood Orange IPA
Description: With the use of Amarillo and Simcoe hops, plus blood orange fruit (similar to grapefruit), this IPA has a slightly sweet and refreshing flavor. Just a touch of bitterness makes this a great introductory IPA! Voted "Best Indiana Beer" by NUVO, and "Best Local IPA" by IndyStar!

Name: Centerpoint Brewing Gold Kolsch
Description: A light and refreshing craft beer, perfect for pizza night, mowing the lawn, and ballgame victory celebrations.

Name: Centerpoint Brewing Black Porter
Description: A big, dark, chocolaty ale with a touch of sweetness. Black with ruby highlights and a tan head, often enjoyed with a marshmallow.

Name: Land Grant 1862 American Kolsch Ale
Description: In 1862, President Lincoln signed the Morrill Act into law, giving the American populous the opportunity to seek a higher education. It called and provided for one great state university in each state of the Union and inadvertently led to tailgate parties, marching bands, fight songs and Bowl Games.As Justin Morrill proposed to put a degree in the people’s right hand, the Land-Grant Brewing Company seeks to put a quality beer in the left. Our 1862 Ale –a dry-hopped American take on the classic German beer– combines the crisp clean flavor of German malt with the aromatics of its American hops.

Name: Land Grant Glory American Wheat Ale
Description: Brewed for, and with the help of, the passionate supporters of Columbus Crew SC. Glory is an American Wheat Ale brewed with Citra hops. The result of two separate test batch tastings and election results, the soccer faithful of the Capital City settled on this refreshing hoppy wheat. Glory to Columbus, indeed.

Name: Land Grant One Goal, One Rye’d
Description: One Goal, One Rye’d is brewed in support of cancer research. This Rye Pale Ale offers up a bit of spice from the malt that pairs nicely with notes of lemon and grapefruit. $1.00 from each six pack sold ­and $1.00 from each taproom goes directly toward Pelotonia’s goal of ending cancer once and for all.

Name: Riggs Hefeweizen
Description:
This Bavarian style wheat beer is brewed with wheat that is grown adjacent to the brewery in Urbana. Balanced notes of banana and clove define this classic style.ABV: 5.2%
IBU: 11
Grain: Riggs grown Wheat Malt, 2 Row, CaraHell
Hops: Magnum

Name: Riggs Citraweizen
Description:
Citraweizen's recipe is based on our Hefeweizen, but we lightened up the color a bit and dry hopped it with a whole bunch of Citra hops. True to their name, Citra hops give this beer a citrus aroma and flavor that pair perfectly with our wheat beer's traditional banana character. Citraweizen is the ideal beer to help you beat this Illinois summer heat.ABV: 5.3%
IBU: 12
Grain: Riggs-Grown Wheat Malt, 2 Row, Carafoam, Acidulated
Boil Hops: Magnum
Whirlpool Hops: Citra
Dry Hops: Citra, Cascade

Name: Riggs American Lager
Description:
A classic, double mashed, American Lager brewed with Riggs-Grown 6 Row Barley and a special variety of low-oil white corn.

ABV: 5.0%
IBU: 17
Grain: Riggs grown 6 Row Barley Malt, 2 Row, Riggs grown Low Oil Corn
Hops: Magnum, Crystal

Name: Hellbender Bare Bones
Description: Bare Bones is a traditional German-style Kolsch ale, light and crisp with just a hint of hop character for a clean, refreshing sip every time.

Name: Hellbender Southern Torrent
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A rich, golden Belgian farmhouse ale with a thick, white head. It finishes crisp and dry with hints of peach and pear.

Name: Hellbender Ignite
Description: Complex, yet light malt bill lets the hops shine through with earthy resin and citrus notes from a healthy dose of Nugget, Columbus, Centennial, Citra and Ekuanot hops.

Name: Seven Stills Kolsch
Description:
A clean and crisp, balanced beer that showcases Perle as a single aroma and flavor hop. The 15 minute and 30-minute addition adds bitterness and spice as well as a touch of mintiness in the finish. Finally, you’re greeted with a white grape ester that lingers after your sip.

You’ll find this beer more bitter than our Slo Flo Pilsner. That’s because our Kolsch yeast is a high attenuator! The bitterness delicately lingers into the finish and is balanced by the carbonation and pilsner malt. This beer drinks fast and easy and is perfect for the dog days of summer.

Name: Seven Stills ‘Five Pounds’ IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: An IPA for the modern pallet. Five Pounds is our core IPA, and it’s about as hazy and juicy as it gets! The flavors you get from Five Pounds are bright and tropical, heavily reminiscent of fresh squeezed orange juice, mango’s, guava… you name it!  It’s everything people want from a hazy IPA, but without having to stand in line for 4 hours. An everyday drinker that’s a cut above the rest. Five Pounds is not only always available, but because we do small packaging runs, it’s always fresh too!

Name: Seven Stills Caviar Dreams IPA
Description: Caviar Dreams is a Brut IPA in collaboration with Social Brewery (SF). Light, bright, yellow, straw/hay colored. Light bitterness from hopping, spicy, aromas of rose, perfume, floral. Finishes very dry.

Name: Zywiec Lager
Description: Filtered. Jasne Pelne signifies full pale lager.

Name: Zywiec Porter
Description: This excellent stout, brewed in Zywiec since 1881, is a brew for connoisseurs. Its flavor and health-giving properties have been known and appreciated by generations of beer lovers.

Name: Lefty’s Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Lefty's simple approach to crafting well balanced brews was inspired many years ago by his first brew recipe, this Pale Ale.  Cascade hops and a variety of malts strike a fine melody, leaving you with hints of citrus and a refreshingly clean finish.

Name: Lefty’s Chocolate Oatmeal Stout
Description: A delicious blend of organic cocoa nibs, oats, and grain creates a silky smooth stout with a rich head and a touch of cocoa lingering in the aroma and the finish.  This crowd pleasing brew is a fine complement to both dinner and dessert.

Name: Turtle Swamp Orange Line
Description: Our New England IPA and our beloved flagship beer.  Yes...this is the citrus bomb New England style IPA, that the good people of JP have demanded.  Orange Line is named after the iconic train of JP and features a unique variety of Citra hops that gives a unique orange citrus quality to the aroma and taste.   This is a silky smooth ale with strong citrus aromas from the crazy triple dose of dry hopping of our Citra variety in the hop back and all throughout fermentation.   Take the Orange Line to Turtle Swamp's taproom and try an Orange Line IPA...the ride is worth it.

Name: Turtle Swamp JP Porter
Description: A full bodied, and full flavored Porter. Strong notes of chocolate and coffee, but without the strong roast trending to burnt notes of more traditional porter. The secret is a Chocolate Rye Malt from Valley Malt in Hadley, MA. It gives color, spiciness, and a hint of sweet chocolate, and doesn't get too dark in the process.

Name: Iron Horse Mocha Death
Description: A dark beer with a huge espresso nose – so big you can taste it. Pure cocoa and all the complexity of our Irish Death rolled together with the aforementioned coffee notes to dole out a highly enjoyable slap in the face. irish death + cocoa + espresso. [you’re welcome]

Name: Iron Horse High Five Hefe
Description: Our take on an American Wheat Ale, this beer has less grainy flavor and notable zesty, citrus presence. The aroma is slightly floral and has a touch of sweetness. Please spare this beer the embarassment and leave the fruit on the plate.

Name: Iron Horse Send It Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This pale ale knows how to crank. It’s a highly drinkable, middle-tier abv beer with moderate hop intensity but full sendability. Made with Citra™ and Comet Hops and comes in at 45 IBUs.

Name: Põhjala Porcini
Description: A salted Baltic Porter brewed with Porcini mushrooms and smoked malts.

Name: Pohjala Oo Xo
Description: A special version of the Öö, aged for months in Cognac barrels.

Name: Põhjala Cherry Banger
Description: Imperial stout with cherries, chocolate and vanilla pods.

Name: Cycle Brewing Roadtrip Anything but Breakfast Maple Barrel Aged Imperial Stout
Cycle Crank IPA
Description: Single Hop Citra IPA

Name: Wild Ride Nutcrusher Peanut Butter Porter
Description: We love beer. And we love peanut butter. And Nut Crusher Peanut Butter Porter is here to bring the best of these two worlds together! With notes of chocolate and caramel, this porter is complemented by the addition of creamy peanut butter flavor. It's a true liquid peanut butter cup, and it's here for you to enjoy.

Name: Wild Ride Journey to Planet Fresh Hop
Wild Ride Electri-Fly IPA
Description: Prepare to lift off and experience an IPA that is sure to excite! Electri-Fly IPA showcases a blend of premium two-row and honey malts, which lay a perfect perch for the addition of hops. Flown in from the southern hemisphere, the unique hops are used to give this beer a pleasant flavor and aroma of tropical fruit. These select ingredients will exhilarate at first taste, and deliver a satisfying experience as you prepare to land.

Name: Les Trois Mousquetaires Porter Baltique
Description: Gamme Grande Cuvée. Unlike typical porters, our Baltic Porter is brewed in the traditional style as a bottom-fermenting lager. The result is a luxuriously round, but robust, black beer with a mild bitterness. A special blend of roasted malts provides this porter with flavors and aromas of chocolate and coffee, and you’ll enjoy it’s subtle hints of cherry-smoked malt.

Name: Hors Serie Gose
Description: Safe German-inspired beer brewed according to the "sour mash" technique, with a lightly salted brewed water flavored with coriander seeds and partly roasted. Malts: pilsner, malted wheat, raw wheat, malted oats. // German-inspired sour-ale, using the sour mash technique, slightly salted brewing water, flavored with partly roasted coriander seeds. Malts: pilsner, malted wheat, white wheat, malted oats

Name: Les Trois Mousquetaires Doppelbock Cuvee
Description: This Doppelbock, or "Double Bock", is a dark, extra full bodied lager after the best Bavarian tradition. Such beer was created by monks for the tough fasting period of Lent. They called it "liquid bread". Look for flavor notes of chocolate, candied fruit and roasted malt.

Name: Old Ox Black Ox
Description: A robust rye porter with hints of coffee and chocolate nicely balanced with a subtle hop influence. A substantial, malty ale, complex and flavorful with a medium body and a slightly roasty finish. The rich dark color is deceptively refreshing. The spice in the rye clears the palate. A sip will explain why we say this is a delightful combination of sweet and spicy!

Name: Old Ox Alpha Ox
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Meet Alpha. Amazing hop character, satisfying malt backbone, smooth finish. Light malt sweetness give way to dazzling citrus and pine hoppy goodness...you know you want to try it. Don't overthink it. Just drink it. Cheers!

Name: Old Ox Hoppy Place IPA
Description: Hoppy Place IPA! Our interpretation of a West Coast style IPA! Very hop forward and deliciously unbalanced. Pine and citrus notes ride the wave of Centennial, Amarillo and Citra hops culminating in a delightfully dry finish. A pint of this will surely take your to your Hoppy Place! Westward Ho!

Name: Renaissance Elemental Porter
Description: A rich, full bodied brew with plenty of dry, dark chocolate and roasty malt flavours which gradually give way to a cleansing hop-driven finish.

Name: Renaissance Craftsman Chocolate Oatmeal Stout
Description: Craftsman is our Chocolate oatmeal stout. To brew it we add a proportion of organic oatmeal to the mash for a velvety smooth mouthfeel. and plenty of dark roasted coca nibs to the mash,boil and fermentor. The result is a rich, intense stout with notes of dark chocolate that gradually gives way to a subtle hop finish. With malt, coffee and chocolate flavours, Craftsman pairs well with any dessert, or match it with hearty fare such as venison and beef.

Name: Renaissance Voyager IPA
Description: Designed first and foremost to be served on beer engines and in the future as a cask or bottle conditioned ale, this beer is inspired by the boldly hoppy Ales of old that were exported from Britain to the furthest corners of her vast and glorious empire, Voyager I.P.A. is a rich satisfying Ale with an emphatic hop bite.   It is brewed with pale ale malt from Canterbury, and small additions of European specialty malts to yield a malt base on which to build its hop edifice.

Name: City Lights Coconut Porter
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Coffee, Mocha, Nutty, Roasted, Smooth, Tobacco, Vanilla
Food Pairing: Dessert - Fruit, Nuts, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: Bright pleasing malt character cradled in a soft, cushiony, smooth mouthfeel.  Notes of coffee, chocolate, nuttiness and aromatic toasted coconut are accentuated with Madagascar Vanilla Beans.  Very well-rounded yet bursting with flavor; this is a great anytime porter.

Name: City Lights Mosaic Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This powerful version of a mid-western pale ale sweeps the palate with mango, lemon, citrus, tropical fruit and stone fruit. This multitude of flavor sinks deep into the taste buds, briefly clinging to the roof of the mouth which enlivens the palate and adds zest. Flowery citrus notes dominate by mid-serving, masterfully integrating with the patina of delicate bitterness that finishes with a 5.3 ABV smoothness. The palate cleansing hop character comes courtesy of Mosaic and Ekuanot hop varieties from the Pacific Northwest. A knockout, clean and forcefully unique pale ale that will keep you coming back for more!

Name: City Lights Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Massive late additions of Citra, Mosaic, and Amarillo hops give this beer a strong tropical aroma and flavor. A simple grain bill of 2 row base malt, wheat, and flaked oats give this beer a beautiful full body; and the high protein content contributes to a pleasant haze. To further accentuate the tropical flavor and aroma we double dry hop this beer with Vic Secret hops. Vic Secret is a newer aroma hop out of New Zealand characterized by its strong tropical fruit flavors and aromas. Even with the massive amount of hops we use this beer comes in at only 35 IBUs; low in bitterness but huge in hop flavor. 7% ABV.

Name: Elder Pine Brewing Tropic Chaser Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Saison fermented with Pink Guava, Passion Fruit, and Blood Orange.

Name: Elder Pine Niveous Dunes
Description: Classic American IPA

Name: Franziskaner Hefe-Weissbier
Description: This medium-bodied wheat beer possesses soft notes of banana and clove spice with a twist of refreshing citrus flavor. Pairs well with sausages and other red meats.

Name: Franziskaner Hefe-Weissebier Dunkel
Description: Deep and dark colored, cloudy with yeast. Brewed with a darker roasted malt which adds some maltiness to the refreshing flavour of the Hefe-Weissbier.

Tasting Notes: Apricot, Citrus, Flavored, Floral, Fresh, Fruity, Light, Peach, Silky, Smooth, Velvety

The stylish 11.2oz blue bottle and premium taste make 1664 Blanc the perfect partner in shared moments of joie de vivre. Name: Kronenbourg 1664 Lager
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Blue, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Pasta, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Tomatoes
Description:
Kronenbourg  1664 Lager is  the most sold French beer in the world and the market leader for high-end premium beers. ​ It was named after the year the Hatt family, the founders of Kronenbourg, first started commercial brewing. ​Kronenbourg 1664 is a 5% ABV Lager that is the fifth oldest beer brand in the world that still exists today.

It’s golden hues and delicate bitterness come from selecting the best hops, the ‘Strisselspalt’, and the unique know-how of Kronenbourg’s master brewers for over 300 years. ​Strisselspalt is also named the caviar hops by the expert master brewers around the world for its low bitterness and aromatic qualities. Its specific soil and culture technique requirements make it rare and quite unique to the Alsace Region and Kronenbourg recipes. 1664 Lager is perfect for special moments, a meal on the terrace or whenever you feel like giving yourself a special treat.

Name: Julius Echter Hefe-Weissbier
Description: Pours a caramel brown color with a small off white head. Smells of wheat, banana, clove, yeast and dark malts. Tastes of Wheat and dark malts with a hint of clove and banana. The malts taste of caramel and raisins. Highly carbontated mouthfeel. Easy to drink .

Name: Julius Echter Hefe-Weissbier Dunkel
Description: Julius Echter Hefe-Weiss Dunkel comes from Germany with an ABV of 4.9%. It pours a caramel brown color with a tall frothy head. Its aroma is sweet and malty with clove scents mixing with hints of wheat. The taste is an excellent balance between sweetness and bitterness, with banana and wheat tones.

Name: Konig Ludwig Weissbier
Description: Royal Bavarian Hefe-weizen. Naturally cloudy Wheat brew. 12.5°

Name: Konig Pilsner
Description: König Pilsener was the first German premium Pilsener beer to gain widespread acceptance wherever quality of the highest order sets the standard. No other brand combines success and excellence as perfectly as König Pilsener.    The finest, carefully selected ingredients and the knowledge of generations of the best master brewers provide the basis for the success of the unique taste of König Pilsener.

Name: Konig Pilsener
Description: The king of the beers - Unique in the taste. The Premium-Pilsener of highest quality.

Name: Celis White Belgian Witbier
Description: This isn’t just any Wheat Beer, it’s the legendary one, first brewed by world-renowned Belgian Brew Master, Pierre Celis, in 1965. This signature witbier sparkles with remnants of Coriander and Orange Peel, that will take you back to the true taste, the first taste, made famous by the legendary “Father of Witbier”.

Name: Celis Citrus Grandis IPA
Description: Kissed with citrus, our East Coast IPA transports you from typical to tropical. Made with the finest Azacca hops, the zesty Caribbean-inspired brew hides juicy citrus aromatics in its hazy golden depths. It's full-bodied, it's refreshing, it's bliss in a beer. Welcome to Citrus Grandis.

Name: Begyle Birds Series IPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Headlands Brewing Hawk Hill Hefeweizen
Description: Hawk Hill follows a traditional German Hefeweizen grain bill with a bit of rye tossed in to draw out the pepper and spice notes from the light hopping schedule. Named after the slope that rises from the Golden Gate Bridge and welcomes you to the Headlands, Hawk Hill will quench your thirst whether you drove, rode, ran or hiked up for the view. Light, crisp, and refreshing, Hawk Hill will bring out the sun, no matter the weather.

Name: Headlands Brewing Hill 88 Double IPA
Description:
Hill 88 is our double IPA and all double IPAs are not created equal. Ours has an all malt backbone that lends a touch of sweetness to an assertive hop profile. And we use a unique hopping technique called Omakase-style hopping. Hill 88 is named after one of the highest spots in the Headlands where the Nike missile launch pads still sit. We might have had one or two beers up there back in the early days. Maybe.

Hops: Omakase!
Grains: 2-Row Malt, Pilsner Malt, Pale Ale Malt & Rye Malt

Name: Headlands Point Bonita Pilsner
Description: The Point Bonita Lighthouse has been guiding ships through Bay Area fog for over 150 years. It won't help you see better, but our Bohemian Pilsner might open your eyes (and taste) buds a little. Rustic grains, noble hop character and body; yet light crisp and refreshing. Cheers!
