Name: Entitled Wit & Wisdom
Description: Wit & Wisdom is the second beer from Entitled Beer Co. This Belgian Style Witbier is crisp and refreshing with a kiss of sweetness. Along with a zesty lemon flavor that continues throughout the experience, you will also enjoy lively carbonation with a hint of spice.

Name: Brasserie Dieu Du Ciel Hibiscus
Description: The Rosée d’Hibiscus is a soft spoken wheat beer. The rose colour comes from the hibiscus flowers added during the brewing process. The aromas and flavour of this tropical flower are very prominent in the beer, giving it a slight acidity and a very agreeable fragrance. It is the perfect thirst quencher on a hot summer day.

Name: Brasserie Dieu Du Ciel Hibiscus
Description: The Rosée d’Hibiscus is a soft spoken wheat beer. The rose colour comes from the hibiscus flowers added during the brewing process. The aromas and flavour of this tropical flower are very prominent in the beer, giving it a slight acidity and a very agreeable fragrance. It is the perfect thirst quencher on a hot summer day.

Name: Estrella Damm
Description:
Mediterranean lager brewed in Barcelona with barley malt, rice and hops. Made with 100% natural ingredients using August K. Damm's original recipe from 1876.
Golden with amber tones and some greenish reflections. It is clean, and bright. Its head has a raw color and is long-lasting. The bubbles, fast-flowing, are fine and abundant. Its scent of fresh spices is enveloping. The roasted notes give personality to the end perception. The taste is smooth as its fizz is integrated and carries dense notes of toasted cereals to the palate. The vividness of its acidity makes it imminently fresh. The bitterness at the end of the taste gives it a lingering after-taste.

Name: Daura Damm Lager
Description: In 2006, Damm's Master Brewers together with the Gluten unit of the CSIC (Spanish Upper Council for Scientific Research) pioneered the development of a celiac-friendly, full-flavored beer. Since then, Daura has been recognized by prestigious internationals competitions as the world’s most award-winning crafted to remove gluten beer.

Name: Inedit Damm
Food Pairing: Beef, Salads  Greens, Chicken, Lamb, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Pork, Tomatoes, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Root Vegetables, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried
Description: Inedit is crafted by Ferran Adrià and Damm's Master Brewers since 2008. It is made from two kinds of beer: barley malt and wheat. It is specially conceived to accompany, with the utmost respect, the new gastronomy cuisine, full of contrasts and aromatic nuances. Inedit is flavored with spices, which confer it singularity and make it special and unique. This wheat beer or white beer is Witbier-style, originally from Belgium and is characterized by being brewed with unmalted wheat. The fact that it is made using unmalted wheat makes the beer more full bodied and increases the sensation of volume and smoothness in the mouth. Inedit was created to combine with a multitude of culinary creations, even the most complicated ones based on citric fruits and bitter components. Splendid with starters, salads and fish dishes with a fatty texture, its versatility also allows it to be combined with bittersweet and hot-spicy sensations. A very dynamic beer that perfectly harmonizes with the whole palette of flavors.

Name: Mama Bear’s Poma Packin’
Description: Poma Packin’ uses a bolstered wheat ale with a neutral palette and blends it with the rich flavors of black tea and hints of nature’s favorite antioxidants, pomegranate and acai berry. The fruitiness of the berries complement the spice and richness of the black tea to provide the ideal counterbalance of tart and sweet. Poma Packin’ is a light and refreshing offering from Mama Bear’s Brew that tastes good anytime, anywhere.

Name: Mama Bear’s Brew
Description: Mama Bear’s Brew is a simple blend of wheat ale and sweet black tea. The body of this ale has been aptly bolstered to compliment the light sweetness and aroma of this finely blended black tea, creating a flavor that is creamy with a tinge of honey.  It is a unique and refreshing combination that goes down smoothly. We just keep asking ourselves, is it beer or is it tea?

Name: Mama Bear’s World Peach
Description: World Peach, by Mama Bear’s Brew, is the latest blend to delight the palate. The black tea used in this delicious combo of wheat ale and black tea is straight from Southern India and steeped in the pure, fresh water of the Rocky Mountains. The wheat ale, though hardy, maintains enough lightness to permit the essence of peaches, taken from organic peach juice, to shine through. The aromas of this blended wheat are in perfect balance to create the experience you’ve been looking for.

Name: Noble Rey Golden Rey Dandy Bavarian Wit
Description: An ALE that's very pale and at times cloudy in appearance due to it being unfiltered and the high level of wheat that's used in the mash. This beer has complex array flavors ranging from banana, clove, tropical fruit, to pepper corn. The crispness and slight twang comes from the wheat and the lively level of carbonation.

Name: Noble Rey Tactical Combat Firefighter IPA
Description: East Coast IPA, small batch

Name: Noble Rey Sex In A Canoe
Description: If you have been made love in a canoe, then you know it is done really close to water...this American Light Lager is our take on the style with a craft twist.

Name: Haverhill Field Guide
Description: This brew just landed in-store last week, and we were excited to try it after falling hard for The Tap Brewing Company’s Intergalactic Acid Berlinerweisse.     The latest release from the Haverhill, Mass-based brewery is “brewed in the style of traditional farmhouse ales from the French speaking portion of Belgium. Fermentation occurs at a scorching 87 degrees (20 degrees higher than most ales) allowing the yeast to impart complex, spice-like flavors and aromas. Not a single spice is added to this brew; it’s all about fermentation.”    The appearance is a deep, amber gold color with a medium haze and medium head retention — the head dissipates pretty quickly.    The aroma is relatively faint, and mostly of malts and grains, little-to-no hops, and an ever-so-slight scent of bananas.    This medium-bodied brew lands fizzy on the palate before opening up into a lightly sweet and vaguely spicy flavor. The hot fermentation temps seem to have imparted a spice profile that’s not altogether unlike a Hefeweizen. This brew seems to walk the line between being a Farmhouse and a Hefe — the low hop profile and mild acidity with that faintly spicy aspect and a higher ABV for the style (6.8%) result in an interesting combination, indeed.    For us, the aftertaste has a burnt character that’s borderline metallic — not as dry as we expected, yet with a lingering bitterness. As the beer warms up, though, the sweetness of the malt profile becomes stronger and the aftertaste morphs into one that has more of the signature tang of a saison. As far as food pairings go, lately we’ve been pairing beers with sweet cherries that are in season (and delicious), and the combination of sugar and slight tartness with just about any beer, including this one, is winning.

Name: Haverhill Scape Goat Bock
Description: A traditional German dunkel (dark) bock brewed the old-fashioned way with dark Munich malts as the base instead of modern lightly kilned malts. This lager is smooth and deep brown in color with just a touch of German noble hops to balance the flavor.

Name: Haverhill Ignoble Indian Pale Lager
Categories: India Pale Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: The hoppy punch of an IPA with the easy-drinking smoothness of a lager.

Name: Cutters Monon Wheat
Description: Years ago whilst pierced the air and the ground literally shook from the power steam. The Monon Railroad helped propel Indiana’s economy from 1897 – 1956 and earned its name from the convergence of its four main routes in Monon, Indiana. From Monon, the mainlines reached Chicago, Louisville, Indianapolis, Michigan City, and most towns in between.

Name: Cutters Empire Imperial Stout
Description: In tribute we present our bold Empire Imperial Stout, black as night and pouring with a thick tan head. It starts with an espresso-like, malt flavor and finishes smooth and slightly sweet from the addition of molasses in the brewing processs. Like standing at the top of a 102-story skyscraper, Empire is rewarding but not for the faint of heart.

Name: Cutters Lost River
Description: Southern Indiana holds more than a few secrets and natural wonders. Among them is the Lost River with 23 of its 85 miles underground. Rising in Washington County, the river flows for miles until the stream turns dry as it vanishes into the limestone to form subterranean caverns, many of which remain unexplored.    Another natural wonder is our version of the Lost River, a crisp, refreshing summer ale with spicy hop notes and a thick white foamy head. One taste and it’s no mystery how Lost River can make any thirst disappear on any occasion.    Description  lightest and easiest drinking beer. Brewed entirely with pilsner malt. Hop character is of the noble variety, leaving a light to medium “spicy” bitterness. A balanced beer, light bodied and lager like interpretation of a bohemian pilsner. If this beer were lagered, it would be a classic bohemian pilsner.

Name: Uncle Billy’s Barton Springs Pale Ale
Danny Boy Miss Ginger Witte
Description: The Ginger Witte is a remarkable beer offering a great take on a witbier. Crystalized ginger and coriander are used during the brewing process giving it unique flavor. A good wheated backbone to make it very drinkable.

Name: Danny Boy Black IPA
Description: Danny Black is an interestingly hoppy, dark brown almost black IPA that is brewed with centennial and citra hops. It will now be offered year-round. The brew is inspired by the great IPA acceptance and further desire for dark brown, porter, and stout beers with hoppy undertones. Brewed to just more than 6 percent ABV and served in a traditional Irish tulip pint glass, the Danny Boy Beers offer to the craft market a nicely robust flavor of craft brews for the session able sports pub crowd. This is a perfect complement to their Training Day Hop forward Pale Ale

Name: Danny Boy Indiana Girl IPA
Description: The Indiana girl is a malt forward IPA loaded with malty goodness and tons of hop editions.

Name: Bridge Bourbon Blood Orange Wheat Ale
Description: This American wheat ale is a crisp, refreshing summer brew. Pouring a hazy straw colour this beer was brewed with the addition of fresh blood oranges and bourbon. Zesty and floral, with clean citrus flavours and a moderate bitterness this beer is ideal for a warm summer day.

Name: Bridge Brewing North Shore Pale Ale
Description: Our North Shore Pale Ale is a local secret—full bodied with a golden colour and a sweet, mild caramel flavour. The finish is crisp and full of hops. This is a highly drinkable and approachable ale, great for making friends or buttering up family. We use Canadian pilsner malt and German Noble hops mixed with Northwest varieties.

Name: Bridge Brewing The Fuzz Milkshake IPA
Description: This Milkshake IPA is bursting with tropical and peach flavours along with hints of vanilla. The lactose and oats add a touch of sweetness along with a smooth and creamy mouthfeel. Pouring a hazy pale yellow, this juicy IPA is unfiltered and contains no clarifying agents.

Name: Hoyne Summer Haze Honey Hefe
Description: On a sunny summer day, just like today, the Great and Wonderful Oz set sail in his hot-air balloon.  As ballast, some say, his basket was loaded to the brim with Hoyne Hefeweizen.  After lift-off, his thirst gathered like a summer storm.  Quenching it, he lightened his load, and found himself carried delightfully away.  The rest, as they say, is his story.

Name: Hoyne Alpha Acid IPA
Description: Introducing a new addition to the Hoyne Brewing Family, Alpha Acid IPA replaces Devil’s Dream IPA in the core lineup. Big additions of Idaho 7, El Dorado and Azacca make this hazy, tropical IPA extra juicy. Brewed with the addition of wheat in the North-Eastern style with a great balance of hops, malt and mouth feel.

Name: Hoyne Pilsner
Description: On the third night, I handed my sweetie a tall slender Pilsner. Perfectly poured. While holding it up and gazing either at it, or through it at me, she said softly, “you are so fine to me.” It was hard to tell if she meant to be heard. “Ambiguity, thy Name is Woman”, I nearly uttered. Whether she was speaking to me, or to the beer, it was merely semantics. The deal was sealed.  I would make it my life”s work to make fine beer.

Name: Insurgente Buho Rompeolas
Description: The load of hops in this beer explodes on your palate like the waves of the Pacific. Buho Ropeolas is a Hoppy Wheat designed to refresh at all times. The use of hops like Citra, Simcoe and Mosaic generates aromas and flavors that make us dream of Baja California beaches.

Name: Blue Stallion Dunkel
Description: Originally brewed in Munich, this classic dark lager has become quite popular throughout Germany. We use a large amount of Munich malts in this lager to provide a bread-like taste with a hint of caramel, which is common of this particular style of beer. We also use one of Germany's finest noble hops from the Hallertauer region to make this beer as authentic as possible. The rich and sweet aromas balanced with its deep brown color will be sure to give your senses an enjoyable overall impression.

Name: Blue Stallion Helles
Description: Helles translates into “bright” in German and is the light colored alternative to a Dunkel in the southern region of Germany. Our Helles offers a crisp and clean taste with a medium body that is both thirst quenching and refreshing. With a mild grainy aroma and frothy white head, this supreme example of the classic German lager is a beautiful pale yellow with medium carbonation and is served in both liter and half-liter sizes.

Name: Blue Frog Hefe Weizen
Description: This unfiltered wheat beer of German style is made using a mixture of wheat malt and barley malt. Special German yeast is used to produce a refreshing beer that has a spicy, clovery nose and a tart, lightly hopped finish. If you’re looking for an easy drinking beer with some personality, try our Hefeweizen. Served without lemon upon request. 15.2 IBU, 13.95 Plato 6.25%

Name: Blue Frog IPA
Description: So named because it had to endure long sea voyages from breweries in England to outposts on the fringes of the British Empire. IPA is a high alcohol, well-hopped brew to enable it to last the voyage and not spoil. 50 IBU's, 15.38 Plato, 6.3% ABV

Name: Blue Frog The Big Double IPA
Description: This monstrous version of our IPA has been overloaded with everything from the malt to the hops, even the tunes we rocked out to during the brew day were huge. this bottle conditioned Double IPA is abound with aromas of citrus hops, English toffee, and fresh baked biscuits. Carmel notes, hoppy lovin’ and slight yeastie notes jump off your tongue.  Enjoy this bottle conditioned beer in a large snifter slightly warmer than normal with the one who keeps you warm at night.

Name: Gizmo Queen Bee Imperial Honey Wheat
Description: A pipping sound, a vibration shakes her cell. The swarm has begun, signaling the dawn of a new monarchy. The wax that covers her chamber is opened; dripping in honey, she emerges before her workers. Her sweetness enchants them. Her crown rules them. To celebrate our second anniversary, we present the Queen of honey wheat beers. Sixty pounds of fresh Orange Blossom Honey was added to this Imperial Hefeweizen. After a month maturing in charred Kentucky bourbon barrels, her time has come to assume the throne. Long Live the Queen! Long Live Gizmo!

Name: Gizmo Deep Blue Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: In the summer of 1997, Deep Blue, a computer designed by IBM, defeated the world champion chess player Garry Kasparov at his own game. This was the first time a master of his craft had been beaten by artificial intelligence. In the summer of 1999, a totally unrelated yet similarly disturbing advancement in technology struck again when the Hollywood classic Deep Blue Sea proved even Samuel L. Jackson was no match for those motherf@#$ing A.I. sharks.   We pay our respects to these victims of technology with a funky twist on a farmhouse favorite. Our saison has a strong blueberry nose accompanied by a classic Belgian aroma. Dry and crisp, a sweet blueberry flavor takes over, accented by a slight tart ending. Gizmo’s summer beer pairs perfectly with hot days, warm nights, chess matches, and sailing in shark infested waters.

Name: Gizmo Gose Wild
Description: A refreshing tart and fruity wheat ale with a salt character

Name: Turkey Foot Honey Berry Wheat
Description: This is a slightly sweet Ale made with a touch of honey and a hint of a tri-berry mix including strawberries, raspberries and blueberries. It is an original style of beer that is in a class of its own.

Name: Turkeyfoot Pale Ale
Description: This  pale  ale  is  a  combination  of  a  base  malt  and  a  bit  of  specialty  malt  with  a  blend  of both  pine  and  floral  hops.  The  bold  taste  and  clean  finish  are  tributes  to  its  complexity  in  simplicity  and  earned  it  first  place  in  a  Boulder  County  Pro  Am  Competition.

Name: Pinkus Organic Pilsner
Description: Pale golden in color; light to medium in body; dry and well-balanced; clean hop and malt character.

Name: Schwelmer Hefeweizen
Description: The crisp, refreshing and naturally cloudy Bavarian style.

Name: 7th Wave Brewing Thank You Wheat
Description: A nice grapefruit and lime wheat beer. Reminds me of a Paloma. nice aroma from the Grapefruit and an after taste of lime

Name: 7th Wave Billy Hill All Night Session
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Classic English Bitter made with English Hops. East Kent Golding and Bramling Cross.

Name: 7th Wave Brewing Fog Horn IPL
Description: A a gently hopped and cloudy New England India Pale Lager.

Name: Fat Cat Sultans Of Wheat Cn
Fat Cat Injunction Pale Ale Cn
Rochefort 8
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: The lower gravity cousin to Rochefort 10. Nicknamed "Spéciale" (’The Special’), this beer is the most recent production. The Rochefort 8 has a more tawny colour and a more pronounced aroma, with an even richer fruitiness (a slight undertone of fig?) and a little more spiced dryness, like that of a cake, which gives a balanced finish to the final notes.

Name: Rochefort 10
Description: The Rochefort brewery is located inside the Abbey of Notre-Dame de Saint-Rémy, near the town of Rochefort, and has been brewing beer since 1595. The Rochefort '10' is a world classic beer.  Brewed with water, malt, other cereal grains, hops, yeast and sugar to a sufficient high gravity to be called Rochefort 10.   Deep red-brown colour with a compact head. The huge profile is a major component in the flavour, the Fig, honey and stone fruit,  of this rich ale

Name: Rochefort 6
Description: Rochefort 6 (red cap, brown beer, 7.5% ABV). Reddish colour, brewed only about once per year, representing approximately 1% of total beer production. This beer begins with a density of 16.5º Plato is 7.5% ABV. “Rochefort 6” is the oldest Rochefort Trappist beer and was brewed empirically until the end of the Second World War. Until 1958, this was the only Rochefort beer that was bottled in both 33 cc bottles and 75 cc bottles. It has a strong malt taste and is slightly bitter.

Name: Westmalle Dubbel
Description: Westmalle Dubbel is a dark, reddish-brown Trappist beer with a secondary fermentation in the bottle. The creamy head has the fragrance of special malt and leaves an attractive lace pattern in the glass. The flavour is rich and complex, herby and fruity with a fresh-bitter finish. It is a balanced quality beer with a soft feel in the mouth and a long, dry aftertaste. The Dubbel contains 7% alcohol.

Name: Westmalle Trappist Tripel
Food Pairing: Fish - Meaty  Oily, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy
Description: Westmalle Tripel is a clear, golden yellow Trappist beer that undergoes a secondary fermentation in the bottle. It is a complex beer with a fruity aroma and a nice nuanced hop scent. It is soft and creamy in the mouth, with a bitter touch carried by the fruity aroma. An exceptional beer, with a great deal of finesse and elegance. And with a splendid long aftertaste. ABV 9.5

Name: Westmalle Trappist Dubbel
Description: A reddish brown trappist ale, malty and fruit, featuring a 3 week secondary fermentation. This ale has a full, pale yellow head. The bouquet is full of esters and fruitiness. Notes of ripe banana predominate. The taste is fruity and slightly bitter, with a long, dry finish.

Name: Whiner Le Tub Wild Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A blended barrel-aged Wild Saison with a funky fresh taste of white grapes and lemon tarts… you’ll want to bathe your mouth with it.

Name: Whiner Miaou Belgian Style Wheat Beer
Description: This refreshing barrel-aged, dry-hopped Belgian-style Wheat ale is aged in Cabernet wine barrels with tasting notes of juicy tangerine, vinous and light hops.

Name: Whiner Candy Darling Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Barrel aged, barrel fermented wild ale with Italian plums.

Name: Manhattan Project Half Life
Description: Hazy IPA

Name: Manhattan Project Wise Monkeys Belgian Strong Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Wise Monkeys is a fairly true to style Belgian Golden Strong, and it packs a punch in a way too drinkable package. When you take a lingering sniff, you will detect a bit of fermented stone fruit, specifically peach. But don’t let the nose fool you. It has a softly perceptible sweetness that we’re calling semi-dry. The flavor isn’t going to be sugary sweet, but more of a subtle reference to the peach, pear, and bubblegum that comes through on the nose.

Name: Manhattan Project Bikini Atoll Gose
Description: With its low hop bitterness, saltiness, and citrus flavors, the Bikini Atoll is often a favorite amongst our friends that think they don’t like beer. In contrast, the beer snobs out there love it as well. It is light and effervescent with high carbonation.

Name: Good People Urban Farmer
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Good People Snake Handler
Description: This Double IPA brew is a spirited celebration of all things hoppy. Aromas of pine, citrus, flowers, spice, pineapple, and grassiness complement a biscuit and caramel backbone. Hands down, our most requested beer.

Name: Good People Mumbai Rye IPA
Description: This hop-forward Rye IPA put spicy earthy flavors on full display, balanced with the hop presence of the American IPA. What comes of the marriage is a uniquely flavorful, easy-to- drink, autumn-friendly beer.

Name: Bosteels Tripel Karmeliet
Description: Brewery Notes  Brewed with oats, barley and wheat, Tripel Karmeliet has soft, full, rich grain character with hints of banana, vanilla, and a slight, pleasing bubble-gum aroma. A restrained hop bitterness offers perfect balance and a gentle counterpart to its substantial maltiness.

Name: Bone Up Brewing Company Henrietta Farmhouse
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This beer is brewed to commemorate the memory of Horatio's great aunt Henrietta, for whom he had an unexpected soft spot. She had a way with words and a way with people, in the sense that being terrible at something still qualifies as a "way." But nevertheless, her ungainly departure was the source of much consternation for dear Horatio, who felt that the insouciant drowning of his myriad sorrows in a ludicrous purple imbibement would most behoove. So lest you miss out on the aforementioned, we forthwith insist you come hither posthaste!

Name: Bone Up Brewing Company Wasted Life IPA
Description: With a wink at the old school and a nod toward the new school and the hint of a sly smile toward the English school, Wasted Life takes a trip all around the Wide World of IPA (with a brief layover in Belgium, of course). It's got a dab of caramel but it's not too sweet or full-bodied, it's got a hint of pine and resin but it's not reminiscent of floor cleaner, it's fruity but it doesn't smell like day-old fruit salad that's been sitting in the lobby of a medium-quality hotel near the airport. It's Wasted Life, and we love it, but we have one hell of a time trying to describe it, so you should probably just see for your dang self!

Name: Bone Up Key Lime White
Description: Inspired by (but not too closely imitating) the scientifically-proven best dessert in the world,* Key Lime White is tart enough to be refreshing (but not enough to get all puckery) with a smidge of creamy sweetness and - if you really look for it - undertones of crackery pie crust, all while managing to still Taste Like Beer. It's great on the beach, and even better after you finish shoveling out your parking spot, so if you ain't had it yet you should probably see what all the fuss is about!

Name: Silver Branch Beyond The Gnome Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A classical saison, brewed with all pilsner malt and Saaz hops, and a blend of Saison yeast from two Belgian breweries.

Name: Silver Branch Quantum Shift
Description: Quantum Shift Volume 1 celebrates the East Coast approach to IPA. Malt flavor and sweetness accompany intense hop flavor and aroma. Copious additions of late kettle hopping, specialty malt and an English ale yeast strike balance between a rich malt backbone and a juicy hop profile.

Name: Silver Branch Glass Castle Pilsner
Description: A delicate balance of spicy Czech hops and golden malt make Glass Castle flavorful, yet eminently drinkable. We use soft water, imported floor-malted barley, Saaz hops and traditional brewing techniques to give you a classic Bohemian Pilsener that is smooth yet flavorful.

Name: Council Beatitude Mango
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Beatitude Tart Saison is a true wild beer using a traditional mixed fermentation of Saccharomyces, Brettanomyces, and Lactobacillus. We use real mango fruit (no extracts) giving this sour and sessionable beer a juicy mango forward aroma and flavor.

Name: Council Beatitude Pineapple
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: This Tart Saison is brewed in the Belgian tradition of tart farmhouse ales. The magic happens when our house blend of Brettanomyces, Lactobacillus and Saison yeast throw an out-of-this-world party in our fermenters. Aged on pineapple, this yields a beer with a lacto forward nose, an intensely tart fruit flavor, a doughy complexity, and takes the word "refreshing" to a whole new level.

Name: Council Beatitude Black Currant
Description: Pleasantly sour beer with intense, real black currant fruit character and a dry, complex finish.

Name: Loverbeer Beerburgna
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: The unique use of Damaschine plums gives this extraordinary beer a lot of warm and sensuous fruity notes with clear,though never too aggressive, sour and citric flavors. Despite its low pH, this unique beer is well balanced thanks to aremarkable fullness and to impressive fruity flavors persisting for a long time. “Brugna” is Piedmontese dialect for “prunes.” Fermented for two weeks in stainless steel with a complex yeast strain containing bretanoymyces and lactic acid bacteria. Secondary fermentation for three-to-four weeks induced by Ramassin (Damaschine) plums from Valley Bronda. Matured in 3hL wooden barrels for nine-to-eleven months.

Name: Loverbeer d’Uva
Description: Prodotto ad Alta Fermentazione. Birra prodotta con l’aggiunta di mosto d’uva Freisa in fermentazione. "Birra complessa, di grande finezza ed eleganza, in cui sorprendentemente convivono tre anime, quella fruttata con sentori che ricordano la fragola, il lampone ed il ribes rosso, quella acidula-citrica con lievi aspre note di limone e quella, più ostica, caratterizzata da off flavors tutti da scoprire. Nonostante la presenza di nette punte di astringenza, una piacevole sensazione di "warming" ci accompagna dopo ogni sorsata." - Lorenzo Dabove in arte Kuaska

Name: Lovebeer Beerbera
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Fermented and maturated in oak vats. No adding yeast. Spontaneous fermentation because of adding freshly pressed Barbera grapes juice that contains the skins, directly from a viticulturist near Alba. Brewed once a year at vintage time obviously. Available in 375 ml or 750 ml bottles.    Fresh, vinous and fruity smell, qualities that are confirmed on the palate and which reveal a close link between the world of beer spontaneously fermented and the wine.

Name: Holy Mountain The Seer Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description:
A hoppy saison brewed with wheat and aged in oak with brett.

This batch was aged for over three months in our foudre with brettanomyces and then dry hopped. Refermented in the bottle with brettanomyces.

Name: Holy Mountain Vesper Table Beer
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Vesper was brewed with Pilsner malt, flaked rye and wheat and lightly hopped with Styrian Golding and Cascade. It was fermented in stainless with one of our favorite Strains of Belgian yeast and then conditioned with Brett.

Name: Holy Mountain Eternal Recurrence
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Biere de Garde
Description: Blonde Bier de Garde brewed with pilsner malt and hopped with French Strisselpalt. Refermented with Brettanomyces.

Name: Smisje Wostyntije Ale With Mustard Seeds
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: dark blond ale brewed with 90% barley malt, 10% munich malt, 2 sorts of hops, dark candy sugar and mustard seeds.

Name: Smisje Bbbourgondier ‘t Smisje
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: A dark and heavy ale - the strongest that the brewery has ever produced - in which three varieties of malt and two spices are utilised. It is brewed "in honour of" the Burgundian Babble Belt, a well known web-site on the Internet, where beer lovers can exchange all sorts of information.

Name: t Smisje Catherine The Great Imperial Stout
Description: Bottle fermented. Brewed with water, barley malt, hops and yeast.

Name: NJ Beer Co 1787 Abbey Single Ale
Description: The 1787 makes a great session beer. It’s light sweetness and distinctive belgian taste make it emminently approachable and perfectly refreshing.

Name: NJ Beer Co Hudson Pale Ale
Description: The Hudson is an American-style Pale Ale, with a bright, hoppy nose, smooth mouthfeel and quick, light finish. This represents a great introduction to the world of hoppy beers and should whet the appetite of true Hop Heads for what is yet to come.

Name: NJ Beer Co Garden State Stout
Description: Our stout is a strong, full-bodied chocolate stout, brewed with real belgian dark chocolate and dark malt, with just enough hop character to balance the sweetness.

Name: Ridgeway Brewing Seriously Bad Elf
Description:
Another masterpiece from Peter Scholey at Ridgeway Brewing. Seriously Bad Elf is Peters’s very English interpretation of a Belgian Tripel, brewed to warming 9% alcohol, especially for his rapidly-growing American following.

Seriously, you don’t want to miss this beer.

Seriously Bad Elf was briefly banned in Connecticut back in 2005! That little red speck you see in the background of the label? Why, that’s none other than Kris Kringle, Santa Claus, who, according to the Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, cannot appear on a beer label. Sleep well, Connecticutians! Your government is working overtime to protect you.

Name: Ridgeway Lump Of Coal Dark Holiday Stout
Description:
Looking forward to a depressing holiday? Here is liquid consolation. This 8% bittersweet chocolate stout is the best you could hope for in these dark times. Come to think of it, considering how bad you’ve been this year, this little coal-black gem is more than you deserve for Christmas. 
 
 Concocted by the vastly talented -- though, frankly, a little too cheery -- Peter Scholey

Name: Ridgeway Bad Elf Winter Ale
Description: Bottle conditioned; Seasonal - Winter. Has also been seen on cask occasionally. Ridgeway produce two versions of Bad Elf "Winter Ale" - one at 4.5%, and the other at 6%. There is a separate listing for the 4.5% version. Olde England meets the New World in this strong, warming golden ale, brewed by Peter Scholey. Master brewer for the late and much-lamented Brakspear Brewery of Henley-on-Thames, England, Peter started his own brewing operations in 2003. Bad Elf is a hop-lover’s dream, balancing a generous amount of famous English malt with an astounding 45 ounces of fresh hops – including American Cascade – per barrel.

Name: Thiriez Extra Dry Hopped Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A joint beer venture between a Kentish and Flanders Craft Brewery using quality brewing ingredients.   Formerly known as Thiriez Xxtra, a special version of Etoile du Nord for the US market.

Name: Thiriez Amber Farmhouse
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: A joint beer venture between a Kentish and Flanders Craft Brewery using quality brewing ingredients.   Formerly known as Thiriez Xxtra, a special version of Etoile du Nord for the US market.

Name: Thiriez Blonde Dry Hopped Farmhouse Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Daniel Thiriezs rustic little brick-and-beam brewery graces the village of Esquelbecq, plunk in the middle of the rolling farm country of French Flanders. With a brewing degree from a Belgian university, and decidedly Belgian-oriented, Monsieur Thiriez makes ales with an earthy, slightly wild character that recalls the early days of farmhouse brewing, before there was a border between France and Belgium. The delicate spicy champagne aromas of this thirst-quenching blonde beauty are quickly followed by a bracing rush of whole fresh hops.

Name: Straight To Ale Brother Joseph’s
Description:
Maimed in an accident that left him with a hunched back, Brother Joseph Zoettl worked in the St. Bernard Abbey power plant shoveling coal. In his spare time, Brother Joseph used found objects such as marbles and chunks of concrete and tile to build miniature shrines and buildings on the Abbey grounds. Over 40 years, he created 125 different models and replicas.

Today, the Ave Maria Grotto covers three acres and is world-renowned as both a fun roadside attraction and an awe-inspiring collection of folk art. We have named our Belgian dubbel after Brother Joseph as a testament to his perseverance, his hard work, and his indomitable spirit. A full-flavored abbey-style ale with a complex taste and aroma, Brother Joseph’s Dubbel is filled with specialty malt and dark fruit character.

Name: Straight To Ale Monkeynaut IPA
Description: Albert. Able. Gordo. Miss Baker. Bonny. Goliath. Between 1948 and 1961 these primate pioneers and others bravely went where no man had ever gone before, paving the way for manned U.S. spaceflight. This hoppy little monkey of a beer is a tribute to those Simian heroes of yesteryear. It has a citrusy, floral hop aroma, a strong malt body, and a crisp finish.

Name: Straight To Ale Gorillanaut Imperial IPA
Description: The bigger, badder brother to our flagship Monkeynaut IPA, this beer definitely shoots for the moon. A supernova of citrusy hop aroma and flavor up front and a sweet malty backbone make this an aggressive yet well-balanced beer. It finishes with a smooth, lingering hop bitterness. If you’ve ever wondered what an 800-lb. gorilla in a spacesuit drinks, well, the answer is Tang, of course ... but when he’s back on Earth and in the mood for a big beer, he reaches for this.

Name: Middle Brow Beer The Life Pursuit
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: The Life Pursuit is the first in our series of Homebrewer releases. This dark saison is a French-style ale with a rich, lightly-caramelized and grainy malt background. It’s characterful yeast showcases a warm, peppery spice and fruity sweetness. The beer is also briefly conditioned with cinnamon sticks and vanilla beans, bringing to life that spicy / sweet balance.

Name: Middle Brow Robyn
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale

Name: Middle Brow Show Me Love
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: A blonde farmhouse aged in Cabernet Sauvignon French oak barrels with raspberries from seedling farms and an unique brettanomyces blend.

Name: Sérénité Grand Cru Quadrupel
Tasting Notes: Bold, Bready, Cassis, Cherry, Currant, Dark Fruit, Dried Fruit, Fig, Malty, Pruny, Red Fruit, Silky, Strong, Toasty
Description: Silver Medal Winner GABF 2019 - Deep amber in color, a nose of malt, fruit and a touch of smoke. Taste notes of brown sugar, plums, grapes, cherries, raisins, coriander and chocolate. Medium-full bodied with a long, dry fruity finish.

Name: Bruz Brut La Grande Champagne Style Beer
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Tasting Notes: Apple, Apricot, Balanced, Biscuit, Bright, Crisp, Crushed Rock, Floral, Green Apple, Minerality, Pear, Smooth, Strong
Description: Brut La Grande is a pale golden color with a dense off-white head. Its perfume aroma yields notes of lemons, apricots, allspice, and black pepper. Its complex flavor profile hints at tart apples, peaches, citrus, vanilla and exotic spices. Brut La Grande is light and airy with a silky mouthfeel, creamy pinpoint carbonation and a tart, bone-dry finish. Every sip is a celebration!

Name: Bruz Beers Dawg Daze Belgian IPA
Tasting Notes: Citrus, Crisp, Dry, Floral, Fresh, Hoppy, Smooth, Tropical
Description: Dawg Daze IPA is a true Belgian-style IPA. It brings together rich Belgian malts, a lively Belgian yeast and a feisty blend of Goldings, Amarillo, Citra and Simcoe hops for a bold and harmonious IPA that will leave you longing for more!

Name: Bent Stick Flight 1884 Pineapple Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description:
"​We brewed a delicious one-off saison late summer 2018, and started scheming up potential fruit additions shortly after.

​Flight 1884, with 5% actual pineapple juice in the brew, represents our first attempt at fruiting our farmhouse ale.

Pineapple, slightly tart, light-bodied and completely refreshing!"

Name: Bent Stick Swap The Hops Pale Ale
Description:
"​Gotta have my hops!

Dive into our Swap the Hops pale ale for your hop needs. Brewed on a semi-regular basis.

It's the same but different ‘cause we swap the hops every time!"

This is a rotating seasonal, the brewery releases different versions of this beer every few months. The image may not match the current release. If you have any questions reach out to Drizly support

Name: Bent Stick Spring-Heeled Jack IPA
Description:
English folklore references the Spring-Heeled Jack, a devil-like creature with eyes like “red balls of fire”!

Our Spring-Heeled Jack Red IPA combines English yeast, malts and hops (Goldings!!) with a progressive hopping schedule.

Oh, and a boatload of Vic Secret hops, just because.

Name: Birra del Borgo Maledetta
Description: Dedicated to the Tuscan cigar and the Club Maledetto Toscano, marks the meeting point between Belgian and Anglo-Saxon brassic culture. Strong hopping blends with a selection of yeasts that grow fruity, floral notes of great charm, intensity and complexity. In the mouth, after the mythical entrance, comes the caramel that evolves in the agrumato and goes to merge with a pleasant bitter and spicy note.

Name: Birra Del Borgo My Antonia Imperial Pilsner
Description: One of the few adventures in the realm of bottom fermented beers for Birra del Borgo. A mix of American and European hops in dry-hopping (Simcoe, Warrior and Saaz). Stronger in alcohol, hence the Imperial appellation, will surprise you with its intensity, being both explosive and balanced at the same time. A blonde beer with a strong backbone, just like the main character of the novel by Willa Cather from which the beer takes its name.

Name: Genziana Del Borgo
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Van Diest Fruli Strawberry Beer
Description: Fruli is a high quality Belgian white beer blended with pure fruit juice. The strawberry juice compliments the zesty fruitiness of the wheat beer and the result is a natural, soft and refreshing drink that is simply delicious!

Name: Abbaye d’Aulne Brune Peres
Description: A highly traditional fermented ale brewed with malt and top quality hops without any chemical additive. Brown and coppered in appearance, this ale is characterised by its rich and scented flavour as well as its velvety taste.

Name: Abbaye D’Aulne Triple Blonde
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Abbaye D’ Blonde
Description: Blonde abbey beer with second fermentation in the bottle. Golden coloured, this beer is distinguished by its lightly fruited hop flavours and light, harmonious body. Tasting notes: A complex beer with delicate fruity notes and a nice hoppy aroma. The mouthfeel is soft on the tongue, and the complex, full body harmonizes perfectly with the alcoholic notes. A beer with a lot of finesse and elegance and an exquisitely long finish. Alcohol content: 6% Plato degree: 14 Bitterness: 20 EBU (medium) Colour: 10 EBC (straw yellow) Ideal drinking temperature: 8°C Food pairing: Hard cheeses, red meats, mussels.

Name: Currahee Wayah Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager

Name: La Divine Blonde
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: The aroma and taste of this beer compose a successful symphony, conducted with care but not in an overstrict manner. The initial taste gives an impression of bitterness that never becomes overpowering, balanced by, where necessary, a round mildness in the centre and at the finish. The quality hops and the pure malt work together to deliver a harmonious recital.

Name: La Divine Triple
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Abbey style top fermentation beer. Colour: Amber colouring 35 EBC. Ingredients: Water, pale ale malt, caramel malt, aromatic malt, sugar, yeast, Kent hop, hallertau hop. Density: 9.5% ABV 19° Plato. Packaging: 33cl Apo bottle, 25l barrel. Drinking temperature: serve between 7 and 10° C. Storage: very long time under normal storage conditions. Taste comments: Its sweet and velvety aroma leads us to a pleasant hop and woody taste. It releases a very fine, bitter even smoky and alcoholised taste at the back of the mouth.

Name: Brasserie de Silly Pink Killer
Description: Pink Killer is a pleasant, slightly sweet, fruity thirst-quencher based on malt, wheat and pink grapefruit, hence its striking colour and the whiff of citrus characteristic of this fruit. A very tasty beer when you just want to quench your thirst.

Name: Red Hare Framboise
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: The Framboise (Frah-boahz) Saison takes the Hare back to his travels to Paris, where the air is sweet and the Parisians enjoy the last few long nights out on the town. Summer lingers just a little longer and the last of the raspberry harvest and a funky French saison yeast come together to create this summer soother full of esters, raspberries, and subtle spiciness.  This beer combines Two-Row and specialty hops together with Saaz and Williamette hops, with a final addition of raspberries.

Name: Red Hare SPF 50/50 India Pale Radler
Description: SPF 50/50 is a light, refreshing blend of Gangway IPA and our house brewed sparkling grapefruit soda. Sweet grapefruit zest mingles perfectly with citrusy hop notes, making this the perfect can to take with you everywhere this summer.

Name: Trou Du Diable La Buteuse
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: This exceptional beer, fermented with three different types of yeast, was aged for six months in oak barrels, which were previously used in the making of apple brandy. Its nose features notes of vanilla, spices, roasted grains and barnyard. Its palate delivers intertwined flavours of burnt caramel, peach and fresh tobacco, as well as a soft effervescence delivered by fine champagne-like bubbles.

Name: Trou Du Diable L’ours
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: With L'Ours, the Devil's Hole assemblers offer you an evolutionary concept: each coming assembly will be distinct, sometimes leaving more intense notes, be they tart, bitter or fruity. It will, however, be a twenty percent blend of a sour rye beer aged two years in Banyuls oak barrels, and eighty percent in a young season. The nose, with delicate notes of rancio and dried fruit, will first of all lead us to believe that we have to make a sure beer. The palate will immediately offer a young beer, tart and subtly woody, all stretching into a refreshing finish.

Name: Trou Du Diable Grivoise De Noel
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: As soon as we zyeute la Grivoise, our eyes are drowning in the dark ruby ​​of the liquid. As inevitably as instinctively, we dive our noses into an irresistible perfume of spices, with accents of liqueur of herbs, small fruits and delicacy that makes us succumb. An in-depth study of the olfactory apparatus, confirmed by the first sips, reveals a complex blend of licorice, cardamom and smoked pepper. With this discovery, a mouth that could not wait, we are rewarded with a sweet and caramelized finish. Throughout the experience, a heat of alcohol supports each sip, calling the taster to sink, always a little deeper, in the saucy.

Name: Strange Fellows Jongleur Belgian Wit
Description: Amid bursts of confetti & music, the Juggler entertains us with a handful of oranges. As the oranges rise & fall, the planets revolve in the universe, babies are born, & the old pass on. Jongleur – our silky bodied, spicy & aromatic Wit – infuses any moment with a spark of joy. A glass of this bright & refreshing beer reminds us of the juggler’s simple lesson: to take pleasure in both the big & the small things in life.

Name: Strange Fellows Talisman West Coast Pale Ale
Description: The Siren of the Seas is a fickle creature: benevolent or spiteful, she can bestow a safe passage & a bountiful catch, or provoke storms & shipwrecks. Sailors have long cast gifts of flowers, food or trinkets into the sea in exchange for good fortune. Talisman – our delicately dry-hopped & golden-hued ale with its tropical & citrusy aroma – may be just the thing to encourage the Siren’s blessing.

Name: Strange Fellows Blackmail Milk Stout
Description: Dispatched each day at dawn, Odin’s two ravens fly the world over, bringing news from the land of men back to the Norse god by nightfall. What secrets do they gather as they spy from on high, or scavenge from the leavings of men?  Next time the black birds call outside your door, perhaps a glass of Blackmail milk stout – with its rich, round & slightly sweet character – will still their extortive tongues.

Name: Moody Ales Intrepid Matcha Tea Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Moody Ales is proud of our homebrewing roots - that's why we regularily serve beers inspired by local homebrew recipes in our tasting room. When local homebrewer Steve Sheldon shared his Lemon Matcha Saison with us, we knew we had to share it with as many beer lovers as we could. Intrepid Matcha Saison is the result of this collaboration. Crisp, refreshing, earthy, spicy, unique - this beer is a celebration of homebrewed creativity.

Name: Moody Ales Lusty Chocolate Oatmeal Stout
Description: Some say the only ingredients in a beer should be barley, hops, yeast and water. We say, the more the merrier. The Lusty Chocolate Oatmeal Stout is brewed with chocolate malt and cocoa powder, then conditioned on cocoa nibs for an intense milk chocolate flavour. Oats contribute a baked oatmeal cookie aroma. A perfect treat right before bed.

Name: Moody Boss Juice Hazy Double IPA
Description: Lumbergh approved hazy double IPA. Ignore the paper jam, scrap the TPS reports, and enjoy this beer. Inspired by the double IPAs of the North East, influenced by the west coast, this double IPA has massive juicy aroma and flavour, with a pronounced bitterness. Balanced and frighteningly easy drinking.

Name: Four Winds Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: We've reincarnated a Belgian standard. Brewed with aromatic Noble hops, we finish our Saison with Pacific Northwest Cascade hops for nuanced notes of flower and spice, and ferment it hot for a fruity ester profile.

Name: Four Winds Pale Ale
Description: A dynamic duo of Cascade and Centennial hops combine for a refreshingly bitter ale, varied with the subtle maltiness that gives way to a clean, brisk finish.

Name: Four Winds Juxtapose IPA
Description: At the heart of this distinctive West Coast IPA stands the juxtaposition of ripe tropical fruit esters and Wild Yeast funk. Moderately bitter and gracefully balanced.  Where orchards meet pastures.

Name: Lazy Magnolia Jefferson Stout
Description: Jefferson Stout, Lazy Magnolia’s original Sweet Potato Cream Stout, is Lazy Magnolia’s version of the ideal Southern-Style Stout. Jefferson Stout is brewed with sweet potatoes and lactose (milk sugar). The sweet potatoes provide the background to an impressive taste with added notes of roasted chocolate, coffee and caramel flavors.

Name: Foster’s Lager Beer
Description: William and Ralph Foster created Foster's in 1887.  Now, more than 120 years later, Foster's is the largest selling Australian beer brand in the world. Unlike other beers, Foster's hops are added at the end of the brewing process to preserve their freshness, giving the beer it's bold, refreshing taste. For the last 120 years, Foster's has been delivering beer with an amber golden color, and a bold, refreshing taste. It's unique Australian roots, makes Foster's beer Cans the perfect 12 pack for your next party, cookout or relaxing night at home. No matter what the occasion, Fosters will deliver.  With it's  low malt notes and slight hop bitter, it's sure to be a crowd pleaser at your next holiday, whether it's a 21st birthday party, summer barbeque or tailgate.

Name: Small Change A Little Rain Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Simple and full of character, we brew our dry-hopped pale ale with pale and munich malt, a touch of wheat, and warrior, cascade, and mosaic hops.

Name: Small Change A Little Rain 1/6 Barrel
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Dry-Hopped with Mosaic

Name: Small Change Brewing Whatever’s Cool With Me IPA
Description: Loaded with Citra hops, our bright and floral American IPA is a medley of east and west coast hop profiles packed with juicy tropical fruit character balanced with hop bitterness.

Name: Swamphead Stump Knocker Pale
Description: We named our pale ale after the notoriously feisty Stumpknocker fish, whose fight is so fierce you might think you’ve hooked into the lunker. True to form, this pale ale remains smooth and drinkable but keeps the same hop-headed attitude as the biggest boy in the pond. Stump Knocker enjoys a generous dry hop addition, producing a sharp, hop centered ale with a crisp and balanced finish. Go ahead… Knock One Back!

Name: Swamphead Midnight Oil
Description: Quiet and sensual like a moonlit night, this complex blend of toasted oats, roasted barley, chocolate wheat malt and dark roast coffee imparts an intense aroma and complex flavor profile.  We brew a traditional English style oatmeal stout with a rich malt profile, then add locally roasted coffee while this ale is cold conditioned. Perfect for burning the midnight oil.

Name: Swamp Head Big Nose IPA
Description: Created with crystal clear spring water that originates deep in the Okefenokee Swamp, Big Nose IPA is a mystical nectar brewed for hop lovers. Inhale the aroma and devour the flavor of Big Nose.Big Nose features massive amounts of late flavor hops, augmented with two dry hop additions to enhance the aromatics.A rich malt backbone combines with the intense hop flavors to deliver a balanced finish that keeps you coming back to say… BEER ME!

Name: The Brew Kettle White Rajah
Description: A West Coast style IPA full of citrus-like and tropical fruit like hop flavor and aroma with an assertive yet smooth bitter finish....malt, take a back seat please

Name: The Brew Kettle 4’s C’s Pale Ale
Description: A malty pale with Cascade, Centennial, Columbus and Chinook hops creating a citrus and piney flavor and assertive bitterness.

Name: The Brew Kettle Major Lager
Description: A traditional Light American Lager with a crisp taste, a slight bite of American hops, a clean & refreshing finish. The perfect game day beer!

Name: Crux Play Wave Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The pursuit of the perfect wave (or beer, for that matter) never ends. But with Play Wave, we’ve crafted a refreshing ride that’ll keep you paddling back out for more. With Mosaic, Galaxy, and Centennial hops added at the tail end, this easy -drinking NW Pale Ale is a tidal wave of citrusy goodness, without the bitter wipeout. Keep chasing your wave, and we’ll keep chasing ours.

Name: Crux Cast Out  IPA
Description: Many breweries procure their hops right here in the Northwest. But this beer features the Galaxy hop from Australia, a country famously populated by England’s cast out convicts. Cast Out IPA employs these hops aggressively from hop back to dry hopping stages. Yet the result is a balanced and bronzy ale, with medium hop bitterness complemented by moderate maltiness, showcasing aromas and flavors reminiscent of passion fruit.

Name: Magnify Low Visibility
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Magnify Vine Shine
Description: This beer was inspired by both East and West coast IPAs. Drawing its dank piney hop character from the West, and its smooth light bitterness, along with its dry crushabilty from the East, Vine Shine combines both styles to make a truly unique IPA.

Name: Magnify Galaxy Thrill IPA
Description: Hazy IPA with Galaxy hops. Brewed with a foundation of fluffy oats and hopped with Galaxy hops, this IPA is bursting with tropical fruit aromas.

Name: Nickel Brook Naughty Neighbour American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Sometimes our neighbours are just too enticing to resist! In this case, our newest ward-winning product pays homage to our naughty neighbours to the south, as our American Pale Ale has something for everyone! For hop lovers, the huge aroma of citrus and pine greet the nose and the hops continue on the palate as hoppy flavour persists, leaving a remarkably easy drinking crisp, dry finish. We pack all this hop aroma and flavour in a brew that is only 4.9% on purpose, which leaves a hugely sessionable beer that is perfectly refreshing on hot summer days! No additives. No preservatives. Naturally carbonated for a smooth, crisp finish.

Name: Nickel Brook Kentucky Bastard Imperial Stout
Nickel Brook Headstock IPA
Description: We admit it. We have a problem... We love our hops. We especially adore the amazing science of hops! As homage to our favourite wonders of nature, we present to you our award-winning Headstock IPA. The flowering humulus lupulus hop-cone provides us with the vital acids, essential oils and resins that permeate throughout our IPA. The result is a deliciously obscene wallop of tropical fruit, citrus and pine flavours and aromas any hop-head would gladly give a DNA sample for. We conclude that hop science is one tasty passion.

Name: Burnt City Dick the Butcher Pale Ale
Badger Hill High Road Everyday Ale
Description: Come join us on the high road. We’ve got our own special beer up here, High Road Everyday Ale, a sessionable ale that is complex yet approachable. Brewed with Galaxy and Wakatu hops, High Road swirls with the aromas of tropical fruit and notes of citrus. The flavor is clean and dry with just a hint of sweetness. Not a blonde or a pale ale, High Road Everyday Ale is an individual. Just like those we brewed it for.

Name: Badger Hill Foundation Stout
Description: Taking cues from old English and Irish Stouts, two brothers from the Land of 10,000 Lakes landed on their own perfect brew. The reveal? A sweet, malty roast that hints of coffee, caramel and chocolate—and finishes off clean with touches of American hops. In other words: not too schmaltzy, not too bitter. Like you’d expect from a couple of nice, well-balanced Minnesota guys.

Name: Badger Hill Traitor IPA
Description: One person’s traitor is another person’s hero, and this IPA just might be yours.  Part West Coast IPA, part not, Traitor rebels against style definitions.  We let our hop lovin’ wishes come true, with lots and lots and lots of Citra, Centennial, Cascade and Galaxy hops added throughout the brewing process, including dry-hopping, to give distinct hop flavor and waves of aroma.  Oh, and we go a little Benedict Arnold by using US Pale Malt with British yeast to give Traitor a smooth, dry finish. Go ahead….Betray Your IPA.

Name: Ruddles County Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Cask; Regular. Ingredients: Pale Malt; Bramling Cross hops.  Originally brewed in the Ruddles brewery in Oakham, Leicestershire (Rutland); moved in 1997 to the Morland brewery in Abingdon, Oxfordshire; finally moved in 2000 to the Greene King brewery in Bury St Edmunds when the strength was reduced to 4.3% and the character was changed.

Name: Greene King IPA
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: A perfectly balanced ale, characterised by its fresh hoppy taste and a clean bitter finish. The Official Beer of England Rugby, Greene King IPA is now the fastest selling cask ale in the UK.

Name: Ruddles Pub Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Pasteurised nitro-can.

Name: Brickway One Way IPA
Description: IPA double dry-hopped with Citra and Mosaic hops.

Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Unsung Buzzaman American Mutant Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Unsung Anthia Ipa
Description: With ANTHIA, we set out to create a very dry, clean, and crisp IPA with tropical notes. Taking advantage of a new frontier of hops streaming in from the intergalactic marketplace, we heavily dosed our hop blend towards the end of the boil and generously during the dry hop process.

Name: Flesk Occams Razor Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: American Pale Ale

Name: Flesk Moped Traveler Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Lemony citrus nose and flavor, light body with a slightly bitter finish.

Name: Flesk Brewing Co. Big Pointy Teeth Double IPA
Description: Flesk Brewing Co  Big Pointy Teeth - Double IPA,  9.4% abv, 60 IBUs     Follow! But! Follow only if ye be craft beer drinkers of valor because this DIPA is brewed with zythos and simcoe hops that delivers hopppy, fresh and tropical flavors.

Name: Arcade Primordial Pair American Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: American Pale Ale Brewed With Jaggery. Brewed in collaboration with Chicago-based pizza shop Dimo's Pizza. This light bodied pale ale is the perfect pair for your pizza craving. Dry hopped with El Dorado and Palisade hops, creating a light and fruity hop character. The jaggery (cane & palm sugar) dries the beer a bit and adds a complex, yet delicate brown sugar note

Name: Arcade Double Grapefruit IPA
Description: The first full production variance of Arcade's popular Grapefruit IPA. Big grapefruit hops and the addition of grapefruit juice create a big, bold grapefruit character

Name: Arcade Grapefruit IPA
Description: It’s dangerous to go alone…take this with you. Arcade Brewery has crafted this very sessionable IPA featuring citrus hop aroma and the addition of grapefruit; creating an awesome balance between hop bitterness and the citrus bite. A fine balancing act of biscuit malts allows a long hop finish wont fatigue taste buds; allowing the second pint to build off the first. An immensely sessionable ale, [the] Grapefruit IPA will win over all drinkers and give IPA lovers a new take on the incredibly popular style.

Name: Epic Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: You can only drink so many beers in a lifetime, so you better make each one count. That's where we can help. Because at Epic we're obessed with creating big hop-fuelled beers. This takes a shed-load of skill. It also takes a shed-load of hops. In fact there are 23 crammed into this bottle. Many brewers would call that 'insane'. We call it flavour.

Name: Epic Epicurean Coffe & Fig Imperial Oatmeal Stout
Description: The Epicurean series is a celebration of the flavours and aromas that can be found within the diverse range of ingredients that brewers and chefs alike use in their creations. This beer is a culmination of hours of cerebration, experimentation, ocgitation and libation. And a sprinkling of dehydrated finesse.

Name: Epic Armageddon IPA
Description: In the beginning, there was nothing. Then an impish brewer piled a ludicrous amount of hops into a batch of beer. This zymurgical big bang is Epic Armageddon, an apocalyptic assault on your preconceptions and taste buds. It may be too huge for this fragile planet so enjoy this beer like it was the last one on Earth.

Name: Fullsteam Humidity Pale Ale
Description: Hazy and slightly sticky, we brew this aromatic pale ale with local triticale, a wheat/rye hybrid.

Name: Fullsteam Rocket Science IPA
Description: We longed for a true-to-style IPA that exuded confidence in its restraint, that paired well with any meal, and wouldn't destroy your palate.

Name: Fullsteam Paycheck Pilsner
Description: A Southern-sourced Pilsner with local barley and corn, Paycheck is crisp, dependable, and rewarding. New Zealand hops give a new-world twist to this otherwise true-to-style classic.

Name: Barnstable Brewing Amerihop
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Barnstable Sweet Night Milk Stout
Description: Not a fan of dark beers? Don’t be so sure. This easy-drinking stout features a malt bill that includes flaked oats and roasted barley. We added lactose during the brewing process to give it a smooth, creamy taste.

Name: Barnstable Brewing Vanilla Milkshake IPA
Description:
Introducing the “Milkshake IPA Series”! Building on top of our hazy, New England IPAs, we tweaked the recipe with the goal of dialing down the extracted bitterness, increase hop-derived tropical fruit aroma, soften the mouth-feel, and add an overall subtle sweetness to the final product. This rotating IPA series will feature different types of brewing additions.

We brought back the first version in this rotating series: the Vanilla Milkshake IPA, brewed with lactose and fermented on top of vanilla beans imported from Mexico and Madagascar. The result of this beer is a soft, sweet IPA with complex aromas of vanilla and coconut.

Name: Everybody’s Mountain Mama Citra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Everybody’s Sprinkles Hibiscus Sour
Description: An American Sour Red Ale brewed with Hibiscus Flowers. Dark pink to red in color, this beer is kettle soured, clean and crisp with a balanced acidity that accentuates aromas of honey, roses, and Riesling grapes.

Name: Everybody’s Little Sister
Description: Little Sister ISA is grassy and dry, as expected given the lighter malt bill. It does deliver a flowery aroma and bitter bite.

Name: Gritty’s Halloween Ale
Description: Every fall marks the return of our legendary Halloween Ale – the beer so good, it’s scary! This masterful brew is not only a great rendition of the Extra Special Bitter style (ESB) but a great alternative to the annual onslaught of pumpkin beers. No pumpkins are harmed in the brewing of this beer!    This robust brew has a deep amber color, a bold, malty palate and a well-rounded hop finish. Halloween Ale is smooth and creamy with a medium-to-full body. It has a big malty flavor with toasted caramel balanced by ripe pear and faint apple undertones. The hops give it ample bitterness, but the beer finishes a bit sweet. Halloween Ale, the perfect beer for a crisp autumn day!

Name: Gritty Mcduff’s Black Fly Stout
Description: There's beer and then there's stout, and Gritty McDuff 's Black Fly Stout is the real deal. Black Fly is a dry, all-malt stout packed with roasted flavor.

Name: Gritty’s Halloween Ale
Description: Every fall marks the return of our legendary Halloween Ale – the beer so good, it’s scary! This masterful brew is not only a great rendition of the Extra Special Bitter style (ESB) but a great alternative to the annual onslaught of pumpkin beers. No pumpkins are harmed in the brewing of this beer!    This robust brew has a deep amber color, a bold, malty palate and a well-rounded hop finish. Halloween Ale is smooth and creamy with a medium-to-full body. It has a big malty flavor with toasted caramel balanced by ripe pear and faint apple undertones. The hops give it ample bitterness, but the beer finishes a bit sweet. Halloween Ale, the perfect beer for a crisp autumn day!

Name: Main Street 420/4 Apa
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Main Street Hop Daddy IPA
Description: Who’s your daddy? If you like huge, fruity aromas and the massive citrusy palette of the classic West Coast IPA, Hop Daddy will have you crying out his name. Big but balanced, assertive while eminently drinkable, our blend of nugget, cascade, and citra hops leaves you relishing bold grapefruit, passion fruit, and mango. Vienna, aromatic, and pilsner malts give this IPA a sturdy malt backbone. Call him daddy and Hop Daddy will bring you to your knees!

Name: Main Street Hop Momma IPL
Categories: India Pale Lager, Lager, Pale Lager
Description: Mamma always knows best. Especially around the brew-kettle! It takes an expert like her to bring the time-honored discipline of German brewing in harmony with the wild excesses of the West Coast beer scene. And Hop Mamma IPL does it in spades. We added an absurd amount of Amarillo, cascade and falconer’s flight hops for a bright, citrusy frontend that offers notes of orange, grapefruit and pineapple, while a blend of malts (pale, Vienna, wheat, pilsner, aromatic, crystal) carry the middle of this beer, providing a medium body that goes down easy. All of this we built upon a foundation of German lager yeast to achieve that unmistakable backend bite of a strong Vienna lager. Crack open a Hop Mamma IPL and you’ll agree: Mamma always knows best.

Name: Thin Man Minkey Boodle Raspberry Sour Ale
Description: Sour ale aged on raspberries.

Name: Thin Man Bliss Hazy Double IPA
Description: Hazy, light gold body with a fluffy  white head. Nose is dank pine,  ripe citrus, mango & melon

Name: Burley Oak Sorry Chicky
Description: At Burley Oak, we love our sour beers! We also love all the aromas you get from our IPA’s. By dry hopping this lacto-happy beer, we’ve created an extreme sensory experience.

Name: Burley Oak Lost IPA
Description: We scrapped all of the traditional recipes, drank a few beers, and completely lost ourselves in deep conversation about the perfect IPA - the one we could drink all the time. We stripped down our preconceived notions of how an IPA is typically crafted and instead built a recipe that would be the ultimate showcase of the most expressive hops available to brewers today. This west coast style ipa is clean and dry with hops prevalent in the aroma and flavor. We were lost...and now we are in love.

Name: Burley Oak Mos Dank IPA
Description: 100% Motueka kettle hopped and 100% Mosaic dry hopped.

Name: Goodwood Hemp Gose
Description: Slightly salty, nice and tart, with a dash of dank--- this shrub-touched Gose is unlike any other you've had before! Our interpretation of this german-style sour beer is crisp, light and refreshing. The malt body compliments the tartness of the brew and the hemp adds a light herbal aroma and a slight funk on the finish!

Name: Goodwood Louisville Lager
Description: Goodwood Louisville Lager is the first and only beer brewed with 100% Kentucky-grown grains. And, in a tip of the cap to our Slugger-making neighbors downtown, white ash – common in baseball bats – is used to enhance brewing. This results in a light-bodied, perfectly balanced lager with a sweet finish delivered by those Kentucky grains.

Name: All The Fuss Lemondrop Sour
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Tasting Notes: Acidic, Bright, Citrus, Fresh, Sour, Tart
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Cheese - Stinky, Dessert - Fruit, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Sweet, Pork, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Turkey
Description: This intriguingly delicious brew brings an air of mystery to any occasion by our deft use of Lemondrop hops. Moderately tart and lemon forward, it can be shared by sour lovers and casual drinkers alike.

Name: Resolute Standing Room IPA
Description: This IPA will ROCK your taste buds with loads of flavor from our unique blend of Amarillo and Eukenot hops along with Norwegian yeast. Notes of stone fruit and orange reverberate on the palate with a harmonious bitterness.

Name: Grill Sauce American Lager
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Crisp, Floral, Light, Melon, Smooth
Food Pairing: Cheese - Hard Aged, Chicken, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Salads  Greens
Description: This lager has all the crisp and refreshing qualities you want with a touch of originality. Clean up front with a hint of melon on the finish, this beer has got you covered no matter what made you thirsty.

Name: Plan Bee Farm Brewery Barn Beer
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Plan Bee Stock Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: An uncarbonated Bourbon Barrel-Aged Wild Ale with tart stone fruity complexity.

Name: Plan Bee Pepper Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description:
New York Wild Ale brewed with farm grown hot peppers and aged in oak. 

All the peppers from our raised beds which includes jalapeño, habanero, Thai, ghost, cayenne, Tabasco, Caribbean hot, Scotch bonnet - we added each pepper at a different time in the boil so you can pick out each one in the flavor profile!

Name: Platform Beer Co. Tart Fizz
Description: Our new take on an old staple. This traditional Berliner weisse is turned into a refreshing, balanced brew with additions of strawberry and lemon to harken back to that nieghborhood lemonade stand.

Name: Platform New Cleveland
Description: This Pilsner/Pale Ale Hybrid is a clear straw color with a crisp German malt body and refreshing Noble hop finish with floral and herbal aromas.

Name: Platform Open Bar Hard Seltzer Variety Pack
Description: Mixed Variety of our 4 newest seltzer creations - Painkiller, Aviation, Blueberry-Lavender, and Peach-Ginger

Name: Lost Nation Mosaic IPA
Description: Our single hop IPA is brewed and dry hopped with Mosaic hops. Clean and crisp with an incredible balance between juicy fruit flavors and hop bitterness.

Name: Fiction Carrate Cake Sour
Description: This carrot cake kettle sour is a collaboration with Tattered Flag Brewery and Still Works in Pennsylvania. This brewery is veteran owned and operated and we appreciate their military level of precision in brewing and their burgeoning sour program with unique ingredients. The mission: creating a beer that has characteristics similar to carrot cake. Difficulty level: high. Too much or too little of any ingredient could throw the balance off entirely. Our approach: simple Berliner Weisse base with pilsner malt, wheat malt, and a touch of oats. Carrot cake simulation: 100 lbs. of carrot juice, rich dark brown sugar, golden molasses, and lactose. Restrained usage of nutmeg and cinnamon

Name: Fiction Beer Co Margarita Gose
Description: The beach is calling and our margarita gose will take you there! Inspired by Jimmy Buffett's 'A Salty Piece of Land', this adventurous concoction will take you from the rivers of the Rocky Mountains to the seas of the Caribbean. The gose style is refreshing and drinkable; lightly sour, lightly salty, and full of flavor - just what you want after hiking a 14er or dropping your main sail. Forget about that lost shaker of salt; we brewed our margarita gose to bring some of the beach to you with Makrut lime leaves, sea salt, and lime zest. This beer is a touch salty and a lot limey.

Name: Fiction Liquid Idiom IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A collaboration with Wiley Roots Brewing Company. Sitting down with the fine folks from Wiley Roots is always a great time. As brewers, we both tend to color outside the lines: we forge our own path to create unique, flavorful, and interesting beers. For our newest collaboration we started with a style we both know well: a New England Style IPA. And because we thrive on a foray into the unknown (and unconventional), we used a US Provoak hop addition. Provoak is a special blend of hops and toasted white oak. The toasted white oak powder blend adds a unique complexity to the flavor and aroma to this IPA. Massive amounts of Nelson and Sabro hops in the dry hop create the flavors of fresh coconut, ripe mango, and crisp gooseberry notes

Name: Connecticut Valley The Ledge Gose
Description: This German Style Gose soured with pinot noir grapes (the oldest grape variety in the world dating back to the first century, when the Romans enjoyed them) is a beautiful rose color with the wonderful aroma of tart berries and currants that that entice your palette to take a sip. It is tart, but not overly sweet as it is balanced nicely with the sea salt. Flavors of black cherry, strawberry, savory spice and everything nice is what makes this Gose the perfect drink Anytime, Anywhere, Any weather

Name: Connecticut Valley Cosmic Circus
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The latest in our Galaxy series, Cosmic Circus, combines the clean passion fruit aroma of Galaxy with the deep grapefruit flavor of Citra to create this 6% NEIPA. This brew opens with a subtle burst of pineapple before finishing with a hint of melon. Step right up and taste the show!

Name: CT Valley Spiked Smoothie Lemonade
Description: No offense to margaritas and G&Ts, but all other refreshing summer drinks are now playing for second place. Imagine the fresh-squeezed, ice-cold lemonade of those childhood front-yard stands….Just spiked for the grown-ups. Until it’s possible to can summer, this is what it tastes like.

Name: Decadent Guava Sorbet
Description: Hints of pink guava and sea salt with a tart finish.

Name: Decadent Apple Crumb Cake
Description: IPA designed to bring out all the fall flavors reminiscent of an apple crumb cake: Apple puree, Lactose, Cinnamon, and Vanilla bean are combined for a sweet and decadent ale.

Name: Decadent Ales Coconut French Toast IPA
Description: DIPA brewed with Vermont Maple Syrup, coconut and stovetop caramelized sugars & cinnamon. Hopped with Simcoe and Mosaic.

Name: Lenny Boy Brewing Strawberry Seduction Kettle Sour Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: We use cold pressed strawberries to unveil a sweet and tart flavor profile. We soured this beer to seduce your taste buds. This sour will steal your heart.

Name: Lenny Boy Brewing Citraphilia IPA
Description: Our flagship IPA was brewed with massive amounts of Citra hops and blended with Amarillo and Ekuanot hops to leave you with a tropical citrus experience.

Name: Lenny Boy Brewing Life In The South Lager
Description: Using a true Southern staple, the addition of grits to the beer lightens the body and creates a crips and crushable beer.

Name: Scires With Cherries
Description: Brewed by way of single step infusion. Bottom fermenting yeast is added to induce fermentation at 10°C (48°F). When attenuation reaches 50 %, it is blended with a combination of old and young sour beer that were fermented with lactic acid bacteria, wild yeast and black sweet cherries. The fermentation continues and the natural sugars from the malt and cherries are converted to alcohol. At the end of primay fermentation, fresh beer wort and top fermenting Saccharomyces Cerevisiae yeast are added. The beer is then bottled and sent to refermentation in a cold room at around 7°C (42°F). The refermentation lasts about 4 months.

Name: Birrificio Italiano Fleurette Gioia Di Vivere
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer

Name: Cassissona Black Currant
Description: A small amount of cassis is added to Cassissona at the beginning of the fermentation. It is matured for at least six months. Bottle-conditioned & unpasteurized, it is a stylish melange of 3 malts and 3 hops varieties. It has a rich, complex fruity aroma - primarily black currant - along with other intense flavors and scents of vanilla and toffee. 6.5% alcohol by volume.

Name: Keegan Ales Mother’s Milk Stout
Description: Mother's Milk  as the name implies  is a dark and creamy milk stout. Hints of oatmeal  chocolate and of course  milk make Mother's Milk's remarkably smooth and silky finish a classic example of the style.

Name: Keegan Ales Joe Mama’s Milk
Description: Big brother to our Mother’s Milk, Joe Mama’s starts with out Mother’s Milk recipe. We then add copious amounts of brown sugar to add body and increase the alcohol. After primary fermentation we then infuse a cold coffee extract from our friends down the street, Monkey Joe’s Roasting Company.

Name: Keegan Ales Hurricane Kitty IPA
Description: Hurricane Kitty is a coppery and heavily hopped India Pale Ale. Named after brewmaster Keegan's grandmother who's driving earned her quite a reputation racing her six children to and from a local Long Island beach ferry during the 1960's  Hurricane Kitty is the undisputed family favorite. We try to make the hop bill read as aggressively as her driving record.

Name: Black Acre One 10 Coffee Stout
Description: Cold steeped with Bee Roaster’s Artemis espresso.  Rich flavors of chocolate & dark fruit balance the coffee’s dark roast and acidity.

Name: Black Acre Saucy Intruder Rye IPA
Description: An American style IPA with large additions of rye malt.

Name: Black Acre Saucy Intruder 1/6 Bb
Description: An Aggressive, Hop forward Rye IPA. Saucy Intruder is a perfect balance of malty rye spiciness and strong citrus hop flavors.
