Name: Saucony Creek Brewing Maple Mistress Imperial Pumpkin Ale
Description:
In the autumn of 1720, Captain Jack Rachman and his pirate-mates were celebrating their victories in typical hard-drinking tradition. Suddenly a British Navy sloop surprised them. The drunken pirates hid below deck, leaving Captain Jack’s mistresses Anne Bonney and Mary Read to defend the ship. The women shared a reputation as “fierce hell cats,” but the British Navy eventually overtook the pirate ship. Captain Jack and the pirates were sentenced to hang. Anne visited her lover in his cell before his execution, and instead of loving words her scathing comments live on throughout history, “Had you fought like a man, you need not have been hang’d like a dog.” Their legacy inspired us to brew an equally ferocious Imperial Pumpkin Ale brewed with pirate rum spices. We added a touch of autumn flavor with roasted butternut squash and natural maple syrup.

Imperial Pumpkin Ale brewed with pirate rum spices. Roasted butternut squash and natural maple syrup lend some autumn charm in this warming 10% brew

Name: River Styx Prometheus
Description: He melded humans from clay and gave us fire. Imperial stout with notes of coffee, vanilla beans, and aged on hazelnut and coconut.

Name: River Styx Triple Galaxy
Description: The titan god of the stars. Astraios is a hoppy/hazy beer with Galaxy as the featured hop. This is the Triple IPA version of Galaxy of Astraios.

Name: River Styx Venom of Cerberus
Description: Often called the Hound of Hades. Cerberus was the three headed dog that guarded the gates to The Underworld. Venom is a hoppy and hazy New England Triple that will warm you up at 10% ABV.

Name: Blue Hills Three Peak Imperial Stout Bomber
Blue Hills Quarter Mile Double IPA
Description: Coming in big at over 80 IBU’s and Alc. 8% by volume. This beer is designed with the old school big blocks in mind. Lots of 2 – row malt goes into this beer to attain the high gravity. More than two pounds of hops per barrel are added to give an overdrive hop punch. To turbo boost the flavor profile, this Double IPA is UN-filtered and packaged fresh.

Name: Blue Hills Imperial IPA
Description: This unfiltered beer is a combination of our Red Baron Ale and our Flagship IPA blended to achieve a smooth malt flavor with an imperial hop PUNCH. It weighs in at 9% A.B.V.

Name: Hubbard’s Cave Chocolate & Cinnamon Pot De Créme Imperial Stout

Description: Hopped Exclusively with Citra Hops

Old Nation M-43 N.E. IPA

Name: Pilsner Urquell Beer
Description:
Plzen in the Czech Republic was literally born to make beer. When King Wenceslas II of Bohemia founded the city in 1295, he granted its 260 households the right to make beer. For hundreds of years, this worked great. Yet as might be expect with this many home brewers, quality varied over time. It was easy to get beer but not so easy to get good beer. In 1838, several of the more enthusiastic brewers in town declared 36 barrels undrinkable and dumped them out in front of the town hall. This drove the brewing households to join forces and collectively build a brewery -- The Citizens Brewery of Plzen. The idea was to create a state of the art brewery to put in place a series of new beer making practices that were making their way across central Europe, such as the production of pale malt. Under the main building they dug a network of ice-cooled tunnels for another new technique called laagering (from the German 'lager'- to store). Four years later they revealed a golden clear, crisp, light-bodied beer that blew the doors off the dark and cloudy beers of the time.

Pilsner Urquell is still brewed in the same brewery with the same soft Plzen water, saaz hops from Zatec, Czech barley from Moravia, and the same H-strain yeast. We still germinate and malt ourselves, and continue to triple-decoct our mash over open flames. Pilsner Urquell is the World’s Original Pilsner. With aromas of fresh bread, hints of Saaz hops and honeysuckle, taste notes of caramel maltiness balanced by a distinct bitterness, and a nice creamy mouthfeel and smooth, refreshing finish, it is easy to see why the original pilsner is a great session beer. 

Excellent choice for craft beer and import beer drinkers looking for an authentic, easy-drinking beer. The light beer is perfect for any occasion, such as sporting events, daytime adult beverage activities, warm weather sessionabilty, barbeques, and food pairing occasions that compliment traditional European dishes, as well as neutral flavored salted snacks.

Description:

Milwaukee’s Best Ice won the bronze medal for American-Style Specialty Lager at the 2003 Great American Beer Festival and 2006 World Beer Cup. 

Born in Milwaukee, WI, Milwaukee's Best Ice is a refreshing, smooth, highly drinkable American-Style Ice Lager. Milwaukee's Best Ice is available in a variety of packages. Whether you're bringing a six pack for a sports party, a 24 pack for a poker night, a thirty pack for your next tailgate barbecue or a 15 pack to stock your pantry you can count on Milwaukee's Best Ice to deliver a bolder taste because it's ice brewed. Name: Gray Duck Bomba Juice Seltzer

We are proud to bring you three flavors of what we know are the cleanest, most brightly flavored, balanced and completely un-junked seltzers on the market. How do we know this? Simply put, our seltzer is the most purely natural tasting drink of its kind…period!

Each ingredient is sourced locally and brewed/canned in Shakopee, MN at Gray Duck Brewing Company.

Name: Tighthead Scarlet Fire Irish Red Ale
Description: Scarlet Fire is an Irish/American style Red Ale. The name is a reference to the playful, improvisational transitions between Grateful Dead songs Scarlet Begonias and Fire on the Mountain. Great balance of malt sweetness from caramel malt and subtle toasty notes from roasted barley. Brewed withj American Ale yeast, and East Kent Golding hops, it pays tribute to it's heritage as an Irish Red Ale.

Name: Tighthead Brew Irie IPA
Description: A malty and complex IPA which supports the generous amounts of Chinook, Centennial, and Colombus hops. American Ale Yeast ferments this beer cleanly allowing the dank hop qualities to shine through.

Name: Maxline Irish Red Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: A Maxline Family favorite, Irish Red has been served in our taproom since we opened our doors in 2016.  With notes of caramel and toffee backed up by dark fruit undertones, this ale is supremely satisfying yet endlessly quaffable.  The perfect brew no matter the season!

Name: Maxline IPA
Description:
Appearance: Pale Golden with light haze. Bright white, effervescent head.

Aroma: Tropical Fruit (Mango, pineapple, grapefruit), Light resinous pine and grainy malt

Flavor: Bright citrus and tropical fruit up front with lingering smooth bitterness on the back end.

Mouthfeel: Medium-light with clean and fresh palate on finish

Pairings: Spicy foods, Indian Curry, Barbecue, Cheddar Cheese, Rich Chocolate Cake

Name: Bitter Sisters Knock Out Irish Red
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: Our traditional Irish Red is a punched up ale with a perfect balance of bready, slightly toffee flavors of the malt mixed with the bitterness of traditional English hops. We use authentic English caramel, dark crystal and chocolate malts along with a good amount of two row barley which kicks this traditional style up a few notches.

Name: Six Mile Bridge Irish Red Ale
Description: This deep ruby-red ale is smooth, medium-bodied and brewed with over 40 lbs of honey to create layers of caramel and toffee notes

Name: Six Mile Bridge Cinnamon Maple Stout
Description: We’ve added an exotic flair to this stout with Indonesian Cassia Bark for an earthy cinnamon aroma. Just when you thought it couldn’t get better, we added our favorite 100% Vermont maple syrup for a winter combo that’s sure to warm you up!

Name: Element Brewing Red Giant
Description: Deep ruby in color, Red Giant contains caramel malt sweetness combined with significant hop bitterness and leathery aroma, resulting in a balanced flavor profile. Not a singular beer, Red Giant’s complexity offers a new flavor with every sip.

Name: Element Plasma Sake IPA

Name: Belmont Brewing Strawberry Blonde

Name: Firemans Redhead Ale

The use of ""crystal malt"" in the brewing process imparts a rich caramel flavor. This combination creates a flavor packed red ale like you’ve never had before!

Name: Firemans Blonde Beer

Name: Milwaukee Hop Freak Double IPA
Description: Herb-in legend is our series of adventure brews. A collaboration with Milwaukee’s Rishi Tea, this IPA is infused with organic jasmine tea, lending it a sweet, floral aroma, Strong citrus notes come form a generous amount of American hops. Hop Freak was born big and bitter but a subtle malt bill adds balance to this beast

Name: Stagecoach Honey Golden Ale

Brewed with generous amounts of noble hops, honey malts are added to balance the hop bitterness and to bring a touch of sweetness to the finish.

Name: Peach Habanero Imperial Red Ale
Description: Beautifully sinful. This unique ale is balanced between the perfect amounts of malt and hops. Tip toeing in is soft tones of peaches finished by the kick of roasted habanero! Our Colorado peach has a wicked right hook.

Name: Crabtree Brewing Oatmeal Stout

Name: Birra Menabrea Ambrata Lager

A full-bodied beer belying its alcoholic strength.

Name: Menabrea Bionda Lager
Categories: Dortmunder  Export Lager, Lager, Pale Lager

Name: Asher Tree Hugger Organic Amber
Description: Living up to its roots, this full-bodied American classic boasts the perfect balance of naughty and nice. Crystal and Munich malts bring a caramel sweetness to the brew. Yet just when you think you’ve satisfied your sweet tooth, the organic German hops produce an unmistakeable dry finish. Take that, taste buds! With a toffee aroma and deep amber color, the Tree Hugger Amber looks innocent enough… but tastes sinfully delicious.

Name: Asher Green Bullet Organic IPA
Description: Green Bullet Organic IPA is a American IPA style beer brewed by Asher Brewing Company in Boulder, CO.

Name: Yukon Red
Description: When we were designing our flagship brands, we knew we would not please everybody, so we went for diversity; our Yukon Red is substantially different from our Yukon Gold. But what has surprised us most is that our local Yukoners have taken both of our flagship brands to heart (and to dinner, and to parties…) and drank almost equivalent quantities of each! This speaks volumes for the apparent consumer cravings for beers with flavour, and Yukon Red is all about flavour.

Name: Yukon Gold
Description: The Yukon’s number one selling draught (yes, including the mega-breweries), this ale was designed to be an almost “non-ale”. It is golden in colour, brilliantly clear, and clean across the palate. The mix of 5 malts still provides subtle character in the body, and the addition of malted wheat provides a slight, but characteristic citrusy finish.

Name: Devil’s Canyon Deadicated Amber Ale
Description:
Deadicated™ Amber Ale pours a beautiful tawny color with a fine lace head.You’ll find this rich, medium bodied ale to have a well-balanced bouquet with a crisp cascade hop finish.
Multiple awards later – it goes to show, you don’t ever know.

Name: Devil’s Canyon California Sunshine Rye IPA
Description: At 85 IBU’s, California Sunshine™ Rye IPA is exceptionally well balanced with assertive hop bitterness, a toasty and bready malt mouth-feel, and a grassy, dry finish.Enjoy our uniquely original re-imagining of a traditional unfiltered English style IPA while pondering being the craft beer polymath you surely are.

Name: Garden Path Fermentation Amber Dreams of Electric Sheep
Description: Foudre-fermented, oak matured, malt-accented, native yeast amber ale, that undergoes extended bottle & keg conditioning with local blackberry honey

Name: Garden Path Fermentation The Gardens Path Led to Flowered
Description: Hoppy blonde ale fermented with native Skagit Valley yeast in an open foudre, blended with oak-matured beer, dry-hopped, and naturally conditioned with Skagit blackberry honey from The Valley’s Buzz.

Name: Kawaba Snow Weizen
Description: Refreshing and smooth. A 100% wheat beer, Snow Weizen starts with a soft subtle entry on the palate and develops into a round full bodies weizen.

Name: Coastal Empire Southern Delight
Description: Our Praline Amber Ale is brewed with a generous addition of Georgia Pecans and Madagascar vanilla. We also add lactose to accentuate the natural caramel flavors from the malt. These additions combine to produce a flavor reminiscent of a traditional Southern candy, the praline.

Name: Coastal Empire Inshore Slam IPA
Description: Our IPA is aggressively hopped and comes in at 75 IBUs. The hop aromas and flavors are a balance of melon, citrus, spicy, and funky hop notes that come from the blend of four types of hops. This balance provides a intense hop flavor without an overpowering hop bite.

Name: Siren Liquid Mistress Dark Red Ale
Description: Cask conditioned and keg unpasteurised br A 5.8% west coast bright red ale: burnt raisins and crackers balanced by citrus. Liquid Mistress is our femme fatale – mysterious, seductive and disarming. She draws and charms drinkers with her full, red colours. You will soon desire her biscuit-and-burnt-raisin malt base, and peach and grapefruit spark. Her devious hop hit will steal your breath.

Name: Siren Caribbean Chocolate Cake
Description: Collaboration with Cigar City. Tropical Stout packed with experimental hop varieties, specially imported Dominican Cacao Nibs, Lactose Sugar and aged on Cyprus wood.

Name: Ancient City Matanzas River Red
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: An Irish style red ale that is full of malty characteristics. Brewed with a touch of chocolate malt and an abundance of roasted barley, this beer is rich and robust.

Name: Ancient City Galleon’s Golden Ale
Description: An American Golden Ale with a medium body that's sweet and malty. This ale is brewed with pilsner-style hops to create a summertime style beer that finishes crisp and clean.

Name: McSorley’s Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, Amber  Red Ale, Irish Red
Description: At McSorley's ale is well. McSorley's Irish Pale Ale is from the old house at home. Established in 1854 in NYC and brewed by McSorley's Brewery in Wilks-Barre, PA. Brewed in the tradition of the historic walls of McSorley's Old Ale House. It took 116 years, the pressure of public opinion and ultimately the authority of a court order for McSorley's to surrender. By the mid 1970s, McSorley's allowed woman inside the bar at 15 E. 7th St for the very first time. Ah, but the owners did not completely forgo tradition, women would wait until 1986 to get their own restroom.

Name: McSorley’s Irish Black Lager
Description: Pours a deep dark brown with thin off-white head. Aromas of caramel, honey, roasted malts and a touch of hops. Sweet flavors up front, with some balancing hops coming through in the middle. Crisp and smooth. Light to medium-bodied.

Name: Scenic Brewing Andes Ascent
Description: Named by a Brew Crew member for the many climbs he's attempted.  Amber ales have a stronger caramel flavor, more body,  and have a balance between bitterness and maltiness.  Great year round beer!

Name: Scenic Brewing Uncharted IPA
Description: An IPA which explains our path through life with a unfinished map to our destination.  We bring in several hops of floral, tropical, citrus, and pine to show a classic American IPA.  These hops explain the forest we travel and the beaches we want to explore.  A beer for every occasion and to start the next adventure.

Name: Napa Smith Lost Dog Red Ale
Description: This full-bodied American Red Ale is rich and robust; the bright copper/red color is topped off with a foamy white head that displays a distinctly unique beer. Malt and hop flavors blend together in a delightfully balanced beer. Incorporating a historically English malt backbone, but finishing with a restrained hop character, Lost Dog is full, yet crisp, and clean. The perfect pint to share with a long lost friend.

Name: Napa Smith Bonfire Imperial Porter
Description: Our family brings together the finest ingredients and 35 years of brewing experience to produce our proprietary beers. Imported roasted premium malts and hops produce rich and creamy chocolate and coffee flavors in this fine Imperial Porter Ale.

Name: Network Chai Red
Description: Chai-Spiced Red Ale - One of our most unique beers, Santiago Creek is well-balanced, has earthy & toasty malt flavors with notes of Chai Spice without being overpowering. This tea/beer hybrid is fantastic and can't be found anywhere else!

Name: Network Two Week Notice
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This popular West Coast IPA has floral notes with citrus, fruitful, and hoppy flavors.

Name: Roots Organic Island Red
Description: We call this a red stout. A very full bodied complex ale brewed with a good amount of oats which help give this red a very rich and creamy head.

Name: Roots Organic Woody IPA
Description: 73.3 IBU, 6.0% abv - dry hopped with magnum hops. FKA Cockeyed IPA.

Name: J Wells The Pleasant Gentleman IPA
Description: Grapefruity IPA with a lingering bitterness. Bold flavor, and Bold color.

Name: Mountain State Almost Heaven Amber Ale
Description: Nut brown in color and lightly hopped with Willamette, this beer is dominated by a pleasing caramel finish that is darn close to heavenly.

Name: Mountain State Miner’s Daughter Oatmeal Stout
Description: Coal Black and creamy smooth, this beer holds a light tan head and is surprisingly light in body – so it won’t fill you up.

Name: Broken Bow Red Ale
Description: Our Broken Red Ale begins with a light toffee & herbal hop notes. This beer has a malty, lightly sweetened personality that is smooth & easy on the palate. Subtle caramel aroma, topped with a cream-colored head, this beer is a jack-of-all-trades when it comes to food pairings.

Name: Broken Bow Old Split-Foot Belgian Golden Strong Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: A full-bodied Belgian ale, intense and complex with a rich, creamy head. The nose is a fruity bouquet topped with honey and clove notes. This "devilish" beer finishes with a spicey alcohol warmth. GOLD MEDAL WINNER, The Great American Beer Festival 2016 - Belgian-Style Strong Specialty Ale -AND- Bronze Medal Can-Can Awards 2018!

Name: Mudshark Scorpion Amber Ale
Description: Overall Impression: A beer that is cleanly malty with a few esters. It has a relatively sweet palate, and as such has a different balance than other Scotch ales.

Name: Mudshark Full Moon Belgian White Ale
Description: One of our top selling beers, a refreshing and high-strength wheat-based ale, yet still smooth and creamy.

Name: Grizzly Paw Rutting Elk Red Scottish Red Ale
Description: A medium bodied Scottish style red ale, this beer has a rich malty flavor with layers of chocolate & roasted malts and just enough English hops for balance.

Name: Cannery Anarchist Amber Ale
Description: Anarchist Amber Ale is a medium bodied ale with balance. Two row ESB malts from Gambrinus Malting provides the backbone for this beer. The addition of crystal and honey malts give this beer its colour and slight caramel sweetness. Chinook hops and California Ale yeast contribute to the crisp, dry finish.

Name: Cannery Brewing Knucklehead Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: Nothing says fall better than this gnarly, spiced-up brown ale. We added 250 pounds of roasted knucklehead pumpkin along with traditional fall spices to this seasonal ale. Not your average knucklehead's ale!

Name: Big Thompson Dani’s Red Ale
Description:
This malt forward, sweet, Irish Red Ale was created by former Beertender Danielle Baker! 

Brewed to be a balanced beer with a medium body, with caramel and toffee flavors and just a subtle note of hoppy bitterness.

Name: Big Thompson Streamside Strawberry Blonde Ale
Description: This light and pale blonde ale is sweetened with Strawberries! We used Fresh Strawberry Puree as well as extract to create this unique balance of sweet, fresh, and ripe strawberries!

Name: Leffe Blonde Ale
Description: A Belgian blonde ale crafted since 1240 Pairs well with red meat, sweet and sour flavors.

Name: Leffe Blonde Ale 1/4 Barrel
Description: Kegs are intended for Kegerator use only. TAP NOT INCLUDED.  NOTE: An additional deposit charge per keg may be placed on your card for first time customers only. A representative from Drizly or the store will be in contact to confirm all details prior to delivery.   Empty barrels will be picked up upon delivery of new kegs.  For special requests, please contact: kegs@drizly.com --------------- How many beers are in a keg? 1/2 Barrel = 15.5 gallons = 165 beers 50 Liter = 13.2 gallons = 140 beers 1/4 Barrel = 7.75 gallons = 82 beers 1/6 Barrel = 5.2 gallons = 55 beers

Name: Cerveceria Colorado Venga Mexican Lager
Description: A light and easy drinking beer, Venga is delicious when served Chelada-style with rimmed salt and a lime wedge

Name: Cerveceria Colorado Senor Pina Pineapple Blonde Ale
Description: This Blonde Ale was fermented with pineapples and dry hopped with Mosaic hops to create a tropical fruity dream.

Name: Thomas Hooker Blonde Ale
Description: Smooth flavor with a subtle malt sweetness accented with the delicate aroma of Czech hops. This brilliant gold ale is a mellow but flavorful microbrew.

Name: Thomas Hooker Chocolate Truffle Stout
Description: Our sweet stout is made in collaboration with Connecticut's favorite chocolatier, Munson's Chocolate. Copious amounts of oat malt produce a silky, full bodied beer laced with hints of roast and chocolate derived from dark malts. Each sip ends with a mild chocolate bitterness from Munson's proprietary cocoa powder, added generously to the brew. To round out this beer, we add several pounds of cocoa nibs at the end of fermentation to provide a fresh chocolate aroma.

Name: Jasper The Bear Ale
Description: Coriander laced with Alberta grown barley and honey that’s been filtered to create a mellow and enjoyable sweetness.

Name: Jasper Crisp Pils
Description: A true Pilsner – clean Alberta grain flavour followed by a dry crisp hop finish. Brighter than your common domestic lager. Delicious ’til the last sip.

Name: Barley Mow Americana
Description: This approachable Golden Ale has aromas of sweet malt and doughy white wheat followed by a crisp and clean body that finishes slightly dry with a subtle citrus Hop character.

Name: Barley Mow Maven Chocolate Milk Stout
Description: Maven Chocolate Milk Stout over cocoa nibs and barrel aged.

Name: Barrio Tucson Blonde
Description: A good starter beer for those that have only drank the mass produced suds. The blonde is a light, crisp beer with a slight malt flavor and just enough Czechoslovakian Saaz hops to balance the malt sweetness.

Name: Barrio IPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Brewed just like the original from Burton upon Trent. This style calls for a high hop rate combined with an elevated alcohol content because it was brewed to survive the journey from England to Bombay as rations for British troops. Huge amounts of two row pale malt with an addition of a few specialty malts provides a nice mouth feel buried under copious additions of Columbus hops. This beer is big but finishes clean.

Name: THAT Strawberry Blonde
Description: Light bodied blonde ale with an exotic strawberry nose. Starts out slightly sweet with notes of hibiscus, lilac and vanilla. Finishes crisp, clean and refreshing. A beer with flavor, NOT a flavored beer.

Name: THAT Brewery Fossil Creek Arizona IPA
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Chicken, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily
Description: Summer IPA packed full of bright Citra, Cascade and Simcoe hops. Brilliantly aromatic with the refreshing flavors of grapefruit, tangerine and citrus zest. A low ABV, crushable IPA.

Name: Appalachian Mountain Brewery Boone Creek Blonde Ale
Description: An ode to the creek along which we built our brewery, Boone Creek Blonde is a refreshing ale for all seasons. Brewed with orange zest to complement its light hop aroma, the beer has a crisp mouth-feel, followed by a hint of sweetness from wildflower honey, This drinkable and delicious brew is an award-winning ale from Boone's beer pioneer.

Name: Appalachian Mountain Brewery Long Leaf IPA
Description: Taking its name from the toast of the Old North State, this amber IPA cheers with a white head, citrus aroma, and an intense, resins hop flavor that will linger on your palate.

Name: Triplehorn Falcon Cloak Blonde Ale
Description: Clean, crisp Golden ale. Light hops.

Name: Triplehorn Brink 182 IPA
Description: A refreshingly juicy IPA that is slightly hazy in appearance and is highlighted by distinct aromas and flavors of pineapple and grapefruit. The beer is also rounded out by an assertively hoppy finish.

Name: Machine House Golden Ale
Description: One of our three year-round standard offerings. A refreshing Golden Ale, with a bright, crisp malt body and complex English hop character.

Name: Machine House Best Bitter
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Our flagship, best-selling English Bitter. A well balanced, copper coloured ale brewed with British Crystal malts and First Gold hops.

Name: Harlem Sugar Hill Golden Ale
Description: Sugar Hill Golden/Blonde Ale opens with caramel and mild sweetness, while the hops add a nice spiced flavor. A highly drinkable, sessionable ale, Sugar Hill is truly a beer for all occasions. Cheers!

Name: Harlem Renaissance Wit
Description: Brewed with coriander, cumin, grains of paradise, and orange peel, this beer greets you with a wonderful spiced aroma. Look for coriander notes to add a big herbal character, backed up by some supporting citrus zest.

Name: Jopen/Cigar City Waynes World
Description: Collab met Cigar City Brewing. This American Blonde is brewed with Wayne Wambles from Cigar City Brewing. It is brewed with loads of fruity aroma hops to give the beer a fruity resiny flavour. Then we added spicy juniper berries and fresh sliced grapefruit and to top it off , we aged it on cedarwood. So many flavours in one glass…

Name: Monarchy Grodziskie
Description: Five beer enthusiasts with a common passion for historic brewing came together to create this distinct Polish beer style in the most authentic way we can think of after the brewery in Grodzisk Wielkopolski closed in 1993. It is brewed by Jopen and Monarchy of Musselland together with the beer writers Ron Pattinson and Evan Rail. We use 100% oak-smoked wheat malt, have the exact same gravity of 7.7 degrees Plato, employed classic Lublin hops and fermented with the original yeast. As the town once and again today belongs to Poland, but in the meantime was part of Prussia, there are two different names for the style: Grodziskie and Grätzer. Our research found that brewers also formerly used willow bark in brewing which we thought was an interesting variation. That is why we are offering two different takes on the style: a classic version bearing the name "Grätzer"and a willow bark version called "Grodziskie".

Name: Hidden Cove Thunderclap Double IPA
Description: Golden hazy color with melon, orange, strawberry and a hint of lime zest aromas. Fresh melon and grapefruit flavors with hints of tropical fruit.

Name: Weed Cellars Golden Ale
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Caramel, Citrus, Coffee, Dried Fruit, Grainy, Neutral, Nutty, Smooth
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish, Turkey
Description: Golden color ale with a frothy top. Aromas of toast, grainsand lemon waft from the grass. Crisp and refreshing with layers of flavor and a bittersweet finish.

Name: Weed Light
Tasting Notes: Apple, Apricot, Bready, Caramel, Grainy, Light, Malty
Food Pairing: Beef, Chicken, Fish - White, Pasta, Pork, Salads  Greens, Turkey
Description: This brew opens with yellow apple, apricot and brown bread. The generous palate balances between sweet caramel and hoppy bitters. Generous body in a light beer is lifted by the carbonation and refreshing citrous on the finish.

Name: Erie Bayfront Blonde Ale
Description: It doesn't get much easier in Erie than a sunny day by the bay...unless, of course, you remembered to bring some Bayfront Blonde!This light-bodied, blonde ale has plenty of flavor and a remarkably easy finish. So, no matter where your bay is, it's always sunny and 75 with a Bayfront Blonde!

Name: Erie Brewing Company Soleil Shandy
Description: Inspired by the colorful Lake Erie sunsets, Soleil Shandy was created with the craft beer drinker in mind. Our customers were anxious for a light, crisp, warm-weather brew and our brewers responded. They crafted a delightfully refreshing raspberry-lemon Shandy to showcase at our annual summer event “Beer on the Bay.”

Name: Long Leg Fuggles Hop Ale
Description: Long Leg is a traditional, full flavoured, golden ale exclusively brewed using Fuggle hops, both in the copper and as a late addition to give a distinctive, late copper hop flavour. The name honours the tradition of hop picking on stilts in order to harvest the tall crop.

Name: Strongarm Ruby Red Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Cask: Regular. Ruby Red Ale. Fuggles, Goldings, Target and Challenger hops.

Name: Claremont Baseline Imperial Blonde Ale
Description: This beer is part crisp Blonde Ale and part over-the-top Double IPA. It’s brewed with 100% Pilsner malt for a light body and refreshing dryness and hopped aggressively with Citra and Amarillo for a wonderful hop-burst. We top it all off with the addition of real lemon peel for that extra dimension of flavor.

Name: Trinity Forest Blonde Ale
Tasting Notes: Balanced, Bright, Caramel, Crisp, Floral, Light, Round, Smooth, Sweet, Vanilla
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fruit - Sweet, Mushrooms, Pasta, Pork, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens
Description: A smooth blonde ale made with 2-Row and Munich Light malts with a little wheat. German Perle hops give this ale a floral, earthy aroma for a nice, balanced finish. Folks who drink our blonde do have more fun. It's a fact.

Name: Trinity Forest – West Coast IPA
Tasting Notes: Fresh, Stone Fruit, Tropical, Tropical Fruit
Food Pairing: Beef, Chicken, Cured Meats, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Fruit, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Duck  Game Bird, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Fruit - Sweet, Lamb, Root Vegetables, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: LIMITED RE-RELEASE!

Name: Coniston Bluebird Bitter Premium XB
Description: Bottle conditioned - contract brewed by Hepworth for Coniston.  Stronger version of Bluebird. For cask version, see Coniston (Premium) XB.  English Pale Ale with American aroma hops. Bluebird XB combines two of the great themes of ale brewing to produce something distinctive and new. The fine tradition of English Pale Ale is about quaffing, refreshment and complexity of flavour without alcoholic strength  Then throw in a new wave of American hop variety Mount Hood with robust citrus aromas. ... Not too much mind or we might have an American Pale Ale on our hands?  Bluebird XB familiar ... but different

Name: Coniston Brew Bluebird Bitter
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description:
This outstanding brewery, run by Ian Bradley, is where Bluebird Bitter is made. This 3.6% session beer won Supreme Champion Beer of Britain 1998 at the Great British Beer Festival Olympia London and has continued to be awarded accolades of recent years.To the pure waters of the Coniston hills - add the finest Challenger hops and wonderfully roasted pale and crystal malts.
Allow the Coniston Brewing Company to use all their skill and instinctive know-how to create what must be described as the finest fully matured cask conditioned Ales.

Name: Evans Brewing Son Of A Beach Blonde Ale
Description: Son of a Beach Blonde got it’s start when one beer recipe was accidentally mixed with another. No one knew what would result. Ten days later, we tasted this “BASTARD” and the first comment heard was “Son of a B.B.B. Beach, this Blonde is really good”.

Name: Evans Chocolate Porter
Description: Chocolate explosion! The chocolate mines supply us with the necessary ingredients to make this ale. Miners use sticks of dynamite to blow chunks of chocolate into rail cars heading straight to the brewery. We mine the most chocolate and espresso flavor from select grains to produce a massive chocolate flavor that rolls over the tongue into a gentle finish with a hint of espresso. ChocōLatté aims to please those with a cocoa addiction

Name: Hell’s Basement Ryes Against The Machine
Description: This is southern Alberta, so let's talk crops! The hardiest of cereals, rye outperforms all other cover crops on infertile, sandy or acidic soil or on poorly prepared land. Nature can be a ruthless machine on the bald prairie, but our farmers have learned to ryes against the machine! This tough little grain adds character and complexity to our beer, bringing bready and spicy notes to a classic Rye style. Ryes Against the Machine is our tribute to autumn, hard working harvesters, and the rich agricultural heritage of Medicine Hat.

Name: Hell’s Basement Fruit Bat Raspberry Ale
Description: A light and jammy raspberry ale.

Name: Townsite Zunga Blonde Ale
Description: This golden blonde ale has a light bitterness and a balanced body to create a dry, refreshing finish, with hints of European hops. It is the perfect accompaniment to a hot day up the lake.

Name: Townsite Lil Red
Description:
Each year, Lil’ Red changes. This year Cédric and team decided to bring this punchy red ale to the next level. Brettanomyces Bruxellensis was added to the bottles for natural carbonation. Which means there are 2 versions
of this beer this year. The bottle and the keg will be different, one a sweet and tangy refresher and one with a layer of horse blanket funk.

The vibrant acidity of this beer is a dead ringer for shellfish. It is delicate and fruity enough for spot prawns with just a hint of sweetness to complement scallops in herbed butter perfectly.

Name: Riot Currant-ly Unavailable Black Currant Blonde Ale
Description: We apologize for not hanging out as much as we’d like. So much going on, you understand. Story of our lives. If this sounds familiar, crack open this super smooth, slightly tart summer Blonde Ale brewed with local black currants. We know you can pencil this one in.

Name: Riot Sorry We Took So Long Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: We are a little tardy to the party, but here’s a beer. Sorry we took so long. (Oh, and by the way, this saison brewed with Belgian yeast is spicy, with complex aromatics and a slightly fruity finish).

Name: Brass Foundry Crazy Hair Blonde Ale
Brass Foundry Question 63 IPA
Description: A complex IPA that's as mysterious as its name.    We made this for you.    It's yours.  -  Enjoy.

Name: Monty Python’s Holy Grail Ale
Description: This brilliant and bold addition to our flock was created to commemorate the 30th anniversary of one of our finest comedic exports - the Monty Python crew!Years later and Holy Grail is still going strong. With more hops than a killer rabbit, it's a full-flavoured golden ale with a distinctively fruity flavour followed by the Black Sheep signature dry finish. Be warned, this beer has been tempered over burning witches! Only joking.

Name: Black Sheep Monty Python’s Holy Grail Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Another fine addition to the Black Sheep Brewery range of premium bottled ales, our Holy Grail Bitter was specially commissioned to commemorate the 30th anniversary of Monty Python. It has a distinctive taste with plenty of fruity hops, and is full flavoured with a dry and refreshing bitterness.

Name: Williams Bros Scottish Session Golden Ale
Old Irving Beezer IPA
Description: Citra & Mosaic double dry-hopped IPA. 2019 GABF Gold Medal Winner.

Name: Old Irving Della Kölsch
Description: Hallertau Mittelfrüh & Hallertau Blanc hopped German-Style Ale brewed with 100% German malts.

Name: Crystal Springs Blood Orange Kolsch
Description: A crisp, hugely refreshing German style ale with a subtle orange aroma, citrus flavors and just a hint of raspberries.

Name: Crystal Springs IPA
Description: IPA is a signature beer available all year around.

Name: Bainbridge Island Kommuter Kolsch
Description: Bainbridge Island Kolsch is a light, malty German ale, brewed like a lager for maximum clarity and a bright, clean, refreshing taste. Malts: German Pilsner, CaraHell and Sauermalz. Hops: "Noble" Sterling and Tettenang give it just a hint of hoppiness to balance the malt-forwardness. Kolsch

Name: Bainbridge Windfall Grapefruit IPA
Description: Our brand new Spring Seasonal, Windfall Grapefruit IPA showcases the combination of several exciting new hops, paired with refreshing grapefruit. Malt: NW Pale, Special Aromatic and Premium English Caramalt. Hops: ADHA 529, ADHA 484, Cascade, Centennial and Azacca™.

Name: Zipline Kolsch
Description: A refreshing ale that drinks like a lager, our German-style Kölsch pours straw yellow with hints of honey malt character and a smooth, crisp finish.

Name: Portico Gradual Diagonal
Description: Slightly hazy New England IPA. Features citrus and fruity aromas from big whirlpool and dry-hop additions of Mosaic and El Dorado hops. Not too bitter nor overly orange juicy, this IPA delivers a dryness that makes it an IPA you can enjoy again and again.

Name: Magnolia Brewing Co. Kalifornia Kölsch
Description: This is a light, crisp and refreshing golden ale in the style of those brewed in the German city of Cologne (Köln). A slightly sweet aroma with a hint of grassiness leads to herbal and spicy hop character and sweet malt notes. Though fermented at a cool temperature for an ale, our Kölsch ale yeast provides a complex, fruity finish fading to a crisp hop note at the very end. It pairs well with salads, goat cheese, asparagus, fish and lighter sausages such as weisswurst. Kölsch is typically served in small, cylindrical glasses meant to be refilled often, insuring that every glass remains refreshingly cool and with bright effervescence.

Name: Magnolia Brewing Hella Extra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Hopped with Chinook, Strata, Mosaic and Galaxy

Name: Dru Bru Whiskey Barrel Sticke Alt
Description: German Sticke Alt aged in Dry Fly Distillery Whiskey barrels and Kentucky Bourbon barrels from Heaven Hills Distillery. Aged for 8 months then blended to yield a mildly tart beer with flavors of vanilla, oak, and bourbon

Name: Dru Bru Kolsch
Description: Golden colored German style ale with a light-medium body. German grown malts provide a bready aroma and flavor that's balanced with a subtle sweetness character - adding complexity as the beer finishes.

Name: Freigeist Ottekolong
Tasting Notes: Crisp, Dry, Floral, Fruity, Grainy, Grassy
Description:
This 4.8% ABV beer is an unfiltered kolsch from Freigeist, the experimental offshoot of Cologne’s small brewery Braustelle, a part of the Brauerei Goller of Zeil Am Main, Germany. On a clever play on words the name of the beer translates as “ Eau de Cologne."

The beer pours a slightly hazy golden yellow. There is a tall head of thick white foam. The aroma is grassy, lightly fruity with a tart note, a touch floral, all over golden grain with light straw. The taste follows the aromas, moderately bitter, drinking light but flavorful, with a super clean and dry finish.

Name: Freigeist Geisterzug Gose
Description: Gose brewed with spruce needles.

Name: Seismic Brewing Liquifaction Kolsch
Description: Rooted in the history of Koln (Cologne), Germany, Kolsch is an old-world beer style known for its subtly understated flavors of malt and fruit. We enhance this delicate-yet-delicious flavor profile with floral hop nobility and a distinct San Francisco sourdough character to create an homage to the traditional Kolsch beer with a modern twist.

Name: Seismic Brewing Alluvium California Pilsner
Description: Inspired by the traditional pilsners of Northern Germany, Alluvium is brewed with 100% California grown and malted barley to get the crisp, clean finish that is a hallmark of German Pilsner. Generously hopped, Alluvium is aromatically imbued with spicy noble hops and a pleasantly bitter finish.

Name: Sufferfest Beer Shred Kolsch
Description: It's all about balance. Weighing in at 95 cals and 5 carbs per can, the Repeat Kolsch drinks like a champ. We've added cayenne and honey so you can enjoy full flavor while keeping it light.

Name: Sufferfest Flyby Pilsner
Food Pairing: Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Fish - White, Nuts
Description: Our award-winning Flyby Pilsner is a champion for a reason: infinitely versatile and easy to love. This pilsner is brewed with yerba mate tea and lemon peel.

Name: Biscayne Kapitans Kolsch
Description: A traditional German style lager with a light-bodied golden color. Crisp flavor with subtle hop notes. A great, easy drinking, “all-day, all-night” beer.

Name: Biscayne Bay Siren’s Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Our combination of Pilsner, Pale and Wheat malts along with French hops and an authentic Belgian yeast creates a beer with a distinguished taste, a generous bitterness and a nice balance between body and bite. Unfiltered to keep its character intact.

Name: High Water Cucumber Kolsch
Description: Prepare for a journey to the land of quaffability. Our Cucumber Kolsch is brewed with pure German Pilsner malt, fresh Cucumber and Mint and the delicate caress of the finest German noble hops. Whether you’re relaxing at the beach or in your backyard, make the experience complete with this fine refreshing ale. From our hands to yours, enjoy the best nature has to offer.

Name: Highwater Breakfast Sour
Description: Central Valley Breakfast Sour is aged in used wine barrels for one year with the finest fruit from the Central Valley of California. It is a bright and beautiful golden sour with an abundance of fresh pressed white grapefruit juice. The tart beginnings are rounded by the lusciousness from the pears and the delicate, exotic perfume of the lychee fruit. A pleasurable ale to enjoy with brunch or anytime of the day.

Name: Black Plague Brewing Revival Kolsch
Description: The aroma of honeycomb is derived from the specialty malts that enhance the flavor. Leaving you with a crisp, subtle malty finish with a hint of honey. Let this Lager revive your spirit from your modern day struggle.

Name: Black Plague Brewing Tropicus Pale Ale
Description: Your first taste of Tropicus will redefine “Fruit Beer”. This tropical hybrid beer feels like drinking the sweet taste of sunset on a hot summer day. It’s not just a flavor; it’s a way of life.

Name: Sucker Free City Kolsch
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Nutty  Semi-Firm, Chicken, Cured Meats, Pork, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: Light, crisp, refreshing

Name: Black Bay Milk Stout
Food Pairing: Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Nuts, Shellfish
Description: Notes of roasted coffee and chocolate milk

Name: E9 Brewing The Duel Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Wild ale with raspberries and cherries.

Name: Toms River Koastal Kolsch Style Ale
Description: Pilsner, Vienna and Munich malts come together to create a beer that is subtle yet complex as the city of its origin, Koln, Germany. A delicately balanced malt profile that's kept in check with a moderate bitterness from the use of a single Noble hop throughout the boil, nothing but love for Hallertau Mittelfruh hops. A refreshing low ABV brew that does not lack in flavor, it's just what the warmer weather ordered for days spent being Köastal down the shore.

Name: Toms River Sa Bro Coconut Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: An American pale ale brewed with lactose (milk sugar) along with a generous amount of Pilsner malt, and both white and flaked wheat to create a soft and pillow-y mouthfeel, along with a cracker-like backbone. Huell Melon, experimental hop HBC-472 and of course Sabro crank out a bouquet of tropical fruit amidst a tidal wave of coconut goodness bursting from the unique HBC-472 and Sabro hops. Close your eyes, take a sip and charge, Sa-Bro.

Name: Dr Jekylls Beer Belly
Description: Beer Belly, a truly unique American Kölsch Style Ale boasts the finest organic Perle and Cascade hops, along with the finest organic malts. Its complex flavors combine hints of raspberry and grapefruit along with aromatic notes of cardamom and coriander. Other super ingredients include acai berry, maqui berry, green tea, green coffee bean, raspberry keytone, and grapefruit fiber. This incredibly light and refreshing low calorie beer will broaden your senses but not your waist line!

Name: Dr. Jekyll’s Bio Beer IPA
Description: Bio Beer, a remarkable one-of –a-kind, India Pale Ale, more in the spiced IPA category — not to be confused with the aggressively hopped West Coast IPAs. Dr. Jekyll’s Bio Beer boasts the finest organic Simcoe®, Perle and Cascade hops, along with the finest organic malts. Experience its complex flavors which combine hints of ginger and clove with aromatic floral notes of citrus and berry. Super foods and spices such as acai berry, acerola fruit, maitake mushroom, turmeric, garlic, green tea, clove oil and ginger, are blended together in perfect harmony to provide a boost to your body, as well as your senses.

Name: (512) Pecan Porter
Description: Nearly black in color, (512) Pecan Porter is made with Organic US 2-row and copious amounts of Crystal malt, along with Baird’s Chocolate and Black malts. Its full body and malty sweetness are balanced with subtle pecan aroma and flavor from locally grown pecans. Yet another true Austin original! Made with 83% organic ingredients (by dry weight)

Name: (512) IPA
Description: (512) India Pale Ale is a big, aggressively dry-hopped American IPA with smooth bitterness (~65 IBU) balanced by medium maltiness. Glacier yields vanilla and grapefruit, Simcoe a citrusy and earthy balance, and finished off with pounds of dank Columbus. Made with 88% organic ingredients (by dry weight)

Name: J Dubs Bell Cow Chocolate Porter
Description: A Milk Chocolate Porter featuring rich notes of Chocolate and a medium-bodied mouth feel. The sweetness from the lactose blends well with the dark malts. The combination of flaked oats and the dark malts results in a tan-colored head. Enjoy our Bell Cow. Moo.

Name: Howler Mocha Joe’s Espresso Roast Porter
Komes Raspberry Baltic Porter
Description: It offers a unique combination of sweetness from the porter and vanilla and fruity notes of raspberries, topped with a slightly spicy finish.

Name: Mothers Nudie Suit Porter
Description:
Grease up your pompadour and throw on your Nudie Suit, ‘cause the spotlight’s on you. Big malt flavor and body meet a flashy American hop bitterness. Here’s an American porter as bold and stylish as you are, slick.

Profile: Robust chocolate malt flavor with a balanced hop bitterness.

Malt flavor and aroma of coffee and dark chocolate, balanced hop bitterness, lingering flavors of caramel and burnt sugars.

Name: Mothers Lil’ Helper IPA
Description:
Help yourself to a well-balanced India Pale Ale with bright, citrus hop character and a clean, refreshing finish. Lil’ Helper is a union of classic American hop varietals and a welcoming Midwestern malt backbone. Go running for its shelter. 

Profile: Citrus and tropical fruit flavors balanced by a subtle, malty sweetness

Name: Millersburg Nuthouse Peanut Butter Porter
Description: "No peanuts used" twist on traditional porter

Name: Millersburg Pope’s Imperial Pumpkin
Description: This Seasonal beer is brewed with 10 pounds of pumpkin per barrel of beer. It has an orange-brown color with the nose of pumpkin pie, brown sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon, and vanilla. As the Imperial Pumpkin Ale rolls across your tongue, you get the spice flavors finishing with a slightly malty sweetness and a alcohol warmth on your palate with a lingering urge to take another sip. Pope's Pumpkin comes in with a 9.0% ABV and a light hop level of 13 IBUs.

Name: Tyranena Devil Over A Barrel
Description: Devil Over a Barrel is a 60/40 blend of a dry-beaned, 4 month bourbon ..... Great find in a small place right down the road from Tyranena. .... Perhaps I'll locate another 4-pack and cellar it until football season.

Name: Tyranena Scurvy IPA
Description: Scurvy India Pale Ale (IPA) India Pale Ale Brewed With Orange Peel. An ample ale, exploding with luscious, fruity hops and citrusy blast of orange zest. Ready to walk the plank, Matey

Name: Yeastie Boys Pot Kettle Black
Description: A juxtaposition of styles: fresh and hoppy, yet dark and rich. Mindbendingly delicious. NZ & rest of the world brewed at Invercargill Brewery. UK & Europe brewed at Brewdog, Aberdeenshire.

Name: Yeastie Boys Gunnamatta Earl Grey IPA
Description: A modern cult classic inspired by the Pale Ales that travelled from England to the East Indies and, perhaps more importantly, all that precious tea that returned on those same ships. Yeastie Boys' Gunnamatta utilises judicious amounts of Earl Grey Blue Flower tea to generate an intoxicating floral and citrus aroma with the quenching dry finish of an ice tea. A truly unique new world India Pale Ale with a decidedly old world twist.  Boldly floral nose – much like your granny’s bedroom - with stonefruit and citrus flavours and a long dry finish.

Name: Santa Clara Peralta Porter
Description: It’s 1807 and Luís María Peralta is looking out the window of his small adobe house in Pueblo San José. Little could he have imagined that over 200 years later his home would still be standing. Our Peralta Porter displays the same hearty character as this resilient landmark. Pouring earthen brown, this ale is built upon a light caramel foundation which firmly supports its chocolate and coffee flavors, finishing with a soft bitterness and earthy hoppiness we know you’ll enjoy.

Name: Santa Clara Electric IPA
Description: Built in 1881 to showcase the electrification of the west, San Jose’s Electric Light Tower stood for over 30 years as a shining star above the Santa Clara Valley.    Our Electric Tower® India Pale Ale reimagines this icon as an intensely West Coast style IPA. A firm malt base builds support for the abundance of hops, allowing hints of pine, citrus and tropical fruit to shine through and light up your palate.

Name: Oliphant Hunkboy Porter
Description: ROBUST MACHO PORTER WITH A SIDE MUSCLES.

Name: Oliphant Jeremy’s Got Talent Stout
Description:
Imperial Stout brewed with Bananas & Vanilla Wafers!!!

Rich, complex, with a rigid booze backbone

Name: Fine Creek Whiskey Barrel Aged Imperial Peated Porter
Description: Aged in Wyoming Whiskey barrels for 6 months. The peat does not create an overpowering smoke flavor, but rather adds some complexity to this roasty, chocolatey, and boozy beer.

Name: Fine Creek Golden Sour W/ Cabernet
Description: Aged on Blenheim barrels and skins.

Name: Meantime Naval College Old Porter
Description: The London brewers were at the forefront of applying new scientific and technological advances to beer making. Consequently the manufacture of Porter changed considerably during its life. By the time the Old Brewery was built in 1836 Porter was a blend of 'stock' or 'stale' beer, matured in giant wooden tuns for up to two years, with young or 'mild' beer.  Meantime Hospital Porter (called Naval College Old Porter in the US) is made in the same fashion. 24 months oak aging in used Bruichladdich Octomore barrels has lent a woody, intensely peaty smokiness to our 'stock' Porter, which we have blended with a younger beer. This latter adds vitality to the brew. Hospital Porter one beer that is best not over-chilled, and, like the original Porters, will mature with age.  This beer has only been available on draught at the Old Brewery at the Old Royal Naval Hospital—until now. We have done our best to ensure that the beer would be recognizable to the retired sailors whom the original Royal Naval Hospital brewery was set up to supply.

Name: Meantime London Porter
Description: Porter was the great London beer style of the 18th  and 19th centuries, when the city was revered as both the brewing capital and trading hub of the world. Named after the legions of porters in her docks, streets and markets who drank this powerful beer to slake their thirst, Meantime London Porter is a classic interpretation of this complex dark beer style.

Name: Deep River Pumpkin Pie Porter
Description: Our Pumpkin Pie Porter won’t stick to your ribs like grandma’s cooking, but it sure packs a fistful of flavor. We pack 7 pounds of pumpkin per barrel into this beer along with our perfect blend of pumpkin pie spices. We know grandma always said “don’t spoil your supper with too many drinkypoos” but we say indulge because grandma is in the kitchen drinking dandelion wine anyways!

Name: Deep River Limetown Lager
Description: Limetown Lager is a variation of our Cottontown Lager in which we add over 5 pounds of lime juice and zest per barrel. The limes give the beer a well rounded snappy citrus quality which plays well with the sleek framework that is Cottontown Lager.

Name: Deep Cove Luminescent Chocolate Coconut Porter
Description: The bio-luminescent jellyfish of deep cove are well known for unexpectedly lighting up the dark waters with a phosphorescent glow. This porter has the power to do the same for beer drinkers who are looking for a flash of the unexpected that won’t soon be forgotten. Tasting notes: warming and sweet, toasted coconut, rich chocolate, light roast malt, deep mahogany colour.

Name: Deep Cove The Crawl Nitro Stout
Description: Inspired by the timeless words of sprit of the west, this creamy stout will keep you going ‘from the troller to the raven.’ Jump on a bus, hop in a cab, or grab your bike and we’ll see you at the last stop before the band takes the stage. Tasting notes: smooth finish, roasted malt, hints of espresso, dark chocolate colour. 5% abv

Name: Hoegaarden White
Description: The original Belgian wheat beer. Pairs well with light salads or seafoods.

Name: Hoegaarden White 1/6 Barrel
Description: Kegs are intended for Kegerator use only. TAP NOT INCLUDED. NOTE: An additional deposit charge per keg may be placed on your card for first time customers only. A representative from Drizly or the store will be in contact to confirm all details prior to delivery. Empty barrels will be picked up upon delivery of new kegs. Name: M.I.A. Tourist Trappe Tripel Ale
Description: This tripel is brewed with blond malts and a touch of candy sugar. It’s fermented with Belgian Abby yeast strain that imparts fruity and spicy yet soft, well rounded esters. This low hopped brew is easy on the palate, but deceptively strong.

Name: M.I.A. Miami Weiss
Description: Our Hefe is full and clean with citrus notes and classic banana esters on the front end. This one’s bready and unfiltered, hopped for balance and finishes dry. Sweet orange peel additions exaggerate a refreshing mild acidity. Around here you have to keep your summertime drinkers pouring year round.

Name: Benediktiner Weissbier
Description: Like luminous amber suffused with orange highlights, Benediktiner Weissbier sparkles in the glass, with an opalescent appearance lent by the natural cloudiness of the yeast. Its rich, white head is characterised by a good density and fine texture. The pot-pourri of aromas combines strong caramel notes, with hints of honey and fruits, chief among them bananas and raisins. Each gently sparkling sip melts on the tongue and palate, bringing a distinct sense of refreshment. A full body, with a harmonious balance of sweet and a discrete bitterness in the background, creates a smooth, creamy mouthfeel.

Name: Benediktiner Helles Lager
Description: A full-bodied lager with a fine effervescence and intense flavour Crystal clear brilliant golden yellow with a white head – light and finely

Name: Grapevine Monarch American Wheat
Description: Nothing fancy, just good. A refreshing wheat beer, filtered, light bodied and slightly hopped for a perfect finish. Each year, the monarch butterfly makes its way from Canada to Mexico by way of Grapevine, Texas. It's a marvelous journey deserving of respite. Take a breath, and enjoy.

Name: Lakefire Rye Pale Ale
Description: Summer in Grapevine, Texas is filled with good times for the whole family. Every Friday night over the calm of Lake Grapevine, we celebrate the summer with fireworks and with our friends. And nothing hits the spot like Lakefire, a refreshingly hoppy American rye pale ale, spicy with a slightly sweet maltiness balanced by a smooth hop finish and subtle fruit aroma. The Lakefire is a unique pale ale and a GCB crowd favorite.

Name: Grizzly Paw Grumpy Bear Honey Wheat
Description: Made with real honey, local pale malts and wheat, this is a sweet medium bodied beer.Show More

Name: Grizzly Paw Beavertail Raspberry Ale
Description: A pink hued unfiltered wheat ale made with loads of real whole raspberries. A combination of malt sweetness and raspberry tartness make for a very refreshing and light beer.

Name: Blanche de Bruxelles
Description: Bottle conditioned.  Also sold as Blanche de Quenast in Dia/Ed supermarkets, as Floreffe Wit for Floreffe Abbey, as Mediterranea for the Italian market, as Blanche de Francorchamps, as t Geheim van de Smit, as Manneken Pis, and as L’Alsacienne Blanche de l’Eté.  Ingredients: Malted barley; wheat (40%); coriander; bitter orange peel; sugar; hops; yeast.  Blanche de Bruxelles owes its natural cloudiness to the large percentage (40 %) of wheat that goes into its composition. The natural spice aromas of coriander and bitter orange peels are added during the brewing process. The brewing method, which includes infusion, is very slow. The beer, which is not filtered, is bottled and refermented with yeast and brewing sugar. You need only take a sip of this delicious drink to appreciate the fresh and mellow flavour with its hint of orange. It is really not like any other beer. Always served chiled, between 3°C and 6°C.

Name: Barbar Belgian Honey Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale

Name: Southern Wit
Food Pairing: Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Cheese - Hard Aged, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Fruit - Sweet, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: Support your local brewers and farmers! This traditional Belgian-Style white ale is proudly brewed with Tennessee grains. Enjoy the superior taste of farm fresh ingredients while putting money right back into the community!  This citrusy, unfiltered white ale hits high notes of tangerine, pear and honey; sourcing from natural ingredients including fresh orange zest, coriander, and chamomile. Batey Farms in Murfreesboro, Tennessee provides all of the grains used in the Southern Wit, giving it a taste that is distinctively Tennessee.

Name: Hippies & Cowboys® IPA
Food Pairing: Beef, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy, Cheese - Fresh  Soft, Chicken, Cured Meats, Fish - Meaty  Oily, Fish - White, Fruit - Citrus, Fruit - Dried, Salads  Greens, Shellfish
Description: This tropical and citrus IPA provides luscious aromas that filter through to the palate. Light on the bittering, it ends with a smooth and crisp finish. Crushable on the ranch or at a music festival.

Name: Whistling Pig Hefeweizen
Description: Fruity, refreshing, and touched with malt sweetness, Whistling Pig Hefeweizen is a bright reward for days under the sun. Crisp yet easygoing, Whistling Pig is an unfiltered wheat bier. Its classically cloudy appearance characterizes the best German hefeweizens. That a hefe this authentic is born in the great Pacific Northwest makes Whistling Pig Hefeweizen all the more delightful.

Name: Monkless Peppercorn Imperial Wit
Description: Peppercorn Imperial Wit takes Monkless’s original Belgian Witbier and kicks it up a notch! The IBUs have been doubled to balance the alcohol, along with the addition of myriad spices, headlined by a four peppercorn blend, accented with fresh orange peel and coriander. The result is a big, yet lightbodied Wit with citrus and pear aromas that finishes clean and peppery.

Name: Monkless Capitulation
Description: What do you do when customers say "I love hoppy beers"? Well, if you're any other brewery you might brew 6 different IPA's for them to choose from, but if you're Monkless, you capitulate, and dry hop your classic Belgian Tripel. We took one of our favorite beers, The Trinity, and dry hopped it to add a blast of flowery, citrusy hop aroma.

Name: Fuggles & Warlock Craftworks The Last Mango
Big Experimental Brew
Description: This is our first big experiment to make it on the shelves. This beer is a Big Belgian style beer with all the traditional flavors you expect from fermenting a beer with Belgian style yeast. It is basically a cross between a "Belgian Triple" and a "Belgian Golden Strong." If you had to force it into a single style it would most resemble a "Belgian Quad" or even bigger! This beer pours a rich golden color and has a rich, sweet malt flavor and a full body mouthfeel. This beer is brewed with a crazy amount of amber Belgian candi syrup which gives it the golden color and really influences the flavor.

Name: Veterans United Buzzin’ Bee
Description: Buzzin’ Bee is an American- style, unfiltered wheat ale made with natural honey. Brewed with pale malt and wheat, we add a touch of rye and sweet orange peel to add complexity. The brew is lightly hopped with the choicest noble hops. Best enjoyed from a glass, the honey aromatics become more prominent as the beer warms. Inspired by the US Navy Seabees (Construction Battalions), Buzzin’ Bee pays homage to the “Can Do” attitude of these intrepid sailors by building a complex yet flavorful beer. Construimus, Batuimus!

Name: Veterans United Hop Banshee
Description: HopBanshee’s screaming hop aroma and flavor mimic the powerful cry of the banshee. Experience the wrath of Cascade, Centennial, Chinook, and Columbus hops. HopBanshee entices you to enjoy this mystical, hop-ladened West Coast style IPA with its sonic hop scream!

Name: Ten Pin Groove Pineapple Pale Wheat Ale
Description: This ale is a result of a collaboration with Moses Lake band, Dimestore Prophets. The beer takes the easy drinking smoothness of an American wheat ale, just adds enough Mosaic hops to brighten it up with tropical fruit aromas, and takes it home with the juice from ten whole pineapples in every keg.

Name: Darwin Circa 1926 Citrus Exchange Tangerine Wheat
Darwin Pirata Pils
Description:
Authentic German Pilsner, brewed with combination
of Noble Hops from Bavaria.

Name: Galveston Bay Watermelon Wheat Ale
Description: Using our wheat base, we add a touch of watermelon to enhance the aroma and crips flavors of this great wheat beer and give it a fun summer twist.

Name: Galveston Bay Blueberry Blonde Ale Beer
Description: This light and thirst-quenching ale is bolstered with fresh blueberries before and after fermentation resulting in a delightful aroma and flavor.

Name: Kyoto White Yuzu Ale
Description:
White Yuzu Ale brewed with spice. Tasted fruity and slightly sweet.
 
 Ingredients: water, barley malt, unmalted wheat, yuzu, coriander, hops, yeast.

Name: Kyoto Matcha IPA
Description: This beer tastes exactly what it sounds like: Matcha IPA. A unique blend of matcha green tea and a Japanese style India Pale Ale, which is not as hoppy as a California IPA but still has a high alcohol percentage of 8.5%.

Name: Kapuziner Schwarz-Weizen
Description: The dark, top fermented speciality. Typical wheat beer character with a perfect malt-aromatic bouquet.

Name: Mönchshof Schwarzbier
Description: Mönchshof Schwarzbier- “the Black Pils”- is a brewing wonder and a brew-lover’s dream. Supremely drinkable, dry and beautifully hopped, yet loaded with dark malt flavor.

Name: Gneiss Weiss
Description: Our backbone, our purpose, our flagship. This beer exemplifies the beauty and simplicity of German-style wheat beer. Banana notes give way to a crisp, flavorful finish with a hint of lemon. Prost!

Name: Gneiss Pyroclast Barrel Aged Golden Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Barrel Aged Golden Wild ale made in collaboration with Orono Brewing Company. Aged in white wine, red wine and neutral oak barrels for 12 months with various wild yeast inoculations. Notes of pear, yogurt and oak, lightly tart.

Name: Engine 15 904 WeissGuy
Description: An American wheat inspired by the traditional bavarian style hefeweissen, notes of clove, orange along with a cloudy yeast character make this a summer favorite.

Name: Edelweiss Wheat
Description: EDELWEISS Hefetrüb is unfiltered, golden and very fruity with a slight banana nose. Refreshingly this fine sparkling wheat beer offers spice-like flavors

Name: Edelweiss Weissbier
Description: EDELWEISS Hefetrüb is unfiltered, golden and very fruity with a slight banana nose. Refreshingly this fine sparkling wheat beer offers spice-like flavors on the palate.

Name: Triporteur From Hell
Description: Triporteur From Hell is a dark beer brewed with hellish burned and roasted BOM malt. The beer reminds us of chocolate, caramel, recently brewed coffee and freshly baked bread. The wheat malt in the unfiltered beer can cause a slight cloudiness. The taste of Hell keeps evolving in the bottle.

Name: Triporteur From Heaven
Description: A heavily hopped belgian ale using Belgians Original Maltbakery's home baked malts.

Name: Antietam Brewery Hager-Weiss
Description: Brewed with 100% German ingredients, this refreshing wheat ale is unfiltered and unfettered. Subtle clove and banana flavors make this a complex beer of character.

Name: Antietam Brewery Seasonal
Description: A hearty wheat beer base complimented by seasonal fruit purees. Varieties include, raspberry, blueberry, boysenberry, and tart cherry.

Name: Angry Scotsman Pints Of Persia Wheat Ale
Description: Belgian witbier with hibiscus, sweet orange and Persian saffron for a tart, fruity nose up front and an earthy, terrior finish.

Name: Angry Scotsman Factor 50 Lager
Description: Our take on classic light lager combines pilsen malt and rice with a subtle addition of noble Citra hops. Whether you’re headed to the beach, a tailgate, or simply looking to kick back and chill, this is the all-day lager for you. Don’t forget to pack the Factor 50.

Name: Burn Em 14 Buck Chuck Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: All Citra hopped APA

Name: Innstadt Extra Schwarze Original
Description: A high-quality, low-fermented full beer with 5.0% by volume of alcohol.   Its tasty fresh taste and the outstanding product packaging in the ironing bottle promises a special beer experience.

Name: Jandrain Jandrenouille Vi Wheat
Description: Hopped with Simcoe and an experimental Yakima Chief hopcultivar.

Name: Jandrain Iv Saison
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: Natural craft beer, non-filtered, non-Pasteurized and refermented in the bottle by the Brasserie de Jandrain-Jandrenouille.

Name: Spanish Peaks Crystal Weiss
Description: A lighter style American Wheat. Black Dog’s Crystal Weiss is an American version of a classic German style Kristall Weizen. This "crystal clear", cold filtered wheat beer is mildly hopped resulting in a refreshing and drinkable beer that can be enjoyed during any season.   Initially contract brewed for Spanish Peaks Brewing Co at City Brewery - WI, in 2009 the production was moved to Olde Saratoga in NY and Butte Creek in CA.

Name: Spanish Peaks Honey Raspberry Single
Description: A light bodied amber ale made with wildflower honey and natural raspberry. These ingredients, combined with five domestic and imported malted barleys, Pacific Northwest hops, water and ale yeast, creat a unique, fruity ale with a soft palate and a touch of sweetness

Name: Seventh Son Grafitti Orange Wheat Ale
Description: Formerly Orange Creamsicle Wheat, this beer was named by a Facebook contest hosted by the brewery.American wheat beer with orange peel, vanilla, and lactose

Name: Seventh Son Humulus Nimbus Super Pale Ale
Description: A pale golden ale that is both super crisp and super hop forward with a refreshing mouthfeel and a summer friendly 6% abv. Mosaic & simcoe hops lend a note of blueberry and fragrant pine to a pleasingly bitter dandelion finish. We wanted the hops to be the star in this flagship ale taking its name from both the hop plant, Humulus Lupulus, and its light color and cloud-like feel, nimbus.

Name: Estes Park Stinger Honey Wheat Ale
Description: We put 6 lbs of unmolested ambrosia honey per barrel into this American wheat ale. The honey adds a sweetness and raises the alcohol content slightly. We use Tettnang Hops, and for a little extra kick it's spiced with coriander and chamomile.

Name: Estes Park Longs Peak Raspberry Wheat
Description: This is one of our most popular beers. It is a light and refreshing raspberry-flavored wheat ale. We use pure raspberry extract to give this beer its fruity aroma and flavor. Hopped with challenger and Willamette hops. Raspberry Wheat was awarded Best of the Rockies/ Southwest in the fruit beer category at the 2006 United States Beer Tasting Championship.

Name: Dovetail Hefeweizen
Description: Easy to drink with a lingering, pleasant aftertaste. A rich, yolky-orange wheat beer, featuring the aroma of clove and fruit in perfect balance; refreshing on a warm day, with a hint of mandarin-orange-like acidity; huge effervescent head. Thick lasting foam that leaves an attractive lacing after every sip.

Name: Dovetail Vienna Lager
Description: Vienna Lager is an underappreciated and underrepresented style that’s garnered some die-hard devotees. Similar to an Oktoberfest Marzen, but not quite as heavy or rich, it artfully balances caramel malt sweetness with herbaceous noble hops. Dovetail’s is made with 100% Vienna malt and Styrian Golding hops and it’s a spot-on example of the style.

Name: Henniker Whipp Wheat
Description: Whipple’s Wheat is a sessionable wheat ale that we dry-hopped with a blend of citrusy American hops and left unfiltered, perfect for summer or anytime you feel like it! This beer pairs well with lazy afternoons and anything cooked outside.

Name: Henniker Hop Slinger
Description: Hop Slinger gets its golden copper color from the light caramel malts, which provide a solid backbone to support all the great hops. This beer presents with an overwhelming citrus aroma that leads into an unmistakable flavor of grapefruit. Hop Slinger leaves you with a nice dry bitterness that pairs well with spicy curries, salty fried foods and ginger based deserts.

Name: Pauwel Kwak Belgian Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: In the 18th century there was a very well-known brewer in the Dendermonde area. His name was Pauwel Kwak. He brewed his own beer, which was dark and heavy and also had a coaching inn on the road between Mechelen and Gent, where the mail coaches used to stop for a break.    In those days, the Napoleonic Code ruled that coach drivers were forbidden to drink beer with their passengers and so they were not allowed to leave the coach to quench their thirst. Pauwel Kwak invented an efficient solution to this problem by offering the famous Kwak beer in a special glass that could be fixed to the carriage, so the drivers could also enjoy one.    This story inspired a brewer from nearby Buggenhout and since the 1980s the Pauwel Kwak is brewed by Brouwerij Bosteels, which also produces the popular Tripel Karmeliet and the DeuS Brut des Flandres.

Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Fruity, spicy, complex aroma and flavor. A sweet palate is followed by low hop bitterness, evident coriander-like spiciness and a titillating alcoholic blast reminiscent of Flemish fantasies.

Name: Piraat Rum Barrel Aged
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Brewed in honor of the original seafarers of the 19th century, Piraat Ale seemed destined to be aged in Rum barrels. The Belgian classic and perennial gold medal winner is aged in barrels for the first time since it’s inception. At 10.5% ABV the beer has a large malt profile which produces flavors of country bread and dried fruits. Due to secondary fermentation in the bottle, Piraat has always been regarded as one of smoothest strong golden ales ever brewed. By aging it in rum barrels the beer picks up vanilla accents, which further rounds out the beer without overpowering the spicy quality which has made Piraat famous.

Name: Palm Belgian Pale Ale
Description: PALM Ale has long been one of Europe's top-selling specialty beers. Made with English hops  French Barley  and Belgian yeast  PALM represents the best of European beer-making traditions. It's the roasted Champagne Malt which gives PALM its amber color  but without being heavy.

Name: Palm Beer
Description:
The “Spéciale Belge Ale” beer style is one of the better Belgian beers of the early 20th century. This smooth-drinking, amber-coloured, top-fermentation beer has a reasonable alcohol content. 

Special PALM malts are responsible for its honey-like mellowness, and PALM’s own selected yeasts give it a fruity yeast aroma. Fine aroma hops from Kent afford a subtle harmony.

Top fermentation – Amber-coloured – Spéciale Belge Ale
Recognised local product – 5.2% ABV

Unique amber-coloured malts determine the basic flavour of PALM: mild caramel flavours with a honey-like mellowness. The malting process adheres to PALM’s specific instructions, which aim for the natural caramelisation that gives the beer its specific flavour.

The aroma is determined to a significant extent by yeast. Through intensive selection, the Van Roy family has amassed a lavish collection of the various yeast strains, each of which gives the beer its own fruity character. PALM is fermented with a specific yeast strain which provides a distinct banana fruitiness.

The glass exudes roundness and conviviality, perfectly matching the mellow flavour and that unique PALM drinking moment.

Name: Central 28 Trekker Bier
Categories: ALE, Belgian-Style Ale, Saison  Farmhouse Ale
Description: We journeyed the globe in our search to connect the bounty of the earth and the contents of the glass. Along the way, a series of appellation adventures inspired a dry, refreshing, straw-colored, unfiltered treasure we call Trekker, an adventurous bier synergized as a tribute to the earth’s best terrior—geography, geology and climate that results in the best craft-malted barley from Canada, aromatic hops from New Zealand—inspired by Belgian "grisette"-style farmhouse ales. We searched around the world and then worked our alchemy right here in Central Florida.

Name: Central 28 Dancing Pierre
Description: This golden Belgian-style unfiltered pale ale dances along the incredibly delicate balance between fruity, spicy aromatics, assertive bitterness, and deep malt character. It’s a difficult balance, depending on taking just the right steps. We think of it as slightly akin to riding on a unicycle while juggling. Never easy but always impressive.

Name: Ale Syndicate Van de Velde
Description: Van de Velde Belgo-Pale Ale blends the subtly spicy and fruity flavors of Belgian yeast with a smooth, slightly sweet malt character. Add in the bold, bitter profile of American hops and you've got a complex, ambitious but still approachable brew - not unlike the early Belgian-Chicagoans of Logan Square who inspired its name.

Name: Ale Syndicate Sunday Session
Description: Sunday Session Hopped-Up Ale, a mellow brew clocking in at only 4.8% ABV. Light, but deliciously hoppy, you can have a few and still remember the fun.

Name: Rinkuskiai Werewolf
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: WEREWOLF has an attractive dark color, slightly sweet, reach taste of malt and slight aroma of hops. Want to drink more? Oh , yes! And be aware that WEREWOLF is based on the recipe of the best Birzai beers

Name: Kriek Des Jacobins Sour Cherry
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: The basic ingredient of our Jacobins Kriek is wort made of wheat and malted barley. This wort is first boiled and then transported to the brewery’s open cooling vessel to cool down.  Afterwards it spontaneously ferments in big oak barrels, giving the beer its refined flavour and aroma.  To obtain its true “kriek” or cherry flavour, natural cherry juices are also added. The fruitiness of the aroma clearly reveals itself in the mouth. Our Jacobins Kriek has a well-balanced, pleasant and slightly sweet flavour, which is best enjoyed when drunk out of its own bowl-shaped glass. An excellent thirst quencher and... perfect for drinking in an outdoor café!

Name: Buffalo 1907 Dark Ale
Description: We are delighted to present this unique limited bottling of Innis & Gunn finished in oak barrels which previously contained navy rum. Maturation in special oak barrels imparts Navy rums with the sweet, spicy character for which they are renowned. We have long wondered what flavours might be imparted to our beer by finishing it in these same barrels and earlier this year we decided to find out. We brewed a special batch of Innis & Gunn beer and matured it in oak for 60 days. Every single drop spent half of that time in American oak barrels before being refilled into selected navy rum barrels to finish the lengthy maturation. Once the beer had absorbed the unique character the barrels were emptied, the beer blended and then maturation continued for a further 47 days until all of the flavours had married together and mellowed. We think the result is absolutely delicious!

Name: Poperings Hommel Fresh Harvest
Description: In mid September fresh hops are picked in the Poperings hop field and immediately used to brew the annual Poperings Hommel Fresh Harvest Ale.    The 4 hops used to brew this fresh cone Hommel are from Poperinge, Saphir, Magnum, Challenger, and Kent-Golding.  After a 3 week resting period, this ale is dry hopped again with Saphir cones.    The ale is bottled exclusively in 750ml bottles with extra yeast and sugar added so it can referment for 3 weeks. There are a limited number of bottles produced because of the one time harvest of fresh picked cones.    High fermented Belgian Ale with refermentation in the bottle.

Name: Poperings Hommelbier Fresh Hop
Description: Hommel is the local abbreviation of humulus, from the botanical name for the hop plant. Confusingly, it also means bumble bee in Flemish. Poperings Hommelbier is a hoppy, golden-bronze, ale. It is made from a blend of winter, summer and aromatic pale malts.
