Description: Brewed with organic flaked oats, dark chocolate and locally-roasted Sumatran and Ethiopian Harar coffee beans from Morrisville, NC's Muddy Dog Roasting Company, our Trappist-style "Breakfast" Dubbel is a smooth, silky, eye-opening take on a classic style, with floral aromatics of deep-roasted coffee, spiced fig and rich, creamy cocoa.

Name: Kasteel Winter Ale
Categories: ALE, Belgian Strong Ale, Belgian-Style Ale
Description: Kasteel Winter is a unique departure from the standard Christmas ales known for their potpourri of cinnamon and clove. In fact, it stands alone as one of the most decadent and elegant Quadruples of Belgium in its own right. This 11% ABV beer pours a Chestnut brown with an off-white head. The nose is rich, with a warming scent of Coffee, Toffee, and Dried Fruits. The mouthfeel is rich and sweet like that of melted candy. The key ingredients to this delicacy is Belgian Chocolate and Coffee...noteworthy phrases in any brewers handbook. All of these elements come together to provide an after taste reminiscent of a tootsie roll.

Name: Vicaris Generaal Dubbel
Description: Dense tan head, on a ruby brown colored beer. Toasted malt with a hint of grass, herbs and raisin. Beautifully balanced. Made by a talented home brewer whose beers were extremely well received at Belgian beer festivals. So well in fact, that Brouwerij DIlewyns opened in 2011, becoming Belgium's newest brewery.

Name: Zundert Trappist 8
Description: Zundert Trappist is a chestnut colored top-fermented beer with secondary fermentation in the bottle. It contains 8% alcohol. We have opted for a beer that we call "a bit unruly". That is to say, Zundert Trappist is a beer that you must give time to actually get to the bottom of it.Our Trappist beer has a promising aroma with a hint of herbs and spices. Zundert Trappist is flowery and slightly sweet at the start. Give the beer some time and the character evolves from light caramel to a nice and dry hop bitterness. In the long finish the bitters flow together with a pleasant spiciness in the background.

Name: Lindemans Lambic Gift Pack
Description: Lindemans Gift Set is a great way to experience a range of fruit lambics - Belgian ales fermented with wild yeast - from this family-owned brewery established in 1822. It's a great gift: these beers are so tasty and unique that Lindemans are the best-selling lambics in the US. Includes one 8.45 oz. bottle each of Peche and Strawberry, and two 8.45 oz. bottles of Framboise (their best-seller), plus an elegant tulip glass with Lindemans Lambic logo. Glass is approximately 8" high x 3-1/2" diameter at widest point. Lindemans Framboise Lambic (ABV 2.5%) Magnificent aroma, delicate palate of raspberries with undertones of fruity acidity; elegant, sparkling clean taste. Lindemans Peche Lambic (ABV 2.5%) Golden in color; with a nose that fills the room with fresh peaches. Sparkling, crisp and refreshing balance of fruit and complexity from wild yeast. Lindemans Strawberry Lambic (ABV 4.1%) Rosy hue, with a beautiful aroma of perfectly ripened strawberries. Shows complex, captivating flavors; delicate sweetness is balanced by traditional lambic tartness in the finish.

Description: A groovy American-Style wheat beer that is infused with the far out flavors of blueberry and vanilla. So when the moon is in the seventh house and Jupiter aligns with Mars grab a Big Blue Van and ask yourself ... What's so funny about peace, love and understanding?

Name: Old Speckled Hen
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: “If, like me, you like to hunt out a hen, well there are plenty of opportunities to find one. ‘Old Speckled Hen’ is in pubs and bars across the country in cask and also as a smooth version at 4.5% ABV.    You can also enjoy ‘Old Speckled Hen’ in 500ml or 355ml bottles and 500ml cans at 5% ABV from all leading supermarkets and convenience outlets. And for the jet setters amongst us, you can even find it in 47 countries around the world, from Australia to the UAE.    ‘Old Speckled Hen’ has a full, smooth flavour and is very easy to drink. Its rich amber colour and superb fruity aromas are complemented by a delicious blend of malty tastes. Toffee and malt combine with bitterness on the back of the tongue to give a balanced sweetness. This, all followed by a refreshingly dry finish.”

Name: Sonoran White Chocolate Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Why worry about the details of what is or isn't, when you can just sit back and enjoy all of the things that make our White Chocolate Ale so damn delicious. While you're at it, let's think about all the cool stuff we did today (or didn't do). Either way this is the perfect time to find yourself.

Name: Zero Issue Multiverse Pale Ale
Description:
You unlock this door with the key of thirst. 

Beyond it is another dimension – a dimension of subtle caramel malt, a dimension of bright citrus hops, a dimension of balance.  You’re moving into a land of both aroma and flavor, of things and ideas.  You’ve crossed into….
the MULTIVERSE.

Name: Tuckerman Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Pale Ale, released in 1998, is brewed with specialty malts, some grown in Maine, and four types of hops. After fermentation, it is cold conditioned and dry-hopped in lagering tanks for maximum taste and quality. It is naturally carbonated in the bottle or keg using a German process called “krausening”, where a small amount of fresh fermenting wort is added. This produces a delicate carbonation and superior flavor. From the Mash Tun to store shelves is a 30 day process.

Name: Spellbound Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Dutchess Ales G.B.Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: G.B. (formerly Ghost Beer) is a 'hybrid' pale ale made to suit both our English and West Coast sensibilities.  Brewed with a variety of US and UK malts and hops. Ghost Beer also features a hybrid yeast that allows this bright, zesty pale ale to drink a bit like a refreshing Kölsch.  Feel free to reach out to us for more ingredient details.

Name: Dick’s 12 Man Pale Ale
Description: Julie Young-Pendleton, the owner of Dick’s Brewing Company, is very proud to be a part of this new beer leaving their brewery and into the hands of the Pacific Northwest customers. Julie states, “The beer is a great easy drinking, sessionable beer that is a well-balanced pale ale at 4.5% ABV that everyone can drink and enjoy as and For the Fan.”

Name: SoPro Devils Harvest
Description: This devilishly dank dry hopped American pale ale uses rich Munich malt to balance out the hop additions. With a full mouth feel and bold aroma, Devil’s Harvest is a flavorful hop bomb.

Name: Pacific Brewing Potomac Citra Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The Potomac Sample Room was located at the Pacific Brewing & Malting Co. brewery on Jefferson Street in Downtown Tacoma over 100 years ago. It was Tacoma’s original tap room. Potomac Citra Pale is a medium bodied single hop beer showcasing Citra hops from the Yakima Valley. Potomac’s aroma provides strong citrus and tropical tones of grapefruit, melon, lime, and passion fruit.

Name: Yeehaw Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Behold the sunset-tinted beauty of our American Pale Ale. Bold, but balanced, there’s no kick-you-in-the-face bitterness here. Just an ample hop flavor combined with quality malt for the perfect amount of sweetness. For a beer worthy of another round, just say…YEE-HAW!

Name: Coronado and Maui Brewing Collaboration Tropical Tide IPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Tropical Tide balances island flavor with west coast hop aroma in this bright, juicy IPA. A blend of American and New Zealand hop varietals including El Dorado, Wimema, Motueka, Mosaic, and Chinook lend the beer flavors of pineapple, mango, stone fruit, citrus, and pine.

Name: Old Golden Hen Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale

Old Golden Hen is perfect for all occasions and best served chilled. Available at 4.1% ABV in 500ml bottles and cask.”

Name: Kerkom Reuss
Description: Reuss is produced for the Bink festival. Marc Limet blends the lambic with a less bitter version of Bink Blond (38 IBUs versus 52 IBUs.) Reuss was the name of the first beer brewed at Kerkom in 1878.

Name: Bellevue 425 Pale Ale

Name: Standard Old Money Brett Pale Ale
Food Pairing: Beef, Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Cheese - Creamy  Bloomy
Description: Old Money is a 100% brettanomyces pale ale. When used to condition a beer that has already undergone fermentation, brett makes a beer quite funky, with aromatics reminiscent of goats and leather. If used for the initial ferment, it behaves much more like saccharomyces, the type of yeast used to make most beers. Old Money puts this on display. Fermented in oak and aged for 2 months, it has subtle brett aromatics, and a tart, fruity palate. moderate hopping gives it a pleasing, bitter finish.

Name: Wonderland 3 Putt Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale

Name: Wells Bombardier
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Bombardier Premium Ale presents burnished copper in colour, and has rich, tempting aromas of caramel, honey as well as a hint of noble hops. The palate is dominated by English malts, which provide flavours of freshly baked bread, caramel and hazlenuts. Comforting and moreishly drinkable.

Name: Bard’s Sorghum Beer
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: This Golden Sorghum Lager will appeal to beer drinkers who prefer the lighter taste of lagers produced by the major brewers  such as Anheuser-Busch  Coors  Miller  and Heineken. This ale has a light crisp taste to meet the thirst quenching requirements of the lager style while still having enough body to interest the ale drinker during the spring and summer seasons. This beer has low bitterness and a subtle but pleasant hop aroma that will gently caress the senses.

Name: Full Tilt Baltimore Pale Ale
Description: Baltimore Pale Ale is brewed with only the finest American hops and barley. Baltimore Pale Ale utilizes Nugget, Columbus, Summit, and Crystal hops in a flavorful blend. This creates an unforgettable armoma apparent from the very instant it is served with a full and pleasant taste which will satisfy your tastebuds no matter what time of year this brew finds you.

Name: Canmore Ten Peaks Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description:
The Valley of the Ten Peaks is one of the most remarkable views in all of Banff National Park, even having the distinction of appearing on the twenty dollar bill on two occasions. O Canada!

A moderately hopped American style pale ale, slightly sweet, biscuity and very quenching. Welcome to craft beer.

Name: Cerveza Hatuey
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Welcome to HATUEY, the legendary Cuban-born craft beer for people with an appetite for life and adventure. To discover HATUEY is to discover a beer as refreshing as the cool island breeze brushing against your face. HATUEY is for those who sway to the beat of a different drum, who have big families, loud laughs, and palates that never settle. If that’s you, welcome.Since 1914, HATUEY has been challenging the way people think about their beer, because a quality beer makes all the difference. HATUEY is about creating real connections with a cold one in your hand. But not just any cold one. Experience a great-tasting beer that carries the passion, magic, and contagious energy of Cuban culture

Name: Moritz Lager Barcelona
Description: This lager is clean and pale, a hint of sweet malt with delicate citric hops. It has a lovely balance of sweet and bitter and is very drinkable. Often described as sunshine in a bottle.

Name: Butchers Mucho Aloha Extra Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: The Pidgin (pigeon) logo represents Pidgin English, a local Hawaiian slang. The Mucho Aloha name is the blending of two words that represents the blend of SoCal and Hawaiian cultures. The tagline "La Cerveza Mo’bettah" is a play on words , mixing So-Cal Spanish and Hawaii pidgin English.

Name: Hailstorm Prairie Madness Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Brewed with American, German and English malts, duly hopped with American Centennial and Ahtanum hops. This golden pale ale is our Midwest take on a classic American craft style. Great malt character and hop aroma with a smooth, citrusy flavor, followed by a crisp, clean finish make this a distinctive beer

Name: American Brewing Patriotic Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: A hop forward NW pale ale bursting with aromas of stone fruit and pine. Simcoe and Amarillo hops abound throughout this tasty brew. Perfect for any NW hike.

Name: Miskatonic Wise Fool IPA
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Brewed with Vienna malt for a gentle, bready malt foundation and hopped with Styrian, Warrior, Cascade and Centennial for an assertive but complementary American hop finish. Wise Fool is an American IPA with an English sensibility.

Name: Untold Pale 143
Description: Not far from our brewery in the cold waters off our coastline stands Minot Light, a lighthouse flashing 1-4-3 to signal "I Love You." For over a century, this message of love has protected ships from the dangerous, rocky seas around them. Pale 143 is a nod to all who have stood on the ocean's edge and felt the same love from that eternal light.

Name: Adnams Southwold Bitter
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Southwold Bitter is a beautiful copper-coloured beer, late and dry-hopped with Fuggles for a distinctive, lingering hoppiness.  Brewed with the finest East Anglian Pale Ale malt barley, sourced locally to the brewery. We use Fuggles hops which we add late in the boil to preserve the herbal flavours of this traditional English hop. We add more Fuggles to each cask so that the flavour of the hops infuses into the beer.  It’s a perfect 3.7% abv in cask and 4.1% abv in bottle and can.  - See more at: http://adnams.co.uk/beer/our-beers/adnams-southwold-bitter/#sthash.3gHEXXiC.dpuf

Name: Black Douglas Ale
Categories: ALE, English Pale Ale  Bitter  ESB, Pale Ale
Description: Black Douglas was a famous Scottish Knight and trusted friend of Robert the Bruce. The Bruce and Black Douglas first met only a few miles from the site of Broughton Ales in the Scottish Borders. We like to think that the dark ruby colour and the full bodied malt flavour of this ale reflect the power and strength of this great Knight.

Name: Gravity Golden Mosaic Pale Ale
Categories: ALE, American Pale Ale, Pale Ale
Description: Pale Ale brewed w/ Golden Promise Malt, hop bursted & dry hopped w/ Mosaic & Citra hops. Tropical Funk!

Name: Northwest Brewing Road Trip Pale Ale
Description: This Classic Pale has a beautiful gold hue and pours with a thick and creamy head. Road Trip is a classic Northwest Pale Ale using the finest Yakima-grown hops and Pacific Northwest malts. This Pale Ale uses Citra and Amarillo hops to develop great citrus notes of grapefruit and oranges along with subtle pine notes with a delicious smooth clean finish and no lingering bitterness.

Name: Brouwerij Verhaeghe Duchesse Chocolate Cherry
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Traditional Duchesse de Bourgogne with Belgian cherries and chocolate essence added during the maturation process in oak casks (foeders). 20 kg of whole Belgian cherries are used in the production of each 100 liters of Chocolate Duchesse Cherry.

Name: Duchesse De Bourgogne Sour Cherry
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Duchesse Cherry is a blend of 1 and 2 year-old Duchesse de Bourgogne with local, sour cherries added to the maturing beer. The malt beverage is aged in oak casks, and utilizing whole cherries from the Limburg region of Belgium, as opposed to cherry syrup that is sometimes used in cherry beer production, Duchesse Cherry truly lives up to its name.

Name: Central City Sour 1 Sour Brown Ale
Description: Belgian style sour brown ale aged for two years in Cabernet Sauvignon oak barrels and Central City Brewers + Distillers is ringing in 2016 with a big splash with the unveiling of their highly anticipated sour beer – Sour Brown I Barrel Aged Sour Ale.

Name: Ritterguts Barentoter
Description: Inspired by an historical Märzen-Gose—stronger and darker than a standard gose—Bärentöter is in fact an entirely new creation. This harmoniously complex brew is produced using an opulent decoction mash-malt mixture, with additions of coriander, salt, orange peel, and a touch of cinnamon. The world’s premier sour bock undergoes a lactic acid fermentation, lending an elegant sourness to its salty malt body and layers of fruity & spicy aromatics.

Name: Silly Sour Ale
Description: Silly Sour is a unique brew that blends 13% of traditional dark Saison with 87% of soured ale. The delicate malt notes from the Saison manage to break through the striking green apple sourness upfront and than give a way to a finishing jolt of lactic sourness! At an approachable 5.5% Alc. by Vol. this chestnut colored brew adds a new page in the history of Saison brewing.

Name: Orpheus Brewing Wandering Blues Sour Ale
Description: Orpheus spent years wandering the Earth in mourning after the fateful serpent bite that killed his wife, Eurydice. Wandering Blues, our blueberry sour, pays homage to Orpheus’ departed love and the epic journey following his loss. It’s fermented with fresh Georgia blueberries, juiced for us by Arden’s Garden, resulting in a delightful balance of depth and brightness.

Name: Vanberg and Dewulf Lambrucha
Description: Blend of two ancient and unique fermented beverages, Lambic and Kombucha. Brewed and bottled at De Troch by Vanberg & DeWulf.

Name: La Sirene Paradoxe
Description: La Sirene Paradoxe and hence its name is referring to how this beer crosses over to almost tasting like a fresh white wine. Classic grape characters and juicy yet tangy green fruits dominate with the bracing acidity that delivers a dry, creamy and refreshing finish

Name: Crooked Stave/Omnipollo Bianca Persica Wild Wild Brett
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Wildflower St Henry White Peach Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: White Peach is an Australian Wild Ale refermented with white peaches from the Nashdale, NSW.

Name: Heathen Tiki Time Sour Ale
Description: American Kettle Sour fruited with Pink Guava, Pineapple, Passion Fruit, and Dry Hopped with Mosaic Hops

Name: Arrowood Farms Porch Beer
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Discord Don’t Stop Til You Get Enough Sour IPA
Description: Hazy plum purple color. Ripe plum, fresh blackberries, stone fruit and punchy citrus aromas. Plums and blackberries up, and melon up front with balanced out with noticeable citrus notes and a subtle, but present grassy finish. Mildly effervescent on the palate, 7.0% ABV

Name: Brouwerij Alvinne Morpheus
Categories: ALE, Flanders Red  Brown, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: St. Louis Fond Tradition Gueuze Lambic
Description: St-Louis Gueuze Fond Tradition is a pure traditional gueuze aimed at connoisseurs. It has the pure taste of a true gueuze based on a blend of young and old lambics. Fruity apple aromas stand out. When tasting, the slightly sour touches, characteristic of lambic beers, make their presence felt. It is very dry in the finish.

Name: Main St Fruit Bomb Kettle Sour
Description: Brewed using the hopbursting technique, this kettle sour is exploding with tropical hop flavours of grapefruit, lime, lemon, mango and peach – guaranteed to ignite your tastebuds. Kettle soured to give a blast of tartness. It’s the bomb!

Name: Side Project Merci
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale

Name: Wanderlinger Brewing Co 100 Day IPA
Description: A bold West Coast IPA brewed with a combination of classic American hops. Color is pale copper to golden at the edges with a thick, white, lingering head. Strong citrus and piney aroma, slightly resinous. Pronounced bitterness with a dry finish.  Our first named beer.  Chris was asked by his son Zack “Dad you like beer a lot don’t you?” to which he replied “Yes son I do”.  The 5-year old Zack responded “But not as much as Uncle Mike, he likes it for like 100 days straight”

Name: Vanessa House 11:09 Blackberry Sour
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Food Pairing: Cured Meats, Dessert - Fruit, Salads  Greens
Description: Actual conversation from an impromptu VHBC Road Trip to Denver at precisely 11:09 am. Zac - How close are we? Justin - What? Zac - How much longer until we are there? Justin - Oh hold on….400 miles. Zac - Ok, but how long? Justin - What? Zac - How much time until we are there? Justin – Oh, it’s 11:09. #notwhatweaskedfor

Name: Brekeriet Rhuboise
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: A fruity, tart and elegant ale with brettanomyces yeast. Loads of raspberries and rhubarb are added during the secondary fermentation.

Name: Brewbaker Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: A real Berlin white wine with fresh, apple-like aroma, fine acidity and fine yeast aromas. A pure pleasure.

Name: Bhramari Brewhouse The Good Fight
Description: Hoppy kettle sour pale ale

Name: Cervecera Del Centro Triguena
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale
Description: Full flavored ale beer with a fresh, crisp, fruit taste, balanced with a hint of a sour finish. This incredibly sessionable ale is perfectly suited for warmer climents. Foam is rich and leaves a nice crown.

Name: 3 Nations Brewing Sucker Punch Watermelon Sour Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: Prairie Sour Variety
Description: Prairie Sour Mix Pack. Featuring 4 cans each of Blueberry Boyfriend, Rainbow Sherbet, and Vape TricksBlueberry Boyfriend - Sour ale with blueberries and lemon zestRainbow Sherbet - Summer forward sour ale with raspberry, pineapple and orangeVape Tricks - Sour ale aged on cherrie

Name: Humble Forager Brewery V6 Tangerine and Mango Coastal Sunshine Sour Ale
Paradise Creek Hucklberry Pucker Berliner Weisse
Categories: ALE, Berliner Weisse, Sour  Wild Ale

Name: 603 Brewery E09 Zest Friends Forever
Description: Lemons and limes equals refreshing times. A tart wheat beer with a citrus finish will make ZFF your new BFF!

Name: 405 Brewing Peaches Of Me Wild Ale
Categories: ALE, Sour  Wild Ale, Wild Ale
Description: Peaches of Me is fermented exclusively with wild yeast captured underneath the mulberry tree in our own brewery backyard. This beer is matured with fresh peaches to present a funky and tart table beer.

Name: VonSeitz Orchard Provender
Description: Orchard Provender is a barrel-aged mixed fermentation fruited ale brewed for Carolina Bauernhaus's annual The "Peachening". Peaches and plums from Clemson University's Messer Fruit Farm were added along with pears and cherries. Show Less

Name: Skygazer Brewing Watercolors Synergy Mango Guava
Description: Mango and Guava combined yields a smooth and creamy tropical cocktail with marshmallow to take it over the top. So dreamy :)Blending Alert: This beer is designed to be blended with Watercolors - Synergy - Raspberry, Blackberry, Graham Cracker, Vanilla, Milk Sugar.

Name: Blue Pants Midnight Gose
Description: Traditional Gose brewed with Midnight Wheat Malt.

Name: Wiley Roots Brewing Creamsicle Carousel Gose
Description: Blood Orange Carousel Gose with a heavy vanilla addition.

Name: Concrete Jungle Citizen Of The Under World
Description: Sour beer made from blend of a blonde ale barrel-aged with passion fruit, and a saison barrel-aged with tart cherries.  After blending, the beer was aged an additional six months in Pinot Grigio barrels.

Name: Beer By Design Wheat Sour Ale
Passionate Cherry Gose
Description: Passion fruit and tart cherry gose.

Name: Area Two Synopsis Black Currant Wild Ale
Young’s Double Chocolate Stout
Food Pairing: Dessert - Vanilla  Caramel, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: Available filtered and pasteurised in 500ml bottles and in nitrocans. Also Nitro Keg on Tap   Production moved from Youngs to Wells & Youngs in 2007. Brand acquired solely by Charles Wells in 2011.  Ingredients: Pale ale and crystal malt, chocolate malt, special blend of sugars, Fuggle and Goldings hops, real dark chocolate and chocolate essence.  Chocolate malt and real dark chocolate are combined with Young’s award winning rich, full flavoured dark beer to craft a satisfyingly indulgent, but never overly sweet experience.

Name: Murphy’s Stout
Description: Since 1856, Murphy's Stout still remains true to its roots in Cork "Rebel" County Ireland. The Murphy brothers crafted a genuine dry Irish-style stout that was both a birthright and a passion. Each jet black pint is filled with the character and resilience of the Irish spirit. Brewing Murphy's Stout is not simply our craft, it's our calling. An authentic dry stout, with roasted malt, coffee and chocolate notes, smooth lingering after taste. 4.0% ABV.

Name: Dragon Stout
Description: Dragon Stout is a moderately sweet stout. It is dark brown in color with a tan head and has a dark malty aroma with a touch of roast. Lightly carbonated and easy drinking, this is a good stout for those who are beginners to dark beer.

Name: Reubens BBIS Imperial Stout
Food Pairing: Cheese - Hard Aged, Dessert - Chocolate  Coffee
Description: The majority of the barrels in this year’s blend have been aging for about one year, and the addition of some two year-aged BBIS into the blend adds layers of complexity. We barrel age this stout in a blend of 10 to 12 year bourbon barrels. Using the same oat-forward and British specialty malt recipe that hails back from the original version brewed in 2013, we introduced some new techniques to make the beer bigger, richer and silkier.

Name: Mcauslan St Ambroise Imperial Stout
Description: St-Ambroise Russian Imperial Stout is Quebec’s tribute to the late 1700’s English Imperial Stouts, brewed for the Russian courts of Catherine the Great.  Made from a blend of barley malts, St-Ambroise Russian Imperial Stout is infused with Cascade, Goldings and Willamette hops, resulting in an outstanding hop-character with a smooth finish. Bourbon wood-aged, this full-bodied ale has a rich, smoky aroma with hints of vanilla, expresso and chocolate.  Serve St-Ambroise Russian Imperial Stout between 13°C and 15°C, preferably in a port glass or a brandy snifter. This stout will improve with age for a number of years. Store in a cool, dark place.

Name: Dogfish Head Bourbon Barrel-Aged World Wide Stout
Description: Just when we thought World Wide Stout couldn’t get any better…Our brewers decided to take a Dogfish Head legend and age it on charred oak bourbon barrels acquired directly from Heaven Hill Distillery – still wet with spirits when they arrived at the brewery!Rare and often rumored about in the darkest corners of the beer community, this variety of World Wide Stout is dark, rich, roasty and complex, balancing notes of coffee and licorice with the carmely, smooth finish of bourbon.Clocking in at 15-18% ABV, Bourbon Barrel-Aged World Wide Stout is an excellent candidate for cellaring, so grab a few bottle to enjoy now and lay the others down for a few years. You’ll be happy you did … trust us.

Name: Middle Ages Dragonslayer
Description: Brewed in the style of a Russian Imperial Stout. Strong, chocolatety and aggressively hopped with finest English hops.

Name: JP’s Casper White Stout
Description: Throw your expectations out the window. We know Stouts are supposed to be dark, but what fun is that? Really. Casper White Stout is a white buffalo standing out from the herd – a diamond in the rough, white chocolate – you get it. Distinctively golden in color with big Pilsen malt flavor, and a touch of hops. Your next step? Pour it in your glass.

Name: 4 Pines Brewing Stout
Tasting Notes: Caramel, Chocolate, Coffee, Roasted, Smooth, Toasty
Description: This beer is where humanity’s first ever quest to create beer for space began. Open and enjoy smooth aromas & flavours of coffee & chocolate. No room for space puns, just out of this world beer. You couldn’t help yourself now…

Name: Timber Ales Morning Shake Out Stout
Description: Morning Shakeout is a collaboration with our friend Zac of Marlowe Ales. This Stout, which has been aged on coffee provided by our friends at Dark Matter Coffee is meant to combine our love for Stouts with Zac's appreciation of lower ABV and approachable beers.

Name: Dragon Head Stout
Description: A black stout which is brimming over with roast malt flavours, balanced with a complex hop blend. Really smooth with roasted aftertaste.

Name: Cuv’ee Alex Le Rouge
Description: Silver medal at Soleure’s extreme beer fest 2007. An extreme black beer whose nose goes toward pepper, vanilla, ashes, tobacco and fresh hops. It reaches the palate all in softness, but quickly becomes intensely bitter, though not very dry. Long and satisfying finish.  This Cuvée was created in the honor of the Jurrassian revolutionist Alex Le Rouge. Enjoy this wonderful Cuvée at about 10°-12° Celsius (50°-53°F), with a crunch of bitter Chocolate or a Cigar. Cuvée Alex Le Rouge can be sequestrated for a few years in a cellar. Ingredients: water, barley malts, hops, cane sugar, yeast, Serawak pepper, Russia tea, Bourbon vanilla.

Name: Olde Hickory The Event Horizon Imperial Stout
Description: The Event Horizon- an annual release. We barrel age an imperial stout in oak bourbon barrels, from several bourbon varieties, and blend the results. Dark and rich with bourbon flavors- once this beer grabs you you'll never escape. Winner of a World Beer Cup (R) 2012 bronze award in the Wood- and Barrel-Aged Strong Stout category! Released each year in the late fall-early winter.

Name: Hourglass Morlock Milk Stout
Description: Brew traveler, contained within this can is a dark, formidable beast known as Morlock Milk Stout. Brutish and menacing at first appearance, you’ll soon discover than there is more to this beer than meets the eye. With a thick, roast forward flavor from Irish, English, Chilean and American malts, and a creamy sweetness from milk sugar, you’ll find yourself seeking out Morlock time and time again.

Name: Marston’s Oyster Stout
Description: Pasteurised bottle containing: Water, malt, hops and co2.  Sometimes available in the cask

Name: Mackeson XXX Stout
Description: This is a higher alcohol version of the British Mackeson Stout. Formerly brewed in the United States by Boston Beer Co. at their Cincinnati location (the old Hudepohl brewery). Presently brewed at the Carib Brewery in Trinidad (and St. Kitts).

Name: Urban Roots Good Morning Son Imperial Stout
Description: Imperial Breakfast Stout w/ Camellia coffee, vanilla and cardamom seeds.

Name: Against the Grain Bo And Luke Imperial Stout
Description: Originally an Against the Grain Brewery and Brouwerij De Molen collaboration beer. For the first incarnation, De Molen head brewer Menno Oliver hopped in a muscle car and drove straight through from the Netherlands to Louisville, KY (that’s USA folks) to brew this bourbon inspired ale, and we liked it so much, we decided to do it again. We took the ingredients in bourbon whiskey (Barley, Rye, Corn) and then smoked them with cherry wood and brewed a huge imperial stout with them. Then to top it off we aged it in Pappy Van Winkle Bourbon Barrels. The resulting beer is rich, smokey and complex, with a bourbon character of caramel, vanilla and spice.

Name: Dandy In The Underworld Sweet Oyster Stout
Brasserie Ellezelloise Hercule Stout
Description:
The only self-proclaimed ‘Belgian stout’ – 9% by volume – named after famed Belgian detective Hercule Poirrot and considered a World Classic.

Made in small batches, then lagered for ten days in German oak casks. 

The Hercule is considered by many to be a classic – very malty, but dry, with a hint of sweetness in the finish, and perfectly hopped. It has a very distinctive and intoxicating spicy aroma of fresh spruce that suddenly, irresistibly, fills the room when the swing-top is released. This unique house character probably derives from the strains of yeast used by the brewery – and possibly from the fermentation in oak – because the beers are made entirely of malt and hops, without any spices or sugar.

Name: Lava Smoked Imperial Stout
Description: Smoked imperial stout with a thick brown head. Sweet with chocolate and roasted malt in the flavour. The aftertaste is roasted malt, smoke and warming alcohol. Aroma of smoke chocolate and a bit of alcohol.

Name: Green Jack Baltic Trader Export Stout
Description: Baltic Trader is an Extra Strong Export Stout. Smooth, rich and fruity with roasted coffee & vanilla flavours. If you havn’t tried it yet, you need to! Baltic Trader celebrates the North Sea sailing ships that traded between East Coast ports like Lowestoft, the Low Countries and Scandinavia.

Name: Devils Trumpet Night Goat Coffee Stout
Description: This smooth coffee stout was brewed with five pounds of Dark Matter Coffee per barrel! The rich coffee flavors blend seamlessly with the silky smooth and roasty malt profile. It finishes with a subtle sweetness from the generous use of lactose sugar.

Name: Cerveceria Montseny Mala Vida Chili
Description:
This is a high-grade black beer brewed with two varieties of American chili peppers.

Tasting notes: A complex beer with a spicy touch from the chiles. On the second sip, a warm taste will permeate your mouth and you will not be able to stop!

Name: SmuttyNose SNACCIDENT Peanut Butter Chocolate Stout
Description: Peanut butter and chocolate fans have united and demanded this delicious and, dare we say it, irresistible flavor combo. This stout has rich notes of peanut butter and chocolate, with a mild undertone of toasted coffee.

Name: Garun Icelandic Imp Stout
Description: "Garún is named for the strong and brave heroine of one of Iceland’s most popular folktales "The deacon of Dark River (Myrká)." A tale of ghosts, undying love, and life triumphing over death told against the backdrop of elements essential to Iceland’s character: ice, snow, and flooding waters whirling dark and mysterious. The same elements that inspire this rich, intense, bold and swirlingly varied Icelandic stout. Garún is a dark aura of intense richness and haunting aroma with notes of chocolate, licorice and coffee. Skál!"

Name: Broadside Imperial Oatmeal Stout
Description: Barrel-aged in bourbon barrels lends a smooth and rich vanilla combination. And with 400+ pounds of rolled oats per batch, this beer has a thick body with roasty, chocolatey notes and a medium alcohol warmth. This beer opens a full flavor salvo.

Name: Sierra Narwhal Red Wine Aged
Description: We aged our Narwhal Imperial Stout in oak barrels formerly used to mature red wine. The influence of the oak and wine cuts through and brightens the massive malt body, adding fruit-forward flavors with a round, vanilla-like sweetness from the wood.

Name: O’Haras’s Barrel Aged Series Leann Follain Irish Stout
Description: Where the essence of select whiskey barrels combines with O’Hara’s award winning beers.  In 2012, we embarked on a new series of beers, barrel aging our beers in select whiskey barrels that we felt would match and balance well with any one of O’Hara’s beers.  Awards / accolades for our highly acclaimed Barrel Aged Leann Folláin include Trophy winner at the Irish Whiskey Awards 2015 (October), Concours M Biere Pierre Celis Platinum Medal winner at Mondial de la Bière 2014 in France and Gold Medal winner at the Irish Whiskey Awards 2014.  The fifth edition of our O’Hara’s Barrel Aged Series introduces our new cork and cage bottling for bottle conditioned beer, which allows fermentation to occur inside the bottle.  To craft this beer we fill casks which were previously used for Irish Whiskey with our full bodied and rich O’Hara’s Leann Folláin Extra Irish Stout.  The stout is aged in oak Irish Whiskey barrels where it picks up the flavours of whiskey and oak cask.  After aging we then bottle condition the beer to give a gentle carbonation, bringing out the best of both the stout and the whiskey.

Name: Shaidzon Gino Time Stout
Description: A slightly bitter stout with roasted character and a dry finish

Name: Iron Goat Goatmeal Stout
Description: An austere buck, the Goatmeal pours pure chocolate brown, with a thick mocha-colored head. Dark and delicate notes of espresso and cocoa swirl lusciously on the tongue, gliding smoothly to a sweet-dry finish.

Name: Guinness Barrel Aged Stock Ale
Description: This unique beer is a blend of two separate, bourbon barrel-aged brews from the team at the Open Gate Brewery in Baltimore. Around 60% of the finished beer is a classic Imperial Stout, while an style Barleywine makes up the remaining 40%. Characteristic stout flavors like roast coffee, lightly bitter chocolate, and toasted bread are balanced by the sweeter notes of raisin, plum, and stone fruit from the Barleywine. Truly a one-of-a-kind beer.

Name: 3rd Wave Brewing Dawn Patrol Coffee & Cream Stout
Description: A dark, luscious, American style creamy milk stout. Lots of coffee flavor and a hint of sweetness. The dark roasted coffee is cold steeped to avoid bitterness. The sweetness comes from the lactose sugar. This is a smooth, full-bodied beer, great for a cold winter day.

Name: Zero Gravity Extra Stout Dry Stout
High Water Imperial Campfire Stout Stout
Big Oyster Brewery On Point Stout
Description: Fresh French Vanilla beans from the The Pointe Cafe in Rehoboth Beach steeped in Big Oyster Stout creates this delicious coffee forward stout

Name: Revolution Deep Wood Deth By Cherries
Mast Landing Coffee Gunner’s Daughter Milk Stout
Short Throw Resting My Greatness Imperial Stout
Maine Beer Company Wolfe’s Neck IPA
Description:
Flavor Profile: Tropical Fruit (Pineapple, Mango, Guava, Coconut) And Orange, With Notes of Onion/Garlic And Underlying Toasted Bread And Pine.
Hops: Mosaic, El Dorado, Sabro
Malt: Briess Brewers Malt, Maine Malt House Mapleton Pale, Maine Malt House Red Wheat,
Briess C-40, Briess Carapils

Name: Dragoon IPA
Description: This is a true West Coast IPA - deep gold in color, featuring a dank, herbal, citrusy hop aroma supported by a sparse malt backbone. It is appropriately bitter, with a relatively high alcohol content. Pair Dragoon IPA with spicy dishes (like chile verde or phở), but if spice isn't your thing, you can't go wrong with any aged sharp cheddar.

Name: Red Hook Big Ballard
Description: n 1982 Redhook was born in a converted transmission shop in the Ballard District outside of Seattle, WA. After 28 years of brewing, Redhook is paying homage to its roots by releasing Big Ballard Imperial IPA. Big Ballard has a rich, deep golden and a very assertive hop character that hits you in the nose before reaching your lips. The flavor and aroma are balanced with complex malty undertones. While it has a friendly side, make no mistake - Big Ballard is brewed for diehard IPA fans.

Name: Persimmon Hollow Beach Hippie IPA
Description: Cruisin’ the beach, burning one down, this East Coast style IPA has a fruity, balanced malt presence and five hop varieties. It is perfect for an evening on the porch with friends or even the hottest beach day.

Name: Mantra Saffron IPA
Description: Brewed as a pacific northwest IPA the essence of saffron and cardamom flash in your mouth followed by a very present and flavorful floral hop finish. Drink this beer fresh.

Name: Stickmen F Bomb IPA
Description: A straightforward IPA with a big load of Falconers Flight late as well as in the dry hopping.

Name: Icarus We Want Gold IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Copiously dry hopped with El Dorado, Columbus, and Mosaic, leaving it jam packed with guava, mango, and orange notes.

Name: Cold Harbor Juice Freak
Description: Juice Freak, our single hop IPA made with...yes, citra! Nicely opaque orange with a very strong juicy flavor, not too heavy on the hops at the back end.

Name: Phillips Rocket ISA
Description: Pull the tab and take off! A big hop nose and bright mouthfeel give way to sweet citrus hop flavours, accented with a hint of pine.

Name: Boréale IPA du Nord-Est IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Sortie d'abord sous le programme ÉPISODE, et ensuite rendue disponible de manière régulière dans la Série Artisan de Boréale.

Name: Garrison Juicy! Double IPA
Description: This ridiculously hoppy East Coast Double IPA uses end-of-boil hop bursting to create maximum effect with minimum bitterness. The resulting beer has citrus, pineapple, mango & berry notes that can only be called “Juicy”!

Name: Dia De Los Muertos DOA IPA
Description: Copper color  full bodied beer with rich malt tones perfectly balanced between a smooth and delicate sweetness and just the right amount of bitterness. Great hop / floral aromas.

Name: Jughandle Brewing 4057 DIPA
Description: "Forty Fifty Seven" is a powerful double IPA that hits all the senses, from its heavy haze to its balance of tropical yet dank aroma and flavor courtesy of a heaping blend of hops.

Name: Burgeon Beer Co. Treevana IPA
Description: West Coast IPA hopped with Mosaic & Amarillo

Name: Ogopogo Blunderbore Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazy Double IPA DDH with Brambling Cross, Azacca, & Mosaic hops. If you ever find yourself in the town of Cornwall, England, be warned dear travller, for here be Giants. Cornish folklore tells tall tales of the giant Blunderbore who has terrorized the region for as long as there have be people.

Name: Hooker #NoFilter NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Juicy New England style IPA dry hopped with a massive amount of citra and mosaic hops

Name: Roughtail Brewing Hoptometrist Double IPA
Description: Hoptometrist is an American style Double IPA that is crisp, dry and very drinkable with just enough malt to support the huge bitterness and intense piney, citrusy, dank hop presence.

Name: Natchez Brewing Old Capital IPA
Description: “American IPA. This cloudy rich apricot-colored IPA screams tropical fruit. The combination of west coast and southern hemisphere hops add hints of pineapple and mango. Old Capital is best consumed fresh!”

Name: Soul Squared Rocky Mountain Haze IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: This thick, hazy, Vermont-style IPA bursts with juicy citrus and tropical flavor and aggressive citrus hop bitterness.

Name: Ribstone Creek Lone Bison IPA
Description: Our Unfiltered IPA comes in with citrus and pine notes, blended with a pronounced hoppy flavour that finishes with a hint of spice. With floral and hop aroma, Lone Bison is an exceptional brew for hopheads and craft beer fans alike.

Name: Cabin Sunshine Rain IPA
Description: Our take on the classic northwest American IPA shuns the heavy caramel and resin notes typically found in this style for something more refined and unique. Sunshine Rain has been brewed to be balanced, lively, fresh and dry, but doesn’t hold back with an aggressive dank and tropical hop punch - a combination of Simcoe, Mosaic and Citra hops.

Name: 26 Degree IPA1A
Description: Jump in and take a hop-fueled ride down highway IPA1A. Inspired by the refreshing breeze and scenic surroundings of South Florida’s most iconic beachside highway, this IPA is the perfect way to end any road trip. From the citrus aroma and floral bouquet to the dry, yet surprisingly quenching zest of hops, IPA1A finishes with a subtle citrus flavor and an understated malty backbone.

Name: Shed IPA
Description: This unfiltered English Strong Ale is a medium to full-bodied ale, with pronounced caramel and toffee notes, followed by a roasted finish. A moderate hop bitterness is derived from generous kettle additions of Mt. Hood and Northern Brewer hops.

Name: Manzanita IPA
Description: Lightly kilned caramel malts round out the pungent, piney Chinook dry-hopping. As its smooth mouthfeel dissipates into a pleasantly bitter finish, we hope you’ll find our IPA an elegant outlier from its hometown crowd.

Name: Sunriver Vicious Mosquito
Description:
“Vicious” is Sunriver Brewing Company’s flagship West Coast styled India Pale Ale. The heavy handed use of the finest Northwest hops define this pungent, resinous brew. This hop attack is coming at you like the vicious mosquitos at our nearby Cascade Mountains.

MALTS
Premium NW 2 Row Malted Barley, Munich and Crystal 40
HOPS
Warrior, Cascade, Centennial, Columbus and Simcoe

Name: HenHouse Brewing Company Certified Independent AF IPA
Description: We're an independent business, our founders and most our investors (our friends and family) live in the Bay Area. We place a lot of value in that. It's important to us that we're creating local wealth, not only by being locally owned, but by creating jobs that pay well locally, by supporting our communities non-profits and by supporting other local businesses. We don't just want to make kick-ass beer and keep the money in the community, want want to create a company that makes the Bay Area proud. We think you should support local business, which is why we're proud to be Certified Independent AF! This hazy as heck IPA is made with Mosaic and Pacific Jade hops.

Name: Real Ale Blakkr Imperial Black Ale
Description: Blakkr Imperial Black Ale was born in 2014 as a collaboration between Surly, 3 Floyds, and Real Ale. Bonded by their love of brewing and love of metal, this unholy trinity of brewers gathered around a brew kettle in Blanco, TX to craft this deeply dark concoction. Subtle dark malt and toffee character quickly yields to the citrus and tropical notes provided by a staggering amount of hops. The result is a crushing, black-as-night Double IPA. All hail the mighty BLAKKR!

Name: Rally King Surfer Girl IPA
Description: A heavily hopped but not overly bitter India pale ale. This beer has a balanced body and bountiful hoppy aroma. A 2014 Taste of Fort Collins home brew award winner & RKB’s flagship beer.

Name: Four Quarters Moondog Double Black IPA
Description: The nighttime alter ego to Sundog just arrived… MOONDOG is a Double Black IPA with Citra & Amarillo hops, 8%.

Name: SweetWater Trainwreck Hazy Double IPA
Description: Trainwreck is an 8% ABV Double IPA that drinks like an orange creamsicle and smells like a fresh bag! Now available in Stash Boxes and soon in 6 packs. The 420 Strain Series features drinkable beer, with the added bonus of an olfactory experience that mimics that of the legendary cannabis strains.

Name: Jekyll Pineapple Habanero Hop Dang Diggity
Icicle Bootjack IPA
Description: This ‘Northwest Classic’ is a harmonious blend of our pride and our passion inspired by the rugged and gentle terrain of the Cascade Mountains. Starting with the pristine waters of Icicle Creek, we add the intense flavors and aromas of our locally grown Yakima hops, pairing the citrusy floral hop notes with a sweet-malty undertone. It’s an IPA that’s breaking the barrier between bitter and bold.

Name: 3 Sheeps Really Cool IPA
Description: It’s all about choosing a dream. Once the decision was made to open a brewery, we knew there could be no more appropriate a name for our founding beer. We combined three hop varieties over a ninety minute boil in three separate additions and a massive amount of hops added for the dry-hop. The smooth malt profile lets the hops do the talking. It’s complex and intricate, yet completely accessible - a labor of love to be shared with the world.

Name: Worthy IPA
Description: Clean, crisp and refreshing. A tribute to our friends at Indie Hops, this amazingly balanced beer is bursting with the finest hops Oregon has to offer: Nugget, Centennial, Meridian, Crystal and Horizon. Renowned for his IPAs, Chad just raised the bar.

Name: Thomas Hooker Brewing Company Hooker Super Duper Double Citra Double IPA
Description: Double NE IPA with all Citra hops.

Name: Sisyphus Scoopshot IPA
Description: Our take on the milkshake IPA except we skipped the lactose (you are welcome, our lactose intolerant friends.) But this thing still tastes like it has a scoop of ice cream in it, with a healthy dose of pineapple and vanilla, to complement the fruity hops and yeast. Look for this one to be a new regular occurrence on our menu!

Name: Dirty Bucket Sicyne IPA
Description: Northwest IPA, hop forward with a citrus nose and unusually dark, balanced malt profile.

Name: Brookeville Beer Farm Spin Out IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Guava and papaya flavors upfront with a strong hoppy finish.

Name: Terminal Gravity Pilsner
Description: Maybe you’re river rafting, maybe you’re playing frisbee, or maybe you just finished a 10 hours of hard work. Whatever the case, at a light and highly drinkable 4.5% abv, Pilsner is probably the ideal beer for it.

Name: Destination Unknown Strawberry Frosted Donut Milkshake IPA
Description: Collaboration with North Fork Donut Company for the Local to Locals Series

Name: Karmic Daaru Pumpkin Jaduu
Description: Lady Dayaan (Witch) soars above Mumbai streets before Diwali casting her spells and spreading good karma to all pumpkin lovers.  Enjoy hints of cinnamon and brown sugar blended with fresh pumpkin while you take in this mild sour ale.

Name: Federation Brewing Zero Charisma Hazy IPA Series
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: The newest rendition of the Zero Charisma series featuring experimental hop HBC-586.  A massive hazy bomb of pineapple, mango, and guava aroma and flavor.

Name: Dayton Beer Oregon Alley IPA
Description: A combination of spicy, citrus and herbal hops deliver lots of bitterness while our blend of Marris otter, Caramel 120, and a hint of roasted barley malt lend a supporting backbone to this highly hopped IPA.

Name: Copperhead Striker IPA
Description: Striker IPA is all about hops. The trio of Citra, Columbus and Apollo hops create a dank, resinous, tropical and citrus flavor. Light bodied with a crisp malt base lets the hops shine

Name: Birds Fly South Blueprint
Description: Our house IPA. A juicy, double dry-hopped beer brewed with guava puree for full flavor and complexity. Hop-bursted with Mosaic, Centennial, and Citra, this balanced pint has a fresh taste and a classic, slightly bitter finish.

Name: Demented Gallows Hill New England IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: A beer as hazy as the nights sky in Salem. This take on the New England style IPA will have you wondering if we're using magic. Like concocting a spell, we used a different combination of citrus hops and yeast to bring you into a realm that nobody has been to before. Stop by, hang out, and try this elixir.

Name: Scarlet Lane Asteria IPA
Description: Gaze upon the dark sky of falling stars and take a trip with Asteria Australian IPA to the edge of divination visions. Crashing into the palate like the Australian coastline, Topaz and Ella hops create a fruit-like aroma with mild bitterness. Reinforced by a split of pale, biscuit-like malts and Australian yeast, Asteria summons a wave of drinkability in this Australian Ale fit for any occasion and beer drinker. Join Asteria on the edge of the earth and never look back

Name: Partake Non Alcoholic IPA
Description: Partake IPA is an award winning craft brew made using all natural ingredients and balances citrusy hops with a subtle malt backbone.  A light, bubbly body and dry finish make it an all-day sipper that packs an incredible amount of flavour.

Name: Iron Springs Casey Jones Imperial IPA
Description: This double IPA has twice the hops and grains as its counterpart. Significant floral, citrus, and peppery notes on the nose, yet even with the enormous hop profile, the huge grain bill results in a very well balanced brew.

Name: Panther Island IPf’nA IPA
Description:
This beer focuses more on the citrus side of things, not the piney, sticky-icky IPAs of the West Coast.

Our Imperial IPA boasts a huge malt bill to balance out the bitterness and presents a nice caramel middle. We use cracked coriander that gives a mellow zest to the beer. We dry hop with Cascade hops to give it the right amount of citrus nose. The spicy grapefruit flavors come from the blending of Summit, Columbus, and Centennial hops.

Name: Catawba Brewing CLT IPA
Description:
Despite George Washington calling it a “trifling place”, Charlotte evolved from a simple dirt crossroads into a leader of the new South. True to that spirit, Catawba has been evolving Carolinas’ craft brewing since 1999. This new creation, CLT India Pale Ale, offers up a modern, double dry-hopped, in-your-face explosion of tropical fruit and pine. And at 7.2% ABV, like today’s Queen City, don’t trifle with it!

This big IPA has loads of ripe tropical and stone fruit notes from copious amounts of Simcoe, Citra, Amarillo,and Centennial hops. A light malt bill leaves this beer with a dry finish allowing the hops to stand out.

Name: Comman Space Random And Dangerous IPA
Description: Monstrous citrus and tropical flavor and aroma from over six pounds per barrel of hops snap you awake from your boring beer stupor.

Name: BraufactuM Progusta 1/4 Barrel
Description:
*This keg requires an "A" system coupler.Kegs are intended for Kegerator use only. TAP NOT INCLUDED.NOTE: An additional deposit charge per keg may be placed on your card. A representative from Drizly or the store will be in contact to confirm all details prior to delivery. Empty barrels will be picked up upon delivery of new kegs. 
For special requests, please contact: kegs@drizly.com

1/2 Barrel = 15.5 gallons = 165 beers
50 Liter = 13.2 gallons = 140 beers

1/6 Barrel = 5.2 gallons = 55 beers

Name: Ursula IPA
Description: Tropical Hop Juice! This very tropical IPA is super juicy with notes of orange, pineapple, and lemon/lime all shining through the restrained malt profile.

Name: Valholl Mother In Law Imperial IPA
Description: Bitter and alcoholic, the Mother in Law is our Double IPA. Aggressive hops dominate the nose of this assertive mother of an IPA. The full malt body and grassy, citrusy hop bitterness and aroma make this a well-balanced, yet bold beer. Hops: Chinook, Centennial, Falconer’s Flight, Zythos, Simcoe Malt: Pale, Munich, Caramel 20

Name: Port Jeff Party Boat IPA
Description: Citrusy, herbal, piney and hoppy. Permission to come aboard this hopped up booze cruise in a glass is hereby GRANTED!

Name: Greenbrier Valley Mothman Black IPA
Description: The Mothman Black IPA is a hop forward, medium bodied black ale. The strong hop flavor is from the use of the choicest Pacific Northwest hops; lending to a balanced bitterness of citrus and hints of floral. The German 2-row and English Crystal malts offer a touch of roasted toffee and chocolate. At 6.7% abv and 71 IBU’s, this Black IPA promises to satisfy any hophead.

Name: Viven Imperial IPA
Description: Viven Imperial IPA came from the westcoast of America but is brewed in Flemish style and gives a great result. It will make the beer lovers heart beat a bit faster. An adventure for your senses. Good hoppy beer with citrusaccents. Fruity nose (peach and pink grapefruit) with floral flavours, recalls a forest (spruce) in the early morning. The hops are prominent. The Viven Imperial IPA is pleasently bitter.

Name: Brewfist Spaceman IPA
Description: Beer of golden color produced in the tradition of the West Coast IPA. Amara, dry but very aromatic and well balanced by the alcoholic content. The three varieties of hops used make a bouquet of aromas in which exotic fruit and citrus fruit stand out. A beer for fans ...

Name: Towne Park American IPA
Description: The IPA is complicated. Misunderstood by some, loved by many. Big in herbal and citric character, our Towne IPA also carries a degree of bitterness that is common in what is considered the flagship flavor of the craft beer movement. If you're looking for something full flavored with a nice malty backbone, the Towne IPA is for you.

Name: Buzzards Bay IPA
Description: Bright and Hoppy and wonderful IPA.

Name: Inlet Monk In The Trunk IPA
Description: This unique copper-colored ale derives its fruity, slightly spicy aroma from authentic Belgian Abbey yeast. The subtle nutty and malty sweet flavors sing in harmony with the freshest organic hops available.

Name: Hop Butcher For The World Megabite Double IPA
Brand: Hop Butcher For The World Brewing

Name: The Booth Two Face West Double IPA
Description:
Introducing our Two Face Double IPA, The Booth's first DIPA duo. Two Face West DIPA, also dubbed "Boothman the Eternal", is the West Coast style version of Two Face. 

West Coast Double IPA pouring a bright golden straw with a brilliant white head. Echoing themes of the Pacific Northwest itself, this DIPA features strong pine and resinous flavors up front and gives way to complex floral and citrus notes. A bitter finish reminds you this is a double IPA!

Which Boothman wins your taste buds, the Eternal or the Terminal?

Name: Big Lug Alpenhorn IPA
Description: Sharp, dry, and floral with light melon aromas from German hops.

Name: The Shed IPA
Description: Named after one of the famous ’front four’ trails on Mt. Mansfield, this I.P.A. is brewed in the English tradition of pale ales shipped from Britain, around Africa, to India. Those ales contained extra hops and a higher alcohol percentage, which both served as natural preservatives. This ale holds true to those original, defining characteristics. Formerly known as "National IPA" at The Shed Restaurant & Brewery.

Name: CBC The Great Pumpkin Ale
Categories: Specialty Beer  Alternatives, Spice  Herb  Vegetable Beer
Description: New England’s first and CBC’s most sought after seasonal beer, The Great Pumpkin Ale, is back in bottles and on draft! We are very proud to be brewing with locally-grown sugar pumpkins from our friends at The Farm School in Athol, and Wilson Farms in Lexington. We’re also using organic barley that was grown in MA and then small-batch malted by our friends at Valley Malt in Hadley, MA.

Name: F-Town Ipalicious IPA
Description: This devilishly good IPA is not for the faint of heart. One sip and you will be hit by its signature piney citrus punch with a complex, yet balanced, malty flavor. Our IPA will give you the hoppy kick that you expect, while still providing you with the balanced finish that you crave and deserve.

Name: Commonwealth Brewing Rainbowe Double IPA
Description: Double IPA made with an extravagant dose of Denali, Idaho 7, Wakatu, and Cascade hops

Name: Blue Point Spectral Haze IPA
Description: Introducing Spectral Haze, a new elixir of dreams, conjuring up hazier, more grandiose illusions than ever. At 6.5% ABV, this glowing blend of Mosaic, Denali, Simcoe, Comet, and Huell Melon hops will indulge your senses with a multitude of tropical fruit flavors and confirm that Illusions are brewed to expand our reality.

Name: Clown Shoes Tuscan Picnic Rose IPA
Description: We often dream of a perfect picnic from the idyllic Tuscan countryside, enjoying a healthy slab of brie, fresh fruit, and a crisp baguette atop a peaceful hill. Of course, being Clown Shoes, our daydreams inevitably turn extraterrestrial. Where did that UFO come from? What’s this fabulous alien foliage populating our dreamscape of a hillside? These questions don’t have answers, but they make us laugh.Tuscan Picnic is our Rosé IPA. Crisp, bright and floral at its base, an addition of Lambrusco grape juice lends sweet fruit notes reminiscent of our favorite wines. We’ll be reaching for this effervescent delight from whatever sunny hillside gives us the best view of the flamboyant alien invasion.

Name: Coronado Brewing/Pizza Port South Of The Pier
Description: Coronado Brewing and Pizza Port go way back. This collaboration celebrates the decades of friendship spent paving the way for craft beer in San Diego. This first release, South of the Pier IPA, is Coronado’s take on a West Coast IPA; brewed with a hefty dose of Southern Hemisphere hops for a bright, tropical aroma and crisp, dry finish. So, let’s raise a pint to good times, great friends, and Beers Between Piers (and peers)!

Name: Yo-Ho Brewing Sorry Umami Ipa With
Description: SORRY UMAMI IPA is a beer that our brewers wanted to drink and not you, sorry! The "umami" is extracted from Katsuobushi (bonito flakes) and while it facilitates beer fermentation, it also adds beer refreshing and fruity tropical flavors. Just in case you’re wondering, this beer doesn't taste like fish!

Name: Melvin Twilight Trance Red
Description: Red IPAs are dead you say? You obviously haven’t tried the latest iteration from Melvin. The brew team took a thick imperial red recipe and went heavy-handed on dry-hopping with loads of Galaxy, Enigma and Vic Secret. These unique Southern Hemisphere hops provide an array of flavors and aromas, from peach, melon and red vine candy, to pungent dank and cedar, all balancing out the rich malty body with a relatively dry finish. This unexpectedly smooth harmony of bold malt and hop additions is sure to leave you in a trance.

Name: Spider Bite Eye Be Use Imperial IPA
Description: Crisp and dangerously drinkable, this double IPA is just what the bitter drinker needs in his life. You’re not looking for anything malty. You’re not looking for the aromatic, floral character of hops. When you’re looking for IBUs, ask for it by nam

Name: Ise Kadoya IPA
Description: India Pale Ale was originally intended to stand up over long voyages, loaded with hops to keep bacteria levels low. Our IPA may no longer have to endure long voyages, but we would never think about changing this recipe—to the delight of our hophead fans. Taking cues from lessons learned for making our pale ale, our IPA achieves an unequaled balance from each ingredient to form a stable and strong body with a clean aftertaste.

Name: McCashin Family Stoke IPA
Description: We hope you enjoy this Stoke IPA. We make it the old fashioned way and never cut corners. It’s brewed using a combination of premium Nelson hops including Pacific Gem, Cascade, Motueka and Styrian Golding, bespoke yeast, 14,000 year old Paleso™ water and lightly toasted malt (no artificial additives or colouring). Stoke IPA is tank conditioned over 4 weeks to ensure a smooth caramel sweetness and hangover-free experience.

Name: Lake Of Bays 10 Point IPA
Description: Pours with dark amber, burnt orange, copper colour and off-white, ecru-coloured foam. The aromatics are primarily citrus (grapefruit) with a subtle pine note. After the first scent, the malt aromatics come through – slight hint of toffee with some mild aromas of hay and straw. The body of the beer is roasted malts, dark toffee, a gentle molasses flavour and a touch of black licorice. The mouth feel is rounded and very dry. The finish is moderate-to-bold bitterness that lingers longer but is very pleasant. The finish is enveloping and builds with each sip.

Name: Byway Overdue Double IPA
Description: Full bodied, copper-hued, orange notes and tons of hops but extraordinarily well-balanced. The Grand Marnier of DIPAs.

Name: Alameda Yellow Wolf Imperial IPA
Description: This big, zesty beer was ahead of its time in the Pacific Northwest’s IPA game. Our most popular brew, Yellow Wolf balances citrus with bitter and delivers a fragrant forest aroma. Sounds intense — but it’s really a big sweetie. Pairs well with sunshine.

Name: Nørrebro Bryghus North Bridge Extreme IPA
Description: North Bridge Extreme, was a present from the brewers to Brewmaster Anders on the first anniversary of Nørrebro Bryghus. Inspired by the Southwest Californian triple IPA’s, it is brewed with British ale malts, adjusted with several colour malts and spiced with extreme amounts of hops.  A dark golden extremely bitter ale (9,5 % ABV) with a prominent hop aroma. Should be enjoyed as the final beer of the evening – Your taste buds will no longer function after drinking this ale!

Name: Nomada Humala IPA
Description: Humala IPA is the artistic expression of drunkenness, poetry that conveys the passion from Nómada to innovate. This India Pale Ale exploits the possibilities of hops on a light malt and crystal but perfectly supports its massive and continuous addition. 7.3% ABV. Combines well with baked fish, Parmentier, salmon, swordfish, all kinds of fish in sushi or sashimi, risottos, snacks, cheese, beef, tempura, breaded, shrimp, pork with salt and sausages.

Name: The Peoples Pint Pied pIPA Ale
Helms Hop The RIPA
Description: Our red India pale ale is a sterling example of excess. We use copious amounts of both malts and hops to create this decidedly bitter yet curiously balanced beer. As its namesake implies it is more than capable of overloading the unsuspecting pallet just with a lot less mutton chops and frock coats. Big caramel, big malts and even bigger resinous citrus hop flavor and aroma. This beer pairs well with BBQ, Curry, Spicy foods and pungent cheeses.

Name: Wilmas Wandering EyePA
Description: A very drinkable Super Imperial IPA. Pronounced but nicely balanced hop profile. Pours amber red, with a thick white head. Subtle notes of orange are present but fade quickly

Name: Route 2 Stacked Double IPA
Description: A completely balanced Double IPA, Stacked with an enormous amount of Hops and Malt.

Name: Category 12 Disruption Black IPA
Description: Compulsion will drive you to distraction. While most of us are happy languishing in the comfort of predictability, there are a select few who are restless. They spend their days trying desperately to hide an urgent need to disrupt this culture of mindless repetition, but their desire to maintain appearances is ultimately overshadowed by their fascinations. Get ready to challenge what you think about dark beer. This black IPA is a calculated anomaly. It looks big and scary like a stout, but it drinks like an IPA. Close your eyes, you’ll never guess how far into the dark you’re sinking. With its fresh hop aroma and roasted malt flavour, Disruption is a whole new beast.

Name: Mt Begbie Nasty Habit IPA
Description: A generously hopped IPA, balanced by a diabolical blend of rich specialty malts and pure mountain water. A wicked ale that leaves you lusting for more!

Name: Saranac West End Winter IPA
Description: In 1888, our (great) grand-father founded the West End Brewery, which is now known as the F.X. Matt Brewing Company. We delivered our IPA’s in those days with horses, wagons and barrels. He gave life to our family’s legacy of craft brewing, and we honor him with our West End Winter IPA.

Name: Geneva Lake No Wake IPA
Description: This American style IPA is the pioneer beer for the Geneva Lake Brewing Co. As a long-time favorite of the co-owners; this IPA delivers on all the flavor and finish we’ve come to expect of a good IPA. Whether you are cruising the lake or docked at home; throw your gears into idle, slow down and enjoy!

Name: Bns Revolver IPA
Description: Your classic southern California IPA brewed with six different types of hops: CTZ, Centennial, Chinook, Mt. Hood, Summit, and Citra. Lots of grapefruit and citrus surrounding a hint of biscuit. At 6.5% ABV this American IPA is very sessionable and refreshing.

Name: Beach City Hang Five IPA
Description: We wouldn’t be properly representing our hometown if we didn’t pay homage to the Surf Culture.   Hang Five IPA walks the nose with a blend of American hops. Layered bitterness dominates the bright straw body with a crisp dry finish that doesn’t linger for long.   A great introductory India Pale Ale for newcomers to the craft scene and those looking for a hoppy 7% punch.   Hops: Magnum, Falconer’s Flight, Centennial, HBC342

Name: Lionstone Savage IPA
Description: Our fiercely hopped India Pale Ale. Untamable!

Name: Santa Cruz Aleworks Pale
Description: Unfiltered and gold in color, this is our most bitter beer.  With more than 2 pounds of hops per barrel including dry hopping this beer is an explosion of citrus flavor that makes up what the West is really famous for….Our use of hops.

Name: Charter Oak Wadsworth IPA
Description: Charter Oak's Wadsworth India Pale Ale beer (named after Captain Joseph Wadsworth, for it was he who actually rode off to hide the Charter in the Charter Oak Tree)  is our American style IPA with plenty of hop aroma (dry hop twice) and a mild bitterness, yet crisp, refreshing and not over the top! Our Charter Oak IPA style will please your palate with more than your typical 'every day India Pale Ale' and you'll be sure to taste our grapefruit citrus overtone backed with notes of pine and floral aroma and taste. Our beer is a medium bodied beer with a rich amber shade. Plenty of choice, high Alpha hops that we hand select, yet well balanced, with no bite, and not too intense for the best and freshest locally brewed IPA from our specialty malted barley.

Name: Dogs Love Me Cause I’m Crazy Sniffable IPA
Bowen Main Sail ISA
Description: Malts: Pale Malt, Vienna, Melanoidin Hops: Nugget, Chinook, Centennial, Cascade  This light bodied session ale is easy drinking and lower in alcohol. With refreshing citrus and floral notes, this well balanced session ale has a light malt body and a medium level of bitterness. “The spray off the bow is refreshing in the warm sun. The whole day is perfect for sailing carrying the scent of the citrus and green fields over the bay. The sea is all smooth waves. The harbor breeze is light but steady"

Name: Mariner Northeast IPA
Description: Bright - Tropical - Juicy

Name: Bitter Brothers Little Brother Citra IPA
Description: This drinkable Citra IPA is a hop-forward ale that is ripe with citrus and tropical fruit.

Name: Field House Fresh Hop Sartori Sour IPA
Description: Our hands harvested these Columbia hop cones straight from the Sartori Hop Ranch in the beautiful Columbia Valley. These fresh hops met our sour red IPA, infusing this once-a-year brew with fresh green earthy flavours. Herbal notes meet fruity melon and tangy citrus, all nestled in a tart IPA.

Name: Dead Frog Fearless Imperial IPA
Description: A big bold Imperial IPA overflowing with tropical citrus flavour and aroma.  A hearty helping of premium malts and a massive amount of dry hopping result in a juicy, captivating finish that will blow you away.

Name: Temescal Citra Single Hop IPA
Description: We upped the dry hop for the second batch of this hazy IPA. Tons of sticky guava, mandarin orange zest, and sweet pineapple. The aroma on this beer is extremely explosive, and Ryan hates it because it has all those overripe tropical fruits that Mike likes. A slightly higher (for us) finishing gravity really plays up the sweet tropical fruits and I think really makes the beer “juicy”. Low bitterness, soft, juicy, this one really hits on all the Hazy IPA points that made these beers so different from West Coast IPA when they squeezed onto the scene.

Name: Swing Oil Pin Seeker IPA
Description: With Pin Seeker we've created a refreshing New England Style IPA using a heavy hand of hops. This blend will give you a punch of citrus and tropical fruit notes

Name: Liquid Hero Cloudoification Session IPA
Description: Light and refreshing with smooth cream-like consistency . Juicy hop forward flavor and aroma. Notes of tropical fruit, citrus, orange, melon and pear.

Name: Diamondback Brewing Green Machine IPA
Food Pairing: Cheese - Blue, Dessert - Fruit, Salads  Greens
Description: Unfiltered IPA dry hopped with Citra and Ella

Name: Two Roads Brewing and Evil Twin Brewing Thirteen Months Of Sun Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Thirteen Months of Sun is a collaboration with Evil Twin Brewing. Two Roads' head brewer, Phil Markowski, traveled to Ethiopia with Jeppe Jarnit-Bjergsø from Evil Twin where they met Henok Fentie from Sweden's Omnipollo Brewing to brew an IPA using Ethiopian ingredients including teff, a grain that was one of civilization's first cultivated crops ,and Ethiopian Sidamo coffee beans. The result is an original Ethiopian hazy IPA.

Name: Kings County Brewers Collective Superhero Sidekicks NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Ripe oranges, fresh pineapple & smooth pine. Mosaic, Idaho 7, Cascade & Centennial hops combine to deliver a powerful lupulin punch, backed by a balanced malt.

Name: Prairie Holiday Gift Pack
Description: American Double/Imperial Stout. This style of beer generally offers a very malt-forward dark body and high alcohol content. These are very dark in appearance and bold in flavors. Occasionally Barrel Aged. Please see package for more information.

Name: Stonecloud Brew’s Lee DIPA
Description: As the rival of the great Chug Norris, Brews Lee continues to hold the title of the greatest martial artist…I mean beer, that’s ever existed! Extremely tropical. Whole-lotta dank. Extra Hoppy. Mosaic. Double. IPA.

Name: 3 Floyds Hati Berserkers IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Our 3RD collaboration with the Mighty Amon Amarth! Inspired from the song “Skoll and Hati” from their newest album Berserker. Skoll and Hati were vicious wolves born of Fenrir. In North Mythology, they chased the sun and the moon creating night and day. For HATI, The Hater, who chases the Moon, we brewed a HAZY IPA – A very hoppy unfiltered IPA with loads of tropical and citrus aromas and flavors including pineapple, mango, lemongrass and grapefruit.

Name: Lone Pine Brewing Company Quantum Cuddle Kitten DIPA
Short Throw The Product
Description: This gem features 100% Mosaic hops for our triple dry-hopped Double India Pale Ale. All the aromas and flavors you'd expect from Mosaic hops, with a malt bill intended to have the hops shine for this incredibly, deceivingly drinkable DIPA.

Name: Brazos Valley Brewing Mama Tried IPA
Jughandle Hopshorne NE IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Jughandle Hopshorne NE IPA

Name: Newburgh Megaboss IPA
Description: “Mega Boss” (adj): meaning ‘radical’ or ‘awesome’ or ‘super duper’  3 years after we opened in 2012, we really think this whole IPA thing might be taking off…  So we bring you “MegaBoss IPA”, our American IPA loaded with 8 different hop varieties, showcasing some of our favorite IPA things: a rich pineapple & tropical fruit aroma, with a flavor profile that very much follows that aromatic start, concluding with a lemon & herbal hop finish.  At 7.0% ABV, it’s incredibly smooth & easy-drinking, with a bitterness that never overpowers the wonderful flavors from the many hops. An IPA to be enjoyed over & over again.

Name: Buglioni Ripasso Il Bugiardo
Description: Buglioni Il Bugiardo Valpolicella Classico Superiore DOC Ripasso

Name: Chapman Crafted Beer Zodiac Series Gemini
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
Description: Hazy IPA with Nelson, Simcoe & Galaxy hops

Name: Ghost Brewing Co. East Coast Ghost
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Local Craft Beer The Juice Is Triple Hazy IPA
Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA

Name: Two Sergeants 17 Pounder Left Coast IPA
Cushwa Billable Hours DIPA
Description: We bring to you a new DIPA, with ultra-smooth drinkability, yet still packs a strong hop punch. In this beer we used our favorite hop, Mosaic, and blended it with two new to us hops in Bru-1 and Topaz. This hop combination, and experimenting with temperatures during the brew process, has helped blend way to a tropical aroma, with a taste that follows in sweet tropical notes. This beer has a lush, soft mouthfeel and we hope you enjoy it fresh!

Name: Checkerspot Maximum Fruitage Blueberry IPA
Description: This NEIPA/Hazy IPA is brewed with more than 300 lbs of local sweet and sour cherries from Baugher's Orchard and Southern Passion, Nelson Sauvin and Barbe Rouge hops.

Name: Wander Shoe Toss Rye IPA
Description: Over 50 lbs. of hops go into each batch of this golden orange colored rye IPA creating a big citrusy treat. The addition of rye adds complexity to the flavor including a crisp spiciness on the palate. Hops include Washington grown Citra, Centennial, Summit and a healthy late kettle addition and dry hop of whole cone Ahtanum.

Name: Alcatraz 2x Double IPA
Description: Alcatraz 2X IPA is a bold India Pale Ale that is full of classic American hops featuring Cascade and Willamette clocking in at 100 IBUs. The lightly roasted malts create a copper colored ale that has a taste as iconic as the legendary island it is named after.

Name: Sumerian Holy Water IPA
Description: Nothing shy about our motive here! Showcasing one of the Northwest’s favorite hop, CITRA! A clean and crisp malt body boasts a delicate balance with our signature heavy handed late hopping addition.

Name: True Vine Daddy’s Juice Box Double IPA
Description: Being a grown-up means responsibilities galore but it also means getting grown-up treats. And we don’t mean fruit snacks and goldfish. We’re talking big, bold, 8.5% treats. Our Daddy’s Juice Box Double IPA is a big, juicy, hop declaration of a treat. With a full nose of tropical aromas from Mosaic, Citra and Simcoe hops along and a super smooth finish, this hop authority is sure to reward. So get your own juice box, kids. This one’s for daddy.

Name: Blank Brewing The One That Just Kicked Double IPA
Periodic Brewing Hope Pass IPA
Description: Made with an abundance of C-type hops and Victory malt, Hope Pass is built to be much easier drink than it is to climb the daunting Hope Pass of the Leadville Trail LT100. It’s a sweet forward IPA built on 4 different hops.

Description: A double imperial pale ale brewed with some of my favorite malts and hops

Name: FAB Johnny Get Your Ray Gun IPA
Description: Beer for art's sake!⁣

Fall River Brewing Lazy Hazy Northeastern IPA

Categories: ALE, IPA, New England  Hazy IPA
